papers.title: CAN We Trust Your Results? A Cross-Dataset Study of Automotive IDS Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: The increasing connectivity of modern vehicles has made securing in-vehicle communication networks a critical challenge. Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) have been widely studied as a defense mechanism for detecting malicious activities on the Controller Area Network (CAN) bus. However, the evaluation of CAN IDS methods remains difficult due to inconsistencies in experimental setups and the lack of standardized benchmarking frameworks. As a result, reported performance often depends on dataset-specific characteristics and may not reflect how detection methods behave in different environments. This work introduces a benchmarking framework for consistent evaluation of CAN IDSs across multiple datasets. Using the proposed framework, we integrate seven publicly available CAN IDS datasets collected under different experimental conditions and perform cross-dataset evaluation of five conceptually different IDS approaches. Our results highlight how detection performance can vary significantly across datasets, demonstrating the importance of cross-dataset benchmarking for assessing the robustness and generalization capabilities of CAN IDS methods.
papers.comment: Accepted at ACSW'26 Workshop on Automotive Cyber Security
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对汽车CAN总线入侵检测系统（IDS）评估中实验设置不一致和缺乏标准化基准的问题，提出了一个跨数据集评估框架。该框架整合了七个公开数据集，对五种不同的IDS方法进行了跨数据集评估。结果表明检测性能在不同数据集间存在显著差异，强调了跨数据集基准测试对评估IDS鲁棒性和泛化能力的重要性。
Motivation: 现有CAN IDS评估依赖于单一数据集，导致报告的性能可能具有数据集特异性，无法反映方法在不同环境下的表现，缺乏标准化基准框架。
Method: 提出了一个统一的基准测试框架，集成七个不同实验条件下收集的公开CAN IDS数据集，对五种概念上不同的IDS方法进行跨数据集评估。
Result: 检测性能在不同数据集间存在显著差异，表明跨数据集基准测试对评估IDS的鲁棒性和泛化能力至关重要。
Conclusion: 作者强调跨数据集评估的必要性，并认为当前单数据集评估结果不可靠，需要标准化框架以统一比较。

papers.title: Arko-T: A Foundation Model for Text-to-Structured 3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-3D systems can now synthesize a mechanical part from a single sentence, yet the result is a shape to render, not a design to edit. We present Arko-T, a 4B-parameter text-to-design model that maps natural-language intent directly into executable, parametric CAD programs. Rather than optimizing for code executability alone, Arko-T aligns every stage of the pipeline to a formal notion of design state, so that data curation, code normalization, and execution-grounded supervision all work to preserve the features, parameters, and construction logic that make a CAD artifact editable. Benchmarked against seven frontier LLMs across 12 metrics, Arko-T attains the best score on 8 and the second-best on 3 more, at roughly one-tenth the per-benchmark cost. The results suggest that targeted design-level training at moderate scale can match frontier general-purpose models on structured CAD generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Arko-T，一个40亿参数的文本到设计模型，将自然语言直接映射为可执行的参数化CAD程序。与传统文本到3D系统不同，Arko-T通过设计状态形式化概念对齐数据整理、代码规范化和执行监督，保留CAD工件的可编辑特征、参数和构造逻辑。在7个前沿LLM和12个指标上，Arko-T在8个上取得最佳，3个上次佳，成本约为十分之一。
Motivation: 现有文本到3D系统生成的只是形状用于渲染，而非可编辑的设计，缺乏对CAD构造逻辑的保留。
Method: 提出Arko-T模型，基于4B参数，通过设计状态形式化概念，对齐数据整理、代码规范化和执行监督，确保输出保留可编辑CAD工件的参数和逻辑。
Result: 在7个前沿LLM的12个指标上，Arko-T在8个上取得最佳，3个上次佳，成本约为十分之一。
Conclusion: 结果表明，中等规模的针对设计训练可以匹配前沿通用模型在结构化CAD生成上的性能。

papers.title: Proofs of Ownership for Machine Learning Models
papers.abstract_en: With the increasing adoption of Machine Learning, protecting model ownership has become an essential challenge. We initiate a formal study of Proof of Ownership for machine learning models: under what conditions can one prove that a stolen model originated from a particular creator? We model proofs of ownership as a game among three parties: a model owner, a thief, and a judge. The owner transforms the original model into a slightly perturbed model together with a proof of ownership. The thief then obtains the transformed model and attempts to minimally modify it so that it remains useful but escapes detection as owned by the model owner. Finally, the judge receives a model and a proof of ownership, and must decide whether the given model is a modified version of some model created by the model owner, or else the given model was developed independently. Our main result is a dichotomy for classifiers in the black-box setting: Under standard cryptographic assumptions, ownership of models for some concept class can be proven in the above sense {\em if and only if} the concept class is not self-correctable, in a sense close to that of Blum, Luby and Rubinfeld, STOC'90. The result is constructive and extends, with some variations, to a number of related settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对机器学习模型的拥有权证明问题进行形式化研究，定义了由模型所有者、窃取者和法官三方参与的博弈，并给出一个二分法结果：在标准密码学假设下，对于黑盒分类器，只有当概念类不可自纠正时才能证明所有权。
Motivation: 随着机器学习模型的广泛采用，保护模型所有权成为重要挑战，但缺乏严格的数学定义和可行性条件。
Method: 通过三方博弈（所有者、窃取者、法官）建模，将原始模型转换为轻微扰动模型并附带所有权证明，分析窃取者可能的最小修改；基于密码学假设和概念类的自纠正性质进行理论刻画。
Result: 在标准密码学假设下，黑盒分类器的所有权可证明当且仅当概念类不可自纠正（类似Blum-Luby-Rubinfeld定义）。该结果具有构造性并扩展到其他相关设置。
Conclusion: 提供了模型所有权证明的严格理论基础，但主要局限于黑盒分类器，且依赖于密码学假设和概念类的性质。

papers.title: OWMDrive: Causality-Aware End-to-End Autonomous Driving via 4D Occupancy World Model
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving systems are steadily moving toward end-to-end paradigms to mitigate the limited adaptability of rule-based pipelines in complex traffic environments. However, most existing learning-based methods still make decisions from static representations of the current scene, without explicit future rollouts or modeling of the temporal causal dynamics in traffic interactions. This limitation often results in unstable or overly conservative planning under high-uncertainty conditions, such as occlusions and unexpected events. To overcome these challenges, we introduce OWMDrive, a generative end-to-end driving framework built upon an Occupancy World Model for multi-step 3D occupancy forecasting, which serves as a conditional prior to guide diffusion-based planning. Conditioned on both current observations and predicted future states, the planner iteratively refines trajectory candidates to generate a reinforced driving trajectory. By explicitly modeling scene evolution over future horizons, OWMDrive captures key spatiotemporal causal dependencies, which leads to more foresighted and robust trajectory generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OWMDrive significantly improves planning reliability and safety, especially in challenging and partially observable driving scenarios.
papers.comment: International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OWMDrive，一种基于占用世界模型（Occupancy World Model）的生成式端到端自动驾驶框架，通过多步3D占用预测作为条件先验来指导扩散规划器，从而捕捉时空因果依赖关系，提升在高不确定性和部分可观测场景下的规划鲁棒性和安全性。
Motivation: 现有端到端方法多基于当前场景的静态表示进行决策，缺乏对未来展开和交通交互中时间因果动力学的显式建模，导致遮挡和突发等场景下规划不稳定或过于保守。
Method: 提出OWMDrive框架，包含占用世界模型用于多步3D占用预测，并作为条件先验指导扩散规划器；规划器基于当前观测和预测的未来状态迭代优化轨迹候选，生成增强的驾驶轨迹。
Result: 实验表明OWMDrive显著提升了规划可靠性和安全性，尤其是在具有挑战性和部分可观测的驾驶场景中。
Conclusion: 通过显式建模未来时间范围内的场景演化，捕捉时空因果依赖关系，生成更具前瞻性和鲁棒性的轨迹。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Experience Augmented Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, existing RLVR methods typically rely on on-policy optimization from scratch, resulting in high sampling costs and inefficient utilization of accumulated experience. As model capabilities and policy behaviors evolve during training, recent attempts to reuse experience via fixed reasoning trajectories further suffer from policy mismatch. Motivated by these limitations, we argue that experience in RLVR should not be reused as fixed reasoning trajectories, but instead expressed in a policy-adaptive manner. In this work, we propose Experience-Augmented Policy Optimization (EAPO), which leverages a prior RL-optimized policy as an action-level experience prior and selectively injects experience at critical decision points during rollout. To ensure stable and unbiased learning from experience-augmented rollouts, EAPO further incorporates an adapted importance sampling scheme. Experiments on using Qwen-2.5-math 7b and Qwen-3-8B on five different benchmarks demonstrate that EAPO consistently improves reasoning performance over state-of-the-art RLVR methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出经验增强策略优化（EAPO）方法，用于改进大语言模型推理能力的强化学习训练。EAPO利用先前RL优化策略作为动作级经验先验，在关键决策点选择性注入经验，并通过自适应重要性采样保证学习稳定。在Qwen系列模型和五个基准上，EAPO一致优于现有RLVR方法。
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法完全依赖在线策略优化，采样成本高且对积累经验利用效率低；直接复用固定推理轨迹又面临策略不匹配问题。
Method: 提出EAPO，将先前RL优化策略作为动作级经验先验，在rollout中关键决策点选择性注入经验，并采用改进的重要性采样确保无偏学习。
Result: 在Qwen-2.5-math 7B和Qwen-3-8B模型上，五个基准测试中EAPO一致提升推理性能，优于当前最优RLVR方法。
Conclusion: EAPO通过策略自适应的经验重用机制，提升了RLVR训练的样本效率和最终性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Point Estimates for Glaucoma Visual Field Forecasting with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting visual fields (VFs) is critical for personalized monitoring and treatment planning in glaucoma. This is inherently uncertain due to heterogeneous disease progression and measurement variability, yet most existing methods produce single deterministic predictions that fail to represent this uncertainty. We formulate VF forecasting as a probabilistic prediction problem and the use of conditioned denoising diffusion models to generate distributions of plausible future VFs from longitudinal observations with irregular follow-up intervals. Experiments on two independent VF cohorts show that diffusion-based predictions produce well-calibrated distributions for clinically relevant VF measures. When reduced to a standard point-estimate, the proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy compared to clinical baselines and prior learning-based methods. Our results highlight the advantages of distributional modeling for VF forecasting and support a shift from point-estimate prediction toward uncertainty-aware, clinically interpretable risk assessment in glaucoma.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用条件去噪扩散模型对青光眼视野进行概率预测，生成未来视野的分布。在三个独立视野队列上，扩散模型预测产生校准良好的分布；当简化为点估计时，与临床基线及先前学习方法相比达到SOTA准确性。
Motivation: 现有方法仅给出确定性点估计，无法表达青光眼视野预测中固有的不确定性（疾病进展异质性和测量变异性）。
Method: 将视野预测形式化为概率预测问题，使用条件去噪扩散模型从纵向观测（不规则随访间隔）生成未来视野的分布。
Result: 在三个独立视野队列上，扩散模型预测产生校准良好的分布；当简化为点估计时，与临床基线及先前学习方法相比达到SOTA准确性。
Conclusion: 分布建模在视野预测中具有优势，支持从点估计预测转向不确定性感知的临床可解释风险评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diffusion Fine-tuning with Rewarded Moment Matching Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Distillation and Reinforcement Learning (RL) fine-tuning are the primary pillars of diffusion post-training. While traditionally studied in isolation, the interaction between these phases remains poorly understood, and in particular how fine-tuning impacts the generative quality of distilled models. We introduce Rewarded Moment Matching Distillation (RMMD), a novel framework that simultaneously distills diffusion models and maximizes a reward function. RMMD preserves the high-fidelity ``naturalness'' characteristic of advanced distillation (such as 8-step Moment Matching) by adapting the sampling loop for on-policy training and repurposing the distillation loss as a proxy for integral KL regularization. By evaluating the FID-Reward Pareto fronts on ImageNet, we demonstrate that RMMD achieves superior trade-offs compared to single-step baselines (DI++) and multi-step competitors (DRaFT, HyperNoise). Finally, we apply RMMD to GenCast, a state-of-the-art weather forecasting model, to distill it while optimizing the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) metric. The resulting distilled model achieves a 7.5x speedup while outperforming the teacher model on 93% of target weather variables, and being better calibrated. This proves that RMMD scales to complex, high-dimensional scientific domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出奖励时刻匹配蒸馏（RMMD），一种同时进行扩散模型蒸馏和奖励函数最大化的框架。RMMD 通过将采样循环适配为在线训练并利用蒸馏损失作为积分 KL 正则化的代理，保留了高级蒸馏（如 8 步时刻匹配）的高保真自然性。在 ImageNet 上的 FID-奖励帕累托前沿评估显示，RMMD 相比单步基线（DI++）和多步竞争者（DRaFT、HyperNoise）实现了更优的权衡。进一步，将 RMMD 应用于天气预测模型 GenCast，在优化连续排序概率得分（CRPS）指标的同时进行蒸馏，所得蒸馏模型实现了 7.5 倍加速，在 93% 的目标天气变量上优于教师模型，且校准更好。
Motivation: 蒸馏和强化学习微调是扩散模型后训练的两大支柱，但两者之间的相互作用尚未被充分理解，尤其是微调如何影响蒸馏模型的生成质量。
Method: 提出奖励时刻匹配蒸馏（RMMD），通过在线训练适配采样循环，并将蒸馏损失重新用作积分 KL 正则化的代理，从而同时实现扩散模型蒸馏和奖励最大化。
Result: 在 ImageNet 上，RMMD 在 FID-奖励帕累托前沿上优于 DI++、DRaFT 和 HyperNoise。在 GenCast 天气预测模型上，实现 7.5 倍加速，在 93% 的目标天气变量上优于教师模型，且校准更好。
Conclusion: RMMD 能够扩展到复杂、高维的科学领域，通过同时蒸馏和奖励优化实现高效且高质量的模型。
Relevance: 90

papers.title: Can LLMs Rank? A Tale of Triads and Triage
papers.abstract_en: From housing allocation for households experiencing homelessness to triage in emergency departments, LLMs are increasingly being considered as judges of consequential decisions that require ranking people for scarce resources. Ranking large groups simultaneously is cognitively demanding and error-prone. A natural solution, drawing on decades of social choice theory, elicits pairwise comparisons and aggregates them into a total order. However, a fundamental question remains when LLMs serve as the pairwise judge: how can a practitioner tell, before committing to a ranking, whether the LLM's judgments are sufficiently consistent to trust the result? We discuss two different ways of identifying consistency. A classical diagnostic, the coefficient of consistency $ζ$, originally developed to measure judge reliability by counting circular triads in tournament graphs, provides a cheap, model-free measure of intra-run consistency. Various standard measures of distance between rankings, for example Kendall's $τ$, can measure inter-run variability. We show, in both theory and practice, that these measures are independently valuable, and advocate for using both to assess reliability of rankings. We demonstrate the practical importance of our results across two high-stakes prioritization tasks: homelessness service allocation and emergency department triage. Three different leading LLMs have considerably different performance profiles across these two axes of consistency. We provide guidelines for how practitioners could think about measuring and assessing consistency before committing to a model for ranking or prioritization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨大语言模型（LLM）在排序任务（如无家可归者住房分配和急诊科分诊）中的可靠性，提出使用经典一致性系数 ζ（通过循环三元组计数）和 Kendall's τ 距离分别衡量运行内一致性和运行间变异性。理论分析和实验表明这两种度量各自有价值，且不同LLM在一致性维度上表现差异显著。
Motivation: LLM被用于高风险的排序决策，但缺乏事前判断其判断一致性是否足够可靠的方法。
Method: 利用社会选择理论中的系数 ζ（检测循环三元组）和 Kendall's τ（测量排序间距离）来评估LLM排序的一致性。
Result: 在住房分配和急诊分诊两个任务上，三种主流LLM在两种一致性度量上表现不同，表明两者不可替代。
Conclusion: 建议实践者在采用LLM进行排序或优先级排序前，同时使用ζ和Kendall's τ评估可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond IID: How General Are Tabular Foundation Models, Really?
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models for predictive machine learning on tabular data have recently gained significant traction in academia and industry. Research communities across disciplines are increasingly evaluating tabular foundation models on diverse datasets and tasks. However, these task- and discipline-specific evaluations remain largely inaccessible to model researchers because benchmark software and evaluation protocols are fragmented. As a result, model researchers rely on standard benchmarks, which are mostly defined for tasks where tabular foundation models already excel. The most challenging scenarios are excluded, limiting meaningful progress in the field by focusing on marginal improvements on IID data rather than on broader, more demanding challenges. To overcome this, we introduce BeyondArena, the first unified holistic benchmark for tabular data that supports diverse task types (IID, temporal, grouped), across sample size and feature dimensionality scales, with diverse feature types (with text, with high cardinality) from a broad range of disciplines. To enable unified benchmarking beyond standard benchmarks, we introduce Data Foundry, a Python framework and metadata schema for curating tabular datasets for predictive machine learning. Our results across 11 models and 142 curated datasets show that existing tabular foundation models excel on tiny- to medium-sized IID data, while traditional tree-based and deep learning models still dominate on non-IID, large, and high-dimensional datasets. BeyondArena guides model research for the most demanding challenges in tabular data, enabling progress towards truly foundational tabular models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BeyondArena，一个统一的表格数据基准测试，支持IID、时间序列、分组等任务类型，覆盖多种数据规模和特征类型。通过对11个模型和142个数据集的评估发现，现有表格基础模型在中小规模IID数据上表现优异，但传统树模型和深度学习模型在非IID、大规模、高维数据上仍占主导。
Motivation: 当前表格基础模型的评估碎片化，标准基准只覆盖模型已擅长的IID任务，缺乏对非IID、大规模、高维等更具挑战性场景的测试，限制了实质性进展。
Method: 提出BeyondArena基准测试和Data Foundry框架，用于统一策划和评估不同任务类型和规模的表格数据集。
Result: 实验发现现有表格基础模型在中小规模IID数据上表现最佳，而传统树模型和深度学习模型在非IID、大规模、高维数据集上仍占主导。
Conclusion: BeyondArena引导模型研究聚焦最挑战性的表格数据问题，推动真正的表格基础模型进步。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: SA-Homo: Scale Adaptive Homography Estimation for Scale Variation Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Homography estimation, as one of the fundamental problems in computer vision, remains challenged by scale variation scenarios where image pairs potentially exhibit significant scale discrepancies. Existing deep learning frameworks frequently suffer from a significant performance degradation in such cases, as they rely on limited displacement assumptions and local feature consistency that might not hold under large scale gaps. In this paper, we propose SA-Homo, a novel scale-adaptive homography estimation framework designed to achieve robust alignment across a wide range of scale discrepancy ratios. We adopt a hierarchical scale alignment strategy that transitions from the global perspective with a heavy module to a local perspective with a light module. Specifically, we introduce the Scale-aware Discrepancy Bridging Module (SDBM) for initial alignment, which utilizes a Multi-scale Linear Attention Cascade (MLAC) to capture long-range dependencies and mitigate feature inconsistencies, along with a global Cross-scale Similarity Matrix Block (CSMB) for scale robust correlation representation. Once the initial scale gap is bridged, a lightweight Iterative Homography Estimation Refinement Module (IHERM) progressively polishes the result using local correlations. To facilitate this research, we contribute the HMSA dataset, a high-resolution, multi-modal satellite benchmark specifically tailored for scale-variant challenges. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SA-Homo maintains high precision even under 8$\times$ scale discrepancies, outperforming state-of-the-art methods in both conventional scale-similar scenarios and challenging scale variation scenarios. Code and collected datasets are available at https://github.com/shangxuanx330/SA_Homo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SA-Homo，一种针对图像尺度变化场景的自适应单应性估计框架。采用分层尺度对齐策略，通过全局视角的Scale-aware Discrepancy Bridging Module（SDBM）进行初始对齐，再使用轻量级Iterative Homography Estimation Refinement Module（IHERM）逐步细化。贡献了高分辨率多模态卫星基准数据集HMSA。实验表明，即使在8倍尺度差异下仍保持高精度，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有单应性估计方法在图像存在显著尺度差异时性能严重下降，因为它们依赖小位移假设和局部特征一致性，而大尺度间隙下这些假设不成立。
Method: 提出分层尺度对齐框架：先通过SDBM（含Multi-scale Linear Attention Cascade和Cross-scale Similarity Matrix Block）从全局视角捕获长程依赖并建立尺度鲁棒的相关性，再通过轻量IHERM利用局部相关性迭代细化结果。
Result: 在HMSA等数据集上，SA-Homo在8倍尺度差异下仍保持高精度，在常规尺度和挑战性尺度变化场景下均优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 所提框架有效解决了尺度变化下的单应性估计问题，高分辨率卫星基准HMSA可促进相关研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MOPD: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Capability Integration in LLM Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models (LLMs) rely on reinforcement learning during post-training to push specific capabilities, yet integrating multiple capabilities into one model remains hard. Existing methods, such as Off-Policy Finetune and Mix-RL, are either inefficient or lose performance. In this work, we propose Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), a post-training paradigm for combining the capabilities of multiple domain RL teachers: we first run per-domain specialised RL to obtain a set of domain teachers, then distill these teachers into the student on its own rollouts. This eliminates exposure bias and provides a dense optimization signal. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, MOPD outperforms Mix-RL, Cascade RL, Off-Policy Finetune, and Param-Merge baselines, inheriting nearly all of each teacher's capability. MOPD also enables parallel, independent development of domain teachers, removing the cross-domain coupling typical of multi-domain post-training. MOPD has been deployed in the post-training of MiMo-V2-Flash, an industrial-scale frontier model, demonstrating its practical value for capability integration in frontier-scale LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）方法，用于大型语言模型后训练中集成多个领域强化学习教师的能力。MOPD先对每个领域进行专门RL训练获得教师，然后在学生自身的rollout上进行蒸馏，避免了曝光偏差并提供密集优化信号。在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，MOPD优于Mix-RL、Cascade RL、Off-Policy Finetune和Param-Merge基线，几乎继承了每位教师的全部能力，并已部署到工业级模型MiMo-V2-Flash的后训练中。
Motivation: 现代LLM后训练中，集成多个能力到单一模型仍然困难，现有方法如Off-Policy Finetune和Mix-RL要么效率低，要么性能受损。
Method: 提出多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）：先为每个领域运行专门的强化学习训练获得一组领域教师，然后在学生自身的rollout上对这些教师进行蒸馏，消除曝光偏差并提供密集优化信号。
Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，MOPD在所有基线上表现最佳，几乎完全继承了每位教师的能力；该方法已成功部署到工业级前沿模型MiMo-V2-Flash中。
Conclusion: MOPD作为一种后训练范式，能够有效集成多个领域RL教师的能力，支持并行独立开发领域教师，消除跨领域耦合，具有实际应用价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ENC-ODE: Event-level Neurodegenerative Modeling in Continuous Time with Neural ODEs
papers.abstract_en: Accurately predicting the temporal evolution of clinical biomarkers is crucial for the early diagnosis and management of neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease. However, this relies on longitudinal data to capture biomarker changes over time, which is often sparse and irregular due to the high cost, labor-intensive nature, and patient burden. To address these challenges, we propose ENC-ODE, an Event-level Neurodegenerative modeling in Continuous time with neural Ordinary Differential Equations. ENC-ODE predicts future biomarker evolution by modeling clinical events through diagnosis-conditioned continuous dynamics. A target-conditioned attention mechanism weights and aggregates event-level predictions for the target time and modality without history compression. Extensive experiments on Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) dataset demonstrate that ENC-ODE outperforms representative sequence models while offering a scalable and neuroscientifically grounded solution for clinical support. The code is available at https://github.com/JardinDelSol/enc-ode.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ENC-ODE，一种基于神经常微分方程 (neural ODE) 的连续时间事件级神经退行性疾病建模方法。该方法通过诊断条件连续动态建模临床事件，预测生物标志物的未来演变，并利用目标条件注意力机制加权聚合事件级预测。在 ADNI 数据集上的实验表明，ENC-ODE 优于代表性序列模型，为临床支持提供了可扩展且神经科学合理的解决方案。
Motivation: 纵向临床数据稀疏且不规则，难以准确捕捉神经退行性疾病生物标志物随时间的变化，早期诊断和管理面临挑战。
Method: 提出 ENC-ODE，使用神经 ODE 对临床事件进行诊断条件连续动态建模，并通过目标条件注意力机制加权聚合事件级预测，无需历史压缩。
Result: 在 ADNI 数据集上，ENC-ODE 优于代表性序列模型，展示了更好的预测性能。
Conclusion: ENC-ODE 为神经退行性疾病生物标志物演化预测提供了可扩展、神经科学合理的临床支持方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Model Predictive Current Control with Harmonic Correction for Single-Phase AC-DC EV Charging
papers.abstract_en: The increasing integration of Electric Vehicles (EVs) has imposed a growing harmonic challenge on the power grid. For AC/DC Power Factor Correction (PFC) in single-phase On-Board Chargers (OBCs), Model Predictive Current Control (MPCC) improves the current quality by predicting and tracking the inductor current. However, finite control set MPCC selects switching states, resulting in discrete control actions and a limited optimisation space. Moreover, the MPCC cost function based on instantaneous current tracking error has limited capability to compensate for low-order harmonic disturbances induced by dead time, control delay, and model parameter mismatch. This paper proposes a duty cycle predictive MPCC incorporating a real-time harmonic estimation reference. The proposed method dynamically estimates the low-order harmonic components of the input current and corrects the MPCC reference current, enabling continuous duty cycle control and targeted suppression of dominant low-order harmonics. Simulation results on a single-phase OBC demonstrate that the proposed duty cycle predictive MPCC reduces the steady-state current THD_i from 11.47% to 6.10% compared with the switching state predictive MPCC. With the harmonic reference, the THD_i is further reduced to 2.85%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单相车载充电器(AC-DC OBC)中的模型预测电流控制(MPCC)提出了一种结合谐波校正的占空比预测MPCC方法。通过实时估计输入电流的低次谐波分量并校正MPCC参考电流，实现了连续占空比控制并有效抑制低次谐波。仿真结果表明，相比开关状态预测MPCC，稳态电流THDi从11.47%降至6.10%，进一步引入谐波参考后降至2.85%。
Motivation: 电动汽车的广泛接入对电网引入了谐波问题，而传统有限控制集MPCC因离散开关状态和基于瞬时电流跟踪误差的代价函数，难以有效补偿由死区、控制延迟和参数失配引起的低次谐波。
Method: 提出一种占空比预测MPCC，包含实时谐波估计参考模块：动态估计输入电流的低次谐波分量，并以此修正MPCC的参考电流，实现连续占空比控制并针对性地抑制主要低次谐波。
Result: 在单相OBC仿真中，所提占空比预测MPCC将稳态电流THDi从开关状态预测MPCC的11.47%降低至6.10%；进一步加入谐波参考后，THDi降至2.85%。
Conclusion: 所提方法能有效降低单相PFC变换器的电流谐波，提升电能质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SADL: What to Ignore? A Benchmark for Subject-Aware Distractor Localization
papers.abstract_en: Photographs frequently contain \emph{visual distractors} besides foregrounds and backgrounds of the intended subject, competing for attention and weakening composition. While modern editing tools streamline object removal, identifying which objects to remove remains a mostly manual process. Existing saliency models and open-vocabulary detectors operate without subject awareness, failing to adapt to shifting user intent. Furthermore, context-agnostic removal may disrupt the scene's semantic coherence (e.g., keep the person but remove the chair they are sitting on). To address these limitations, we formalize the task of subject-aware distractor localization, which identifies distractors while retaining compositionally essential objects. This paper introduces \textsc{SADL}, the first real-world benchmark for this task, comprising 1,800 subject-aware cases across 1,000 photographs to enable systematic evaluation and facilitate future research. In total, there are 14,617 annotated candidates, including a robust set of 1,938 hard negatives to stress-test exclusion calibration. We evaluate seven proprietary and open-weight Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on a sequential pipeline of distractor classification followed by exclusion filtering, structured around five inclusion factors and three contextual exclusion rules. Our analysis reveals that VLMs are highly capable of identifying distractors, but then over-apply exclusion, which systematically suppresses true distractors at scale. By exposing this critical bottleneck, \textsc{SADL} provides a foundational diagnostic tool to advance subject-conditioned reasoning in multimodal systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 SADL，首个用于主体感知干扰物定位的真实世界基准，包含 1,800 个主体感知案例和 14,617 个候选注释。评估了七个视觉-语言模型在干扰物分类和排除过滤流水线上的表现，发现模型虽能识别干扰物但过度排除，导致真实干扰物被系统抑制。
Motivation: 现有编辑工具在识别干扰物时依赖人工，显著性模型和开放词汇检测器缺乏主体感知，无法适应不同用户意图，且上下文无关的移除可能破坏场景语义一致性。
Method: 形式化主体感知干扰物定位任务，构建包含 1,800 个案例、14,617 个候选注释的基准，其中包括 1,938 个硬负样本。评估七个 VLM 在干扰物分类和排除过滤流水线上的表现，结构围绕五个包含因子和三个上下文排除规则。
Result: VLM 能有效识别干扰物，但过度应用排除规则，导致系统性地抑制真实干扰物。
Conclusion: SADL 暴露了 VLM 在主体感知推理中的关键瓶颈，可作为诊断工具推动多模态系统的发展。

papers.title: Predict, Reuse, and Repair: Accelerating Dynamic Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic sparse attention (DSA) accelerates long-context LLM decoding by attending to only the top-K KV blocks relevant to each query, but it introduces a serialized selection-to-attention dependency that emerges as a new latency bottleneck. We present PRR, a speculate-reuse-repair runtime that exploits temporal locality in DSA selections to predict likely blocks, speculate the attention over them while selection is in flight, and incrementally repair missed blocks once the true selected set is known. PRR uses a lightweight EMA-based predictor, a profiling-guided speculation budget that keeps speculative work off the critical path, and a FlashAttention-based repair kernel that folds missed blocks into the partial attention state using online-softmax statistics. Across long-context benchmarks and representative DSA methods, PRR reduces per-token decoding latency by up to 40% while preserving downstream task accuracy. Github: https://github.com/Tianyu9748/Incremental_FlashAttention
papers.comment: 9 pages body plus 3 pages appendix, 13 pages total
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRR 运行时系统，利用动态稀疏注意力（DSA）中的时间局部性，通过预测、重用和修复机制加速长上下文 LLM 解码。PRR 使用轻量 EMA 预测器、轮廓引导的推测预算和基于 FlashAttention 的修复内核，在保持下游任务准确率的同时，将每 token 解码延迟降低高达 40%。
Motivation: 动态稀疏注意力（DSA）通过仅关注与每个查询最相关的 top-K KV 块来加速长上下文解码，但其串行的选择-注意依赖关系成为新的延迟瓶颈。
Method: PRR 采用推测-重用-修复方法：利用 EMA 预测未来查询的 top-K 块，在真实选择完成前推测性计算注意力，并通过在线 softmax 统计增量合并遗漏的块。
Result: 在多个长上下文基准测试和代表性 DSA 方法上，PRR 将每 token 解码延迟降低最多 40%，且不损害下游任务准确率。
Conclusion: PRR 有效解决了 DSA 中串行依赖导致的延迟瓶颈，通过时间局部性预测和增量修复实现加速，且保持模型输出质量。

papers.title: A Stochastic--Geometric Theory of Scaling Laws in Grokking
papers.abstract_en: Delayed generalization (\ie~grokking) refers to the phenomenon in which a neural network fits its training data early in training but only begins to generalize after a prolonged delay, often through an abrupt transition. Despite extensive empirical study, its underlying mechanism remains poorly understood. In this work, we first theoretically characterize a shell--core topological configuration of the reachable solution space induced by Adam's optimization dynamics with weight-shrinkage regularization, supported by empirical evidence. This optimization-induced topological configuration gives rise to grokking. In model's parameter space, random initialization solutions concentrate on a thin outer spherical shell, enclosing another spherical shell of memorization solutions, which in turn contains a core corresponding to the generalization solutions. Leveraging stopping-time theory, we then analyze the geometry of this topological configuration and the solution transition time at which optimization trajectories escape the memorization manifold and first reach the boundary of the generalization manifold. Our theoretical analysis derives grokking scaling laws for the learning rate, batch size, and $\ell_2$ regularization coefficient, which are further validated through experiments and shown to recover results from prior literature.

Motivation: 尽管grokking现象被广泛研究，但其底层机制仍不清楚。本文旨在通过随机-几何理论提供理论解释。
Method: 首先理论刻画Adam优化和权重衰减导致的壳-核拓扑结构，然后利用停时理论分析优化轨迹从记忆流形逃逸并首次到达泛化流形边界的过渡时间，从而推导缩放定律。
Result: 推导出学习率、batch size和L2正则化系数的grokking缩放定律，并通过实验验证，能够复现先前文献的结果。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一种理论框架解释grokking，并通过缩放定律给出可验证的预测。

papers.title: Scalar Representations of Neural Network Training Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Training in artificial neural networks can be viewed as a trajectory evolving through a high-dimensional loss landscape. However, the large number of trainable parameters makes the direct analysis of these dynamics challenging. In this work, we treat such training trajectories as temporal networks and apply recently proposed strategies for the scalar embedding of temporal networks. We investigate whether such a scalar embedding provides a meaningful low-dimensional representation of neural network training dynamics. Using a multilayer perceptron trained on the MNIST classification task, we show that the embedding preserves the main dynamical features observed in the original parameter space, including the emergence of sensitivity to initial conditions for specific learning rate regimes and an accurate reconstruction of the network's maximum Lyapunov exponent. We then use the embedded scalar trajectory to define a characteristic time, analogous to a Lyapunov time, after which the exponential separation between initially close embedded trajectories saturates. This characteristic time captures the typical decorrelation time between initially close network trajectories in the original high-dimensional system. Finally, we investigate the statistical organization of asymptotic training states through a spacing observable defined in the embedded space. We find that the distributions of rescaled asymptotic spacings collapse onto a common form across initial conditions and are compatible with a skew lognormal distribution. Altogether, our results suggest that scalar low-dimensional embeddings provide a useful framework for studying and visualizing the dynamical properties of neural network optimization trajectories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将神经网络训练轨迹视为时间网络，并应用标量嵌入方法获取低维表示。在MNIST分类任务的多层感知器上，该嵌入保留了原始参数空间的主要动力学特征，包括对初始条件的敏感性和最大Lyapunov指数的重建。通过嵌入轨迹定义的特征时间与Lyapunov时间类似，描述了轨迹分离的饱和时间。渐近训练状态的间距分布在重新标度后呈偏对数正态分布。
Motivation: 神经网络训练轨迹在高维损失景观中难以直接分析，亟需一种低维表示来捕捉关键动力学特征。
Method: 将训练轨迹建模为时间网络，采用近期提出的标量嵌入策略，将高维参数轨迹映射为标量时间序列。
Result: 在MNIST任务上，标量嵌入准确恢复了最大Lyapunov指数，并定义了饱和特征时间。渐近训练状态的间距分布经重新标度后呈现统一的偏对数正态形式。
Conclusion: 标量低维嵌入为研究和可视化神经网络优化轨迹的动力学性质提供了一个有用的框架。

papers.title: Whose Side Is Your Agent On? Multi-Party Principal Loyalty in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: A rapidly growing class of LLM agents is multi-party: the agent acts for a principal (who briefs it, sends follow-ups, and receives results) while also conversing in a separate channel with a counterparty whose interests may diverge (negotiating with a vendor, screening inbound requests, or mediating between employees). Here "help whoever you are talking to" is the wrong objective. The agent must stay loyal to the principal it represents without over-refusing the principal's own cooperative asks. We study this multi-party loyalty problem and contribute a measurement instrument, two mechanisms, and a structural lesson. PrincipalBench is a 75-item multi-turn benchmark with leak probes, dual judges, and an integrity-audit gate. Across 13 frontier subjects it exposes a sharp split (<=20% vs. 53.6-75.3% harm) invisible to single-turn safety evaluations: a selective cluster that declines adversarial probes while still following the principal's legitimate requests, and an over-refusing cluster that refuses broadly. (M1) A prompt-time loyalty scaffold (a fixed system prompt of seven prioritized rules, open-coded from 50+ failure trajectories) holds Claude-Sonnet to 19.4% harm and all nine selective subjects to <=20%. (M2) A per-token-KL distillation recipe transfers a prompted Qwen3-32B teacher into 8B Qwen3 and Llama-3.1 students, the strongest open-weight recipe we measure. (Lesson) Both mechanisms only move along a common leak/over-refusal trade-off rather than crossing it: improving one axis costs the other, and the jointly favorable outcome stays out of reach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多主体LLM代理中代理对委托人忠诚度的问题，即代理既要与对手方对话又要忠实于委托人。作者提出了一个75项的多轮基准PrincipalBench，测试表明前沿模型存在明显分裂：拒绝攻击性提示但遵从合法请求的一类，以及广泛拒绝的一类。提出了两种机制：提示时忠诚框架和蒸馏配方，但两者仅在泄露/过度拒绝权衡上移动，未能同时改善两者。
Motivation: 在多主体场景中，LLM代理需要忠诚于委托人（Principal），同时与利益可能冲突的对手方（Counterparty）交互。现有单轮安全评估无法捕捉这种多轮忠诚度问题，导致模型要么泄露信息，要么过度拒绝。
Method: 构建了PrincipalBench基准，包含75个多轮任务，带有泄漏探测、双重裁判和完整性审计。然后提出两种机制：(M1) 提示时忠诚框架，使用7条优先规则的固定系统提示；(M2) per-token-KL蒸馏，将Qwen3-32B教师蒸馏到8B学生模型。
Result: 在13个前沿模型上，PrincipalBench显示出一个明显的分裂：选择性集群拒绝攻击性提示同时遵从合法请求（危害率≤20%），而过度拒绝集群广泛拒绝（危害率53.6-75.3%）。M1将Claude-Sonnet的危害率降至19.4%，所有9个选择性模型降至≤20%。M2是作者测量到的最强开放权重蒸馏配方。但两种机制都只能沿着泄露/过度拒绝权衡移动，无法跨过该权衡。
Conclusion: 论文强调，目前的方法只能沿着泄露/过度拒绝权衡移动，无法同时实现低泄露和低过度拒绝，需要新的思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RenderFormer++: Scalable and Physically Grounded Feed-Forward Neural Rendering
papers.abstract_en: We present RenderFormer++, a scalable and physically grounded feed-forward neural rendering framework for global illumination in mesh scenes. Existing Transformer-based neural rendering methods such as RenderFormer achieve promising cross-scene generalization, but suffer from limited physical consistency and poor scalability due to the quadratic attention complexity of triangle-level tokenization. To address these issues, we introduce Physics-Informed Transport Guidance (PITG), which embeds rendering-equation inductive biases into the attention mechanism and enforces transport consistency loss, enabling physically consistent light transport modeling. We further propose Hierarchical Object-Centric Tokenization (HOCT), which aggregates triangle-level features into compact object-level tokens via cross-attention with learnable queries, substantially reducing computational and memory costs while preserving geometric and radiometric information. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RenderFormer++ achieves scalable, stable, and generalizable feed-forward global illumination rendering across complex large-scale scenes with improved physical accuracy and efficiency over prior neural rendering methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RenderFormer++ 提出一种可扩展且物理一致的前馈神经渲染框架，用于网格场景全局光照。通过引入物理信息传输指导（PITG）将渲染方程归纳偏置嵌入注意力机制，并提出层次化物体中心标记化（HOCT）将三角形级特征聚合为紧凑的物体级令牌，降低计算和内存成本。实验表明，该方法在大规模复杂场景中实现了可扩展、稳定且泛化的前馈全局光照渲染，物理准确性和效率优于以往方法。
Motivation: 现有基于Transformer的神经渲染方法（如RenderFormer）尽管跨场景泛化能力强，但因三角形级标记化导致的二次注意力复杂度而存在物理一致性差和可扩展性不足的问题。
Method: 提出物理信息传输指导（PITG），在注意力机制中嵌入渲染方程归纳偏置并施加传输一致性损失；提出层次化物体中心标记化（HOCT），通过可学习查询的交叉注意力将三角形级特征聚合为紧凑的物体级令牌。
Result: 在复杂大规模场景中实现可扩展、稳定且泛化的前馈全局光照渲染，物理精度和效率优于此前方法。
Conclusion: 该框架提升了神经渲染的物理一致性和可扩展性，适用于复杂网格场景的全局光照。

papers.title: OmniCoT: A Benchmark for Global and Multi-Step Panoramic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated promising spatial reasoning capabilities, while these abilities remain underexplored in the emerging visual modality of panoramic imagery. The full 360°$\times$180° field of view of panoramas essentially supports complex global multi-step reasoning, which is also the fundamental advantage of panoramas in applications such as embodied intelligence. However, existing panoramic benchmarks largely focus on simplistic queries that rely on local cues or single-/few-step reasoning, thereby ignoring the fundamental advantage of panoramas and failing to fully exploit their potential. To address this gap, we introduce OmniCoT, a panoramic spatial reasoning suite designed to enable MLLMs to use global evidence and perform multi-step inference across viewpoints. It includes OmniCoT-B (6.7K data) for evaluation, which measures both answer accuracy and reasoning quality, OmniCoT-Real (1K data) as a manually annotated real-world subset to quantify the Sim-to-Real gap. For training, OmniCoT-T (14.3K data) is purpose-built with structured stepwise Chain-of-Thought annotations that explicitly link intermediate reasoning steps to panoramic evidence. Based on OmniCoT-T, we introduce OmniCoT-R1 and adopt a two-stage training strategy tailored to the geometrically complex panoramic space, where Supervised Fine-tuning (SFT) anchors reasoning to panoramic evidence (e.g., bearings, proximity) and GRPO penalizes geometrically incoherent paths to consolidate global 360° spatial consistency. Through OmniCoT, we aim to recalibrate the difficulty of panoramic spatial reasoning to better align with the intrinsic capabilities of panoramic imagery, thereby fostering meaningful progress in this research area.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniCoT，一个全景空间推理基准套件，旨在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）利用全局证据进行多步推理的能力。包括评估集OmniCoT-B（6.7K数据）、真实世界子集OmniCoT-Real（1K数据）和训练集OmniCoT-T（14.3K数据），并引入两阶段训练策略（SFT+GRPO）增强全景空间一致性。
Motivation: 现有全景基准多依赖局部线索或单步推理，未能充分发挥全景图像支持全局多步推理的固有优势，制约了MLLMs在全景空间中的应用。
Method: 构建OmniCoT基准，包含结构化逐步思维链（CoT）注释的训练集；采用两阶段训练：SFT将推理锚定于全景证据（如方位、邻近度），GRPO惩罚几何不一致路径以强化全局360°空间一致性。
Result: 摘要未报告具体量化结果，但声称通过OmniCoT可重新校准全景空间推理难度，推动领域进展。
Conclusion: OmniCoT旨在弥合现有基准与全景图像自身能力之间的差距，促进MLLMs在全景空间推理中的有意义进步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FlowAWR: Online Adaptive Flow Reinforcement via Advantage-Weighted Rectification
papers.abstract_en: Aligning generative flow models on continuous spaces via online reinforcement learning is constrained by intractable trajectory likelihoods. Existing density-approximated policy gradient methods rely on stochastic SDE samplers to construct tractable transition kernels, which introduce training-inference inconsistencies and necessitates Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG). While implicit frameworks such as DiffusionNFT directly optimize forward-process velocity fields, its heuristic fixed-magnitude corrections prevent optimization strength from relative intra-group quality. We propose \textit{Flow Advantage-Weighted Rectification} (\textbf{FlowAWR}), a paradigm that recasts continuous generative policy optimization as supervised regression toward a theoretically optimal velocity field. Starting from the optimal policy of a KL-constrained reward maximization, FlowAWR derives the optimal velocity field that admits a magnitude-aware, advantage-weighted rectification form, yielding SDE-free optimization and CFG-free generation. In comparative evaluations on SD3.5-Medium, FlowAWR achieves improved alignment performance alongside a 2$\times$ to 5$\times$ convergence acceleration over DiffusionNFT (e.g., reaching a 24.12 PickScore in 1.2k steps, versus 23.82 in 2.0k steps for DiffusionNFT and 23.50 in $>$4k steps for FlowGRPO). Under multi-reward constraints, FlowAWR sustains generation quality, satisfying structural rules while maintaining stable out-of-domain performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出FlowAWR，一种用于连续空间中生成流模型的在线强化学习方法，通过优势加权校正将策略优化转化为有监督回归，避免了SDE采样和分类器引导，在SD3.5-Medium上加速收敛2-5倍。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖密度近似的策略梯度，需要随机SDE采样导致训练-推理不一致，且需分类器引导；隐式框架（如DiffusionNFT）使用固定幅度校正，无法根据相对质量调整优化强度。
Method: FlowAWR从KL约束奖励最大化的最优策略出发，推导出具有幅度感知、优势加权校正形式的最优速度场，实现免SDE优化和免CFG生成。

Conclusion: FlowAWR通过优势加权校正将在线连续生成策略优化简化为有监督回归，在加速收敛的同时避免SDE和CFG，提升了训练-推理一致性。

papers.title: Set-Inclusive Uncertainty Modeling for Robust Brain Tumor Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal MRI is essential for accurate brain tumor segmentation. However, acquiring all modalities at inference is often challenging in practice, which causes intrinsic uncertainty due to unavoidable information loss. Without modeling this uncertainty, existing methods encode incomplete evidence into deterministic representations that appear plausible but lack reliability. In this regime, we propose a probabilistic representation framework that models representations as Gaussian distributions, where their mean captures task information and their variance measures uncertainty from missing evidence. To make variance reflect information deficiency, we regularize the mean from each partial configuration toward its full-modality counterpart, while scaling the variance with the discrepancy between their aligned means. We further introduce a set-inclusive strategy that exploits the hierarchical structure of modality subsets and enforces an ordering constraint to maintain their consistent uncertainty relationships. Extensive experiments on BraTS 2018 and 2020 demonstrate that our approach offers superior performance over baselines across diverse missing-modality scenarios. Code and model checkpoint are available at https://github.com/atlas-sky/SIUM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态MRI在推理时部分模态缺失导致的不确定性，提出概率表示框架。将特征建模为高斯分布，均值与方差分别刻画任务信息与缺失证据带来的不确定性，并通过集合包含策略利用模态子集的层次结构保持一致的序关系。在BraTS 2018/2020上的实验表明，该方法在多种缺失模态场景下优于基线。
Motivation: 实际中获取所有MRI模态困难，缺失模态导致信息损失，现有方法将不完整证据编码为确定性表示，缺乏可靠性。
Method: 将表示建模为高斯分布，用均值捕获任务信息、方差度量缺失证据的不确定性；通过正则化使部分模态的均值逼近完整模态均值，并以对齐均值的差异缩放方差；引入集合包含策略利用模态子集的层次结构，施加有序约束保持不确定性关系一致。
Result: 在BraTS 2018和BraTS 2020上，该方法在多种缺失模态场景下性能优于基线。
Conclusion: 所提出的概率表示框架能有效建模缺失模态带来的不确定性，提升分割鲁棒性。代码和模型已开源。

papers.title: Using Large Language Models as Low-Cost Statistical Estimators for Human-Response Data
papers.abstract_en: Quantitative research across the social and behavioral sciences depends on human subject experiments that are expensive, slow, and subject to sampling bias. Here we show that pretrained large language models induce risk-equivalent estimators of conditional expectations under squared loss, establishing restricted functional risk equivalence: under squared loss, the LLM induces an estimator whose risk matches the Bayes optimal risk for squared-loss prediction of conditional expectations for any inference that depends on the data only through the conditional mean. We formalize the LLM as a misspecified functional estimator $T(\hat{P}_n)$ trained on i.i.d.\ data, decompose the estimation error into representation bias $ε_{\mathrm{rep}}$ and optimization error, and prove that under mild regularity conditions the LLM's expected error converges to the irreducible population variance plus the squared representation bias, with the representation bias bounded by the Pinsker inequality. The identifiability error $δ$ propagates into the effective bias, inflating the asymptotic risk floor. We establish restricted functional risk equivalence via a bidirectional Le Cam deficiency analysis: the forward deficiency vanishes asymptotically while the reverse deficiency is exactly zero. We provide finite-sample concentration bounds and a calibration protocol with explicit decision rules. The result is a precise, provable statement: a well-calibrated LLM achieves the Bayes-optimal risk for conditional-mean-dependent inference, bounded by explicit scope conditions. In practical applications, this means that under satisfied conditions and well-calibrated models, large language models can be used in many prediction and decision-making tasks that originally relied on human experiments, approximating near-optimal statistical inference at lower cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明预训练大语言模型（LLM）在均方误差下可以诱导出风险等价的估计量，从而取代昂贵、缓慢且有抽样偏差的人类实验。通过将LLM视为在独立同分布数据上训练的设定有偏函数估计器，作者将估计误差分解为表征偏差与优化误差，证明其期望误差收敛到不可约总体方差加上平方表征偏差，并通过双向Le Cam缺陷分析建立受限函数风险等价性。最终结论是：经过良好校准的LLM在条件均值依赖的推理任务中能达到贝叶斯最优风险，从而以更低成本近似最优统计推断。
Motivation: 社会科学与行为科学的定量研究依赖昂贵、缓慢且存在抽样偏差的人类实验，亟需低成本的替代统计估计方法。
Method: 将LLM视为在i.i.d.数据上训练的设定有偏函数估计器，通过分解误差为表征偏差和优化误差，并利用Pinsker不等式、有限样本浓度界及双向Le Cam缺陷分析，从理论上证明风险等价性。
Result: LLM的期望误差收敛到不可约总体方差加上平方表征偏差；在条件均值依赖的推理中，校准后的LLM能达到贝叶斯最优风险。
Conclusion: 在满足假设条件和良好校准下，LLM可替代人类实验用于预测和决策任务，实现近最优统计推断且成本更低。

papers.title: MUSE: Unlocking Timestep as Native Task Steering for One-Step Dense Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Monocular dense prediction has recently seen remarkable success by repurposing pre-trained diffusion models. This opens a promising yet challenging avenue for more efficient multi-task learning paradigm. However, existing multi-task diffusion methods often introduce parameter-heavy adapters, experts, or learnable task tokens, leading to computational redundancy. In this paper, we reveal an inherent mechanism within one-step diffusion models: the native, fixed sinusoidal timestep embedding can be repurposed as an endogenous task steering signal. Based on this discovery, we propose Multi-task Unified eStimation via timestep Embedding (MUSE), a parameter-free, single-model multi-tasking approach for dense prediction. We interpret this mechanism via Manifold Decoupling, where discrete, fixed timestep values deterministically steer the generation process towards decoupled, task-specific manifolds in the latent space. Extensive experiments across 10 datasets demonstrate that MUSE achieves highly competitive performance on both monocular depth and normal estimation, and its efficacy generalizes across U-Net and DiT architectures. Our work offers a concise and efficient path toward generalist vision models by simply unlocking the latent potential of existing generation infrastructure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现一步扩散模型中的固定正弦时间步嵌入可以充当内生的任务导向信号，并据此提出 MUSE，一个无参数、单模型的多任务密集预测方法。在 10 个数据集上的实验表明，MUSE 在单目深度和法线估计上性能有竞争力，且能泛化至 U-Net 和 DiT 架构。
Motivation: 现有多任务扩散方法通常引入大量参数（适配器、专家或可学习任务令牌），导致计算冗余。本文旨在探索更简洁的方式，利用扩散模型内在的时间步嵌入来实现多任务导向。
Method: 提出 MUSE，基于发现：一步扩散模型中原生固定的正弦时间步嵌入可以被重新用作任务导向信号。通过流形解耦（Manifold Decoupling）机制，离散的固定时间步值确定性地引导生成过程走向潜在空间中解耦的任务特定流形。
Result: 在 10 个数据集上，MUSE 在单目深度估计和法线估计任务上取得具有竞争力的性能，并且其有效性在 U-Net 和 DiT 架构上均得到验证。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一条简洁高效的路径，通过解锁现有生成基础设施的潜在能力来构建通用视觉模型。

papers.title: CouCE: A Unified Causal Framework for Debiased Deep Metric Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep Metric Learning (DML) often struggles with zero-shot generalization because standard objectives inherently capture what co-occurs rather than what causes similarity. Consequently, DML models are vulnerable to shortcut learning driven by two structurally distinct confounders: background spurious correlations (which create backdoor paths via scene context) and foreground nuisance perturbations (which inject non-semantic variations like pose or illumination). Although existing methods have proposed targeted solutions for each pathway individually, none can simultaneously address both due to their fundamentally distinct causal roles. To bridge this gap, we propose the Counterfactual Causal Embedding (CouCE), a unified causal framework that explicitly models and neutralizes both confounders. Specifically, we introduce Orthogonal Dictionary-Based Backdoor Adjustment (ODBA), which isolates spurious background patterns into a variance-gated dictionary and stably disentangles them from the learned embeddings via soft orthogonal regularization. Simultaneously, we propose Multi-Scale Randomized Causal Intervention (MSRCI) to enforce causal invariance against foreground nuisances through multi-scale Fourier amplitude randomization and a symmetric KL invariance constraint. Notably, CouCE seamlessly integrates with any proxy-based loss, incurring modest training overhead without requiring architectural modifications during inference. Extensive experiments on CUB-200-2011, Cars-196, and Stanford Online Products demonstrate that CouCE consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, providing a principled and robust solution for debiased DML.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的因果框架 CouCE，用于解决深度度量学习（DML）中的两个结构不同的混杂因素：背景伪相关（通过场景上下文产生后门路径）和前景扰动（如姿态、光照等非语义变化）。方法包括基于正交字典的后门调整（ODBA）和多尺度随机因果干预（MSRCI），能够同时处理两种混杂，且可与任何基于代理的损失函数集成。在 CUB-200-2011、Cars-196 和 Stanford Online Products 上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有深度度量学习方法容易受到两种结构不同的混杂因素的影响（背景伪相关和前景扰动），但已有方法只能针对其中一种，无法同时处理。本文旨在统一两大因果路径，实现去偏的度量学习。
Method: 提出 CouCE 框架，包含两个组件：1）正交字典后门调整（ODBA）：通过方差门控字典隔离背景伪相关模式，并利用软正交正则化将其从嵌入中解耦；2）多尺度随机因果干预（MSRCI）：通过多尺度傅里叶幅度随机化和对称 KL 不变性约束，强制对前景扰动保持因果不变性。
Result: 在 CUB-200-2011、Cars-196 和 Stanford Online Products 三个基准上，CouCE 始终达到最先进性能，且仅增加少量训练开销，推理时无需修改架构。
Conclusion: CouCE 为去偏深度度量学习提供了一个原则性且鲁棒的解决方案，能够统一处理两种关键混杂因素，并易于集成到现有代理损失中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReactiveBFM: Reactive Closed-Loop Motion Planning Towards Universal Humanoid Whole-Body Control
papers.abstract_en: While current Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) provide robust control priors for humanoids, they only execute pre-defined reference motions. As a result, they are vulnerable to environmental shifts and incapable of reactive whole-body coordination. Naively cascading them with generative motion planners fails to achieve true reactivity, as inevitable tracking discrepancies induce fatal cumulative exposure bias. To bridge this gap, we propose ReactiveBFM, a real-time closed-loop planning-control framework. At its core, we effectively mitigate exposure bias via a scheduled prefix sampling curriculum, forcing the generative planner to actively learn error-recovery behaviors from imperfect physical states rather than ground-truth trajectories. Systematically, to reconcile the severe latency mismatch between auto-regressive planning and high-frequency tracking, we introduce an asynchronous replanning mechanism. Combined with trajectory chunking to temporally ensemble spatial references, our system guarantees spatio-temporally fluid execution without physical jitter. Deployed on the Unitree G1 humanoid, ReactiveBFM demonstrates unprecedented physical agility across a vast repertoire of text-conditioned closed-loop motions. Notably, ReactiveBFM achieves zero-shot moving target reaching, showcasing intricate whole-body coordination and on-the-fly replanning. In sim-to-sim benchmarking under severe perturbations, ReactiveBFM achieves a 93.1% success rate, significantly outperforming cascaded open-loop baselines by 28.6%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReactiveBFM，一个用于人形机器人全身控制的实时闭环规划-控制框架。通过调度前缀采样课程缓解生成式规划器与跟踪之间的暴露偏差，并引入异步重规划机制解决自回归规划与高频跟踪的延迟不匹配。在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上实现了零样本移动目标追踪，在强扰动仿真中成功率达93.1%，比开环基线高28.6%。
Motivation: 现有行为基础模型（BFMs）只能执行预定义参考动作，无法应对环境变化和实现反应性全身协调。简单级联生成式运动规划器由于跟踪误差导致累积暴露偏差，无法实现真正反应性。
Method: 核心是调度前缀采样课程，迫使生成式规划器从不完美的物理状态学习纠错行为，而非理想轨迹。引入异步重规划机制和轨迹分块，以协调自回归规划与高频跟踪之间的延迟，保证时空流畅执行。
Result: 在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上展示多种文本条件闭环运动，零样本实现移动目标追踪。在强扰动仿真基准中达到93.1%成功率，比开环基线提升28.6%。
Conclusion: ReactiveBFM 有效实现了人形机器人的反应性全身控制，通过缓解暴露偏差和延迟不匹配，显著优于开环级联方法。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 ReactiveBFM，一个用于人形机器人全身控制的实时闭环规划-控制框架。通过调度前缀采样课程缓解生成式规划器与跟踪之间的暴露偏差，并引入异步重规划机制解决自回归规划与高频跟踪的延迟不匹配。在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上实现了零样本移动目标追踪，在强扰动仿真中成功率达93.1%，比开环基线高28.6%。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有行为基础模型（BFMs）只能执行预定义参考动作，无法应对环境变化和实现反应性全身协调。简单级联生成式运动规划器由于跟踪误差导致累积暴露偏差，无法实现真正反应性。
summary_sections.method: 核心是调度前缀采样课程，迫使生成式规划器从不完美的物理状态学习纠错行为，而非理想轨迹。引入异步重规划机制和轨迹分块，以协调自回归规划与高频跟踪之间的延迟，保证时空流畅执行。
summary_sections.result: 在 Unitree G1 人形机器人上展示多种文本条件闭环运动，零样本实现移动目标追踪。在强扰动仿真基准中达到93.1%成功率，比开环基线提升28.6%。
summary_sections.conclusion: ReactiveBFM 有效实现了人形机器人的反应性全身控制，通过缓解暴露偏差和延迟不匹配，显著优于开环级联方法。

papers.title: On the Vulnerability of Parameter-Level Defenses to Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: The training-free integration of expert models via model merging has exposed significant security risks, enabling free-riders to combine specialized models without authorization. Recent works propose parameter-level defenses that employ linear parameter transformations to neutralize this threat. In this paper, we systematically analyze such defenses and reveal that their protected task vectors are inherently small in magnitude. Consequently, the protected weights remain overwhelmingly dominated by the pretrained model. Based on this observation, we designate the pretrained model as a static reference anchor and propose the Anchor-Guided Attack (AGA) to circumvent existing safeguards. Specifically, AGA aligns the protected model with this anchor to recover the transformation matrix analytically. Extensive evaluations validate that AGA consistently bypasses both individual and composite defenses under realistic defense-agnostic scenarios. Furthermore, we provide Anchor-Repulsive Fine-tuning (ARF), a defense method to mitigate the anchor dominance leveraged by AGA. Empirical results confirm that ARF effectively defeats the proposed attack. Our code is available at https://github.com/krumpguo/secure-merge-attack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了针对模型合并的参数级防御，发现受保护的任务向量幅度较小，受保护权重由预训练模型主导。基于此，提出了锚点引导攻击（AGA），通过将受保护模型与预训练锚点对齐来恢复变换矩阵。实验表明AGA可以绕过现有防御。同时提出锚点排斥微调（ARF）防御方法，能够有效抵御攻击。
Motivation: 现有模型合并技术存在安全风险，允许未经授权的自由骑手组合专家模型。近期提出的参数级防御通过线性参数变换来抵御该威胁，但本文发现这些防御存在根本性漏洞。
Method: 通过分析发现受保护的任务向量幅度小，受保护权重主要由预训练模型主导。提出Anchor-Guided Attack (AGA)，将预训练模型作为静态参考锚点，通过对齐受保护模型与锚点来解析恢复变换矩阵。还提出Anchor-Repulsive Fine-tuning (ARF)防御方法。
Result: 在多项评估中，AGA一致地绕过了单个和组合防御，在防御不可知的现实场景下有效。ARF防御方法能够有效击败所提出的攻击。
Conclusion: 揭示了参数级模型合并防御的脆弱性，并提供了有效的攻击方法及对应的防御策略。

papers.title: Learning the structure of open quantum systems
papers.abstract_en: We design an algorithm for learning the coefficients of an $n$-qubit constant-local Lindbladian to $\varepsilon$ error with $O(g d^2 \log(n) / \varepsilon^2)$ total evolution time, where $g$ is the single-site energy and $d$ is the (approximate) degree of the interaction graph. Though Lindbladians present new challenges not present in the special case of Hamiltonians, our algorithm achieves the suite of desiderata attained by state-of-the-art Hamiltonian learning algorithms: (1) it uses non-adaptive, ancilla-free randomized Pauli measurement circuits with a time resolution of only $Θ(1/g)$; (2) it works without knowledge of the structure of the unknown Lindbladian; (3) it depends on a smooth form of degree, thereby supporting the learning of quasi-local and power-law Lindbladians. Our algorithm is a simple iterative method, where the objective function consists of Fourier coefficients of the Lindbladian restricted to few-site regions. Its analysis identifies the difficulty unique to open systems, which we call "confusing" terms. For settings where the "confusion" is limited, the performance of the algorithm improves. We demonstrate this for the case of structure learning of Hamiltonians from access to real-time evolution, where we obtain a new algorithm that is significantly simpler than previous work. In addition, using the same iterative method, we design the first efficient algorithm for structure learning Hamiltonians from high-temperature Gibbs states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文设计了一种学习n量子比特恒定局部Lindbladian系数至ε误差的算法，总演化时间O(g d^2 log(n) / ε^2)，其中g是单站点能量，d是相互作用图的近似度。该算法实现了与最先进哈密顿学习算法相同的理想特性：使用非自适应、无辅助的随机Pauli测量电路，时间分辨率仅Θ(1/g)；无需知道未知Lindbladian的结构；依赖于光滑形式的度，从而支持拟局部和幂律Lindbladian的学习。算法是简单的迭代方法，目标函数由限制在少站点区域上的Lindbladian傅里叶系数构成。分析识别了开放系统独有的困难，称为“混淆”项。
Motivation: 开放量子系统（Lindbladian）的学习比哈密顿学习更具挑战性，现有方法未能同时满足非自适应、无辅助、无需先验知识等理想特性。
Method: 提出一种非自适应、无辅助的随机Pauli测量电路，时间分辨率为Θ(1/g)，通过迭代优化由Lindbladian在少站点区域上的傅里叶系数构成的目标函数来学习系数。
Result: 算法在总演化时间O(g d^2 log(n) / ε^2)内实现ε误差学习，并支持拟局部和幂律Lindbladian；同时，该方法可简化用于从实时演化学习哈密顿结构，并首次实现从高温Gibbs态学习哈密顿结构。
Conclusion: 该算法识别了开放系统学习的独特困难（混淆项），并在混淆受限时性能提升；此外，同一迭代方法可用于哈密顿结构学习，获得更简单的算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OLIVE: View-Augmented Latent Prediction with Waveform Reconstruction for Speech SSL
papers.abstract_en: We propose Online Latent prediction with Invariant Views and rEconstruction (OLIVE), a self-supervised speech representation learning framework that jointly optimizes analysis and synthesis objectives. OLIVE combines view-augmented masked latent prediction with waveform reconstruction under a unified objective. Reconstruction constrains early encoder features to retain signal-level information, while masked latent prediction shapes later contextual representations toward invariance for robust downstream performance. We show that these objectives enable representations that support a broad range of tasks. In particular, OLIVE improves results on generation and speaker tasks, maintains competitive performance on recognition and semantic tasks, and improves waveform reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OLIVE，一种自监督语音表示学习框架，联合优化分析（掩码潜在预测）与合成（波形重建）目标。通过视点增强的潜在预测学习上下文不变表示，波形重建保留早期编码器的信号级信息。实验表明OLIVE在生成任务、说话人任务上提升性能，在识别和语义任务上保持竞争力，并改进波形重建质量。
Motivation: 现有自监督语音模型通常只优化分析或合成目标，难以同时支持下游识别、生成和说话人任务。需要统一框架平衡信号保持与语义抽象。
Method: OLIVE框架包含两个分支：视点增强的掩码潜在预测（masked latent prediction with view augmentation）和波形重建（waveform reconstruction），在统一损失函数下联合训练。重建约束早期编码器保留信号细节，潜在预测塑造后续上下文表示的鲁棒性。
Result: 在语音生成、说话人识别任务上取得改进，在语音识别、语义任务上保持与现有方法相当的性能，同时提升了波形重建的保真度。
Conclusion: 结果表明联合优化分析与合成目标能学习到支持多种任务的通用语音表示，重建目标有助于保留信号级信息而不损害下游性能。

papers.title: Residual-Guided Expert Specialization for Incomplete Multimodal Learning
papers.abstract_en: As real-world prediction systems often face missing modalities at inference, incomplete multimodal learning (IML) remains a practical challenge. While prior methods aim to learn representations robust to missing inputs, representations from incomplete modalities inevitably deviate from their full-modality counterparts due to missing evidence. To explicitly leverage these deviations, we propose MARS (Missingness-Aware Residual-guided Specialization), a mixture-of-experts framework that guides expert specialization based on how representations are reshaped by missingness. By contrasting task representations derived from incomplete inputs with their complete counterparts during training, we derive a privileged residual signal that captures this representational gap. The residual signal guides a residual router to assign samples to experts specialized for the corresponding deviation patterns. In parallel, a feature router learns to imitate this routing behavior using only incomplete inputs, enabling deployment without access to full modalities. To mitigate this train-test router gap, we develop a discrepancy-aware noise regularization that adaptively perturbs the residual router's decisions when the feature router deviates, enhancing expert robustness under imperfect imitation. Experiments on multimodal classification (CASIA-SURF, CREMA-D, UPMC Food-101) and segmentation (MCubeS) under missing scenarios show that MARS consistently surpasses baselines while remaining efficient and extensible to diverse backbones and tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对推理时模态缺失的不完整多模态学习问题，提出MARS框架。该框架通过对比完整与不完整输入的任务表示得到残差信号，利用残差路由器引导混合专家模型中的专家专业化，同时让特征路由器仅依赖不完整输入模仿该路由行为，并引入差异感知噪声正则化来缓解训练与测试间的路由器差异。实验在CASIA-SURF、CREMA-D、UPMC Food-101分类及MCubeS分割任务上均显示优于基线方法。
Motivation: 真实预测系统中常出现模态缺失，现有方法虽致力于学习鲁棒表示，但未显式利用缺失导致的表示偏差。为了利用这一偏差改进专家专业化，提出残差引导的专家专业化方法。
Method: 提出MARS框架：1）通过对比较完整与不完整模态的任务表示得到残差信号；2）残差路由器根据该残差将样本分配给处理特定偏差模式的专家；3）特征路由器模仿残差路由器行为，但仅使用不完整输入；4）引入差异感知噪声正则化，在特征路由器偏离时自适应扰动残差路由器决策，增强专家鲁棒性。
Result: 在CASIA-SURF、CREMA-D、UPMC Food-101分类和MCubeS分割任务上，MARS持续超越基线方法，且保持高效性，可扩展到不同骨干网络和任务。
Conclusion: 实验验证了MARS在不完整多模态学习中的有效性，其残差引导的专家专业化机制能有效处理模态缺失，且方法具有通用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FastPano3D: Feed-Forward Indoor Panoramic 3D Reconstruction from a Single Image
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D scene reconstruction have highlighted the intricate trade-offs among rendering quality, inference efficiency, and data dependency. To address the challenge of rapidly reconstructing detailed 3D indoor scenes from minimal input, we introduce FastPano3D, an end-to-end framework that directly generates renderable 3D Gaussian representations from a single panoramic image. Unlike perspective-based methods, panoramic images inherently suffer from equirectangular projection distortions and spatially non-uniform feature distributions, making direct feed-forward Gaussian generation particularly challenging. In contrast to existing Gaussian Splatting based methods that rely on multi-view supervision or per-scene optimization, FastPano3D employs a lightweight feature encoder, adaptive Gaussian sampling, and a point-cloud-guided refinement strategy to achieve efficient and accurate scene generation without any test-time optimization. Our approach reconstructs high-fidelity 3D scenes within seconds, achieving up to 156 times faster inference than prior state-of-the-art methods such as Pano2Room, while using only half the parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FastPano3D delivers rendering quality comparable to NeRF- and 3DGS-based reconstructions, establishing a new benchmark for rapid, single-view 3D scene inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FastPano3D，一种端到端框架，能从单张全景图像直接生成可渲染的 3D 高斯表示，实现快速室内场景重建。方法使用轻量特征编码器、自适应高斯采样和点云引导的细化策略，无需测试时优化，推理速度比 prior work Pano2Room 快 156 倍，参数量仅一半，渲染质量接近 NeRF 和 3DGS。
Motivation: 现有方法需多视图监督或逐场景优化，难以从单张全景图快速重建高质量 3D 场景。全景图本身存在畸变和非均匀特征分布，直接前馈生成高斯表示面临挑战。
Method: FastPano3D 采用轻量特征编码器、自适应高斯采样和点云引导的细化策略，直接生成 3D 高斯表示，无需测试时优化。
Result: 方法在数秒内重建高保真 3D 场景，推理速度比 Pano2Room 快 156 倍，参数量减半，渲染质量与 NeRF 和 3DGS 相当。
Conclusion: FastPano3D 为单视图快速 3D 场景推理建立了新基准，但方法专注于室内全景图像，其泛化性未充分讨论。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 方法在数秒内重建高保真 3D 场景，推理速度比 Pano2Room 快 156 倍，参数量减半，渲染质量与 NeRF 和 3DGS 相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: FastPano3D 为单视图快速 3D 场景推理建立了新基准，但方法专注于室内全景图像，其泛化性未充分讨论。

papers.title: FFAvatar: Feed-Forward 4D Head Avatar Reconstruction from Sparse Portrait Images
papers.abstract_en: We present FFAvatar, a Transformer-based 3D Gaussian framework for fast construction of high-quality and animatable 4D head avatars from one or more reference portrait images. Unlike existing feed-forward approaches that require a fixed number of input views, FFAvatar supports incremental reconstruction, progressively refining the avatar representation as additional reference images become available. At the core of our method is an alternating attention mechanism that disentangles identity appearance from expression and viewpoint variations, enabling the reconstruction of a canonical 3D appearance that remains consistent across poses and facial expressions. To balance visual fidelity and computational efficiency, we introduce a sparse-to-dense learning paradigm. Coarse appearance features are first learned using sparse primitives anchored to the FLAME vertex level and are subsequently densified in the UV domain to capture fine-grained geometric and texture details. We further propose a plug-and-play motion refinement module that enables subject-specific dynamic personalization by modeling residual motion beyond parametric deformation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FFAvatar efficiently produces high-fidelity and controllable 4D head avatars, achieving superior flexibility, driving efficiency, and identity-consistent rendering across diverse expressions and viewpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FFAvatar，一种基于Transformer的3D高斯框架，能够从一张或多张参考肖像图像快速构建高质量、可动画化的4D头部头像。该方法支持增量式重建，通过交替注意力机制解耦身份外观与表情/视角变化，并采用稀疏到密集的学习范式以及即插即用的运动细化模块，实现了高保真、可控的头像生成。
Motivation: 现有前馈方法需要固定数量的输入视图，缺乏灵活性，且难以在身份一致性和表情/视角变化之间解耦。
Method: 提出基于Transformer的3D高斯框架，包含交替注意力机制、稀疏到密集学习范式（先FLAME顶点级稀疏原语再UV域密集化）、以及即插即用运动细化模块（建模参数化变形之外的残差运动）。
Result: 实验表明FFAvatar高效生成高保真4D头像，在灵活性、驱动效率和跨表情/视角的身份一致性渲染上表现优越。
Conclusion: 该框架支持增量重建和主题特定动态个性化，为4D头像重建提供了灵活高效的解决方案。

papers.title: DRIFT: Difficulty Routing Self-DIstillation with Rhythm-Gated Exploration and Success BuFfer Training
papers.abstract_en: Enabling large language models to achieve stable self-improvement without external expert supervision remains a central challenge in complex reasoning tasks. Existing self-distillation and reinforcement learning methods lack explicit mechanisms for tracking problem-level learning progress and adapting optimization strategies accordingly. Consequently, training may over-optimize easy problems, receive weak supervision from hard problems, and fail to sufficiently explore borderline cases. To resolve these issues, we propose DRIFT, an online self-evolution policy optimization framework for large language models. DRIFT regulates the model's self-improvement process through the joint use of Difficulty Routing and Rhythm Gating. The former identifies the model's learning state at the problem level and dynamically allocates self-distillation and reinforcement learning signals, while the latter refines policy updates at the token level, concentrating exploration on critical reasoning positions. By further incorporating a success buffer and a two-stage curriculum learning strategy, DRIFT preserves high-quality historical experience while progressively guiding the model from reliable behavior acquisition toward stable policy evolution. Evaluated across five benchmarks and three model scales, DRIFT surpasses the peak performance of both GRPO and SDPO across all evaluated metrics. On the average score over the five benchmarks, DRIFT achieves 79.5$\%$, outperforming GRPO by 9.5$\%$ and SDPO by 7.5$\%$, establishing a new state-of-the-art result. Notably, on ToolUse, DRIFT reaches an accuracy of 79.2$\%$, improving over GRPO by 13.5$\%$ and SDPO by 10.7$\%$, setting a new state-of-the-art and substantially outperforming all concurrent methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DRIFT，一个在线自进化策略优化框架，通过难度路由（Difficulty Routing）和节奏门控（Rhythm Gating）联合调控大语言模型的自我提升过程，并在五个基准上超越GRPO和SDPO，平均得分79.5%。
Motivation: 现有自蒸馏和强化学习方法缺乏对问题级学习进程的显式追踪和自适应优化，导致易问题过优化、难问题监督弱、边界情况探索不足。
Method: DRIFT框架结合难度路由（按问题难度动态分配自蒸馏和强化学习信号）与节奏门控（在token级聚焦关键推理位置进行策略更新），并引入成功缓冲区与两阶段课程学习策略。
Result: 在五个基准和三种模型规模上，DRIFT平均得分79.5%，超过GRPO 9.5%、SDPO 7.5%；在ToolUse上准确率79.2%，超过GRPO 13.5%、SDPO 10.7%，均达到新最佳。
Conclusion: DRIFT通过联合使用难度路由和节奏门控，有效引导模型从可靠行为获取向稳定策略进化过渡，无需外部专家监督。

papers.title: Early Cue Precision Shapes Visual Shortcut Learning in Controlled Cue-Manipulation Benchmarks
papers.abstract_en: Visual classifiers can achieve high matched-distribution accuracy while relying on low-level cues that fail under conflict or suppression. We test whether this failure is shaped by early cue precision: the reliability with which a low-level cue predicts the label during early learning or downstream probe fitting. Across synthetic shape-texture tasks, sequential digit training, a 10-class frozen-representation audit, and a CIFAR-10 natural-image-based texture-overlay benchmark, we manipulate object-texture match probability and evaluate matched-ID accuracy, conflict accuracy, texture-choice rate, and suppression behavior. Degraded-but-predictive input does not substitute for cue decorrelation. In 10-class digit probes, conflict accuracy drops from 0.589 under chance-like cue precision to 0.005 under target-perfect texture. In CIFAR-10 frozen probes, conflict accuracy drops from 0.569 to 0.114, while texture choice rises from 0.049 to 0.855; this ordering persists across texture-overlay strengths alpha in {0.15,0.25,0.35,0.50}. End-to-end CIFAR-10 training shows that low early cue precision improves pre-target conflict behavior, but shortcut-rich fine-tuning can rapidly overwrite this benefit. Cue decorrelation must therefore be maintained during downstream adaptation rather than treated as a one-time inoculation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过控制早期线索精度（early cue precision）——低级线索在早期学习或下游探测中预测标签的可靠性——来研究视觉分类器对短期线索（shortcut）的依赖。在合成形状-纹理任务、顺序数字训练、10类冻结表示审计以及基于CIFAR-10的自然图像纹理覆盖基准中，操纵对象-纹理匹配概率，评估匹配ID准确率、冲突准确率、纹理选择率和抑制行为。结果表明，降级但可预测的输入不能替代线索去相关；低早期线索精度在端到端训练中能改善冲突行为，但随后的微调会迅速覆盖这一收益，因此线索去相关必须在下游适应中持续维持。
Motivation: 视觉分类器可能在匹配分布上取得高准确率，但依赖低级线索会在冲突或抑制条件下失败。本文希望测试这种失败是否由早期线索精度塑造，即低级线索在早期学习或下游探测阶段预测标签的可靠性。
Method: 通过操纵对象-纹理匹配概率（object-texture match probability）来改变早期线索精度，在合成形状-纹理任务、顺序数字训练、10类冻结表示审计和CIFAR-10纹理覆盖基准中比较匹配ID准确率、冲突准确率、纹理选择率和抑制行为。
Result: 在10类数字探测中，冲突准确率从接近随机的0.589降至目标完美纹理下的0.005；在CIFAR-10冻结探测中，冲突准确率从0.569降至0.114，纹理选择率从0.049升至0.855，且该顺序在多种纹理覆盖强度下保持。端到端CIFAR-10训练显示低早期线索精度能改善冲突行为，但富含短期线索的微调会迅速覆盖这一益处。
Conclusion: 线索去相关（cue decorrelation）不能视为一次性接种，而必须在下游适应中持续维护。

papers.title: A Classifier-Agnostic Zero-Shot Adversarial Attack Detection via CLIP
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial attacks pose a challenge to the reliability of deep learning models, motivating effective detection methods. Existing techniques often rely on attack-specific assumptions, access to adversarial samples, or knowledge of the underlying classifier (white-box). We propose \textit{$A^4D$ (\textbf{A}ttack- and \textbf{A}rchitecture-\textbf{A}gnostic \textbf{A}dversarial \textbf{D}etector)}, a completely black-box, zero-shot adversarial attack detection framework that utilizes prompt-based similarity scores derived from CLIP. To the best of our knowledge this is the first attempt to utilize CLIP for such a task. The method is based on two key observations: (i) CLIP is sensitive even to small imperceptible non-semantic perturbations; (ii) The shift in CLIP embedding space is not arbitrary and can be used as a robust attack indicator. Experiments across multiple attacks, datasets and classifiers validate that $A^4D$ achieves SOTA detection results in the attack-agnostic and classifier-agnostic setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出A⁴D，一种完全黑盒、零样本的对抗攻击检测框架，利用CLIP的提示相似度分数。实验表明该方法在多种攻击、数据集和分类器上达到SOTA检测结果。
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击检测方法通常依赖攻击特定假设、访问对抗样本或白盒知识，缺乏通用性。
Method: 基于两个关键观察：CLIP对微小非语义扰动敏感，且CLIP嵌入空间的偏移可作为鲁棒攻击指标，利用CLIP的提示相似度分数进行检测。
Result: 在多种攻击、数据集和分类器上，A⁴D在攻击无关和分类器无关的设置中达到SOTA检测结果。
Conclusion: 这是首次利用CLIP进行对抗攻击检测，证明了CLIP在完全黑盒零样本场景下的有效性。

papers.title: REAR: Test-time Preference Realignment through Reward Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse user preferences is a critical yet challenging task. While post-training methods can adapt models to specific needs, they often require costly data curation and additional training. Test-time scaling (TTS) presents an efficient, training-free alternative, but its application has been largely limited to verifiable domains like mathematics and coding, where response correctness is easily judged. To extend TTS to preference alignment, we introduce a novel framework that models the task as a realignment problem, since the base model often fails to sufficiently align with the stated preference. Our key insight is to decompose the underlying reward function into two components: one related to the question and the other to preference information. This allows us to derive a REAlignment Reward (REAR) that selectively rescales the proportions of these two reward terms. We then show that REAR can be formulated as a linear combination of token-level policy log-probabilities, making it computationally efficient and easy to integrate with various TTS algorithms such as best-of-$N$ sampling and tree search. Experiments show that compared to other test-time baselines, REAR not only enables scalable test-time realignment for preference alignment tasks under diverse user requirements, but also generalizes to mathematical and visual tasks under appropriate preference settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REAR框架，通过将奖励函数分解为问题相关和偏好相关两部分，得到重新对齐奖励（REAR），并将其表达为token级策略log概率的线性组合，从而高效集成到best-of-N采样和树搜索等测试时缩放（TTS）算法中。实验表明，REAR在多样用户偏好下实现可扩展的测试时偏好重新对齐，并能在适当偏好设置下泛化到数学和视觉任务。
Motivation: 现有后训练方法需要昂贵的数据整理和额外训练，而TTS虽高效但局限于数学和编程等可验证领域。为将TTS扩展到偏好对齐，需要解决基础模型未能充分对齐用户偏好的问题。
Method: 将底层奖励函数分解为问题相关和偏好相关两部分，推导出重新对齐奖励（REAR）作为这两个奖励项比例的重新缩放。进一步证明REAR可写为token级策略log概率的线性组合，从而易于与各种TTS算法（如best-of-N采样和树搜索）集成。
Result: 相比于其他测试时基线，REAR不仅能在不同用户需求下实现可扩展的测试时偏好重新对齐，还能在适当偏好设置下泛化到数学和视觉任务。
Conclusion: REAR通过奖励分解实现了高效的测试时偏好重新对齐，兼具计算效率和泛化能力，为将TTS应用于偏好对齐提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Sequential Fairness Auditing with Limited Output Access
papers.abstract_en: External evaluations are becoming increasingly central to the governance of AI systems. In practice, however, independent auditors often have limited access to deployed models and must rely on query-based interactions. Most existing fairness evaluation methods assume static datasets and fixed-sample statistical tests, making them poorly suited to real-world auditing scenarios in which evidence must be collected sequentially under query constraints. In this work, we formulate fairness auditing as a tolerance-aware sequential hypothesis-testing problem under limited model output access. We develop a sequential generalized likelihood-ratio framework that allows auditors to accumulate evidence from a finite audit pool and stop once sufficient support for compliance or violation has been obtained. The framework is instantiated for decision-based Statistical Parity and Equal Opportunity audits, and extended to score- and logit-based proxy audits when richer observables are available. Our results show that both the fairness metric and the level of model access significantly affect audit efficiency, and that the benefits of richer output information are not uniform across auditing settings. In particular, richer outputs can substantially reduce the number of queries required for some fairness metrics and operating regimes, while offering limited gains in near-threshold cases. This work provides a practical statistical framework for sequential fairness auditing under realistic deployment constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对外部审计中模型输出访问受限的问题，将公平性审计建模为容忍感知的序列假设检验问题，提出序列广义似然比框架，允许审计员在有限查询预算下逐步积累证据并适时停止。该框架实例化于基于决策的统计平等和机会平等审计，并扩展到基于分数和logit的代理审计。实验表明公平性度量和模型访问级别显著影响审计效率，且更丰富的输出信息在接近阈值时收益有限。
Motivation: 现实中的独立审计员往往只能通过查询与模型交互，而现有公平性评估方法假设静态数据集和固定样本统计检验，不适合查询受限的序列审计场景。
Method: 提出基于序列广义似然比（sequential generalized likelihood-ratio）的容忍感知假设检验框架，允许审计员从有限审计池中积累证据，一旦获得足够支持合规或违规的证据即停止。为决策型统计平等和机会平等审计实例化，并扩展到分数和logit型代理审计。
Result: 结果表明公平性度量和模型访问级别显著影响审计效率；更丰富的输出信息在某些公平性度量和操作区间能大幅减少所需查询数，但在接近阈值时收益有限。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一个在部署约束下进行序列公平性审计的实用统计框架。

papers.title: FlexTab: A Flexible Encoder-Decoder Architecture for In-Context Learning Across Diverse Tabular Tasks
papers.abstract_en: We introduce FlexTab, a flexible encoder-decoder architecture for in-context learning on tabular data that pairs a single, task-agnostic encoder with a suite of task-specific decoders. Unlike existing tabular in-context learners, which entangle feature representations with a specific prediction target, our design produces \textit{target-agnostic} row embeddings that can be leveraged across a wide range of downstream tasks within a table-native in-context learning setup. We demonstrate this flexibility on six distinct problems: classification, regression, anomaly detection, clustering, entity matching, and entity classification in relational databases. Both the encoder and the task-specific decoders are trained on a large corpus of real-world, unlabeled tables. FlexTab achieves state-of-the-art performance on classification, regression, anomaly detection and entity matching, while remaining competitive with specialized models on entity classification in a relational setting. These results demonstrate that a single shared encoder, paired with task-specific decoders, can serve as an effective general-purpose backbone for diverse tabular prediction problems. The inference code and checkpoints will be made publicly available at https://github.com/SAP-samples/flextab.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FlexTab 是一种灵活的编码器-解码器架构，用于表格数据的上下文学习 (in-context learning)。它使用一个任务无关的编码器生成目标无关的行嵌入，再配合多个任务特定的解码器，可处理分类、回归、异常检测、聚类、实体匹配和关系数据库中的实体分类等六种任务。该架构在真实未标注表格的大语料上训练，在分类、回归、异常检测和实体匹配上达到最先进性能，在关系实体分类上与专用模型相当。
Motivation: 现有的表格上下文学习方法将特征表示与特定预测目标耦合，难以灵活迁移到不同下游任务。本文旨在设计一种目标无关的行嵌入，使得单个编码器能支持多种表格任务。
Method: 提出 FlexTab 架构，包含一个共享的任务无关编码器和一组任务特定解码器；编码器生成目标无关的行嵌入，解码器针对不同任务进行预测。模型在大量真实未标注表格数据上训练。
Result: 在分类、回归、异常检测和实体匹配任务上达到最先进性能；在关系数据库中的实体分类上与专用模型竞争力相当。
Conclusion: 单个共享编码器配合任务特定解码器可作为表格预测问题的通用骨干网络，展示了跨多种任务的灵活性和有效性。

papers.title: BayesEvolve: Explicit Belief States for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous scientific discovery systems increasingly use large language models (LLMs) to propose new hypotheses, but many such systems condition primarily on experimental memory: archives of high-scoring candidates or heuristic summaries of recent trials. We argue that discovery agents should instead maintain explicit, uncertainty-aware beliefs about hypothesis quality. We introduce BayesEvolve, a belief-guided discovery framework that converts experimental evidence into a predictive belief state and uses this belief to guide future experimentation. As a controlled testbed for belief-guided discovery, we evaluate BayesEvolve on shifted BBOB-style black-box optimization tasks, leaving program and laboratory discovery domains to future work. BayesEvolve improves sample efficiency over memory- and archive-guided LLM baselines under a fixed evaluation budget. We further show that the belief state is predictive on held-out candidate pools, that controlled decision-rule ablations favor belief-guided selection with an annealed uncertainty bonus, and that BayesEvolve exhibits productive late-stage concentration rather than unfocused exploration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BayesEvolve，一种信念引导的自主科学发现框架，将实验证据转化为显式的不确定性感知信念状态，并用其指导后续实验。在迁移BBOB类黑盒优化任务上评估，相比基于记忆或存档的LLM基线提高了样本效率。信念状态在候选池上具有预测性，消融实验支持信念引导选择与退火不确定性奖励，且展现了后期集中探索而非漫无目的的探索。
Motivation: 现有自主科学发现系统主要依赖实验记忆（高分候选档案或最近试验的启发式摘要），缺乏对假设质量的不确定性感知信念，限制了探索效率。
Method: 提出BayesEvolve框架，将实验证据转化为显式的预测性信念状态，并利用该信念指导实验选择。信念状态包含不确定性估计，使用退火不确定性奖励平衡探索与利用。
Result: 在迁移BBOB类黑盒优化任务上，BayesEvolve在固定评估预算下比记忆/存档引导的LLM基线样本效率更高。信念状态在候选池上具有预测性，消融实验表明信念引导选择加退火不确定性奖励效果最佳，且后期呈现集中探索而非分散探索。
Conclusion: 信念引导的发现框架能够提升样本效率，但当前工作仅局限于黑盒优化测试，程序或实验室发现领域留待未来研究。
