papers.title: Local-Minima-Preserving Continuous Relaxation of Ising Problems
papers.abstract_en: The generalized Ising problem captures a broad spectrum of hard combinatorial problems, including MAX-CUT, Number Partitioning (NPP), and Maximum Independent Set. In this work, we consider the notion of one-flip local minima for this problem. We construct a polynomial relaxation and prove the landscape equivalence theorem: there exists a one-to-one correspondence between the local minima of the relaxation and the one-flip minima of the original Ising problem. This guarantee reduces the Ising problem to finding the local minima of a smooth function, allowing us to leverage gradient-based optimizers such as ADAM. We demonstrate that our method is scalable and it achieves strong performance across challenging benchmarks, including spin-glass models, MAX-CUT, and NPP.
papers.comment: Accepted (regular) at 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML'26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对广义 Ising 问题（包括 MAX-CUT、数划分等）构建了一种多项式连续松弛，并证明了景观等价定理：松弛的局部极小值与原始 Ising 问题的单翻转局部极小值一一对应。该理论将 Ising 问题转化为光滑函数的局部极小值搜索，从而可使用 ADAM 等梯度优化器求解。实验在自旋玻璃、MAX-CUT 和数划分等基准上表现出可扩展性和强性能。
Motivation: 广义 Ising 问题涵盖多种困难组合优化问题，但其离散性质使得优化困难。现有连续松弛方法往往无法保持原始问题的局部极小值结构，导致求解质量下降。
Method: 提出一种多项式连续松弛，并证明其局部极小值与原始 Ising 问题的一阶局部极小值（单翻转）存在一一对应关系（景观等价定理）。基于此，可直接应用梯度优化器（如 ADAM）求解松弛问题。
Result: 在自旋玻璃模型、MAX-CUT 和数划分等挑战性基准上，该方法性能强劲且具有可扩展性。
Conclusion: 景观等价定理为组合优化问题提供了一种保持局部极小结构的连续松弛途径，使梯度方法可有效应用于离散优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UniGP: Taming Diffusion Transformer for Prior-Preserved Unified Generation and Perception
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion models have shown impressive performance in controllable image generation and dense prediction tasks. However, existing approaches typically treat diffusion-based controllable generation and dense prediction as separate tasks, overlooking the potential benefits of jointly modeling the heterogeneous distributions. In this work, we introduce UniGP, a framework built upon MMDiT, which unifies controllable generation and dense prediction through simple joint training, without the need for complex task-specific designs or losses, while preserving the backbone's versatile priors. By learning controllable generation and prediction under different conditions, our model effectively captures the joint distribution of image-geometry pairs. UniGP is capable of versatile controllable generation, dense prediction, and joint generation. Specifically, the proposed UniGP consists of DUGP and a unified dataset training strategy. The former, following the principle of Occam's razor, uses only a copied image branch of MMDiT to model dense distributions beyond RGB, while the latter integrates heterogeneous datasets into a unified training framework to jointly model generation and perception tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our unified model surpasses prior unified approaches and performs on par with specialized methods. Furthermore, we demonstrate that multi-task joint training provides complementary benefits: generative priors enrich perceptual details, while perceptual learning improves structural alignment in generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniGP，一个基于 MMDiT 的统一框架，通过简单联合训练将可控图像生成与密集预测（如分割、深度估计）整合，无需复杂任务特定设计或损失函数，同时保留骨干网络的通用先验。实验表明，该统一模型性能优于先前的统一方法，并与专用方法持平，且多任务联合训练具有互补优势。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型方法将可控生成和密集预测视为分离任务，忽视了联合建模异构分布（图像-几何对）的潜在优势。
Method: UniGP 包含两个核心组件：DUGP（遵循奥卡姆剃刀原则，仅使用 MMDiT 的复制图像分支来建模超过 RGB 的密集分布）和统一数据集训练策略（整合异构数据集以联合建模生成与感知任务）。
Result: 在多项任务上，UniGP 超越先前的统一方法，性能与专用方法相当；多任务联合训练中，生成先验丰富感知细节，感知学习改善生成的结构对齐。
Conclusion: 通过简单联合训练统一生成与感知是可行的，且两者相互促进；该框架无需复杂设计，保留了骨干网络的通用先验。

papers.title: Extrapolating from Regularised Solutions for Solving Ill-Conditioned Linear Systems in Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Rapid prototyping of algorithms is a critical step in modern machine learning. Most algorithms exploit linear algebra, creating a need for lightweight numerical routines which -- while potentially sub-optimal for the task at hand -- can be rapidly implemented. For the numerical solution of ill-conditioned linear systems of equations, the standard solution for prototyping is Tikhonov-regularised inversion using a nugget. However, selection of the size of nugget is often difficult, and the use of data-adaptive procedures precludes automatic differentiation, introducing instabilities into end-to-end training. Further, while data-adaptive procedures perform multiple linear solves to select the size of nugget, only the result of one such solve is returned, which we argue is wasteful. This paper aims to circumvent the above difficulties, presenting autonugget; a Python package for automatic and stable numerical solution of linear systems suitable for rapid prototyping, and fully compatible with automatic differentiation using JAX. autonugget combines multiple linear solves using Richardson extrapolation to determine the solution of the ill-conditioned system, improving in accuracy over approximations based on a single nugget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出autonugget，一个基于JAX的Python包，用于自动且稳定地求解病态线性系统。它结合Tikhonov正则化与Richardson外推，通过多次线性求解外推得到更精确的解，避免了传统数据自适应方法中调参困难和不兼容自动微分的问题，适合快速原型设计。
Motivation: 机器学习算法快速原型设计中，病态线性系统的求解常依赖Tikhonov正则化，但数据自适应选择正则化参数困难且不兼容自动微分，且多次求解仅用一次结果，效率低下。
Method: 提出autonugget方法，基于Tikhonov正则化进行多次线性求解（不同正则化参数），然后通过Richardson外推组合这些解，逼近原始病态系统的解，全程支持自动微分。
Result: 摘要指出该方法相比单一正则化参数求解提高了精度，但没有给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: autonugget提供了一种自动、稳定、兼容自动微分的病态线性系统求解方案，适用于机器学习的快速原型设计。
Relevance: 20

summary_sections.result: 摘要指出该方法相比单一正则化参数求解提高了精度，但没有给出具体数值结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: autonugget提供了一种自动、稳定、兼容自动微分的病态线性系统求解方案，适用于机器学习的快速原型设计。

papers.title: Hybrid Active-Online Learning Framework for Label-Efficient Concept Drift Adaptation in Optical Network Failure Detection
papers.abstract_en: We propose a hybrid active-online learning framework for label-efficient concept drift adaptation in optical network failure detection. Using margin-based selective labeling, our method achieves nearceiling accuracy and AUC scores while querying only 3.4% of streaming samples, with negligible latency overhead compared to static inference.
papers.comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the European Conference on Optical Communication (ECOC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合主动-在线学习框架，用于光网络故障检测中的标签高效概念漂移适应。通过基于边距的选择性标注，仅查询3.4%的流样本即可达到接近理论最优的准确率和AUC，且延迟开销可忽略。
Motivation: 光网络故障检测中，概念漂移会降低模型性能，但实时标注所有样本成本高昂，需要一种标签高效的适应方法。
Method: 提出混合主动-在线学习框架，在流式数据中根据模型预测的边距（margin）选择不确定性高的样本请求标签，其余样本用于无监督在线更新。
Result: 在实验设置下，仅标注3.4%的流样本即达到接近天花板（near-ceiling）的准确率和AUC，延迟开销相比静态推理可忽略。
Conclusion: 该框架在保持高检测精度的同时大幅降低标注成本，适用于需要持续适应概念漂移的光网络故障检测场景。

papers.title: Optimizing Image Preparation and Compression for Face Recognition within 1024 Bytes
papers.abstract_en: ICAO-compliant machine readable travel documents enable automated biometric face verification. The biometric reference is stored on an RFID chip included in form of a JPEG or JPEG 2000 compressed facial image. In contrast, temporary travel documents lack of machine readability, which excludes the owner from such automated processes. This disadvantage could be solved by equipping such documents with 2D barcodes. This technology offers a resource-saving alternative to expensive RFID chips, while still offering machine readability and fast issuing processes. However, this solution introduces the challenge of storing the face images at significantly smaller storage capacities, creating the need for reducing the file size of the included facial image to a maximum of 1024 bytes. This study examines preprocessing steps and compression configurations, using JPEG, JPEG 2000, JPEG XL, JPEG AI, HEIF, AVIF, and WebP for image compression to this target size, while still preserving as much face recognition performance as possible. While the reference sample must always comply with ICAO specifications, the individual samples may or may not meet these requirements, depending on the application. This work optimizes compression steps for both of these prerequisites. It is shown that the recently standardised JPEG AI, when using optimized settings, provides the best face recognition performance, in particular when the comparison includes only images with high face image quality. AVIF and WebP also provide good results. The losses caused by the strong lossy compression are comparatively small. For the comparison of ICAO-compliant face images only, converting the images to grayscale proves to be a helpful preprocessing step, whereas for comparisons involving less suitable samples, preserving color is preferable. In addition, smoothing and resizing the images beforehand also turns out to be beneficial.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究将人脸图像压缩至1024字节以内以用于2D条码临时旅行证件，比较多种图像压缩格式（JPEG, JPEG 2000, JPEG XL, JPEG AI, HEIF, AVIF, WebP）对人脸识别性能的影响。结果表明，最新标准化的JPEG AI在优化设置下提供最佳人脸识别性能，AVIF和WebP也表现良好。灰度预处理对仅比较ICAO合规人脸图像有益，而包含低质量样本时保留彩色更优。
Motivation: 临时旅行证件缺乏机器可读性，无法进行自动人脸验证。2D条码提供低成本替代方案，但存储容量极低（1024字节），需要研究如何在此限制下仍保持人脸识别性能。
Method: 系统评估预处理步骤（灰度转换、平滑、缩放）和多种压缩格式（JPEG, JPEG 2000, JPEG XL, JPEG AI, HEIF, AVIF, WebP）在目标文件大小下对人脸识别性能的影响，并针对ICAO合规和非合规样本分别优化。
Result: JPEG AI在优化设置下提供最佳人脸识别性能，尤其当比较双方均为高质量人脸图像时；AVIF和WebP也表现良好。灰度预处理有益于仅ICAO合规图像比较，而保留彩色更适合包含低质量样本的情况。平滑和预缩放也有帮助。
Conclusion: 通过优化预处理和压缩配置，可以在1024字节内实现可接受的人脸识别性能，其中JPEG AI是最佳选择。

papers.title: BrainJanus: A Unified Model for Understanding and Generation across Brain, Vision, and Language
papers.abstract_en: Modeling the bidirectional correspondence between external sensory stimuli and internal neural activity has emerged as a critical frontier in neuroscience. However, existing approaches predominantly treat brain encoding and decoding as isolated tasks, relying heavily on unimodal alignment and external priors while overlooking the brain's intrinsic nature as a multimodal integration system. To address these limitations, we propose BrainJanus, the first unified brain model that integrates brain, vision, and language within a single framework. Specifically, we introduce a Unified Brain Tokenizer to quantize continuous neural dynamics into discrete tokens aligned with visual and linguistic representations in a shared Omni space. Building on this, we utilize an All-in-One autoregressive architecture that leverages next-token prediction to enable seamless any-to-any generation, which encompasses image-to-brain and text-to-brain encoding, and brain-to-image and brain-to-text decoding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BrainJanus achieves superior performance across diverse benchmarks. Furthermore, our framework exhibits zero-shot generalization and preserves interpretable biological topography, highlighting its potential as a general-purpose brain modeling paradigm. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/HaitaoWuTJU/BrainJanus}{GitHub}.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BrainJanus，首个统一大脑、视觉和语言的模型。通过 Unified Brain Tokenizer 将神经信号量化为离散令牌，并在共享 Omni 空间中与视觉、语言表示对齐；采用 All-in-One 自回归架构，基于下一令牌预测实现图像↔大脑、文本↔大脑的双向生成。实验表明该方法在多个基准上取得优越性能，具备零样本泛化能力，并保留可解释的生物拓扑结构。
Motivation: 现有大脑编码/解码方法多作为孤立任务，依赖单模态对齐和外部先验，忽视了大脑作为多模态整合系统的本质。
Method: 提出 Unified Brain Tokenizer 将连续神经动态量化为离散令牌，在共享 Omni 空间中与视觉、语言表示对齐；构建 All-in-One 自回归架构，通过下一令牌预测实现 any-to-any 生成（包括图像→大脑、文本→大脑编码，以及大脑→图像、大脑→文本解码）。
Result: 在多个基准任务上达到 superior 性能；展示零样本泛化能力，并保留可解释的脑区拓扑结构。
Conclusion: 该框架作为通用大脑建模范式具有潜力，代码已开源。

papers.title: MCP Server Architecture Patterns for LLM-Integrated Applications
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP), introduced by Anthropic in November 2024, defines a standardized interface for connecting large language models (LLMs) to external tools, data sources, and services. Within months of release, hundreds of community-built MCP servers appeared on GitHub, but no software-maintenance literature has yet described how the ecosystem is being structured in production. This industry experience paper catalogues five recurring MCP server architectural patterns observed across an enumerated corpus of fifteen independently developed servers (five production servers from the ANSYR voice AI platform plus ten public servers from the official MCP registry): Resource Gateway, Tool Orchestrator, Stateful Session Server, Proxy Aggregator, and Domain-Specific Adapter. Each pattern is described in the structured form of Gamma et al.: context, problem, solution, and consequences. We also document four anti-patterns and a set of cross-cutting concerns around authentication, versioning, and observability. The quantitative evaluation contributes three measurements: inter-rater reliability of the taxonomy across two independent LLM raters on 54 held-out servers (Cohen's kappa = 0.76), which also localizes three pattern-boundary ambiguities; transport overhead measured end-to-end on loopback and modeled for cross-host paths; and a tool-count study showing tool-selection accuracy drops below 90% between 10 and 15 tools per context for Claude Haiku 4.5 and between 20 and 30 tools for Sonnet 4. Code, corpus, and prompts are released as a replication package.
papers.comment: 9 pages, IEEEtran conference format, 2 figures. Extended version; a condensed version is under review at IEEE Software. Replication package: https://github.com/rodriguescarson/mcp-patterns-icsme2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于15个MCP服务器（5个生产环境服务器和10个公共注册表服务器）的系统分析，提炼出五种MCP服务器架构模式（资源网关、工具编排器、有状态会话服务器、代理聚合器、领域适配器）以及四个反模式。定量评估包括两位独立LLM评估者在54个未参与模式提取的服务器上的评分者间信度（Cohen's kappa=0.76）、传输开销测量和工具数量对选择准确率的影响（Claude Haiku 4.5在10-15个工具时准确率低于90%，Sonnet 4在20-30个工具时下降）。
Motivation: MCP协议发布后，社区涌现大量MCP服务器实现，但缺乏对其生产环境中架构模式的系统性描述和分析。
Method: 采用行业经验报告方法，枚举15个MCP服务器（含ANSYR语音AI平台和官方注册表服务器），使用Gamma等人提出的结构化形式描述模式，并定量评估模式分类的信度、传输开销和工具选择准确性。
Result: 识别出五种架构模式和四个反模式；跨两位LLM评估者的评分者间Cohen's kappa=0.76，发现三个模式边界模糊；传输开销测量和工具选择准确率下降的阈值（10-15个工具时Claude Haiku 4.5准确率低于90%）。
Conclusion: 本文首次系统化描述了MCP服务器架构模式，提供了可复现的分类法和评估数据，对MCP应用开发者和协议设计者具有参考价值。

papers.title: Toward an Energy-Optimized Operation of Data Centers Located in Wind Farms Using Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies Reinforcement Learning as an online controller for curtailment-aware workload shifting in wind-turbine-integrated high-performance computing (HPC) data centers. We introduce a reproducible fixed-day simulation framework with synthetic wind and price signals and delayed completion feedback, designed to be extensible toward more complex scenarios. As a controlled benchmarking basis, we then focus on the minimal case with one wind turbine and one co-located data center. In this setting, pure Reinforcement Learning exhibits a pronounced credit-assignment problem and tends to underuse free wind energy early in the day. We therefore evaluate two complementary countermeasures: optimization-based Imitation Learning and potential-based Reward Shaping. Across multi-seed training and a 200-day test set, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) variant with an additional on-policy update routine achieve strong empirical performance among learned policies, and both Imitation Learning and Reward Shaping provide improvements in relevant configurations. A performance gap to the optimizer remains, which is expected: the optimizer plans offline with full-day foresight, whereas Reinforcement Learning must decide online from current observations without future realizations. The benchmark and ablation results provide a transparent basis for extending the approach toward richer multi-site and continuous-time scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习作为在线控制器，用于风能集成的高性能计算数据中心的负载转移（workload shifting），以减少弃风。提出了一个可复现的固定日仿真框架，包含合成风力和价格信号以及延迟完成反馈。在单风机单数据中心的最小配置下，纯粹的强化学习存在信用分配问题，倾向于低估白天的免费风能。评估了两种补偿措施：基于优化的模仿学习和基于势能的奖励塑造。PPO和带有额外在线更新例程的SAC变体在所学策略中表现出色，但性能仍落后于具有全天预见的离线优化器。
Motivation: 数据中心能耗巨大，若与风电场共址并利用风能，可降低碳排放和运营成本。但风能间歇性强，需要实时决策来平衡负载与可用风能，强化学习适合此类在线控制问题，但面临信用分配等挑战。
Method: 提出一个可复现的固定日仿真框架，合成风力、电价和延迟反馈信号。在单风机单数据中心场景下，对比纯强化学习（PPO、SAC）与两种改进：基于优化的模仿学习（模仿最优离线策略）和基于势能的奖励塑造（引入额外奖励引导早期利用风能）。
Result: 在多随机种子训练和200天测试中，PPO和带有在线更新例程的SAC变体在所学策略中表现强劲。模仿学习和奖励塑造均在相关配置下带来改进。但所有RL策略仍与具有全天信息的最优离线优化器存在性能差距。
Conclusion: 强化学习在风能集成数据中心在线控制中具有潜力，但信用分配问题需要额外的机制来缓解；当前基准可用于扩展到多站点和连续时间场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Real-Time Underwater Image Enhancement via Frequency-Guided Dual-Path Attention
papers.abstract_en: Real-time underwater image enhancement (UIE) is crucial for mobile underwater photography and autonomous robotic systems, where practical deployment typically requires low latency and compact models under constrained computational resources. Recent ultra-lightweight CNNs based on structural re-parameterization meet these constraints but operate purely in the spatial domain, ignoring the frequency-sensitive nature of underwater degradation. To address this, we propose a lightweight UIE framework that integrates two key components: a Multi-Branch Reparameterizable Convolution with Fixed DCT Priors (MBRConv-DCT) that injects structured directional frequency priors during training, and a Frequency-Guided Dual-Path Attention (FGDPA) module that fuses spatial and spectral cues via a dual-path design for adaptive feature modulation. Both components are fully compatible with structural re-parameterization: the convolution branch introduces zero additional inference cost after re-parameterization, while the attention module incurs only a minimal computational overhead. Experiments show our model achieves state-of-the-art performance with only 4.23K parameters and 600+ FPS, outperforming much larger methods in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. Code is available at https://github.com/LethyZhang/FGDPA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对实时水下图像增强任务，提出轻量级框架FGDPA。该框架包含多分支可重参数化卷积与固定DCT先验（MBRConv-DCT）以及频率引导双路径注意力（FGDPA）模块，在保持结构重参数化兼容性的同时引入频率先验。实验表明，模型仅需4.23K参数、600+ FPS，在定量指标和视觉质量上达到SOTA。
Motivation: 现有超轻量CNN水下图像增强方法仅在空间域操作，忽略了水下退化对频率的敏感性，需要一种既能保持低延迟又考虑频率特性的轻量模型。
Method: 提出两个关键组件：MBRConv-DCT在训练时注入结构化方向频率先验；FGDPA模块通过双路径设计融合空间和频谱特征实现自适应调制。两者均兼容结构重参数化，推理时几乎无额外开销。
Result: 在标准水下图像增强基准上，模型以4.23K参数和600+ FPS实现了SOTA性能，优于参数量更大的方法。
Conclusion: 本文证明，在超轻量模型中结合频率先验与双路径注意力可有效提升水下图像增强效果，且计算成本极低，适合实时部署。

papers.title: TRACE: A Concept Bottleneck Model for Longitudinal 3D Glioblastoma Response Assessment
authors: Hasan Md Tusfiqur Alam Daniel Sonntag
papers.abstract_en: Longitudinal glioblastoma response assessment requires comparing subtle tumor changes across MRI time points using structured clinical criteria such as RANO. However, most deep learning methods predict response labels directly from imaging features, which limits clinical inspection, verification, and correction. We introduce TRACE, a RANO 2.0-aligned concept bottleneck model for interpretable 4-class glioblastoma response classification on longitudinal 3D MRI. TRACE processes paired baseline and follow-up multimodal MRI scans with a shared 3D vision encoder, predicts clinically meaningful tumor measurements as root concepts, computes downstream RANO-derived concepts through deterministic rules, and incorporates scan interval and new-lesion information as passthrough concepts. This design frames response assessment as structured concept reasoning rather than direct image-to-label prediction. Using 5-fold patient-wise cross-validation on the LUMIERE dataset, TRACE achieves a 4-class macro F1 of 0.4769 and a binary progression-versus-non-progression macro F1 of 0.7085. It improves over a concept bottleneck baseline and remains within the range of published non-interpretable deep learning approaches. Ablation studies show that the expert RANO graph and intervention-consistency training are important for performance, while intervention experiments demonstrate that correcting concepts can improve downstream predictions. These results suggest that structured concept bottlenecks offer a transparent and clinically aligned direction for longitudinal glioblastoma response assessment, while highlighting the need for larger protocol-aligned datasets and external validation.
papers.comment: Accept in the EXPLIMED: Explainable Artificial Intelligence for the Medical Domain workshop in IJCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE，一种与 RANO 2.0 对齐的概念瓶颈模型，用于可解释的纵向 3D 胶质母细胞瘤响应四分类。模型通过共享 3D 视觉编码器提取基线和随访 MRI 特征，预测肿瘤测量作为根概念，经确定规则计算 RANO 衍生概念，并整合扫描间隔与新病变信息。在 LUMIERE 数据集上，四分类宏 F1 为 0.4769，二分类（进展 vs 非进展）宏 F1 为 0.7085，表明结构化概念瓶颈可提升透明性与临床对齐。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法直接预测响应标签，缺乏临床可检查性与可修正性，难以与 RANO 等结构化标准对齐。
Method: TRACE 采用共享 3D 视觉编码器处理配对的多模态 MRI，预测肿瘤测量作为根概念，通过确定性规则计算 RANO 衍生概念，并加入扫描间隔与新病变作为直通概念，实现结构化概念推理。
Result: 在 LUMIERE 数据集上，5 折患者级交叉验证得到四分类宏 F1 0.4769，二分类宏 F1 0.7085，优于概念瓶颈基线，且性能处于非可解释深度学习方法的已发表范围。消融实验表明专家 RANO 图和干预一致性训练至关重要。
Conclusion: 结构化概念瓶颈为纵向胶质母细胞瘤响应评估提供了透明且临床对齐的方向，但需要更大协议对齐数据集和外部验证。

papers.title: Highly Data Parallelizable Estimation of the Sliced-Wasserstein Distance Using Cumulative Distribution Functions
papers.abstract_en: The Sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance has emerged as a computationally attractive alternative to the Wasserstein distance by leveraging one-dimensional optimal transport along random projections. Standard estimators of the SW distance rely on Monte Carlo averages of one-dimensional Wasserstein distances computed via quantile functions, which require sorting projected samples and access to full datasets. In this work, we introduce a new class of estimators for the Sliced Wasserstein distance based on cumulative distribution functions (CDFs) of projected measures, that avoid sorting and scale via massive dataset parallelism. This class includes several estimators, some of them being indexed by hyperparameters controlling their variance or smoothness. We show that they are especially well suited to scenarios in which CDFs are more tractable than quantile functions, such as mixtures of Gaussians, and moreover that they are also naturally compatible with federated learning, since CDFs of projected data can be computed and aggregated locally without requiring the exchange of raw samples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一类基于累积分布函数（CDF）的切片Wasserstein距离估计器，避免了对投影样本进行排序，从而支持大规模数据并行处理。新估计器特别适用于CDF比分位数函数更易计算的情形（如高斯混合模型），并天然兼容联邦学习，可在不交换原始样本的情况下局部计算和聚合CDF。
Motivation: 标准切片Wasserstein距离估计依赖于蒙特卡洛平均和排序操作，需要访问完整数据集，难以扩展到大规模并行或联邦学习场景。
Method: 提出基于投影测度的CDF而非分位数函数来估计一维Wasserstein距离，从而避免排序；估计器族包含多个变体，可通过超参数控制方差或光滑性。
Result: 摘要指出新估计器在CDF易计算场景（如高斯混合）中表现良好，并且支持大规模数据并行和联邦学习，但未提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 基于CDF的切片Wasserstein距离估计器是标准蒙特卡洛方法的可行替代，特别适合需要数据局部性和并行性的应用。

papers.title: A Point Cloud Transformer for Remote Monitoring and Automated Assessment of Physical Rehabilitation Exercises
papers.abstract_en: Rehabilitation exercises are essential in restoring lost physical functions of patients suffering from various diseases (e.g., Parkinson's, back pain). Carrying out these rehabilitation exercises, often prescribed by health experts, is costly, unavailable, and requires expert supervision. The availability of RGBD images and movement/position data of joints along with expert annotation of exercise data has prompted the use of automatic assessment of the quality of rehabilitation exercises, which is cost-effective and can be carried out at home. However, existing approaches do not extract relevant features, lack practical application, require expensive pre-processing, or overlook crucial features. This study proposes a transformer-based framework for point clouds to extract features and assess rehabilitation exercises by analyzing joint positions collected through RGBD data. We adapt and utilize a curve-based point-cloud feature aggregation technique to augment point-cloud information that aids model output. The transformer architecture also uses axial self-attention, recognizing important joints and their roles to assist users in performing the exercise better. The guided system outperforms existing approaches and is also practically relevant due to its small size, fast inference, and generalization on specific joints in similar exercises. We conduct our experiments on three crucial baseline datasets for rehabilitation exercises: Kimore, UI-PRMD, and IRDS.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics (JBHI), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于点云变换器（Point Cloud Transformer）的框架，用于远程监测和自动评估康复训练的质量。该框架利用RGBD数据收集的关节位置，通过曲线点云特征聚合和轴向自注意力机制，识别关键关节并评估训练动作。实验在Kimroe、UI-PRMD和IRDS三个基准数据集上进行，结果表明该方法在性能、模型大小和推理速度上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有康复训练评估方法特征提取不足、缺乏实用性、预处理成本高或忽略关键特征，且需要专家监督。本文旨在开发一种低成本、可在家庭使用且自动评估康复训练质量的方案。
Method: 提出基于点云变换器的框架，采用曲线点云特征聚合技术增强点云信息，并利用轴向自注意力机制识别重要关节及其作用。模型输入为RGBD数据采集的关节位置，输出评估结果。
Result: 在Kimroe、UI-PRMD和IRDS三个基准数据集上，该方法在性能上优于现有方法，同时具有模型小、推理快的优势，并能泛化到类似训练中的特定关节。
Conclusion: 该框架为康复训练评估提供了实用且高效的解决方案，适合远程监测和家庭使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Video Diffusion Models for Hand Motion Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: 4D hand motion reconstruction from egocentric video is bottlenecked by clear limitations of existing methods: image-based pipelines depend on a detector that fails under heavy occlusion, while video-based methods rely on temporal modules learned only from scarce hand-pose annotations, a narrow signal insufficient to model motion dynamics, occlusion reasoning, and hand-object interaction. These capabilities, however, are exactly what video generative models must implicitly acquire when trained to synthesize coherent video at internet scale. Motivated by this, we present ViDiHand, which leverages the representations of a pretrained video diffusion model to reconstruct 4D two-hand pose. We adapt it via a hand-overlay rendering objective that specializes its features for hands while preserving its world priors. A decoder then recovers metric-scale pose from the adapted features. The whole pipeline operates directly on full frames--no detector, no infiller, and no test-time optimization. On ARCTIC, HOT3D, and HOI4D, ViDiHand substantially outperforms prior methods, establishing video diffusion models as a powerful new foundation for hand motion reconstruction and a promising route to scalable in-the-wild data collection for embodied AI. Project page: https://vidihand.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ViDiHand，利用预训练视频扩散模型的表征进行4D双手姿态重建，无需检测器或后处理，在ARCTIC、HOT3D和HOI4D数据集上显著优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有基于图像的方法在严重遮挡下失效，基于视频的方法受限于稀疏的手部姿态标注，无法有效建模运动动态、遮挡推理和手物交互。视频生成模型在互联网规模训练中隐式获得了这些能力。
Method: ViDiHand通过手部覆盖渲染目标适配预训练视频扩散模型，使其特征专注于手部同时保留世界先验，再用解码器从适配特征中恢复度量尺度姿态，全程直接在完整帧上操作。
Result: 在ARCTIC、HOT3D和HOI4D数据集上，ViDiHand大幅超越先前方法，表明视频扩散模型可作为手部运动重建的强大新基础。
Conclusion: 视频扩散模型为手部运动重建提供了有效表征，并为可扩展的真实世界数据收集提供了新途径。

papers.title: Always-OnAgents:A Survey of Persistent Memory, State, and Governance in LLMAgents
papers.abstract_en: Always-on agents are systems whose future behavior depends on durable state accumulated across earlier interactions. We treat them as persistent-state systems: the operative system includes retrievable memories, but also task ledgers, permissions, credentials, commitments, provenance and audit records, shared state, trigger conditions, and externally committed effects linked to those records. The survey reads the literature through six diagnostic axes for each state item, authority, scope, mutability, provenance, recoverability, and actionability, and through a lifecycle in which state is written, validated, organized, retrieved, acted upon, updated, forgotten, audited, and sometimes rolled back. Across a 435-work coded corpus, treated as a scoped map rather than an exhaustive census, the literature concentrates more heavily on accumulating and retrieving state than on governing, recovering, or relinquishing it. We therefore introduce the Always-On Evaluation Protocol (AOEP-v0), a pilot evaluation contract that makes these governance requirements concrete by scoring state mutation and recovery obligations rather than answer quality alone. The resulting agenda connects always-on agents to databases, distributed systems, formal methods, capability security, and machine unlearning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了持久状态 LLM Agent（Always-On Agents）的研究，定义其状态项需从六个诊断轴（权威性、范围、可变性、来源、可恢复性、可行动性）分析，并涵盖状态生命周期。通过对 435 篇文献的编码分析，发现现有工作侧重状态积累与检索，而忽视治理、恢复与放弃。作者提出 Always-On Evaluation Protocol (AOEP-v0) 合约，将评估焦点从答案质量转向状态突变与恢复义务。
Motivation: 现有 LLM Agent 缺乏对持久状态的系统性治理，导致状态管理（如记忆、凭证、审计记录）不完善，影响系统的可靠性与可审计性。
Method: 采用六个诊断轴（authority, scope, mutability, provenance, recoverability, actionability）分析状态项，并结合状态生命周期（写入、验证、组织、检索、行动、更新、遗忘、审计、回滚）。基于 435 篇文献的编码映射，提出 AOEP-v0 评估合约，以状态突变与恢复义务作为评分标准。
Result: 文献分析显示研究集中于状态积累与检索，而对治理、恢复与放弃关注不足。AOEP-v0 提供了将持久状态纳入评估的具体方法。
Conclusion: 持久状态 Agent 的研究应借鉴数据库、分布式系统、形式化方法、能力安全与机器遗忘等领域的成果，以完善状态治理。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文综述了持久状态 LLM Agent（Always-On Agents）的研究，定义其状态项需从六个诊断轴（权威性、范围、可变性、来源、可恢复性、可行动性）分析，并涵盖状态生命周期。通过对 435 篇文献的编码分析，发现现有工作侧重状态积累与检索，而忽视治理、恢复与放弃。作者提出 Always-On Evaluation Protocol (AOEP-v0) 合约，将评估焦点从答案质量转向状态突变与恢复义务。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 LLM Agent 缺乏对持久状态的系统性治理，导致状态管理（如记忆、凭证、审计记录）不完善，影响系统的可靠性与可审计性。
summary_sections.method: 采用六个诊断轴（authority, scope, mutability, provenance, recoverability, actionability）分析状态项，并结合状态生命周期（写入、验证、组织、检索、行动、更新、遗忘、审计、回滚）。基于 435 篇文献的编码映射，提出 AOEP-v0 评估合约，以状态突变与恢复义务作为评分标准。
summary_sections.result: 文献分析显示研究集中于状态积累与检索，而对治理、恢复与放弃关注不足。AOEP-v0 提供了将持久状态纳入评估的具体方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 持久状态 Agent 的研究应借鉴数据库、分布式系统、形式化方法、能力安全与机器遗忘等领域的成果，以完善状态治理。

papers.title: Research Entity Extraction and Topic Detection from UKRI Grant Proposals
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents preliminary findings from a UKRI-funded Metascience project comparing three LLM-based approaches, GPT-4o, Mistral, and a bespoke algorithm, DSIT-Taxonomies, for extracting and classifying research entities from funding proposals. Our project "Tracking Stars and Unicorns" aims to identify early signals of emerging research areas to inform public investment. Our methodology employed a three-stage pipeline, leveraging Mistral for primary entity extraction and mapping against the OpenAlex Topics taxonomy. We evaluated our approach across 42 proposals' abstracts from different areas and observed that Mistral and GPT-4o produce comparable, high-quality entity sets with significant semantic overlap, outperforming the fragmented DSIT-Taxonomies approach. Crucially, the Mistral-based approach achieved superior topic classification accuracy (90.5%) compared to the full DSIT-Taxonomies pipeline (71.4%). We conclude that Mistral offers a high-performance, operationally efficient, and secure solution for large-scale analysis of sensitive grant data.
papers.comment: Accepted at the STI-ENID Conference. Will be presented in September 2026 in Antwerp (Belgium)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一项英国研究理事会（UKRI）资助的元科学项目的初步结果，比较了三种基于LLM的方法（GPT-4o、Mistral和定制算法DSIT-Taxonomies）从资助提案中提取和分类研究实体的效果。研究发现Mistral和GPT-4o产生了高质量且语义重叠的实体集，优于DSIT-Taxonomies；Mistral在主题分类准确率上达到90.5%，远高于DSIT-Taxonomies的71.4%。作者认为Mistral为大规模敏感资助数据分析提供了高性能、高效且安全的解决方案。
Motivation: 现有方法难以从大量资助提案中自动提取研究实体并检测新兴研究领域，尤其是处理敏感数据时需要高效且安全的方案。
Method: 采用三阶段流水线：使用Mistral进行初始实体提取，然后映射到OpenAlex Topics分类体系，并与GPT-4o和DSIT-Taxonomies方法对比。
Result: Mistral和GPT-4o产生的实体集质量相当且语义重叠高；Mistral的主题分类准确率达90.5%，而DSIT-Taxonomies仅为71.4%。
Conclusion: Mistral在大规模敏感资助数据分析中表现出高性能、操作效率高且安全，适合替代现有碎片化方法。

papers.title: ManimAgent: Self-Evolving Multimodal Agents for Visual Education
papers.abstract_en: Multi-round reflection lets agents built on large language models recover from failures within a single task, but each task remains an isolated episode: lessons learned across many reflection rounds on one task are discarded before the next begins. We study this gap on a code-generation task: from a scientific paper section, the agent writes Python in the open-source Manim library to render a mathematical animation. We present ManimAgent, a self-evolving multimodal agent that carries reflection experience across tasks through a dual-channel Episodic Memory Bank grown entirely from its own task stream, with no weight updates and no human seeds. After each animation converges, a vision-language model scores the rendered keyframes; the resulting signals populate a positive channel M+ that stores success rationales as soft Reference Examples, and a negative channel M- that stores validated failure patterns as hard Known Pitfalls. On a fixed-probe evaluation against no-memory, matched-budget retrieval-augmented generation, and shuffled-memory baselines, blind human Pass@1 rises and reflection rounds fall as memory size grows. We will release the code, frozen memory snapshots, and the task stream.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ManimAgent，一种自我进化的多模态智能体，用于从科学论文片段生成数学动画。它通过双通道情节记忆库（Episodic Memory Bank）跨任务传递反思经验，无需权重更新或人工种子。在固定探针评估中，随着记忆增长，盲人Pass@1提升且反思轮数减少。
Motivation: 现有的多轮反思智能体仅在单个任务内从失败中恢复，但跨任务的经验被丢弃。本文旨在解决这一间隙，使智能体能够积累并复用来自先前任务的经验，以提高代码生成和动画渲染的效率。
Method: ManimAgent采用双通道情节记忆库：正通道M+存储成功理由作为软参考示例，负通道M-存储验证过的失败模式作为硬已知陷阱。记忆库完全由智能体自身的任务流生成，无需外部种子或权重更新。
Result: 在固定探针评估中，与无记忆、匹配预算检索增强生成和打乱记忆基线相比，随着记忆大小增长，盲人Pass@1提升，反射轮数减少。
Conclusion: ManimAgent展示了跨任务记忆积累的有效性，有望提升基于LLM的智能体在长周期任务中的性能。代码和记忆快照将开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rehearsed Multi-Agent Live Product Demonstrations with Real-Time Voice Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Live product demonstrations are a recurring, high-cost activity in software organizations: a human presenter must select features, dispatch the corresponding interactions on a running application, narrate them coherently, and answer questions in real time. Existing automation addresses only fragments -- generalist browser agents target instruction-conditioned task completion, and demo-video tools produce fixed MP4 artifacts that cannot be questioned and silently break under interface drift. We propose Rhetor, a multi-agent system that takes a running web application and its source-code repository as input and produces a rehearsed live demonstration with segment-synchronized narration and real-time voice question answering. The architectural contributions are a cross-modal feature representation that merges UI exploration with source-code analysis into features tagged with discrete focus tiers, a grounded scripter constrained to UI elements observed during exploration and dispatched through multi-strategy semantic locators, a pre-presentation rehearsal loop with explicit convergence and graceful degradation to narration-only segments, and a runtime synchronization invariant that ties each browser action to the audio-end event of its narration segment. Across six pipeline sessions on four deployed applications -- including the public-domain whiteboard application Excalidraw -- the rehearser's internal locator-firing rate (sigma-bar) spans 0.31-1.00 over 147 scripted actions; on the substantial workload (53 actions, full tier differentiation), sigma-bar is approximately 0.92, and on the public-domain reference point the locator-repair step drives convergence to sigma-bar = 1.00 at iteration 2. We additionally define a benchmark protocol of ten metrics across six application categories that would establish, beyond the case study, whether each design choice contributes positively.
papers.comment: Preprint. 4 figures, 1 algorithm, 5 tables. Systems paper with a preliminary six-session case study on four deployed applications; full benchmark protocol proposed, corpus run to appear in a later revision
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Rhetor，一个多智能体系统，用于自动生成排练过的现场产品演示，支持实时语音问答。系统结合UI探索与源码分析，构建跨模态特征表示，通过预演循环确保动作与旁白同步，并在四个部署应用上进行了案例研究。
Motivation: 现有演示自动化工具仅覆盖部分环节，如通用浏览器代理或固定视频，无法实时问答且易因界面变化失效。需要一种能生成可问答、可排练的现场演示系统。
Method: 提出Rhetor，包含跨模态特征表示（融合UI探索与源码分析并标记焦点层级）、基于多策略语义定位器的脚本生成、预演循环（含收敛与优雅降级），以及运行时同步机制。
Result: 在四个部署应用（含Excalidraw）的六次会话中，定位器触发率(sigma-bar)范围为0.31-1.00；在主要负载（53个动作，全层级区分）中sigma-bar约为0.92，公共参考点上在第2次迭代收敛至1.00。
Conclusion: 系统展示了多智能体架构在自动演示生成中的可行性，但当前仅为案例研究，需要更大规模基准协议验证各设计选择。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview: A Low-Compute Real-Time Controllable World Model
papers.abstract_en: We present DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview, a preview foundational world model for real-time interactive world simulation. The system adapts the LongLive 1 autoregressive video stack, itself derived from Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, with a residual action pathway inspired by the Matrix-Game family. DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview focuses on a complementary axis to frontier-scale world simulators: low-compute adaptation, consumer-GPU runtime, and broad interactive capability coverage. It supports live keyboard and mouse control, multimodal initialization, mid-stream reprompting, dual-view operation, and minute-scale interactive rollouts at native 480p resolution, reaching up to 14 to 15 FPS FPS on a single RTX 4090 with a low memory footprint. By leveraging open video backbones and applying targeted adaptation runs, we build the preview system with high cost-efficiency. DF-World 0.1 Preview is not yet a memory-complete or frontier-quality world simulator, but demonstrates a practical low-compute route toward real-time controllable world-model previews on consumer GPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DreamForge-World 0.1 Preview，一个低计算消耗的实时可控世界模型，基于 LongLive 自回归视频栈和残差动作路径，支持实时键盘鼠标控制、多模态初始化、中间流重提示等功能，在单张 RTX 4090 上以 480p 分辨率达到 14-15 FPS。
Motivation: 现有前沿世界模拟器计算需求高，本文旨在提供低计算适应、消费级 GPU 运行时和广泛交互能力的替代方案。
Method: 采用来自 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 的 LongLive 自回归视频栈，并结合 Matrix-Game 家族的残差动作路径进行适应训练。
Result: 支持实时键盘鼠标控制、多模态初始化、中间流重提示、双视图操作，在单张 RTX 4090 上以 480p 分辨率达到 14-15 FPS，且内存占用低。
Conclusion: 该预览版虽非记忆完整或前沿质量的世界模拟器，但展示了在消费级 GPU 上实现实时可控世界模型的低计算路径。

papers.title: PromptGNN-sim: Deep Fusion and Alignment of GNN and LLMs for Text-Attributed Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs) combine textual semantics with graph structure and are central to many graph learning tasks. However, existing fusion methods often treat text and structure as separate inputs in a shallow, one-way pipeline, which limits deep interaction between modalities and weakens performance under sparse connectivity or cross-graph generalisation. To address this issue, we propose PromptGNN-sim, a bi-directional structure-semantic fusion framework for collaborative GNN-LLM learning. PromptGNN-sim uses a Graph Attention Network (GAT) for semantically aware neighborhood selection by combining structural attention with textual similarity. The selected structural context is then used to generate structure-aware prompts for an LLM, including the target node summary, label categories, and representative keywords from similar neighbors. During training, bi-directional cross-modal contrastive learning and cross-attention are introduced to jointly optimize the GNN and LLM components. Experiments on six public datasets, including Cora, Pubmed, and WikiCS, evaluate accuracy, generalisation, and robustness under cross-task transfer, cross-dataset generalisation, and sparse perturbations. Results show that PromptGNN-sim outperforms classical GNNs, LLMs, and recent GNN-LLM fusion methods, demonstrating the effectiveness of interactive structure-semantic collaboration for text-attributed graph learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PromptGNN-sim，一种双向结构-语义融合框架，通过图注意力网络进行语义感知的邻域选择，并生成结构感知的提示给大语言模型，结合双向跨模态对比学习和交叉注意力，在六个文本属性图数据集上优于经典GNN、LLM及近期融合方法。
Motivation: 现有融合方法通常将文本和结构视为浅层单向输入，限制了模态间深度交互，在稀疏连接或跨图泛化时性能下降。
Method: 使用图注意力网络结合结构注意力和文本相似性进行语义感知邻域选择，生成包含目标节点摘要、类别标签和代表性关键词的结构感知提示给LLM，并引入双向跨模态对比学习和交叉注意力联合优化GNN和LLM组件。
Result: 在Cora、Pubmed、WikiCS等六个数据集上，在准确性、泛化性和鲁棒性方面优于经典GNN、LLM及近期GNN-LLM融合方法。
Conclusion: 交互式结构-语义协作有效提升了文本属性图学习性能。

papers.title: VisReflect: Latent Visual Reflection for Fine-Grained Perception in Long Visual Context
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable success on vision-language tasks, yet fine-grained perception over high-resolution images and long-context videos remains challenging. As the number of visual tokens increases, the visual attention sink phenomenon becomes increasingly severe, causing irrelevant tokens to absorb a disproportionate amount of attention mass. Recent approaches attempt to mitigate this issue by explicitly predicting bounding boxes or temporal spans and re-encoding the cropped visual regions. Such methods depend on unreliable numeric localization in the discrete token space and incur significant computational overhead due to additional forward passes. In this work, we propose **VisReflect**, a simple yet effective framework that improves fine-grained perception in long visual contexts through latent visual reflection. Instead of decoding intermediate predictions into discrete tokens, the model generates continuous visual reflection that represents question-relevant visual features in the latent space. These reflections selectively emphasize salient regions or frames, guiding attention towards relevant visual tokens within a single forward pass. We conduct comprehensive evaluations on challenging high-resolution image benchmarks, including BLINK, V*, and HRBench-4K/8K, as well as video understanding benchmarks such as MVBench, VideoMME, and MLVU. Our method consistently improves over strong baselines, achieving gains of 4.1% on image benchmarks and 1.8% on video benchmarks. Compared with zooming-based methods, our model achieves comparable performance while reducing inference time by roughly 44% on video understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VisReflect框架，通过潜在视觉反射（latent visual reflection）在单一前向传播中生成问题相关的连续视觉特征，选择性关注显著区域或帧，缓解长视觉上下文中视觉注意力沉没（visual attention sink）问题。在高分辨率图像和长视频基准上，VisReflect相比强基线方法提升4.1%和1.8%，并比基于缩放的方法减少约44%推理时间。
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在处理高分辨率图像和长视频时，视觉令牌增多导致注意力沉没现象加剧，无关令牌占用过多注意力。现有方法依赖显式边界框或时间跨度预测并重新编码裁剪区域，需要不可靠的数值定位和多次前向传播，计算开销大。
Method: VisReflect框架不将中间预测解码为离散令牌，而是在潜在空间中生成连续视觉反射（question-relevant visual features），该反射选择性强调显著区域或帧，并引导注意力在单一前向传播中关注相关视觉令牌。
Result: 在BLINK、V*、HRBench-4K/8K等图像基准和MVBench、VideoMME、MLVU等视频基准上，VisReflect分别提升4.1%和1.8%；相比基于缩放的方法，推理时间减少约44%。
Conclusion: VisReflect通过潜在视觉反射实现高效细粒度感知，避免多次前向传播和离散数值定位，有望推广到更多长视觉上下文任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Continual Motion-Language Agents: LoRA Variants for Incremental Motion Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Motion-language agents must possess the bidirectional capability to both understand human movement (motion-to-text, M2T) and generate it from natural language (text-to-motion, T2M). While foundational models have achieved strong performance in static settings, autonomous agents operating in dynamic environments must continuously incorporate new motion concepts -- such as novel athletic styles or specialized gestures -- without catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired skills. We investigate the stability-plasticity trade-off in bidirectional motion-language learning under sequential task exposure. Building on a frozen large language model backbone, we introduce low-rank adaptation (LoRA) variants designed to mitigate inter-task interference. We specifically propose mixture-of-experts architectures that utilize an autoencoder-based router to select task-specific experts at inference time, so that no task-label is needed. To evaluate these methods, we establish a reproducible five-task benchmark derived from HumanML3D through semantic clustering of motion descriptions. Our experimental results demonstrate near-zero forgetting across both M2T and T2M directions while maintaining high generation and captioning quality. Furthermore, we show that hard expert selection via routing significantly outperforms soft expert blending in quality metrics, indicating that preserving expert isolation is critical for maintaining performance in our continual learning setting. Finally, we observe that a divergence between token-level accuracy and downstream generation quality may occur, highlighting the need for more comprehensive evaluation protocols in future research on lifelong motion-language agents.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 1 figure, Accepted at the Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对运动语言代理的持续学习问题，提出基于低秩适应（LoRA）变体的方法，结合混合专家（MoE）架构，利用自编码器路由器在推理时选择任务特定专家，无需任务标签。在从HumanML3D构建的五任务基准上，该方法在动作到文本（M2T）和文本到动作（T2M）两个方向上均实现近零遗忘，同时保持高质量的生成与描述。实验表明硬专家选择在质量指标上显著优于软专家混合，并发现token级准确率与下游生成质量可能不一致。
Motivation: 基础运动语言模型在静态设置下表现良好，但自主代理需在动态环境中持续融入新动作概念（如新运动风格或手势），同时避免灾难性遗忘已有技能，当前研究缺乏对双向运动语言持续学习稳定-可塑性权衡的系统探讨。
Method: 基于冻结的大语言模型（LLM）骨干，引入LoRA变体以减少任务间干扰，并设计混合专家架构，通过自编码器学习路由函数，在推理时根据输入选择特定任务专家，从而消除对任务标签的依赖。
Result: 在基于HumanML3D语义聚类构建的五任务基准上，M2T和T2M方向均实现近零遗忘，同时保持高生成与描述质量；硬专家选择在质量指标上显著优于软专家混合，表明保持专家隔离是持续学习性能的关键。
Conclusion: 论文强调隔离专家对维持性能的重要性，并指出token级准确率与下游生成质量可能存在偏差，呼吁未来研究采用更全面的评估协议。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Is a Draft Accepted? A Theory of Acceptance in Speculative Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates language model inference by using a fast drafter to propose candidate tokens that are then verified by a larger target model. Existing theory largely studies the stochastic, distribution-preserving setting, where the goal is to exactly sample from the target distribution. In contrast, many practical systems use greedy decoding, relaxed acceptance rules, or tree-based candidate sets, where success is governed by local ranking and threshold events rather than exact distributional equality. We develop a theory for these regimes. We identify that many common acceptance criteria have rejection regions that can be characterized as lower level sets of the target distribution. For these, we characterize the exact KL divergence required for rejection yielding exact certificates and sharp margin-based bounds for strict greedy decoding, additive and multiplicative relaxed acceptance, top-(m) relaxed criteria, and entropy-thresholded acceptance. We then extend the framework to greedy tree decoding, deriving exact and margin-only certificates for when the target greedy token remains covered by the drafter's top-(m) candidates. Finally, we evaluate the resulting certificates on Qwen3 models, showing that relaxed and tree-based criteria substantially enlarge the region of certified acceptance, especially on decoding steps with low target model distribution margin. These results complement existing distribution-preserving analyses of speculative decoding by characterizing the deterministic local acceptance events common in practical inference systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对投机解码中的常见接受准则（如贪心解码、松弛接受、top-m准则、熵阈值接受及贪心树解码）提出理论框架，将拒绝区域刻画为目标分布的低水平集，推导了精确的KL散度需求和基于边界的界限。在Qwen3模型上的实验表明，松弛和树形准则显著扩大了认证接受区域，尤其在目标模型分布边际较低的步骤上。
Motivation: 现有投机解码理论主要研究随机、保分布设置，但实际系统常用贪心解码、松弛接受规则或树形候选集，这些场景的成功由局部排序和阈值事件决定，缺乏严格理论分析。
Method: 通过将拒绝区域刻画为目标分布的低水平集，推导了不同接受准则下所需的精确KL散度界限；对贪心树解码给出了目标贪心token被drafter top-m候选覆盖的精确和仅边界证书。
Result: 在Qwen3模型中，松弛和树形准则显著扩大认证接受区域，尤其在目标模型分布边际较低的解码步骤上。
Conclusion: 该理论补充了现有保分布分析，刻画了实际推理系统中常见的确定性局部接受事件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Defending Against Harmful Supervision Hidden in Benign Samples
papers.abstract_en: Existing defenses are effective when harmful content is explicitly mixed into downstream fine-tuning data, but crafted samples can instead hide harmful supervision inside benign tasks. We propose Embedded Attack, where harmful QA pairs are embedded within benign training samples, and show that representative guardrails often fail to detect them at the example level. To address this, we propose Dual-Reference SFT (DR-SFT), which adapts DPO-style contrastive objective design to SFT through token-level regularization, mitigating harmful fine-tuning beyond coarse data filtering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现现有防御机制在面对将有害监督隐藏于良性样本中的对抗攻击时极易失效。作者提出Embedded Attack，将有害QA对嵌入良性训练样本，并展示代表性防护措施在示例级别难以检测。为应对此问题，提出Dual-Reference SFT（DR-SFT），通过令牌级正则化将DPO式对比目标适配到SFT，从而超越粗粒度数据过滤来减轻有害微调。
Motivation: 现有防御主要针对显式混合有害内容，但未能应对将有害监督隐藏在看似良性的任务中的对抗性样本。
Method: 提出Embedded Attack攻击方法，将有害QA对嵌入良性训练样本；并设计Dual-Reference SFT（DR-SFT），在SFT中引入令牌级正则化的DPO式对比目标进行防御。
Result: 摘要表明代表性防护措施（如基础SFT）在示例级别无法检测Embedded Attack，而DR-SFT能够缓解有害微调。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了隐式有害监督的威胁，并提出了一种超越数据过滤层的防御框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Intermediate Text Representation Guided Text-to-Image Generation for Enhancing One-and-Only Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models often fail to faithfully render explicit textual descriptions, instead defaulting to strongly learned visual priors due to a phenomenon referred to as concept association bias. We show that such bias is particularly strong for one-and-only (OAO) objects, entities that exist in a single canonical form, such as celestial bodies, landmarks, and artworks. The deeply ingrained visual identity for these concepts often resists modification through prompting alone. Addressing this challenge, we first identify through an information-theoretic analysis that the final text embedding discards concept-level information present in the intermediate-layer text representations, reducing the mutual information available to the subsequent denoising process. We then propose Intermediate Text Representation (IR)-guided diffusion, which injects intermediate hidden states of the text encoder into the conditioning signal during early denoising steps, recovering suppressed concepts without any additional training, optimization, or external models. To systematically evaluate the challenging task of aligning generative outputs with unusual prompts for OAO objects, we introduce OAO-AttackBench, a benchmark comprising counterfactual prompts that directly conflict with the core visual identity of OAO objects. Experiments on four benchmarks, including OAO-AttackBench, show that our method achieves up to a 19.1 percentage-point improvement in VQAScore while preserving generation fidelity and human preference. Project page: https://soyoun-won.github.io/one-and-only-ir-guidance/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像扩散模型中的概念关联偏差，尤其对于“唯一性对象”（如天体、地标、艺术品）往往难以通过提示修改其视觉身份的问题，提出无训练的中间文本表示引导扩散方法，通过注入文本编码器的中间隐藏状态恢复丢失的概念信息。实验在包括新提出的OAO-AttackBench在内的四个基准上取得最高19.1个百分点的VQAScore提升。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型在生成唯一性对象（如特定天体、地标）时，由于概念关联偏差，常忽视文本描述而依赖强视觉先验，导致提示对齐失败。
Method: 提出中间文本表示（IR）引导扩散，在去噪早期步骤中将文本编码器的中间隐藏状态注入条件信号，无需额外训练或优化，即可恢复被最终文本嵌入丢弃的概念级信息。
Result: 在四个基准上，包括自建的OAO-AttackBench（包含与唯一性对象视觉身份冲突的反事实提示），方法最高提升VQAScore 19.1个百分点，同时保持生成保真度和人类偏好。
Conclusion: 无训练的中间表示注入可有效缓解唯一性对象的概念关联偏差，且不依赖外部模型，但方法仅针对文本到图像生成中的特定偏差类型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KnowsTFM: Knowledge-Informed Fine-Tuning of Small Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models have advanced deep learning for tabular data by delivering strong default performance across many small and medium tasks. Yet in niche domains, where data is scarce, high-dimensional, and shifted from the pretraining distribution, they may still fail to outperform carefully designed domain-specific methods. Many such domains also provide curated relational knowledge in the form of knowledge graphs and knowledge banks, but how to use this knowledge to improve and steer \textit{small} specialist tabular foundation models remains unclear. We address this problem through \textbf{Know}ledge-informed fine-tuning of \textbf{s}mall \textbf{T}abular \textbf{F}oundation \textbf{M}odels (\modelname). Specifically, we study nanoscale TabPFN- and TabICL-style variants, pretrained under controlled synthetic prior families and adapted using two complementary mechanisms: structural attention priors derived from knowledge graphs and parameter-efficient low-rank updates. We show that injecting domain-specific structural knowledge during fine-tuning yields meaningful gains over vanilla variants in specialist settings, whereas gains on general-domain tasks are marginal. We further observe that continual fine-tuning of frontier models can trigger collapse of pretrained knowledge and mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出知识引导微调（Knowledge-Informed Fine-Tuning）方法，针对小型表格基础模型（如TabPFN和TabICL变体）在专业领域数据稀缺、分布偏移时的性能提升问题。通过注入知识图谱的结构注意力先验和参数高效低秩更新，在专业场景下获得有意义改进，但通用领域提升微弱，且持续微调可能导致预训练知识崩溃。
Motivation: 在数据稀缺、高维且分布偏移的利基领域，现有表格基础模型可能不如专门设计的领域方法，而许多这类领域拥有知识图谱等结构化知识，但如何有效利用它们来改进小型表格基础模型尚不明确。
Method: 提出KnowsTFM框架，采用两种互补机制：从知识图谱导出的结构注意力先验（structural attention priors）和参数高效低秩更新（parameter-efficient low-rank updates），对预训练的小型表格基础模型（TabPFN/TabICL变体）进行微调。
Result: 在专业设置中，注入知识图谱的模型相比普通变体有显著提升，而在通用领域任务上提升微弱。此外，持续微调前沿模型可能导致预训练知识崩溃。

papers.title: EMPATH: A Multilingual Auditor-Judge Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Emotional-Support Chatbots
papers.abstract_en: Safety benchmarks often buy scalability by fixing the prompt, the language, and the turn structure. For emotional-support chatbots, that bargain hides precisely where safety failures emerge: across a multilingual, multi-turn crisis conversation. We present EMPATH, a benchmark for safety evaluation of emotional-support chatbots. An auditor model role-plays help-seeking users, generating multi-turn conversations from 140 seed instructions and 34 personas. A judge model scores each full transcript against 19 metrics across five dimensions: crisis handling, therapeutic quality, conversational integrity, emotional safety, and cultural adaptation. EMPATH is built for Mexican Spanish and US English; the studies reported here run in Mexican Spanish. Auditor and judge are drawn from different model families, and the judge is treated as an instrument to be calibrated rather than trusted. A strict per-criterion rubric reveals material score inflation on 10 of the 19 metrics and restores discrimination. We study the measurement properties of the benchmark through judge calibration and cross-family inter-judge agreement. We also illustrate EMPATH on three frontier models, one of them open-weight. Aggregate scores sit within 0.74 points of one another, but per-metric profiles diverge by up to six points in model-specific places. Under the standard rubric, both the ranking and the weak spots are stable across a second, cross-family judge: 93% of scores fall within plus or minus 1. A five-run test-retest adds a second axis: even the steadiest model swings from 2 to 10 on a crisis metric across identical re-runs, and deepseek-v4-pro returns a different conversation on every run even at temperature 0. Run-to-run reliability is therefore a per-model safety property, not noise to average away. EMPATH is system-agnostic; the pipeline, seeds, personas, and rubrics are released for reuse.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EMPATH，一个多语言审计-法官基准，用于评估情感支持聊天机器人的安全性。审计模型扮演求助用户生成多轮对话，法官模型按19个指标（覆盖危机处理、治疗质量、对话完整性、情感安全和文化适应）评分。在墨西哥西班牙语上的实验发现标准评分准则导致10个指标分数膨胀，校准后恢复区分度。三个前沿模型的聚合得分相近（差0.74以内），但分指标差异高达6点；跨家族法官一致性高（93%评分在±1内），但运行间可靠性因模型而异，deepseek-v4-pro即使在温度0也会每次生成不同对话。
Motivation: 现有安全基准通常固定提示、语言和回合结构，这无法捕捉情感支持聊天机器人在多语言、多轮危机对话中的安全失败。
Method: EMPATH包含两个组件：审计模型（auditor）基于140条种子指令和34种角色扮演对模型生成多轮对话；法官模型（judge）对完整对话按5个维度19个指标评分。法官来源于不同模型家族，并经过校准以消除分数膨胀。
Result: 在19个指标中，有10个存在显著的分数膨胀，校准后恢复了区分度。三个前沿模型（含一个开源权重模型）的聚合得分差异在0.74以内，但分指标评分差异高达6分。跨家族法官的评分一致性高：93%的分数落在±1以内。然而，运行间可靠性因模型而异，最稳定的模型在危机指标上的得分在2到10之间波动，deepseek-v4-pro即使在温度0下每次运行也产生不同对话。
Conclusion: EMPATH是系统无关的，其管道、种子、角色和评分准则已公开发布。论文强调运行间可靠性是每个模型自身的安全属性，不应被视为可平均的噪声。

papers.title: Inoculation Adapters: Improved Selective Generalization of Capabilities with Fewer Surprising Backdoors
papers.abstract_en: Inoculation prompting is a selective generalization technique used against Emergent Misalignment. We introduce inoculation adapters (IA), which similarly diminish the optimization pressure to learn undesired traits by strengthening the trait at train time. Inoculation adapters are LoRAs that are trained and used over three steps: 1) trained on undesired traits; 2) attached frozen while a separate task adapter is trained on data exhibiting both desired and undesired traits; 3) at deployment, the IA is discarded, and only the task adapter is kept. We show across six model families and several undesired traits including emergent misalignment, that inoculation adapters are more effective at suppressing undesired traits, while avoiding two drawbacks of inoculation prompting: inoculation adapters can suppress capabilities and traits that cannot be reliably elicited by a prompt, and they introduce fewer surprising backdoors than inoculation prompting under our probes. While undesired traits are better suppressed by inoculation adapters, the retention of desired traits is not consistently improved upon inoculation prompting and remains a challenge for both techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出接种适配器（Inoculation Adapters, IA），一种改进的选择性泛化技术，用于抑制不期望的模型特质（如突发性错误对齐）。IA通过三步训练：先在不良特质上训练LoRA，然后冻结该LoRA并训练任务适配器，最后丢弃IA仅保留任务适配器。实验表明，相比于接种提示（Inoculation Prompting），IA能更有效抑制不良特质，且引入的意外后门更少，但保留期望特质方面仍有挑战。
Motivation: 接种提示存在两个缺点：无法抑制无法通过提示可靠诱发的特质，且可能引入意外后门。本文旨在解决这些问题。
Method: 提出接种适配器方法，利用低秩适配（LoRA）分三步训练：1）在不良特质上训练IA；2）冻结IA，训练另一个任务适配器；3）部署时丢弃IA，仅使用任务适配器。
Result: 在六个模型系列和多种不良特质上，IA比接种提示更有效地抑制不良特质，且引入更少的意外后门。
Conclusion: IA改善了选择性泛化，减少了意外后门，但保留期望特质方面仍有改进空间。

papers.title: Curvature-Guided Sheaf Diffusion for Unsupervised Community Detection on Heterophilic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Detecting communities in heterophilic graphs -- where connected nodes often belong to different classes -- is hard for unsupervised methods: classical modularity and spectral methods are feature agnostic, while deep graph-clustering methods rely on contrastive or generative machinery that is opaque. We propose Curvature-Guided Sheaf Diffusion (CGSD), a fully unsupervised community-detection algorithm that uses the discrete Forman--Ricci curvature of each edge as its single topological signal, propagated through every stage of an end-to-end pipeline. CGSD makes three concrete contributions: (i)~a curvature-gated sheaf-diffusion encoder that gates edge messages by $σ(κ_e)$ and is trained from three label-free structural losses (modularity, anti-collapse, curvature-weighted reconstruction); (ii)~a curvature-aware spectral clusterer (CSpec) that re-weights the $k$-NN affinity of the embedding by $σ(ακ_{e^*})$ before Ng--Jordan--Weiss; and (iii)~a unified label-free evaluation against nine truly-unsupervised baselines. On five heterophilic benchmarks (Cora, Cornell, Texas, Wisconsin, Chameleon), CGSD wins outright on Wisconsin and Chameleon and is competitive on the remaining three against nine unsupervised baselines. The gain over the strongest baseline is driven by the clusterer, not the encoder: on the same embedding, CSpec improves mean NMI from $0.091$ with $K$-Means to $0.107$ ($+15\%$, paired $t$-test $p=0.008$). The mechanism is interpretable: intra-community and inter-community curvature distributions are visibly separated. Code is open-sourced at https://github.com/woodywff/cgsd.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Curvature-Guided Sheaf Diffusion (CGSD)，一种完全无监督的社区检测算法，专门针对异配图（heterophilic graphs）设计。利用离散Forman-Ricci曲率作为拓扑信号，通过曲率门控编码器和曲率感知谱聚类，在五个异配基准上取得竞争性结果，并在Wisconsin和Chameleon上达到最优。代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有无监督社区检测方法在异配图上效果不佳：经典模块度和谱方法忽略节点特征，而深度图聚类方法依赖不透明的对比或生成损失机制，难以适应异配结构。
Method: 提出CGSD，包含三个贡献：(i) 曲率门控的sheaf diffusion编码器，通过sigmoid(κ_e)控制消息传递，并用模度、抗塌缩和曲率加权重建三种无标签损失训练；(ii) 曲率感知谱聚类器CSpec，在Ng-Jordan-Weiss谱聚类前对嵌入的k-NN亲和度进行曲率加权；(iii) 与九个真正无监督基线进行统一无标签评估。
Result: 在Cora、Cornell、Texas、Wisconsin、Chameleon五个异配基准上，CGSD在Wisconsin和Chameleon上取得最佳，其余三个上具有竞争力。在相同嵌入上，CSpec相比K-Means将平均NMI从0.091提升至0.107（+15%，配对t检验p=0.008）。
Conclusion: 该方法的机制可解释：社区内和社区间的曲率分布明显分离。代码开源，为异配图无监督社区检测提供了基于几何曲率的新途径。

papers.title: Your Data Manifold is Secretly a Reward Model: Shell-LCC for Text-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models rely heavily on auxiliary reward signals (e.g., via reward models or DPO) to align generated content with human aesthetics and improve realism. These signals, however, incur substantial computational overhead, require costly human annotations, and often yield limited improvement in fine-grained local details. In this paper, we argue that your data manifold is secretly a reward model. By explicitly modeling the manifold structure of high-quality Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) data and encouraging video latents to lie on this manifold, we derive dense, differentiable, and nearly cost-free reward signals that significantly improve video quality, particularly in mitigating low-level distortions. Our modeling builds upon Local Coordinate Coding (LCC), which captures the `skeleton' of the manifold. However, directly applying LCC suffers from mean regression, pulling latents toward the geometric mean and losing high-frequency details. We therefore extend it to Shell Local Coordinate Coding (Shell-LCC), which models the manifold `surface' as an isotropic shell to align with the true high-density region. Experiments demonstrate that our approach improves realism, enhances high-frequency details, reduces over-smoothing artifacts, and alleviates motion blur.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出数据流形本身可作为奖励模型，用于文本到视频（T2V）扩散模型的训练。通过Shell Local Coordinate Coding (Shell-LCC) 建模高质量SFT数据的流形表面，提供密集、可微且几乎无成本的奖励信号，有效提升视频质量，减少低级失真和运动模糊。
Motivation: 现有T2V模型依赖辅助奖励信号（如奖励模型或DPO），计算成本高、需要人工标注，且对局部细节改善有限。论文探索利用数据流形结构作为内在奖励源。
Method: 基于Local Coordinate Coding (LCC) 捕获流形骨架，但LCC存在均值回归导致高频细节丢失的问题。为此提出Shell-LCC，将流形表面建模为各向同性壳层，以对齐真实高密度区域，从而获得更优的奖励信号。
Result: 实验表明，该方法能改善生成视频的真实感，增强高频细节，减少过度平滑伪影，并缓解运动模糊。
Conclusion: 通过显式建模高质量SFT数据的流形表面结构，可以衍生出有效的奖励信号，无需额外标注或计算开销，为T2V生成提供新视角。

papers.title: Clarus: Coordinating Autonomous Research Agents toward Web-Scale Scientific Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Existing autonomous research agents can support parts of the research process, but most systems still treat research as either an isolated assistant task or a closed workflow. Therefore, autonomous science needs a collaboration infrastructure that coordinates projects, agents, and digital and physical resources. We identify this as a shift from code-centered execution loops to research-oriented collaboration processes, where questions, evidence, participants, and resources must be coordinated under uncertainty. In this framing, an agent may be an AI system, a human researcher, a team, a laboratory, or an organization-backed participant. To this end, we present Clarus, a collaboration infrastructure for coordinating autonomous research agents toward web-scale scientific collaboration. Clarus reformulates research as an open, auditable, attributable, and resource-aware multi-phase collaboration process. It defines a minimal project-agent-resource object model and organizes scientific collaboration through four layers including Research Application, Digital Collaboration, Physical Substrate, and Physical World. Core modules are implemented as pluggable mechanisms, allowing Clarus to adapt to task risk, collaboration structure, and resource constraints. Through a controlled paper-generation case study, we show that Clarus can organize a research goal into a traceable, reviewable, attributable, and accumulative collaboration network across phases, tasks, and participants. Together, the object model, collaboration protocol, trust mechanisms, and prototype validation provide an initial foundation for open research networks. Clarus is now available at clarus.holosai.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Clarus是一个用于协调自主研究代理进行大规模科学协作的基础设施，将研究重新定义为开放、可审计、可归属且资源感知的多阶段协作过程。它定义了最小项目-代理-资源对象模型，并通过四个层次组织科学协作。通过受控的论文生成案例研究，展示了Clarus能将研究目标组织成可追踪、可审查、可归属和可累积的协作网络。
Motivation: 现有自主研究代理大多将研究视为孤立助手任务或封闭工作流，缺乏协调项目、代理及数字和物理资源的协作基础设施，因此需要从以代码执行为中心转向以研究为导向的协作过程。
Method: Clarus提出了一种协作基础设施，包含最小项目-代理-资源对象模型和四个层次（Research Application, Digital Collaboration, Physical Substrate, Physical World），核心模块作为可插拔机制实现，以适应任务风险、协作结构和资源约束。
Result: 通过受控的论文生成案例研究，Clarus能够将研究目标组织成跨阶段、任务和参与者的可追踪、可审查、可归属和可累积的协作网络。
Conclusion: Clarus的对象模型、协作协议、信任机制和原型验证为开放研究网络提供了初步基础，并已开源。

papers.title: Semantic-Driven Scale and Spatial Selection for Efficient Cross-Modal Alignment in Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Referring Remote Sensing Image Segmentation (RRSIS) seeks to localize and segment the target object or region specified by a natural language expression in a remote sensing image. While existing RRSIS models have benefited from large-scale foundation models, they predominantly rely on full fine-tuning. These approaches are computationally intensive and may weaken the generalization ability of pre-trained models, as extensive fine-tuning on significantly smaller downstream datasets can distort the well-structured feature representations learned during large-scale pre-training. Although Parameter-Efficient Tuning (PET) offers a potential alternative, existing PET frameworks primarily focus on single-modal optimization, failing to capture the complex cross-modal dependencies required for multimodal reasoning, while simultaneously struggling to bridge the substantial domain gap between natural scenes and aerial imagery. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework, Semantic-driven Scale and Spatial Selection for Efficient Cross-modal Alignment (S4ECA), which enables effective and efficient cross-modal interaction through parameter-efficient adaptation. Specifically, we design a dual-encoder adapter architecture. The textual adapter employs learnable queries to distill highly semantic language proxies from word-level embeddings, facilitating early grounding. Simultaneously, the visual adapter refines hierarchical feature representations through a multi-scale dense extractor, followed by a language-guided scale and spatial selection mechanism that dynamically emphasizes relevant visual contexts, ensuring precise cross-modal alignment. By updating only 2.4% of the backbone parameters, our proposed model achieves state-of-the-art performance on the RRSIS-D and RefSegRS datasets, demonstrating superior efficiency and precision in complex aerial scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语义驱动的尺度和空间选择高效跨模态对齐框架（S4ECA），用于遥感图像指代分割（RRSIS）。仅更新2.4%骨干参数，在RRSIS-D和RefSegRS数据集上取得最佳性能，平衡了效率和精度。
Motivation: 现有RRSIS模型全微调计算量大且损害泛化能力，参数高效微调（PET）虽能缓解但主要针对单模态，未能有效处理多模态跨模态依赖和自然场景与航拍图像的领域差距。
Method: 设计双编码器适配器架构：文本适配器用可学习查询从词级嵌入中提取高级语义代理；视觉适配器通过多尺度密集提取器和语言引导的尺度空间选择机制动态强调相关视觉上下文，实现精确跨模态对齐。
Result: 仅更新2.4%骨干参数，在RRSIS-D和RefSegRS数据集上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该方法在复杂航拍场景中展现出优越的效率和精度，为遥感图像指代分割提供了一种轻量级高效方案。

papers.title: A Distributionally Robust Framework for Learned Reconstructions in Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Learned reconstruction operators for inverse problems are typically trained under a fixed noise model, and generalize poorly when the distribution during testing differs from the one assumed during training. Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) addresses this by optimizing against the worst-case distribution within a prescribed ambiguity set, but standard Wasserstein DRO perturbs the full joint distribution uniformly, which can be overly conservative and ignores the physics of the measurement process. We develop a structured DRO framework in which the ambiguity set is restricted to structured perturbations aligned with the data-acquisition process. This allows us to learn data-driven reconstruction operators that remain robust to distributional shifts. By constraining perturbations to subsets such as $P(Y|X)$, our framework models uncertainty in the forward operator and noise model more faithfully, accommodating any noise model expressible as a stochastic forward operator. We establish strong duality for this general formulation and derive explicit finite-dimensional dual representations for perturbations in the joint, marginal, and conditional distributions. A central result is an explicit worst-case risk bound that induces Tikhonov regularization on the Lipschitz constant of the reconstruction operator, and is less conservative relative to standard DRO for well-posed problems. Numerical experiments on deblurring and sinogram-to-CT reconstruction demonstrate improved robustness, stability, and interpretability over standard DRO and MSE baselines. In the linear setting, the learned operator becomes effectively low-rank, truncating at the intrinsic dimension of the data and recovering a data-driven analogue of truncated-SVD regularization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对逆问题中学习重建算子在测试分布与训练分布不同时泛化差的问题，提出一种结构化分布鲁棒优化（DRO）框架。该框架将模糊集限制为与数据采集过程一致的结构化扰动，从而更精确地建模前向算子和噪声模型的不确定性。主要理论结果包括强对偶性、显式有限维对偶表示，以及一个诱导Tikhonov正则化的最坏情况风险界。数值实验在去模糊和CT重建任务上展示了比标准DRO和MSE基线更好的鲁棒性和稳定性。
Motivation: 标准Wasserstein DRO扰动整个联合分布，忽略测量过程的物理结构，可能过于保守。需要一种结构化方法，使模糊集与数据采集过程对齐。
Method: 提出结构化DRO框架，将模糊集限制在联合分布、边缘分布或条件分布的子集上，特别是扰动条件分布P(Y|X)来建模前向算子和噪声模型的不确定性。推导了强对偶性和显式对偶表示，并得到风险界。
Result: 主要结果是风险界诱导了重建算子Lipschitz常数的Tikhonov正则化，且对于良态问题比标准DRO更不保守。数值实验在去模糊和CT重建上展示了改进的鲁棒性、稳定性和可解释性。在线性设置中，学习到的算子变为有效低秩。
Conclusion: 结构化DRO为学习鲁棒重建算子提供了一个原理性框架，能更好地利用测量过程的物理结构，减少保守性。

papers.title: B3O: Scalable Boltzmann Batch Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Modern engineering workflows increasingly rely on massive parallel simulation, driving the need for scalable, large-batch Bayesian Optimization (BO). Existing batch BO methods, however, incur large computational cost or rely on approximations that erode batch diversity. We propose B3O (Boltzmann Batch Bayesian Optimization), a framework that reframes batch generation as a pure sampling problem: drawing samples directly from the Boltzmann distribution defined by the acquisition function avoids the bottlenecks of existing large-batch methods. Theoretically, we prove that queries sampled from this distribution incur only negligible additional regret. Empirically, B3O outperforms existing batch BO methods on standard synthetic benchmarks and adapts robustly across complex applied tasks, including multi-objective electrode design and mixed-variable race car configuration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: B3O 提出将批量贝叶斯优化中的批次生成问题重新定义为直接采样问题，即从由采集函数定义的玻尔兹曼分布中抽取样本，从而避免了现有大规模批量方法的计算瓶颈。理论证明该分布的查询仅带来可忽略的额外遗憾，实验表明 B3O 在标准合成基准和多目标电极设计、混合变量赛车配置等复杂应用任务上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有批量贝叶斯优化方法在大批量场景下计算成本高或依赖近似而导致批次多样性不足，难以满足大规模并行仿真的需求。
Method: 提出 B3O 框架，将批次生成视为纯采样问题：直接从采集函数定义的玻尔兹曼分布中采样，避免了传统方法的瓶颈。
Result: 理论上证明该采样方法仅引入可忽略的额外遗憾；实验在标准合成基准上优于现有批量 BO 方法，并在多目标电极设计和混合变量赛车配置等任务中表现出鲁棒性。
Conclusion: B3O 是一种可扩展的大规模批量贝叶斯优化方法，通过直接采样避免了计算瓶颈和多样性损失，适用于复杂工程应用。

papers.title: Characterizing Optimizer-Dependent Training Dynamics Through Hessian Eigenvector Displacement and Localization
papers.abstract_en: Hessian spectral properties are a standard tool in analysing neural-network training, with eigenvalues linked to sharpness, generalization, and optimization dynamics. Eigenvalues quantify curvature magnitude, while eigenvectors identify which parameters generate that curvature. In this work, we study how the leading Hessian eigenvectors evolve during training and how they affect the learning trajectories. We track the training dynamics of multilayer perceptrons on a classification problem and measure eigenvector dynamics through two complementary statistics: (i) displacement over time, inspired by analyses of glassy systems, and (ii) localization via the inverse participation ratio. The metrics are compared against a random null model of the Hessian induced by the architecture. Our results reveal clear optimizer-dependent behaviour. SGD leads to progressively more stable leading curvature directions, while Adam exhibits substantially stronger reorganization of eigenvectors throughout training. We also observe a localization phenomenon under Adam, where a small subset of parameters contributes disproportionately to the leading curvature directions. These results suggest that Hessian eigenvector dynamics capture key differences in optimizer behaviour and the resulting training trajectories.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster at High-dimensional Learning Dynamics (HiLD), ICML 2026. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=SabYcw5Nh6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究神经网络训练过程中Hessian矩阵主导特征向量的演化，通过位移（displacement）和局域化（inverse participation ratio）两个统计量分析多层感知机在分类任务上的训练动态。实验发现SGD优化器下曲率方向逐渐稳定，而Adam则持续重组特征向量并表现出显著的参数局域化现象。
Motivation: 现有工作主要通过Hessian特征值分析曲率大小，但特征向量如何随时间演化及其对训练轨迹的影响尚不明确，理解这一动态有助于揭示优化器之间的行为差异。
Method: 跟踪多层感知机在分类问题上的训练过程，计算Hessian主导特征向量的位移（借鉴玻璃系统分析）和逆参与率（IPR）来衡量局域化程度，并与架构诱导的随机零模型进行比较。
Result: SGD训练中主导曲率方向逐渐稳定，而Adam则表现出更强的特征向量重组；Adam下少数参数对曲率方向贡献不成比例，出现局域化现象。
Conclusion: Hessian特征向量动力学能够捕捉不同优化器行为的关键差异，为理解训练轨迹提供新视角。

papers.title: From Accuracy to Visual Dependence: Auditing and Filtering Modality Collapse in Traffic VideoQA
papers.abstract_en: High benchmark accuracy does not guarantee genuine use of visual evidence. We study this problem in traffic accident Video Question Answering (VideoQA), where correct answers should depend on scene-specific visual evidence but may instead be inferred from textual shortcuts. Through an audit of four public benchmarks, we find that several recent open-weight Vision-Language Models (VLMs) perform competitively, and sometimes better, without video input. On the MM-AU benchmark, removing video consistently improves accuracy, and adding more frames further degrades performance. To quantify visual dependence, we introduce two dataset-level diagnostics: Blind Gap, measuring above-chance text-only performance, and Visual Gain, measuring the marginal benefit of adding video. We further propose an instance-level Shortcut Score that combines text-only confidence with visual necessity signals, enabling continuous, training-free filtering of shortcut-prone questions. The resulting subsets reduce shortcut bias and improve visual grounding. Our findings reveal large differences in grounding quality across benchmarks and show that visually grounded evaluation, not just high accuracy, is essential in safety-critical VideoQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计了交通事故视频问答（VideoQA）中的模态坍塌问题，发现多个开源视觉语言模型（VLM）在没有视频输入时性能更好甚至更高。作者提出两个数据集级诊断指标（Blind Gap和Visual Gain）和一个实例级Shortcut Score，用于量化视觉依赖并过滤捷径问题。实验表明，在MM-AU基准上移除视频反而提升准确率，过滤后的子集减少了捷径偏差并改善了视觉基础。
Motivation: 高基准准确率可能来自文本捷径而非真正的视觉推理，这在安全关键的交通场景中尤其危险，需要诊断和过滤模型对视觉信息的依赖程度。
Method: 首先审计四个公开基准上的多个VLM，比较有无视频输入的性能；然后引入Blind Gap（文本仅准确率超出随机水平）和Visual Gain（添加视频的边际收益）两个数据集级指标，并设计实例级Shortcut Score结合文本置信度和视觉必要性信号，实现无需训练的捷径问题过滤。
Result: 在MM-AU基准上，去除视频持续提升准确率，增加帧数反而降低性能；过滤捷径后的子集减少了偏差并改善了视觉基础。
Conclusion: 视觉基础的评估（而非仅高准确率）对于安全关键VideoQA至关重要，且不同基准的视觉基础质量存在显著差异。

summary_sections.conclusion: 视觉基础的评估（而非仅高准确率）对于安全关键VideoQA至关重要，且不同基准的视觉基础质量存在显著差异。

papers.title: EvalSafetyGap: A Hybrid Survey and Conceptual Framework for LLM Evaluation-Safety Failures
papers.abstract_en: LLM evaluation and AI safety face a shared measurement problem: benchmark scores, reward-model signals, and reported safety metrics can improve while the latent properties they are meant to represent remain difficult to verify. This paper combines a hybrid survey - a systematic search paired with narrative synthesis and separately tracked grey evidence - with a conceptual framework and a structured ten-model audit. The synthesis spans eight evidence streams: benchmark validity, dynamic evaluation, LLM-as-judge reliability, safety evaluation, jailbreak/refusal robustness, reward hacking, mechanistic interpretability, and governance/auditability, covering 2018-2026 evaluation-safety measurement work. We introduce EvalSafetyGap as an organizing hypothesis for comparing evaluation-side and alignment-side proxy failures under optimization pressure, using Goodhart's Law together with two constructs we develop here - an Instability Decomposition and an Alignment Trilemma - as tools for generating testable comparisons. The audit shows how conclusions shift when capability, behavioral safety, and governance are measured separately. In this sample (n = 10), the association between capability and sustained adversarial robustness is statistically indeterminate using the displayed Table 3 inputs (Pearson r = +0.232, p = 0.520), and the apparent open-closed safety gap is modest, driven mainly by governance and disclosure rather than behavioral robustness, and sensitive to how a single borderline model is classified; attempt-budget results are protocol dependent. Because the public evidence uses heterogeneous protocols, the audit is diagnostic rather than rank-generating. The contribution is a shared vocabulary and evidence map to support dynamic evaluation, transparent source reporting, multi-attempt safety measurement, and auditable alignment practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过混合调查（系统搜索与叙述综合）和概念框架，结合10个模型的审计，提出EvalSafetyGap作为组织假设，用于比较LLM评估和对齐中的代理失败。摘要涵盖基准有效性、动态评估、LLM-as-judge可靠性、安全评估、越狱/拒绝鲁棒性、奖励破解、可解释性和治理等8个证据流，并引入不稳定性分解和对齐三难困境。审计显示能力与持续对抗鲁棒性之间的关联统计上不显著，开放-封闭安全差距主要由治理和披露驱动而非行为鲁棒性。
Motivation: LLM评估和AI安全面临共同的测量问题：基准分数、奖励模型信号和报告的安全指标可能提升，但潜在属性仍难以验证。
Method: 结合混合调查（系统搜索与叙述综合，并单独跟踪灰色证据）、概念框架和结构化10模型审计，引入EvalSafetyGap假设以及不稳定性分解和对齐三难困境作为工具。
Result: 在10个模型的审计中，能力与持续对抗鲁棒性之间的关联统计上不显著（Pearson r=+0.232, p=0.520），开放-封闭安全差距较小且主要由治理和披露驱动，结果对单个边界模型的分类敏感。
Conclusion: 贡献在于提供共享词汇和证据图，支持动态评估、透明来源报告、多次尝试安全测量和可审计的对齐实践。

papers.title: Efficient RGB-T Object Detection via Sparse Cross-Modality Fusion
papers.abstract_en: RGB-T detectors leverage the complementary strengths of visible and thermal infrared modalities, achieving robust performance under challenging conditions. Many of them resort to heavy dual backbones and exhaustive cross-modality fusion across the entire image, leading to impractically high computational costs. We observe that most image regions are smooth backgrounds (e.g., sky, ground) that can be easily handled by lightweight single-modality models. In light of this observation, we propose a sparse fusion mechanism for efficient RGB-T detection: first rapidly scanning the image to identify the proposals and then carefully examining the remaining sparse proposals via feature fusion. We propose a two-stage framework to instantiate this mechanism, which performs detection in two stages: 1) a lightweight and modality-specific detection stage that produces high-recall RoIs, and 2) a fusion-driven examination and refinement stage that filters out the false positives and refines the bounding boxes. This design enables the detector to adaptively allocate more computational resources to the potential foregrounds, improving the efficiency while ensuring detection accuracy. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves competitive performance with substantially fewer parameters and lower cost, while maintaining strong scalability to high-resolution images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对RGB-T目标检测中计算成本高的问题，提出稀疏跨模态融合机制。通过快速扫描生成候选区域，再对稀疏候选区域进行特征融合，从而实现高效检测。两阶段框架包括轻量级单模态检测产生高召回率RoI，以及融合驱动的精细化阶段。实验表明该方法在保持竞争力的同时显著减少参数量和计算成本，且对高分辨率图像可扩展。
Motivation: 现有RGB-T检测器依赖重型双骨干网络和全图跨模态融合，计算成本高。作者观察到大多数图像区域是平滑背景，可由轻量级单模态模型处理，因此需要更高效的融合策略。
Method: 提出稀疏融合机制，先快速扫描图像获取候选区域，再对稀疏候选区域进行跨模态特征融合。具体为两阶段框架：第一阶段使用轻量级模态专用检测器产生高召回率RoI；第二阶段进行融合驱动的检查和细化，过滤假阳性并优化边界框。
Result: 实验表明方法在保持竞争性能的同时，参数量和计算成本显著降低，且对高分辨率图像具有良好的可扩展性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过自适应地分配更多计算资源给潜在前景，提高了效率同时保证了检测精度。

papers.title: A Multi Center Breast FNAC Whole-Slide Cytology Dataset for AI-Assisted Patch-Wise Classification Using C1 to C5 Reporting Categories
papers.abstract_en: We present a multi center breast fine needle aspiration cytology (FNAC) dataset designed for patch wise classification using C1 to C5 reporting labels. The prospective dataset includes 321 patients and 470 whole-slide images (WSIs) collected from participating tertiary medical centers in India between May 2023 and March 2026. Slides were stained using Papanicolaou (190 WSIs) or MayGrunwald Giemsa (280 WSIs), scanned on a Hamamatsu NanoZoomer S360 at 40X magnification and 0.25 microns per pixel, and stored directly in NDPI format. Across the 470 WSIs, 446 WSIs contain annotated patch regions, yielding 7,398 PNG image patches with expert-verified C1 to C5 labels. The release includes NDPI WSIs, WSI-level GeoJSON annotation files, extracted patch images, deidentified metadata, a data dictionary, a validation summary, a manifest linking WSIs to Zenodo records, and code for dataset inspection and reuse. The complete dataset is approximately 950 GB and is available through Zenodo.
