papers.title: ACPO: Agent-Chained Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative tasks in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) require agents to collectively maximize a shared return. Under the Centralized Training with Decentralized Execution (CTDE) paradigm, policy gradients have remained difficult to compute directly. Prior methods largely follow two approaches: independent factorized updates with centralized critics, which lack general joint-improvement guarantees without value decomposition assumptions, or alternating best-response updates, which can converge to suboptimal Nash Equilibria. In this paper, we show the joint policy gradient admits an exact decentralized decomposition of per-agent terms, each formed from per-agent score functions and decentralized critics. Based on this decomposition, we develop Agent-Chained Policy Optimization (ACPO), where actors are trained independently, with their updates together constituting a single step on the joint policy gradient. Central to this result is a serialized view of the simultaneous joint decision in which agents commit actions one at a time, each conditioning on a belief over preceding actions. The belief acts as the coordination mechanism which ties the independent per-agent updates into a joint gradient step. We evaluate ACPO on Multi-Robot Warehouse, SMACv2, and MA-MuJoCo, where it outperforms strong baselines, with the gap widening as the number of agents grows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ACPO（Agent-Chained Policy Optimization），一种多智能体强化学习算法。通过将联合策略梯度精确分解为每个智能体的项，利用序列化决策和信念协调机制，实现独立智能体更新构成联合梯度步骤。在Multi-Robot Warehouse、SMACv2和MA-MuJoCo基准上，ACPO超越强基线，且优势随智能体数量增加而扩大。
Motivation: 现有MARL方法中，基于集中式评论家的独立更新缺乏联合改进保证，而交替最佳响应更新可能收敛到次优纳什均衡。需要一种既能保持CTDE范式又具有联合梯度保证的方法。
Method: 基于联合策略梯度的精确分解，推导出每个智能体的独立更新项，通过序列化动作提交和信念协调机制，将独立更新组合成联合梯度步骤。
Result: 在Multi-Robot Warehouse、SMACv2和MA-MuJoCo上，ACPO性能优于强基线，且优势随智能体数量增加而扩大。
Conclusion: ACPO提供了一种在CTDE范式下进行联合策略梯度优化的新方法，具有理论保证和实际性能提升。

papers.title: Predictive Objectives Discard Exogenous Control-Relevant Features: A Controlled Mechanistic Study
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive (JEPA-style) objectives learn representations by predicting future latents. In doing so they can discard features that are exogenous (uncontrollable by the agent) yet control-relevant, even when those features are trivially encodable. This occurs because the objective optimizes temporal predictability rather than control-relevance. We isolate this failure mode in a controlled 2x2 experimental design that varies feature controllability and relevance independently, using a predictability knob that decouples a feature's temporal predictability from its control-relevance. Comparing six objectives: reconstruction, JEPA, action-conditioned JEPA, controllability-based JEPA, inverse dynamics under a random policy, and reward-grounded JEPA, we observe that all evaluated reward-free predictive objectives leave the exogenous control-relevant feature near chance accuracy, while a reward-grounded variant retains it selectively. The remedy is label-efficient and robust: as little as 2% of reward-labeled transitions recovers the feature, the effect holds across two environments with different surface forms, and it persists across latent dimensions from 16 to 1024. Comparing the learned latent geometry against bisimulation theory's prediction, the JEPA latent realizes only a small fraction of the class separation a supervised reference attains.
papers.comment: 15 pages 3 tables 5 figures for associated github repo see https://github.com/bushesarebetter/jepa_research_project
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验揭示，联合嵌入预测（JEPA）式目标函数会丢弃外生（agent不可控）但控制相关的特征，即使这些特征易于编码。在2x2实验设计中独立变化特征的可控性和相关性，比较六种目标（重建、JEPA、动作条件JEPA、基于可控性的JEPA、随机策略逆动力学、奖励接地JEPA），发现所有无奖励预测目标均使外生控制相关特征接近随机精度，而奖励接地变体能选择性保留。仅需2%的奖励标注转换即可恢复该特征，效果跨环境和潜在维度。
Motivation: 现有JEPA式目标通过预测未来潜在变量学习表示，可能丢弃对agent控制任务重要的外生特征，而现有研究缺乏对这种失败模式的受控分析。
Method: 采用2x2受控实验设计，独立操纵特征的可控性和控制相关性，并引入‘可预测性旋钮’解耦特征的时间可预测性与控制相关性。比较六种目标函数：重建、JEPA、动作条件JEPA、基于可控性的JEPA、随机策略逆动力学、奖励接地JEPA。
Result: 所有无奖励预测目标均导致外生控制相关特征上的表现接近随机精度，而奖励接地JEPA能选择性保留该特征。仅需2%的奖励标注数据即可恢复特征，此结果在两个不同环境及潜在维度16-1024上均成立。
Conclusion: 摘要强调奖励接地对于保留控制相关外生特征的必要性，并指出JEPA潜在空间仅实现了有监督参考所达到的一小部分类分离。

papers.title: Neural Subspace Reallocation: Continual Learning as Retrieval-Based Subspace Memory Management
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Neural Subspace Reallocation (NSR), which reframes continual learning as memory management over parameter subspaces. Instead of treating Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) modules as disposable per-task adapters, NSR manages them as compressible, retrievable memory units on a frozen backbone through a recurring cycle: (1) compress learned LoRAs via SVD, (2) reserve them in a TaskKnowledgeBank, (3) recall related past LoRAs by embedding similarity to warm-start new or returning tasks, and (4) reallocate the active subspace accordingly, with distillation protecting prior tasks. We prove that in cyclic environments any memoryless allocation policy incurs cumulative regret Omega(T(M-1)Delta_switch) relative to a history-aware policy backed by the Bank (Theorem 1). Empirically, on Split-CIFAR-100 the Bank reduces cyclic recovery time by 10x, exactly as predicted, and on the heterogeneous 5-Datasets benchmark NSR achieves the highest accuracy and the least forgetting, about 9x closer to zero backward transfer than the memoryless heuristics. Crucially, we run a controlled study that isolates which component matters: holding the Bank fixed and varying only the allocation rule, we find that a simple similarity-based retrieval rule matches or beats a learned reinforcement-learning controller (recovering recurring tasks in 0 vs 1.8 steps and reaching equal accuracy). Our central, honest finding is therefore that the memory mechanism -- compression and similarity retrieval -- rather than a learned allocation policy, drives continual-learning performance under fixed capacity. A memory-budget analysis confirms the compressed Bank stays small -- 0.29 MB of parameter memory per task -- so a top-K retention cap bounds the total footprint while preserving fast recovery for retained tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经子空间重分配（NSR），将连续学习重新定义为参数子空间上的内存管理。NSR将低秩适配（LoRA）模块作为可压缩、可检索的记忆单元，通过循环进行SVD压缩、存储到任务知识库、基于嵌入相似性召回以及重新分配子空间，并使用蒸馏保护旧任务。在Split-CIFAR-100上，知识库将循环恢复时间减少10倍；在异构5-Datasets基准上，NSR达到最高准确率和最小遗忘，向后转移接近零。关键发现是压缩和相似性检索的内存机制而非学习型分配策略驱动性能。
Motivation: 现有方法将LoRA模块视为一次性适配器，缺乏有效的记忆管理，导致连续学习中反复遗忘和恢复缓慢。
Method: NSR通过循环操作管理参数子空间：(1)对已学习的LoRA进行SVD压缩；(2)将压缩后的表示存入TaskKnowledgeBank；(3)通过嵌入相似性从银行中召回相关的历史LoRA以热启动新任务或返回任务；(4)重新分配活动子空间，并通过知识蒸馏保护旧任务。
Result: 在Split-CIFAR-100上，知识库使循环恢复时间减少10倍（与理论预测一致）；在5-Datasets基准上，NSR实现最高准确率和最少遗忘，向后转移比无记忆启发式方法接近9倍更接近零。
Conclusion: 性能提升主要来自内存机制（压缩和相似性检索），而非学习型分配策略；压缩后的知识库很小（每任务0.29 MB参数内存），通过top-K保留上限可控制总足迹并保持快速恢复。

papers.title: Data-Driven Energy-Based Learning via Gibbs Measures on Hierarchical Structures
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a data-driven probabilistic framework for learning systems based on Gibbs measures on hierarchical structures. Unlike standard empirical risk minimization, where a dataset is used to identify a single optimal parameter, our approach transforms the empirical loss function into an interaction potential defining an energy-based model. The resulting Gibbs distribution describes a family of equilibrium learning states generated by the data. We formulate the consistency conditions of the associated finite-volume distributions and derive nonlinear integral fixed-point equations whose solutions characterize the admissible learning states. These equations provide a rigorous connection between empirical loss landscapes and probabilistic inference on trees. For translation-invariant solutions, the problem reduces to the analysis of positive compact operators induced by data-dependent kernels, allowing us to establish existence and uniqueness conditions in the one-dimensional setting. Furthermore, we show that hierarchical learning systems may exhibit phase-transition phenomena: for certain empirical kernels on Cayley trees, multiple Gibbs measures emerge beyond a critical inverse temperature, corresponding to distinct equilibrium prediction regimes. Numerical experiments with non-separable kernels illustrate the appearance of multiple solution branches and demonstrate the coexistence of several data-induced learning states. Our results provide a new perspective on energy-based learning, where data do not merely determine an optimal model through minimization but define an entire probabilistic landscape of possible inference states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于层次结构上吉布斯测度的数据驱动概率学习框架。不同于标准经验风险最小化，该方法将经验损失函数转化为相互作用势，定义了一个能量模型。吉布斯分布描述了数据生成的平衡学习状态族。作者推导了非线性积分不动点方程，并证明了一维情况下存在唯一解的条件。在Cayley树上展示了相变现象，多个吉布斯测度出现在临界逆温之上。数值实验展示了多解分支。
Motivation: 标准经验风险最小化只找出单一最优参数，但实际数据可能对应多个合理学习状态；本文旨在通过吉布斯分布描述整个概率景观。
Method: 将经验损失函数作为相互作用势定义能量模型，利用层次结构上的吉布斯测度，推导一致性条件和非线性积分不动点方程；对于平移不变解，通过数据依赖核的正紧算子进行分析。
Result: 在一维情形下建立了存在唯一性条件；在Cayley树上，当逆温超过临界值时出现多个吉布斯测度，表明相变；数值实验验证了多解分支。
Conclusion: 本文为能量学习提供了新视角：数据不仅确定最优模型，还定义了一个概率景观，可能存在多个平衡学习状态。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Little Brains, Big Feats: Exploring Compact Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While large language models have been dominating the research landscape recently, small language models remain highly relevant across various domains; yet, they receive far less attention. In this study, we investigate how smaller language models perform during the generation stage within a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system. To benchmark these models effectively, we utilised both open-source and proprietary datasets covering diverse subject areas and question types. Our findings demonstrate that a RAG system with small language models can be executed directly on-device without requiring any GPU hardware within a reasonable time. The experimental code and links to the supplementary materials can be accessed through the GitHub repository: https://github.com/SibNN/SLM-RAG-EVAL.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECML PKDD 2026, Applied Data Science track. Author preprint; the definitive version will appear in the proceedings of ECML PKDD 2026, Springer LNCS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文探究小型语言模型在检索增强生成（RAG）系统中的生成性能，使用开源和专有数据集进行基准测试。实验表明，搭载小型语言模型的RAG系统可在无GPU的设备上合理时间内运行。
Motivation: 大型语言模型尽管主导研究，但小型语言模型在资源受限场景下仍具实用价值，然而其受关注度较低，尤其在RAG系统中的表现尚待系统评估。
Method: 采用检索增强生成（RAG）框架，集成小型语言模型，并在涵盖多领域与问题类型的开源及专有数据集上评测生成质量。
Result: 小型语言模型在无GPU设备上即可完成RAG推理，时间开销在可接受范围内。
Conclusion: 研究证实小型语言模型在RAG系统中具备可行性，为边缘设备上的语言应用提供了轻量化方案。

papers.title: From Failure Taxonomy to Intervention: A Diagnostic Methodology for Industry-Scale AVLM in Video and Live-Streaming Platform Moderation
papers.abstract_en: Industry-scale video and live-streaming moderation imposes requirements that are difficult to satisfy with generic pretrained public models or external APIs, including adaptation to platform-specific data distributions, policy-specific objectives, and product-level safety constraints. As a result, platforms must undertake internal model development, naturally turning to shared public research for guidance. However, existing multimodal foundation-model studies primarily report architectures, training recipes, data scaling strategies, and benchmark results, but provide less systematic guidance on how failures should be localized and translated into targeted model-development interventions. Interventions are essential because deployment failures are rarely self-explanatory. Similar failures can originate from different causes. Without targeted interventions, improvement reduces to heuristic trial-and-error, where benchmark improvements are weakly attributable, and failures are difficult to trace to their underlying causes. To address this gap, we present a diagnostic methodology for industry-scale Audio-Visual-Language Models AVLM development. The methodology maps model failures into a taxonomy of observable failure signatures and links each class of failure to an intervention space. We instantiate this methodology across the development and alignment lifecycle of an AVLM foundation model for a large-scale video and live-streaming platform. The resulting system supports over 100 regions and is designed for noisy, ambiguous, and highly diverse content drawn from global platform traffic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业级视频和直播平台内容审核中的音频-视觉-语言模型（AVLM）开发，提出了一种诊断方法论，将模型故障分类为可观察的故障特征，并为每类故障链接对应的干预空间。该方法在支持100多个区域的大型平台AVLM基础模型上实例化，处理噪声、模糊及高度多样化的全球流量内容。
Motivation: 现有多模态基础模型研究多关注架构、训练和数据策略，但缺乏系统性的故障定位与干预指导，导致部署中的故障难以追溯原因，改进沦为启发式试错。
Method: 提出一种诊断方法论，将模型故障映射到可观察的故障特征分类体系，并将每类故障与干预空间相关联。
Result: 该诊断方法已在一个大型视频和直播平台AVLM基础模型的全生命周期中实例化，支持超100个区域，能够处理来自全球流量的噪声、模糊及高度多样化的内容。
Conclusion: 该方法填补了从故障分类到针对性干预的指导空白，有助于系统化地提升平台特定多模态模型的开发效率。

papers.title: Emergence of a Shared Canonical Object Frame from In-the-Wild Videos
papers.abstract_en: Comparing object orientations and positions across different instances requires their poses to be expressed in a shared canonical frame. Establishing such frames has traditionally required manual annotation, creating a scaling bottleneck that limits category and instance diversity. We show that a shared canonical frame can instead emerge from self-supervised training on object-centric videos captured in the wild, using only noisy camera poses from Structure-from-Motion. Our key idea is to route all training sequences through a shared geometric bottleneck: a coarse canonical mesh that carries no category-specific detail. By learning dense correspondences from image pixels to this mesh, and estimating per-sequence alignments from noisy SfM geometry, a common canonical frame emerges from multi-view consistency and the semantic priors of the feature extractor, without any canonical pose labels or category conditioning. Trained in a self-supervised manner on 160,000 in-the-wild object videos, our method achieves competitive accuracy on category-level pose estimation benchmarks compared to methods that rely on canonical pose supervision. The code and checkpoint is available on https://github.com/Fischer-Tom/Emergent-Canonical-Frame/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督方法，从野外物体中心视频中学习共享规范物体框架，用于类别级姿态估计。通过将视频帧与一个粗规范网格建立密集对应，并利用来自运动恢复结构(SfM)的噪声相机姿态进行多视图一致性训练，无需任何规范姿态标注或类别先验。在16万野外物体视频上训练后，该方法在类别级姿态估计基准上达到与依赖规范监督的方法相当的精度。
Motivation: 传统建立共享规范框架需要人工标注，限制了类别和实例多样性，成为扩展瓶颈。
Method: 核心思路是让所有训练序列通过一个共享几何瓶颈——一个不携带类别细节的粗规范网格。通过学习图像像素到该网格的密集对应，并从噪声SfM几何估计每序列的对齐，利用多视图一致性和特征提取器的语义先验，自监督地涌现出共享规范框架。
Result: 在16万野外物体视频上自监督训练后，该方法在类别级姿态估计基准上取得了与依赖规范姿态监督的方法相比有竞争力的精度。
Conclusion: 本文表明，仅使用噪声相机姿态，无需规范标注或类别条件，即可从野外视频中自监督地涌现共享规范物体框架，为姿态估计提供了可扩展的解决方案。

papers.title: Illuminating Unified Multimodal Model for Free-form Interleaved Text-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: The advancement of generative AI models capable of producing text and image marks a critical step forward in the realm of multimodal intelligence, particularly for tasks involving the interleaving of both modalities. To advance this intelligence to the next stage, it is crucial for models to autonomously generate free-form interleaved text-image sequences. In this paper, we introduce ILLUME-X, an advanced unified multimodal paradigm that enables high-quality, free-form interleaved text-image generation by improving multimodal data efficiency and stabilizing the multimodal training process. ILLUME-X comprises three key components: (i) an expanded training data pipeline optimized for interleaved text-image generation, (ii) a progressive training strategy with self-adaptive objectives for free-length multimodal token sequences, and (iii) an objective and comprehensive evaluation method ILScore for interleaved text-image sequences. Notably, our ILLUME-X outperforms previous unified models across multiple interleaved text-image generation tasks like style transfer, image decomposition and storytelling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ILLUME-X，一个统一的跨模态模型，能够进行高质量、自由形式的交错文本-图像生成。通过改进多模态数据效率、稳定训练过程以及提出新的评估方法ILScore，ILLUME-X在风格迁移、图像分解和叙事等任务上优于现有统一模型。
Motivation: 现有模型在自主生成自由形式的交错文本-图像序列方面能力不足，缺乏高效的数据利用和稳定的训练方法。
Method: ILLUME-X包含三个关键组件：扩展的训练数据管道优化交错生成、带自适应目标的渐进训练策略处理自由长度多模态token序列，以及针对交错序列的客观全面评估方法ILScore。
Result: ILLUME-X在风格迁移、图像分解和叙事等多个交错文本-图像生成任务上超越之前的统一模型。
Conclusion: ILLUME-X通过数据效率改进和稳定训练，实现了高质量的自由形式交错文本-图像生成，为多模态生成提供了有效范式。

summary_sections.result: ILLUME-X在风格迁移、图像分解和叙事等多个交错文本-图像生成任务上超越之前的统一模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: ILLUME-X通过数据效率改进和稳定训练，实现了高质量的自由形式交错文本-图像生成，为多模态生成提供了有效范式。

papers.title: Notes on generative modeling: flow matching, diffusion, optimal transport and Schr{ö}dinger bridge
papers.abstract_en: These notes recapitulate the high level mathematical principles behind different techniques for generative modeling. I show the connections between optimal transport and standard techniques such as Schr{ö}dinger bridge and flow matching.

papers.title: Bridging the Gap Between Image Restoration and Navigational Safety in Hazy Conditions: A New Visibility Estimation Metric for Maritime Surveillance
papers.abstract_en: Visibility distance is critical to maritime navigational safety because it determines the effective observation range of shipborne and shore-based monitoring systems. Under hazy conditions, degraded visual information shortens observable distance and increases navigational risks and economic losses. Although numerous image dehazing methods have been developed, conventional image quality assessment metrics, such as PSNR, SSIM, FSIM, FADE, and NIQE, cannot establish a physically interpretable relationship between restoration quality and practical visibility thresholds. To address this limitation, this work proposes a visibility-oriented evaluation framework that links dehazing performance with visible-distance estimation. First, a Maritime Simulated Visibility Dataset (MSVD) is constructed using Unity3D to simulate maritime traffic scenes under graded visibility conditions. The dataset provides paired hazy and clear images with precise visibility annotations, enabling quantitative analysis of visibility restoration. Second, a dehazing visibility evaluation metric is developed by using object detection accuracy as an intermediate indicator. By establishing a mapping between visibility distance and detection performance, the proposed metric converts image restoration improvements into measurable visibility gains. Six representative dehazing methods are evaluated using both conventional image quality metrics and the proposed visibility metric. Experimental results under different imaging conditions demonstrate that MSVD provides a reliable benchmark for evaluating dehazing performance across graded visibility levels, while the proposed metric enables interpretable and reliable visible-distance estimation, thereby supporting the assessment of navigational safety and operational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对雾天条件下图像恢复与航海安全的脱节问题，提出一种基于可见距离评估的新指标。通过构建海事模拟可见度数据集（MSVD）和基于目标检测精度的可见度映射，将去雾效果转化为可测量的可见距离增益，从而为航海安全提供可解释的评估。
Motivation: 现有图像质量评估指标（如PSNR、SSIM）无法建立恢复质量与实际可见距离之间的物理可解释关系，限制了去雾方法在航海安全中的应用。
Method: 构建海事模拟可见度数据集（MSVD），利用Unity3D模拟不同能见度下的海事场景，提供精确的可见度标注；提出一种基于目标检测精度的去雾可见度评估指标，建立可见距离与检测性能的映射。
Result: 在模拟和真实条件下，对六种代表性去雾方法的评估表明，MSVD提供了不同能见度级别的可靠基准，所提指标能实现可解释且可靠的可见距离估计。
Conclusion: 该框架桥接了图像恢复与航海安全之间的差距，为评估雾天条件下的导航安全性和操作效率提供了新工具。

papers.title: Argus: Metric Panoramic 3D Reconstruction for Indoor Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Metric feed-forward 3D reconstruction for panoramic data remains under-explored due to the lack of large-scale panoramic RGB-D training data. We present Realsee3D, a hybrid dataset of 10K indoor scenes (1K real, 9K synthetic) with 299K panoramic viewpoints and precise metric annotations, and Argus, a feed-forward network trained on it for metric panoramic 3D reconstruction. In the sparse unordered capture setting of Realsee3D, a poorly chosen coordinate anchor can cause global pose drift. Argus addresses this with a learned covisibility module that selects the geometrically optimal reference view to anchor the metric world frame. To further improve multi-task learning, we decompose the bidirectional pixel-to-world mapping into interpretable sub-steps with per-step supervision and cross-coordinate joint constraints, reinforcing geometric consistency across prediction branches. On the Realsee3D benchmark, Argus achieves state-of-the-art metric performance in camera pose estimation, depth estimation, and point cloud reconstruction. Project page: https://argus-paper.realsee.ai.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Realsee3D混合数据集（10K室内场景，含299K全景视点）以及Argus前馈网络，用于公制全景3D重建。Argus通过可学习的共视模块选择最优锚定视图，并将双向像素-世界映射分解为可解释子步骤，从而提升多任务学习中的几何一致性。在Realsee3D基准上，在相机姿态估计、深度估计和点云重建方面取得SOTA。
Motivation: 全景数据的公制前馈3D重建因缺乏大规模全景RGB-D训练数据而研究不足。
Method: 提出Realsee3D数据集和Argus网络。Argus包括一个可学习的共视模块用于选择最优参考视图，并将双向像素-世界映射分解为可解释子步骤，每个子步骤有监督和跨坐标联合约束。
Result: 在Realsee3D基准上，Argus在相机姿态估计、深度估计和点云重建方面取得SOTA公制性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法通过分解映射和共视模块有效提高了室内全景场景的3D重建精度。

papers.title: Walking in the Implicit: Interactive World Exploration via Neural Scene Representation
papers.abstract_en: Interactive video generation systems for camera-controlled world exploration roll out growing sequences of latent video frames, entangling state transition with high-frequency observation synthesis. We propose Walking in the Implicit, a scene-centric paradigm that changes the rollout variable from frame latents to a fixed-length, renderable implicit state, termed Neural Implicit Scene (NIS). This factorizes interactive generation into stochastic transition of a compact scene state and deterministic pose-conditioned rendering given the sampled state. We instantiate this paradigm as NeuWorld: a transformer VAE learns locally anchored NIS from sparse posed frames, and a diffusion transformer evolves NIS conditioned on future camera trajectories and geometry-aware retrieved history. By reusing the VAE encoder as a unified conditioner, NeuWorld maps camera, reference-image, and history cues into the same NIS modality, avoiding external heterogeneous encoders. Trained from scratch on public posed-view data without pretrained video backbones or auxiliary 3D reconstructors, NeuWorld achieves strong long-horizon consistency with favorable inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Walking in the Implicit 场景中心范式，将交互式视频生成从帧隐变量滚动转为固定长度的可渲染隐式状态 (Neural Implicit Scene, NIS)。实例化 NeuWorld 模型：Transformer VAE 从稀疏有姿态帧学习局部锚定 NIS，扩散 Transformer 根据未来相机轨迹和几何感知检索历史演进化 NIS。重用 VAE 编码器作为统一条件器，避免外部异构编码器。在公开姿态视图数据上从头训练，无需预训练视频骨干或 3D 重建器，实现长程一致性并提升推理效率。
Motivation: 现有交互式视频生成系统将状态转移与高频观测合成纠缠，导致长程一致性和效率瓶颈。
Method: 提出 NIS 因子化：随机转移紧凑场景状态，然后根据采样状态执行确定性位姿条件渲染。NeuWorld 使用 Transformer VAE 学习 NIS，扩散 Transformer 演进化 NIS，并通过共享编码器统一多模态条件。
Result: 摘要报告 NeuWorld 在长程一致性和推理效率上优于先前方法，且无需预训练视频骨干或辅助 3D 重建器。
Conclusion: 本文展示了将隐式场景表示作为交互式生成中间状态的可行性，为世界探索提供更高效、一致的新范式。

papers.title: Building Multi-Task Agentic LLMs via Two-Phase Distillation
papers.abstract_en: A key step toward artificial general intelligence is to train models that can perform multiple tasks. In this paper, we study how to build such models by first training separate RL experts for individual tasks and then consolidating them via distillation, as an alternative to directly training a single model on mixed tasks. We show that off-policy distillation degrades in multi-task settings due to the mode-covering nature of forward KL: aggregating data from multiple tasks introduces a large number of behavioral modes that can exceed the student's capacity, forcing it to average across behaviors and leading to degraded performance. In contrast, on-policy distillation is mode-seeking but requires strong initialization. Inspired by these observations, we propose a two-phase approach: off-policy distillation followed by on-policy refinement. Evaluation across conversational agents and text-based games confirms that this two-phase approach matches single-task RL expert performance for each individual task, whereas off-policy or on-policy distillation alone fails to match this performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何通过两阶段蒸馏（先离线策略蒸馏，再在线策略精炼）构建多任务智能体LLM，并验证该方法在对话代理和基于文本的游戏任务上能达到单任务RL专家性能。
Motivation: 直接在多任务混合数据上训练单一模型性能下降，而离线策略蒸馏因前向KL的mode-covering特性导致学生容量过载，在线策略蒸馏虽mode-seeking但依赖强初始化。
Method: 提出两阶段蒸馏方法：先进行离线策略蒸馏，再进行在线策略精炼。
Result: 在对话代理和基于文本的游戏任务上，两阶段蒸馏匹配了各单任务RL专家的性能，而单独使用离线或在线蒸馏均无法达到。
Conclusion: 两阶段蒸馏是多任务智能体LLM构建的有效策略，克服了单一蒸馏方法的缺陷。

papers.title: Heads, Not Backbones: Output Heads Dominate Architectures on Fat-Tailed Returns
papers.abstract_en: In a deep forecasting pipeline for fat-tailed financial returns at short horizons, which matters more - the backbone architecture or the output head? We compare four modern backbones (TimesNet, DLinear, N-BEATS, iTransformer) under three output heads: a point head, a single-Gaussian density head, and a Gaussian mixture density head with K=4 components. On S and P 500 monthly log-returns (1871-2023) under anchored walk-forward validation, the three heads form a strict gradient: switching from point to Gaussian improves CRPS by about 1.3 percent; switching from Gaussian to mixture adds a further about 2.4 percent. Switching between backbones, in contrast, changes CRPS by less than 1.5 percent on the point-head row and on the backbone-mean axis; density-head backbone spread is larger (up to 5.1 percent on the h=1 Gaussian row, driven by N-BEATS) but the head gradient (3.7 percentage points) still dominates. The Model Confidence Set on squared errors does not exclude any of the 12 variants at the 5 percent level: the head separates them only on distributional metrics (CRPS, pinball, coverage), not on squared error. The mixture head incremental value over a single Gaussian is largest in the highest-volatility regimes (13.9 percent in 1970s stagflation at h=12), confirming the mixture captures tail risk beyond what a unimodal Gaussian can express. The picture is horizon-dependent: the head dominates at short horizons, but at long horizons (h >= 6) the backbone re-takes the lead - an h-split we document against classical baselines (section 5.1). We conclude that on fat-tailed returns at short horizons, the head dominates the backbone, and the mixture distribution adds genuine value over a single Gaussian during crisis periods when risk-management decisions actually matter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在短周期肥尾金融收益预测中，骨干网络架构与输出头（点预测、单高斯密度、混合高斯密度）哪个更重要。在标普500月度对数收益（1871-2023）上的实验表明，输出头的影响显著大于骨干网络：从点预测切换到高斯分布CRPS提升约1.3%，再切换到混合高斯额外提升约2.4%；而骨干网络带来的变化通常不超过1.5%。混合高斯在高波动时期（如1970年代滞胀）价值最大。但该优势仅存在于短预测周期，长周期（h≥6）时骨干网络重新占主导。
Motivation: 现有金融预测文献多关注骨干网络架构创新，但输出头（概率密度估计）对肥尾分布预测性能的影响尚未被系统量化。本文旨在探讨在短周期肥尾收益预测中，输出头与骨干架构哪个更关键。
Method: 在四种现代骨干网络（TimesNet, DLinear, N-BEATS, iTransformer）上搭配三种输出头（点预测、单高斯密度、混合高斯密度K=4），在标普500月度对数收益上采用锚定滚动验证（anchored walk-forward validation）进行实验。使用CRPS、分位数损失、覆盖率等分布指标以及均方误差评估。
Result: 输出头形成严格梯度：点→高斯提升CRPS约1.3%，高斯→混合提升约2.4%；骨干网络在点预测行及平均值轴上变化小于1.5%。密度头下骨干网络差异较大（最多5.1%），但头梯度（3.7个百分点）仍占主导。模型置信集在均方误差上无法区分任何变体，但分布指标可区分。混合高斯在高波动时期（如1970年代滞胀h=12时提升13.9%）优势最大。短周期头占主导，长周期（h≥6）骨干网络占主导。
Conclusion: 在短周期肥尾收益预测中，输出头比骨干网络更重要，混合高斯分布在危机时期能捕捉尾部风险。但结论依赖于预测周期长短：短周期头主导，长周期骨干主导。

summary_sections.result: 输出头形成严格梯度：点→高斯提升CRPS约1.3%，高斯→混合提升约2.4%；骨干网络在点预测行及平均值轴上变化小于1.5%。密度头下骨干网络差异较大（最多5.1%），但头梯度（3.7个百分点）仍占主导。模型置信集在均方误差上无法区分任何变体，但分布指标可区分。混合高斯在高波动时期（如1970年代滞胀h=12时提升13.9%）优势最大。短周期头占主导，长周期（h≥6）骨干网络占主导。
summary_sections.conclusion: 在短周期肥尾收益预测中，输出头比骨干网络更重要，混合高斯分布在危机时期能捕捉尾部风险。但结论依赖于预测周期长短：短周期头主导，长周期骨干主导。

papers.title: Consensus Clustering of Free-Viewing Gaze Data: New Insights into Human-Information Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Free-viewing gaze data provides a rich, task-free window into human visual attention. Conventional exploratory data analysis of the data provides user attention patterns through fixations and areas of interest. However, despite the richness of this gaze data, its human-information interaction (HII) patterns are understudied. We address this gap using consensus clustering of gaze data with respect to users and stimulus characteristics. We present a novel end-to-end unsupervised ensemble learning system for consensus clustering of free-viewing gaze datasets, EnsembleGaze. With a goal of characterizing the user behavior and stimulus type, we propose a feature engineering step based on statistical descriptors of fixation-based distributions. EnsembleGaze involves consensus voting of selected clustering methods implemented on the feature vector to compute the co-association matrix. Using the separate consensus clustering of users and stimuli as a baseline, we further propose two high-dimensional clustering strategies for determining gaze clusters based on joint user and image characterization. They are consensus subspace clustering and spectral biclustering. Clustering performance is evaluated using selected standard metrics and is further interpreted through image-level properties. Our system provides a replicable method for the unsupervised analysis of fixation behavior in scene perception research. Our results show that image stimuli groupings are highly consistent across methods, reflecting a robust ambient-versus-focal viewing mode distinction, whereas user groupings are image-context-dependent, a structure that only biclustering and the two-step conditional approaches are architecturally capable of recovering. Testing on the publicly available datasets revealed dataset-specific patterns, with each offering complementary insights through distinct clustering strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为 EnsembleGaze 的无监督集成学习系统，用于自由观看眼动数据的共识聚类。通过基于注视分布的统计描述符进行特征工程，并采用共识投票、共识子空间聚类和谱双聚类等策略，对用户和刺激进行分类。结果表明，图像刺激分组在不同方法间高度一致，反映了环境与焦点观看模式的稳健区分，而用户分组则依赖于图像上下文，只有双聚类和两步条件方法能够恢复这种结构。
Motivation: 自由观看眼动数据虽丰富，但其人机交互模式研究不足。现有探索性数据分析主要关注注视点和兴趣区，缺乏对用户行为和刺激类型的高层次聚类分析。
Method: 提出 EnsembleGaze 系统，包括基于注视分布统计描述符的特征工程、多种聚类方法的共识投票生成共关联矩阵，以及两种高维聚类策略：共识子空间聚类和谱双聚类。
Result: 在公开数据集上，图像刺激分组高度一致，区分环境与焦点观看模式；用户分组因图像上下文而异，仅双聚类和两步条件方法能有效恢复。不同数据集呈现特定模式。
Conclusion: 该系统为场景感知研究中注视行为的无监督分析提供了可复制的方法，揭示了用户聚类的图像依赖性。

papers.title: CogSENet: Blind Image Deblurring with Blur-Conditioned Semantic Routing and Explicit Frequency Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Blind image deblurring demands the recovery of high-fidelity details and coherent structures from complex, unknown degradations. Current blind image deblurring methods struggle with real-world, spatially varying degradations, and lack the semantic awareness necessary to reliably differentiate valid textures from artifacts. To bridge this gap, we propose CogSENet, a dynamic, semantic-aligned reconstruction framework inspired by the eagle's visual system. By mimicking the eagle's active saccadic scanning, we devise a Semantic-Driven State Space Module (SDSSM) with semantic-aware token regrouping via differentiable routing, enabling prompt-conditioned long-range dependency modeling. To ensure physically interpretable recovery of textures and structures, a BiFreqFusionBlock (BFFB) mirrors functional differentiation of the eagle's retina by decomposing features into high and low frequencies using wavelet transforms. Finally, we estimate a continuous Blur Field (CBF) from blur image and fuse it with CLIP semantic priors to modulate the deepest latent features, emulating focal adaptation and enabling adaptive restoration under spatially non-uniform blur. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CogSENetoutperforms state-of-the-art deblurring methods in both visual quality and structural fidelity with fewer parameters, while also performing favorably on dehazing, deraining, and denoising tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CogSENet，一种受鹰视觉启发的盲图像去模糊网络。核心设计包括语义驱动的状态空间模块（SDSSM）通过可微路由实现语义感知的token重分组，以及双频融合块（BFFB）利用小波变换显式融合高低频特征。此外，网络估计连续模糊场（CBF）并结合CLIP语义先验调制深层特征，以应对空间非均匀模糊。实验表明，CogSENet在多个去模糊基准上以更少参数取得领先的视觉质量和结构保真度，并在去雾、去雨、去噪任务上表现良好。
Motivation: 现有盲去模糊方法难以处理真实世界中空间变化的退化，缺乏语义感知能力以区分有效纹理和伪影。
Method: 模仿鹰视觉系统，提出SDSSM进行语义感知的token重分组（可微路由）以实现长程依赖建模；BFFB通过小波变换分解特征为高低频进行显式融合；估计连续模糊场（CBF）并与CLIP语义先验结合，动态调制深层特征。
Result: 在多个去模糊基准上，CogSENet在视觉质量和结构保真度上超越现有方法，且参数更少；同时在去雾、去雨、去噪任务上表现良好。
Conclusion: CogSENet通过语义对齐和频率融合实现了高效的盲去模糊，并展示了跨任务泛化能力。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Iteration Distillation for Robust IHD Screening: The IDNet Framework and A New Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Color Fundus Photography (CFP) offers a low-cost and non-invasive route for ischemic heart disease (IHD) screening, but current studies are limited by scarce public benchmarks and ineffective fusion of retinal images with sparse clinical variables. We propose IDNet, a multimodal framework with a Cross-Modal Distillation Aggregator (CDA) that uses learnable queries to sequentially integrate left-eye, right-eye, and clinical features, mitigating the imbalance between high-dimensional visual features and low-dimensional tabular inputs. We also construct a reproducible UK Biobank benchmark with open-source curation and quality-control pipelines, yielding 50,410 images from 25,205 subjects. On this benchmark, IDNet outperforms image-only, clinical-only, and several multimodal baselines, and CDA consistently improves multiple visual encoders as a plug-in fusion module.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IDNet框架，用于缺血性心脏病（IHD）筛查，通过跨模态蒸馏聚合器（CDA）融合左右眼视网膜图像与临床变量。同时构建了基于UK Biobank的可复现基准（50,410张图像，25,205名受试者），实验表明IDNet优于单模态及多模态基线，CDA作为即插即用模块能提升多种视觉编码器。
Motivation: 现有IHD筛查研究缺乏公开基准且难以有效融合视网膜图像与稀疏临床变量，导致模态间不平衡。
Method: 提出IDNet框架，包含跨模态蒸馏聚合器（CDA），使用可学习查询顺序整合左眼、右眼和临床特征，缓解高维视觉与低维表格特征的不平衡。
Result: 在UK Biobank基准上，IDNet超过纯图像、纯临床及多种多模态基线，CDA作为即插即用融合模块一致提升多种视觉编码器性能。
Conclusion: 本文强调了可复现基准构建和跨模态融合在基于眼底图像的IHD筛查中的重要性，CDA模块具有通用性。

papers.title: MuseBench: Benchmarking Intent-Level Audiovisual Arts Understanding in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Audiovisual arts encompass diverse creative disciplines, including cinema, visual arts, stage performance, and game design, where artistic meaning arises from deliberate combinations of visual, auditory, and narrative elements (e.g., fear amplified through claustrophobic framing, or grief conveyed through silence and lingering close-ups). True artistic understanding extends beyond recognizing what is depicted to reasoning about why it is expressed through particular creative choices. Despite the strong progress of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), this critical aspect of artistic understanding remains underexplored, as existing benchmarks largely measure perceptual recognition while overlooking reasoning about creative intent. To address this gap, we introduce Musebench, a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate MLLMs on nuanced artistic understanding. It comprises 4,016 questions spanning cinematic arts, static visual arts, stage performing arts, and game arts, distilled from over 10K candidate video essays that pair professional commentary with visual demonstration. To capture the open-ended nature of artistic analysis at scale, the benchmark combines single-select and variable-option multi-select questions. All questions are generated and refined through a four-phase iterative pipeline combining shortcut filtering, adversarial distractors, and expert validation. Comprehensive zero-shot evaluation of 28 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals that even the best-performing model achieves only 48.29% accuracy, substantially below human expert performance of 87.18%, exposing a significant gap in current models' creative domain expertise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MuseBench是一个用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）对视听艺术意图理解能力的综合基准，包含4,016个问题，涵盖电影、静态视觉艺术、舞台表演和游戏艺术。通过28个SOTA MLLM的零样本评估，最佳模型准确率仅48.29%，远低于人类专家的87.18%，揭示了当前模型在创意领域专业知识上的显著差距。
Motivation: 现有MLLM基准主要测量感知识别能力，缺乏对创造性意图（即为什么通过特定艺术手法表达）的推理评估，这一关键方面尚未被充分探索。
Method: 从超过10K候选视频论文中筛选出4,016个问题，结合单选和多选题，通过四阶段迭代流水线（包括快捷过滤、对抗性干扰项和专家验证）生成和优化。
Result: 28个SOTA MLLM在零样本设置下评估，最佳模型准确率48.29%，人类专家准确率87.18%，差距明显。
Conclusion: 摘要强调当前MLLM在创意领域理解上存在显著不足，MuseBench为评估和提升这一能力提供了基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IBRSteG: Learning a Generalizable Steganography Framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in deep learning have notably improved steganographic message hiding. However, designing a generalizable steganographic approach for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) that can embed meaningful 3D scene content remains challenging. In this paper, we propose IBRSteG, a generalizable framework for 3DGS steganography that enables undetectable concealment of secret scenes within a steganographic scene. Unlike existing approaches whose parameter generation is rigidly coupled with the specific scene, we formulate 3D steganography as a feed-forward 3D Gaussian embedding process that generalizes across different 3DGS scenes. To realize this, we introduce GAS (Gaussian Attributes Steganographer), a network that learns a scene-independent embedding function by injecting the attributes of secret 3D Gaussian points into a cover scene, thereby directly reconstructing the steganographic scenes without per-scene finetuning or optimization. By transforming 3D Gaussian into these structured attributes, these attributes are compatible with 2D learning paradigms and benefit from their structured nature, thereby enhancing generalization to unseen 3DGS scenes. Extensive experiments on established datasets demonstrate that IBRSteG can effectively conceal different scenes with high visual quality, and achieves superior capacity and security. Code is available at https://github.com/LingXiang2023/IBRSteG.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IBRSteG，一种面向3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的可泛化隐写框架，能够在隐写场景中隐蔽地嵌入秘密场景。通过引入高斯属性隐写器（GAS），学习场景无关的嵌入函数，无需逐场景微调即可直接重建隐写场景。实验表明该方法在视觉质量、容量和安全性方面表现优越。
Motivation: 现有3DGS隐写方法参数生成与特定场景紧密耦合，缺乏泛化能力，难以在不同场景间迁移。
Method: 将3D隐写形式化为前馈式3D高斯嵌入过程，设计GAS网络对秘密3D高斯点属性进行注入，使嵌入函数与场景无关，并利用2D学习范式的结构化特性增强泛化性。
Result: 在标准数据集上，IBRSteG能有效隐藏不同场景，达到高视觉质量，并在容量和安全性上取得更优性能。
Conclusion: IBRSteG实现了无需逐场景优化的3DGS隐写泛化框架。

papers.title: Uncertainty Estimation in Pathology Foundation Models via Deep Mutual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) offer generalizable representations for whole-slide image (WSI) analysis, yet their clinical adoption remains limited. Specifically, their predictions lack reliable confidence estimates, and no single PFM is universally best across tasks, which severely undermines trust in medical settings. To overcome this, we propose $\mathtt{DICE}$, a plug-and-play framework that ensembles $K$ frozen PFMs and models their disagreement as a proxy for uncertainty estimation. To ensure this proxy yields meaningful estimates, we align the ensemble members via deep mutual learning, and theoretically show that this objective upper-bounds the model uncertainty. Additionally, we demonstrate that the ensemble's consensus localizes abnormalities at the patch level without any explicit supervision. We evaluate $\mathtt{DICE}$ on three challenging WSI benchmarks. Notably, our framework provides reliable uncertainty estimates that accurately flag failure-prone cases under in- and out-of-distribution settings, while matching or outperforming SOTA baselines in classification, calibration, and localization. Overall, $\mathtt{DICE}$ takes a crucial step toward translating PFMs into uncertainty-aware decision-support systems.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: OmniDance: Multimodal Driven Dance Video Generation with Large-scale Internet Data
papers.abstract_en: Music-driven dance video generation aims to synthesize expressive human motion that is temporally aligned with music while maintaining high visual fidelity. Despite recent progress, existing methods still face two key limitations: the lack of large-scale, high-quality dance video datasets, and the absence of principled frameworks for integrating music as a complementary conditioning signal into Video Generation Foundation Models. To address these limitations, we introduce CIPE-Dance, a large-scale Internet-sourced dance video dataset with choreography-informed text annotations, constructed via a progressive expert pipeline. To the best of our knowledge, CIPE-Dance is the largest dataset for dance video generation to date, comprising 300k high-quality clips over 400 hours and covering diverse dancers, environments, and dance genres. We further propose OmniDance, a framework-level recipe for integrating music into a TI2V foundation model without sacrificing its original controllability or visual fidelity. Motivated by the complementary roles of text as low-frequency semantics and music as high-frequency temporal dynamics, OmniDance co-designs a depth-aware specialization architecture, an anchored easy-to-hard curriculum learning strategy, and a modality-specialized time-dependent CFG strategy, enabling unified TI2V, MI2V, and MTI2V generation. Extensive experiments on CIPE-Dance demonstrate that OmniDance achieves state-of-the-art performance across all three tasks and exhibits robust multimodal integration capability. Project is available at https://github.com/AMAP-ML/OmniDance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出大规模互联网采集的舞蹈视频数据集 CIPE-Dance（含 30 万片段、超 400 小时），并在此基础上提出 OmniDance 框架，将音乐作为互补条件信号集成到文本到视频生成基础模型中。OmniDance 通过深度感知专业化架构、锚定易到难课程学习和模态特定的时间依赖 CFG 策略，实现了文本驱动、音乐驱动及文本-音乐联合驱动的舞蹈视频生成，在各项任务上达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有音乐驱动舞蹈视频生成方法受限于两个关键瓶颈：缺乏大规模高质量舞蹈视频数据集，以及缺乏将音乐作为条件信号无缝融入视频生成基础模型的原则性框架。
Method: 构建 CIPE-Dance 数据集，通过渐进式专家流水线生成编舞注释文本；提出 OmniDance 框架，包含深度感知专业化架构、锚定易到难课程学习策略和模态特定时间依赖 CFG 策略，在不牺牲原有可控性和视觉保真度的前提下实现多模态驱动。
Result: 在 CIPE-Dance 数据集上的实验表明，OmniDance 在文本到视频、音乐到视频以及文本-音乐到视频三个任务上均达到最先进性能，展现出鲁棒的多模态集成能力。
Conclusion: 论文强调了大规模数据集和原则性框架对于音乐驱动舞蹈视频生成的重要性，OmniDance 为多模态融合提供了有效思路。

papers.title: Monte Carlo Energy Aggregation for Mobile 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting have demonstrated unprecedented success in novel view synthesis. However, the substantial inference and storage overhead driven by high-order Spherical Harmonics (SH) are primary bottlenecks for mobile platforms. In this paper, we present Flux-GS, a real-time Gaussian Splatting method designed to achieve high-fidelity rendering with significantly reduced overhead for resource-constrained mobile platforms. We first propose a Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator, sampling third-order radiance residuals and aggregating specular energy into a compact latent space. In this way, our method effectively preserves visually salient lighting features in lower-order bands without expensive distillation or pre-training. To mitigate the high-frequency details lost during compression, we introduce an Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement module. This module predicts Gaussian-aware offsets based on intrinsic Gaussian attributes, which enhance the first-order SH representation prior to inference, without extra inference costs. Furthermore, the original single-view gradient-based densification is prone to producing excessive Gaussians and overfitting to a certain view. We address these limitations by proposing a Multi-view Alpha-based Densification and Pruning strategy. By leveraging multi-view guidance, we ensure multi-view structure consistency and the precise removal of redundant primitives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Flux-GS achieves substantial parameter reduction while maintaining competitive visual quality, offering a robust and scalable solution for real-time mobile rendering. Code: \textcolor{magenta}{\href{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/flux-gs-project/}{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/flux-gs-project/}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flux-GS，一种面向移动平台的实时 3D 高斯泼溅方法。通过蒙特卡洛镜面能量聚合器（Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator）将高阶球谐函数压缩至低阶潜在空间，并利用属性条件的 SH 增强模块恢复高频细节。还提出多视角 Alpha 密度修剪策略，减少冗余高斯体。在多个基准上实现参数大幅减少，同时保持竞争性视觉质量。
Motivation: 现有 3D 高斯泼溅方法因高阶球谐函数导致的高推理和存储开销，成为移动平台的主要瓶颈。
Method: 提出蒙特卡洛镜面能量聚合器，采样三阶辐射残差并将镜面能量聚合到紧凑潜在空间；引入属性条件 SH 增强模块，根据高斯内在属性预测偏移以增强一阶 SH 表示；提出多视角 Alpha 密度修剪策略，确保多视角一致性并移除冗余基元。
Result: 实验表明，Flux-GS 在显著减少参数量的同时保持竞争性视觉质量，适用于实时移动端渲染。
Conclusion: Flux-GS 为资源受限的移动平台提供了一种鲁棒且可扩展的实时渲染解决方案。

papers.title: Shell-Supervised Gaussian Splatting for Urban Real-to-Sim Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Real-to-sim reconstruction for embodied AI requires geometry that is useful for collision reasoning, navigation, and agent-environment interaction, not only photorealistic novel-view synthesis. However, close-range urban facades are difficult for video-to-3D reconstruction: glass, reflections, repeated windows, and weak texture can produce visually plausible renderings with unstable surface geometry. We introduce shell-supervised Gaussian Splatting, a reconstruction-stage framework that uses an external facade structural shell as lightweight geometric supervision for video-driven Gaussian reconstruction. The method aligns an exterior shell to the video reconstruction frame, renders per-view depth, camera-space normal, and valid-mask maps, and applies these cues through mask-gated losses during Gaussian optimization. This design preserves RGB-driven appearance while regularizing only visible shell-supported facade regions. Experiments on anonymized close-range urban facade scenes show improved facade orientation and visible-surface point-cloud consistency over photo-only, monocular-cue, and surface-oriented Gaussian baselines, while maintaining comparable held-out rendering quality.
papers.comment: 10 pages main paper, 2 pages supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 shell-supervised Gaussian Splatting，一种利用外部立面结构壳作为轻量几何监督的框架，用于视频驱动的城市立面近距离重建。该方法通过将外部壳对齐到视频重建帧，渲染每视角深度、相机空间法线和有效掩膜图，并在高斯优化过程中通过掩膜门控损失进行正则化。实验表明，与仅使用RGB、单目线索和面向表面的高斯基线相比，该方法改善了立面朝向和可见表面点云一致性，同时保持相当的保留视图渲染质量。
Motivation: 面向具身AI的真实到仿真重建不仅需要逼真的新视角合成，还需要对碰撞推理、导航和智能体-环境交互有用的几何结构。然而，城市近距离立面包含玻璃、反射、重复窗户和弱纹理，导致视频到3D重建可能产生视觉上合理但表面几何不稳定的渲染结果。
Method: 提出 shell-supervised Gaussian Splatting，使用外部立面结构壳作为轻量几何监督。方法包括：将外部壳对齐到视频重建帧，渲染每视角深度、相机空间法线和有效掩膜图，然后通过掩膜门控损失在高斯优化过程中正则化仅受壳支持的可见立面区域，同时保留RGB驱动的外观。
Result: 在匿名化的近距离城市立面场景上，该方法在立面朝向和可见表面点云一致性上优于仅使用照片、单目线索和面向表面的高斯基线，同时保持相当的保留视图渲染质量。
Conclusion: 该设计通过仅正则化壳支持的可见区域，在保持RGB外观的同时改善了立面几何精度。

papers.title: SkelEM: Training-Signal Decoupling of Skeleton and Diffusion for Self-supervised Axial Super-Resolution in Volume Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Volume microscopy, including electron and light microscopy, suffers from severe anisotropic resolution due to physical axial sectioning. Existing self-supervised axial super-resolution (ASR) methods face a trilemma bounded by overly smoothed regression textures, structural hallucinations of pure diffusion models, and prohibitive inference latency. In this paper, we propose Skeleton-refinE Microscopy (SkelEM), a self-supervised framework that decouples ASR at the training-signal level: a frozen topological network and a diffusion refiner are optimized by disjoint objectives, separating low-frequency topology formulation from high-frequency detail enhancement. Building on this deterministic skeleton, we exploit a unified cycle-consistent mechanism on input sparse slices to simultaneously extract a real-domain residual prior and bidirectionally align the diffusion refiner, washing away cross-plane artifacts without synthetic bias. By truncating the reverse diffusion process with this physical prior, SkelEM achieves high-fidelity detail restoration in merely $\le 5$ steps. To rigorously assess cross-instrument generalization, we further introduce BRAVE-ASR, a new benchmark of co-aligned anisotropic and isotropic volumes acquired on a Plasma-FIB instrument. Across public benchmarks, SkelEM achieves the most favorable balance across the fidelity-perception trade-off among self-supervised methods, with state-of-the-art downstream membrane segmentation performance and robust zero-shot generalization across distinct modalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SkelEM，一种自监督框架，用于体积显微镜中的轴向超分辨率（ASR），通过将拓扑网络和扩散精炼器的训练信号解耦，分别处理低频拓扑和高频细节。利用统一循环一致机制从输入稀疏切片中提取真实域残差先验，并双向对齐扩散精炼器，消除交叉平面伪影。仅需≤5步扩散即可实现高保真细节恢复。在公开基准上，SkelEM在自监督方法中实现了保真度-感知权衡的最佳平衡，并取得下游膜分割的最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有自监督轴向超分辨率方法面临三难困境：回归纹理过于平滑、纯扩散模型的结构幻觉、以及推理延迟过高。需要一种能同时解决保真度和效率的方法。
Method: 提出SkelEM，训练信号解耦：冻结的拓扑网络和扩散精炼器分别优化，分离低频拓扑形成与高频细节增强。利用循环一致机制从稀疏切片中提取真实域残差先验，并双向对齐扩散精炼器。通过物理先验截断反向扩散过程，仅需≤5步。
Result: 在公开基准上，SkelEM在自监督方法中实现了保真度-感知权衡的最佳平衡，取得下游膜分割的SOTA性能，并在不同模态间具有鲁棒的零样本泛化能力。同时引入BRAVE-ASR基准用于跨仪器评估。
Conclusion: SkelEM通过训练信号解耦和循环一致先验，有效解决了自监督轴向超分辨率的三难困境，实现了高效高保真的细节恢复。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: T3R: Deeper Test-Time Adaptation for Graph Neural Networks via Gradient Rotation
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) deployed in real-world systems typically have fixed weights, often leading to degraded performance under distribution shifts. This issue can be mitigated by conventional fine-tuning, but in many real-world cases, collecting labeled data is expensive or infeasible. A potential approach is Test-Time Training (TTT), which adapts models' weights using unlabeled test data, yet it is typically limited to shallow updates that affect only a subset of model parameters. We propose T3R, leveraging multiple Rotograd matrices to improve task affinity between the target and auxiliary tasks, essential for effective test-time training. T3R further introduces a rotation technique that reorients self-supervised signals using these matrices to create surrogate gradients for the target task, allowing deeper adaptation across nearly the entire architecture. Empirically, T3R reduces MAE by 0.172 points over standard inference in regression datasets and achieves at least 9.37% relative improvement on cross-domain OGB classification benchmarks compared to models without adaptation. These results highlight the potential to develop an adaptation pipeline for graph-based systems, particularly in settings where conventional fine-tuning or retraining is infeasible.
papers.summary_zh:

Conclusion: T3R 展示了构建图系统自适应管线的潜力，特别适用于传统微调或重训练不可行的场景。

papers.title: GeoEdit: Geometry-Aware Object Editing via Dual-Branch Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Precisely manipulating objects in a single photograph (translation, rotation, scaling) while obeying 3D physical constraints remains unsolved for diffusion-based editors. Current 2D methods lack spatial awareness and produce perspective violations. Forcing structural proxies into the latent space also disrupts variance homogeneity, and the resulting self-attention leakage leads to ghosting and background blur. The core difficulty is asymmetric: the relocated object must follow a rigid geometry, yet the uncovered background needs freedom to synthesize plausible content. We present GeoEdit, a training-free Lift-Manipulate-Render-Denoise pipeline that satisfies both constraints. We decouple scene and object in 3D, align them through point correspondence, and render a geometry-aligned proxy with a structural depth map. A Dual-Branch Denoising stage then refines this proxy: a video diffusion backbone preserves object identity, while 3D constraints are injected into the foreground within a narrow denoising window at matching noise variance (variance-homogeneous injection). The background denoises freely. Because the injected signal matches the native latent statistics, self-attention stays undisturbed. We also introduce GeoEditBench, a pose-aware benchmark covering object translation, object rotation, and camera movement with pose-aware evaluation metrics. Experiments confirm consistent gains in geometric accuracy, identity fidelity, and background quality. Our codes are available at https://github.com/Heey731/GeoEdit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoEdit 提出一种无需训练的 Lift-Manipulate-Render-Denoise 管道，解决单张照片中物体移动、旋转、缩放时遵循 3D 物理约束的问题。通过 3D 解耦场景与物体、点对应对齐以及结构深度图渲染，再经双分支去噪（视频扩散骨干固定物体身份，方差同质注入前景约束，背景自由去噪）来避免鬼影与模糊。实验在自建的 GeoEditBench 基准上显示几何精度、身份保真度和背景质量均有提升。
Motivation: 现有扩散编辑器在物体操作时缺乏空间感知，产生透视违例；强制结构代理到潜在空间会破坏方差同质性，导致自注意力泄漏和背景模糊。核心难点在于既要保持物体刚性几何，又要让背景有自由生成空间。
Method: 提出 GeoEdit，训练无关的 Lift-Manipulate-Render-Denoise 管道：先在 3D 空间解耦场景与物体，通过点对应对齐后渲染结构深度图；再使用双分支去噪——视频扩散骨干保持物体身份，在匹配噪声方差的前景注入 3D 约束（方差同质注入），背景则自由去噪，避免干扰自注意力。
Result: 在 GeoEditBench 基准上，该方法在几何精度、身份保真度和背景质量方面均取得一致提升。
Conclusion: GeoEdit 通过 3D 解耦与方差同质注入，同时满足刚性物体几何约束和背景自由合成需求，代码已开源。

papers.title: SICAGE: Speaker-Independent Culture-Aware Gesture Generation using TED4C-L Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Recent co-speech gesture generation methods often overlook cultural differences, limiting their effectiveness in human-agent interaction. Moreover, culture-conditioned models are rarely evaluated under speaker-disjoint splits, so apparent "cultural" behavior may be confounded with speaker-specific gesturing style. We introduce SICAGE, a modular framework for culture-aware co-speech gesture generation that conditions motion synthesis models on speaker-independent cultural representations. SICAGE learns these representations from audio and text by treating each speaker as a separate domain while imposing invariance across speakers. This encourages representations to remain culture-discriminative while reducing dependence on speaker identity. The resulting cultural embeddings condition a multimodal generator to produce culturally appropriate gestures. We instantiate this idea with two domain generalization approaches: adversarial learning and Fishr regularization. We further introduce ALaDiT, a real-time diffusion-based gesture generator designed to efficiently incorporate the learned cultural embeddings. To validate our method, we built TED4C-L, a 106-hour multimodal dataset of 764 TED speakers from four cultural groups. Experiments show that SICAGE improves motion realism, diversity, beat synchronization, semantic relevance, and cultural consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SICAGE，一个模块化的文化感知共言语手势生成框架，通过学习说话者无关的文化表示来条件化动作合成，并引入包含 764 位 TED 演讲者、106 小时的多模态数据集 TED4C-L。摘要声称在运动真实性、多样性、节拍同步、语义相关性和文化一致性上均有提升。
Motivation: 现有共言语手势生成方法常忽视文化差异，且在说话者无关划分下，模型学习的“文化”行为可能被说话者特有风格所混淆。
Method: 采用领域泛化方法（对抗学习和 Fishr 正则化）从音频和文本中学习说话者无关的文化嵌入，并基于这些嵌入条件化一个实时扩散手势生成器 ALaDiT。
Result: 在 TED4C-L 数据集上的实验表明，SICAGE 在运动真实性、多样性、节拍同步、语义相关性和文化一致性等指标上均优于基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调文化感知与说话者不变性对于生成文化恰当手势的重要性，但未明确讨论方法局限性。

papers.title: AlgoSkill: Learning to Design Algorithms by Scheduling Human-Like Skills
papers.abstract_en: Designing an algorithm from a natural-language problem statement requires identifying the problem structure, reading constraints, choosing a suitable paradigm, checking correctness, and refining complexity. Existing large language model (LLM) methods often rely on direct generation or generic self-refinement, leaving these steps implicit. We propose AlgoSkill, which models algorithm design as sequential decision-making over a typed library of algorithmic skills, including abstraction, constraint analysis, state design, data-structure selection, proof checking, counterexample construction, and complexity refinement. A learned scheduler proposes skills from the current design state, while a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) controller explores skill sequences using verification feedback from compilation, testing, stress testing, and complexity analysis. Experiments on competitive programming and combinatorial optimization benchmarks show that AlgoSkill improves over direct LLM generation, chain-of-thought prompting, self-refinement, and MCTS without typed skills. Ablations show that typed skills, verification-based repair, and search-based scheduling each contribute to performance. These results support treating automatic algorithm design as verification-guided skill scheduling rather than one-shot code generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AlgoSkill，将算法设计建模为在类型化算法技能库上的序列决策过程，包括抽象、约束分析、状态设计、数据结构选择、证明检查、反例构造和复杂度细化。使用学习型调度器根据当前设计状态提出技能，并通过蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）控制器探索技能序列，利用编译、测试、压力测试和复杂度分析的验证反馈。在竞争性编程和组合优化基准上，AlgoSkill 优于直接 LLM 生成、思维链提示、自我细化和无类型技能的 MCTS。消融实验表明，类型化技能、基于验证的修复和基于搜索的调度各自贡献了性能提升。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 方法在从自然语言问题描述设计算法时，通常依赖直接生成或通用自我细化，将识别问题结构、读取约束、选择合适范式、检查正确性和优化复杂度等步骤隐含处理，导致算法设计过程不透明且效果有限。
Method: 提出 AlgoSkill 框架，包含一个类型化算法技能库（如抽象、约束分析、状态设计等），一个学习型调度器从当前设计状态选择技能，以及一个 MCTS 控制器探索技能序列，利用编译、测试、压力测试和复杂度分析等验证反馈指导搜索。
Result: 在竞争性编程和组合优化基准上，AlgoSkill 优于直接 LLM 生成、思维链提示、自我细化和无类型技能的 MCTS。消融实验表明，类型化技能、基于验证的修复和基于搜索的调度均贡献性能提升。
Conclusion: 自动算法设计应被视为验证引导的技能调度，而非一次性代码生成。本文方法通过显式建模设计步骤和验证反馈，展示了比现有方法更优的性能。

papers.title: Rigel: Self-Distilled Score Adaptation for Image and Video Captioning Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Automatic evaluation of image and video captioning is essential for benchmarking multimodal systems, although standard evaluation metrics show limited alignment with human judgments. Recent approaches using large language models (LLMs), commonly referred to as LLM-as-a-Judge, have improved alignment with human judgments but still suffer from a mismatch between large-vocabulary language modeling and evaluation over a small label set. To address this, we propose Rigel, an automatic evaluation metric for image and video captioning, based on self-distilled score adaptation. The metric employs an evaluation-specific scoring head distilled from a frozen LLM, which captures judgment signals in a task-aligned space without relying on large-vocabulary token sets. We then refine the LLM backbone with human judgment data. To train Rigel, we constructed the Vid-Lepus dataset, which contains 3,338 video clips, 33,380 reference captions, and 5,637 candidate captions. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Rigel outperforms state-of-the-art metrics, achieving over 10-point improvements on ActivityNet-Fact in the reference-free setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Rigel，一种基于自蒸馏得分调整的图像和视频描述自动评估指标。通过从冻结LLM中提取评估专用评分头，并在人类判断数据上微调LLM骨干，解决了LLM作为评判时词汇规模与少量标签不匹配的问题。在多个基准上优于现有指标，尤其在参考无关设置下ActivityNet-Fact上提升超过10点。
Motivation: 现有图像/视频描述评估指标与人类判断一致性有限，基于LLM的方法虽然改进但存在大词汇语言模型与少量标签评估之间的不匹配。
Method: 采用自蒸馏得分调整：从冻结LLM中蒸馏出评估专用的评分头，并在人类判断数据集Vid-Lepus（包含3,338视频片段等）上微调LLM骨干。
Result: 在多个基准上超越现有最优指标，参考无关设置下ActivityNet-Fact上提升超过10点。
Conclusion: Rigel通过自蒸馏和人类数据微调有效提升了图像/视频描述评估与人类判断的一致性。

papers.title: Be Faithful When Response: Returning Fluent and Grounded Answers for Vision-Language Models Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is an important paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, directly applying RL to rollout multimodal reasoning can lead to instability, due to the exploitation of language priors, the neglect of visual evidence, and the generation of reasoning traces that are fluent yet not visually grounded. The question arises: Can initially steer the policy toward visually faithful reasoning regime before applying reinforcement learning? To this end, we propose a Faithful Warm-Start (FWS) strategy that first curates samples with explicit vision-language causal relationships from six general VQA benchmarks to construct the FaithfulQA dataset, where each of the image-question pairs gains a certain degree of visual observations, question requirements, commonsense knowledge, domain knowledge, and the final answer. Subsequently, a VLM-based judge is employed to further purify the dataset, ensuring strong causal consistency and visual faithfulness. This warm-start stage equips the model with the capability to understand causally grounded vision-language patterns before subsequent RL optimization under sparse answer-level rewards. Experimental results show that such faithful supervision improves answer accuracy, stabilizes RL training, and reduces visually unsupported reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 Faithful Warm-Start (FWS) 策略，通过构建包含明确视觉-语言因果关系的 FaithfulQA 数据集，并利用 VLM 裁判净化，使视觉-语言模型在强化学习前获得视觉忠实的推理能力，从而提高答案准确性、稳定训练并减少无视觉依据的推理。
Motivation: 直接对视觉-语言模型应用强化学习时，模型可能利用语言先验、忽略视觉证据，生成流畅但不基于视觉的推理轨迹，导致训练不稳定。需要一种方法在强化学习前引导策略朝向视觉忠实的推理。
Method: 从六个通用 VQA 基准中筛选具有显式视觉-语言因果关系的样本，构建 FaithfulQA 数据集；然后使用 VLM 裁判进一步净化数据集，确保因果一致性和视觉忠实性；在此数据集上预热训练后，再应用强化学习优化。
Result: 实验表明，这种忠实监督提高了答案准确性，稳定了强化学习训练，并减少了无视觉支持的推理。
Conclusion: FWS 策略通过预热阶段使模型学习因果 grounding 的视觉-语言模式，从而为后续强化学习提供稳定的初始化，提升了 VLM 的视觉忠实性和推理质量。

summary_sections.motivation: 直接对视觉-语言模型应用强化学习时，模型可能利用语言先验、忽略视觉证据，生成流畅但不基于视觉的推理轨迹，导致训练不稳定。需要一种方法在强化学习前引导策略朝向视觉忠实的推理。
summary_sections.method: 从六个通用 VQA 基准中筛选具有显式视觉-语言因果关系的样本，构建 FaithfulQA 数据集；然后使用 VLM 裁判进一步净化数据集，确保因果一致性和视觉忠实性；在此数据集上预热训练后，再应用强化学习优化。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明，这种忠实监督提高了答案准确性，稳定了强化学习训练，并减少了无视觉支持的推理。
summary_sections.conclusion: FWS 策略通过预热阶段使模型学习因果 grounding 的视觉-语言模式，从而为后续强化学习提供稳定的初始化，提升了 VLM 的视觉忠实性和推理质量。

papers.title: Stabilizing Extrapolation in Looped Transformers via Learned Stochastic Stopping
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers, which repeatedly apply a shared transformer block, are an architecturally natural fit for variable-length algorithmic tasks. Although they can exhibit strong length generalization beyond the length of training sequences, this behavior is brittle, yielding high out-of-distribution (OOD) variance, even across well-performing in-distribution solutions. We trace this variance to the spurious correlation in simple algorithmic tasks between sequence length and number of loops. Introducing stochasticity into the number of loops during training sharply reduces OOD variance and stabilizes predictions across inference-time loop counts. To improve upon heuristic randomization schemes, we further analyze RL-Halting as a learned stochastic schedule and find that it generally improves the accuracy-stability trade-off. Across binary addition, Dyck-1, Unique Set, and Copy, learned stochastic stopping often improves this trade-off but can also stabilize a suboptimal computation. Our work suggests that "when to stop" should be treated as a training-time design choice, not merely an inference-time computation-allocation rule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Looped Transformers在变长算法任务上的长度泛化问题，发现序列长度与循环次数之间的虚假相关性导致外推不稳定性。通过训练时引入循环次数的随机性，可以降低分布外方差。进一步分析RL-Halting作为学习到的随机停止策略，在多种任务上改善了准确性-稳定性权衡。结果表明“何时停止”应作为训练时的设计选择。
Motivation: Looped Transformers在变长任务上表现出脆弱的长度泛化，高分布外方差源于序列长度与循环次数的虚假相关。
Method: 提出训练时对循环次数引入随机性，并分析RL-Halting作为学习到的随机停止调度，以稳定外推。
Result: 在二元加法、Dyck-1、Unique Set和Copy任务上，学习到的随机停止通常改善了准确性-稳定性权衡，但有时也会稳定次优计算。
Conclusion: 作者认为“何时停止”应视为训练时的设计选择，而非仅推理时的计算分配规则。

papers.title: Exploration and Online Transfer with Behavioral Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot Transfer in Reinforcement Learning (RL) aims to train an agent that can generate optimal policies for any reward function, without additional learning at transfer time, while training only on reward-free trajectories. For their generality over tasks, such models are sometimes called ``Behavioral Foundation Models'' (BFMs). While they have shown strong performances and improvements in recent years, the current framework and algorithms still assume that, during the transfer phase, the agent is informed offline about the reward (the task to solve) through a dataset of state-reward pairs, which it uses to pick the best policy to deploy. However, in practice if the reward is a black-box (e.g. direct user feedback), it is not possible to generate such a dataset: it is necessary to observe the reward through interactions with the environment. In other words, the current framework of offline transfer is not aligned with the traditional RL setting of online learning through trial-and-error, which requires exploration in order to find rewards. This paper proposes to tackle this new online transfer in zero-shot RL, with the key insight that the BFM itself can be used to generate exploration policies. We show that it is possible to frame this online learning problem in terms of a bandit-like exploration-exploitation problem. More precisely, at each step the bandit algorithm recommends a policy, the BFM executes it in the environment, which yields a reward and a new state; we repeat the process until we converge to the optimal policy. In the popular context of linear reward approximation, we derive a formulation inspired by Upper Confidence Bound and show that exploration can be achieved through the minimization of the eigenvalues of an uncertainty matrix. We evaluate qualitatively and quantitatively our framework on a simple environment to validate the concept of our method.
papers.journal_ref: Conf{é}rence sur l'Apprentissage automatique, Universit{é} de Montpellier, Jul 2026, Montpellier, France
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对零样本迁移强化学习（Zero-shot RL）中在线奖励获取问题，提出利用行为基础模型（BFM）生成探索策略，将在线学习建模为bandit探索-利用问题。在线性奖励近似下，基于Upper Confidence Bound（UCB）推导出通过不确定性矩阵特征值最小化实现探索的方法。在简单环境中的定性和定量评估验证了该概念的有效性。
Motivation: 当前零样本迁移RL框架假设在迁移阶段通过离线数据集提供奖励信息，但实际中奖励可能是黑盒（如用户反馈），无法生成此类数据集，需要在线交互探索。现有框架与强化学习在线试错范式不匹配。
Method: 将在线迁移问题转化为bandit探索-利用问题：每一时间步，bandit算法推荐一个策略，BFM在环境中执行该策略并获得奖励和新状态，重复至收敛到最优策略。在线性奖励近似下，提出一种受UCB启发的公式，通过最小化不确定性矩阵的特征值来实现探索。
Result: 在一个简单环境中进行了定性和定量评估，验证了所提框架的概念可行性。
Conclusion: 本文首次将零样本迁移RL扩展到在线设置，利用BFM自身生成探索策略，并形式化为bandit问题。未来工作可扩展至更复杂环境和任务。

papers.title: A multi-architecture study of specificity refinement and false-positive mechanism analysis in prostate MRI
papers.abstract_en: Objectives: To characterize residual false positives in prostate MRI detection, and to evaluate a lightweight post-hoc refinement head for case-level specificity. Materials and Methods: This retrospective study used PI-CAI (5-fold cross-validation) and Prostate158 (n=158; external). A context-aware evidence head and an 89,216-parameter refinement head were trained on a frozen detection backbone; the evidence head was also trained on four further backbones (bare nnU-Net, bare U-Net, bare Mamba, MIGF-Mamba). For each false-positive region, T2-weighted, apparent-diffusion-coefficient, and high-b-value contrast ratios versus peri-lesional rings were compared against ground-truth lesions and contralateral benign regions. Results: False positives were closer to true cancers than to benign tissue in evidence and raw T2-weighted and apparent-diffusion-coefficient contrast, reproducing 35/35 across five architectures (Cohen's d 1.10; FP/benign evidence ratio 2.38x) and 105/105 across modality-perturbation scenarios. On PI-CAI fold-0, refinement raised case-level specificity from 0.469 to 0.549 (+17.2%) at preserved sensitivity (0.943); 5-fold cross-validation showed fold-conditional behavior (9/15 observations positive; range -22% to +28%). On Prostate158, both models saturated (McNemar pooled p=0.69), while the false-positive contrast-matching finding replicated. Conclusion: Residual false positives are contrast-matched to cancer (sharing raw imaging features rather than histologically confirmed mimicry), reproducing across five architectures -- a data-level imaging property, not model-specific artifacts; post-hoc refinement adds practical specificity in-domain but is fold-conditional.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在前列腺MRI检测中，对残留假阳性进行了多架构分析，并提出了一种轻量级后处理细化头来提高病例级特异性。在PI-CAI和Prostate158数据集上，假阳性在对比度特征上与真实癌症相似，而非组织学伪影。细化头在域内提高了特异性，但存在折叠条件性。
Motivation: 前列腺MRI检测中的残留假阳性尚未充分表征，且现有方法难以区分假阳性和真实癌症。
Method: 使用一个89,216参数的上下文感知证据头和细化头，在冻结的检测骨干上训练；并在五个不同架构（nnU-Net、U-Net、Mamba、MIGF-Mamba）上训练证据头。对比假阳性区域与周围环的T2加权、ADC和高b值对比度比值。
Result: 假阳性在证据和原始T2加权、ADC对比度上更接近真实癌症而非良性组织，跨五个架构复制（Cohen's d 1.10；FP/良性证据比2.38x）。细化头在PI-CAI fold-0上将病例特异性从0.469提高到0.549（+17.2%），灵敏度保持0.943；但5折交叉验证显示折叠条件性。在Prostate158上两组模型饱和，假阳性对比度匹配结果复制。
Conclusion: 残留假阳性在成像特征上与癌症对比度匹配，是数据层面的属性而非模型伪影；后处理细化可提高域内特异性但具有折叠条件性。

papers.title: Learning Efficient 4D Gaussian Representations from Monocular Videos with Flow Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes from monocular videos is challenging due to scene complexity and temporal dynamics. With the advancement of 3D Gaussian Splatting in novel view synthesis, existing methods extend 3D Gaussians to 4D domain with deformation fields, trajectories or spatiotemporal 4D volumes to model scene element deformation. However, these methods suffer from long training time, low rendering speed or high memory consumption for per-frame reconstruction of 4D volumes, without fully exploiting dense dynamic information. To address this issue, we propose Flow Splatting, which constructs the velocity field and enables the conventional splatting technique to render optical flow from the velocity field to supervise dynamics learning process from monocular videos. Specifically, we extend 4D volumes with time varying means and covariance to represent complex dynamics. Then, we construct and approximate the velocity field naturally based on this representations. While conventional volume rendering techniques support to render color fields, we extend the volume rendering strategy to splat the velocity field by considering the influence of camera motions. We conduct experiments on various benchmarks to demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of our method. Compared to the state-of-the-art methods, our model achieves better image quality with less time consumption and higher rendering speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Flow Splatting方法，从单目视频中高效重建动态4D高斯表示。通过构建速度场并扩展体渲染技术渲染光流，监督动态学习过程，在多个基准上实现了比现有方法更好的图像质量、更短的训练时间和更高的渲染速度。
Motivation: 现有基于3D高斯散点（3DGS）扩展的4D方法（如变形场、轨迹或时空4D体）存在训练时间长、渲染速度慢或内存消耗高的问题，未能充分利用密集动态信息。
Method: 提出Flow Splatting，构建速度场并扩展传统散点技术渲染光流，利用时间变化均值和协方差扩展4D体以表示复杂动态，并通过考虑相机运动影响来优化速度场。
Result: 在多个基准上，该方法相比最优方法取得了更好的图像质量，同时训练时间更短、渲染速度更高。
Conclusion: Flow Splatting能够有效从单目视频中学习高效的4D高斯表示，平衡了重建质量与计算效率。

papers.title: Atompack: A Storage and Distribution Layer for Read-Heavy Atomistic ML Training Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Atomistic machine learning datasets are increasingly used for training: large immutable snapshots are read repeatedly, shuffled across epochs, staged across clusters' storage systems, and republished as reusable scientific artifacts. This workload differs from interactive scientific curation, where mutable records and ad hoc inspection are often more important than random indexed throughput. We present Atompack, an append-oriented storage format and distribution layer designed around a simple workload: training pipelines usually consume complete molecular records, while the order of records is randomized by the learning algorithm. Atompack appends records efficiently during dataset construction, then commits an immutable index and serves records through a memory-mapped read path optimized for training. We compare Atompack with HDF5, LMDB, and ASE baselines representing array stores, key-value records, serialized records, and object-oriented databases. The benchmarks measure sequential reads, shuffled reads, shared-filesystem behavior, write throughput, and artifact size. On a representative 64-atom workload, Atompack is 96x faster than ASE LMDB on shuffled training-style reads while producing artifacts about 79\% smaller. The results indicate that serving complete molecule records, rather than field chunks or reconstructed objects, improves shuffled training throughput while keeping artifacts compact enough for public distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Atompack，一种面向原子机器学习训练数据集的追加写入存储格式与分发层。该格式针对训练流水线中大规模分子记录的顺序读取与随机混洗需求设计，通过不可变索引和内存映射读路径优化读取性能。实验表明，在64原子工作负载上，Atompack在训练风格的随机读取上比ASE LMDB快96倍，且存储体积减小约79%。
Motivation: 现有原子机器学习数据集存储格式（如HDF5、LMDB、ASE）在设计上更适用于交互式科学数据整理，而非训练场景中大规模不可变快照的高吞吐随机读取，导致训练效率低下。
Method: Atompack采用追加写入（append-oriented）记录方式，构建完成后提交不可变索引，并通过内存映射（memory-mapped）文件提供面向训练的随机读取路径，避免逐字段反序列化或对象重建。
Result: 在64原子代表性工作负载上，Atompack在训练风格的随机混洗读取中比ASE LMDB快96倍，同时生成的数据体积减小约79%。
Conclusion: Atompack通过提供完整分子记录而非字段分片或重建对象，显著提升了混洗训练吞吐量，同时保持数据工件的紧凑性，适合公开分发。

papers.title: First-Order Temporal Logic Tensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: Most of the existing neuro-symbolic AI methods focus on the scenario of static knowledge where objects do not change according to a temporal dimension. Temporal neuro-symbolic works are still under explored and are mainly developed for time-interval logic or propositional linear temporal logic. There is a lack of models studying linear temporal logics with predicates that deal with objects whose properties and relations change through the time. We present First-Order Temporal Logic Tensor Networks (FOT-LTN) that is an extension of Logic Tensor Networks (LTN) that fills this gap by considering a linear-temporal dimension. In particular, FOT-LTN joins the syntax of First-Order Linear Temporal Logic with the fuzzy (and real-valued) semantics of LTN obtaining a framework that supports both temporal operators and quantifiers and is totally differentiable. A first evaluation regards a temporal knowledge graph completion task on two synthetic datasets showing better performance of FOT-LTN with respect to dedicated (purely neural) methods.

papers.title: NeuReasoner: Theory-grounded Mapping of Reasoning Elicitation Boundaries
papers.abstract_en: A growing body of work suggests that the reasoning capabilities of large language models are largely latent in their base form, with post-training primarily amplifying rather than introducing them. However, this evidence comes mainly from mathematical and coding benchmarks, leaving the boundary conditions of that claim largely unexplored, namely which cognitive tasks can be recovered through elicitation and where that recovery fails. To investigate this, we introduce NeuReasoner, a theory-grounded elicitation instrument. At each step, an orchestrator pairs a Neuro Lens, inspired by functional specificity, with a Cognitive Lens, drawn from the Erotetic Theory of Reasoning, and integrates their outputs through internal modularization of a single model, without external tools. We evaluate NeuReasoner on CogBench, a suite of behavioral tasks from cognitive psychology, alongside standard mathematical and coding benchmarks, measuring both its improvement over vanilla inference and its ability to match a model's post-trained thinking mode. At sufficient scale, NeuReasoner matches or exceeds thinking-mode baselines on arithmetic reasoning, code generation, Bayesian reasoning, and reward learning; these gains persist against self-consistency and iterative-refinement baselines matched to NeuReasoner's per-decision call budget. Using NeuReasoner allows us to find clear boundaries: risk-taking and decision making under uncertainty remains hard to recover through elicitation alone, and model scale interacts with elicitation in both directions: widening its advantage on some cognitive signatures while erasing it on others. Overall, through NeuReasoner as a modular, interpretable, theory-grounded elicitation instrument, we empirically map where reasoning elicitation succeeds and fails, beyond the mathematical and coding benchmarks where prior claims have rested.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NeuReasoner 是一个基于理论引导的推理激发工具，通过神经透镜和认知透镜的组合，在 CogBench 等基准上评估大型语言模型的推理能力，发现激发可以恢复某些推理能力但存在边界，例如风险决策仍难以通过激发恢复。
Motivation: 现有证据表明大语言模型的推理能力主要在基座中潜在，后训练只是放大而非引入，但边界条件（哪些认知任务可通过激发恢复、哪些失败）尚未充分探索，特别是在数学和编码基准之外。
Method: 提出 NeuReasoner，一个理论引导的激发工具，每步由一个协调器配对神经透镜（基于功能特异性）和认知透镜（来自 Erotetic 推理理论），通过单个模型的内部模块化整合输出，无需外部工具。
Result: 在足够规模下，NeuReasoner 在算术推理、代码生成、贝叶斯推理和奖励学习上达到或超过思考模式基线，且增益在自洽性和迭代精炼基线下保持；但在风险决策和不确定性下的决策上难以通过激发恢复，模型规模对激发的效应有双向影响。
Conclusion: 通过 NeuReasoner 作为一个模块化、可解释、理论引导的激发工具，实证绘制了推理激发成功和失败的边界，超越了先前声称所依赖的数学和编码基准。

papers.title: RiverONE: Generating Knowledge-Intensive VLM by Simulated Quantum Machines
papers.abstract_en: Quantum computing provides a powerful paradigm for representing and transforming high-dimensional information through superposition, entanglement, and measurement-induced nonlinear features. While current quantum hardware is not yet practical for direct large-scale vision-language model (VLM) inference, simulated quantum computation can be used during model construction to generate structured parameters for compact classical AI systems. We build RiverONE, a lightweight vision-language model for quantum calibration plot understanding, using simulated quantum computation. It employs a specialized visual encoder and an InternVL-based language backbone. To compensate for compression-induced information loss, we introduce quantum-generated parameters, which are materialized as classical tensors after training. This allows RiverONE to run entirely on classical GPUs at inference time, with no quantum hardware or runtime quantum simulation. With approximately 1.9 billion parameters, RiverONE achieves at least 95\% of the performance of NVIDIA Ising Calibration 1 on quantum calibration plot understanding tasks while using less than 10\% of its parameter count. These results suggest that simulated quantum computation can serve as a practical construction-stage mechanism for building lightweight, knowledge-intensive scientific VLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/THeWakeSystems/RiverOne.

papers.title: Variance Reduction on the Camera Axis: Multi-View Score Distillation for 3D
papers.abstract_en: Score distillation turns a pretrained 2D diffusion model into a 3D generator, but the per-step gradient is estimated from a single randomly chosen view: it is high-variance and blind to global shape consistency. Prior work addresses this by retraining the diffusion prior on multi-view data; this improves consistency but makes the sampling contribution inseparable from prior quality. We instead isolate the sampling axis. The per-step gradient is one noisy sample of an expectation over views; aggregating K samples per step at a fixed total UNet budget reduces variance without touching the prior. We introduce Multi-View Aggregated Score Distillation (MV-SDI), which aggregates gradients from K views per step via gradient accumulation, keeping peak memory unchanged and the 2D prior frozen, and draws views as antithetic antipodal pairs, a prior-independent geometric property, for balanced angular coverage. At a fixed 10,000-UNet-call budget, K=2 raises CLIP R-Precision from 74.8% to 83.8% and CLIP score from 0.297 to 0.312, with consistent gains on HPSv2 and ImageReward and a 0.0% divergence rate on the 43-prompt benchmark; optimization steps halve as a consequence. K=4 gives a fourfold step reduction at R-Precision 86.9% and CLIP 0.307, still well above the single-view baseline on every alignment metric. MV-SDI is compatible with gradient-based score-distillation pipelines, including Score Distillation via Inversion, and requires no retraining and no multi-view data.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多视图聚合分数蒸馏（MV-SDI），通过在每步梯度计算中聚合K个视角的梯度（使用对偶对采样），在不重新训练2D扩散先验的情况下降低梯度方差，提升3D生成的一致性。固定10,000次UNet调用预算下，K=2将CLIP R-Precision从74.8%提升至83.8%，CLIP分数从0.297提升至0.312，优化步数减半；K=4进一步减少步数并保持高对齐指标。该方法无需多视图数据，兼容现有梯度分数蒸馏流水线。
Motivation: 现有分数蒸馏方法每步仅使用单视图梯度，方差大且难以保证全局形状一致性。先前工作通过在多视图数据上重新训练扩散先验来改进，但代价高昂且难以分离采样贡献。
Method: 提出MV-SDI，每步从固定UNet调用预算中分配K个视图，通过梯度累积聚合梯度，并采用对偶对采样（antithetic antipodal pairs）实现均匀角度覆盖，无需修改先验模型或增加峰值内存。
Result: 在10,000 UNet调用预算下，K=2使CLIP R-Precision从74.8%升至83.8%，CLIP分数从0.297升至0.312，HPSv2和ImageReward一致提升，43个提示基准上发散率为0.0%。K=4获得四倍步数减少，R-Precision达86.9%，CLIP为0.307。
Conclusion: MV-SDI通过纯采样策略降低梯度方差，无需重新训练或额外数据，可即插即用于多种分数蒸馏管线（如SDI），在保持生成质量的同时大幅减少优化步数。
