papers.title: Explainability-Aware Frustum Attack: Exposing Structural Vulnerabilities in LiDAR-Based 3D Object Detectors
papers.abstract_en: The structural vulnerabilities of point cloud-based 3D object detectors remain poorly understood. Prior work has studied adversarial robustness primarily on isolated 3D object models, while recent LiDAR spoofing attacks target richer and more realistic driving scenes but focus mainly on physical realizability rather than understanding detector behavior or attack efficiency. In this work, we investigate how LiDAR-based detectors rely on spatial evidence in complex scenes and whether these reliance patterns can be exploited to induce failures more efficiently. To this end, we propose an explainability-guided adversarial analysis methodology. We introduce the Saliency-LiDAR (SALL) method, which aggregates Integrated Gradient attributions across scenes to produce universal saliency maps for LiDAR-based 3D object detectors. Guided by these maps, we design the Explainability-aware Frustum Attack (EFA), which selectively perturbs only the most influential frustums rather than uniformly attacking entire object regions. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes, across detectors such as PointPillars and SECOND, show that EFA reduces detection recall by more than 15 percentage points while requiring 25-50% fewer perturbed frustums than the state-of-the-art non-saliency-aware baseline. These findings reveal that modern 3D detectors concentrate discriminative evidence in a small subset of spatial regions, exposing a structural robustness vulnerability in current LiDAR perception systems. Our code is released at https://github.com/SecMindLab/Saliency_LiDAR.
papers.comment: The 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可解释性引导的对抗分析方法，针对基于LiDAR的3D目标检测器在复杂场景中的结构脆弱性。通过集成梯度方法生成通用显著性图（SALL），并据此设计可解释性感知的截锥体攻击（EFA），仅扰动最关键的截锥体区域。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上对PointPillars和SECOND等检测器的实验表明，EFA在减少25-50%扰动截锥体的情况下，将检测召回率降低超过15个百分点，揭示了当前LiDAR感知系统中存在的结构鲁棒性漏洞。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注独立3D物体模型的对抗鲁棒性，或仅强调物理可实现性而忽视对检测器行为理解和攻击效率，对点云3D检测器在复杂场景中的结构脆弱性理解不足。
Method: 提出可解释性引导的对抗分析框架，包括：1) SALL方法，通过跨场景聚合集成梯度（Integrated Gradients）生成通用显著性图；2) EFA攻击，根据显著性图选择性扰动最具影响力的截锥体区域，而非均匀攻击整个目标区域。
Result: 在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，针对PointPillars和SECOND检测器，EFA相比非显著性图基线方法，在扰动截锥体数量减少25-50%的情况下，将检测召回率降低超过15个百分点。
Conclusion: 现代3D检测器将判别性证据集中在少量空间区域，暴露了当前LiDAR感知系统的结构鲁棒性漏洞，需引起对该脆弱性的关注。

papers.title: DuoMem: Towards Capable On-Device Memory Agents via Dual-Space Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents can solve complex procedural tasks by interacting with environments over multiple turns, but this ability typically depends on large models, long contexts, and repeated inference calls. This makes advanced memory-augmented agents difficult to deploy on resource-constrained devices. We introduce DuoMem, a dual-space distillation framework that transfers procedural problem-solving ability from a large teacher model to compact student models. DuoMem distils in two complementary spaces: (1)context-space distillation, which replaces student-generated memories with higher-quality teacher-generated procedural memories prepended to the student's input, and (2)parameter-space distillation, which fine-tunes lightweight LoRA adapters on successful teacher trajectories. Evaluated on ALFWorld, a challenging embodied decision-making benchmark, DuoMem boosts a 4B-parameter model from 4.3% to 77.9% task success rate, closing most of the gap to a 72B teacher model (87.1%), while adding fewer than 10M trainable parameters and only a few megabytes of pre-computed teacher memories. Moreover, the DuoMem-enhanced 4B model completes tasks over 3x faster than the 72B teacher in wall-clock time, making it viable for real-time edge deployment, which would be challenging for the teacher.Extensive ablations across eight models spanning 2B-72B parameters reveal that both distillation axes contribute complementary
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DuoMem是一种双空间蒸馏框架，旨在将大型语言模型（LLM）的复杂程序性任务解决能力迁移到紧凑的学生模型上，使其能在资源受限设备上高效运行。该方法在ALFWorld基准上将4B参数模型的任务成功率从4.3%提升至77.9%，接近72B教师模型的87.1%，同时仅增加不到1000万可训练参数和几兆字节的预计算教师记忆。此外，增强后的4B模型在端到端推理速度上比72B教师模型快3倍以上。
Motivation: 基于LLM的智能体通常依赖大模型、长上下文和多次推理调用来解决复杂任务，这阻碍了其在资源受限设备上的部署。现有方法缺乏高效的记忆增强机制，在边缘设备上难以实现。
Method: 提出双空间蒸馏框架，包括上下文空间蒸馏（用高质量教师生成的过程性记忆替换学生生成的记忆）和参数空间蒸馏（在成功教师轨迹上微调轻量级LoRA适配器）。
Result: 在ALFWorld基准上，4B参数学生模型任务成功率从4.3%提升至77.9%（教师为87.1%），仅增加<10M参数和数MB教师记忆；推理速度比72B教师快3倍以上。八种模型（2B-72B）的消融实验表明两种蒸馏维度互补。

papers.title: SWE-Together: Evaluating Coding Agents in Interactive User Sessions
papers.abstract_en: Most coding-agent benchmarks are static: an agent receives a complete task description up front and is judged only by its final code. Real coding assistance is interactive, with users clarifying goals, adding constraints, and correcting mistakes over multiple turns. We introduce SWE-Together, a multi-turn benchmark reconstructed from real user-agent coding sessions. To make real interactions verifiable, we curate 109 repository-level tasks from 11,260 recorded sessions, selecting sessions with recoverable repository states, clear user goals, and observable outcomes. To replay these interactions across agents, we build a reactive LLM-based user simulator that preserves the original users' intents and provides feedback when the coding agent's progress requires it. To evaluate agents as collaborators, we measure both final repository correctness and the number of corrective feedback turns required during the interaction. Experiments with frontier coding agents show that stronger agents generally achieve higher final success rates while requiring fewer interventions, suggesting an improved user experience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SWE-Together，一个从真实用户-代理编码会话重建的多轮交互基准，包含 109 个仓库级任务。通过构建反应式 LLM 用户模拟器，评估编码代理在交互式会话中的协作能力，同时衡量最终代码正确性和所需纠正反馈轮数。实验表明，更强的代理通常成功率更高且干预更少。
Motivation: 现有编码代理基准是静态的，忽略真实编码中用户交互的多轮动态，无法评估代理在用户反馈下调整行为的能力。
Method: 从 11,260 条记录中筛选 109 个可恢复仓库状态、有明确用户目标和可观察结果的任务；构建基于 LLM 的用户模拟器，保留原始用户意图并在必要时提供反馈；评估指标包括最终仓库正确性和纠正反馈轮数。
Result: 更强的前沿编码代理在最终成功率上更高，同时需要的纠正反馈轮数更少，表明用户体验改善。
Conclusion: SWE-Together 提供了一个更真实的交互式编码代理评估框架，未来可扩展至更多场景和代理类型。

papers.title: SpreadsheetBench 2: Evaluating Agents on End-to-End Business Spreadsheet Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Spreadsheets are widely used for business analysis, financial modeling, reporting, and decision-making. However, most existing spreadsheet benchmarks evaluate isolated operations such as single-formula generation or local cell edits, and therefore fail to capture end-to-end workflows in realistic business settings. We introduce \textsc{SpreadsheetBench 2}, a workflow-level benchmark for spreadsheet agents that covers three task categories: generation, debugging, and visualization. The benchmark is constructed from authentic business data, including financial reports and corporate filings, and is annotated and validated by domain experts. The benchmark contains 321 tasks; each instance averages 11.8 worksheets and requires 593.5 cell modifications, reflecting large multi-sheet workbooks with cross-sheet dependencies. We evaluate eight frontier large language models under a unified multi-turn agent scaffold, and additionally include several LLM-based spreadsheet products as complementary baselines. Results show that current systems remain far from reliable on real-world workflows: the best model achieves 34.89\% overall task accuracy, and debugging accuracy is as low as 12.00\%. Trajectory analysis and a failure taxonomy further indicate that insufficient spreadsheet inspection and incorrect target-cell selection are the dominant bottlenecks. Together, these findings position \textsc{SpreadsheetBench 2} as a challenging testbed for advancing reliable spreadsheet automation. Project page: https://spreadsheetbench.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍SpreadsheetBench 2，一个面向电子表格代理的工作流级基准测试，包含生成、调试和可视化三类任务，基于真实商业数据构建，每任务平均涉及11.8个工作表和593.5次单元格修改。评估了8个前沿大语言模型及若干电子表格产品，最佳模型整体任务准确率仅34.89%，调试准确率低至12.00%。分析表明，不充分的电子表格检查和错误的目标单元格选择是主要瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有电子表格基准大多评估孤立操作（如单公式生成或局部编辑），无法捕捉真实商业环境中的端到端工作流。
Method: 构建包含321个任务的基准，涵盖生成、调试和可视化三类任务，数据来自真实财务报告和企业文件，由领域专家标注验证。使用统一的多轮代理脚手架评估LLM，并补充LLM电子表格产品作为基线。
Result: 最佳模型整体任务准确率34.89%，调试准确率仅12.00%。轨迹分析和失败分类表明，电子表格检查不足和目标单元格选择错误是主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: SpreadsheetBench 2作为挑战性测试床，可用于推进可靠的电子表格自动化。

papers.title: Exploiting Local Flatness for Efficient Out-of-Distribution Detection
papers.abstract_en: Detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) data is crucial for reliable machine learning deployment. Among detection strategies, post-hoc methods are particularly attractive due to their efficiency, as they operate directly on pre-trained networks without requiring retraining. Within this paradigm, one promising direction exploits loss-landscape curvature to estimate model uncertainty; however, such methods incur substantial computational cost and rely on implicit assumptions about how landscape flatness differs between in-distribution (ID) and OOD data. In this work, we provide the first systematic investigation of this curvature discrepancy and show that OOD inputs exhibit larger Hessian curvature than ID data, with the gap widening under stronger distributional shifts. Motivated by these observations, we propose Fold, a lightweight flatness-modulated OOD detector that leverages the feature Hessian and partial feature normalization to improve ID-OOD separability while avoiding costly parameter-space curvature approximations. To optimally adapt this normalization across diverse datasets, we further introduce AutoFold, a self-supervised tuning scheme that synthesizes pseudo-OOD samples via ID logit masking for automatic calibration without requiring external data. Experiments on OOD benchmarks show that Fold outperforms prior methods, improving the average AUROC by 1.63% and reducing FPR95 by 2.30%, while maintaining computational efficiency comparable to a standard forward pass. Supported by theoretical analysis and extensive ablations, Fold provides a principled and practical solution for robust real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了分布内（ID）与分布外（OOD）数据在Hessian曲率上的差异，发现OOD数据具有更大的曲率，且分布偏移越强差距越大。基于此，提出Fold，一种轻量级平坦度调制OOD检测器，利用特征Hessian和部分特征标准化改善ID-OOD可分离性，并引入AutoFold通过ID logit掩码合成伪OOD样本实现自动校准。实验表明Fold在AUROC上平均提升1.63%，FPR95降低2.30%，计算效率接近标准前向传播。
Motivation: 现有基于损失景观曲率的OOD检测方法计算成本高且依赖隐含假设，缺乏对ID与OOD数据曲率差异的系统性理解。
Method: 提出Fold，通过特征Hessian和部分特征标准化来调制平坦度，避免昂贵的参数空间曲率近似；AutoFold通过ID logit掩码生成伪OOD样本，实现无需外部数据的自监督调参。
Result: 在OOD基准上，Fold平均AUROC提高1.63%，FPR95降低2.30%，计算效率可与标准前向传播媲美。
Conclusion: Fold提供了一种原则性且实用的OOD检测方案，结合理论分析与广泛消融，适用于稳健的部署场景。

papers.title: Improved Predictive Performance and Interpretability for Mesomorphic Neural Networks Using Local Fidelity Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Interpretable Mesomorphic Neural Networks (IMNs) offer a promising framework that combines the predictive power of deep neural networks with the interpretability of linear models. However, the original formulation lacks safeguards to ensure that the learned interpretations are in fact reliable. In particular, the network is free to concentrate all explanatory variance into a single weight of the linear output layer, achieving strong predictive performance while producing interpretations that are largely meaningless. Paradoxically, the L1 penalty proposed to encourage sparse solutions exacerbates this problem by further incentivizing such degenerate configurations. To address this vulnerability, we introduce Local Fidelity Regularization (LFR), a novel penalty term that prevents degenerate weight collapse by aligning the linear output weights with local data variations. This structural constraint guarantees faithful explanations and substantially improves the reliability of model interpretations. Furthermore, empirical evaluations across the OpenML benchmark suite demonstrate that LFR does not compromise accuracy for explainability; rather, it achieved improved AUROC over the unregularized IMN. By yielding results highly competitive with state-of-the-art black-box models, LFR provides the dual benefit of reliable interpretability and superior predictive performance. Source code and usage instructions are available at https://github.com/hugohammer/LFR-IMN.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可解释中间型神经网络（IMN）中解释不可靠的问题，提出局部保真度正则化（LFR），通过将线性输出权重与局部数据变化对齐，防止权重坍塌，从而保证忠实的解释。实验表明LFR在提升可解释性的同时，还能改善AUROC，达到与黑盒模型相当的性能。
Motivation: 原始IMN缺乏保证解释可靠性的机制，网络可能将所有解释方差集中到单个线性输出权重，导致强预测性能但解释无意义；L1稀疏惩罚反而加剧了这种退化配置。
Method: 提出局部保真度正则化（LFR），一种新的惩罚项，通过约束线性输出权重与局部数据变化一致，防止退化权重坍塌，确保解释的忠实性。
Result: 在OpenML基准套件上的实证评估显示，LFR在提高AUROC的同时，未牺牲准确性，且与最先进的黑盒模型结果高度竞争。
Conclusion: LFR为IMN提供了可靠的可解释性和优越的预测性能的双重收益，源代码已公开。

papers.title: Data-Efficient Multimodal Alignment for Histopathology-based Molecular Prediction
papers.abstract_en: H&E-stained whole-slide images offer cohort-scale availability and rich spatial context but lack molecular specificity, whereas bulk RNA-seq provides transcriptome-wide resolution at high cost with limited archival availability. We show that training a lightweight alignment module atop frozen histopathology and RNA-Seq foundation models enables open-vocabulary molecular prompting -- querying H&E slides with gene-set signatures to predict pathway activity without sequencing or end-to-end retraining. Using contrastive learning on a multi-cancer cohort (N=1,720), we achieve a 25-fold improvement in retrieval over baseline methods. Systematic analysis reveals a graduated predictability spectrum: morphologically grounded programs (cell-cycle programs, immune-related) are most reliably predicted (R^2>0.5), while predicting pathways with no morphological footprint remains challenging as expected. We validate clinical utility on the POSEIDON clinical trial: H&E-predicted squamous cell carcinoma scores recapitulate NSCLC subtype identity and predicted IFN-gamma mirror PD-L1 tumor-cell expression groups. Furthermore, genesets describing immune activation and fibrosis predict known tumor microenvironment archetypes from histology alone. We further validate generalization of our approach across unseen cohorts and demonstrate data-efficient domain adaptation, establishing a slide-native framework for molecular analysis on H&E images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据高效的多模态对齐方法，通过在冻结的组织病理学（H&E）和RNA-seq基础模型之上训练轻量级对齐模块，实现从H&E全切片图像开放词汇分子预测。使用对比学习在多癌队列（N=1,720）上训练，检索性能提升25倍。系统分析显示形态学相关程序（如细胞周期、免疫相关）预测可靠（R²>0.5），而缺乏形态足迹的通路预测困难。在POSEIDON临床试验中验证了预测的鳞状细胞癌评分和IFN-γ信号与已知亚型和PD-L1表达一致。
Motivation: H&E染色全切片图像广泛可用且富含空间信息，但缺乏分子特异性；而bulk RNA-seq虽提供转录组分辨率，但成本高且存档有限。需要一种数据高效的方法从H&E图像预测分子特征，无需测序或端到端重训练。
Method: 在冻结的医学基础模型（组织病理学和RNA-seq）之上训练轻量级对齐模块，采用对比学习进行多模态对齐，实现开放词汇的分子提示——即用基因集特征查询H&E图像以预测通路活性。
Result: 多癌队列（N=1,720）上检索提升25倍；形态相关程序（细胞周期、免疫相关）预测R²>0.5；在POSEIDON临床试验中，预测的鳞状细胞癌评分重现NSCLC亚型，预测的IFN-γ反映PD-L1肿瘤细胞表达组。在未见队列上验证了泛化性和数据高效的域适应。
Conclusion: 该框架为H&E图像上的分子分析提供了一种slide-native方法，具有数据高效域适应能力，并展示了在临床环境中的实用性。

summary_sections.result: 多癌队列（N=1,720）上检索提升25倍；形态相关程序（细胞周期、免疫相关）预测R²>0.5；在POSEIDON临床试验中，预测的鳞状细胞癌评分重现NSCLC亚型，预测的IFN-γ反映PD-L1肿瘤细胞表达组。在未见队列上验证了泛化性和数据高效的域适应。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为H&E图像上的分子分析提供了一种slide-native方法，具有数据高效域适应能力，并展示了在临床环境中的实用性。

papers.title: Diagnosing and Mitigating Retrieval Bottlenecks in LLM-Based Cold-Start Recommendation
authors: Yicheng Wang (3) ((1) University of Maine at Presque Isle
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as rerankers in recommender systems, with the expectation that semantic understanding will help in cold-start and long-tail regimes. We test this assumption with a five-domain benchmark that explicitly separates reranking quality from retrieval coverage. In a positive-controlled regime where the gold item is guaranteed present, calibrated LLM rerankers fail to consistently outperform strong collaborative and content baselines under natural traffic, and within-family scaling from Qwen3-8B to Qwen3-32B narrows but does not close the gap on most domains. In a retrieval-realistic regime where the gold item is not injected, the bottleneck is more severe: standard single retrievers place the gold item in a 200-item pool only 4.6-22.9% of the time, largely because 32-91% of cold-start targets are brand-new items with no training interactions. We introduce LHF, a validation-trained learned hybrid fusion layer over a multi-retriever union pool, as a retrieval-side realizability baseline. LHF is the only combiner we test that beats every single retriever on all five domains and recovers 17-61% of oracle coverage headroom on content-rich domains, but only 5-7% on collaboratively strong domains. End-to-end experiments reveal the remaining mismatch: learned non-LLM ranking exploits the LHF pool, while prompt-level LLM reranking often degrades it. LLMs exhibit pockets of semantic cold-start advantage, especially in text-rich domains when the item is already present, but this advantage is largely unreachable in current retrieve-then-rerank pipelines. We release the benchmark protocol, splits, prompts, evaluation tooling, and archived reproducibility artifacts: data at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20991039 and code at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20993306.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过五个领域的基准测试，系统评估了基于LLM的重排序器在冷启动推荐中的表现。在正控制（黄金物品保证存在）下，校准的LLM重排序器未能持续优于强协同过滤和内容基线；在检索现实（黄金物品可能缺失）下，标准单检索器在200个物品池中仅4.6-22.9%包含黄金物品，主要因为32-91%的冷启动目标是全新物品。作者提出LHF（学习型混合融合层），在多个检索器的联合池上训练融合，作为检索侧的可实现性基线，它能击败所有单检索器并恢复部分oracle覆盖率。端到端实验表明，非LLM排序可充分利用LHF池，而LLM重排序常使其性能下降。
Motivation: 现有LLM作为推荐系统重排序器被期望通过语义理解帮助冷启动和长尾场景，但该假设缺乏系统验证，尤其是未分离重排序质量和检索覆盖率的影响。
Method: 构建五个领域的基准，包含正控制（gold item present）和检索现实（gold item可能缺失）两种设置。提出LHF（validation-trained learned hybrid fusion layer），在多个检索器的联合池上学习融合权重，作为检索侧的可实现性基线。
Result: 在正控制下，LLM重排序器未能一致优于强基线；在检索现实下，标准单检索器的黄金物品命中率仅4.6-22.9%。LHF在所有五个领域击败每个单检索器，在内容丰富领域恢复17-61%的oracle覆盖率，在协同强领域仅恢复5-7%。端到端实验中非LLM排序利用LHF池获得提升，而LLM重排序常使其退化。
Conclusion: LLM在文本丰富领域存在语义冷启动优势，但受限于当前检索-重排序管线难以发挥；需改进检索端或重新设计管线以释放该优势。

papers.title: Scene-aware Prediction of Diverse Human Movement Goals
papers.abstract_en: Anticipation of human behaviours facilitates autonomous systems in proactive planning. Human behaviour could be stochastic due to varying goals. Human goals typically guide their own movement and could therefore help to predict the human trajectory and human motion in the long-term. To infer the human movement intentions, the environmental context plays a significant role, in addition to the social cues expressed by the individual. Previous works on human goals prediction either require semantic knowledge of the scene, or only tackle interactions with objects. In this paper, we propose a novel multi-goal prediction method using the generative model to address the stochasticity of human movement. It leverages the current RGB scene and the human pose to predict diverse potential future goals of human movement based on the Conditional Variational Autoencoder (CVAE). Our results demonstrate that our approach is capable of generating multiple movement goals in the scene via samplings in latent space of the CVAE and exhibits generalization capability across scenarios in GTA-IM dataset and PROX dataset. Code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/Q-Y-Yang/DiverseGoalsPrediction.git}{\texttt{https://github.com/Q-Y-Yang/DiverseGoalsPrediction}}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人体运动目标的随机性，提出了一种基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）的多目标预测方法。该方法利用当前RGB场景和人体姿态，通过潜在空间采样生成多样化的未来运动目标，并在GTA-IM和PROX数据集上验证了泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有的人体目标预测方法要么需要场景语义知识，要么仅处理与物体的交互，缺乏对运动随机性和场景上下文的联合建模。
Method: 提出基于CVAE的生成模型，以当前RGB场景和人体姿态为条件，在潜在空间采样生成多个可能的未来运动目标。
Result: 在GTA-IM和PROX数据集上的实验表明，该方法能够生成多样化的运动目标，并展现出跨场景的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 本文的方法利用场景和人体姿态信息，通过CVAE采样有效解决了人体运动目标的随机性问题。

papers.title: Seeing Touch from Motion: A Unified Modality-Aware Visuo-Tactile Policy with Tactile Motion Correlation
papers.abstract_en: Visuo-Tactile policies leveraging optical tactile sensors have shown great promise in contact-rich manipulation. These sensors achieve high spatial resolution and multi-dimensional force sensing by utilizing an internal camera to monitor the deformation of their elastic gel surface, thereby indirectly inferring tactile cues. Despite their advantages, extracting fine-grained contact states necessary for contact-rich manipulation remains an open challenge. Existing methods typically use either raw images or cumulative motion fields to represent tactile cues. However, both are prone to perception ambiguity. Raw tactile images mainly capture appearance changes, while cumulative motion fields only reflect the aggregate gel deformation. Consequently, distinct fine-grained contact states can exhibit highly similar patterns, making it difficult to explicitly distinguish subtle contact variations. To address this issue, we explore the dynamic priors of tactile motion and discover that the correlation between transient and cumulative motion can explicitly distinguish fine-grained contact states. Based on this insight, we propose a motion-aware tactile representation to facilitate contact-rich manipulation. Beyond tactile representation, effective fusion of tactile and visual modalities is also critical. Most existing fusion methods either directly concatenate features from each modality or train modality-specific networks separately and fuse their outputs. However, these strategies struggle to simultaneously model cross-modal interactions and preserve modality-specific characteristics. In this work, we take advantage of the Mixture-of-Transformers architecture and propose a unified modality-aware visuo-tactile policy that captures cross-modal complementarity while maintaining modality-specific properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对光学触觉传感器在接触丰富操作中面临的感知模糊问题，提出基于运动相关性的触觉表示，并利用 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构设计统一模态感知的视觉-触觉策略，旨在更好地区分细粒度接触状态并实现跨模态融合。
Motivation: 现有触觉表示（原始图像或累积运动场）在区分细粒度接触状态时存在感知模糊，且视觉-触觉融合方法难以同时建模跨模态交互和保持模态特定特征。
Method: 通过瞬态运动与累积运动之间的相关性来显式区分细粒度接触状态，构建运动感知触觉表示；并采用 Mixture-of-Transformers 架构设计统一模态感知策略，同时捕获跨模态互补性和保留模态特性。
Result: 摘要在接触丰富的操作任务中展示了该方法的潜力，但未报告具体量化结果。
Conclusion: 利用运动相关性触觉表示与统一模态感知策略，有望缓解现有方法的感知模糊和融合不足问题。

papers.title: SAGA: Scene-Aware, Goal-Evolving Agents for Long-Horizon CivRealm Strategy Planning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon strategic planning in complex strategy games demands concurrent reasoning across multiple decision domains under imperfect information and sparse reward. Existing LLM-based agents suffer from three systematic failures: scene blindness from raw tile coordinates, context overflow and domain coupling from monolithic state dumps, and shallow cross-game learning that treats each episode in isolation. We present SAGA, an LLM multi-agent framework with three mechanisms each directly targeting one class of failure: (i) a Map-Semantic Scene Graph that encodes typed spatial relations among game entities into per-unit natural-language context, resolving spatial blindness without global token inflation; (ii) a Tool-Augmented Planner that pulls fine-grained domain state on demand and dispatches per-domain directives to dedicated specialist controllers, eliminating context overflow, domain coupling, and mechanical constraint violations; and (iii) a Dual-Horizon Feedback Loop that combines periodic within-game goal generation with structured cross-game causal post-mortem, enabling principled strategic evolution without manual reward engineering. Evaluated on FreeCiv, SAGA attains the highest mean civilization score -- the environment's sole sparse objective reward -- with lower variance than the two strongest baselines, and is the only method that significantly surpasses every baseline on infrastructure construction, the resource axis most readily sacrificed under multi-objective conflict. It outscores the two strongest baselines in most head-to-head games while cutting output tokens (the dominant decoding cost) by 27%. Equipped with the cross-game evolution module, SAGA reaches the highest end-of-chain score across five successive episodes. Ablation studies confirm that each architectural component contributes independently to this advantage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAGA，一个基于LLM的多智能体框架，用于解决长期战略规划任务中的三种系统性问题：场景盲视、上下文溢出与领域耦合、以及浅层跨游戏学习。SAGA包含地图语义场景图、工具增强规划器和双视野反馈循环三个模块。在FreeCiv策略游戏上，SAGA取得了最高的平均文明分数，方差低于最强基线，输出token减少27%，并且跨游戏进化模块使连续五局的最终分数持续提升。消融实验证实每个组件独立贡献优势。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理在长期策略游戏中普遍存在三种失败模式：场景盲视（依赖原始坐标）、上下文溢出与领域耦合（处理完整状态转储导致token过多和跨域干扰）、以及浅层跨游戏学习（孤立处理每局游戏），限制了战略规划能力。
Method: 提出SAGA框架，包含三个针对性机制：(i) 地图语义场景图(Map-Semantic Scene Graph)，将实体间的类型化空间关系编码为每个单元的自然语言上下文，避免全局token膨胀；(ii) 工具增强规划器(Tool-Augmented Planner)，按需拉取细粒度领域状态，并将领域指令分派给专用控制器，消除上下文溢出和领域耦合；(iii) 双视野反馈循环(Dual-Horizon Feedback Loop)，结合周期内目标生成和结构化跨游戏因果事后分析，实现无需手动奖励设计的策略演化。
Result: 在FreeCiv上，SAGA取得最高的平均文明分数，方差低于两个最强基线；在基础设施构建（多目标冲突下最易被牺牲的资源轴）上显著超越所有基线；在多数直接对战中得分高于最强基线，同时输出token减少27%。加入跨游戏演化模块后，连续五局中最终分数达到最高。
Conclusion: 摘要强调SAGA的三个组件各自独立贡献了性能优势，整体框架有效提升了长期策略规划中LLM智能体的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HippoSpark: An On-Demand Experience System for LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Distilling historical trajectories into reusable experience to enhance future problem-solving has become a focal point of recent LLM research. However, existing methods predominantly operate at the task level, leveraging general summaries or rules under the assumption that analogous tasks share universal solution patterns. This approach often fails in complex reasoning, which typically falters at local bottlenecks that require precise, state-specific guidance rather than broad heuristics. We introduce HippoSpark, a state-level experience system that performs on-demand retrieval tailored to the immediate needs of the current reasoning state. Across mathematical, scientific, and programming benchmarks, HippoSpark consistently outperforms both standard prompting and task-level experience baselines. Our findings reveal that the most effective experience systems are those that provide actionable guidance at critical bottlenecks rather than serving as generic task-level context. Our code is available at https://github.com/DanlingMeng/HippoSpark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HippoSpark，一种状态级经验系统，根据 LLM 当前推理状态即时检索并利用过往轨迹中的经验，以解决复杂推理中的局部瓶颈问题。在数学、科学和编程基准上，该方法一致优于标准提示和任务级经验基线。作者认为，最有效的经验系统是在关键瓶颈处提供可操作指导，而非通用任务级上下文。
Motivation: 现有经验方法主要在任务级别操作，利用通用摘要或规则，假设类似任务共享通用解决方案模式。然而，复杂推理中常因局部瓶颈而失败，需要精确、状态特定的指导而非宽泛启发式。
Method: 提出 HippoSpark，一个状态级经验系统，通过按需检索 (on-demand retrieval) 匹配当前推理状态的即时需求，提供针对性的历史经验。
Result: 在数学、科学和编程基准上，HippoSpark 显著优于标准提示和任务级经验基线。
Conclusion: 最有效的经验系统应提供关键瓶颈处的可操作指导，而非通用任务级上下文。代码已开源。

papers.title: Latent-CURE for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Models have significantly advanced automated breast ultrasound diagnosis. However, most existing frameworks utilize opaque, end-to-end paradigms prioritizing global statistical correlations over structured clinical reasoning. Consequently, these models remain susceptible to shortcut learning amid extreme real-world epidemiological imbalances, often bypassing rare but decisive malignant indicators for dominant benign patterns. To address this disconnect, we propose Latent-CURE, a novel diagnostic framework driven by asymmetric weighted chain-of-thought methodology grounded in latent space reasoning. Unlike traditional approaches, our framework constructs an implicit reasoning trajectory forcing the model to sequentially infer standardized BI-RADS morphological descriptors before converging on a final diagnosis. Furthermore, to combat the extreme scarcity of critical malignant features, we couple this architecture with a dual-asymmetric optimization strategy. By dynamically adjusting margins and weights, this strategy safeguards high-specificity malignant descriptors from being overshadowed by common benign priors. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that our knowledge-injected approach provides transparent clinical evidence while achieving robust, accurate diagnostic performance in imbalanced medical cohorts.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Latent-CURE框架，用于自动乳腺超声诊断。该方法利用潜在空间推理的异步加权思维链（chain-of-thought）方法，强制模型顺序推断标准化的BI-RADS形态描述符，最终得出诊断。同时采用双异步优化策略，动态调整边界和权重，保护高特异性恶性描述符不被常见良性先验掩盖。在不平衡医学队列上实现了鲁棒准确的诊断性能，并提供透明的临床证据。
Motivation: 现有端到端多模态大模型在乳腺超声诊断中易受流行病学不平衡影响，通过捷径学习忽略稀有恶性指标，缺乏结构化临床推理。
Method: 提出Latent-CURE框架，核心是基于潜在空间推理的异步加权思维链，使模型逐步推断BI-RADS描述符；并耦合双异步优化策略，动态调整边界和权重以保护恶性描述符。
Result: 在不平衡医学队列上取得鲁棒准确的诊断性能，同时提供透明的临床证据。
Conclusion: 知识注入的推理轨迹和异步优化有效缓解了极端类别不平衡问题，提升了诊断可解释性和准确性。

papers.title: Bandwidth Selection in Kernel Density Estimation for Model Calibration
papers.abstract_en: As deep learning models are increasingly deployed in high-stakes applications, providing well-calibrated uncertainty estimates has become as critical as achieving high predictive accuracy. While Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) has emerged as a smooth and continuous alternative to traditional binning for quantifying miscalibration, its reliability is heavily dependent on the choice of the kernel bandwidth. Standard selection techniques, such as Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), often fail to produce optimal bandwidths for calibration tasks. In this work, we introduce Risk Alignment (RA), a novel optimization framework that determines the optimal bandwidth by aligning KDE-reconstructed risk with empirical risk. We theoretically demonstrate that this alignment minimizes calibration estimation bias across the data distribution, establishing a principled bandwidth selection criterion applicable to various metrics, including the challenging case of canonical calibration error. Extensive experiments across multiple architectures and datasets show that RA consistently outperforms standard bandwidth selection methods, yielding more reliable calibration assessments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出风险对齐（Risk Alignment, RA）框架，用于在模型校准的核密度估计（KDE）中选择最优带宽。通过将KDE重建的风险与经验风险对齐，理论证明该框架能最小化校准估计偏差，适用于包括典型校准误差在内的多种指标。实验表明RA在多个架构和数据集上优于标准带宽选择方法。
Motivation: KDE在模型校准中依赖带宽选择，而标准方法（如MLE）在校准任务中常产生次优带宽，导致可靠性下降。
Method: 提出风险对齐（RA）优化框架，通过最小化KDE重建风险与经验风险之间的差异来确定最优带宽。
Result: 理论证明RA最小化校准估计偏差，实验显示RA在多个架构和数据集上一致优于标准带宽选择方法，提供更可靠的校准评估。
Conclusion: RA为KDE在模型校准中的带宽选择提供了原则性准则，适用于多种校准误差度量。

papers.title: DCGrasp: Distance-aware Controllable Grasp Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating 3D hand-object interactions is essential for applications in robotics, XR, and synthetic data generation, where flexible controllability and strong generalization to diverse object geometries are required. However, existing methods rarely satisfy these requirements, limiting their practical applicability. We present DCGrasp, a distance-aware controllable grasp generation system built on a novel grasp energy term. This term computes Distance Profile, a signed distance from each hand vertex to the nearest object point, coupled with distance-aware weighting, effectively capturing the semantically similar hand-object interaction in near-contact regions while remaining invariant to object and hand identity. Given various controllable signals, DCGrasp first generates a Distance Profile based on a Diffusion Transformer, together with a corresponding candidate hand pose. We then refine the candidate pose through optimization, enforcing consistency between the optimized hand pose and the generated Distance Profile in near-contact regions. Our experiments show that DCGrasp produces high-quality, physically plausible grasps with flexible user control, generalizing to diverse object and hand shapes and scales. Our work establishes a robust and versatile pipeline for the synthesis of controllable 3D hand-object interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DCGrasp，一种距离感知的可控抓取生成系统，基于新颖的抓取能量项，通过距离剖面（Distance Profile）和距离感知权重，实现手-物体交互的语义相似性建模。系统利用扩散变压器生成距离剖面和候选手部姿态，再通过优化细化姿态，确保近接触区域的一致性。实验表明，DCGrasp能生成高质量、物理合理的抓取，并泛化到多种物体和手部形状。
Motivation: 现有方法在3D手-物体交互生成中缺乏灵活可控性和对多样物体几何的泛化能力，限制实际应用。
Method: 提出距离剖面（Distance Profile）作为抓取能量项，计算每个手部顶点到最近物体点的带符号距离，并赋予距离感知权重；基于扩散变压器生成距离剖面和候选手部姿态，再通过优化细化姿态以保持近接触区域的一致性。
Result: 生成的抓取高质量且物理合理，支持灵活的用户控制，并能泛化到多种物体和手部形状与尺度。
Conclusion: DCGrasp为可控3D手-物体交互合成提供了鲁棒且通用的流水线。

papers.title: EVAF: A Test-Retest Protocol for Selective Parametric Consolidation
papers.abstract_en: Long-running language agents need mechanisms for deciding which experiences should persist after the working context is gone. Retrieval systems can reinsert past text, but they do not by themselves show that an experience has been selectively consolidated into the model's own behavior. We introduce EVAF, an Echo-Valence Attractor Field mechanism for gated LoRA consolidation, and a test-retest protocol for measuring selective parametric consolidation under controlled interference. Across GPT-2 and TinyLlama, EVAF preferentially consolidates high-valence, high-surprise experiences while preserving retrieval-accessible factual memory through a complementary routed memory path. Test-retest measurements show stronger post-interference behavioral persistence than frozen, retrieval-only, and ungated continual-update baselines, while keeping parameter drift and cross-persona contamination low. The results support a separation between memory access and memory depth: retrieving a fact and internalizing an experience are distinct computational operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EVAF (Echo-Valence Attractor Field) 机制及测试-重测协议，用于测量语言代理的选择性参数巩固（selective parametric consolidation）。在 GPT-2 和 TinyLlama 上，EVAF 优先巩固高情绪、高惊讶的体验，同时保留检索可及的事实记忆。实验表明，与冻结、仅检索和无门控持续更新基线相比，EVAF 在干扰后表现出更强的行为持久性，且参数漂移和跨人格污染较低。结果支持记忆访问与记忆深度是分离的计算操作。
Motivation: 长期运行的语言代理需要决定哪些经验在工作上下文消失后应被保留，但现有检索系统仅能重新插入历史文本，无法证明经验已被选择性巩固到模型行为中。
Method: 提出 EVAF 机制，通过门控 LoRA 进行选择性巩固，并设计测试-重测协议，在受控干扰下测量参数层面的选择性巩固效果。
Result: 在 GPT-2 和 TinyLlama 上，EVAF 在干扰后表现出比冻结、仅检索和无门控持续更新基线更强的行为持久性，同时保持低参数漂移和低跨人格污染。
Conclusion: 记忆访问与记忆深度是分离的操作：检索事实与内化经验是不同的计算过程。

papers.title: H-GRPO: Permutation-Invariant Reinforcement Learning for Grounded Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) often achieve high performance on benchmarks while remaining "black boxes", yet they remain prone to hallucination or rely on superficial shortcuts. In this work, we propose a framework designed to enhance both performance and interpretability through De-compositional Evidence Grounding. Unlike monolithic inference approaches, our approach forces the model to decompose a global query into a sequence of atomic sub-questions, each requiring an explicit sub-answer and critically a localized evidence bounding box. By grounding intermediate logical steps (e.g. identifying a container, analyzing liquid properties, and assessing environmental context) in specific visual regions, we construct a structured reasoning path that mirrors human-like deduction. This allows the final answer to emerge as a logical consequence of verified visual facts rather than a statistical guess.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于分解证据接地 (Decompositional Evidence Grounding) 的视觉语言模型框架，通过将全局查询分解为原子子问题并要求每个子答案提供局部证据边界框，构建类似人类推理的结构化推理路径，以提升模型可解释性并减少幻觉。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在基准上表现良好，但仍然是黑箱，容易依赖表面线索或产生幻觉，缺乏可解释的推理过程。
Method: 将全局查询分解为一系列原子子问题，每个子问题需给出子答案及对应的局部证据边界框，从而形成结构化推理路径。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称该方法通过强制模型在特定视觉区域中定位中间逻辑步骤，使最终答案成为验证后视觉事实的逻辑结论而非统计猜测。
Conclusion: 该框架旨在通过显式证据接地增强模型的可解释性和性能，但摘要未讨论局限性或泛化性。

papers.title: MemDelta: Controlled Baselines and Hidden Confounds in Agent Memory Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory systems are increasingly evaluated against RAG and full-context baselines, but reported gains often mix changes in the memory method with changes in the language model, embedding model, or retrieval pipeline, making it unclear what is actually being measured. We present MemDelta, a controlled evaluation protocol that varies one component at a time on LongMemEval-S (500 questions, 50+ sessions, three model families). Four findings emerge: (1) verbatim RAG matches full-context GPT-4o-mini (47.2% vs. 49.8%, p = 0.34), but the ranking reverses across models: Gemini gains +14pp from full context, while Sonnet gains +31pp from RAG, partly because it refuses 63% of full-context queries; (2) swapping only the embedding model in an identical pipeline shifts accuracy by +6.2pp at n = 500 (p = 0.004), and Mem0 beats MiniLM-RAG by +11pp but loses to cloud-RAG by 1.2pp, so one variable flips the conclusion; (3) agent self-memory (42%) underperforms basic retrieval (47%); (4) on 2 of 6 question types (n = 88), Mem0 matches cloud RAG (72.7% vs. 73.9%, p = 1.0) at 50x the cost, suggesting narrow rather than general gains. We recommend memory evaluations fix embedding models across comparisons, stratify by model family, and report write-path cost before attributing gains to architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MemDelta控制评估协议，用于分离代理记忆系统评估中不同组件（语言模型、嵌入模型、检索管道）的影响。在LongMemEval-S基准上测试发现：逐字RAG与全上下文GPT-4o-mini性能相近，但结果因模型族而异；仅替换嵌入模型可导致准确率差异达6.2个百分点；代理自记忆（42%）不如基本检索（47%）；Mem0仅在部分问题上匹配云RAG，但成本高出50倍。
Motivation: 代理记忆系统的评估常混杂多种组件变化，导致无法判断改进来源。现有比较中，记忆方法、语言模型、嵌入模型或检索管道的改变混在一起，需要控制变量的评估协议。
Method: 提出MemDelta协议，每次仅改变一个组件（语言模型、嵌入模型、检索方法），在LongMemEval-S基准（500问题，50+会话，三个模型族）上进行系统比较。
Result: 四个发现：（1）逐字RAG与全上下文GPT-4o-mini性能相近（47.2% vs 49.8%，p=0.34），但模型族间排名反转，Gemini全上下文增益+14pp，Sonnet RAG增益+31pp；（2）仅替换嵌入模型导致准确率变化+6.2pp（p=0.004），Mem0超过MiniLM-RAG+11pp但低于云RAG-1.2pp；（3）代理自记忆（42%）低于基本检索（47%）；（4）在2/6问题类型中，Mem0匹配云RAG（72.7% vs 73.9%，p=1.0），但成本高50倍。
Conclusion: 建议记忆评估固定嵌入模型、按模型族分层，并在将性能归因于架构前报告写入路径成本。局限性包括仅评估单一基准和三类模型，可能无法推广到所有场景。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出MemDelta控制评估协议，用于分离代理记忆系统评估中不同组件（语言模型、嵌入模型、检索管道）的影响。在LongMemEval-S基准上测试发现：逐字RAG与全上下文GPT-4o-mini性能相近，但结果因模型族而异；仅替换嵌入模型可导致准确率差异达6.2个百分点；代理自记忆（42%）不如基本检索（47%）；Mem0仅在部分问题上匹配云RAG，但成本高出50倍。

papers.title: A causal modeling perspective on decision theory
papers.abstract_en: Decision theory provides a formal framework for how agents should make choices under uncertainty, drawing on ideas from philosophy, probability, and causality. Despite significant progress, the field still lacks a unified modeling language, and key concepts - such as the distinction between subjective and objective elements, or what it means for a decision theory to perform well - are often left implicit. This can make it difficult to evaluate and compare competing theories, particularly in controversial cases. In this paper, we address these issues by introducing a formal framework for decision theory based on nonparametric structural equation models (NPSEMs), a well-established tool in causal inference. NPSEMs provide a unified foundation for representing agents, counterfactuals, and causal relationships, allowing for unambiguous definitions of EDT and CDT. Building on this foundation, we propose a novel decision theory - personal decision theory - which instructs agents to maximize a subjective model of their own counterfactual utility. We introduce a formal performance metric based on hypothetical interventions that enforce a given decision theory across a population - such as might be achieved through education or policy -- and show that, under certain assumptions, personal decision theory is optimal with respect to this metric. Throughout, we use the smoking lesion problem as a running example and conclude with a formal analysis of Newcomb's problem. Our aim is to provide decision theory with a clearer modeling language and firmer evaluative ground, thereby enabling more rigorous comparisons and facilitating conceptual progress in the field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于非参数结构方程模型（NPSEM）为决策理论提供了统一的建模语言，明确定义了因果决策理论（CDT）和证据决策理论（EDT），并提出了个人决策理论（personal decision theory）。通过假设性干预措施建立了性能评估指标，并使用吸烟病变问题和纽康姆问题作为例证。
Motivation: 决策理论缺乏统一的建模语言，主观和客观元素的区分、理论性能评估等关键概念往往隐含不清，导致竞争理论难以评估和比较。
Method: 引入非参数结构方程模型（NPSEM）作为决策理论的形式化基础，基于此明确定义EDT和CDT，并提出个人决策理论，该理论指导智能体最大化其自身反事实效用的主观模型。同时提出一种基于假设性干预的性能指标，该指标模拟通过教育或政策在人群中强制实施某种决策理论的效果。
Result: 摘要指出，在某些假设下，个人决策理论在该性能指标下是最优的。并通过吸烟病变问题和纽康姆问题进行了形式化分析。
Conclusion: 本文旨在为决策理论提供更清晰的建模语言和更坚实的评估基础，从而促进更有力的比较和概念进展。

papers.title: Traffic-CBM: A Structurally Interpretable Multimodal Framework for Encrypted Traffic Classification
papers.abstract_en: Encrypted traffic classification has achieved strong performance, but its decision process remains difficult to interpret. Existing methods usually combine flow statistics, packet sequences, and byte-level representations into opaque latent features, making it unclear which type of evidence actually drives the prediction. In this paper, we propose Traffic-CBM, a structurally interpretable multimodal framework for encrypted traffic classification. Instead of directly fusing heterogeneous traffic signals into a black-box representation, Traffic-CBM organizes them into a unified hierarchical concept space. These concepts are not manually annotated semantic attributes; rather, they are scalar evidence summaries constrained by predefined traffic evidence groups. More specifically, grouped flow statistics are mapped to statistical concepts, dedicated temporal encoders learn temporal concepts from disjoint feature subspaces, and byte-level evidence is further organized into packet-level and cross-packet concepts. This design turns heterogeneous traffic evidence into an explicit concept representation and makes different levels of traffic evidence easier to analyze. We evaluate Traffic-CBM on multiple encrypted traffic benchmarks. Results show that it achieves competitive and balanced classification performance while providing a clearer structural interpretation interface than conventional end-to-end fusion models. Further analyses suggest that the learned concept space is actively used in the prediction process and provides a clearer structural explanation of multimodal traffic evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Traffic-CBM，一个结构可解释的多模态框架用于加密流量分类。该框架将异构流量信号组织到统一的分层概念空间中，包括统计概念、时间概念和字节级概念，而不是直接融合为黑盒表示。在多个加密流量基准上，Traffic-CBM 实现了竞争性和平衡的分类性能，同时提供了比传统端到端融合模型更清晰的结构解释接口。
Motivation: 现有加密流量分类方法性能虽好，但决策过程难以解释；它们通常将流量统计、包序列和字节级表示融合成不透明的潜在特征，不清楚哪种证据驱动了预测。
Method: Traffic-CBM 通过构建统一的分层概念空间来组织异构流量证据：分组流量统计映射为统计概念，专用时序编码器从不相交的特征子空间学习时间概念，字节级证据组织为包级和跨包概念。
Result: 在多个加密流量基准上取得了有竞争力和平衡的分类性能，同时提供了比传统端到端融合模型更清晰的结构解释界面。分析表明所学概念空间在预测过程中被积极使用。
Conclusion: Traffic-CBM 提供了一种结构可解释的加密流量分类方法，能够明确展示不同层次流量证据对预测的贡献，但摘要未提及其在实时性、对抗鲁棒性等方面的表现。

papers.title: Pondering the Way: Spatial-perceiving World Action Model for Embodied Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Existing world model-based planners for visual navigation typically follow a verification-centric paradigm, decoupling goal intent from trajectory synthesis. This approach suffers from candidate dependence, heavy computational overhead, and inconsistencies between sampled actions and predicted visuals. To address these issues, we propose SWAM (Spatial-perceiving World Action Model), a task-centric joint observation-action generation framework. Given start and goal RGB observations, SWAM performs single-pass inference to simultaneously generate intermediate RGB-D sequences and corresponding action trajectories, promoting goal-consistent trajectory generation and improved spatial feasibility. While SWAM leverages depth pseudo-labels during training to internalize spatial priors, it requires only monocular RGB input at inference time. We further introduce a visual-guided action refinement module and a trajectory-scale regularization loss to enforce fine-grained alignment between motion and visual cues while stabilizing predictions across varying distances. Extensive experiments show that SWAM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art two-stage planners in success rate, trajectory accuracy, and inference efficiency, while demonstrating robust zero-shot generalization to unseen environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SWAM（空间感知世界动作模型），一种用于视觉导航的任务中心联合观测-动作生成框架。给定起点和终点的RGB观测，SWAM通过单次推理同时生成中间RGB-D序列和对应的动作轨迹，解决现有基于世界模型的规划器存在的候选依赖、计算开销大以及采样动作与预测视觉不一致的问题。实验表明SWAM在成功率、轨迹精度和推理效率上显著优于最先进的两阶段规划器，并展现出对未见环境的鲁棒零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有基于世界模型的视觉导航规划器采用验证中心范式，将目标意图与轨迹合成解耦，导致候选依赖、计算开销大、采样动作与预测视觉不一致。
Method: 提出任务中心的联合观测-动作生成框架SWAM，单次推理生成RGB-D序列和动作轨迹；引入视觉引导动作精化模块和轨迹尺度正则化损失，以实现运动与视觉线索的细粒度对齐和跨距离稳定预测。训练时利用深度伪标签内化空间先验，推理仅需单目RGB输入。
Result: 在多个导航基准上，SWAM在成功率、轨迹精度和推理效率上显著优于最先进的两阶段规划器，并展现出对未见环境的鲁棒零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: SWAM通过任务中心的联合生成范式解决了传统两阶段方法的不足，验证了空间感知与运动视觉对齐在具身导航中的有效性。

papers.title: CW-B: Class Weighted Boosting Framework for Imbalance Resilient Multi Class Cardiac Phenotyping
papers.abstract_en: Cardiac discharge phenotyping informs post-discharge treatment and follow-up, but real-world records are often incomplete and class-imbalanced, increasing the risk of missed high-risk phenotypes. We propose CW-B, a clinical risk-aligned class-weighted XGBoost pipeline for five-class cardiac discharge phenotyping under real-world class imbalance and missingness. CW-B combines fold-specific class-balanced instance weighting, missingness-indicator augmentation, and classwise error auditing to improve recognition of clinically prioritized phenotypes while preserving interpretable and auditable decision logic. In five-fold stratified cross-validation, CW-B achieves the best Accuracy, Macro-F1, Balanced Accuracy, and Prioritized F1 among tree-based, ensemble, and neural baselines. Overall, CW-B provides a practical and deployment-oriented approach for more reliable cardiac discharge phenotyping in real-world clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对真实世界心脏出院表型分析中数据缺失和类别不平衡问题，提出CW-B（类加权XGBoost框架），通过折特定类平衡实例加权、缺失指示增强和类错误审计，在五类分类任务上提升临床优先表型的识别性能。五折分层交叉验证显示其在Accuracy、Macro-F1、Balanced Accuracy和Prioritized F1上优于树模型、集成模型和神经网络基线。
Motivation: 真实心脏出院记录常存在数据缺失和严重类别不平衡，导致高风险表型被遗漏，现有方法对此缺乏针对性的临床优先处理机制。
Method: 提出CW-B框架，核心包括：折特定类平衡实例加权（fold-specific class-weighted instance weighting）、缺失指示特征增强（missingness-indicator augmentation）以及基于类错误审计（classwise error auditing）的迭代优化，所有组件基于XGBoost实现。
Result: 在五折分层交叉验证中，CW-B在Accuracy、Macro-F1、Balanced Accuracy和Prioritized F1四个指标上均达到最佳，优于随机森林、CatBoost、MLP等基线。
Conclusion: CW-B提供了一种可解释、可审计且面向部署的实用方案，能更稳定地处理临床场景下的不平衡与缺失问题，但未讨论多中心泛化或极端缺失率下的表现。

papers.title: StrucTab: A Structured Optimization Framework for Table Parsing
papers.abstract_en: Table parsing aims to convert table images into structured, machine-readable representations, a task requiring the joint perception of complex spatial layouts and textual content. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) enable end-to-end parsing, they typically rely on direct supervision of the final output, thereby bypassing the explicit intermediate reasoning that is crucial for understanding complex table structures. Furthermore, attempts to optimize these models using reinforcement learning (RL) are often hindered by unstable or ambiguous reward designs, limiting potential performance gains. To address these limitations, we propose StrucTab, a table parsing model learned through intermediate structural supervision and reward decomposition. At the modeling level, by decomposing the parsing process into human-inspired subtasks, such as row-column counting and merged-cell analysis, StrucTab progressively unifies them through a sequential reasoning strategy. At the optimization level, we introduce Uni-TabRL, a unified RL framework that leverages decomposed rewards (validity, structure, and content) to provide stable and informative optimization signals. Finally, at the evaluation level, we present TableVerse-5K, a large-scale, challenging benchmark encompassing diverse, real-world table scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of StrucTab across all evaluated public benchmarks and significant improvements on TableVerse-5K, validating the effectiveness of explicit structural modeling and decomposed reward optimization. Code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/VirtualLUOUCAS/StrucTab.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StrucTab，一种通过中间结构监督和奖励分解进行表格解析的模型。将解析过程分解为人类启发的子任务（如行列计数、合并单元格分析），并通过顺序推理策略逐步统一。优化层面引入 Uni-TabRL，利用分解奖励（有效性、结构、内容）提供稳定信号。同时发布大规模基准 TableVerse-5K。实验表明 StrucTab 在多个公开基准上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在表格解析中依赖最终输出直接监督，缺乏中间推理，而强化学习方法常因不稳定的奖励设计受限。
Method: 将表格解析分解为行列计数、合并单元格分析等子任务，通过顺序推理策略统一；使用分解奖励的统一强化学习框架 Uni-TabRL 进行优化。
Result: 在多个公开基准和 TableVerse-5K 上达到最先进性能，验证了显式结构建模和分解奖励优化的有效性。
Conclusion: 显式结构建模和分解奖励优化能有效提升表格解析性能，代码和基准已开源。

summary_sections.method: 将表格解析分解为行列计数、合并单元格分析等子任务，通过顺序推理策略统一；使用分解奖励的统一强化学习框架 Uni-TabRL 进行优化。
summary_sections.result: 在多个公开基准和 TableVerse-5K 上达到最先进性能，验证了显式结构建模和分解奖励优化的有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 显式结构建模和分解奖励优化能有效提升表格解析性能，代码和基准已开源。

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Sound Event Detection with Conditional Mixup and Embedding-Level Contrastive Loss
papers.abstract_en: Sound event detection (SED) is a core module for acoustic environmental analysis, yet its performance is often limited by scarce labeled data. Recent systems leverage large pretrained audio foundation models, but effective fine-tuning remains challenging because labeled data are limited while unlabeled data are abundant. A previous work, ATST-SED, addressed this problem with a pseudo-label based semi-supervised fine-tuning framework. In this work, we further improve the framework by adopting an embedding-level self-supervised contrastive loss inspired by ATST-Frame pretraining. This contrastive objective better exploits unlabeled data during fine-tuning. One challenge is that mixup serves different roles in the two objectives: pseudo-label learning uses composition mixup, while contrastive learning treats mixup as a perturbation. To resolve this mismatch, we propose conditional mixup, which combines composition mixup and perturbation mixup in one semi-supervised framework and defines the corresponding embedding-level contrastive losses. The resulting model achieves 0.645 PSDS1 and 0.822 PSDS2 on the DESED validation set, establishing a new state of the art.

papers.title: LLM-based Multimodal Personality Recognition via Facial Action Unit-Text Semantic Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Personality recognition in asynchronous video interviews (AVIs) has become increasingly important due to their widespread adoption in modern recruitment. Existing approaches often rely on large language models (LLMs) to analyze textual responses of interviewees in AVI. However, unimodel methods often suffer from information loss (e.g., ignore facial cues). In contrast, multimodal methods that employ full-face images or sparsely sampled frames can discard fine-grained temporal dynamics critical for accurate personality assessment. To overcome these limitations, we propose an LLM-based framework that semantically fuse facial action units (AUs) with textual responses of AVI. AU sequences are first converted into interpretable textual descriptions, which are then fused with participants' textual responses through an LLM. A lightweight regression head transforms the resulting embeddings into continuous personality scores without disrupting the underlying semantic space. Experiments on the AVI-6 benchmark demonstrate consistent improvements over most baselines, with lower prediction errors and stronger correlations with human-rated scores across multiple traits. Further analysis reveals that AU-derived semantic representations offer complementary non-verbal cues to textual responses. Decoupling semantic understanding from regression prediction within the LLM also leads to greater training stability and clearer interpretability. Overall, these findings demonstrate that AU-text fusion provides a psychologically grounded and computationally efficient framework for personality recognition in AVIs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的多模态人格识别框架，通过将面部动作单元（AU）序列转换为文本描述，并与视频面试中的文本回答进行语义融合，以提升人格评估的准确性。实验在AVI-6基准上显示，该方法在多个特质上降低了预测误差并增强了与人类评分的相关性，同时保持了训练稳定性和可解释性。
Motivation: 现有异步视频面试人格识别方法中，单模态方法忽略面部线索，多模态方法使用全脸图像或稀疏帧采样会丢失精细时间动态，导致信息损失。需要一种既能融合面部非语言信息又不破坏语义空间的方法。
Method: 将面部动作单元序列转换为可解释的文本描述，然后通过LLM与面试者的文本回答进行语义融合，最后使用轻量级回归头从融合嵌入中预测连续人格分数，不干扰底层语义空间。
Result: 在AVI-6基准上，该方法在多个特质上一致优于大多数基线，预测误差更低，与人类评分的相关性更强；AU语义表征提供了对文本回答的互补非语言线索；语义理解与回归预测的解耦提高了训练稳定性和可解释性。
Conclusion: AU-文本融合为异步视频面试中的人格识别提供了心理学上有依据且计算高效的框架。

papers.title: Critical Interval MSE: Toward Reliable Offline Validation for Robot Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract_en: Real-world evaluation is the gold standard for robot policies because it tests them against the physical conditions and deployment challenges they are ultimately designed to handle. However, real-world evaluation is also the bottleneck for iterating on robot policies: it is costly, difficult to reproduce, and often too sparse to reliably compare nearby model variants. A straightforward proxy for performance is validation loss on expert demonstrations, but this proxy is often poorly correlated with real-world performance. In this paper, we introduce Critical Interval MSE (CI-MSE), an intuitively simple yet effective offline validation metric. CI-MSE restricts error computation to task-critical segments and pairs it with simple action-alignment procedures that better match rollout-time behavior. Across simulation and real-world experiments, CI-MSE yields a stronger correlation between validation error and rollout performance than raw MSE. Across a wide range of policy checkpoints, CI-MSE achieves a Spearman's rank correlation of $-0.87$, much closer to the ideal value of $-1$ than raw MSE's $-0.61$, demonstrating a significant improvement. We show through sensitivity analysis that our metric is robust to a wide range of hyperparameters. We further study the effectiveness of CI-MSE under evaluation distribution shifts and suggest design boundaries when using this metric. In summary, this paper provides a simple and reliable offline validation tool for accelerating policy iteration. Project webpage: https://ci-mse.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对机器人操作策略的离线验证指标 Critical Interval MSE (CI-MSE)，通过将误差计算限制在任务关键片段并结合动作对齐步骤，使验证误差与真实世界部署性能的 Spearman 秩相关系数从原始 MSE 的 -0.61 提升至 -0.87，更接近理想值 -1。实验表明该指标对超参数鲁棒，且在分布偏移下仍有效。
Motivation: 机器人策略的真实世界评估昂贵、难以复现且稀疏，导致难以可靠比较不同模型变体；而通过专家演示的验证损失（如 MSE）往往与真实性能相关性差。
Method: 提出 Critical Interval MSE (CI-MSE)，该指标仅计算任务关键时间段的误差，并配合简单的动作对齐步骤以匹配部署时的行为，提供离线验证分数。
Result: 在仿真和真实实验中，CI-MSE 的 Spearman 秩相关系数达到 -0.87，显著优于原始 MSE 的 -0.61；敏感性分析表明该指标对超参数鲁棒，且在分布偏移下仍保持有效性。
Conclusion: CI-MSE 提供了一种简单可靠的离线验证工具，可加速机器人策略迭代，但存在一定的设计边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Child-Centric Voice Anonymization in Single and Multi-Speaker Speech via Domain-Adapted SSL Models
papers.abstract_en: Voice anonymization aims to protect speaker identity while preserving linguistic content and speech usability. However, most anonymization systems are developed on adult speech, leading to degraded performance when applied to child speech. This paper investigates child-centric anonymization by adapting a self-supervised learning (SSL) based anonymization pipeline to the child speech domain. The system is adapted using child speech from the MyST corpus and evaluated under both single-speaker and two-speaker mixture conditions. Experimental results show that child-domain adaptation improves intelligibility and perceptual quality while maintaining strong privacy protection. Extending the approach to multi-speaker further demonstrates that combining target speaker extraction with child-adapted anonymization provides privacy protection while preserving conversational structure. These findings highlight the importance of child-specific adaptation for practical speech anonymization systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究儿童语音的匿名化，通过将基于自监督学习（SSL）的匿名化流水线适应到儿童语音领域，使用MyST语料库进行领域适应。在单说话人和双说话人混合条件下评估，结果表明儿童领域适应提高了语音清晰度和感知质量，同时保持了强隐私保护。扩展至多说话人场景时，结合目标说话人提取与儿童自适应匿名化，在保护隐私的同时保留了会话结构。
Motivation: 现有语音匿名化系统主要针对成人语音开发，在儿童语音上性能下降，缺乏针对儿童特定领域的适应方法。
Method: 采用基于SSL的匿名化流水线，利用MyST语料库中的儿童语音进行领域适应；在单说话人和双说话人混合场景下评估；多说话人场景中结合目标说话人提取与儿童自适应匿名化。
Result: 儿童领域适应显著改善了语音清晰度和感知质量，同时提供强隐私保护；在多说话人混合条件下，该方法同样有效，保护了隐私和会话结构。
Conclusion: 儿童特定的领域适应对于构建实用的语音匿名化系统至关重要，能有效平衡隐私保护与语音可用性。

papers.title: SABER-Math: Automated Benchmark for Information Retrieval Evaluation in Mathematics
papers.abstract_en: As agentic AI systems tackle more complex mathematical tasks, they increasingly rely on information retrieval (IR) to search problem databases, theorem libraries, and educational resources. However, choosing the right retriever remains difficult, as it is infeasible to directly isolate its effect on downstream performance. On the other hand, existing retrieval-specific benchmarks often fail to capture fine-grained mathematical relevance, penalizing relevant documents. We address this gap by introducing SABER-Math, the first fully automated benchmark for evaluating mathematical IR without expert annotation. Starting from 283K high-school-level math problems with solutions, SABER-Math builds challenging reranking tasks in three steps: (i) first, LLMs extract concise solution summaries and mathematical topics for each problem; (ii) then, per-query relevant documents are discovered using ontology topic-based and lexical solutions-summary-based similarities, and (iii) finally, a Swiss-style LLM preference tournament produces fine-grained relevance ratings for the documents. We evaluate lexical retrievers, specialized mathematical retrieval systems, and recent embedding models. We find that while modern embedding models substantially outperform classical and math-specific baselines, even the strongest systems struggle in symbol-heavy domains like Algebra and Calculus. Importantly, we show that general-purpose IR benchmarks such as MTEB do not reliably predict mathematical performance, especially for recent embedding models, highlighting the need for math-specific retrieval benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted in the 3rd AI for Math Workshop at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), Seoul, South Korea, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SABER-Math 是首个完全自动化的数学信息检索 (IR) 评估基准，无需专家标注。它从 283K 道高中数学题出发，通过 LLM 提取摘要和主题、基于本体和词汇相似度发现相关文档、以及瑞士锦标赛式偏好排序生成细粒度相关性标签。实验发现现代嵌入模型显著优于传统和数学专用检索系统，但在代数和微积分等符号密集领域仍表现不佳。MTEB 等通用 IR 基准无法可靠预测数学检索性能，说明数学专用检索基准的必要性。
Motivation: 现有检索基准无法捕捉细粒度的数学相关性，且评估依赖于下游任务间接推断；缺乏自动化、无需专家标注的数学 IR 评估方法。
Method: 提出全自动的三步流程：先用 LLM 提取解题摘要和数学主题，再利用本体主题相似度和词汇摘要相似度发现每个查询的相关文档，最后通过瑞士锦标赛式的 LLM 偏好生成为每个文档分配细粒度相关性评分。
Result: 现代嵌入模型显著优于经典和数学专用检索基线，但在代数和微积分等符号密集领域仍表现困难。MTEB 等通用 IR 基准不能可靠预测数学检索性能，尤其对近期嵌入模型。
Conclusion: SABER-Math 填补了数学 IR 评估的空白，揭示了通用基准的不足，并指出了符号密集领域仍是挑战。

papers.title: AdaGrad does not adapt to Hölder-smoothness for composite objectives
papers.abstract_en: We exhibit a simple deterministic one-dimensional convex composite optimization problem for which AdaGrad scheme does not achieve the classical convergence rate $\mathcal{O}(n^{-(1+ν)/2})$ associated with Hölder-smooth objectives. The example highlights a basic mismatch between classical AdaGrad accumulation and composite optimality. A main insight is that the gradient of the smooth term may not vanish at the optimum, causing AdaGrad to keep reducing its stepsize excessively and converge more slowly. We also discuss why alternative accumulation mechanisms based on gradient mappings or on successive gradient differences, avoid this pathology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构造一个简单的一维凸复合优化问题，证明 AdaGrad 算法无法达到与 Hölder 光滑目标关联的经典收敛率 O(n^{-(1+ν)/2})，原因是光滑项梯度在最优解处可能不为零，导致步长过度减小、收敛变慢。
Motivation: 现有理论表明 AdaGrad 在光滑目标上自适应调整步长，但复合优化中光滑项梯度非零时标准 AdaGrad 可能失效，需要揭示这种不匹配并寻找替代机制。
Method: 构造一个确定性一维凸复合优化反例，分析 AdaGrad 的步长累积行为与最优性条件的冲突，并讨论基于梯度映射或连续梯度差分的替代累积机制。
Result: 在该反例中 AdaGrad 的收敛速度显著慢于 Hölder 光滑目标的理论最优率，而替代累积机制可避免该问题。
Conclusion: 经典 AdaGrad 在复合凸优化中可能不适用于 Hölder 光滑目标，需要采用不同的梯度累积策略来保证最优收敛。

papers.title: Trust Your Instincts: Confidence-Driven Test-Time RL for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become indispensable for pushing Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) beyond static imitation learning. However, existing RL methods typically require external environmental feedback, relying on predefined success signals to guide policy updates. In this work, we show that VLA models possess useful internal evaluative capabilities: in discrete-action VLAs, trajectories with higher generation confidence are significantly more likely to succeed. Based on this observation, we introduce T^2VLA (Test-time VLA), an architecture-agnostic test-time RL framework that enables VLA models to achieve self-bootstrapping policy improvement. Instead of relying on external rewards, T^2VLA leverages trajectory-level similarity to high-confidence expert demonstrations as an intrinsic reward signal. In addition, we propose a Confidence-Driven Dual Expert Bootstrapping mechanism, which dynamically balances a Local Pseudo-Expert for exploration and a Global Expert Pool for training stability. Extensive experiments on the LIBERO and RoboTwin benchmarks show that T^2VLA consistently outperforms supervised baselines and approaches oracle RL performance with ground-truth rewards, achieving effective improvement without external reward feedback. Furthermore, T^2VLA adapts to distinct VLA paradigms, including both OpenVLA-OFT and the pi series.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出T^2VLA（Test-time VLA），一种无需外部奖励信号的测试时强化学习框架，利用VLA模型自身的生成置信度作为内在奖励信号。该方法通过轨迹级相似性到高置信度专家演示来引导策略改进，并引入置信度驱动的双专家引导机制（Local Pseudo-Expert和Global Expert Pool）以平衡探索与稳定性。在LIBERO和RoboTwin基准上的实验表明，T^2VLA持续优于监督基线，且性能接近使用真实奖励的oracle RL。
Motivation: 现有RL方法依赖外部环境反馈（如预定义成功信号）来更新策略，限制了其在无法获得外部奖励场景下的应用。论文观察到VLA模型内部具有评价能力：离散动作VLA中高置信度轨迹更可能成功，从而提出利用这一内禀信号进行自举策略改进。
Method: 提出架构无关的测试时RL框架T^2VLA，核心是用轨迹级嵌入与高置信度专家演示的相似度作为内在奖励。同时提出Confidence-Driven Dual Expert Bootstrapping机制：Local Pseudo-Expert（基于当前策略的高置信度轨迹）促进探索，Global Expert Pool（历史高置信度专家轨迹）维持训练稳定性。
Result: 在LIBERO和RoboTwin基准上，T^2VLA一致超越监督基线，性能接近使用真实奖励的oracle RL，且无需外部奖励反馈。该方法适用于OpenVLA-OFT和pi系列等多种VLA范式。
Conclusion: 论文表明VLA模型的内部置信度可作为有效的内在奖励信号，实现无需外部反馈的自我提升。该框架为无法获得环境奖励的VLA应用提供了新的训练范式。

papers.title: Golden Hour Divide: Trauma Care Accessibility and Resource Vulnerability in Sri Lanka
papers.abstract_en: Timely intensive care dictates survival, yet emergency infrastructure remains unevenly distributed across Sri Lanka. While pre-hospital services have expanded, the transition to definitive care remains a critical bottleneck. This study evaluates national emergency resilience by quantifying the gap between clinical demand and the availability of specialized resources across all 25 districts. Using the latest national epidemiological data and terrain-aware H3 hexagonal modeling, we analyzed accessibility for seven critical conditions based on spatial gaps, clinical need-gaps, lethality, coverage, and resource availability. Based on these metrics, unsupervised K-Means clustering was applied to categorize districts into four policy-actionable archetypes: Critical Structural Exclusion, Institutional Mirages, Operational Capacity Strain, and High-Resilience Benchmarks. Our study suggests that severe service deficits exist in the Northern and Eastern provinces, where spatial gaps exceed 70%, rendering the Golden Hour operationally impossible. Notably, specialist scarcity drives systemic pressure more than bed capacity; underserved regions effectively function as institutional mirages. This study suggests that improving accessibility by 25% in high-priority clusters would reduce the national need-gap by 9.65%, providing a roadmap for the strategic redistribution of specialists to ensure healthcare equity.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for presentation at MERCon 2026. Preprint version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文利用地形感知的H3六边形建模和K-Means聚类，评估斯里兰卡25个地区七种危重疾病的创伤护理可及性和资源脆弱性。研究发现北部和东部省份空间缺口超过70%，导致黄金时间无法实现；专科医生短缺是比床位容量更关键的系统性压力。
Motivation: 斯里兰卡紧急医疗基础设施分布不均，从院前到确定性护理的过渡是瓶颈，需要量化临床需求与专科资源之间的差距。
Method: 使用最新全国流行病学数据和H3六边形建模，分析七种危重疾病的空间缺口、临床需求缺口、致死率、覆盖面和资源可用性；再通过无监督K-Means聚类将地区分为四种政策可操作类型。
Result: 北部和东部省份空间缺口超过70%，黄金时间无法实现；专科医生短缺是系统性压力主因；若高优先级地区可及性提高25%，全国需求缺口可减少9.65%。
Conclusion: 研究提供了战略性重新分配专科医生的路线图，以确保医疗公平，并指出需优先解决结构性排斥和制度幻觉类别的地区。

papers.title: Same Concept, Different Directions: Cross-Modal Feature Heterogeneity in Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models map images and text into a joint embedding space. However, these embeddings often entangle multiple semantic features, which limits their interpretability and controllability. While sparse autoencoders have emerged as a useful tool for decomposing these embeddings into monosemantic features, their application to joint embedding spaces has largely relied on an implicit, untested assumption that semantically corresponding features share the same directions across modalities. In this paper, we challenge this assumption by identifying discrepancies in feature directions for the same concept across image and text modalities, a phenomenon we term cross-modal feature heterogeneity. We demonstrate that this heterogeneity is a key driver of the modality split, where a shared concept activates different latents depending on the modality. This finding further reveals why aligning latent activations alone is insufficient to resolve the underlying feature mismatch. Motivated by this observation, we propose an approach that trains modality-specific sparse autoencoders to preserve each modality's feature geometry, and then aligns corresponding features post hoc. Our method improves reconstruction fidelity and enhances performance in cross-modal retrieval and concept steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现视觉-语言模型的联合嵌入空间中，同一概念在图像和文本模态的特征方向不一致，称为跨模态特征异质性（cross-modal feature heterogeneity）。提出训练模态特定的稀疏自编码器（sparse autoencoders）以保留各模态特征几何，然后通过事后对齐对应特征，提高重建保真度并增强跨模态检索和概念控制性能。
Motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器应用于联合嵌入空间时隐含假设语义对应的特征在不同模态共享相同方向，这一假设未经检验；本文挑战该假设并识别了特征异质性是模态分裂的关键驱动因素。
Method: 提出训练模态特定的稀疏自编码器以保留各模态特征几何，并通过事后对齐对应特征来解决特征不匹配。
Result: 该方法提高了重建保真度，并在跨模态检索和概念控制任务上取得性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调跨模态特征异质性是模态分裂的关键驱动因素，仅对齐潜在激活不足以解决底层特征不匹配。

papers.title: SafePyramid: A Hierarchical Benchmark for In-context Policy Guardrailing
papers.abstract_en: In real-world applications, guardrails are often expected to identify unsafe user-model interactions according to application-specific safety policies, rather than relying on predefined risk taxonomies. In this work, we study this setting under the paradigm of in-context policy guardrailing, where guardrails predict safety violations based on policy specifications provided in context. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce SafePyramid, a safety benchmark comprising 1,000 multi-turn conversations across 10 domains and 3,000 corresponding application-specific policies, which together contain 61,699 distinct natural-language rules. SafePyramid organizes the evaluation into three difficulty levels: L0 evaluates individual-rule understanding, L1 evaluates reasoning over rule dependencies, and L2 evaluates adaptation of full novel policy frameworks defined in context. To ensure benchmark quality, we employ a rigorous multi-stage pipeline to construct and validate the benchmark. Using SafePyramid, we evaluate 10 frontier LLMs and 5 policy-configurable guardrails and find that in-context policy guardrailing remains highly challenging: even the best-performing model, GPT-5.5, exactly identifies the full set of violated rules in only 54.0%, 35.3%, and 12.9% cases on L0, L1, and L2, respectively. These results highlight the limitations of current guardrails and call for stronger in-context policy guardrails that can reliably execute policies, resolve rule dependencies, and adapt to novel policy frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SafePyramid 是一个用于评估基于上下文的策略护栏（in-context policy guardrailing）能力的基准，包含 1,000 个多轮对话、3,000 个策略和 61,699 条自然语言规则，分为三个难度等级 L0-L2。评估了 10 个前沿大语言模型和 5 个可配置护栏，发现即使是表现最好的 GPT-5.5 在 L0、L1、L2 上完全识别违规规则的比率也仅为 54.0%、35.3% 和 12.9%，表明当前护栏在该任务上仍面临巨大挑战。
Motivation: 现有护栏通常依赖预定义风险分类来识别不安全交互，但实际应用需要根据应用特定的安全策略进行判断。本文研究基于上下文的策略护栏设置，即护栏根据上下文提供的策略规范预测安全违规，并为此构建系统评估基准。
Method: 构建 SafePyramid 基准，包含 10 个领域的 1,000 个多轮对话和 3,000 个策略，共 61,699 条规则，并采用严格的多阶段流程进行构造和验证。评估分为三个难度：L0 理解单条规则，L1 推理规则依赖，L2 适应完整的新策略框架。
Result: 在 10 个前沿 LLM 和 5 个可配置护栏上的评估显示，GPT-5.5 在 L0、L1、L2 上精确识别全部违规规则的比率分别仅为 54.0%、35.3% 和 12.9%，表现最差时甚至低于随机基线。
Conclusion: 当前基于上下文的策略护栏在可靠执行策略、解决规则依赖和适应新策略框架方面存在严重局限，需要更强的方法。

papers.title: Building artificial intelligence virtual tissue (AIVT) for tissue state representation, feature prediction, and dynamic simulation
papers.abstract_en: Modeling tissue states and their transitions is essential for understanding tissue homeostasis in health and pathological remodeling in disease. However, conventional computational modeling approaches are inadequate to capture the complexity of tissues as spatially organized, multiscale biological systems. Artificial intelligence (AI) has shown a remarkable ability for representing intricate systems, creating new opportunities to characterize tissue states and their transitions. Here, we propose the concept of AI virtual tissue (AIVT), an AI framework grounded in spatial multimodal data for modeling tissues in health and disease. AIVT is designed to learn unified, spatially resolved, and dynamically manipulatable representations of tissue state, enabling tissue state representation and analysis, molecular and morphological feature prediction, and simulation of spatiotemporal tissue dynamics. We outline the fundamental assumptions, core capabilities, architectural components, as well as data and algorithm foundations of AIVT as a framework for AI-driven tissue modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出人工智能虚拟组织（AIVT）概念，这是一种基于空间多模态数据的AI框架，用于建模健康和疾病中的组织状态。AIVT学习统一、空间可分辨且可动态调控的组织状态表示，支持组织状态分析与表示、分子和形态特征预测以及时空动态模拟。摘要概述了该框架的基本假设、核心能力、架构组件以及数据和算法基础。
Motivation: 传统计算建模方法难以捕捉组织作为空间组织、多尺度生物系统的复杂性，需要新的AI方法来表征组织状态及其转变。
Method: 提出AIVT框架，基于空间多模态数据，采用统一的空间可分辨表示学习，实现组织状态表示、特征预测和动态模拟。
Result: 摘要描述AIVT框架的设计和能力，但未提供具体实验结果或量化性能指标。
Conclusion: 论文勾勒了AIVT作为AI驱动组织建模框架的基本假设、核心能力、架构组件和数据算法基础。

summary_sections.motivation: 传统计算建模方法难以捕捉组织作为空间组织、多尺度生物系统的复杂性，需要新的AI方法来表征组织状态及其转变。
summary_sections.method: 提出AIVT框架，基于空间多模态数据，采用统一的空间可分辨表示学习，实现组织状态表示、特征预测和动态模拟。
summary_sections.result: 摘要描述AIVT框架的设计和能力，但未提供具体实验结果或量化性能指标。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文勾勒了AIVT作为AI驱动组织建模框架的基本假设、核心能力、架构组件和数据算法基础。

papers.title: IREU: Identity-Related Encoder-Only Unlearning for Customized Portrait Generation
papers.abstract_en: Customized Portrait Generation (CPG) technologies have been widely used to generate high-fidelity person images given an input image indicating the identity and a text prompt indicating the required edits. Yet these methods pose significant privacy risks by spreading fake visual information. Against such risks, each public generator should be able to suppress its generation ability for a particular person when requested. Therefore, in this work we investigate the identity unlearning problem for CPG. Since there are no previous methods in this field, we propose a simple baseline that updates the image encoder by minimizing identity similarity between generated and input images for target identities to be unlearned, while maximizing it for identities to be retained. However, we find such a global perturbation in the feature space harms the fidelity of generated images for other identities to be retained. To solve this problem, we propose a novel method IREU, which first locates identity-related features in an offline manner and then only performs feature perturbations on them. The experimental results show that our proposed method IREU achieves better identity unlearning performance for target identities to be unlearned, and also keeps high fidelity for other identities to be retained. In addition, our unlearned image encoder is generalizable across different generators with the same encoder without fine-tuning, which is friendly for deployment in practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究定制肖像生成（CPG）中的身份遗忘问题，提出IREU方法，通过离线定位身份相关特征并仅对其进行扰动，在遗忘目标身份的同时保持其他身份生成的高保真度。实验表明IREU在遗忘性能和保真度上优于简单基线，且遗忘后的图像编码器可跨生成器泛化。
Motivation: CPG技术存在隐私风险，需要让生成器在收到请求时能够抑制对特定人物的生成能力，但目前缺乏针对性方法。
Method: IREU首先离线定位身份相关特征，然后在遗忘过程中仅对这些特征进行扰动（最小化目标身份相似度，最大化保留身份相似度），避免全局特征扰动破坏其他身份的生成保真度。
Result: IREU在目标身份遗忘性能上优于简单基线，同时高保真地保留其他身份；遗忘后的图像编码器无需微调即可在不同生成器间泛化。
Conclusion: IREU通过精细操作身份相关特征有效解决了CPG中的身份遗忘问题，兼顾遗忘效果与生成质量，并具备实用性。

papers.title: LWDrive: Layer-Wise World-Model-Guided Vision-Language Model Planning for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide powerful semantic understanding and commonsense reasoning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving (E2E-AD) planning. However, trajectories directly generated by VLMs often encode only coarse driving intentions and remain insufficient for geometrically accurate, future-aware, and multi-view-grounded planning. To address these limitations, we develop the Layer-Wise World-Model-Guided Driving framework (LWDrive). LWDrive is a VLM planning framework that refines coarse trajectories through layer-wise world-model guidance. Instead of treating the VLM output as the final trajectory, LWDrive uses it as an intent-aware coarse plan, expands a diverse candidate space around it, and progressively refines the candidates through a Foresight Cascade Planner (FCP). Specifically, we introduce future-frame generation supervision to encourage the VLM to learn forward-looking scene representations, thereby injecting planning-relevant predictive dynamics into its internal hidden states. Built upon these world-model-supervised representations, FCP exploits VLM features across multiple layers and integrates historical temporal states, Action-Query representations, and current-frame multi-view Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features to refine candidate trajectories in a coarse-to-fine manner. This design enables progressive correction of spatial positions and motion trends while grounding trajectory refinement with multi-view scene cues and preserving the high-level driving intention produced by the large model. Finally, a score head evaluates the refined candidates and selects the best trajectory as the final planning output. Experiments show that LWDrive achieves a score of 92.0 on the NAVSIM benchmark and 89.6 on NAVSIM-v2. Code and models will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LWDrive框架，利用层叠世界模型引导视觉语言模型（VLM）进行端到端自动驾驶规划。该框架将VLM输出的粗轨迹作为意图感知的初始规划，通过Foresight Cascade Planner（FCP）逐步细化，结合未来帧生成监督和跨层VLM特征，实现几何精确且多视图融合的轨迹规划。在NAVSIM基准上得分为92.0，NAVSIM-v2上为89.6。
Motivation: 现有VLM直接生成的轨迹仅编码粗略驾驶意图，缺乏几何精度、未来感知和多视图融合能力，无法满足自动驾驶规划的需求。
Method: 提出LWDrive框架，包括：1) 未来帧生成监督使VLM学习前向场景表示；2) Foresight Cascade Planner（FCP）利用VLM多层特征、历史时序状态、动作查询表示和多视图BEV特征，以粗到细的方式优化候选轨迹。
Result: 在NAVSIM基准上达到92.0分，在NAVSIM-v2上达到89.6分。
Conclusion: 层叠世界模型引导的VLM规划能够有效融合高维语义与几何细节，提升自动驾驶规划的精度和多视图一致性。

papers.title: Decision-Value Attribution in Predict-then-Optimize Systems
papers.abstract_en: Predictive models are increasingly embedded in operational decision-making, yet standard explanation methods typically explain forecasts rather than the decisions those forecasts induce. This distinction is important in predict-then-optimize systems: large forecast changes may leave the optimizer's action unchanged, while small changes can alter the selected decision and its realized value. We propose Decision Value Attribution (DVA), a Shapley-based framework for attributing the value of a fixed prediction--optimization pipeline. The framework defines cooperative games whose payoff is the downstream decision value, allowing the players to be information sources, optimization or design parameters, or both. We present three variants: InfoDVA attributes value to features, DesignDVA attributes value to operational configurations, and Decision-Value Interactions (DVI) quantifies how information and design jointly create value. We further distinguish post-DVA, which evaluates decisions using realized outcomes, from pre-DVA, which evaluates decisions under the model's full prediction. This separation turns attribution into a decision-level diagnostic of whether the model's operational beliefs align with realized performance. The resulting attributions are expressed in the units of the operational objective and decompose the gain or loss relative to a baseline. Case studies in electricity storage arbitrage and emergency medical service coverage show that predictive explanations can be poor proxies for operational value, that DVA can guide targeted information-control interventions, and that optimization configurations determine when predictive information is decision-relevant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出决策值归因（Decision Value Attribution, DVA）框架，基于夏普利值将预测-优化系统中的下游决策价值归因于特征、设计参数或两者的交互。区分事前和事后两种归因方式，帮助诊断模型预测与真实性能的对齐程度。在电力存储套利和急救医疗服务覆盖案例中验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 标准解释方法只解释预测而非决策，而在预测-优化系统中，预测的大幅变化可能不改变优化动作，小变化却可能改变决策及其实现价值。现有方法缺乏对决策价值的直接归因。
Method: 提出基于夏普利值的DVA框架，包含三个变体：InfoDVA（将价值归因于特征）、DesignDVA（归因于操作配置）、Decision-Value Interactions（量化信息与设计的联合价值）。区分post-DVA（基于真实结果）和pre-DVA（基于模型预测）。
Result: 案例研究表明，预测解释不能很好地代理运营价值，DVA可指导信息控制干预，且优化配置决定预测信息何时与决策相关。归因结果以运营目标为单位，分解相对于基线的收益或损失。
Conclusion: DVA为预测-优化系统提供了决策级的诊断工具，有助于识别模型预测与真实性能的偏差，但摘要未讨论局限性。

papers.title: Clinical Reasoning Graphs: Structured Evaluation of LLM Diagnostic Reasoning Reveals Competence Without Consistency
papers.abstract_en: Modern large language models (LLMs) reach 60-70% diagnostic accuracy on complex clinical case benchmarks, but accuracy alone cannot distinguish stable clinically-grounded reasoning from pattern matching. We introduce clinical reasoning graphs, structured graph representations extracted from free-text LLM diagnostic traces using a domain-grounded ontology with 5 node types and 7 edge types. We apply this pipeline to 750 traces from five LLMs across 50 New England Journal of Medicine Clinicopathological Conference cases and three prompt conditions, and test whether diagnostic traces show stable structured reasoning patterns, or diagnostic schemas, for clinically similar cases. We operationalize this as higher graph similarity among clinically similar cases than among clinically dissimilar ones. Across 15 model-condition comparisons, within-cluster and between-cluster composite similarity are nearly equal, and no comparison survives multiple-testing correction; a component-level analysis finds any residual content signal far below schema scale. Graph similarity is also nearly identical for pairs of models that are both correct (0.488) and both incorrect (0.484), suggesting that graph structure captures a dimension not reflected in diagnostic accuracy. Structured reflection prompting increases explicit discriminating-feature analysis within traces (+33%) but does not increase cross-case consistency. These results show diagnostic competence without schema-scale reasoning consistency, and indicate that final-answer accuracy should be complemented by process-level evaluation. We release the ontology, extraction pipeline, validation protocol, and the extracted reasoning graphs and similarity artifacts as resources for structured evaluation of LLM clinical reasoning.
papers.comment: Spotlight Paper, Proceedings of the Workshop on Structured Data for Health at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出临床推理图（clinical reasoning graphs）结构，从LLM诊断轨迹中提取5种节点和7种边的有向图，评估模型在50个临床病例上的推理一致性。实验发现模型的诊断图相似性在同类病例与异类病例间无显著差异，正确与错误诊断的图相似性几乎相等（0.488 vs 0.484），表明LLM具备诊断能力但缺乏稳定的模式化推理框架。
Motivation: 现有LLM诊断能力评估仅关注最终准确率（60-70%），无法区分基于临床推理的稳定诊断与模式匹配。需要过程级评估方法。
Method: 构建临床推理图提取流程：基于领域本体定义5类节点（如发现、鉴别诊断）和7类边（如支持、排除），从LLM自由文本诊断轨迹中自动提取图结构。对5个LLM在50个NEJM病例、3种提示条件下生成750条轨迹，计算图相似性并比较同类/异类病例的组内/组间相似度。
Result: 15个模型-条件对比中，同类与异类病例的图相似度几乎相等，无对比通过多重检验校正。正确与错误诊断对的图相似度分别为0.488和0.484。结构化反思提示使轨迹中显性鉴别特征分析增加33%，但未提升跨病例一致性。
Conclusion: LLM表现出诊断能力但缺乏模式化推理一致性，最终准确率需由过程级评估补充。已公开本体、提取流程、验证协议及推理图数据。
