papers.title: A Machine-Verified Proof of a Quantum-Optimization Conjecture
papers.abstract_en: We report a machine-verified resolution of a problem open for over a decade in quantum optimization: the Farhi, Goldstone and Gutmann (FGG) conjecture that depth-$p$ Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) on the ring of disagrees attains approximation ratio $(2p+1)/(2p+2)$ exactly. We found the proof using a large language model, Claude Fable 5, and verified its correctness end-to-end by the Lean 4 proof assistant. Our methodology includes several ingredients: building on a substantial Lean library of quantum information, we formalized the QAOA components and the known parts of the problem, and reduced the conjecture to a single open mathematical statement. The model was then handed the library and our agentic toolkit, and tasked with closing that gap by constructing a proof in Lean. The resulting process is a feedback loop between the model's natural-language reasoning and Lean's mechanical verification, which converged to a machine-verified proof. Human verification is required only for the structural scaffolding - that the formal statement faithfully encodes the intended claim - while the proof itself is supplied by the model and certified mechanically by Lean. The proof is nevertheless striking - the model uncovered a hidden dynamical symmetry of the problem and exploited it, borrowing tools and machinery from an adjacent field to turn a hard existence problem into an explicit construction. This work paves the way for resolving open conjectures in quantum information science and beyond.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了利用大语言模型 Claude Fable 5 和 Lean 4 证明辅助器，机器验证了量子优化中著名的 Farhi-Goldstone-Gutmann (FGG) 猜想：深度 p 的 QAOA 在不同意环 (ring of disagrees) 上达到精确近似比 (2p+1)/(2p+2)。证明过程通过自然语言推理与形式化验证的反馈循环完成，模型发现了隐藏的动力学对称性并借用邻近领域的工具。
Motivation: FGG 猜想在量子优化领域已开放十余年，验证其正确性有助于深入理解 QAOA 的能力边界。传统手动证明困难，需要借助自动化验证工具。
Method: 构建基于 Lean 的量子信息库，将猜想归约为单一的数学陈述；使用大语言模型代理工具包，让模型在 Lean 环境中交互式构造证明，形成自然语言推理与机械验证的反馈循环。
Result: 成功得到 Lean 4 验证的完整证明，模型通过发现隐藏的动力学对称性并借用邻近领域工具将存在性问题转化为显式构造。
Conclusion: 该方法有望推广至量子信息科学及其他领域的开放猜想证明，但人类仍需负责形式化陈述与猜想编码的准确性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 成功得到 Lean 4 验证的完整证明，模型通过发现隐藏的动力学对称性并借用邻近领域工具将存在性问题转化为显式构造。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法有望推广至量子信息科学及其他领域的开放猜想证明，但人类仍需负责形式化陈述与猜想编码的准确性。

papers.title: PoseShield: Neural Collision Fields for Human Self-Collision Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Self-collision remains a persistent challenge in SMPL-based human pose estimation and motion generation. Under extreme articulations or stochastic motion synthesis, generated meshes frequently exhibit self-penetrations, leading to physically implausible results. We propose PoseShield, a neural collision constraint defined directly in SMPL pose space. We formulate collision correction as a constrained optimization problem and connect the learned constraint with the Eikonal equation. Enforcing Eikonal regularization ensures non-vanishing gradients near the collision boundary, improving numerical stability and robustness of the optimization process. Unlike prior methods that operate in the mesh space or rely on heuristic penalties, our approach operates directly in the low-dimensional space of human poses and is theoretically grounded. The same learned constraint extends to human motion sequences, providing a generator-agnostic post-hoc collision corrector without retraining the underlying motion model. Experiments on a newly constructed SMPL pose benchmark show that our method achieves a 95.8% success rate and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PoseShield，一种直接在SMPL姿态空间定义的神经碰撞约束，用于解决人体自碰撞问题。方法将碰撞校正形式化为约束优化问题，并利用Eikonal正则化提高数值稳定性。在新构建的SMPL姿态基准上达到95.8%成功率，优于现有方法。
Motivation: SMPL人体姿态估计和运动生成中，极端姿态或随机运动合成常导致网格自穿透，产生物理上不合理的结果。现有方法在网格空间操作或依赖启发式惩罚，缺乏低维姿态空间的理论支撑。
Method: 在SMPL姿态空间直接定义神经碰撞场（Neural Collision Field），将碰撞校正转化为带约束的优化问题，并引入Eikonal方程的正则化项以保证碰撞边界附近梯度非零。
Result: 在作者构建的SMPL姿态基准上，方法达到95.8%的成功率，优于最先进的基线方法。
Conclusion: 该方法无需重新训练运动模型即可作为后验碰撞校正器，理论上有望扩展到人体运动序列，且由于在低维空间操作，优化稳定高效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CAREBench: A Child-Safety Risk Benchmark for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: How can we evaluate whether frontier AI systems recognize child-safety risks before they escalate into explicit harm? Existing child safety evaluations focus on child sexual abuse material, yet many child-safety failures begin earlier: in model assistance that helps adults manipulate, impersonate, profile, or isolate minors, and in model responses that deepen children's emotional dependence on AI systems rather than redirecting them toward human support. We introduce CAREBench (Child AI Risk Evaluation), a benchmark to assess such upstream child-safety risks in language models. CAREBench contains 500 prompts spanning twelve risk categories, including grooming and relationship engineering, deception and impersonation, surveillance and privacy, sextortion and sexual abuse, AI anthropomorphization, emotional dependency, and mental illness sensitivity. Developed with response annotations from parents and clinicians, the benchmark excludes explicit abuse material and imagery; instead, it evaluates whether models recognize, refuse, de-escalate, or redirect risky interactions before harm becomes overt. Evaluating seven frontier models on our benchmark, we find failure rates ranging from 2% to 58%, with failure patterns that vary across risk categories. CAREBench provides a responsibly scoped evaluation for LLM developers to identify and close gaps in child safety policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAREBench基准，用于评估语言模型在儿童安全风险早期（如操控、欺骗、情感依赖等）的识别与应对能力。基准包含500个提示，覆盖12个风险类别，由家长和临床医生标注。对7个前沿模型评估发现失败率从2%到58%不等。
Motivation: 现有儿童安全评估聚焦于儿童性虐待材料，但许多伤害始于模型帮助成人操控、模仿或隔离未成年人，或加深儿童情感依赖，缺乏对这类上游风险的评估。
Method: 构建CAREBench基准，包含500个提示，跨越12个风险类别（如引诱、欺骗、隐私侵犯等），由家长和临床医生提供响应标注，评估模型是否识别、拒绝、缓和或引导风险交互。
Result: 对7个前沿模型评估，失败率范围为2%至58%，不同风险类别失败模式各异。
Conclusion: CAREBench为LLM开发者提供了一个负责任范围的评估工具，用于识别和弥补儿童安全政策中的漏洞。

papers.title: Evolutionary Hyperparameter Optimization to Find Lightweight CNN Models for Autonomous Steering
papers.abstract_en: This research investigates the optimization of Convolutional and Dense Neural Networks (CNNs and DNNs) for autonomous steering using the (N+M) Evolution Strategy (ES) with the 1/5th success rule. The primary objective is to develop a lightweight CNN based model capable of real-time steering angle prediction, mimicking human driving behavior on predefined paths. The ES algorithm automates hyperparameter tuning, dynamically adjusting parameters such as filter sizes and layer configurations. Data collection encompasses driving scenarios recorded via the LTU ACTor autonomous driving platform, including variations in path direction and driving style. The very small dataset consists of timestamped images labeled with steering angles and pre-processed to focus on relevant visual information. Initial experiments involve training a baseline CNN model, which is then refined using ES to significantly reduce the size of the model while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy. The results highlight the viability of lightweight neural network architectures for real-time autonomous systems, striking a balance between computational efficiency and performance. This study not only advances research initiatives on the use of evolutionary algorithms for autonomous driving applications but also lays the foundation for the deployment of cost-effective and scalable solutions in self-driving technology.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted at 2025 IEEE International Conference on Electro Information Technology (eIT). Author-accepted manuscript. Final published version: https://doi.org/10.1109/eIT64391.2025.11103679
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用(N+M)进化策略（ES）和1/5成功规则优化卷积神经网络（CNN）和密集神经网络（DNN）的超参数，旨在为自主转向任务开发轻量级模型。在LTU ACTor平台采集的小数据集上，ES算法自动调整滤波器大小和层配置，将基线CNN模型显著压缩，同时保持可比的预测精度。结果表明，轻量级架构能够在实时自主系统中平衡计算效率与性能。
Motivation: 现有自主转向模型通常计算量较大，难以在资源受限的实时系统中部署。需要一种自动化方法发现轻量级CNN模型，在保持预测精度的同时降低模型复杂度，以支持低成本可扩展的自动驾驶方案。
Method: 采用(N+M)进化策略和1/5成功规则自动搜索超参数（如滤波器大小和层配置）。先训练基线CNN，再用ES迭代优化模型结构，目标是最小化模型尺寸同时维持转向角预测的准确性。
Result: ES优化后的模型尺寸相比基线显著减小，在自主转向任务上保持了有竞争力的预测精度，验证了轻量级网络在实时系统中的可行性。
Conclusion: 进化超参数优化能有效发现轻量级CNN架构，为实时自动驾驶中计算效率与性能的权衡提供了可行方案，为低成本可扩展的自驾技术奠定了基础。

papers.title: Sample-Efficient Learning of Probabilistic Causes for Reachability in Markov Decision Processes with Probabilistic Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic model checking for Markov decision processes (MDPs) provides quantitative guarantees, but often offers limited insight into why undesired outcomes occur. Probability-raising (PR) causality addresses this by identifying states whose visitation increases the probability of reaching designated states. Existing PR-cause identification methods, however, use MDP modifications not well-suited for learning: the gap between conditional and unconditional reachability probabilities can be hard to detect from transition samples, and construction requires reachability probabilities of the MDP, which are unavailable when transition probabilities are unknown. We study unknown MDPs and propose a learning approach with probabilistic guarantees for PR-cause identification. Our key ingredient is a restart-based MDP modification that reduces PR-cause checking to two conditional reachability queries without using reachability values of the original MDP. We prove correctness, establish sample-complexity bounds, and develop an anytime learning-and-checking algorithm based on two-sided value iteration that progressively classifies states as causal, non-causal, or undecided. Experiments on two benchmarks demonstrate reliable and fast identification of PR causes.
papers.comment: Accepted to UAI2026 as oral presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对未知转移概率的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），提出一种基于重启的MDP修改方法，将概率提升（PR）因果关系检查简化为两个条件可达性查询，无需原始MDP的可达性概率。作者证明了正确性，给出了样本复杂度界，并开发了一个基于两侧值迭代的任意时刻学习与检查算法，逐步将状态分类为因果、非因果或未定。在两个基准上的实验表明，该方法能可靠且快速地识别PR原因。
Motivation: 现有PR因果识别方法依赖MDP修改，不适合在转移概率未知时学习，因为条件与非条件可达性概率的差距难以从样本中检测，且需要已知的可达性概率。
Method: 提出一种重启式MDP修改，将PR原因检查转化为两个条件可达性查询；基于两侧值迭代设计任意时刻学习与检查算法，逐步分类状态。
Result: 摘要报告在基准实验中实现了可靠且快速的PR原因识别，并给出了样本复杂度理论保证。
Conclusion: 该方法适用于未知MDP的PR因果学习，但未提及在复杂高维系统上的扩展性。

papers.title: Learning as Observable Matrix Dynamics: Diffusive Relaxations versus Phase Transitions
papers.abstract_en: Observable Matrix Dynamics (OMD) is a diagnostic framework that probes the dynamics of high-dimensional internal representations of inputs by a neural network via a fixed-size $N \times N$ distance matrix $M(t)$ on a held set of $N$ inputs. OMD uses methods of random matrix theory and particle dynamics to explore spectral reorganisations that are missed by scalar loss functions, but are informative of the training process. We read $M(t)$ against a perturbative ambient-versus-latent decomposition extending the Bogomolny--Bohigas--Schmit (BBS) theory of random distance matrices, with per-snapshot diagnostics for the top-of-spectrum band structure and ambient noise, trajectory-level observables linking snapshots, and a 3D MDS embedding (bottom-three eigenvectors) rendering training as a moving particle cloud. Across seven experiments, diffusive regimes lack stable top-of-spectrum band structure, while sharp endogenous or externally driven reorganisations produce stable fingerprints: consistent with smooth or product latent geometries in BBS-adjacent cases, and with finite-cluster or Fourier-soliton structures otherwise. OMD thus reads the geometric regime of a representation rather than reporting a single intrinsic dimension.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可观测矩阵动力学（OMD）框架，通过固定大小距离矩阵探测神经网络高维内部表示的动态，使用随机矩阵理论和粒子动力学分析训练过程中的谱重组。实验表明扩散模式缺乏稳定带结构，而尖锐重组产生稳定指纹，从而读取表示的几何状态。
Motivation: 现有标量损失函数无法捕捉训练过程中的谱重组信息，这些信息对理解训练过程很重要。
Method: 提出OMD框架，包括对距离矩阵的Bogomolny-Bohigas-Schmit理论扩展、每快照诊断、轨迹级观测和3D MDS嵌入。
Result: 在七个实验中，扩散状态无稳定带结构，而内生或外源重组产生稳定指纹，对应不同几何结构。
Conclusion: OMD能够读取表示的几何状态，而不是报告单一内在维度。

papers.title: I-BBS: Coordinate-Free Inference of Latent Sub-Manifolds Using Random Distance Matrix Theory
papers.abstract_en: Bogomolny, Bohigas and Schmit (BBS) found that the spectrum of the pairwise distance matrix on N points sampled from a smooth d-dimensional manifold encodes a signature of the underlying geometry. We develop I-BBS (Inference-BBS), a coordinate-free method that identifies a low-dimensional latent sub-manifold embedded in a high-dimensional ambient distance matrix alone, without accessing an ambient high-dimensional vector space. It therefore applies even when that space is only partly observable or undefined. We model the ambient embedding by two classes of generative noise, model-based and model-free. The noise mixes the latent signal with off-manifold components, so the eigenvalues reorganise collectively and the latent geometry cannot be read off eigenvalue by eigenvalue. We recover it instead from two integer-stable signatures that survive the noise: the multiplicity of the top non-Perron multiplet, which fixes $d$, and a parameter-free law for how the multiplet positions shrink as the noise grows. On synthetic spheres $S^1$, $S^2$ and $S^3$ these integer signatures are far more stable under noise than the continuous spectral slope, and a blind test recovers both the manifold and the noise model from a single distance matrix. Applications to neural-network representations and to the dynamic training regime are developed in two companion papers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 I-BBS（Inference-BBS）方法，一种无需坐标的低维潜在子流形推断方法，仅利用高维距离矩阵即可识别嵌入的流形结构，无需访问高维向量空间。该方法通过两种生成噪声模型模拟高维嵌入，并从噪声干扰后的特征值中提取整数稳定的签名（顶部非 Perron 多重态的简并度和收缩规律）来推断流形维度和噪声模型。在合成球面 S1、S2、S3 上验证了比连续谱斜率更强的抗噪性，并能在单距离矩阵中盲恢复流形和噪声模型。
Motivation: 现有方法通常需要高维坐标或显式特征表示来推断潜在低维流形，但实际场景中高维空间可能仅部分可观或未定义。BBS 理论表明距离矩阵谱可编码几何信息，但噪声会导致特征值集体重组，无法逐特征值读取几何。本文旨在从带噪距离矩阵中可靠恢复潜流形的维度和结构。
Method: 提出 I-BBS 方法，基于随机距离矩阵理论。将高维嵌入建模为两类生成噪声（模型驱动和无模型），通过分析噪声扰动下特征值的全局重组，提取两个整数稳定的签名：最大非 Perron 多重态的简并度（确定流形维度 d）以及多重态位置随噪声增长而收缩的无参数律。
Result: 在合成球面 S1、S2、S3 上，整数签名在噪声下的稳定性远高于连续谱斜率；盲测试能从单一距离矩阵同时恢复流形维度和噪声模型。

papers.title: Unlocking the Visual Record of Materials Science: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset from Scientific Literature
papers.abstract_en: The materials science literature encodes decades of experimental knowledge in figures, yet this visual record remains locked away and inaccessible to AI at scale. The core difficulty is structural: most scientific figures are compound, with a single caption describing multiple sub-panels simultaneously, making direct image-text pairing unreliable. We present MatMMExtract, an end-to-end open-source pipeline that resolves this by decomposing compound figures into individual sub-panels and generating structured, grounded annotations using a large language model guided by a curated materials science taxonomy. Applied to 14,810 open-access articles, MatMMExtract produces MatSciFig; 391,606 panel-level image-text pairs from 180,571 figures, each annotated with a sub-caption, a two-level visualisation category spanning 19 classes and over 100 subtypes, and a scientific summary. To enable accurate panel localisation, we introduce MaterialScope, a domain-specific detection dataset of 2,811 manually annotated materials science figures, on which a fine-tuned YOLO12-m detector achieves mAP_50 of 0.9227. Among six benchmarked language models, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite delivers the best cost-quality trade-off for annotation generation, with 82% of outputs rated good and a hallucination rate of 4.8%. A dual-encoder retrieval baseline on MatSciFig achieves a 4.4 times improvement in R@1 over zero-shot CLIP, demonstrating the dataset's immediate utility for vision-language learning. All resources are released openly to the community.

Motivation: 材料科学文献中的图形多为复合图（多子图共享一个标题），直接图像-文本配对不可靠，限制了 AI 对视觉知识的规模化利用。
Method: 开发端到端开源管道 MatMMExtract，先分解复合图为子面板，再利用大语言模型（以材料科学分类法引导）生成结构化注释（子标题、两级可视化类别、科学摘要）。同时构建 MaterialScope 数据集（2,811 张手工标注图）以训练面板检测器。
Result: 微调 YOLO12-m 在 MaterialScope 上达到 mAP_50 0.9227；Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite 在标注生成中质量最佳（82% 良好，幻觉率 4.8%）；基于 MatSciFig 的双编码器检索基线相比零样本 CLIP 在 R@1 上提升 4.4 倍。
Conclusion: 所有资源（数据集、模型、管道）开源，为材料科学领域的视觉语言学习提供基础资源。

papers.title: Adjusted Wasserstein distances for bridging empirical and true distributions with applications to MDS
papers.abstract_en: This paper examines how metric adjustments to Multidimensional Scaling (MDS) can enhance its effectiveness as a visual tool for pattern recognition. The distance under consideration, referred to as Max-D-SW, is an adjustment of the Max-Sliced Wasserstein distance. In contrast to the original formulation, which optimizes over single unit directions, Max-D-SW aggregates contributions over orthonormal bases. This modification provides a clear numerical advantage in MDS outcomes, particularly when applied to heavy-tailed distributions. We also establish sample-complexity bounds showing that Max-D-SW remains statistically tractable, with rates comparable to those of its max-sliced counterpart. Moreover, we show that a better sample complexity for a metric does not necessarily translate into better performance when the metric is used as an input for MDS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了多维缩放（MDS）中距离度量的调整，提出Max-D-SW距离，该距离是Max-Sliced Wasserstein距离的变体，通过对正交基上的贡献进行聚合来改进MDS结果，尤其在重尾分布下表现更好。文章还建立了样本复杂度界，并指出更好的样本复杂度不一定带来更好的MDS性能。
Motivation: 传统Max-Sliced Wasserstein距离仅优化单个单位方向，限制了其在MDS中的有效性，特别是在重尾分布下的模式识别任务中。
Method: 提出Max-D-SW距离，它将Max-Sliced Wasserstein距离中的优化扩展到正交基上的贡献聚合，并分析了其统计可处理性和样本复杂度。
Result: Max-D-SW在MDS结果上显示出数值优势，尤其是在重尾分布下；样本复杂度与Max-Sliced相当，但更好的样本复杂度并不保证更好的MDS性能。
Conclusion: Max-D-SW是MDS中一种有效的距离调整，但样本复杂度与MDS性能之间无直接对应关系。

papers.title: Benchmarking Geospatial Foundation Models for Agriculture Applications
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial foundation models pretrained on satellite imagery promise broad generalization across remote sensing tasks and regions, but their geographic transferability has not been systematically tested, especially in agriculture applications. This paper presents a controlled benchmark that evaluates three models, Prithvi, SpectralGPT, and SatMAE, on multi-temporal crop segmentation and change detection across four U.S. states, Iowa, North Carolina, California, and Minnesota. By assigning each train, validation, and test split to a separate region, we measure how well each model transfers to land it has not seen. All three degrade sharply under regional distribution shift, predicting only the most common crops while missing rare ones. We further find that fitting these models to a shared input format affects each one differently, which complicates direct architectural comparison. These results expose key limitations of current geospatial foundation models for agriculture and point to region aware evaluation as a necessary standard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了三种地理空间基础模型（Prithvi、SpectralGPT、SatMAE）在农业应用中的地理迁移能力，使用多时相作物分割和变化检测任务，在四个美国州（爱荷华、北卡罗来纳、加利福尼亚、明尼苏达）进行跨区域测试。结果表明，所有模型在区域分布偏移下性能显著下降，仅能预测最常见作物，且输入格式适配对不同模型影响各异，暴露了当前地理空间基础模型在农业领域的局限性。
Motivation: 地理空间基础模型在遥感任务中声称具有广泛泛化能力，但其地理迁移性在农业应用中尚未被系统测试，现有评估多局限于同区域设置，无法反映跨区域真实部署场景。
Method: 构建受控基准测试，将训练、验证和测试集按区域分离，评估Prithvi、SpectralGPT和SatMAE三种模型在四个州的多时相作物分割和变化检测任务上的表现，并分析输入格式统一化对各个模型性能的影响。
Result: 所有模型在跨区域测试中性能急剧下降，仅能正确预测常见作物类别，稀有作物几乎完全遗漏；将不同模型调整至统一输入格式对其性能产生不一致影响，使得直接架构比较复杂化。
Conclusion: 当前地理空间基础模型在农业应用中存在显著的地理迁移性缺陷，论文呼吁将区域感知评估作为必要标准。

papers.title: Diversity is the Strength of the AI Crowd
papers.abstract_en: Top AI forecasting systems are approaching superforecaster-level accuracy on future world events, but still rely primarily on off-the-shelf LLMs combined with forecasting-specific context gathering and scaffolding. We study how to improve this recipe through ensembling: given a fixed number of samples, which off-the-shelf model forecasts should be combined to maximize accuracy? On binary questions from the Metaculus AI Benchmark, we find that individual accuracy is not enough: many frontier LLMs make highly correlated predictions, limiting the value of additional forecasts from the same or similar models. Instead, the strongest ensembles combine accurate but diverse forecasters, with models such as \model{Grok 4} contributing disproportionately because their predictions are less correlated with other frontier LLMs. These results suggest that the strength of the AI crowd comes not from sampling more forecasts indiscriminately, but from combining forecasts across models with complementary errors, motivating forecasting systems that explicitly optimize for both model quality and diversity.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence, Seoul, South Korea, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何通过集成（ensembling）提升AI预测系统的准确率，发现仅仅选择高准确率的模型是不够的，因为许多前沿LLM（大语言模型）的预测高度相关；相反，最强集成应结合准确但多样化的预测器，其中Grok 4等模型因与其他模型相关性更低而贡献更大。结果表明AI集成的优势来自互补误差的组合，而非盲目增加采样。
Motivation: 现有AI预测系统主要依赖现成LLM与情境收集及脚手架，但如何通过固定样本数量的集成最大化准确率仍未充分探索，尤其是模型间的预测相关性会限制集成的收益。
Method: 在Metaculus AI基准的二元问题上，比较不同现成LLM的预测准确率与相关性，构建集成并评估其性能。
Result: 摘要指出，单个模型准确率不足以决定集成性能：许多前沿LLM的预测高度相关，导致额外同质样本收益有限；而集成准确但多样化的模型（如Grok 4）能显著提升效果，因其预测与其他模型相关性较低。
Conclusion: AI预测系统的优势来自于组合具有互补误差的模型，而非简单增加预测数量，因此应同时优化模型质量和多样性。

papers.title: How Good Can Linear Models Be for Time-Series Forecasting?
papers.abstract_en: Time-series forecasting research has been moving steadily toward larger architectures, from specialized transformers to general-purpose foundation models, on the assumption that capacity is what unlocks accuracy. We take the opposite position: most of the gap can be closed at far lower cost by tuning preprocessing rather than scaling models. We use Ridge regression as the testbed, since it has a closed-form solution and interpretable weights, which let the optimal hyperparameters be read off the search directly. We search over context length, local normalization, regularization, and augmentation on eight standard benchmarks and find three patterns. (1) Optimal lookback is strongly series-specific and often non-monotonic in forecast horizon, with fitted power-law exponents ranging from $+0.46$ on ETTm2 to $-0.19$ on Exchange and Traffic, challenging the convention that longer horizons need longer history. (2) Normalizing over a learned trailing fraction of the context, rather than its entirety, is almost universally preferred. (3) Series within the same dataset often disagree on hyperparameters; the optimal degree of cross-series sharing varies from fully shared to fully per-series. The resulting models beat prior linear forecasters on most dataset-horizon entries and exceed Transformer, MLP, and CNN baselines on six of eight benchmarks. The optimized hyperparameters also serve as a diagnostic on the data itself, revealing structures that larger models absorb silently into their learned parameters. We provide an accompanying interactive online demonstration and the code at https://sakanaai.github.io/SearchCast/.
papers.comment: Project page: https://sakanaai.github.io/SearchCast/ 17 pages, 10 figures, and 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑时间序列预测领域趋向更大模型的假设，以岭回归（Ridge regression）为测试平台，通过优化预处理（如上下文长度、局部归一化、正则化和数据增强）在八个标准基准上取得优于Transformer、MLP和CNN基线的结果。研究发现最优回溯长度强烈依赖序列本身且与预测窗口非单调、倾向于对上下文的一小部分进行归一化、同一数据集内系列之间超参数存在分歧。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测研究趋向使用更大架构（从专用Transformer到通用基础模型），本文认为大多数性能差距可以通过调优预处理以更低成本弥补，而非单纯扩大模型规模。
Method: 采用闭式解的岭回归作为测试平台，系统搜索上下文长度、局部归一化（学习上下文的尾部分数而非全部）、正则化强度和增强策略，并在八个标准基准上观察最优配置的模式。
Result: 优化后的线性模型在大部分数据集-预测窗口组合上超越先前的线性预测器，并在六个基准上超过Transformer、MLP和CNN基线；最优回溯长度与预测窗口的关系呈非单调，归一化偏向于使用学习到的上下文尾部分数。
Conclusion: 通过简单线性模型配合精心选择的预处理即可达到甚至超过复杂架构的性能，且优化后的超参数可作为数据结构的诊断工具。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有时间序列预测研究趋向使用更大架构（从专用Transformer到通用基础模型），本文认为大多数性能差距可以通过调优预处理以更低成本弥补，而非单纯扩大模型规模。
summary_sections.method: 采用闭式解的岭回归作为测试平台，系统搜索上下文长度、局部归一化（学习上下文的尾部分数而非全部）、正则化强度和增强策略，并在八个标准基准上观察最优配置的模式。
summary_sections.result: 优化后的线性模型在大部分数据集-预测窗口组合上超越先前的线性预测器，并在六个基准上超过Transformer、MLP和CNN基线；最优回溯长度与预测窗口的关系呈非单调，归一化偏向于使用学习到的上下文尾部分数。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过简单线性模型配合精心选择的预处理即可达到甚至超过复杂架构的性能，且优化后的超参数可作为数据结构的诊断工具。

papers.title: HyperDFlash: Hyper-Connection-Aligned Block Speculative Decoding with Gated Residual Reduction
papers.abstract_en: We present HyperDFlash, a block-parallel speculative decoding framework tailored to DeepSeek-V4's Hyper-Connections (HC). Despite the strong performance of DeepSeek-V4's native Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) module on initial token drafting, its draft accuracy degrades sharply at later positions, as error accumulation from unverified intermediate tokens harms draft acceptance rates. Although the original DFlash method supports efficient one-pass block drafting, it cannot be seamlessly adapted to the HC paradigm, since DeepSeek-V4's multi-path residual stream induces inherent feature misalignment with conventional drafting designs. To resolve this architectural mismatch, we propose two dedicated, model-aligned optimizations for HC residual streams. First, we adopt pre-collapse residual states as the exclusive conditioning signal, preserving complete multi-path structural information and better aligning the drafter with the target's native prediction pathway. Second, we replace the heavy generic linear compressor with a lightweight gated residual reducer, whose parameters are directly inherited from the target model's built-in hc_head module. This design yields input-aware path aggregation with three orders of magnitude fewer parameters while maintaining precise architectural alignment. We further enhance model training via a targeted KL distillation loss applied to the LM-head, regularizing predictions against the target distribution to improve early draft quality. Extensive experiments across math reasoning, code synthesis, and conversational benchmarks demonstrate that HyperDFlash consistently outperforms both the native MTP baseline and vanilla DFlash adaptation, achieving substantial gains in average accepted draft length and decoding speedup. These results validate HC alignment, gated reduction, and targeted distillation for high-performance speculative decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HyperDFlash，一种针对DeepSeek-V4的Hyper-Connections架构定制的块并行推测解码框架。由于DeepSeek-V4的多路径残差流导致传统草稿设计特征不对齐，论文设计了两种架构匹配优化：采用预折叠残差状态作为条件信号，以及用轻量级门控残差缩减器替代通用线性压缩器，参数直接继承自目标模型的hc_head模块。实验表明，在数学推理、代码生成和对话任务上，HyperDFlash在平均接受草稿长度和解码加速上优于原生MTP基线和DFlash适配版。
Motivation: DeepSeek-V4的MTP模块在后续位置草稿精度下降，而现有DFlash方法无法适配Hyper-Connections架构，因为多路径残差流导致特征不对齐。
Method: 提出两种针对HC残差流的优化：1) 使用预折叠残差状态作为唯一条件信号；2) 用门控残差缩减器替换线性压缩器，参数从hc_head继承。此外，对LM-head应用KL蒸馏损失以改善早期草稿质量。
Result: 在数学推理、代码合成和对话基准上，HyperDFlash在平均接受草稿长度和解码加速上持续优于MTP基线和原始DFlash适配。
Conclusion: HC对齐、门控缩减和针对性蒸馏对于高性能推测解码有效。

papers.title: The Verification Horizon: No Silver Bullet for Coding Agent Rewards
papers.abstract_en: A classical intuition holds that verifying a solution is easier than producing one. For today's coding agents, this intuition is being inverted: as foundation models develop stronger reasoning capabilities and engineering harnesses grow more sophisticated, generating complex candidate solutions is no longer difficult -- reliably verifying them has become the harder problem. Every verifier we can build is only a proxy for human intent, never the intent itself. This makes verification subject to a twofold difficulty: first, intent is underspecified by nature, making it inherently hard to faithfully check whether it has been fulfilled; second, during model training, optimization widens the gap between proxy and intent -- manifesting as reward hacking or signal saturation. To address this, we characterize the quality of verification signals along three dimensions -- scalability, faithfulness, and robustness -- and argue that achieving all three simultaneously is the central challenge. We further study four reward constructions: a test verifier for general coding tasks, a rubric verifier for frontend tasks, the user as verifier for real-world agent tasks, and an automated agent verifier for long-horizon tasks. Across different task types and policy capability levels, we conduct in-depth analysis and experiments on the core challenges of reward design and how to more effectively leverage reward signals. Experiments show that targeted verification design can effectively suppress reward hacking, improve task completion quality, and achieve significant gains across multiple internal and public benchmarks. These experiences collectively point to a core observation: no fixed reward function can remain effective as policy capability continues to grow; and verification must co-evolve with the generator.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了“验证比生成容易”的传统直觉，指出在当代编码智能体中，随着基础模型推理能力增强和工程框架进步，生成复杂解决方案已不再困难，而可靠验证反而成为瓶颈。作者将验证信号的质量分解为可扩展性、忠实性和鲁棒性三个维度，并认为同时实现三者是核心挑战。通过研究测试验证器、评分标准验证器、用户作为验证器以及自动化智能体验证器四种奖励构造，实验表明针对性的验证设计能有效抑制奖励黑客行为并提升任务完成质量。最终指出，没有固定奖励函数能随策略能力增长而持续有效，验证必须与生成器共同进化。
Motivation: 传统直觉认为验证比生成容易，但当前编码智能体中，生成复杂解决方案已不困难，可靠验证反而更难，因为意图本质上是未明确指定的，且训练中的优化会扩大代理与意图之间的差距，导致奖励黑客或信号饱和。
Method: 提出验证信号的三维分析框架（可扩展性、忠实性、鲁棒性），并研究四种奖励构造：通用编码任务的测试验证器、前端任务的评分标准验证器、真实世界智能体任务的用户作为验证器、长周期任务的自动化智能体验证器。
Result: 在多个内部和公共基准上，针对性的验证设计能有效抑制奖励黑客、提升任务完成质量，并取得显著收益。
Conclusion: 没有固定奖励函数能随策略能力增长而持续有效；验证必须与生成器共同进化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Red Queen Gödel Machine: Co-Evolving Agents and Their Evaluators
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving agents are state-of-the-art (SOTA) on agentic coding benchmarks and have recently been extended to general domains. However, their search methods generally assume a stationary evaluation criterion: a fixed verifier, benchmark, or labeled dataset that remains valid as the agent improves. This ignores a central feature of evolution: species adapt as their environments change with them. We aim to bring the same principle to recursive self-improvement, making evaluation part of the improvement loop and opening search to evolving evaluators, adversarial objectives, and dynamic utilities that may surpass static benchmarks. We introduce the Red Queen Godel Machine (RQGM), an evolutionary framework for recursive self-improvement under non-stationary utilities. The RQGM makes this possible through controlled utility evolution: search is organized into epochs with a fixed within-epoch evaluation criterion, while the utility can be updated at epoch boundaries, so self-improvement guarantees hold per epoch as the objective evolves across them. We begin by showing that even on verifiable coding tasks, the RQGM improves test pass rate over the prior SOTA by adding a complementary agent-as-a-judge code-review signal. This signal is cheaper and the RQGM uses 1.35x-1.72x fewer tokens. We then turn to scientific paper writing and reviewing, and Olympiad-level proof writing and grading, where the RQGM improves performance over prior self-improving agents: co-evolved writers reach 1.78x-1.86x higher acceptance rates under a diverse agent-as-a-judge panel, while co-evolved graders reach 9% higher ground-truth accuracy. In paper reviewing, the strongest baseline reviewer over-accepts AI-generated papers at up to 1.91x the human rate. The RQGM corrects this by introducing an adversarial objective that discovers reviewers equally stringent on AI and human work.
papers.comment: 13 pages main text + 21 pages appendix (38 pages total, incl. references); 11 figures (7 main text + 4 appendix); 10 tables (2 main text + 8 appendix). Preliminary preprint; work in progress. Keywords: self-improving agents, learned evaluation, multi-agent systems, auto-mated scientific discovery, controlled utility evolution, co-evolutionary search, autoresearch
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出红皇后哥德尔机器（RQGM），一种用于非平稳效用下的递归自我改进的进化框架，将评估纳入改进循环，允许共同进化评估器和敌对目标。在可验证编码任务上，RQGM通过添加补充代码审查信号提高了测试通过率，并使用1.35x-1.72x更少标记；在科学论文写作和奥林匹克级证明写作中，共同进化的作者达到1.78x-1.86x更高的接受率，共同进化的评分者达到9%更高的真值准确率；该方法还通过敌对目标纠正了基线审查者对AI生成论文的过度接受问题。
Motivation: 现有自我改进代理假设固定的评估标准，忽略了进化中物种与环境共同变化的原则。本文旨在使评估动态化，作为改进循环的一部分，以处理非平稳效用。
Method: 提出红皇后哥德尔机器（RQGM），通过受控效用进化组织搜索：每个时期使用固定评估标准，在时期边界更新效用，从而在每个时期内保持自我改进保证。
Result: 在编码任务上，RQGM比先前SOTA提高测试通过率，且使用更少标记（1.35x-1.72x）；在科学写作中，共同进化的作者达到1.78x-1.86x更高接受率；共同进化的评分者达到9%更高真值准确率；在论文评审中，纠正了基线对AI生成论文的过度接受（最高达1.91x人类率）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将评估纳入改进循环的有效性，并通过敌对目标处理AI生成论文的评审偏见。方法仍依赖人工设定时期边界和效用更新规则。

papers.title: Falcon: Functional Assembly and Language for Compositional Reasoning in X-ray
papers.abstract_en: Conventional vision-language models are largely object-centric, focusing on detecting and describing individual entities. In safety-critical X-ray baggage screening, however, threat often emerges not from a single object but from the functional compatibility of spatially dispersed components, such as batteries, detonators, and explosive charges. We formalize this setting as \emph{compositional threat reasoning}, where risk is modeled as a relational property of grounded regions rather than an independent detection outcome. We introduce \textbf{Falcon}, a multimodal framework that abstracts segmentation-aware region features into a structured safety state capturing component presence, pairwise functional compatibility, and scene-level risk. This structured representation is injected into the language model as an explicit intermediate interface, encouraging relationally consistent and safety-aware reasoning. To evaluate this problem, we present \textbf{Falcon-X}, a benchmark that unifies dense grounding with structured supervision over component completeness and risk inference in cluttered X-ray imagery. Experiments show that while existing multimodal models adapt to appearance, they struggle with compositional safety reasoning. Falcon improves functional grounding and produces more coherent threat assessments, establishing compositional safety reasoning as a distinct evaluation paradigm for multimodal systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对X光行李安检中威胁源于分散组件功能性兼容而非单个目标的问题，提出Falcon多模态框架。该框架将分割感知的区域特征抽象为结构化安全状态，包含组件存在、成对功能兼容性和场景级风险，并注入语言模型作为中间接口。实验表明，现有模型无法进行组合安全推理，而Falcon改进了功能接地和威胁评估，确立了组合安全推理作为多模态系统的独立评估范式。
Motivation: 传统视觉语言模型以目标为中心，无法捕捉X光安检中分散组件（如电池、雷管、炸药）的功能兼容性所构成的威胁。
Method: 提出Falcon，一个多模态框架，将分割感知的区域特征抽象为结构化安全状态（组件存在、成对功能兼容性、场景级风险），并作为显式中间接口注入语言模型。同时提出Falcon-X基准，统一密集接地与结构化监督。
Result: 实验显示现有多模态模型虽能适应外观，但无法进行组合安全推理；Falcon改进了功能接地并产生更一致的威胁评估。
Conclusion: 本文将组合安全推理确立为多模态系统的一个独立评估范式，并展示了结构化中间表示在关系推理中的有效性。

papers.title: TACO: Towards Task-Consistent Open-Vocabulary Adaptation in Video Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Adapting CLIP for open-vocabulary video recognition necessitates a delicate balance between newly acquired video knowledge and the pretrained generalization. While existing studies pursue this generalization-specialization trade-off with additional regularizations or constraints, we argue that they overlook the deviation of representations beyond the fine-tuning data distribution, resulting in suboptimal adaptation effects. We believe such deviation is inherited from the inconsistency between the fine-tuning and evaluation objectives, where model optimization is restricted to the known training distribution but evaluated on unseen ones. In this paper, we introduce \emph{TACO}, a simple yet effective framework to mitigate the potential negative effects induced by this inconsistency. Our key insight is that adaptation should preserve OOD-relevant alignment beyond the training distribution. To this end, we propose \emph{Relative Structure Distillation}, which regularizes the relative geometry of the representation space and suppresses harmful alignment shift during training. We further decouple the representation space from the optimization space with a lightweight specialization projection, allowing task-specific adaptation without directly overspecializing the representations used at test time. \emph{TACO} establishes state-of-the-art performance on diverse benchmarks under cross-dataset and base-to-novel settings. Code will be released at https://github.com/ZMHH-H/TACO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TACO框架，用于视频识别中CLIP模型的开放词汇适应，通过相对结构蒸馏和轻量级专业化投影来缓解微调与评估目标不一致导致的表示偏移，在跨数据集和base-to-novel设置下达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有方法通过正则化或约束来平衡视频知识获取与预训练泛化能力，但忽略了微调数据分布之外的表示偏差，导致适应效果次优。这种偏差源于微调与评估目标的不一致性。
Method: 提出相对结构蒸馏（Relative Structure Distillation），在训练中保持表示空间的相对几何结构，抑制有害的对齐偏移；同时通过轻量级专业化投影（specialization projection）将表示空间与优化空间解耦，避免测试时使用的表示过拟合。
Result: 在多个基准的跨数据集和base-to-novel设置下取得最先进性能。
Conclusion: 适应过程应保留训练分布之外的与开放词汇（OOD）相关的对齐，所提方法有效缓解了微调与评估目标不一致带来的负面影响。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Reclaim Evaluation: A Lossy Memory Is Worse Than an Empty One
papers.abstract_en: A language model's memory can be worse than no memory at all. A memory that keeps a wrong conclusion but drops the work behind it makes the model emit the stale value as a confident answer, where an empty memory would make it abstain; we call this brittle memory. We measure it with reclaim evaluation: compress a drifted interaction at a fixed budget, then test whether a correction recovers the known answer, scored against ground truth with no judge. Correctability is bottlenecked not by capability but by whether the answer-determining source survives compression, so an 8B model and a frontier one wall in the same place. Across eight models a lossy memory is never better than an empty one, and strictly worse on those disposed to answer rather than abstain. A one-line source-first policy, keep the recomputable source and drop the re-derivable conclusion, restores correctability at equal budget where the answer-determining source is compact and identifiable; a length-matched control rules out added text, and a deployable one-prompt form reclaims 0.49-0.88, rising toward the oracle's 1.00 when a frontier model writes the note. The failure compounds through a memory loop and replicates on three deployed memory systems and on real dialogue (MultiWOZ), with a located boundary past which the fix fails silently unless the note records its completeness. This is a controlled study of a mechanism: judge-free exact scoring, matched-budget controls, and validators built to come out false; we release the harness, the paired memory conditions, and these validators.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 3 figures. v2: corrected the disposition, blank-vs-lossy, failure-mode, and correction-robustness tables for an answer-parsing error; source-first and recovery-rate results unchanged. Code, data, and reproduction harness: https://github.com/collapseindex/reclaim-eval
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型记忆的脆性问题，发现保留错误结论但丢弃推导过程的记忆（有损记忆）比空白记忆更差，因为它会使模型自信地输出错误答案。通过“回收评估”方法测量：在固定预算下压缩偏离的交互，然后测试修正是否能恢复已知答案。实验表明，在8个模型上，有损记忆从未优于空白记忆，且对于倾向回答而非放弃的模型更差。提出一种单行“源优先”策略，保留可重新计算的源，丢弃可重新推导的结论，在答案确定源紧凑且可识别的情况下恢复可修正性。失效模式在记忆循环中累积，并在三个部署的记忆系统和真实对话MultiWOZ上复现。
Motivation: 语言模型记忆存在脆性问题：如果记忆保持了错误结论但丢弃了推导过程，模型会自信地输出陈旧错误，而空白记忆会使模型放弃回答。因此需要评估和缓解这种有损记忆的负面影响。
Method: 提出“回收评估”方法，通过压缩偏离交互（固定预算），然后测试修正能否恢复已知答案，使用无裁判的精确评分。进一步提出“源优先”策略，保留可重新计算的源，丢弃可重新推导的结论。
Result: 在8个模型上，有损记忆从未优于空白记忆，且对于倾向回答而非放弃的模型更差。源优先策略在答案确定源紧凑且可识别时恢复可修正性。在记忆循环中失效模式累积，在三个部署的记忆系统和MultiWOZ上复现。
Conclusion: 本文是对语言模型记忆机制的受控研究，强调有损记忆的危害，并提供了缓解策略和评估工具。限制包括源优先策略依赖于源的可识别性和紧凑性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HiFiVe: High-Fidelity Vehicle Generation Leveraging Auto-Regressive 2D Generative Priors
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D vehicle generation methods often suffer from low geometric fidelity and blurry textures, hindering their downstream applications. While recent works adopt multi-view diffusion models for high-fidelity texture, they are often constrained by fixed viewpoints, limited resolution, and a reliance on costly fine-tuning to achieve cross-view consistency. In this paper, we propose HiFiVe, a training-free framework for high-fidelity vehicle modeling through joint texture and geometry enhancement by imposing 3D geometric constraints to anchor 2D generative priors. Specifically, we propose an auto-regressive texture refinement pipeline that progressively synthesizes high-resolution textures from arbitrary viewpoints. To ensure cross-view consistency, the coarse geometry serves as a synchronization prior, conditioning each generation step on previously synthesized frames via depth-based warping and multi-view texture fusion. Moreover, the inherent symmetry of vehicles is exploited to mitigate error accumulation. Finally, high-frequency surface details are recovered by refining the mesh geometry using normal maps estimated from the enhanced textures. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world vehicle datasets demonstrate that our method significantly improves both geometric detail and texture quality compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Project page: https://honglixiao.github.io/hifive.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HiFiVe，一种无需训练的框架，通过结合2D生成先验的3D几何约束，实现高保真车辆建模。该方法采用自回归纹理细化流程，从任意视角逐步合成高分辨率纹理，并利用深度扭曲和多视角纹理融合保证跨视角一致性，同时利用车辆对称性减少误差累积，最后通过法向图细化网格几何恢复高频表面细节。实验表明，在合成和真实车辆数据集上，HiFiVe在几何细节和纹理质量上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 现有3D车辆生成方法几何保真度低且纹理模糊，多视角扩散方法受限于固定视角、有限分辨率及昂贵的跨视角一致性微调。
Method: 提出无需训练的HiFiVe框架，包含自回归纹理细化管线：以粗几何为同步先验，通过深度扭曲和多视角纹理融合，逐步生成任意视角的高分辨率纹理；利用车辆对称性抑制误差累积；最后用从增强纹理估计的法向图优化网格几何，恢复高频表面细节。
Result: 在合成和真实车辆数据集上，HiFiVe在几何细节和纹理质量上均显著优于当前最先进方法。
Conclusion: 该方法通过3D几何约束锚定2D生成先验，实现了高保真车辆建模，且无需训练，具有推广潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: We present Wan-Streamer, a native-streaming, end-to-end interactive foundation model designed from the ground up for real-time, low-latency, full-duplex audio-visual interaction. Wan-Streamer seamlessly models language, audio, and video as both input and output within a single Transformer, where the sequence is represented as interleaved visual, audio, and text input tokens together with visual, audio, and text output tokens, coordinated by block-causal attention for incremental streaming. Unlike cascaded interactive systems that rely on separate VAD, ASR, language, TTS, audio-driven animation, or video-generation modules, Wan-Streamer does not rely on external language, speech, avatar, or video-generation modules: perception, reasoning, generation, response timing, turn management, and cross-modal synchronization are learned jointly within one unified model, reducing pipeline latency and error accumulation. To support natural audio-visual responsiveness, we redesign the entire stack around streamability, including causal encoders, causal decoders, block-causal attention, and low-latency multimodal token scheduling, enabling streaming units as short as 160 ms at 25 fps. Wan-Streamer achieves approximately 200 ms model-side response latency and approximately 550 ms total interaction latency when combined with 350 ms bidirectional network latency, supporting sub-second duplex audio-visual communication. These results position Wan-Streamer as a unified, end-to-end, multimodal interactive foundation model for low-latency streaming interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Wan-Streamer 是一个原生流式、端到端交互的基础模型，专为实时、低延迟、全双工音视频交互设计。它在一个 Transformer 内统一建模语言、音频和视频的输入与输出，使用块因果注意力实现增量流式，无需依赖外部模块。模型端延迟约 200ms，总交互延迟约 550ms，支持亚秒级双工音视频通信。
Motivation: 现有的级联交互系统依赖多个独立模块（如 VAD、ASR、TTS 等），导致管线延迟和错误累积，需要更统一的端到端模型来减少延迟并提升交互自然性。
Method: 重新设计了完整架构以支持流式处理，包括因果编码器、因果解码器、块因果注意力和低延迟多模态令牌调度，支持短至 160ms（25fps）的流式单元。
Result: 论文报告模型端响应延迟约 200ms，结合 350ms 双向网络延迟后总交互延迟约 550ms，实现了亚秒级双工音视频通信。
Conclusion: Wan-Streamer 是一个统一的、端到端的、多模态交互基础模型，适用于低延迟流式交互场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 3DCarGen: Scalable 3D Car Generation via 3D-consistent Multi-view Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: High-quality 3D vehicle assets are essential for autonomous driving simulation. Although multi-view diffusion-based paradigms enable controllable single-image reconstruction, they typically produce limited viewpoints and exhibit cross-view geometric inconsistencies, thereby reducing reconstruction fidelity in real-world scenarios. In this work, we introduce 3DCarGen, a scalable single-view 3D car generation framework designed for real-world images by synthesizing an arbitrary number of 3D-consistent multi-view images. Specifically, given a single image as input, we first synthesize a set of images from fixed viewpoints. These images are then fed into a feed-forward reconstruction model, resulting in a coarse 3D representation based on 3D Gaussian Splatting. Conditioned on this explicit 3D prior, our multi-view diffusion model generates 3D-consistent images from arbitrary camera viewpoints. We further extend a fast mesh reconstruction algorithm by incorporating color-normal joint optimization to recover detailed and coherent 3D vehicle models from the synthesized dense views. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves robust geometric consistency and reconstruction fidelity compared to existing methods. Project page: https://honglixiao.github.io/3dcargen.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出3DCarGen，一种从单视图图像生成高质量3D汽车模型的可扩展框架。该方法先合成固定视角的多视图图像，通过前馈重建得到3D高斯泼溅粗略表示，再以此为条件生成任意视角的3D一致图像，并联合优化颜色和法线以重建精细网格。实验表明，该方法在合成和真实数据集上实现了比现有方法更优的几何一致性和重建保真度。
Motivation: 现有基于多视图扩散的单图像重建方法视角有限且跨视图几何不一致，限制了实景重建的保真度。
Method: 首先从单张输入图像合成固定视角的多视图图像，输入前馈重建模型得到基于3D高斯泼溅的粗略3D表示；然后以此显式3D先验为条件，多视图扩散模型生成任意视角的3D一致图像；最后扩展快速网格重建算法，通过颜色-法线联合优化从密集视图中恢复详细且连贯的3D车辆模型。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，与现有方法相比，该方法在几何一致性和重建保真度方面表现更优。
Conclusion: 该框架适用于自动驾驶仿真中高质量3D车辆资产的生成，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Spec Learning: Inference-Time Alignment from Preference Pairs
papers.abstract_en: Steering a large language model (LLM) toward a desired behavior typically relies on an iterative process of hand-crafting a prompt based on a careful inspection of the model's responses. This is an involved, brittle, and error-prone process. Preference-based fine-tuning is a more rigorous but often prohibitively expensive solution. We propose spec learning, a framework that relies on a brief user instruction and a small set of preference judgments. These are compiled into specifications in the form of natural-language prompts for an LLM. Specifications condition LLMs at inference time, and no parameter updates to the underlying models are required. We show that the responses generated based on the compiled specifications often outperform direct preference optimization (DPO) on datasets from specialized domains whose preference signal is dense. Unlike opaque weight updates, the resulting specifications are human-readable and double as interpretable and transparent written embodiments of the preference signal that produced them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出spec learning框架，基于少量用户指令和偏好判断，编译成自然语言规格（specifications），在推理时引导LLM行为，无需参数更新。实验表明在偏好信号密集的领域，specs生成的响应常优于直接偏好优化（DPO），且规格可供人类阅读。
Motivation: 现有方法如手工提示词调整脆弱易错，而偏好微调成本高。目标是以更低成本实现对齐。
Method: 提出spec learning，将简短用户指令和少量偏好判断编译成自然语言规格，在推理时条件化LLM。
Result: 在偏好信号密集的专用领域数据集上，specs生成的响应常优于直接偏好优化（DPO）。

papers.title: Spectral Gating via Damped Oscillations for Adaptive Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have been proven successful in encoding continuous signals through coordinate-based networks, yet facing a spectral dilemma: periodic activations capture fine details but act as all-pass filters that memorise noise, while spatially compact activations regularise effectively but suffer from low-frequency bias. Existing attempts to resolve this trade-off introduce computational overhead or tuning frailty. We propose to model each neuron's activation as the steady-state response of a sinusoidally-forced damped harmonic oscillator, whose amplitude naturally governs the network's spectral selectivity during training. By jointly optimising the oscillator parameters alongside the network weights, our method adapts to the target signal's spectral content without explicit regularisation. Initialised in the stopband, the network exhibits a coarse-to-fine learning curriculum that progressively expands its spectral gate, capturing low-frequency structures first and high-frequency details only when justified by the reconstruction objective. Comprehensive experiments show that our approach consistently achieves state-of-the-art or competitive results against established INRs, while requiring no task-specific tuning of any hyperparameters.

papers.title: Rethinking Prototype-based Similarity Learning for Few-Shot Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot object detection aims to detect novel object categories from only a few labeled examples, avoiding costly large-scale annotation. Recent prototype-based similarity learning approaches enable training-free adaptation by matching query features with class prototypes. However, they suffer from two fundamental limitations: (i) class confusion arising from inter-class similarity margin collapse, and (ii) insufficient visual cues for precise localization, as similarity scores capture only class-level semantic affinity while providing limited spatial information. To address these issues, we introduce two complementary components. Text-Anchored Semantic Mask (TSMa) leverages class-level text features as semantic anchors to identify semantically aligned channels through channel-wise interaction between visual and text features. By suppressing style-induced spurious responses and emphasizing class-intrinsic signals, TSMa enlarges inter-class similarity margins and mitigates class confusion. We further propose Stage-Aligned Hierarchical Autoregressive Regression (SHARe), which reformulates localization as a hierarchical autoregressive process that progressively refines bounding boxes across multiple stages. SHARe leverages the layer-wise characteristics of ViT representations by aligning feature abstraction levels with regression stages: deeper layers guide early coarse localization, while shallower layers rich in edge and texture cues refine spatial details in later stages. Experiments on COCO demonstrate a new state of the art, outperforming the previous best by +10.1 nAP, with extensive analysis validating each component. The code is available at https://github.com/VisualScienceLab-KHU/ReSet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新思考了基于原型相似性学习的少样本目标检测方法，指出两个问题：类间相似性边距崩溃和定位视觉线索不足。为此提出两个组件：文本锚定语义掩码 (TSMa) 利用类别级文本特征作为语义锚点，通过通道级交互增强类间边距；阶段对齐层次自回归回归 (SHARe) 将定位重构为层次自回归过程，利用ViT不同层特征逐步细化边界框。在COCO上达到新SOTA，比之前最好方法提升+10.1 nAP。
Motivation: 现有基于原型相似性学习的少样本目标检测方法在适应新类别时无需训练，但存在两个根本限制：类间相似性边距塌缩导致类别混淆，以及相似性分数仅捕获类别级语义而缺乏空间信息，导致定位不精确。
Method: 提出文本锚定语义掩码 (TSMa) 和阶段对齐层次自回归回归 (SHARe)。TSMa通过视觉与文本特征的通道级交互识别语义对齐通道，抑制风格引起的虚假响应，增强类内信号。SHARe将定位建模为层次自回归过程，利用ViT深层进行初始粗定位，利用浅层边缘纹理细节进行后续精化。
Result: 在COCO数据集上，该方法比之前最好方法在nAP上提升+10.1，达到新SOTA。
Conclusion: 摘要指出通过TSMa和SHARe两个组件有效缓解了类别混淆和定位不精确问题，实验验证了各组件有效性。代码已开源。

papers.title: Computational references are not experiments: pre-registered validation of machine-learned sodium-cathode voltages
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning screens for battery materials are trained and judged almost entirely against computed reference voltages, and those references carry their own systematic errors. We report a case in which this matters quantitatively: our own screening stack (a graph-network voltage screen, a prior-art triage layer, and a local PBE+U bench) fails pre-registered validation against experiment-anchored literature values. Verdict thresholds, failure modes, and the primary metric were committed before analysis. On an operator-audited set of known Na-ion cathodes (n = 6 after one documented exclusion; verdict unchanged at n = 7), the raw held-out mean absolute error was 0.67 V, the pre-registered conservative metric, the upper 95% confidence bound of the cross-validated bias-corrected error, was 1.09 V, and the residual was strongly voltage-dependent (r = -0.94), so no additive calibration is valid. On the two compounds where prediction, database reference, and experiment could all be compared, the Materials Project PBE+U reference sat about 0.54 V below measurement: the reference, not the model, dominated the error. A prior-art screen found at least 70% of the targeted Na substitution space already published. We retire the screen, bound what "verified" means for our DFT ledger, and pre-register a calibration audit of it against four benchmark Li couples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器学习筛选电池材料时完全依赖计算参考电压（携带系统误差）的问题，报告了预注册验证失败的案例。作者使用图网络电压屏、先验分类层和PBE+U基准，在已知钠离子阴极集上的预注册保守指标（交叉验证偏差校正误差的上95%置信界）为1.09 V，残差强烈依赖电压（r=-0.94），无法进行加性校准。在可比较的两个化合物中，PBE+U参考值比实验测量低约0.54 V，说明参考误差主导了模型误差。
Motivation: 现有机器学习电池材料筛选几乎完全基于带系统误差的计算参考电压进行训练和评估，但其对实验结果的预测准确性未经严格验证。
Method: 采用预注册验证方法，在已知钠离子阴极集上评估图网络电压屏、先验分类层和局部PBE+U基准的组合，预先承诺判定阈值、失效模式和主要指标。
Result: 在操作者审核的已知钠离子阴极集（n=6，排除一个后n=7）上，原始留出平均绝对误差0.67 V，预注册保守指标（交叉验证偏差校正误差的上95%置信界）为1.09 V，残差与电压强相关（r=-0.94）。对两个可比较的化合物，PBE+U参考值比实验低约0.54 V。
Conclusion: 作者指出计算参考而非模型本身主导了误差，因此撤回了该筛选流程，并预注册了针对四个基准锂对的数据校准审计。

papers.title: A Transport-Based Geometry of Belief-Cost
papers.abstract_en: A finite agent, a machine's digital twin or any bounded reasoner, infers a fixed and noisy world through finite sensors, so its coherent output is a belief: a probability density over states (the Bayes posterior). Such an agent stops short of certainty, and revising a belief carries a cost. We propose an axiomatic framework for transport-based belief costs, motivated by these facts. We pose two postulates. P0 (the arena): a revision cost is a scalar price on optimal transport, so beliefs live in Wasserstein space. P1 (uniform pricing): one nat of knowledge costs the same metric length everywhere, the eikonal condition. Among conceivable pricing rules we study this one. Under P0 and P1 the cost metric is optimal transport conformally reweighted by Fisher information, $\tilde g_{e,U}=2(e+U)\,g_{W_2}$, and the Fisher family is a characterization: among continuous reliefs, uniform pricing is equivalent to $U=cJ$. Two consequences follow on the conformal class. Certainty sits at infinite cost-distance once the relief dominates the Fisher information, so a well-posed inference has a cost floor diverging at certainty (necessity conjectural beyond power laws). On location-scale leaves the geometry is hyperbolic, and the Stam bound places the Gaussian as the most curved one (at $e=0$). The results are geometric, in nats. Via Landauer (one nat worth $k_BT$) the cost floor becomes an energy floor: revising toward certainty would demand unbounded energy. Physics anchors the unit and enters no theorem. Removing either postulate leaves the selection open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对有限智能体通过有限传感器推理固定噪声世界的过程，提出基于最优传输的信念成本公理框架。假设修订成本是Wasserstein空间中的标量价格，并满足均匀定价（eikonal条件），得到由Fisher信息共形加权的度量。结论包括确定性需要无限成本距离，位置尺度族上几何是双曲的，且通过Landauer原理成本底限变为能量底限。
Motivation: 有限智能体通过有限传感器推理固定噪声世界，其输出是信念（贝叶斯后验），修订信念有成本，需要建立公理化框架来统一描述这种成本。
Method: 提出两个公设：P0（修订成本是Wasserstein空间上的标量价格）和P1（均匀定价，即知识单位成本处处相同）。研究该定价规则下的几何，得到度量公式并证明Fisher信息族是均匀定价的特征。
Result: 在均匀定价下，确定性位于无穷成本距离（当relief主导Fisher信息时）。位置尺度族上几何是双曲的，Stam界将高斯分布置于最弯曲位置（e=0）。通过Landauer原理，成本底限变为能量底限（修订趋向确定性需无限能量）。
Conclusion: 论文强调该公理框架的几何结果，去掉任一公设则选择开放。物理通过Landauer联系但不出现在定理中。

papers.title: Sparse Point-Guided Fusion of Supervised and Self-Supervised Learning Model for Seaweed Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: The ocean plays a critical role in sustainable development, particularly in climate change mitigation. Among marine ecosystems, blue carbon ecosystems are recognized as important natural carbon sinks. In this context, this paper addresses precise seaweed classification for blue carbon quantification in Ocean Digital Twin initiatives. Conventional methods, including supervised learning (limited by data scarcity and domain gaps) and self-supervised learning (unable to assign class labels), struggle with underwater complexities and diverse seaweed species. To overcome this, we propose a novel two-stage seaweed segmentation technique. This technique first utilizes Supervised and Self-supervised Learning Model Propagation (SSL.Prop.), which leverages supervised learning for initial class information and approximate locations, guiding self-supervised learning for detailed, accurate segmentation. Subsequently, MaskFusion (MF) refines these results by merging instance-level masks for highly accurate segmentation. This integrated approach allows automatic class label assignment and mitigates domain gap effects. Specifically, instance segmentation estimates sparse point locations which then guide self-supervised learning for detailed region segmentation. Evaluated with underwater images from Yamaguchi Prefecture, our full proposed method (SSL.Prop.+MF) achieved a 0.082 mIoU improvement over USIS-SAM, demonstrating significant accuracy gains, particularly for small seaweed. This approach demonstrates strong potential for improving blue carbon quantification and marine ecosystem monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种两阶段海藻分割方法，结合监督学习和自监督学习，通过稀疏点引导融合（SSL.Prop.）和MaskFusion（MF）细化，实现精确的类别标签分配与域差距缓解。在Yamaguchi县水下图像上，完整方法相比USIS-SAM提升0.082 mIoU，尤其对小海藻分割效果显著。
Motivation: 传统监督学习受限于数据稀缺和域差距，自监督学习无法分配类别标签，难以应对水下复杂环境和多样海藻物种，亟需精确分割方法用于蓝碳量化。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段SSL.Prop.利用监督学习提供初始类别和稀疏点位置，引导自监督学习进行详细区域分割；第二阶段MaskFusion融合实例级掩码以细化分割结果。
Result: 在Yamaguchi县水下图像上，SSL.Prop.+MF相比USIS-SAM在mIoU上提升0.082，尤其对小海藻的分割精度提升显著。
Conclusion: 该方法能够自动分配类别标签并减轻域差距影响，为蓝碳量化和海洋生态监测提供了有效工具。

papers.title: SA-VIS: Sparse frame Annotations for training Video Instance Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Recent online video instance segmentation (VIS) methods have achieved impressive results, thus becoming the preferred approach to segment instances in videos. Despite the resurgence of impressive single image models, the online (or semi-online) VIS approaches outperform single-image models (e.g., based on SAM) by using long sequences of densely annotated frames during training. However,such a training setup of VIS is expensive in the sense of compute as well as dense annotations required. In order to solve these major flaws, we argue that the effective modeling of the instances and their evolution in videos do not require densely annotated frames. To that end, we propose a simple and effective module, called Past-frames Feature Propagation (PFP) which aggregates low-dimensional features from the image encoder of multiple frames. This simple low-compute module provides tremendous learning capability in using sparse video frame labels for end-to-end training. Combined with a light-weight frame-specific Instance Queries, our Sparse frame Annotation VIS (SA-VIS) significantly improves performance over its baseline. Most interestingly, our simple design that avoids complexities effectively bridges the gap in accuracy between training on sparsely and densely annotated video sequences. This translates to a mere 0.4% drop in performance of SA-VIS when using annotations for only 1/5 of the images in the dataset. Empirically, SA-VIS shows strong improvements over the baseline on YouTube-VIS 2019/2021/2022 and Occluded VIS (OVIS) and an over 1% improvement in AP on the state-of-the-art in a limited annotations scenario.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SA-VIS，一种利用稀疏帧标注训练视频实例分割 (VIS) 的方法。核心是 Past-frames Feature Propagation (PFP) 模块，它聚合多帧的低维特征，使端到端训练能够使用稀疏标注，并配合轻量帧特定查询。实验表明，在仅使用 1/5 图像标注时，性能仅下降 0.4%，并在 YouTube-VIS 2019/2021/2022 和 OVIS 上超越基线，在有限标注场景下比 SOTA 提升超过 1% AP。
Motivation: 现有在线 VIS 方法依赖密集标注帧进行训练，计算和标注成本高昂。作者认为实例建模不需要密集帧标注，旨在用稀疏标注实现相近性能。
Method: 提出 Past-frames Feature Propagation (PFP) 模块，从图像编码器聚合多帧低维特征，结合帧特定轻量查询，实现基于稀疏帧标注的端到端训练。
Result: 在 YouTube-VIS 2019/2021/2022 和 OVIS 上显著超越基线；仅用 1/5 标注时性能仅下降 0.4%；在有限标注场景下比 SOTA 提升超过 1% AP。
Conclusion: 简单低计算量的 PFP 模块能有效弥合稀疏和密集标注训练之间的精度差距，降低 VIS 标注成本。

papers.title: EventVLA: Event-Driven Visual Evidence Memory for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Memory remains a critical bottleneck for long-horizon robotic manipulation, as standard Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often fail when task-relevant cues become occluded or unobservable over time. While existing memory-augmented methods utilize historical context, they either suffer from severe information bottlenecks, incur high latency via decoupled dual systems, or rely on unselective buffers that accumulate massive visual redundancies. To address these limitations, we introduce EventVLA, an end-to-end framework founded on the concept of sparse visual evidence memory that comprises two core components: foundational visual anchors to retain initial and short-term contexts, and a dynamic Keyframe Evidence Memory (KEM) module. Specifically, KEM directly predicts future keyframe probabilities from the VLA's latent embeddings to autonomously capture and store sparse, task-critical visual events. This foresight-driven mechanism empowers the policy to dynamically evaluate the future causal utility of current observations, preserving transient visual evidence before it becomes unobservable. Furthermore, we propose RoboTwin-MeM, a diagnostic benchmark specifically designed to evaluate non-Markovian manipulation tasks with interactive visual evidence. Extensive evaluations show that across 17 memory-requiring simulation tasks and 4 real-world bimanual tasks, EventVLA achieves an average success rate improvement of +40% over state-of-the-art memory-augmented VLAs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EventVLA，一种基于稀疏视觉证据记忆的端到端框架，用于长时域机器人操作。该方法包含基础视觉锚点和动态关键帧证据记忆模块，通过从 VLA 潜在嵌入中预测未来关键帧概率来自动捕获稀疏的关键视觉事件。在 17 个模拟任务和 4 个真实双臂任务中，相比现有记忆增强 VLA，平均成功率提升 40%。
Motivation: 标准 VLA 策略在长时域操作中因任务相关线索随时间变得遮挡或不可观测而失败；现有记忆增强方法存在信息瓶颈、高延迟或大量视觉冗余的问题。
Method: EventVLA 包含两个核心组件：基础视觉锚点（保留初始和短期上下文）和动态关键帧证据记忆模块——后者从 VLA 潜在嵌入直接预测未来关键帧概率，以自主捕获和存储稀疏的、任务关键的视觉事件。
Result: 在 17 个记忆需求模拟任务和 4 个真实世界双臂任务中，EventVLA 相比最先进的记忆增强 VLA 实现了平均成功率 +40% 的提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，动态记忆关键帧的自主选择与未来因果效用的评估可以有效解决长时域操作中的视觉记忆瓶颈。

papers.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Reservoir Computing
papers.abstract_en: Reservoir computing offers a lightweight framework for forecasting dynamical systems but may struggle to capture long-range dependencies due to limited representational capacity. Conventional reservoir computing recurrently uses trainable reservoirs with hyperparameter sensitivity, while the next-generation reservoir computing removes recurrence at the cost of rapidly growing feature dimensions. Here, we develop Kolmogorov-Arnold Reservoir Computing (KARC), which replaces reservoirs with explicit basis-function expansions inspired by the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem. We rigorously show that KARC is a lightweight design of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs), preserving the potential expressive capacity of KANs while admitting efficient closed-form training of reservoir computing. At comparable cost, KARC outperforms existing reservoir computing methods on challenging benchmarks including partial differential equations. It can also be integrated with generative diffusion models for text-to-image generation. This work thus establishes a principled bridge between reservoir computing and KANs, enabling efficient and high-fidelity dynamical system forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kolmogorov-Arnold 储层计算（KARC），用显式基函数展开替代传统储层，灵感来自 Kolmogorov-Arnold 表示定理。理论证明 KARC 是 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）的轻量级变体，保持了 KAN 的表达能力并支持闭式训练。在偏微分方程等基准上，KARC 以相近计算成本优于现有储层计算方法，并可集成扩散模型用于文本到图像生成。
Motivation: 传统储层计算在捕捉长程依赖方面能力有限，下一代储层计算去除递归但特征维数快速增长。需要一种轻量且高效的方法来处理复杂动态系统。
Method: 用 Kolmogorov-Arnold 表示定理中的基函数展开替代传统储层，设计为轻量级 KAN，支持闭式训练，避免了传统储层计算的超参数敏感性和特征维数爆炸。
Result: 在包括偏微分方程在内的挑战性基准上，以相近计算成本，KARC 性能优于现有储层计算方法。还展示了与扩散模型集成的文本到图像生成能力。
Conclusion: 本文建立了储层计算与 KAN 之间的原理性桥梁，实现了高效高保真的动态系统预测。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Explaining Attention with Program Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: A longstanding goal of research on interpretable deep learning is to replace opaque neural computations with human-meaningful symbolic descriptions. In this paper, we propose an approach for approximating the behavior of components of deep networks with executable programs. We focus on attention heads in transformer language models. For a given head, we first compute its associated attention matrices on a collection of randomly selected training examples. Next, we prompt a pre-trained language model with a summary of these matrices, and instruct it to generate a set of Python programs that can reproduce the associated attention patterns given only text from the input sentence. Finally, we re-rank programs according to how well our final set of programs predict behavior on held-out inputs. We demonstrate that a set of fewer than 1,000 such generated programs can reproduce the attention patterns of heads in GPT-2, TinyLlama-1.1B, and Llama-3B, achieving an average Intersection-over-Union similarity above 75% on TinyStories. Moreover, the best-fit programs can replace neural attention heads without substantially affecting model behavior: replacing 25% of attention heads with programmatic surrogates across the three models incurs only a 16% average perplexity increase, while maintaining performance on a variety of downstream question answering benchmarks. This work contributes a scalable pipeline for reverse-engineering attention heads in transformer models using human-readable, executable code, advancing a path toward symbolic transparency in neural models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用程序合成解释Transformer注意力头：先计算注意力矩阵，利用预训练语言模型生成Python程序来复制注意力模式，再对程序重排序。在GPT-2、TinyLlama-1.1B和Llama-3B上，少于1000个程序即可达到平均IoU>75%，替换25%注意力头仅使困惑度增加16%，且下游问答性能保持。该方法为神经模型提供可读、可执行的符号解释。
Motivation: 可解释深度学习长期目标是替换黑箱神经计算为人类可理解的符号描述，但现有方法难以自动化生成精确的符号解释。
Method: 先对每个注意力头计算其在随机训练样本上的注意力矩阵，然后用预训练语言模型根据矩阵摘要生成候选Python程序，最后根据程序对保留样本的预测性能重排序，选出最佳程序。
Result: 在GPT-2、TinyLlama-1.1B和Llama-3B上，生成的少于1000个程序在TinyStories上平均IoU超过75%；替换25%注意力头后，平均困惑度仅增加16%，且在多个问答基准上性能保持。
Conclusion: 这项工作提供了一个可扩展的流程，用人类可读、可执行的代码反向工程Transformer注意力头，推动神经模型向符号透明迈进。

papers.title: TimeLAVA: Learning-Agnostic Valuation for Time Series Data
papers.abstract_en: Data valuation quantifies the intrinsic quality of individual samples to enable principled data curation, quality control, and robust learning. For time series in critical domains such as healthcare, finance, and industrial monitoring, effective valuation methods are essential yet fundamentally lacking. Existing approaches are either model-dependent, limiting their generalizability, or designed for i.i.d. data and thus fail to capture temporal dependencies, multi-scale patterns, and non-stationary dynamics inherent to sequential data. We introduce TimeLAVA, a learning-agnostic framework that values temporal segments by their marginal contribution to minimizing distributional discrepancy between evaluated and reference data. At its core is a novel Selective Wavelet-based Wasserstein discrepancy combining multi-scale wavelet transforms for temporal localization with unbalanced optimal transport for robustness to distributional shifts. Segment values are efficiently computed via sensitivity analysis without requiring model training and aggregated into point-wise scores. We provide theoretical guarantees linking valuation to model-agnostic generalization and prove bounded sensitivity to outlier contamination. Extensive experiments across anomaly detection, data pruning, and label noise detection demonstrate that TimeLAVA produces significantly more informative value scores than existing methods on diverse real-world datasets.
papers.journal_ref: ICML2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TimeLAVA 是一个无学习依赖的时间序列数据估值框架，通过衡量时间片段对最小化评估数据与参考数据分布差异的边际贡献来赋值。核心是结合多尺度小波变换和非平衡最优传输的选择性小波 Wasserstein 散度，通过敏感性分析高效计算片段价值，并聚合为点级分数。理论上证明了与模型无关的泛化能力和对异常值的鲁棒性。实验在异常检测、数据剪枝和标签噪声检测中显示优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有数据估值方法要么依赖模型（泛化性差），要么针对 i.i.d. 数据（无法捕捉时间依赖、多尺度模式和非平稳动态），而时间序列数据在关键领域（如医疗、金融）缺乏有效的估值方法。
Method: 提出 TimeLAVA 框架，使用 Selective Wavelet-based Wasserstein discrepancy，结合多尺度小波变换进行时间定位和非平衡最优传输以应对分布偏移。通过敏感性分析高效计算片段边际贡献，无需模型训练。
Result: 在异常检测、数据剪枝和标签噪声检测等任务上，TimeLAVA 在多个真实世界数据集上生成的得分比现有方法更具信息量。
Conclusion: TimeLAVA 提供了一种学习无关的时间序列数据估值方法，具有理论保证，适用于多种数据质量相关任务。

papers.title: When Web Agents Finish but Still Fail: Reproducible Triggers and Trace Diagnostics for Parallel Web Exploration
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon web agents often fail in ways hidden by final-answer evaluation: they may visit useful pages, produce a well-formed answer, and terminate confidently while still missing fields, over-including unsupported items, or relying on stale evidence. We study these failures with Parallel WebBench, a parallel web-exploration benchmark containing 1,679 verified records: 350 manually curated parallel tasks and 1,329 reconstructed records with verified URL-based trajectories. We train WebExplorer-style agents with GRPO under human-only, balanced human-synthetic, and synthetic-heavy data mixtures. At 16k context and 16 interaction rounds, the best GRPO model improves completion over WebExplorer-8B from 50.7% to 96.0% and GPT-4.1-mini-judged element-wise F1 from 0.2489 to 0.4529, but binary accuracy remains far below completion. Trace-level analysis identifies three persistent failure modes: context-bound search loops, premature termination on partial answers, and synthesis collapse after relevant evidence has already been retrieved. These results show that synthetic-data GRPO reduces abstention and improves partial correctness, but leaves a completion-correctness gap that requires evidence-grounded coverage and synthesis diagnostics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长期web agent在最终答案评估中隐藏的失败模式，提出Parallel WebBench基准（1679条验证记录），并训练基于GRPO的WebExplorer-style agent。在16k上下文和16轮交互下，最佳GRPO模型将完成率从50.7%提升至96.0%，元素级F1从0.2489提升至0.4529，但二进制准确率仍远低于完成率。分析识别出三种持久失败模式：上下文受限搜索循环、部分答案提前终止、以及证据检索后的合成崩溃。
Motivation: 长期web agent常因最终答案评估的掩盖而失败：它们可能访问有用页面、生成正确格式的回答并自信终止，但仍遗漏字段、过度包含未支持项或依赖过时证据。
Method: 构建Parallel WebBench基准，包含350个手动策划的并行任务和1329个基于URL轨迹的重建记录；采用GRPO训练WebExplorer-style agent，对比人类-only、平衡人类-合成和合成-heavy三种数据混合。
Result: 在16k上下文和16轮交互下，最佳GRPO模型将完成率从50.7%提升至96.0%，GPT-4.1-mini评判的元素级F1从0.2489提升至0.4529，但二进制准确率仍远低于完成率。
Conclusion: 合成数据GRPO减少了放弃率并提高了部分正确性，但留下了完成-正确性差距，需要基于证据的覆盖和合成诊断来弥合。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究长期web agent在最终答案评估中隐藏的失败模式，提出Parallel WebBench基准（1679条验证记录），并训练基于GRPO的WebExplorer-style agent。在16k上下文和16轮交互下，最佳GRPO模型将完成率从50.7%提升至96.0%，元素级F1从0.2489提升至0.4529，但二进制准确率仍远低于完成率。分析识别出三种持久失败模式：上下文受限搜索循环、部分答案提前终止、以及证据检索后的合成崩溃。

papers.title: Sequential Hiring of Contingent Workers Through Learning-Based Optimization
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study a sequential workforce management problem in a contingent labor setting with uncertainty in both worker production and labor supply. A firm seeks to maximize cumulative profit by maintaining an active team of fixed size while learning worker productivity over time. We emphasize two critical operational frictions in this problem: replacing workers is costly, and workers may not be available immediately for hiring because of, for example, prior job commitments, scheduling constraints, or onboarding procedures. Thus, hiring decisions take effect only after a random delay. We formulate this problem as a stochastic multi-play bandit with costly switching and delayed actions, and develop a learning-based hiring policy, DR-UCB (DelayedReplacement-UCB), that makes replacement and hiring decisions sequentially through learning cycles. In each cycle, the policy uses real-time production data to determine when to initiate workforce changes and which workers to replace and hire. We show that the leading-order regret of the proposed policy matches its lower bound in its dependence on the time horizon. Our numerical experiments show that DR-UCB outperforms benchmark policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究临时工招聘问题，考虑工人产出和劳动力供给的不确定性，以及替换成本高昂和招聘存在随机延迟的现实摩擦。将问题建模为带成本切换和延迟动作的随机多臂老虎机，提出DR-UCB策略，通过学习周期做出替换和招聘决策。理论证明该策略的领先阶遗憾界匹配下界，数值实验表明优于基准策略。
Motivation: 临时工招聘中替换工人成本高且招聘存在随机延迟，现有方法未同时处理这些摩擦，导致实际应用效果不佳。
Method: 将问题建模为带成本切换和延迟动作的随机多臂老虎机（stochastic multi-play bandit with costly switching and delayed actions），提出DR-UCB策略。该策略通过学习循环，利用实时生产数据决定何时启动人员变动及替换哪些工人。
Result: 理论分析表明DR-UCB的领先阶遗憾界与其下界在时间跨度上的依赖性匹配，数值实验证明其优于多种基准策略。
Conclusion: 论文表明在考虑替换成本和招聘延迟的临时工招聘中，基于学习的优化策略能实现接近最优的性能，且遗憾界具有理论保证。

papers.title: Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System
papers.abstract_en: Agentic navigation systems require a base navigation model whose observation strategy can be externally reconfigured at inference time, because instruction following, object search, target tracking, and autonomous driving share the same perception-planning backbone yet demand fundamentally different strategies for consuming the visual stream. We present Qwen-RobotNav, a scalable navigation model built on Qwen-RobotNav that addresses it through a parameterised interface with two complementary dimensions: multiple task modes that select the navigation behaviour, and controllable observation parameters (e.g., token budget, per-camera weights) that govern how visual history is encoded. With training-time randomization over all parameters, Qwen-RobotNav is robust to any inference-time configuration requiring zero architectural modification to the Qwen-RobotNav backbone. We train Qwen-RobotNav on 15.6M samples; co-training with vision-language data prevents the collapse into reactive action-sequence mappers observed in trajectory-only training. The parameterised interface also makes Qwen-RobotNav a natural building block for agentic systems: for long-horizon scenarios, an upper-level planner decomposes goals into sub-tasks and dynamically switches Qwen-RobotNav's task mode and context strategy mid-episode, composing complex behaviours from repeated calls to the same model. Extensive experiments show that Qwen-RobotNav sets new state-of-the-art results across major navigation benchmarks. The model exhibits favourable scaling from 2B to 8B parameters, with joint multi-task training developing a shared spatial-planning substrate that transfers across task families, and demonstrates strong zero-shot generalisation to real-world robots across diverse environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Qwen-RobotNav，一个可扩展的导航模型，通过参数化接口支持多种任务模式和可控制的观测参数（如token预算、每相机权重），在15.6M样本上训练，联合视觉-语言数据防止崩溃。在多个导航基准上达到新SOTA，从2B扩展到8B参数表现出有利缩放，并展示了对真实机器人的零样本泛化。
Motivation: 现有导航系统需要基础导航模型能够根据下游任务动态调整观测策略，但不同任务（如指令跟随、目标搜索、目标跟踪、自动驾驶）需要不同的视觉处理方式，缺乏统一可配置的模型。
Method: 构建基于Qwen-RobotNav的模型，引入参数化接口，包含任务模式和观测参数（如token预算、每相机权重），通过训练时随机化所有参数使模型对推理时配置鲁棒。训练集含15.6M样本，联合视觉-语言数据以防止崩溃为反应式动作序列映射器。
Result: 在多个导航基准上达到新SOTA，模型从2B扩展到8B参数表现出有利缩放，联合多任务训练产生共享的空间规划基础并跨任务迁移，在真实机器人上展示强零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: Qwen-RobotNav通过参数化接口成为智能体导航系统的自然构建块，上层规划者可动态切换任务模式和上下文策略，组合出复杂行为。

papers.title: RoboPIN: Grounded Embodied Reasoning via Pinned Chain-of-Thought
papers.abstract_en: Embodied reasoning requires models to perceive task-relevant objects and spaces in physical environments and maintain consistent visual grounding throughout multi-step reasoning. However, current vision-language models rely on text-only or coordinate-augmented chain-of-thought, where entity references remain implicit and ambiguous. This may cause the reasoning process to decouple from visual evidence, entity references to drift across steps, and a causal disconnection between the reasoning trajectory and the final answer, with these problems further amplified in multi-view scenarios due to cross-view appearance changes. To address these issues, we propose Pinned Chain-of-Thought (PinCoT), a structured reasoning paradigm that pins every reasoning step to visual evidence. PinCoT introduces the concept of reasoning anchor, which binds each task-relevant entity to a structured visual anchor with entity name, unique identity, view index, and spatial grounding, enabling consistent entity tracking across reasoning steps and views. We build a fully automated data generation pipeline to construct PIN-170K, a high-quality PinCoT-formatted reasoning dataset. We then train RoboPIN through three-stage post-training that progressively injects embodied knowledge, structured reasoning ability, and process-supervised alignment, with rewards that directly constrain both anchor localization and identity consistency during reasoning. On 14 benchmarks covering embodied spatial reasoning, multi-view reasoning, and pointing, RoboPIN with only 4B parameters consistently outperforms 7B level open-source embodied models, achieving a 12% average improvement over the strongest 7B baseline, Mimo-Embodied. Further analysis shows that PinCoT improves grounding accuracy and cross-step identity consistency, validating the effectiveness of process supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pinned Chain-of-Thought (PinCoT) 结构化推理范式，通过将每个推理步骤锚定到视觉证据（推理锚点：实体名称、唯一ID、视角索引和空间定位）来解决具身推理中实体引用模糊和漂移问题。基于自动构建的 PIN-170K 数据集，训练 RoboPIN 模型（4B参数）并通过三阶段后训练注入具身知识与结构化推理能力。在14个具身推理基准上，RoboPIN 超越7B级别开源模型，平均提升12%。
Motivation: 当前视觉-语言模型在具身推理中使用纯文本或坐标增强的思维链，实体引用隐式且模糊，导致推理过程与视觉证据脱节、实体引用跨步骤漂移以及推理轨迹与最终答案因果断裂，在多视角场景下问题加剧。
Method: 提出 PinCoT 范式，引入推理锚点（reasoning anchor）绑定实体与结构化视觉锚；构建全自动数据生成管线获取 PIN-170K 数据集；通过三阶段后训练（注入具身知识、结构化推理能力、过程监督对齐）训练 RoboPIN，奖励函数直接约束锚点定位与身份一致性。
Result: 在14个涵盖具身空间推理、多视角推理和指向的基准上，RoboPIN（4B参数）平均超越最强7B基线模型 Mimo-Embodied 12%，并提升定位准确性和跨步身份一致性。
Conclusion: PinCoT 通过过程监督和视觉锚点有效改善了具身推理中的视觉定位与实体追踪一致性，验证了结构化推理范式的有效性。

papers.title: Surprise-Guided MergeSort: Budget-Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Ranking via Adaptive Comparison Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise comparison is the gold standard for subjective ranking tasks; however, exhaustive annotation requires a massive number of human comparisons ($O(n^2)$). While sorting-based methods have reduced this burden to $O(n\log n)$, they still require expensive human judgment for every single comparison. To further improve annotation efficiency, we propose leveraging a Vision-Language Model (VLM) not as an annotator replacement, but as a \emph{question prioritizer} to identify which comparisons genuinely require human judgment. The proposed \textbf{Surprise-Guided MergeSort (SGS)} framework achieves this through three integrated components: (1) a bottom-up MergeSort scheduler that structures comparisons and exploits transitivity, (2) a composite Surprise Scorer -- combining position-bias-cancelled VLM confidence, Elo gap, and vote entropy -- to quantify comparison ambiguity, and (3) an adaptive budget allocator that routes high-surprise pairs to humans while automating low-surprise pairs via transitivity inference. Validation was conducted on six diverse benchmarks spanning text similarity (STS-B, BIOSSES, SICKR-STS) and image quality assessment (KonIQ-10k, TID2013, LIVE Challenge). SGS effectively identified and skipped up to 535 non-informative comparisons per session. Consequently, it achieved Kendall's $τ{\times}100$ improvements of $+6$ to $+12$ over Active Elo under the same total budget. These results demonstrate that combining VLM-guided surprise metrics with algorithmic sorting provides a generally consistent accuracy-efficiency trade-off across diverse domains.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Surprise-Guided MergeSort (SGS) 框架，用于高效的人力参与排序任务。该框架利用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为问题优先级排序器，结合自底向上的归并排序调度、组合惊讶评分器（包括位置偏差消除后的 VLM 置信度、Elo 差距和投票熵）以及自适应预算分配器，将高惊讶比较路由给人类，低惊讶比较通过传递性自动处理。在六个文本相似度和图像质量基准上，相同预算下 SGS 相比 Active Elo 在 Kendall's τ×100 上提升 6 到 12 点，并每会话跳过最多 535 次非信息性比较。
Motivation: 成对比较是主观排序的标准，但穷举标注需要海量人力（O(n²)）。排序方法虽将复杂度降至 O(n log n)，但仍需人类判断每次比较。目标是通过 VLM 预先筛选哪些比较真正需要人类判断，从而进一步减少人力开销。
Method: 提出 SGS 框架，包含三个组件：(1) 自底向上的归并排序调度器，利用传递性减少比较次数；(2) 复合惊讶评分器，融合位置偏差校正后的 VLM 置信度、Elo 分差和投票熵，量化比较模糊性；(3) 自适应预算分配器，将高惊讶比较分配给人类，低惊讶比较通过传递性推理自动完成。
Result: 在 STS-B、BIOSSES、SICKR-STS、KonIQ-10k、TID2013 和 LIVE Challenge 六个基准上，SGS 每会话有效识别并跳过多达 535 个非信息性比较。在相同总预算下，Kendall's τ×100 比 Active Elo 提升 6 到 12 点。
Conclusion: 将 VLM 引导的惊讶度量与算法排序相结合，能在不同领域提供一致的准确率与效率权衡。
Relevance: 0
