papers.title: CARE: Controlling LLM-Generated Policies through Auditable Review of Evidence in Scientific Experimentation
papers.abstract_en: Granting LLMs direct control over costly, irreversible scientific experiments leads to unsafe exploration and unstable performance, but discarding LLM creativity entirely sacrifices significant optimization potential. We introduce CARE (Controlling LLM-Generated Policies through Auditable Review of Evidence in Scientific Experimentation), an auditable controller for high-throughput experimentation (HTE) optimization that keeps a non-LLM incumbent optimizer as the default action path while using LLMs to revise challenger ranking policies. Before each outcome is revealed, a public-evidence intervention gate compares the challenger with the incumbent. It authorizes the challenger's selection only when the evidence available before selection supports the change, with the decision recorded in the audit log. CARE outperforms all other evaluated methods on Minerva/Olympus and ChemLex benchmarks, with final-best improving from 80.0 to 88.5 on Minerva/Olympus and from 83.9 to 92.1 on ChemLex, relative to the public incumbent. Our experiments indicate that LLM self-evolution is more reliable when it expands the proposal space under an auditable controller, rather than directly choosing experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CARE框架，通过在科学实验中引入可审计的干预门控机制，让非LLM的改进优化器作为默认动作路径，同时利用LLM修改挑战者排序策略。在Minerva/Olympus和ChemLex基准上，CARE最终最佳值从80.0提升至88.5和从83.9提升至92.1，显著优于所有对比方法。
Motivation: 赋予LLM对昂贵、不可逆科学实验的直接控制会导致不安全探索和不稳定性能，但完全丢弃LLM创造力会损失优化潜力。
Method: CARE框架：保留非LLM的改进优化器作为默认路径，LLM仅用于修订挑战者排序策略；在结果揭示前，通过公共证据干预门比较挑战者与改进者，仅当已有证据支持改变时才授权挑战者选择，并记录决策至审计日志。
Result: 在Minerva/Olympus基准上，最终最佳值从80.0提升至88.5；在ChemLex基准上，从83.9提升至92.1。实验表明，LLM在可审计控制器下扩展提议空间比直接选择实验更可靠。
Conclusion: CARE通过可审计的干预机制安全地利用LLM创造力提升实验优化性能，适用于高通量实验场景。

papers.title: Small LLMs: Pruning vs. Training from Scratch
papers.abstract_en: Pruning promises a shortcut to strong small language models. In this work, we examine this promise by pruning Llama-3.1-8B at pruning ratios of 0.5--0.8 with six methods spanning depth, width, and sparse granularities, under two controlled token-matched settings. (1) With the same training token budget, pruned initialization consistently outperforms random initialization. This shows that the parent model provides a strong starting point, although the advantage narrows as the training token budget grows and as the pruning ratio rises, nearly vanishing at the highest pruning ratio we study. (2) When training from scratch is instead given the full token budget consumed by the whole pipeline, pruning at finer granularities still retains an advantage, while coarser structured pruning can be matched or surpassed. This suggests that the parent model transfers knowledge that additional training tokens alone cannot fully recover, but only at fine granularity. Taken together, our results yield a clear recommendation: with a large pretrained model in hand and a limited training token budget, pruning is better than training from scratch; when the training budget is not limited, training from scratch can be competitive for coarser pruning, so a large pretrained parent is not always necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了从大模型剪枝得到小模型与从头训练小模型的性能差异。在Llama-3.1-8B上以六种剪枝方法（覆盖深度、宽度和稀疏粒度）在0.5-0.8剪枝率下进行实验。结果表明：在相同训练token预算下，剪枝初始化始终优于随机初始化，但优势随预算和剪枝率增加而缩小；若考虑整个管线的总token预算，细粒度剪枝仍保持优势，而结构化剪枝可能被从头训练超越。结论是：在有限训练预算下剪枝更好；预算充足时，粗粒度剪枝下从头训练可与之竞争。
Motivation: 现有研究对剪枝与从头训练在小模型生成上的优劣缺乏系统对比，尤其在不同训练预算和剪枝粒度下缺乏清晰结论。
Method: 在Llama-3.1-8B上以0.5-0.8剪枝率应用六种剪枝方法（涵盖深度、宽度和稀疏粒度），并在两种token匹配设置下与随机初始化从头训练对比。
Result: 相同token预算下剪枝初始化始终优于随机初始化；考虑管线总预算时，细粒度剪枝仍优于从头训练，但粗粒度结构化剪枝可被超越。
Conclusion: 有限预算下推荐剪枝；预算充足时粗粒度剪枝可被从头训练匹敌，大模型父模型并非必需。

papers.title: Agents-K1: Towards Agent-native Knowledge Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Current LLM-based research agents have advanced through agent orchestration, yet largely overlook scientific knowledge orchestration. Existing works often reduce papers to abstracts, surface mentions, and flat \texttt{cites} edges, omitting key entities, claims, evidence, mechanisms, and method lineages essential for scientific reasoning. To this end, we introduce \textbf{Agents-K1}, an end-to-end knowledge orchestration pipeline that converts raw documents into agent-native scientific knowledge graphs. Agents-K1 integrates three components under a unifying theoretical foundation: a multimodal parser whose five-module schema captures entities, multimodal evidence, citations, and typed inter-entity relations across the full paper rather than abstracts alone; a 4B information-extraction backbone trained with GRPO under a rule-based reward; and a graphanything CLI, a tri-source agent interface that unifies web search, multimodal graph retrieval, and cross-document traversal. On top of this, we process 2.46 million scientific papers across six subjects to produce \textbf{Scholar-KG}, of which we release a one-million-paper subset, and the full Scholar-KG is accessible via the SCP link below. The same pipeline can be extended to general-domain corpora and to schema-conformant data synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Agents-K1 achieves superior performance in scientific information extraction, knowledge graph construction, and multi-hop scientific reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agents-K1，一个端到端的科学知识编排流水线，将原始文档转换为智能体可用的科学知识图谱。该流水线包含多模态解析器、基于 GRPO 训练的 4B 信息提取骨干以及三源智能体接口，并处理了 246 万篇论文构建 Scholar-KG。实验表明，Agents-K1 在科学信息抽取、知识图谱构建和多跳科学推理上表现优越。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的研究智能体多关注智能体编排，而忽视了科学知识本身的编排；现有工作常将论文简化为摘要、表面提及和扁平引用，缺少科学推理所需的关键实体、主张、证据、机制和方法谱系。
Method: 提出 Agents-K1 流水线，包含三个组件：五模块多模态解析器（捕获全文实体、多模态证据、引用和类型化关系）、基于 GRPO 和规则奖励训练的 4B 信息提取骨干，以及统一 Web 搜索、多模态图检索和跨文档遍历的三源智能体接口。
Result: 在六个学科领域处理了 246 万篇论文，构建 Scholar-KG 并开放百万论文子集；实验在科学信息抽取、知识图谱构建和多跳推理任务上达到优越性能。
Conclusion: Agents-K1 的统一理论基础使其可扩展至通用领域语料和符合模式的数据合成，为科学推理提供智能体原生知识编排。

papers.title: The Emergence of Autonomous Penetration Capabilities in Large Language Model-Powered AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Nowadays, the autonomous execution of cyberattacks capable of causing substantial real-world harm is widely regarded as one of the critical red lines that frontier AI systems must not cross. Within this broader red-line scenario, autonomous penetration represents a core enabling capability and subtask: the ability of LLM-powered AI systems to independently conduct adversarial operations against a target server without human intervention, identify and exploit vulnerabilities, and obtain unauthorized access or control. A growing body of work has sought to assess the autonomous penetration capabilities of AI systems. However, existing evaluations often employ opaque methodologies, rely on unrealistic or overly simplified penetration-testing scenarios, or provide LLMs with excessive prior knowledge and task-specific guidance, and cannot accurately capture the extent to which modern AI systems can autonomously perform this core capability within broader high-impact cyberattack scenarios. To address these limitations, we construct a new autonomous penetration evaluation framework consisting of two components: target servers and agent scaffolding. Specifically, on the target-server side, we design two levels of target environments based on the number of secure services without known vulnerabilities deployed alongside a vulnerable service: Tier~1 (one secure service) and Tier~2 (three secure services), resulting in a total of 300 target servers. Meanwhile, the agent scaffolding adopts a general-purpose agent architecture equipped with a set of general-purpose cybersecurity tools, without any target-specific prior knowledge. We evaluate 19 open-weight and proprietary LLMs, and find that current models achieve penetration success rates ranging from 10.7% to 69.3%. Moreover, we observe that autonomous penetration capability continues to improve alongside advances in overall model capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个新的自主渗透评估框架，包含两个层次的靶机环境（Tier1和Tier2，共300个靶机）和通用智能体架构，评估了19个开源和专有LLM。摘要报告当前模型的渗透成功率在10.7%到69.3%之间，并发现自主渗透能力随模型整体能力提升而提高。
Motivation: 现有自主渗透评估方法存在方法论不透明、场景不现实、给模型过多先验知识等局限，无法准确衡量LLM在真实高影响网络攻击场景中的自主渗透能力。
Method: 设计两个层次靶机环境（Tier1:1个安全服务+1个脆弱服务；Tier2:3个安全服务+1个脆弱服务），共300个靶机；采用通用智能体架构，配备通用网络安全工具，不提供目标特定先验知识。
Result: 19个模型在自主渗透任务上的成功率为10.7%至69.3%；自主渗透能力随模型整体能力提升而持续改进。
Conclusion: 该框架能更真实地评估LLM自主渗透能力，表明当前模型已具备一定自主渗透能力，但仍有较大提升空间。

papers.title: Breaking the Ice: Analyzing Cold Start Latency in vLLM
papers.abstract_en: As scalable inference services become popular, the cold start latency of an inference engine becomes important. Today, vLLM has evolved into the de-facto inference engine of choice for many inference workloads. Although popular, due to its complexity and rapid evolution, there has not been a systematic study on the startup latency of its engine. With major architectural innovations under it (e.g., the V1 API, introduction of torch.compile), in this paper, we present the first detailed performance characterization of vLLM startup latency. We break down the startup process into six foundational steps and demonstrate that this process is predominantly CPU-bound. Each step exhibits consistent and interpretable scaling trends with respect to model- and system-level parameters, enabling fine-grained attribution of latency sources. Building on these insights, we develop a lightweight analytical model that accurately predicts vLLM's startup latency for a given hardware configuration, providing actionable guidance for resource planning in large-scale inference environments. All our benchmarking datasets, analysis tools, and prediction scripts are open-sourced at https://github.com/upb-cn/vllm-startup-profiler
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 9th MLSys Conference, Bellevue, WA, USA, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地对vLLM推理引擎的冷启动延迟进行了性能特征分析，将启动过程分解为六个基础步骤，发现该过程主要由CPU限制，并针对模型和系统参数展示了可解释的缩放趋势。基于这些洞察，作者开发了一个轻量级分析模型，能够准确预测vLLM在给定硬件配置下的启动延迟，为大规模推理环境中的资源规划提供可操作的指导。所有基准数据集、分析工具和预测脚本均已开源。
Motivation: 随着可扩展推理服务的普及，推理引擎的冷启动延迟变得重要。vLLM已成为许多推理工作负载的事实标准，但由于其复杂性和快速演进，尚未有对其引擎启动延迟的系统性研究。
Method: 将vLLM的启动过程分解为六个基础步骤，并表征每一步的性能特征，发现启动过程主要由CPU限制，且每步对模型和系统级参数呈现一致的、可解释的缩放趋势。基于这些洞察，开发了一个轻量级的解析模型来预测启动延迟。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称该分析框架能够精确归因延迟来源，且解析模型能够准确预测启动延迟。
Conclusion: 该研究为vLLM的冷启动延迟提供了系统性的理解和预测工具，有助于大规模推理环境中的资源规划。

papers.title: Beyond Absolute Scores: Relative Edit-induced Difference for Generalizable Image Aesthetic Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Traditional Image Aesthetic Assessment (IAA) methods mainly rely on regressing absolute Mean Opinion Scores (MOS). However, such a paradigm overlooks the inherently dynamic nature of human aesthetic perception, which relies on subconscious comparison against implicit visual references. Consequently, the lack of causal reasoning regarding aesthetic differences prevents models from learning generalizable aesthetic principles, thus limiting their generalization across diverse scenarios. In this work, we rethink the IAA task and propose Relative Edit-induced Difference Aesthetic learning (RED-Aes), a novel framework that leverages controllable image editing models to simulate the human aesthetic reasoning process. Instead of fitting absolute score distributions, RED-Aes explicitly learns the visual factors that drive aesthetic changes. To support this paradigm, we construct the RED-20k dataset, which comprises editing-based image pairs, quantitative aesthetic differences, and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. Furthermore, we introduce a three-stage training strategy guided by a relative ranking consistency reward, optimizing the model solely via relative supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RED-Aes achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple public benchmarks, exhibiting superior generalization capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的图像美学评估（IAA）框架RED-Aes，通过可控图像编辑模型模拟人类审美推理过程，学习驱动美感变化的视觉因素，而非传统绝对分数回归。构建了包含编辑图像对、定量美学差异和思维链推理的RED-20k数据集，并采用三阶段训练策略，仅通过相对监督优化。实验表明在多个公开基准上达到最先进性能，泛化能力更强。
Motivation: 传统IAA方法忽略人类审美感知的动态性和比较性，缺乏对美学差异的因果推理，导致模型无法学习普遍的美学原则，限制了跨场景泛化。
Method: 提出RED-Aes框架，利用可控图像编辑模型生成编辑图像对，显式学习驱动美学变化的视觉因素。构建RED-20k数据集，包含编辑对、定量美学差异和链式思维推理。采用三阶段训练策略，使用相对排序一致性奖励作为唯一监督。
Result: 在多个公开基准上取得最先进性能，展现出更优的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 相对编辑诱导差异学习框架可有效提升图像美学评估的泛化性，超越传统绝对分数回归范式。

papers.title: A New Angle on Bones: Robust Pose Estimation in X-Ray and Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Measuring the angle between bone structures is a routine task in medical image analysis and provides a key quantitative parameter for diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated methods can reduce time and cost while improving reproducibility. In this work, we address automatic bone pose estimation using a learning-based point candidate proposal followed by a line model to extract axis parameters. Since conventional line models such as least squares are sensitive to outliers, we incorporate false-positive reduction strategies and robust fitting techniques, such as RANSAC and Hough transforms, to improve robustness. We evaluate our method on three clinically relevant paediatric angle estimation tasks: fracture fragment assessment in radiographs and ultrasound and developmental dysplasia of the hip evaluation in ultrasound using the Graf method. Our approach achieves mean errors of $4.1^\circ$, $5.4^\circ$, and $5.51^\circ$, respectively, not only remaining within the expected clinical observer variability, but also significantly outperforming landmark-based methods. Our code and annotations for fracture angle assessment in radiographs are publicly available on GitHub.
papers.comment: Accepted at MIUA 2016 (oral presentation); Code and annotations for fracture angle assessment in radiographs: https://github.com/multimodallearning/RobustBonePoseEstimation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于学习的关键点候选与鲁棒线模型（结合RANSAC和Hough变换）的骨骼姿态估计方法，用于X光片和超声影像中的角度测量。在三种儿科临床任务（骨折片段评估及髋关节发育不良Graf法评估）上，该方法达到平均误差4.1°、5.4°、5.51°，优于基于地标的方法，并处于临床观察者变异范围内。
Motivation: 医学图像中骨骼角度测量是常规诊断依据，但手动测量耗时且可重复性差，现有自动方法易受异常值影响。需要一种鲁棒的自动姿态估计方法。
Method: 采用学习式点候选提议网络，随后使用线模型（如RANSAC和Hough变换）进行鲁棒拟合，并加入假阳性减少策略以提升抗异常值能力。
Result: 在骨折片段评估（X光、超声）和髋关节发育不良超声评估三个任务上，平均角度误差分别为4.1°、5.4°、5.51°，均优于基于地标的基准方法。
Conclusion: 所提方法在儿科骨骼角度估计任务中达到临床可接受的精度，并公开了代码和注释以促进复现。

papers.title: LiftQuant: Continuous Bit-Width LLM via Dimensional Lifting and Projection
papers.abstract_en: Existing quantization methods are fundamentally limited by rigid, integer-based bit-widths (e.g., 2, 3-bit), resulting in a ``deployment gap" where Large Language Models cannot be optimally fitted to specific memory budgets. To bridge this gap, we introduce LiftQuant, a novel framework that enables continuous bit-width control for true Pareto-optimal deployment. The core innovation is a ``lift-then-project" mechanism which approximates low-dimensional weight vectors by projecting a simple 1-bit lattice from a higher-dimensional ``lifted" space. Crucially, the effective bit-width is determined simply by the ratio of the lifted dimension to the original dimension, which allows the bit-width to be tuned quasi-continuous as the dimension is a flexible structural parameter. This projection generates a structured yet non-uniform codebook, capturing the expressive power of Vector Quantization (VQ). While beneficial over VQ, LiftQuant's decoding path relies solely on linear transformations and 1-bit uniform quantizers, retaining hardware-friendly nature. This flexibility is transformative: LiftQuant enables a 70B LLM to be compressed to 2.4 bits to precisely fit a 24GB GPU, where its performance significantly surpasses state-of-the-art 2-bit models fitted on the same device. Our code and ckpt is available at https://github.com/Heliulu/LiftQuant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiftQuant 框架，通过“提升-投影”机制实现连续比特宽度的 LLM 量化。核心在将简单 1-比特格点从高维提升空间投影到低维，使有效比特宽度由维度比准连续可调，产生结构化非均匀码本。实验表明，70B 模型可压缩至 2.4 比特以适配 24GB GPU，性能显著优于最先进 2-bit 模型。
Motivation: 现有量化方法受整数比特宽度限制，模型无法精确适配不同内存预算，产生“部署鸿沟”。需要连续可调的量化方法以优化部署。
Method: 提出“提升-投影”方法：用高维提升空间中的 1-bit 均匀格点投影来近似低维权重向量，通过调节提升维度与原维度之比实现准连续比特宽度控制。码本具有向量量化表现力，解码仅需线性变换和均匀量化器。
Result: LiftQuant 可将 70B 模型压缩至 2.4 比特适配 24GB GPU，在该设备上性能大幅超越最先进 2-bit 量化模型。
Conclusion: 连续比特宽度控制使 LLM 可按内存预算精确压缩，达到帕累托最优部署；且硬件友好。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agent libOS: A Runtime Substrate for Capability-Controlled Self-Evolving LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming long-running software actors rather than fixed tool users. They accumulate memory, activate skills, synthesize tools, fork children, attach remote resources, and commit checkpoints into reusable execution images. These mechanisms improve adaptability, but also create a systems-security failure mode: if exposing an action also grants the authority needed to perform it, self-evolution becomes a permission-escalation path. This paper presents Agent libOS, an agent-native library-OS substrate for capability-controlled self-evolving agents. Its central invariant is that model-visible affordances may evolve while resource authority changes only through explicit, audited runtime primitives. Agent libOS represents an agent as an AgentProcess with process identity, process-local Object Memory, message queues, a tool table, loaded Skills, process-local Deno/TypeScript JIT tools, child processes, budgets, checkpoints, and explicit capabilities. AgentImage objects define boot-time prompt and tool-table state; Skills and JIT tools extend the action surface; checkpoint-derived images make internal state reusable. None of these mechanisms grants filesystem, shell, human, memory, process, checkpoint, image, JSON-RPC, MCP, or PTY authority by itself. The prototype implements process-local namespaces, persistent runtime state, LLM-call observability, human approval queues, budgets, syscall-mediated JIT tools, trusted Runtime Modules, Object-bound PTY sessions, checkpoint restore/fork/commit, JSON-RPC and MCP providers, and a deterministic runtime-safety benchmark. On 27 versioned deterministic tasks, it completed the task plans while preventing all modeled unauthorized side effects, with a 7.0% conservative false-denial rate. Simple wrapper and sandbox baselines preserved task completion but failed most safety checks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Agent libOS，一个专为LLM agent设计的运行时库操作系统，旨在解决自演进agent中动作暴露与权限提升之间的安全矛盾。其核心思想是模型可见的动作集可以动态变化，但资源权限的变更必须通过显式审计的运行时原语进行。原型实现了进程本地命名空间、检查点、JIT工具、可信模块等机制，并在27个确定性安全基准上完成了任务计划，同时阻止了所有建模的非授权副作用，保守假阴性率为7.0%。
Motivation: LLM agents正从固定工具使用者演变为长期运行的软件参与者，能够积累记忆、激活技能、合成工具、派生子进程、挂载远程资源以及创建可复用的执行快照。这种自演进能力提升了适应性，但也引入了系统安全漏洞：如果暴露某个动作的同时也授予了执行该动作所需的权限，那么自演进就变成了一条权限提升路径。
Method: 将agent建模为AgentProcess，包含进程身份、进程本地对象内存、消息队列、工具表、已加载的技能、Deno/TypeScript JIT工具、子进程、预算、检查点和显式能力（capabilities）。AgentImage定义启动时的提示词和工具表状态；Skills和JIT工具扩展动作表面；基于检查点生成的镜像使内部状态可复用。所有机制本身都不授予文件系统、shell、人类交互、内存、进程、检查点、镜像、JSON-RPC、MCP或PTY权限。
Result: 在27个版本化确定性安全任务上，Agent libOS完成了所有任务计划，同时阻止了所有建模的非授权副作用，保守假阴性率为7.0%。相比之下，简单的包装器和沙盒基线虽然保持了任务完成率，但未能通过大多数安全检查。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，Agent libOS通过强制资源权限仅能通过显式、可审计的运行时原语来变更，从而在允许动作集演进的同时维持安全不变性。原型验证了这种设计在真实agent场景中的有效性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Consistent Yet Wrong: Evidence Insensitivity in Spatial Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to robotics, autonomy, and embodied AI, yet modern vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable on metric distance queries. A common assumption is that consistent predictions across viewpoints reflect geometric grounding. We test this assumption and find the opposite: leading VLMs often produce view-invariant and consistent answers even when those answers are incorrect, indicating weak coupling between predictions and viewpoint-specific visual evidence. We introduce \textbf{ViewDiag}, a controlled multi-view evaluation protocol built from Hypersim, ScanNet, and KITTI360, comprising 176 object-pair tracks across 80 scenes with 2--10 views per track. The protocol evaluates models along three axes: metric accuracy, distributional concentration, and internal collapse, the last of which is assessed using a latent feature probe. Across diverse models, we observe a consistent pattern of high prediction stability paired with substantial error, clustering in a regime characterized by strong consistency but low accuracy. \noindent These results challenge the common use of cross-view consistency as a proxy for geometric understanding. Instead, we show that stable predictions may reflect prior-driven collapse rather than evidence-sensitive reasoning. ViewDiag provides a controlled benchmark and diagnostic framework for evaluating whether spatial VLMs are not only accurate, but also meaningfully coupled to visual evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现现代视觉语言模型（VLMs）在度量距离查询中倾向于产生跨视图一致但错误的答案，表明预测与视觉证据的耦合较弱。作者提出ViewDiag多视图评估协议，基于Hypersim、ScanNet和KITTI360构建176个物体对轨迹，从度量准确率、分布集中度和内部塌陷三个维度评估。实验显示模型普遍呈现高稳定性伴随高错误率，挑战了跨视图一致性作为几何理解代理的常用假设。
Motivation: 现有假设认为VLMs的跨视图一致性预测反映了几何基础，但本文发现模型在错误时仍保持一致性，表明预测与视觉证据耦合弱，需要更严格的评估方法。
Method: 引入ViewDiag协议，包含80个场景中的176个物体对轨迹，每个轨迹2-10个视图。评估三个轴：度量准确率、分布集中度（通过熵度量）和内部塌陷（通过潜在特征探针测试）。
Result: 多个VLMs在ViewDiag上表现出高预测稳定性但低准确率，即强一致性-低准确率聚类模式。
Conclusion: 结果质疑了跨视图一致性作为几何理解的代理，稳定预测可能来自先验驱动的内部塌陷而非证据敏感推理。ViewDiag提供了诊断空间VLM是否真正耦合视觉证据的框架。

papers.title: X-Stream: Exploring MLLMs as Multiplexers for Multi-Stream Understanding
papers.abstract_en: While video streaming understanding has made significant strides, real-world applications, such as live sports broadcasting, autonomous driving, and multi-screen collaboration, inherently demand continuous, multi-stream interactions. However, existing benchmarks are confined to single-stream paradigms, leaving a critical gap in evaluating online, cross-stream reasoning. To bridge this, we introduce X-Stream, the first benchmark dedicated to multi-stream streaming understanding. Comprising 4,220 rigorously curated QA pairs across 932 videos, X-Stream evaluates 11 subtasks across multi-window, multi-view, and multi-device scenarios. Crucially, our dataset is constructed using a novel dual-verification pipeline that prevents over-reliance on a single stream. Furthermore, we pioneer the conceptualization of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) as naive multiplexers, systematically evaluating their performance through the lens of Signal Multiplexing Theory. Our extensive online inference experiments reveal a stark reality: state-of-the-art MLLMs struggle significantly with concurrent streams, achieving only about 50% score and exhibiting poor proactive ability. Ultimately, X-Stream exposes the trade-off of current multiplexing schemes, providing both a practical evaluation protocol and empirical guidance for next-generation multi-stream agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 X-Stream，首个专门用于多流流媒体理解的基准，包含 4,220 个精心构建的 QA 对（覆盖 932 个视频）和 11 个子任务，涵盖多窗口、多视角和多设备场景。通过双验证流水线防止对单一流的过度依赖，并利用信号复用理论将多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 概念化为朴素复用器进行评估。在线推理实验表明，最先进的 MLLM 在多并发流上仅达到约 50% 的得分，且主动推理能力薄弱。
Motivation: 现有视频理解基准局限于单流范式，无法评估真实世界中要求的连续多流交互（如直播体育、自动驾驶、多屏协作）中的在线跨流推理能力。
Method: 构建 X-Stream 数据集，采用新型双验证流水线确保 QA 对不依赖单个流；并借鉴信号复用理论，系统评估 MLLM 作为朴素复用器在多流场景下的表现。
Result: 在 4,220 个 QA 对上的在线推理实验显示，当前最先进的 MLLM 在多并发流理解上仅达到约 50% 的得分，且缺乏主动推理能力。
Conclusion: X-Stream 暴露了现有复用方案的权衡，为下一代多流智能体提供了实用的评估协议和经验指导。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 X-Stream，首个专门用于多流流媒体理解的基准，包含 4,220 个精心构建的 QA 对（覆盖 932 个视频）和 11 个子任务，涵盖多窗口、多视角和多设备场景。通过双验证流水线防止对单一流的过度依赖，并利用信号复用理论将多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 概念化为朴素复用器进行评估。在线推理实验表明，最先进的 MLLM 在多并发流上仅达到约 50% 的得分，且主动推理能力薄弱。

summary_sections.method: 构建 X-Stream 数据集，采用新型双验证流水线确保 QA 对不依赖单个流；并借鉴信号复用理论，系统评估 MLLM 作为朴素复用器在多流场景下的表现。

papers.title: SkelMo: Universal Skeletal Motion Generation for 3D Rigged Shapes
papers.abstract_en: Motion generation for rigged shapes is vital for scalable 4D asset production. However, template-based methods are limited by specific topologies and fail to generalize across diverse morphologies. Conversely, per-case optimization is computationally expensive, susceptible to local optima, and highly sensitive to viewpoint-induced ambiguities. In this paper, we present SkelMo, a diffusion-based framework designed for category-agnostic skeletal animation generation from 2D video guidance. To overcome the scarcity of high-quality training data, we have curated a large-scale dynamic dataset comprising approximately 20,000 diverse 3D animations, each featuring complete textures, skeletal rigging, and a wide array of comprehensive animation sequences. To bridge the kinematic gap between 2D visual motion cues and heterogeneous 3D skeletal structures, we propose a structural-semantic injection mechanism. Our model integrates texture and semantic attributes directly into skeletal joint representations. This allows it to map perceived visual dynamics to specific joint hierarchies and their functional roles. This enables SkelMo to synthesize high-fidelity animations that maintain anatomical consistency across a vast range of unseen categories, from existing biological species to fantastical beings. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing methods, setting a new state-of-the-art benchmark for robust and efficient 4D asset generation. Project Page: https://research.davytao.me/skelmo/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SkelMo，一个基于扩散的框架，用于从 2D 视频引导生成与类别无关的 3D 骨骼动画。作者构建了包含约 20,000 个多样化 3D 动画的数据集，并设计结构-语义注入机制，将纹理和语义属性集成到骨骼关节表示中，从而桥接 2D 视觉运动与异构 3D 骨骼结构。实验表明，该方法在广泛未见类别上生成高保真动画，显著优于现有方法，树立了 4D 资产生成的新基准。
Motivation: 现有模板动画方法受限于特定拓扑，无法泛化到多样形态；而逐案例优化计算昂贵，易陷入局部最优，且对视角歧义敏感。因此需要一种能处理异构骨骼结构和未见类别的通用动画生成框架。
Method: 提出 SkelMo 框架，采用扩散模型，并引入结构-语义注入机制，将纹理和语义属性直接集成到骨骼关节表示中，使模型能够将 2D 视觉动态映射到对应的关节层级和功能角色。同时构建了一个包含约 20,000 个高质量 3D 动画的大规模数据集以缓解训练数据稀缺问题。
Result: 在多种未见类别（包括现有生物和幻想生物）上生成高保真动画，保持解剖一致性，性能显著优于现有方法，树立了鲁棒且高效的 4D 资产生成新基准。
Conclusion: SkelMo 通过结构-语义注入和扩散模型实现了类别无关的骨骼动画生成，为 4D 资产生产提供了高效的解决方案。

papers.title: Distilling Neuro-Symbolic Programs into 3D Multi-modal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Current 3D spatial reasoning methods face a fundamental trade-off: neuro-symbolic 3D (NS3D) concept learners achieve interpretable reasoning through compositional programs but are constrained to closed-set concept vocabularies and simple programs; end-to-end 3D multi-modal LLMs (3D MLLMs) could handle complex natural language and open-vocabulary concepts but suffer from black-box reasoning without explicit spatial verification. We introduce APEIRIA, a neuro-symbolic 3D MLLM to bridge two paradigms by distilling symbolic reasoning patterns into MLLMs with natural language chain-of-thought. Our three-stage curriculum progressively builds reasoning capabilities: a) 3D perception alignment grounds object visual-geometric features to the LLM, b) CoT-SFT teaches query decomposition and stepwise verification from symbolic program traces, and c) CoT-RL extends reasoning patterns to open-set concepts and deeply nested instructions. By transferring reasoning patterns rather than concept-specific knowledge, APEIRIA preserves key NS3D virtues: transparent reasoning and modular interchangeability of planning and perception components. Evaluations on grounding, question answering, and captioning show that APEIRIA surpasses prior NS3D methods and matches state-of-the-art 3D MLLMs on 3D spatial reasoning datasets, unifying symbolic methods' systematic reasoning with MLLMs' flexibility. Code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/APEIRIA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出APEIRIA，一种通过蒸馏神经符号程序到3D多模态大语言模型的方法，旨在结合符号推理的透明性与MLLM的灵活性。该方法采用三阶段课程学习：3D感知对齐、基于符号程序轨迹的CoT监督微调以及通过强化学习扩展推理模式。实验表明APEIRIA在接地、问答和描述任务上超越先前的神经符号方法，并匹配最先进的3D MLLM。
Motivation: 当前3D空间推理方法面临根本性权衡：神经符号方法可解释但局限于封闭集概念和简单程序，而端到端3D MLLM能处理复杂自然语言但缺乏可解释的空间验证。
Method: 提出三阶段课程学习：a) 3D感知对齐将视觉几何特征对齐到LLM；b) CoT-SFT从符号程序轨迹学习查询分解和逐步验证；c) CoT-RL将推理模式扩展到开放集概念和深层嵌套指令。
Result: 在接地、问答和描述任务上，APEIRIA超越先前的神经符号方法，并与最先进的3D MLLM相匹配。
Conclusion: 通过转移推理模式而非概念特定知识，APEIRIA保留了神经符号方法的透明推理和模块化可互换性，统一了符号方法的系统推理与MLLM的灵活性。

papers.title: Pause and Think: A Dataset and Benchmark for Video-Grounded Assistive Action Suggestion
papers.abstract_en: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle with grounded reasoning, temporal consistency, and context aware planning in videos. We introduce pause-and-think-T, a reasoning-centric training dataset that encourages models to pause, reason over visual evidence, and produce concise, actionable responses. The dataset promotes structured reasoning prior to answer generation, guiding models toward human-like, scene-grounded assistance. We fine-tune a compact 4B-parameter model and evaluate it on our pause-and-think-B benchmark targeting contextual understanding and goal planning tasks. The model achieves 58.0% accuracy at 59x fewer parameters than Qwen3-VL-235B (58.9%), matching GPT-5.2 on scene understanding and surpassing GPT-4o. Beyond our benchmark, it also shows strong out-of-distribution performance on EgoThink and TempCompass, with substantial gains in affordance, assistance, attribution recognition, situated reasoning, and temporal order, without benchmark-specific training. Our results indicate that targeted reasoning supervision enables compact models to deliver actionable, visually grounded guidance while generalizing beyond training data, without requiring large-scale model expansion.
papers.comment: Accepted in IROS 2026 (IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 pause-and-think-T 训练数据集，通过鼓励模型在生成回答前暂停并推理视觉证据，以提升视频基础动作建议的接地推理、时序一致性和上下文感知规划。微调了一个 4B 参数紧凑模型，在 pause-and-think-B 基准上达到 58.0% 准确率，参数数量仅为 Qwen3-VL-235B 的 1/59，但性能接近（58.9%）；在场景理解上匹配 GPT-5.2，超越 GPT-4o。模型在 EgoThink 和 TempCompass 等分布外基准上也表现出显著提升，特别是在 affordance、assistance、attribution 识别、情境推理和时序顺序任务上。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在视频接地推理、时序一致性和上下文感知规划方面存在不足，缺乏能够引导模型进行结构化推理的训练数据。
Method: 构建 pause-and-think-T 推理中心训练数据集，要求模型在生成答案前先进行结构化推理；基于此微调一个 4B 参数的紧凑视觉-语言模型，并在 pause-and-think-B 基准上评估。
Result: 模型在 pause-and-think-B 上达到 58.0% 准确率，参数仅为 Qwen3-VL-235B 的 1/59，但性能接近；场景理解匹配 GPT-5.2，超越 GPT-4o。在 EgoThink 和 TempCompass 上无需基准特定训练即取得分布外性能提升。
Conclusion: 目标推理监督能够使紧凑模型提供可行动的、视觉引导的指导，并泛化到训练数据之外，无需大规模模型扩展。

papers.title: Bridging Reasoning Trajectories in On-Policy Distillation via Near-Future Guidance
papers.abstract_en: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) improves large language model reasoning by training a student model on trajectories sampled from its own policy under teacher supervision. Although OPD operates on trajectories, its learning signal remains token-level: it identifies deviations through high-loss tokens and repairs them through local reverse-KL correction. We show that this "trajectory-sampled but token-learned" mechanism cannot reliably bridge student trajectories toward teacher trajectories. About 30% of high-loss tokens fall into the low-divergence regime, indicating that many are surface-form mismatches rather than real reasoning forks. Moreover, even truly divergent tokens are difficult to repair with isolated token-level supervision, since reasoning failures often unfold as short-horizon distributional drift. We propose Trajectory-aware OPD (TOPD), which uses near-future trajectory information to identify real divergent states and distribute guidance across multiple future tokens. Experiments show that suppressing non-divergent high-loss tokens improves standard OPD from 47.8% to 48.2% average accuracy, while TOPD further improves performance to 52.2%, with gains on AIME24 from 60.0% to 63.3% and AIME25 from 46.7% to 53.3%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析On-Policy Distillation (OPD)在大型语言模型推理中的局限性，指出其轨迹采样但token级学习的机制无法有效弥合学生与教师轨迹间的偏差。提出Trajectory-aware OPD (TOPD)，利用近未来轨迹信息识别真正发散状态并跨多个未来token分配指导。实验显示，抑制非发散高损失token可将标准OPD准确率从47.8%提升至48.2%，TOPD进一步达到52.2%，在AIME24和AIME25上分别从60.0%提升至63.3%、从46.7%提升至53.3%。
Motivation: 现有OPD在token级进行反向KL修正，但约30%的高损失token属于表面形式不匹配而非真正推理分歧，且孤立token监督难以修复因短期分布漂移导致的推理失败。
Method: 提出TOPD，通过近未来轨迹信息识别真正发散状态，并跨多个未来token分配引导信号，同时抑制非发散高损失token的干扰。
Result: 在推理基准上，抑制非发散token将OPD平均准确率从47.8%提至48.2%，TOPD进一步提至52.2%；具体地，AIME24从60.0%提至63.3%，AIME25从46.7%提至53.3%。
Conclusion: TOPD通过轨迹感知的引导机制有效提升OPD在推理任务上的性能，尤其在高难度数学推理上取得显著增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lumos-Nexus: Efficient Frequency Bridging with Homogeneous Latent Space for Video Unified Models
papers.abstract_en: Connector-based video unified models have demonstrated strong capability in instruction-grounded video synthesis, but integrating a large high-fidelity generator into the unified training loop is computationally prohibitive, limiting achievable visual quality. We therefore propose Lumos-Nexus, a training-efficient unified video generation framework that facilitates the development of strong reasoning-driven generation capabilities while significantly enhancing visual fidelity. Lumos-Nexus adopts a two-stage design: 1) During training, only a lightweight generator is aligned with the understanding block to learn to take in reasoning-driven semantic control. 2) During inference, we introduce Unified Progressive Frequency Bridging (UPFB) to progressively hand off generation to a high-capacity pretrained generator in the shared latent space, enabling coarse-to-fine refinement and producing high-fidelity videos without compromising reasoning quality. To fill the gap in reasoning-driven video generation benchmarks, we introduce VR-Bench, which assesses a model's capability to translate inferred intent into coherent and semantically aligned video content. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Lumos-Nexus achieves substantial gains in visual realism and temporal coherence on VBench, while exhibiting strong reasoning-based generative performance on VR-Bench. Code and models are available at https://jiazheng-xing.github.io/nexus-lumos-home/.
papers.comment: ECCV 2026 Camera-Ready Version. Project page (https://jiazheng-xing.github.io/nexus-lumos-home/) and Code (https://github.com/alibaba-damo-academy/Lumos-Custom/) are available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Lumos-Nexus 提出了一种两阶段训练框架，用于构建高效的视频统一模型。训练阶段仅使用轻量级生成器与理解模块对齐以学习推理驱动的语义控制；推理阶段通过统一渐进式频率桥接（UPFB）在共享潜在空间中逐步切换至高性能预训练生成器，实现从粗到细的细化，生成高保真视频。同时引入 VR-Bench 基准评估推理驱动的视频生成能力。实验表明，该方法在 VBench 上显著提升视觉逼真度和时间连贯性，在 VR-Bench 上展现强大的推理生成性能。
Motivation: 现有基于连接器的视频统一模型整合高保真生成器时计算成本过高，限制了视觉质量。
Method: 两阶段设计：训练阶段仅对齐轻量级生成器与理解模块；推理阶段采用UPFB渐进式频率桥接，在共享潜在空间中将生成任务逐步转移至高性能生成器。
Result: 在VBench上实现视觉逼真度和时间连贯性的显著提升，在VR-Bench上展现强推理生成性能。
Conclusion: Lumos-Nexus 能高效提升视频统一模型的视觉质量，同时保持推理能力。

summary_sections.tldr: Lumos-Nexus 提出了一种两阶段训练框架，用于构建高效的视频统一模型。训练阶段仅使用轻量级生成器与理解模块对齐以学习推理驱动的语义控制；推理阶段通过统一渐进式频率桥接（UPFB）在共享潜在空间中逐步切换至高性能预训练生成器，实现从粗到细的细化，生成高保真视频。同时引入 VR-Bench 基准评估推理驱动的视频生成能力。实验表明，该方法在 VBench 上显著提升视觉逼真度和时间连贯性，在 VR-Bench 上展现强大的推理生成性能。

papers.title: PatchWorld: Gradient-Free Optimization of Executable World Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-agent environments are typically modeled as partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs), assuming that the simulator's latent state and transition dynamics are hidden from the agent. Yet little work has examined whether executable code can be induced to serve as a world model for prediction and planning under partial observability. We introduce PatchWorld, a gradient-free framework that turns offline trajectories into executable Python world models through counterexample-guided code repair. Instead of predicting the next observation with a black-box model, PatchWorld induces symbolic belief-state programs whose action updates can be inspected, replayed, and locally patched. Across seven AgentGym environments, PatchWorld-Simple achieves the highest code-based planning score among evaluated methods, reaching 76.4% macro success in live one-step lookahead while invoking no LLM calls inside the world-model prediction module itself. We further find that a human-specified residual-memory bias improves surface observation fidelity but weakens decision utility. This exposes a tradeoff in executable world models, since improving observation fidelity can come at the expense of action-discriminative dynamics, and vice versa. Code is available at https://github.com/HKBU-KnowComp/PatchWorld.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PatchWorld 是一个无需梯度的框架，通过反例引导的代码修复，将离线轨迹转化为可执行的 Python 世界模型。在七个 AgentGym 环境中，PatchWorld-Simple 实现了 76.4% 的宏成功率的单步前瞻规划，并且世界模型预测模块内部不调用 LLM。同时发现人工指定的残差记忆偏差可提升表面观测保真度但降低决策效用。
Motivation: 现有文本智能体环境通常使用黑盒模型预测下一观测，缺乏可解释性和可调试性。本文试图通过诱导可执行代码作为世界模型，实现部分可观测下的预测与规划。
Method: 提出 PatchWorld 框架：利用反例引导的代码修复，从离线轨迹中归纳出符号化的信念状态程序，该程序的动作更新可检查、可重放、可局部修补。
Result: 在七个 AgentGym 环境中，PatchWorld-Simple 达到最高代码规划得分，单步前瞻宏成功率为 76.4%，且世界模型模块内无 LLM 调用。残差记忆偏差提升观测保真度但降低决策效用。
Conclusion: 可执行世界模型存在观测保真度与动作判别动力学的权衡，PatchWorld 提供了一种高效的、无需梯度的构建方式。

papers.title: MetaRanker: Human-in-the-loop Active Ranking for Metalens Image Quality
papers.abstract_en: Image quality in modern imaging systems emerges from the coupled effects of the sensor, optics, and computational reconstruction. Ultra-thin metalenses offer a path toward substantial miniaturization of optical modules, but practical designs often exhibit pronounced chromatic and field-dependent aberrations that necessitate computational reconstruction. In current metalens pipelines, reconstruction models are commonly trained and selected using distortion-based fidelity objectives, such as PSNR, yet these proxies can be weakly correlated with human preference and downstream utility, reflecting the well-known perception--distortion trade-off. We introduce MetaRanker, a human-in-the-loop active ranking framework that formalizes metalens image quality in terms of semantic interpretability, defined as the degree to which humans can reliably recognize objects and structures in the presence of optical artifacts. MetaRanker combines a probabilistic preference model with uncertainty-aware query selection, and leverages vision--language models to provide lightweight semantic priors. Importantly, these priors are used only to guide the sampling of informative comparisons; human judgments remain the primary supervision signal throughout. Across real-world and synthetic metalens datasets with distinct degradation profiles, MetaRanker produces rankings that align most closely with human assessments, while reducing the number of pairwise annotations required by approximately 80% relative to exhaustive pairwise evaluation. Finally, we show that standard image quality assessment metrics exhibit limited alignment with human interpretability in the metalens domain, positioning MetaRanker as a practical step toward perceptually grounded metalens evaluation and co-design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaRanker，一个人机协同主动排序框架，用于评估超薄金属透镜 (metalens) 图像质量，以人类可解释性为指标，结合概率偏好模型和不确定性感知查询选择，并利用视觉-语言模型提供轻量级语义先验，仅用于引导有效比较采样，人类判断仍是主要监督。在真实和合成数据集上，MetaRanker 生成的排序与人类评估高度一致，并且相比穷举成对比较，所需标注量减少了约 80%。
Motivation: 当前金属透镜成像系统中，重建模型通常基于失真保真度目标（如 PSNR）训练和选择，但这些代理指标与人类偏好和下游实用性的相关性较弱，存在感知-失真权衡（perception-distortion trade-off）。需要一种更符合人类感知的质量评估方法。
Method: 提出 MetaRanker 框架：结合概率偏好模型与不确定性感知的查询选择，利用视觉-语言模型提供轻量级语义先验（仅用于引导采样），人类判断作为主要监督信号。采用主动学习方式，减少标注量。
Result: 在真实和合成金属透镜数据集上，MetaRanker 生成的排序与人类评估一致性最高，且相比穷举成对评估，所需注释量减少约 80%。
Conclusion: 标准图像质量评估指标在金属透镜领域与人类可解释性对齐有限，MetaRanker 为基于感知的金属透镜评估和协同设计提供实用步骤。

papers.title: Theoretical Foundations and Effective Algorithms for Policy-Aware Simulator Learning
papers.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) agents typically learn world models by minimizing predictive loss. However, powerful RL optimizers inevitably exploit minor model inaccuracies, leading to simulator exploitation and a reality gap where policies succeed in simulation but fail in the real world. We propose that the objective for learning simulators should be strategic robustness rather than predictive accuracy, and formulate this as a zero-sum minimax game between a model player and an adversarial policy player. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis: (1) an online learning guarantee showing the game is learnable with sublinear regret bounds; (2) a tractable critic-based simplification bounding the global policy-value gap by the local critic's loss; and (3) an Error-MDP duality, proving that finding the worst-case policy is formally dual to a standard RL problem where the reward is the one-step critic error. This duality yields a provably convergent active data selection algorithm. Experiments on continuous control tasks demonstrate that our approach reduces prediction error in strategically important regions by $1.5$-$2.2\times$ and enables policies trained purely in simulation to match near-optimal real-world performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对模型基强化学习（MBRL）中模拟器被智能体利用导致现实差距的问题，提出策略感知模拟器学习（policy-aware simulator learning）框架，将其形式化为模型玩家与对抗策略玩家之间的零和极小极大博弈。作者提供了完整的理论分析，包括在线学习保证、基于评论家的简化以及误差-MDP对偶性，并由此导出可证明收敛的主动数据选择算法。在连续控制任务上，该方法在策略关键区域将预测误差降低1.5-2.2倍，使仅基于模拟器训练的策略接近真实环境最优性能。
Motivation: 传统MBRL通过最小化预测损失学习世界模型，但强化学习优化器会利用模型微小的不准确性，导致模拟器被利用（simulator exploitation）和现实差距（reality gap），即策略在模拟中成功但在真实世界中失败。因此需要一种策略鲁棒而非仅预测准确的模拟器学习目标。
Method: 提出将模拟器学习形式化为零和极小极大博弈，包含模型玩家和对抗策略玩家。理论贡献包括：(1) 在线学习保证，证明博弈可学习且具有次线性遗憾界；(2) 基于评论家的简化，将全局策略价值差距限制为局部评论家损失；(3) 误差-MDP对偶性，证明寻找最坏情况策略等价于以单步评论家误差为奖励的标准RL问题，从而导出可证明收敛的主动数据选择算法。
Result: 在连续控制任务上，该方法在策略关键区域将预测误差降低1.5-2.2倍，使得仅在模拟器中训练的策略能够匹配接近最优的真实世界性能。
Conclusion: 论文强调了将模拟器学习目标从预测准确转向策略鲁棒性的重要性，并提供了理论框架和有效算法。

papers.title: ChainCaps: Composition-Safe Tool-Using Agents via Monotonic Capability Attenuation
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using agents increasingly operate in open-ended deployment environments, where they compose file systems, web APIs, code interpreters, and enterprise services at runtime. This creates a safety gap in tool composition: an agent can satisfy every per-tool permission check and still produce an unsafe end-to-end effect, such as reading a confidential document, summarizing it, and sending the summary to an external endpoint. We call this failure mode permission laundering. ChainCaps addresses it with a runtime rule: every value carries a sink-specific capability budget, and tool composition propagates budgets by intersection. A value can preserve or lose authority as it moves through a tool chain, but it cannot gain new authority through composition. We implement ChainCaps as a transparent MCP proxy that requires no changes to the agent or tool servers. On 82 tasks across five frontier models from three providers, ChainCaps reduces attack success rate from 25-68% to 0-4.8% while preserving 96-100% benign completion. In replay experiments, it also outperforms scalar-IFC and per-function-isolation baselines. Manifest quality is the dominant deployment bottleneck: expert manifests reach 100% attack blocking, while naive manifests fall to 27.3%. Our claims are limited to explicit-flow composition safety under trusted manifests and proxy-visible data movement, a practical gap in deployed tool-using agents today.
papers.comment: Published at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD) at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工具使用代理在组合多个工具时产生的安全漏洞（权限洗钱），提出ChainCaps机制。该机制通过给每个值附加能力预算，并在工具链中按交集传播，确保组合后不会获得新的权限。实现为透明MCP代理，无需修改代理或工具服务器。在82个任务上，五个前沿模型攻击成功率从25-68%降至0-4.8%，良性疾病完成率保持96-100%。
Motivation: 现有工具使用代理尽管每个单独工具都通过权限检查，但组合使用可能导致不安全的结果，如读取机密文档并外发。这种权限洗钱模式是当前部署中的实际安全缺口。
Method: 提出ChainCaps规则：每个值携带一个接收器特定的能力预算，工具组合通过交集传播预算，值只能在链中保持或损失权限，不能获得新权限。实现为透明的MCP代理，无需修改代理或工具服务器。
Result: 在82个任务上，ChainCaps将攻击成功率从25-68%降至0-4.8%，良性疾病完成率保持96-100%。在回放实验中优于标量IFC和每函数隔离基线。专家manifest可达100%攻击阻断，而朴素manifest仅27.3%。
Conclusion: ChainCaps在可信manifest和代理可见数据移动的假设下，证明了显式流组合安全的有效性。manifest质量是部署瓶颈，未来需改进manifest编写。

papers.title: Exascale Hybrid Numerical-AI Ensembles for Operational Flood-Season Forecasting in East Asia: 15-km Decadal Hindcasts and 1-km High-Resolution Capability
papers.abstract_en: Seasonal forecasting of summer rainfall in East Asia remains a grand challenge, as predictability at 3 to 6 month lead times is constrained by the spring predictability barrier, weak large-scale signals, and localized nonlinear convective extremes. We address this challenge with CAPES, which integrates a kilometer-resolution coupled regional model with atmosphere, land, and ocean components and a data-driven AI seasonal forecasting system. At 15 km resolution, the fused workflow combines 174 numerical members from varying start times, physics schemes, and parameter perturbations with 1,600 AI members generated from initial and physical perturbations. Using the full LineShine system, CAPES completes ten annual 1,774-member hindcasts for 2016 to 2025 within 14.6 hours, improving the mean prediction score from ECMWF's 71.8 to 75.9 and delivering a major gain in operational forecasting capability. The 1-km configuration further enables fine-scale typhoon simulation and establishes the feasibility of kilometer-scale fused ensemble forecasting on a one-week timescale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CAPES 系统集成公里分辨率耦合区域模型与数据驱动 AI 季节性预报系统，针对东亚夏季风季节预报挑战，在 15 km 分辨率下融合 174 个数值成员和 1600 个 AI 成员完成 10 年（2016–2025）每年 1774 成员的回顾预报，耗时 14.6 小时，将平均预测评分从 ECMWF 的 71.8 提升至 75.9；1 km 配置还实现了精细台风模拟和公里尺度融合集合预报的可行性。
Motivation: 东亚夏季风季节预报面临春季可预报性障碍、弱大尺度信号和局地非线性对流极端事件等挑战，亟需提升 3–6 个月提前期的预测能力。
Method: 提出 CAPES 框架，结合公里分辨率耦合区域模型（大气–陆地–海洋）与数据驱动 AI 季节性预报系统。15 km 分辨率工作流融合 174 个数值成员（多起始时间、物理方案、参数扰动）和 1600 个 AI 成员（初始和物理扰动），并利用 LineShine 系统高效完成大规模集合预报。

papers.title: The Neglected Baseline in Model Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: We observe that existing model interpretation methods generally ignore the baseline, and such neglect often results in imprecise or even incorrect interpretation. In this paper, we reformulate the task of model interpretation and the interpretation principles for model interpretation results to demonstrate the importance of the baseline. For the first time, we unify gradient-based methods, Integrated Gradients (IG), and Taylor expansion, clarify the relationships among the three, and explicitly identify the corresponding baseline for each method. This may have a significant impact on the further performance improvement of some gradient-based schemes. On this basis, we analyze the flaws and errors in related model interpretation methods (IG, LayerCAM, ODAM, Difference Map). We advocate evaluating the quality of model interpretation results precisely through the attribution error between the attribution result and the attribution target, rather than adopting flawed evaluation methods, such as those based on marginal-effect or the assumption of perfect model performance. We revise IG and develope a model interpretation method with a clear and reasonable baseline, achieving better results. Our method supports model interpretation based on features from any layer. Interpretation based on features from different layers are all reasonable, and the differences among these results reflect varying degrees of feature extraction at different feature extraction stages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文指出当前模型解释方法普遍忽略基线（baseline）导致解释不精确甚至错误，首次统一梯度方法、Integrated Gradients（IG）和泰勒展开，明确各方法的对应基线，并分析了现有方法的缺陷。在此基础上，作者修正了IG并提出一种具有清晰合理基线的模型解释方法，支持基于任意层特征的解释，并声称获得更好的解释结果。
Motivation: 现有模型解释方法通常忽略基线，导致解释结果不精确或错误，作者认为需要重新审视基线在解释中的核心作用。
Method: 重新定义模型解释任务与原则，统一梯度方法、IG与泰勒展开，明确各方法的基线；分析IG、LayerCAM、ODAM、Difference Map等方法的错误；修正IG提出带合理基线的新方法，支持任意层特征的解释。
Result: 摘要报告新方法在模型解释上获得更好结果，且基于不同层特征的解释均合理，反映不同特征提取阶段的差异。
Conclusion: 强调基线对于模型解释的重要性，指出当前评估方法（基于边际效应或假设完美模型）存在缺陷，应通过归因误差（attribution error）精确评价解释质量。

papers.title: Decomposing Ensemble Spread in Lorenz '96 With Learned Stochastic Parameterizations
papers.abstract_en: Weather and climate forecasts are inherently uncertain due to chaotic dynamics, imperfect initial conditions, and incomplete representation of the underlying physical processes. Operational ensemble forecasts aim to represent these uncertainties through forecast spread, yet many approaches yield underdispersive estimates, with spread that grows too slowly relative to forecast error. Using the two-scale Lorenz 1996 system as a widely used, controlled testbed, we design a systematic approach to disentangle intrinsic variability, initial-condition perturbations, and stochastic model uncertainty. We compare multiple ensemble configurations and parameterization strategies, including existing deterministic and autoregressive as well as novel Bayesian and flow-based approaches. Our results show that ensemble perturbations do not increase the system's long-term variance; rather, they regulate how rapidly trajectories decorrelate and explore the invariant measure. Stochastic parameterizations, particularly those with temporally persistent structure, enhance early spread growth and improve spread-error consistency. Overall, we bring clarity to how different sources of uncertainty interact in a chaotic system and provide guidance for the design and evaluation of stochastic parameterizations in weather and climate models.
papers.comment: Accepted as a conference paper at UAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在双尺度Lorenz 1996系统中，系统性地分解了集合预报的展开来源，包括内在变率、初值扰动和随机模型不确定性。比较了多种参数化策略，发现随机参数化（尤其具有时间持久结构）能增强早期展开增长并改善展开-误差一致性。
Motivation: 天气和气候集合预报常出现欠扩散（underdispersion），即展开增长慢于预报误差。需要厘清不同不确定性来源如何相互作用，以改进随机参数化设计。
Method: 在Lorenz '96系统中设计多种集合配置和参数化策略，包括确定性、自回归、贝叶斯和基于流（flow-based）方法，对比其对长期方差和轨迹去相关速率的影响。
Result: 集合扰动不增加系统长期方差，但调节轨迹去相关速率和不变测度的探索。具有时间持久结构的随机参数化能提升早期展开增长和展开-误差一致性。
Conclusion: 为混沌系统中不同不确定性来源的相互作用提供了理解，并为天气和气候模型中随机参数化的设计和评估提供了指导。

papers.title: Objective-Induced Bias and Search Dynamics in Multiobjective Unsupervised Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised feature selection is commonly formulated as a multiobjective optimisation problem that jointly optimises subset quality and subset size. Yet the behaviour of this formulation depends critically on the choice of evaluation objective, the direction of subset-size regularisation, and the initialisation strategy. We study these factors in a controlled setting using a synthetic dataset with known informative, redundant, and irrelevant feature types. Six formulations are compared by combining three evaluation objectives: accuracy, silhouette score, and PCA reconstruction loss with subset-size minimisation or maximisation. The results show that formulation strongly affects both search dynamics and the quality of the resulting Pareto front. Silhouette-based formulations exhibit a strong bias toward trivial low-cardinality solutions and remain weak proxies for predictive performance. In contrast, the proposed PCA loss objective produces compact subsets with test accuracy comparable to subsets obtained by directly optimising supervised accuracy. Overall, the study shows that objective design is central to effective multiobjective unsupervised feature selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过合成数据集研究多目标无监督特征选择中目标函数、子集规模正则化方向和初始化策略对搜索动态和帕累托前沿质量的影响。比较了三种评价目标（准确率、轮廓系数、PCA重构损失）与子集规模最小化或最大化的六种组合。结果表明，基于轮廓系数的公式倾向于低基数平凡解，而PCA损失目标能产生与监督准确率相当的紧凑子集。
Motivation: 无监督特征选择常被表述为多目标优化问题，但目标选择和子集规模正则化方向对行为的影响缺乏系统理解。
Method: 在已知信息特征、冗余特征和无关特征的合成数据集上，比较六种公式：三种评价目标（准确率、轮廓系数、PCA重构损失）分别与子集规模最小化或最大化组合。
Result: 基于轮廓系数的公式产生低基数平凡解，且是预测性能的弱代理；提出的PCA损失目标产生的紧凑子集在测试准确率上与直接优化监督准确率的子集相当。
Conclusion: 目标设计是多目标无监督特征选择有效性的核心因素。

papers.title: SCRIBE: Diagnostic Evaluation and Rich Transcription Models for Indic ASR
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speech recognition replaces typing only when correction costs less than manual entry - a threshold determined by error types, not counts: fixing a misrecognized domain term costs far more than inserting a comma. Word error rate (WER) fails on two fronts: it collapses distinct error categories into a single scalar, and it structurally penalizes agglutinative languages where valid sandhi merges inflate scores. We introduce SCRIBE, a diagnostic framework offering categorical error decomposition into lexical, punctuation, numeral, and domain-entity rates via sandhi-tolerant alignment with domain vocabulary injection. Human validation confirms SCRIBE aligns with expert judgment where WER does not. We release SCRIBE, an LLM curation pipeline, benchmarks, and open-weight rich transcription models for Hindi, Malayalam, and Kannada.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SCRIBE是一个针对印度语言的自动语音识别诊断框架，提供词汇、标点、数字和领域实体等类别的错误分解，并通过容忍sandhi的对齐和领域词汇注入实现。摘要报告SCRIBE在人工验证中比WER更符合专家判断，并发布了基准和富转录模型。
Motivation: 词错误率（WER）将不同错误类别合并为单一标量，且在粘着性语言中因sandhi合并而惩罚过高，无法反映实际修正成本。
Method: 提出SCRIBE诊断框架，通过容忍sandhi的对齐和领域词汇注入，将错误分解为词汇、标点、数字和领域实体等类别。
Result: 人工验证表明SCRIBE比WER更符合专家判断；发布了印地语、马拉雅拉姆语和卡纳达语的基准和开放权重富转录模型。
Conclusion: SCRIBE提供了比WER更细致的错误分析，适合印度语言ASR评估。

papers.title: Learning to Balance: Decoupled Siamese Diffusion Transformer for Reference-Based Remote Sensing Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based methods demonstrate significant potential for remote sensing image super-resolution at large scaling factors, particularly in reference-based super-resolution (RefSR), where high-resolution reference images provide critical fine-grained texture priors. However, existing methods often suffer from a trade-off between over-reliance on reference information, which leads to texture artifacts, and under-utilization of such information, which results in insufficient detail recovery. To address these issues, we propose DS-DiT, a Decoupled Siamese Diffusion Transformer that decouples the interaction between low-resolution (LR) and reference (Ref) conditions within the attention mechanism. By allowing LR structural priors and Ref texture information to independently interact with the noisy latent, the framework effectively mitigates competition between the two conditional sources. To further compensate for the limited local modeling ability of global attention, we introduce a Patch-Level Weighting (PLW) module that adaptively modulates the fusion of conditional sources. In addition, the siamese architecture enables an inference-time autoguidance strategy that exploits the prediction discrepancy between strong and weak Ref conditions to improve generation quality without additional training. Experimental results across multiple datasets and scaling factors show that DS-DiT outperforms existing methods in both quantitative metrics and visual fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出DS-DiT，一种解耦的孪生扩散Transformer用于参考遥感图像超分辨率，通过解耦低分辨率和参考条件的注意力交互，引入补丁级权重模块和推理时自动引导策略，在多个数据集和放大倍数上取得更好性能。
Motivation: 现有扩散RefSR方法在过度依赖参考信息导致纹理伪影和利用不足导致细节恢复不够之间存在权衡。
Method: 提出DS-DiT，包括解耦孪生注意力机制让LR结构先验和Ref纹理信息独立与噪声潜变量交互，补丁级权重模块自适应调节条件融合，以及推理时自动引导策略利用强弱Ref预测差异提升生成质量。
Result: 在多个数据集和放大倍数上，DS-DiT在定量指标和视觉保真度上优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了方法的有效性和泛化能力，但未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: Road Maps as Free Geometric Priors: Weather-Invariant Drone Geo-Localization with GeoFuse
papers.abstract_en: Drone-view geo-localization aims to match a query drone image, often captured under adverse weather conditions (e.g., rain, snow, fog), against a gallery of geo-tagged satellite images. Weather-induced degradations in the drone view, such as noise, reduced visibility, and partial occlusions, severely exacerbate the intrinsic cross-view domain gap. While prior methods predominantly rely on weather-specific architectures or data augmentations, they have largely overlooked road map data, a readily available modality that provides strong, inherently weather-invariant geometric layout cues (e.g., road networks and building footprints) at negligible additional cost. We introduce GeoFuse, a cross-modal fusion framework that integrates precisely aligned road map tiles with satellite imagery to yield more discriminative and weather-resilient representations. We first augment the existing University-1652 and DenseUAV benchmarks with geo-aligned road maps, supplying structural priors robust to meteorological variations. Building on this, we propose a flexible fusion module that combines satellite and road map features via token-level and channel-level interactions, with a lightweight dynamic gating mechanism that adaptively weights modality contributions per instance. Finally, we employ class-level cross-view contrastive learning to promote robust alignment between weather-degraded drone features and the fused satellite-roadmap representations. Extensive experiments under diverse weather conditions show that GeoFuse consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving +3.46% and +23.18% Recall@1 accuracy on the University-1652 and DenseUAV benchmarks, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GeoFuse框架，融合道路地图和卫星图像以提升无人机在恶劣天气下的地理定位鲁棒性。通过动态门控机制和跨视图对比学习，在University-1652和DenseUAV基准上分别取得Recall@1提升3.46%和23.18%。
Motivation: 无人机地理定位在雨雪雾等天气下因视觉退化而困难，现有方法依赖天气特定设计，而道路地图作为低成本、天气不变的几何先验未被充分利用。
Method: 引入对齐的道路地图瓦片与卫星图像融合，提出令牌级和通道级交互模块及轻量动态门控加权，采用类级跨视图对比学习对齐退化无人机特征与融合表示。
Result: 在University-1652上Recall@1提升3.46%，在DenseUAV上提升23.18%，在多种天气下一致优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 道路地图作为免费几何先验能有效提升跨视图地理定位的天气不变性，融合框架泛化性强。

papers.title: Delta Forcing: Trust Region Steering for Interactive Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Interactive real-time autoregressive video generation is essential for applications such as content creation and world modeling, where visual content must adapt to dynamically evolving event conditions. A fundamental challenge lies in balancing reactivity and stability: models must respond promptly to new events while maintaining temporal coherence over long horizons. Existing approaches distill bidirectional models into autoregressive generators and further adapt them via streaming long tuning, yet often exhibit persistent drift after condition changes. We identify the cause as conditional bias, where the teacher may provide condition-aligned but trajectory-agnostic guidance, biasing generation toward locally valid yet globally inconsistent modes. Inspired by Trust Region Policy Optimization, we propose Delta Forcing, a simple yet effective framework that constrains unreliable teacher supervision within an adaptive trust region. Specifically, Delta Forcing estimates transition consistency from the latent delta between teacher and generator trajectories, and uses it to balance teacher supervision with a monotonic continuity objective. This suppress unreliable teacher-induced shifts while preserving responsiveness to new events. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Delta Forcing significantly improves consistency while maintaining event reactivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Delta Forcing框架，用于交互式自回归视频生成。通过约束不可靠的教师监督在自适应信任区域内，该方法在保持事件反应性的同时显著改善长期一致性。实验证实了其在视频生成任务中的有效性。
Motivation: 现有方法在条件变化后存在持久漂移，原因是教师模型提供条件对齐但轨迹无关的指导，导致局部有效而全局不一致的条件偏差。

Result: 大量实验表明，Delta Forcing在保持事件反应性的前提下显著提升了生成视频的长期一致性。
Conclusion: 该框架有效解决了交互式自回归视频生成中反应性与稳定性的平衡问题，通过自适应信任区域限制不可靠的教师指导。

papers.title: Not All Timesteps Matter Equally: Selective Alignment Knowledge Distillation for Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs), which are brain-inspired and spike-driven, achieve high energy efficiency. However, a performance gap between SNNs and artificial neural networks (ANNs) still remains. Knowledge distillation (KD) is commonly adopted to improve SNN performance, but existing methods typically enforce uniform alignment across all timesteps, either from a teacher network or through inter-temporal self-distillation, implicitly assuming that per-timestep predictions should be treated equally. In practice, SNN predictions vary and evolve over time, and intermediate timesteps need not all be individually correct even when the final aggregated output is correct. Under such conditions, effective distillation should not force every timestep toward the same supervision target, but instead provide corrective guidance to erroneous timesteps while preserving useful temporal dynamics. To address this issue, we propose Selective Alignment Knowledge Distillation (SeAl-KD), which selectively aligns class-level and temporal knowledge by equalizing competing logits at erroneous timesteps and reweighting temporal alignment based on confidence and inter-timestep similarity. Extensive experiments on static image and neuromorphic event-based datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over existing distillation methods. The code is available at https://github.com/KaiSUN1/SeAl
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）知识蒸馏中所有时间步均匀对齐的问题，提出选择性对齐知识蒸馏（SeAl-KD），通过只对齐错误时间步并基于置信度和时间步间相似性重新加权，在静态图像和神经形态事件数据集上优于现有蒸馏方法。
Motivation: 现有SNN知识蒸馏方法对所有时间步强制均匀对齐，但中间时间步预测不一定都正确，强制对齐会破坏有用动态。
Method: 提出SeAl-KD，选择性对齐类级和时间知识：在错误时间步均衡竞争logits，并根据置信度和时间步间相似性重新加权时间对齐。
Result: 在静态图像和神经形态事件数据集上，该方法一致优于现有蒸馏方法。代码公开。
Conclusion: 摘要强调选择性对齐可以在不破坏时间动态的情况下纠正错误时间步，提升蒸馏效果。

papers.title: Vividh-ASR: A Complexity-Tiered Benchmark and Optimization Dynamics for Robust Indic Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning multilingual ASR models like Whisper for low-resource languages often improves read speech but degrades spontaneous audio performance. To diagnose this mismatch, we introduce Vividh-ASR, a complexity-stratified benchmark for Hindi and Malayalam across four tiers: studio, broadcast, spontaneous, and synthetic noise. Through a controlled study of learning-rate timing and curriculum ordering, we find that early large parameter updates improve global WER by 12 absolute points, while a hard-to-easy curriculum adds gains for spontaneous speech. These findings motivate reverse multi-stage fine-tuning (R-MFT), a training recipe that enables a parameter-efficient 244M Whisper model to match or exceed conventionally fine-tuned 769M counterparts. Representational analysis via CKA and SVD reveals effective schedules concentrate adaptation in the decoder, preserving the pre-trained encoder's acoustic geometry. We release the benchmark and models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 Vividh-ASR，一个针对印地语和马拉雅拉姆语的复杂度分层语音识别基准，包含四个层级：录音室、广播、自发性语音和合成噪声。通过控制学习率时机和课程顺序的研究，发现早期大参数更新可使全局 WER 降低 12 个绝对点，而难到易的课程进一步提升了自发性语音的性能。这些发现催生了反向多阶段微调（R-MFT）训练方法，使得参数高效 244M 的 Whisper 模型能够匹配甚至超越传统微调的 769M 模型。CKA 和 SVD 表示分析表明有效调度将适应集中在解码器，保持预训练编码器的声学几何。
Motivation: 多语言 ASR 模型（如 Whisper）在低资源语言微调时，通常能提升朗读语音性能，但会降低自发性语音表现。现有基准缺乏针对不同语音复杂度的分层评估，且微调策略的优化动力学尚未被充分研究。
Method: 构建 Vividh-ASR 基准（四个复杂度层级），系统研究学习率时机和课程顺序的影响，提出反向多阶段微调（R-MFT）训练方法，并使用 CKA 和 SVD 进行表示分析。
Result: 早期大参数更新使全局 WER 降低 12 个绝对点；难到易课程进一步提升自发性语音性能；244M 参数的 Whisper 模型通过 R-MFT 可匹配或超越 769M 模型的传统微调结果。
Conclusion: R-MFT 有效将适应集中在解码器，保留预训练编码器声学几何，为低资源语言 ASR 的微调提供了一种参数高效的训练方案；基准和模型已开源。

papers.title: Break the Brake, Not the Wheel: Untargeted Jailbreak via Entropy Maximization
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies show that gradient-based universal image jailbreaks on vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit little or no cross-model transferability, casting doubt on the feasibility of transferable multimodal jailbreaks. We revisit this conclusion under a strictly untargeted threat model without enforcing a fixed prefix or response pattern. Our preliminary experiment reveals that refusal behavior concentrates at high-entropy tokens during autoregressive decoding, and non-refusal tokens already carry substantial probability mass among the top-ranked candidates before attack. Motivated by this finding, we propose Untargeted Jailbreak via Entropy Maximization(UJEM)-KL, a lightweight attack that maximizes entropy at these decision tokens to flip refusal outcomes, while stabilizing the remaining low-entropy positions to preserve output quality. Across three VLMs and two safety benchmarks, UJEM-KL achieves competitive white-box attack success rates and consistently improves transferability, while remaining effective under representative defenses. Our experimental results indicate that the limited transferability primarily stems from overly constrained optimization objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视了视觉语言模型（VLM）上基于梯度的通用图像越狱的跨模型迁移性问题。作者发现拒绝行为集中在自回归解码中的高熵token上，且非拒绝token在攻击前已具有较高概率质量。据此提出UJEM-KL方法，通过最大化决策token熵来翻转拒绝，同时稳定低熵位置保持输出质量。在三个VLM和两个安全基准上，该方法在白盒攻击成功率上表现竞争力，并持续提升迁移性，且对典型防御有效。实验表明有限迁移性主要源于过度约束的优化目标。
Motivation: 现有研究认为梯度基通用图像越狱在VLM上几乎无跨模型迁移性，但这一结论可能受限于固定的前缀或响应模式约束。作者希望在严格非目标威胁模型下重新检验，并探究拒绝行为背后的token级熵分布特性。
Method: 提出UJEM-KL，一种轻量级非目标越狱方法。利用自回归解码中拒绝行为集中于高熵token的观察，优化时最大化这些决策token的熵以翻转拒绝，同时通过KL散度约束稳定其他低熵token位置，保证输出质量。
Result: 在三个VLM和两个安全基准上，UJEM-KL达到有竞争力的白盒攻击成功率，并一致地提升了跨模型迁移性，在代表性防御下依然有效。实验表明有限迁移性源于过度约束的优化目标。
Conclusion: 本文揭示VLM通用图像越狱的迁移性瓶颈主要来自优化目标过度约束，通过熵最大化可有效提升迁移性。方法轻量且对防御鲁棒。

papers.title: Cornerstones or Stumbling Blocks? Deciphering the Rock Tokens in On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: While recent work in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has shown that a small subset of critical tokens disproportionately drives reasoning gains, an analogous token-level understanding of On-Policy Distillation (OPD) remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate high-loss tokens, a token type that--as the most direct signal of student-teacher mismatch under OPD's per-token KL objective--should progressively diminish as training converges according to existing studies; however, our empirical analysis shows otherwise. Even after OPD training reaches apparent saturation, a substantial subset of tokens continues to exhibit persistently high loss; these tokens, which we term Rock Tokens, can account for up to 18\% of the tokens in generated outputs. Our investigation reveals two startling paradoxes. First, despite their high occurrence frequency providing a disproportionately large share of total gradient norms, Rock Tokens themselves remain stagnant throughout training, resisting teacher-driven corrections. Second, through causal intervention, we find that these tokens provide negligible functional contribution to the model's actual reasoning performance. These findings suggest that a vast amount of optimization bandwidth is spent on structural and discourse residuals that the student model cannot or need not internalize. By deconstructing these dynamics, we demonstrate that strategically bypassing these ``stumbling blocks'' can significantly streamline the alignment process, challenging the necessity of uniform token weighting and offering a more efficient paradigm for large-scale model distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation, OPD）中的高损失token，发现一类被称为Rock Tokens的token在训练饱和后仍持续高损失，占比可达18%。这些token贡献了大部分梯度范数，但自身在训练中停滞，且对推理功能贡献微弱，表明大量优化资源被浪费在结构性和话语残留上。通过策略性绕过这些token，可简化对齐过程。
Motivation: 现有强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）工作发现关键token驱动推理增益，但OPD中token级理解尚未探索。本文聚焦OPD中高损失token，揭示其与现有理论预期的矛盾。
Method: 实证分析OPD训练后高损失token的行为，识别Rock Tokens，进行因果干预和梯度分析，评估其对推理功能的实际贡献。
Result: Rock Tokens在生成输出中占比高达18%，提供不成比例的大梯度范数，但自身损失不下降且对推理性能贡献极小。
Conclusion: 这些token是学生模型无法或无需内化的残留，均匀token加权策略可能不必要，绕过它们可提高蒸馏效率。

papers.title: Robust Multi-Agent LLMs under Byzantine Faults
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly collaborate over peer-to-peer networks to improve their reliability. However, these same interactions can also become a source of vulnerability, as unreliable or Byzantine agents may sway neighboring agents toward incorrect conclusions and degrade overall system performance. Existing methods rely on leader-based coordination or self-reported confidence, both of which are susceptible to adversarial manipulation. We study decentralized LLM multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) and propose Self-Anchored Consensus (SAC), a fully decentralized iterative filter-and-refine protocol in which agents iteratively exchange responses, locally evaluate and filter unreliable messages, and refine their own outputs. We present $(F{+}1)$-robustness conditions for the communication graph that ensure honest agents preserve and propagate reliable information despite Byzantine influence. Experiments on mathematical and commonsense reasoning benchmarks show that SAC effectively suppresses Byzantine influence and consistently improves performance across diverse communication topologies, whereas prior methods degrade under adversarial conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对去中心化多智能体LLM系统在拜占庭攻击下的鲁棒性问题，提出自锚共识（SAC）协议，通过迭代过滤和精炼机制，使智能体在不依赖中心化协调或自我报告置信度的情况下，有效抑制不可靠信息。实验表明SAC在数学和常识推理基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多智能体LLM系统依赖中心化协调或自我报告置信度，容易受到拜占庭智能体操纵，导致系统性能下降。需要一种完全去中心化的鲁棒方案。
Method: 提出Self-Anchored Consensus（SAC），一种迭代滤波-精炼协议：智能体之间交换响应，本地评估并过滤不可靠消息，然后精炼自身输出。推导了通信图的(F+1)-鲁棒性条件。
Result: 在数学和常识推理基准上，SAC有效抑制拜占庭影响，并在多种通信拓扑下持续提升性能，而先前方法在对抗条件下性能下降。
Conclusion: 去中心化滤波-精炼协议可以有效提升多智能体LLM系统对拜占庭故障的鲁棒性，无需假设全局可信节点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SearchSkill: Teaching LLMs to Use Search Tools with Evolving Skill Banks
papers.abstract_en: Teaching language models to use search tools is not only a question of whether they search, but also of whether they issue good queries. This is especially important in open-domain question answering, where broad or copied queries often waste retrieval budget and derail later reasoning. We propose \Ours, a framework that makes query planning explicit through reusable search skills. At each step, the model first selects a skill, then generates a search or answer action conditioned on the selected skill card. The skill inventory itself is not fixed: SearchSkill maintains an evolving SkillBank, expands or refines it from recurrent failure patterns, and reconstructs affected trajectories before supervised training. The resulting two-stage SFT recipe aligns training with the inference-time protocol of skill selection followed by skill-grounded execution. Across open-source and closed-source models, SearchSkill improves exact match on knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks and yields better retrieval behavior, including fewer copied first queries, more atomic hop-focused queries, and more correct answers within a small search budget. These results suggest that explicit skill-conditioned query planning is a lightweight alternative to treating search as an undifferentiated action.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SearchSkill框架，通过显式的技能库（SkillBank）让LLM在开放域问答中学习选择搜索技能并生成查询，技能库可根据失败模式动态扩展并重构轨迹，最终通过两阶段SFT训练。实验表明该方法提升了知识密集型QA的精确匹配率，并改进了检索行为（减少重复查询，增加原子查询等）。
Motivation: 现有LLM使用搜索工具时往往生成宽泛或重复的查询，浪费检索预算并影响推理；缺乏显式的查询规划能力。
Method: 提出SearchSkill框架，维护一个可演化的技能库，每个技能卡指导搜索或回答动作；模型先选择技能，再生成动作；技能库根据失败模式扩展或精炼，并重构受影响轨迹后用于监督训练。
Result: 在知识密集型QA基准上，SearchSkill提升了精确匹配率，并改善了检索行为，包括更少的复制首次查询、更多原子跳转查询，以及在较小搜索预算下得到更多正确回答。
Conclusion: 显式的技能条件查询规划是将搜索视为无差异化动作的轻量级替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unison: Harmonizing Motion, Speech, and Sound for Human-Centric Audio-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Motion, speech, and sound effects are fundamental elements of human-centric videos, yet their heterogeneous temporal characteristics make joint generation highly challenging. Existing audio-video generation models often fail to maintain consistent alignment across these modalities, leading to noticeable mismatches between motion, speech, and environmental sounds. We present Unison, a unified framework that explicitly promotes coherence across the motion, speech, and sound modalities. Within the audio stream, Unison employs a semantic-guided harmonization strategy that decouples the generation of speech and sound-effect components. Leveraging bidirectional audio cross-attention and semantic-conditioned gating for semantic-driven adaptive recomposition, this approach effectively mitigates speech dominance and enhances acoustic clarity. For audio-motion synchronization, we propose a bidirectional cross-modal forcing strategy where the cleaner modality guides the noisier one through decoupled denoising schedules, reinforced by a progressive stabilization strategy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Unison achieves state-of-the-art performance in both audio perceptual quality and cross-modal synchronization, highlighting the importance of explicit multimodal harmonization in human-centric video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Unison，一个统一框架，用于协调人类中心视频中的动作、语音和声音效果。在音频流中采用语义引导的协调策略，解耦语音和音效生成；通过双向音频交叉注意力和语义条件门控实现语义驱动的自适应重组，缓解语音主导并增强声学清晰度。提出双向跨模态强制策略，利用更干净的模态指导更嘈杂的模态，通过解耦去噪调度和渐进稳定策略实现音频-动作同步。实验表明在音频感知质量和跨模态同步上达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有音频-视频生成模型难以在动作、语音和环境声音之间保持一致对齐，导致明显不匹配。
Method: 提出 Unison 框架，包括语义引导的音频协调策略（解耦语音和音效，双向交叉注意力，语义门控）和双向跨模态强制策略（解耦去噪，渐进稳定）。
Result: 摘要报告 Unison 在音频感知质量和跨模态同步上达到最先进性能，强调了显式多模态协调的重要性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式多模态协调对于人类中心视频生成至关重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NEURON: A Neuro-symbolic System for Grounded Clinical Explainability
papers.abstract_en: Clinical AI adoption is hindered by the black-box/grey-box nature of high-performing models, which lack the ontological grounding and narrative transparency required for professional-level explainability. We present NEURON, a neuro-symbolic system designed to enhance both predictive reliability and clinical interpretability. NEURON integrates SNOMED CT ontology-informed structural representations with machine learning models to bridge the gap between raw data and medical nomenclature. To facilitate human-aligned interaction, the system utilizes a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounded LLM layer to synthesize SHAP feature attributions and patient-specific clinical notes into coherent, natural-language explanations. Validated on the MIMIC-IV dataset for Acute Heart Failure mortality prediction, NEURON improved the AUC from 0.74-0.77 to 0.84-0.88 and significantly outperformed raw SHAP visualizations in human-aligned metrics (0.85 vs. 0.50). Our results demonstrate that NEURON offers a robust, scalable engineering solution for deploying trustworthy, human-centered connected health applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NEURON，一种神经符号系统，将 SNOMED CT 本体知识与机器学习结合，并通过 RAG 增强的 LLM 层生成自然语言解释。在 MIMIC-IV 数据集上用于急性心力衰竭死亡预测，AUC 从 0.74-0.77 提升至 0.84-0.88，并在人类对齐指标上显著优于原始 SHAP 可视化（0.85 vs 0.50）。
Motivation: 临床 AI 部署受限于高性能模型的黑箱/灰箱特性，缺乏专业级别可解释性所需的本体基础和叙事透明度。
Method: NEURON 融合 SNOMED CT 本体知识的结构化表示与机器学习模型，利用基于 RAG 的 LLM 层将 SHAP 特征归因和患者特定临床笔记合成为连贯的自然语言解释。
Result: 在 MIMIC-IV 急性心力衰竭死亡预测任务中，AUC 从 0.74-0.77 提升至 0.84-0.88；人类对齐指标为 0.85，远高于原始 SHAP 可视化的 0.50。
Conclusion: NEURON 为部署可信、以人为本的互联健康应用提供了鲁棒、可扩展的工程解决方案。

papers.title: Most Current Model Organisms Are Leaky: Perplexity Differencing Often Reveals Finetuning Objectives
papers.abstract_en: Finetuning can significantly modify the behavior of large language models, including introducing harmful or unsafe behaviors. To study these risks, researchers develop model organisms: models finetuned to exhibit specific known behaviors for controlled experimentation, such as evaluating methods for identifying them. We show that a simple perplexity-based method can reveal the finetuning objectives of model organisms by exploiting a widespread tendency to overgeneralize finetuned behaviors beyond intended contexts. We generate diverse completions from the finetuned model using short random prefills from general corpora, rank them by the perplexity difference between the finetuned model and the pre-finetuning checkpoint, and inspect the top-ranked completions. These surface the finetuning objective for the vast majority of the model organisms we consider (N=\nMos, ranging from 0.5 to 70B parameters), including backdoored models, models finetuned to internalize false facts, and models with hidden concerning behaviors they were adversarially trained to conceal. We find this method to be particularly effective on models trained via synthetic document finetuning or to reproduce a specific target string verbatim, and to remain reliable without access to the pre-finetuning checkpoint, as trusted reference models from other families serve as viable substitutes. Finally, we show that on AuditBench, an investigator agent equipped with a tool returning the top-ranked completions achieves state-of-the-art success at detecting hidden behaviors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大多数当前模型有机体（即被微调以展现特定行为的语言模型）存在“泄漏”现象：通过计算微调模型与微调前检查点的困惑度差异（perplexity differencing），并对差异最大的补全进行审查，可以揭示微调目标。该方法在多种模型（0.5-70B参数）上有效，包括后门模型、内化虚假事实的模型以及隐藏有害行为的模型；即使没有原始检查点，其他家族的参考模型也可替代。在AuditBench基准上，配备该工具的智能体在检测隐藏行为方面达到了最先进的成功率。
Motivation: 微调可能给大语言模型引入有害行为，研究人员需要可靠的方法来检测这些行为；现有的模型有机体为受控实验提供了基础，但缺乏通用且自动化的检测手段。
Method: 利用困惑度差异：用通用语料中的短随机前缀从微调模型生成多样补全，按微调模型与微调前检查点的困惑度差异排序，并检查排名靠前的补全以揭示微调目标。无需微调前检查点时，可用其他家族的可信参考模型替代。
Result: 在多数模型有机体上（规模0.5-70B参数）成功揭示微调目标，包括后门、虚假事实隐藏等行为；在AuditBench上检测隐藏行为的成功率达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: 困惑度差异方法简单有效，适用于多种微调场景，但依赖参考模型的可比性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond SFT-to-RL: Pre-alignment via Black-Box On-Policy Distillation for Multimodal RL
papers.abstract_en: The standard post-training recipe for large multimodal models (LMMs) applies supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated demonstrations followed by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, SFT introduces distributional drift that neither preserves the model's original capabilities nor faithfully matches the supervision distribution. This problem is further amplified in multimodal reasoning, where perception errors and reasoning failures follow distinct drift patterns that compound during subsequent RL. We introduce PRISM, a three-stage pipeline that mitigates this drift by inserting an explicit distribution-alignment stage between SFT and RLVR. Building on the principle of on-policy distillation (OPD), PRISM casts alignment as a black-box, response-level adversarial game between the policy and a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) discriminator with dedicated perception and reasoning experts, providing disentangled corrective signals that steer the policy toward the supervision distribution without requiring access to teacher logits. While 1.26M public demonstrations suffice for broad SFT initialization, distribution alignment demands higher-fidelity supervision; we therefore curate 113K additional demonstrations from Gemini 3 Flash, featuring dense visual grounding and step-by-step reasoning on the hardest unsolved problems. Experiments on Qwen3-VL show that PRISM consistently improves downstream RLVR performance across multiple RL algorithms (GRPO, DAPO, GSPO) and diverse multimodal benchmarks, improving average accuracy by +4.4 and +6.0 points over the SFT-to-RLVR baseline on 4B and 8B, respectively. Our code, data, and model checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/XIAO4579/PRISM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PRISM 是一种在 SFT 与 RLVR 之间插入分布对齐阶段的多模态大模型后训练方法。通过黑盒在线蒸馏（OPD）策略，使用 MoE 判别器提供感知和推理解耦的校正信号，缓解 SFT 带来的分布漂移。实验在 Qwen3-VL 上显示，PRISM 在多种 RL 算法和多模态基准上平均提升 4.4 (4B) 和 6.0 (8B) 个点。
Motivation: 标准 SFT 后接 RLVR 流程中，SFT 引入的分布漂移会损害模型原始能力且不匹配监督分布，在多模态推理中感知和推理错误的不同漂移模式在后续 RL 中进一步放大。
Method: PRISM 三阶段流水线：SFT 后插入分布对齐阶段，基于黑盒在线蒸馏（OPD），将对齐视为策略与 MoE 判别器（含专用感知和推理专家）之间的对抗博弈，无需教师 logits。额外从 Gemini 3 Flash 收集 113K 高保真演示。
Result: 在 Qwen3-VL 上，PRISM 在 GRPO、DAPO、GSPO 等 RL 算法和多模态基准上持续提升下游 RLVR 性能，4B 和 8B 模型平均准确率分别提升 +4.4 和 +6.0 点。
Conclusion: PRISM 通过在 SFT 和 RLVR 之间插入显式分布对齐阶段，有效缓解分布漂移，提升多模态 RL 后训练效果。代码、数据和模型已公开。
Relevance: 0
