papers.title: Probing and Leveraging Video Diffusion Transformer Features for Robust Point Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Despite achieving strong results on standard benchmarks, current point tracking methods rely on feature backbones that are rarely designed with the temporal coherence needed for robust real-world performance. While recent works incorporate powerful visual foundation model (VFM) features into tracking pipelines, no prior work has systematically analyzed which VFM provides the most robust representations for point tracking. We present the first such analysis, evaluating diverse VFMs in a zero-shot setting on both standard and robustness benchmarks for point tracking. Our study reveals that video diffusion transformers (DiTs) consistently yield the most temporally coherent and discriminative features, even surpassing ResNet backbones explicitly supervised on tracking data. We hypothesize this advantage stem from large-scale video pretraining, full 3D spatio-temporal attention, and a diffusion training objective. Motivated by this finding, we propose DiTracker, which integrates video DiT features into existing tracking frameworks through query-key matching cost computation, cost-level fusion with a lightweight ResNet branch, and LoRA adaptation. Under the same tracking head, DiTracker is trained solely on synthetic data with far fewer iterations, yet outperforms CoTracker3 trained with additional real-world videos, with the largest gains under challenging and corrupted scenarios. It further generalizes across tracking heads and scales with backbone size, confirming that generative video pretraining provides real-world priors that reduce the dependence on large-scale real-data supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统分析多种视觉基础模型（VFM）在点跟踪任务中的特征鲁棒性，发现视频扩散Transformer（DiT）在零样本设置下提供最连贯的时间特征和判别性特征，优于有跟踪监督的ResNet。基于此，提出DiTracker，利用视频DiT特征通过查询-键匹配成本计算、成本级融合和LoRA适配集成到现有跟踪框架中，仅用合成数据训练少量迭代即超越使用真实视频的CoTracker3，尤其在挑战和退化场景下提升显著。
Motivation: 当前点跟踪方法依赖的特征骨干网络很少针对时间连贯性设计，且没有工作系统分析哪种VFM提供最鲁棒的点跟踪特征。
Method: 提出DiTracker，将视频DiT特征集成到跟踪框架中，包括查询-键匹配成本计算、与轻量ResNet分支的成本级融合，以及LoRA适配。
Result: 在相同跟踪头下，DiTracker仅用合成数据训练远少于CoTracker3的迭代次数，即超越CoTracker3（使用额外真实视频），并在挑战和退化场景下取得最大增益；同时跨跟踪头和骨干大小泛化良好。
Conclusion: 生成式视频预训练提供了真实世界先验，减少了对大规模真实数据监督的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Delayed Bidirectional Alignment via Disentangled Audio Semantics for Audio-Visual Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) aims to localize sound-producing objects at the pixel level by integrating auditory and visual cues. However, existing methods often struggle with multi-source entanglement and audio-visual misalignment, leading to a dominance bias toward acoustically or visually salient objects (i.e., louder or larger ones) at the expense of subtler or co-occurring sources. To address these challenges, we propose DDAVS: Delayed Bidirectional Alignment via Disentangled Audio Semantics for Audio-Visual Segmentation. To mitigate multi-source entanglement, DDAVS employs learnable queries to extract audio semantics and anchor them within a structured semantic space derived from an audio prototype memory bank. This process is further optimized through contrastive learning to enhance discriminability and robustness. To alleviate audio-visual misalignment, DDAVS introduces dual cross attention with delayed modality interaction, improving the robustness of multimodal alignment. Extensive experiments on the AVS-Objects and VPO benchmarks demonstrate that DDAVS achieves state-of-the-art performance across single-source, multi-source, and multi-class multi-instance scenarios. These results validate the effectiveness and generalization ability of our framework under challenging real-world audio-visual segmentation conditions. Project page: https://trilarflagz.github.io/DDAVS-page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DDAVS，一种通过解耦音频语义和延迟双向对齐来解决音频-视觉分割中多源纠缠和音视频错位问题的方法。在 AVS-Objects 和 VPO 基准上，该方法在单源、多源和多类多实例场景下均达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理多源声音时，往往偏向于声学或视觉上突出的物体（如更响或更大的物体），忽略细微或共存声源；同时存在音视频特征错位问题。
Method: DDAVS 使用可学习查询提取音频语义，并通过音频原型记忆库将其锚定在结构化语义空间中，利用对比学习增强判别性；引入双交叉注意力与延迟模态交互来改善对齐。
Result: 在 AVS-Objects 和 VPO 基准上，DDAVS 在单源、多源和多类多实例场景下均取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 实验验证了所提框架在复杂真实场景下的有效性和泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 DDAVS，一种通过解耦音频语义和延迟双向对齐来解决音频-视觉分割中多源纠缠和音视频错位问题的方法。在 AVS-Objects 和 VPO 基准上，该方法在单源、多源和多类多实例场景下均达到最优性能。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有方法在处理多源声音时，往往偏向于声学或视觉上突出的物体（如更响或更大的物体），忽略细微或共存声源；同时存在音视频特征错位问题。
summary_sections.method: DDAVS 使用可学习查询提取音频语义，并通过音频原型记忆库将其锚定在结构化语义空间中，利用对比学习增强判别性；引入双交叉注意力与延迟模态交互来改善对齐。
summary_sections.result: 在 AVS-Objects 和 VPO 基准上，DDAVS 在单源、多源和多类多实例场景下均取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 实验验证了所提框架在复杂真实场景下的有效性和泛化能力。

papers.title: InsertAnywhere: Geometrically Grounded and Optics-Aware Video Object Insertion
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion models have enabled impressive video editing capabilities, yet production-grade Video Object Insertion (VOI) remains challenging due to inadequate 4D scene understanding and a lack of proper optical interactions, such as shadows and reflections. To address these limitations, we present InsertAnywhere, a comprehensive VOI framework that achieves geometrically grounded object placement and optics-aware video synthesis. Our approach first leverages a 4D-aware mask generation module that allows users to anchor an object's 3D pose in a single frame. The framework automatically propagates this placement across the video, accurately handling local scene dynamics and occlusions. To synthesize realistic physical lighting interactions, we introduce Optics-Aware Representation Alignment, a novel strategy that utilizes an extended mask to guide feature extraction, enabling optical effects to seamlessly extend beyond the inserted object's boundary. Finally, to overcome the lack of training data for such phenomena, we construct and open-source ROSE++, a specialized quadruplet dataset tailored for the supervised learning of optical effects. Extensive experiments demonstrate that InsertAnywhere produces geometrically plausible and photometrically realistic insertions in complex real-world scenarios, significantly outperforming existing research and commercial generative tools.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出InsertAnywhere框架，用于在视频中插入物体，实现几何合理的放置和光学感知的合成。通过4D感知掩码生成和光学感知表示对齐策略，该方法能够自动传播物体放置并处理局部场景动态和遮挡，同时生成阴影和反射等光学效果。基于构建的ROSE++数据集，实验表明该方法在复杂真实场景中显著优于现有生成工具。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在视频物体插入中缺乏4D场景理解和光学交互（如阴影和反射），导致插入结果不够真实。
Method: 提出4D感知掩码生成模块，允许用户单帧锚定物体3D姿态并自动传播到整个视频；引入光学感知表示对齐策略，利用扩展掩码引导特征提取，使光学效果延伸到物体边界外；构建并开源ROSE++数据集用于监督学习光学效果。
Result: 在复杂真实场景中，InsertAnywhere生成几何合理且光学校正的插入结果，显著优于现有研究和商业生成工具。
Conclusion: 该框架通过结合几何约束和光学建模，提升了视频物体插入的真实感，但可能依赖用户提供的单帧姿态标注。

papers.title: BrepLLM: Enabling Large Language Models to Understand Boundary Representations
papers.abstract_en: Current token-sequence-based Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to directly process 3D Boundary Representation (B-rep) models that contain complex geometric and topological information. To this end, we propose BrepLLM, the first multimodal framework that enables LLMs to directly parse and reason over raw B-rep data. BrepLLM adopts a two-stage training pipeline: cross-modal alignment pre-training and two-stage LLM fine-tuning. In the first stage, we design an adaptive UV sampling strategy to convert B-reps into graph representations that integrate geometric and topological information. Subsequently, we construct a hierarchical BrepEncoder to extract features from geometric elements (faces and edges) and topology, generating a global token and a sequence of node tokens. Then, via contrastive learning, we conduct an initial alignment between this global token and the text embeddings of a frozen CLIP text encoder (ViT-L/14). In the second stage, we integrate the pre-trained BrepEncoder into the LLM and employ a two-stage progressive strategy to align the sequence of node tokens: (1) training an MLP-based semantic mapping network that utilizes the prior knowledge of a 2D-VLM to align the B-rep representation to the 2D visual semantic space; (2) utilizing LoRA for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of the Q-Former and the LLM backbone network to achieve the final 3D-language generation capability. Furthermore, we construct the Brep2Text dataset, which contains 269,444 B-rep and text question-answer pairs. Experiments demonstrate that BrepLLM achieves SOTA performance on 3D object classification and captioning tasks. The project page is available at https://user-deng.github.io/BrepLLM/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BrepLLM是首个使大语言模型（LLM）直接解析和理解3D边界表示（B-rep）数据的多模态框架。它采用两阶段训练：第一阶段通过自适应UV采样将B-rep转换为图表示，利用分层BrepEncoder提取几何和拓扑特征，并通过对比学习与CLIP文本嵌入对齐；第二阶段通过MLP映射网络和LoRA微调实现最终3D语言生成能力。在Brep2Text数据集（269,444个问答对）上训练，在3D物体分类和描述任务上达到SOTA。
Motivation: 当前基于token序列的LLM难以处理包含复杂几何和拓扑信息的3D B-rep模型，需要一种方法使LLM直接理解原始B-rep数据。
Method: 提出BrepLLM，包括自适应UV采样将B-rep转换为图表示，分层BrepEncoder提取特征，两阶段训练：跨模态对齐预训练（对比学习）和两阶段微调（先MLP映射到2D视觉语义空间，再LoRA微调Q-Former和LLM）。
Result: 在3D物体分类和描述任务上达到SOTA性能，构建了包含269,444个B-rep-文本问答对的Brep2Text数据集。
Conclusion: 首次实现LLM直接处理原始B-rep数据，通过两阶段对齐策略有效融合几何拓扑信息与语言语义，为3D形状理解提供新范式。

papers.title: Efficient-VLN: A Simple yet Strong Baseline for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant promise in Vision-Language Navigation (VLN), existing agents remain heavily constrained by systemic bottlenecks across inference, training, and data collection. Specifically, they suffer from prohibitive latency due to visual history reprocessing, action leakage during sequence-packed training, and suboptimal exploration in self-correction data collection. To overcome these intertwined challenges, we present Efficient-VLN, a highly efficient and robust baseline that systematically resolves these issues through three simple-yet-effective mechanisms. (1) Inference: We introduce KV-cache reuse with contiguous RoPE, enabling the model to process only the newly observed frame at each step for real-time inference. (2) Training: We propose packed training with an action-isolating mask to accelerate throughput while effectively bridging the training-inference gap by preventing action leakage. (3) Data Collection: We employ an Adaptive DAgger to dynamically balance autonomous exploration and oracle guidance, enhancing error-recovery capability without escalating computational costs. Extensive evaluations show that Efficient-VLN significantly advances the state-of-the-art across the R2R-CE (73.2% SR) and RxR-CE (75.6% SR) benchmarks. Meanwhile, it yields a 28% latency reduction compared to the previous state-of-the-art StreamVLN, establishing a new paradigm for streaming MLLM-based navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Efficient-VLN，一种高效的视觉语言导航基线，通过KV缓存重用、连续旋转位置编码（RoPE）、打包训练中的动作隔离掩码和自适应DAgger数据收集方法，解决了推理延迟、训练动作泄漏和数据收集效率问题。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE基准上分别达到73.2%和75.6%的成功率（SR），相比StreamVLN延迟降低28%。
Motivation: 现有基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的视觉语言导航（VLN）代理在推理、训练和数据收集方面存在系统性瓶颈，包括视觉历史重复处理导致的过高延迟、序列打包训练中的动作泄漏以及自校正数据收集中的次优探索。
Method: 提出三个高效机制：1）推理：KV缓存重用与连续RoPE，使模型每步只处理新观察帧；2）训练：带动作隔离掩码的打包训练，防止动作泄漏；3）数据收集：自适应DAgger动态平衡自主探索和教师引导，增强错误恢复能力。
Result: 在R2R-CE基准上达到73.2% SR，在RxR-CE基准上达到75.6% SR，相比StreamVLN延迟降低28%。
Conclusion: 建立了一种新的流式MLLM导航范式，有效解决推理、训练和数据收集三方面的效率问题，并取得先进导航性能。

papers.title: Weighted Contrastive Learning for Anomaly-Aware Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Reliable forecasting of multivariate time series under anomalous conditions is crucial in applications such as ATM cash logistics, where sudden demand shifts can disrupt operations. Modern deep forecasters achieve high accuracy on normal data but often fail when distribution shifts occur. We propose Weighted Contrastive Adaptation (WECA), a Weighted contrastive objective that aligns normal and anomaly-augmented representations, preserving anomaly-relevant information while maintaining consistency under benign variations. Evaluations on a nationwide ATM transaction dataset with domain-informed anomaly injection show that WECA improves SMAPE on anomaly-affected data by 6.1 percentage points compared to a normally trained baseline, with negligible degradation on normal data. These results demonstrate that WECA enhances forecasting reliability under anomalies without sacrificing performance during regular operations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对异常条件下的多元时间序列预测问题，提出加权对比适应（WECA）方法，通过加权对比学习对齐正常表示和异常增强表示，保留异常相关信息同时保持良性变化下的一致性。在ATM交易数据集上，WECA将异常影响数据的SMAPE降低6.1个百分点，而对正常数据性能影响极小。
Motivation: 现有深度预测器在正常数据上精度高，但分布偏移下常失效，需要提升异常条件下的预测可靠性。
Method: 提出Weighted Contrastive Adaptation (WECA)，一种加权对比目标，通过对比学习对齐正常和异常增强表示，在良性变化下保持一致性。
Result: 在全国ATM交易数据集上，与正常训练基线相比，WECA在异常影响数据上SMAPE降低6.1个百分点，正常数据上性能下降可忽略。
Conclusion: WECA能提升异常条件下的预测可靠性，而不牺牲正常操作期间的性能。

papers.title: SDGIC: A Semantic Disambiguation-Guided Generative Image Compression Method for Ultra-Low Bitrates
papers.abstract_en: Generative image compression has recently shown impressive perceptual quality, but often suffers from semantic inconsistency at ultra-low bitrates (bpp < 0.05), limiting its reliable deployment in bandwidth-constrained scenarios such as 6G semantic communications. This inconsistency stems from incomplete guidance information, which introduces semantic ambiguity into the generation process and may lead to natural-looking but source-inconsistent content. In this work, we propose a Semantic-Disambiguation-Guided Generative Image Compression (SDGIC) framework to constrain diffusion-based reconstruction at ultra-low bitrates. Specifically, SDGIC compresses the source image into three compact and complementary guidance streams: a concise text caption for global semantics, a highly compressed image (HCI) for dense visual evidence, and Reconstruction-Aware Semantic Residual Tokens (RSRTs) for reconstruction-relevant residual semantics that remain ambiguous under the text caption and HCI conditions. The RSRTs are directly optimized toward the downstream denoising objective, enabling them to provide source-specific semantic constraints for disambiguating diffusion-based reconstruction. To inject these three guidance streams into the generation process effectively, we design a Dual-Path Conditioned Diffusion Decoder (DPCD), which uses cross-attention for semantic conditions and ControlNet residuals for dense visual guidance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SDGIC improves semantic consistency at ultra-low bitrates while maintaining favorable perceptual quality, with a 23.4% reduction in AFINE on the CLIC2020 dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种语义消歧引导的生成图像压缩方法SDGIC，针对超低码率下生成图像语义不一致的问题。SDGIC将源图像压缩为三个互补的引导流：简洁文本描述、高度压缩图像和重建感知语义残差令牌，并通过双路径条件扩散解码器注入。实验表明在CLIC2020上AFINE降低23.4%。
Motivation: 现有生成式图像压缩在超低码率下常出现语义不一致，限制其在带宽受限场景（如6G语义通信）中的可靠部署。
Method: 提出SDGIC框架，压缩源图像为三个引导流：文本描述、高度压缩图像和面向重建的语义残差令牌；设计双路径条件扩散解码器，用交叉注意力处理语义条件、ControlNet残差处理密集视觉引导。
Result: 在CLIC2020数据集上，AFINE指标降低23.4%，在超低码率下改善语义一致性并保持良好感知质量。
Conclusion: SDGIC通过语义消歧引导约束扩散重建，有效提升超低码率下的生成图像语义一致性。

papers.title: See, Think, Learn: A Self-Taught Multimodal Reasoner
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in integrating visual perception with language understanding. However, effective multimodal reasoning requires both accurate perception and robust reasoning, and weakness in either limits the performance of VLMs. Prior efforts to enhance reasoning often depend on high-quality chain-of-thought (CoT) data, obtained via labor-intensive human annotations, costly proprietary models, or self-training methods that overlook perception. To address these limitations, we propose a simple yet effective self-training framework called See-Think-Learn (STL). At its core, STL introduces a structured reasoning template that encourages the model to see before thinking, first extracting visual attributes in textual form, then using them to guide reasoning. The framework jointly improves perception and reasoning by having the model generate and learn from its own structured rationales in a self-training loop. Furthermore, we augment the training data with negative rationales, i.e. explanations that justify why certain answer choices are incorrect, to enhance the model's ability to distinguish between correct and misleading responses. This fosters more discriminative and robust learning. Experiments across diverse domains show that STL consistently outperforms baselines trained directly only on answers or self-generated reasoning, while qualitative analysis confirms the high quality of its rationales. STL thus provides a cost-effective solution to enhance multimodal reasoning ability of VLMs.
papers.comment: Accepted at The Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 See-Think-Learn (STL) 的自训练框架，旨在提升视觉语言模型的多模态推理能力。该方法引入结构化推理模板，先让模型提取视觉属性再推理，并通过负样本 rationale 增强辨别能力。实验表明，STL 在多个领域优于直接训练答案或自生成推理的基线，且推理质量高。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在多模态推理中常因感知或推理不足而受限，且提升推理依赖昂贵的人工标注或专有模型。
Method: STL 框架包含结构化推理模板（先视觉属性提取再推理），并在自训练循环中生成和学习自己的推理过程，同时引入负样本 rationale 来区分正确与误导性答案。
Result: 摘要报告 STL 在多个领域一致优于直接训练答案或仅靠自生成推理的基线，定性分析显示其推理质量高。
Conclusion: STL 提供了一种成本有效的方式来增强视觉语言模型的多模态推理能力。

papers.title: ClusterStyle: Modeling Intra-Style Diversity with Prototypical Clustering for Stylized Motion Generation
papers.abstract_en: Existing stylized motion generation models have shown their remarkable ability to understand specific style information from the style motion, and insert it into the content motion. However, capturing intra-style diversity, where a single style should correspond to diverse motion variations, remains a significant challenge. In this paper, we propose a clustering-based framework, ClusterStyle, to address this limitation. Instead of learning an unstructured embedding from each style motion, we leverage a set of prototypes to effectively model diverse style patterns across motions belonging to the same style category. We consider two types of style diversity: global-level diversity among style motions of the same category, and local-level diversity within the temporal dynamics of motion sequences. These components jointly shape two structured style embedding spaces, i.e., global and local, optimized via alignment with non-learnable prototype anchors. Furthermore, we augment the pretrained text-to-motion generation model with the Stylistic Modulation Adapter (SMA) to integrate the style features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing state-of-the-art models in stylized motion generation and motion style transfer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ClusterStyle 框架，通过原型聚类 (prototypical clustering) 建模同一风格类别内的多样运动变化，解决风格化运动生成中风格内多样性不足的问题。该方法引入全局和局部两种风格多样性，并设计 Stylistic Modulation Adapter (SMA) 将风格特征注入预训练的文本到运动生成模型。实验表明该方法在风格化运动生成和运动风格迁移任务上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有风格化运动生成模型能理解特定风格信息，但难以捕捉同一风格下的多样运动变化（intra-style diversity），导致生成结果缺乏丰富性。
Method: 提出基于聚类的框架 ClusterStyle：使用一组可学习原型 (prototypes) 建模同类别风格运动的全局多样性和时序局部多样性，构建全局和局部两个风格嵌入空间，并通过与不可学习的原型锚点对齐进行优化；同时设计 Stylistic Modulation Adapter (SMA) 将风格特征集成到预训练文本到运动生成模型中。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在风格化运动生成和运动风格迁移任务上超越现有最先进模型，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 通过原型聚类有效建模风格内多样性，为运动生成中细粒度风格控制提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stay Unique, Stay Efficient: Preserving Model Personality in Multi-Task Merging
papers.abstract_en: Model merging has emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling multi-task capabilities without additional training. However, traditional basic merging methods often experience performance degradation due to parameter conflicts, even when applied to similar tasks. While recent personalized merging frameworks successfully preserve task-specific information to maintain performance, they typically incur storage overhead. In this paper, we propose Decomposition, Thresholding, and Scaling (DTS), an approximation-based personalized merging framework that pushes task-specific storage efficiency. DTS first applies singular value decomposition to the task-specific information and retains only a small subset of singular values and vectors. It then introduces a novel thresholding strategy that partitions singular vector elements into groups and assigns a scaling factor to each group. To enable generalization to unseen tasks, we further extend DTS with a variant that fuses task-specific information in a data-free manner based on the semantic similarity of task characteristics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DTS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines while requiring only 1\% extra storage per task. Furthermore, experiments on unseen tasks show that the DTS variant achieves significantly better generalization performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/krumpguo/DTS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DTS（分解、阈值和缩放）框架，通过近似存储任务特定信息实现多任务模型合并中的个性化保留。DTS对任务特定信息进行奇异值分解（SVD），仅保留少量奇异值和向量，并用新颖的阈值策略对奇异向量元素分组赋予缩放因子。实验表明，DTS在每个任务仅需1%额外存储下优于现有基线，且其变体能泛化到未见任务。
Motivation: 传统多任务模型合并方法因参数冲突导致性能下降，而现有的个性化合并框架虽能保持任务性能但引入额外存储开销。本文旨在解决存储效率与性能保持之间的矛盾。
Method: 提出DTS框架：先对任务特定信息进行SVD分解，保留少量奇异值和向量；然后设计阈值策略将奇异向量元素分组并为每组分配缩放因子，实现近似存储。此外，扩展出基于任务特征语义相似度、无需数据的变体以支持泛化。
Result: DTS在多个多任务合并基准上持续优于现有基线，且每个任务仅需1%额外存储。在未见任务上的实验表明，DTS变体取得了显著更好的泛化性能。
Conclusion: DTS在保持模型个性（任务特定性能）的同时极大降低了存储开销，并通过近似存储和语义融合实现了高效泛化。

papers.title: ORCA: Open-ended Response Correctness Assessment for Audio Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Reliable assessment of the abilities of large audio language models (LALMs) is essential to advancing the state of the art. As benchmarks rapidly evolve to incorporate complex reasoning and subjective tasks, they increasingly necessitate open-ended responses from LALMs. We present Open-ended Response Correctness Assessment (ORCA) -- a reliable and lightweight model-based approach for answer correctness and disagreement modeling. We employ a three-stage annotation pipeline combining human judgment, structured feedback, and human-AI correction, yielding 9,663 annotations across 3,699 question-answer pairs from 15 LALMs on three audio understanding and reasoning benchmarks (achieving a Krippendorff's alpha of 0.82). Our experiments employing curriculum learning show that ORCA models achieve a Spearman correlation of 0.91 with average human correctness ratings on seen benchmarks and generalize to unseen benchmarks with a score of 0.85, outperforming several LLM judge baselines including Gemini 2.5 Flash. Furthermore, we demonstrate that ORCA's predicted variance correlates strongly with human disagreement, allowing it to effectively identify problematic benchmark items.
papers.comment: Accepted to TACL; pre-MIT Press publication version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文提出ORCA，一种可靠且轻量的基于模型的方法，用于评估大音频语言模型（LALMs）在开放式问答中的回答正确性及建模人工分歧。采用三阶段标注流程，在三个音频理解和推理基准上获得9,663个标注（Krippendorff's alpha=0.82）。实验表明，ORCA模型与平均人工正确性评分的Spearman相关系数达到0.91，并能泛化到未见基准（0.85），其预测方差与人工分歧强相关。
Motivation: 现有基准快速演进以包含复杂推理和主观任务，需要开放式回答，但缺乏可靠的自动化正确性评估方法。
Method: 采用三阶段标注流程：人工判断、结构化反馈、人机协同校正。使用课程学习训练轻量级ORCA模型以预测回答正确性和分歧度。
Result: ORCA在已见基准上Spearman相关系数0.91，泛化到未见基准0.85，优于多种LLM judge基线（包括Gemini 2.5 Flash）。预测方差与人工分歧强相关，能有效识别有问题的基准项。
Conclusion: ORCA为音频问答开放式回答评估提供可靠方案，其预测分歧能力有助于提升基准质量。

papers.title: HieraMix: A Hierarchical MLP-Mixer for Large-Scale Traffic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Traffic forecasting task is significant to modern urban management. Recently, there is growing attention on large-scale forecasting, as it better reflects the complexity of real-world traffic networks. However, existing models often exhibit quadratic computational complexity, making them impractical for large-scale real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel framework, Spatio-Temporal Hierarchical Mixer (HieraMix), which leverages an all-MLP architecture for efficient and effective large-scale traffic forecasting. HieraMix employs a hierarchical spatiotemporal mixing block to extract multi-resolution features through bottom-up aggregation and top-down propagation. Furthermore, an adaptive region mixer generates transformation matrices based on regional semantics, enabling our model to dynamically capture evolving spatiotemporal patterns for different regions. Extensive experiments conducted on four large-scale real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed method not only achieves state-of-the-art performance but also exhibits competitive computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HieraMix，一个全 MLP 架构的分层时空混合器，用于大规模交通预测。通过分层时空混合块提取多分辨率特征，并利用自适应区域混合器动态捕捉区域时空模式。在四个大规模真实数据集上达到最先进性能，同时保持高效计算。
Motivation: 现有交通预测模型在大规模场景下计算复杂度呈二次增长，难以实际应用，亟需高效且有效的模型。
Method: 提出层次化时空混合器（HieraMix），包含分层时空混合块（自底向上聚合和自顶向下传播）和自适应区域混合器（根据区域语义生成变换矩阵）。
Result: 在四个大规模真实交通数据集上取得最先进预测精度，同时计算效率具有竞争力，验证了全 MLP 架构的可行性。
Conclusion: 全 MLP 的分层架构在大规模交通预测中能兼顾精度和效率，自适应区域混合器可动态捕捉时空模式变化。

papers.title: Contrastive vision-language learning with paraphrasing and negation
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive vision-language models continue to be the dominant approach for image-text retrieval. Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) trains two neural networks to align their image and text embeddings in a shared latent space. As a challenging case-study for neurosymbolic AI, recent results evaluating CLIP on negated or paraphrased text have shown mixed performance as these are difficult to define formally for text data. Negation produces the opposite meaning using various possible but small lexical changes. Paraphrasing may use very different textual expressions to denote essentially the same thing. As a result, learning of paraphrasing and negation together poses a significant challenge because of the above mismatch between changes in syntax and intended meaning expected to be captured by distances in embedding space. This paper proposes a new CLIP contrastive loss function capable of balancing the requirements of having both paraphrasing and negation. It applies training triplets consisting of original, paraphrased and negated text generated by multiple large language models to the evaluation of CLIP models. The approach, called SemCLIP, aims to learn semantically-relevant and simple embeddings, placing paraphrased captions nearer to the original image embeddings while at the same time pushing negated captions farther away. Empirically, SemCLIP is shown to be capable of preserving roughly the same performance as CLIP augmented with either negation or paraphrasing. Although direct comparisons are difficult to make because the problem of learning with both negation and paraphrasing is different, an expected benefit of SemCLIP should be robustness when applied zero-shot to downstream image classification tasks. Our experiments confirm such robustness as measured by difference in accuracy (mean-accuracy delta) between original and negated captions on five downstream datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CLIP模型在同时处理否定（negation）和释义（paraphrasing）文本时的困难，提出一种新的对比损失函数SemCLIP。该方法利用多个大语言模型生成包含原始、释义和否定文本的三元组进行训练，将释义文本嵌入拉近图像嵌入，同时将否定文本嵌入推远。实验表明，SemCLIP在保持与仅增强否定或释义的CLIP相近性能的同时，在五个下游数据集上展现出更好的鲁棒性，通过原始与否定描述的平均准确率差衡量。
Motivation: CLIP模型在否定和释义文本上表现不一致，因为否定通过微小词法变化产生相反含义，而释义使用不同表达表示相同内容，两者在嵌入空间中难以通过距离同时捕捉，现有工作未将两者结合处理。
Method: 提出SemCLIP损失函数，使用由原始、释义和否定文本组成的三元组训练CLIP模型。损失函数鼓励释义文本的嵌入靠近对应图像嵌入，同时将否定文本的嵌入推远，以平衡两种语义需求。
Result: SemCLIP在五个下游数据集上，通过原始与否定描述之间的平均准确率差衡量鲁棒性，实验确认了这种鲁棒性，且性能与仅增强否定或释义的CLIP基线相当。
Conclusion: 该工作为同时学习否定和释义提供了可行方案，预期在零样本下游图像分类任务中带来鲁棒性提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interaction-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Dynamic Hand-Object Interaction Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: This paper focuses on a challenging setting of simultaneously modeling geometry and appearance of hand-object interaction scenes without any object priors. We follow the trend of dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting based methods, and address several significant challenges. To model complex hand-object interaction with mutual occlusion and edge blur, we present interaction-aware hand-object Gaussians with newly introduced optimizable parameters aiming to adopt piecewise linear hypothesis for clearer structural representation. Moreover, considering the complementarity and tightness of hand shape and object shape during interaction dynamics, we incorporate hand information into object deformation field, constructing interaction-aware dynamic fields to model flexible motions. To further address difficulties in the optimization process, we propose a progressive strategy that handles dynamic regions and static background step by step. Correspondingly, explicit regularizations are designed to stabilize the hand-object representations for smooth motion transition, physical interaction reality, and coherent lighting. Experiments show that our approach surpasses existing dynamic 3D-GS-based methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance in reconstructing dynamic hand-object interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出交互感知的4D高斯泼溅方法，用于动态手-物体交互场景的重建，无需物体先验。方法引入可优化参数实现分段线性结构表示，将手部信息融入物体形变场以建模复杂交互，并采用渐进式策略及正则化优化动态与静态区域。实验表明该方法在动态手-物体交互重建上达到最新最优性能。
Motivation: 现有动态3D高斯泼溅方法在手-物体交互场景中面临相互遮挡、边缘模糊等挑战，且缺乏对交互紧密性的显式建模。
Method: 提出交互感知手-物体高斯表示，通过可优化参数采用分段线性假设提升结构清晰度；构造交互感知动态场，将手部信息融入物体形变场；采用渐进式策略分步处理动态区域与静态背景，并设计显式正则化保证运动平滑、物理交互真实和光照一致。
Result: 在动态手-物体交互重建任务上，该方法超越现有基于动态3D高斯泼溅的方法，取得最先进性能。
Conclusion: 本文方法有效处理了无先验条件下手-物体交互的几何与外观联合建模，但未提及对极端形变或快速运动的泛化性。

papers.title: AD-DAE: Alzheimer's Disease Progression Modeling with Unpaired Longitudinal MRI using Diffusion Auto-Encoders
papers.abstract_en: Generative modeling frameworks have emerged as an effective approach to capture high-dimensional image distributions from large datasets without requiring domain-specific knowledge, a capability essential for disease progression modeling. Recent generative approaches have attempted to capture progression by mapping images to a latent space and guiding representations to generate follow-up images from previous time points. However, these methods impose constraints on distribution learning, resulting in latent spaces with limited controllability for generating follow-up images without paired subject-specific longitudinal guidance. In order to enable controlled movements in the latent representational space and generate progression images from a previous time-point image without subject-specific guidance, we introduce a conditionable Diffusion Auto-encoder framework that forms a compact latent space capturing high-level semantics and providing means to control generation. Our approach leverages this latent space to condition and apply controlled shifts to the representations of previous time-point images by isolating progression and subject identity information for generating follow-up images. The shifts are implicitly guided by correlating with progression attributes and constraining to Alzheimer's disease specific regions, without paired longitudinal guidance. We validate the generations through image quality metrics, volumetric progression analysis, and downstream tasks in Alzheimer's disease datasets from different sources. This demonstrates the effectiveness of our approach for Alzheimer's progression modeling and longitudinal image generation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于条件扩散自编码器（Conditionable Diffusion Auto-encoder）的无配对纵向MRI阿尔茨海默病进展建模方法。该方法通过构建紧凑的潜在空间分离疾病进展和个体身份信息，在无需受试者特定配对指导的情况下，从先前的MRI图像生成后续时间点的图像，并通过与进展属性关联及约束至AD特定区域来隐式指导潜在空间的移动。在多个AD数据集上的图像质量、体积进展分析和下游任务验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 现有生成式方法在建模疾病进展时，因分布学习约束导致潜在空间可控性有限，无法在没有配对受试者纵向指导的情况下生成后续图像。需要一种无需配对纵向数据即可控制潜在位移以生成进展图像的方法。
Method: 引入可条件的扩散自编码器框架，学习紧凑潜在空间以捕获高层语义；通过分离进展和个体身份信息，对先前时间点图像的潜在表示施加受控位移，位移隐式地通过关联进展属性并约束至AD特定区域来指导，无需配对纵向指导。
Result: 在多个AD数据集上，通过图像质量指标、体积进展分析和下游任务验证了生成图像的有效性，展示了该方法在AD进展建模和纵向图像生成中的效果。
Conclusion: 该方法成功实现了无需配对纵向指导的AD进展图像生成，潜在空间的可控位移为疾病建模提供了新途径。

papers.title: Hard-constraint physics-residual networks for hydrogen crossover prediction and high-pressure extrapolation in PEM water electrolysis
papers.abstract_en: Hydrogen crossover is a critical safety and efficiency constraint in high-pressure polymer electrolyte membrane water electrolysis (PEMWE), but accurate prediction remains difficult because data are limited, transport physics are strongly coupled, and industrial operation requires reliable extrapolation beyond observed conditions. This study develops a hard-constraint physics-residual network (PR-Net) for hydrogen crossover prediction in PEMWE and compares it with a purely data-driven neural network (NN) and a soft-constraint physics-informed neural network (PINN). PR-Net embeds Henry's, Fick's, and Faraday's laws as a deterministic backbone and learns only a residual correction for unmodelled nonlinear effects. The benchmark includes 184 observations from eight peer-reviewed sources across six membrane types, covering 1-200 bar, $25-85°C$, and $0.05-5.0 A cm^{-2}$. PR-Net achieves $R^2 = 99.57 \pm 0.16%$, with 9-fold lower prediction variability than NN and PINN. In pressure-axis extrapolation, PR-Net attains $R^2 = 94.02 \pm 0.92%$ at 200 bar, 2.5 times beyond the training pressure range, compared with $68.06 \pm 5.52%$ for PINN and $58.00 \pm 8.60%$ for NN (p < 0.001). Residual analysis indicates that the learned correction captures part of the high-pressure gas-phase non-ideality and recovers a transport-regime transition near $0.23 A cm^{-2}$ between Fickian diffusion-dominated and Faradaic production-dominated transport. With a computation time of $1.08 \pm 0.34 ms$ on low-power embedded hardware, PR-Net provides a practical framework for real-time crossover monitoring, adaptive process control, and safer high-pressure green-hydrogen operation.

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种硬约束物理残差网络（PR-Net）用于预测PEM水电解中的氢交叉现象，在184个跨六种膜类型的实验数据上，PR-Net的R²达到99.57%，预测变异性比纯数据驱动神经网络和软约束物理信息神经网络低9倍；在压力外推至200 bar时，R²为94.02%，远超对比模型。该方法嵌入了亨利、菲克和法拉第定律作为确定性主干，仅学习未建模非线性效应的残差修正，计算时间仅1.08毫秒，适用于实时监测。
Motivation: 氢交叉是高压PEM水电解中关键的安全和效率约束，但现有数据有限、传输物理强耦合，且工业操作需要可靠外推，传统方法难以准确预测。
Method: 开发硬约束物理残差网络（PR-Net），将亨利定律、菲克定律和法拉第定律作为确定性主干嵌入网络，仅学习未建模非线性效应的残差修正；与纯数据驱动神经网络和软约束物理信息神经网络进行对比。
Result: 在184个观测值（8篇文献，6种膜类型，压力1-200 bar，温度25-85°C，电流密度0.05-5.0 A cm⁻²）上，PR-Net的R²为99.57±0.16%，预测变异性比NN和PINN低9倍；在压力轴外推至200 bar（超出训练范围2.5倍）时，R²为94.02±0.92%，显著优于PINN的68.06±5.52%和NN的58.00±8.60%（p<0.001）。残差分析捕捉了高压气相非理想性和传输区域转变。
Conclusion: PR-Net为实时氢交叉监测、自适应过程控制和更安全的高压绿色氢操作提供了实用框架，计算时间在低功耗嵌入式硬件上仅1.08±0.34毫秒。

papers.title: CostBench: Evaluating Multi-Turn Cost-Optimal Planning and Adaptation in Dynamic Environments for LLM Tool-Use Agents
papers.abstract_en: Current evaluations of Large Language Model (LLM) agents primarily emphasize task completion, often overlooking resource efficiency and adaptability. This neglects a crucial capability: agents' ability to devise and adjust cost-optimal plans in response to changing environments. To bridge this gap, we introduce CostBench, a scalable, cost-centric benchmark designed to evaluate agents' economic reasoning and replanning abilities. Situated in the travel-planning domain, CostBench comprises tasks solvable via multiple sequences of atomic and composite tools with diverse, customizable costs. It also supports four types of dynamic blocking events, such as tool failures and cost changes, to simulate real-world unpredictability and necessitate agents to adapt in real time. Evaluating leading open-sourced and proprietary models on CostBench reveals a substantial gap in cost-aware planning: agents frequently fail to identify cost-optimal solutions in static settings, with even GPT-5 achieving less than 75% exact match rate on the hardest tasks, and performance further dropping by around 40% under dynamic conditions. By diagnosing these weaknesses, CostBench lays the groundwork for developing future agents that are both economically rational and robust.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CostBench，一个以成本为中心的基准测试，用于评估 LLM 代理在动态环境中进行经济推理和重新规划的能力。基准测试基于旅行规划领域，包含多种工具序列和动态阻塞事件（如工具失败、成本变化）。评估发现，即使是 GPT-5 在静态设置下也难以找到成本最优解，动态条件下性能下降约 40%，揭示了当前代理在成本感知规划方面的严重不足。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代理评估主要关注任务完成率，忽视了资源效率和适应性，特别是代理在动态环境中制定和调整成本最优计划的能力。
Method: 设计了 CostBench 基准，位于旅行规划领域，任务可通过多种原子和复合工具序列解决，工具具有可定制的成本，并支持四种动态阻塞事件（工具故障、成本变化等）以模拟真实世界的不确定性。
Result: 评估多个开源和专有模型发现：在静态设置中，GPT-5 在最难任务上的精确匹配率不到 75%；动态条件下性能进一步下降约 40%，表明代理在成本最优规划方面存在显著差距。
Conclusion: CostBench 诊断了代理在成本感知和适应能力上的弱点，为开发既经济理性又鲁棒的未来代理奠定了基础。

papers.title: Emergence of Minimal Circuits for Indirect Object Identification in Attention-Only Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability aims to reverse-engineer large language models (LLMs) into human-understandable computational circuits. However, the complexity of pretrained models often obscures the minimal mechanisms required for specific reasoning tasks. In this work, we train small, attention-only transformers from scratch on a symbolic version of the Indirect Object Identification (IOI) task, a benchmark for studying coreference-like reasoning in transformers. Surprisingly, a single-layer model with only two attention heads achieves perfect IOI accuracy, despite lacking MLPs and normalization layers. Through residual stream decomposition, spectral analysis, and embedding interventions, we find that the two heads specialize into additive and contrastive subcircuits that jointly implement IOI resolution. Furthermore, we show that a two-layer, one-head model composes information from the previous layer primarily through query-key interactions. These results demonstrate that task-specific training induces highly interpretable, minimal circuits, offering a controlled testbed for probing the computational foundations of transformer reasoning.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从头训练仅含注意力层的小型Transformer，在符号化间接对象识别（IOI）任务上发现单层双头模型即可达到完美准确率。通过残差流分解、谱分析和嵌入干预，揭示两个注意力头分别扮演加性子电路和对比性子电路，共同实现IOI推理。两层层单头模型则通过查询-键交互组合前层信息。该工作展示了任务特定训练可诱导出高度可解释的最小电路，为研究Transformer推理的计算基础提供了受控实验平台。
Motivation: 现有预训练大语言模型的复杂性掩盖了特定推理任务所需的最小计算机制，机械可解释性研究需要更简洁的模型来理解核心原理。
Method: 训练小型仅注意力（attention-only）Transformer，无MLP和归一化层，使用符号化IOI任务。采用残差流分解、谱分析和嵌入干预来解析内部计算。
Result: 单层两个注意力头的模型在IOI任务上达到100%准确率；两层单头模型通过查询-键交互组合信息。两个头分别形成加性和对比性子电路。
Conclusion: 任务特定训练能诱导出极简且可解释的电路，为后续研究Transformer推理机制提供了可控的简化测试平台。

papers.title: Attention Enhanced Entity Recommendation for Intelligent Monitoring in Cloud Systems
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present DiRecGNN, an attention-enhanced entity recommendation framework for monitoring cloud services at Microsoft. We provide insights on the usefulness of this feature as perceived by the cloud service owners and lessons learned from deployment. Specifically, we introduce the problem of recommending the optimal subset of attributes (dimensions) that should be tracked by an automated watchdog (monitor) for cloud services. To begin, we construct the monitor heterogeneous graph at production-scale. The interaction dynamics of these entities are often characterized by limited structural and engagement information, resulting in inferior performance of state-of-the-art approaches. Moreover, traditional methods fail to capture the dependencies between entities spanning a long range due to their homophilic nature. Therefore, we propose an attention-enhanced entity ranking model inspired by transformer architectures. Our model utilizes a multi-head attention mechanism to focus on heterogeneous neighbors and their attributes, and further attends to paths sampled using random walks to capture long-range dependencies. We also employ multi-faceted loss functions to optimize for relevant recommendations while respecting the inherent sparsity of the data. Empirical evaluations demonstrate significant improvements over existing methods, with our model achieving a 43.1% increase in MRR. Furthermore, product teams who consumed these features perceive the feature as useful and rated it 4.5 out of 5.

papers.title: MatchAttention: Embedding Explicit Matching Constraints into Attention for Efficient Stereo Matching
papers.abstract_en: Standard attention mechanisms are not well suited to stereo matching. Global attention scales quadratically and provides no explicit matching constraint, while local attention is efficient but loses long-range correspondences. We propose MatchAttention, an attention mechanism that embeds an explicit matching constraint into attention by treating the relative position between a query and its matched key as a learnable component of attention sampling. Centering a small contiguous sampling window on this learnable relative position enforces the matching constraint and supports long-range correspondence at strictly linear attention complexity. A differentiable contiguous attention sampling (CAS) operator enables sub-pixel accuracy, and cascaded MatchAttention blocks iteratively refine the relative positions through residual connections. We instantiate MatchAttention as a hierarchical coarse-to-fine stereo network with two variants. MatchAttentionXL targets accuracy and MatchAttentionRT targets real-time edge inference. MatchAttentionXL achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on Middlebury V3 and top results across KITTI 2012/2015 and ETH3D. MatchAttentionRT runs at 9.3 ms on RTX 4060 Ti and 79.1 ms on Jetson Orin NX 16 GB at 1024 x 512, making it the first stereo model to deliver real-time edge inference without sacrificing zero-shot generalization. The code is available at https://github.com/TingmanYan/MatchAttention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MatchAttention注意力机制，通过将查询与匹配键的相对位置作为可学习组件嵌入注意力，实现严格线性复杂度的长距离对应，并应用于立体匹配。两个变体MatchAttentionXL和MatchAttentionRT分别在精度和实时边缘推理上取得领先结果。
Motivation: 标准注意力机制不适用于立体匹配：全局注意力无显式匹配约束且计算量二次增长，局部注意力高效但丢失长距离对应。
Method: MatchAttention将显式匹配约束嵌入注意力，通过可学习相对位置中心化一个小连续采样窗口，并设计可微分连续注意力采样操作实现亚像素精度，通过级联残差块迭代优化。
Result: MatchAttentionXL在Middlebury V3上达到最优精度，在KITTI 2012/2015和ETH3D上取得顶级结果；MatchAttentionRT在RTX 4060 Ti上9.3ms，Jetson Orin NX上79.1ms（1024x512），是首个实现实时边缘推理且零样本泛化的立体模型。
Conclusion: 本文证明将显式匹配约束嵌入注意力可在保持线性复杂度的同时实现高精度长距离匹配，为立体匹配提供高效新范式。

papers.title: Echoes of Human Malice in Agents: Benchmarking LLMs for Multi-Turn Online Harassment Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are powering a growing share of interactive web applications, yet remain vulnerable to misuse and harm. Prior jailbreak research has largely focused on single-turn prompts, whereas real harassment often unfolds over multi-turn interactions. In this work, we present the Online Harassment Agentic Benchmark consisting of: (i) a synthetic multi-turn harassment conversation dataset, (ii) a multi-agent (e.g., harasser, victim) simulation informed by repeated game theory, (iii) three jailbreak methods attacking agents across memory, planning, and fine-tuning, and (iv) a mixed-methods evaluation framework. We utilize two prominent LLMs, LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct (open-source) and Gemini-2.0-flash (closed-source). Our results show that jailbreak tuning makes harassment nearly guaranteed with an attack success rate of 95.78--96.89% vs. 57.25--64.19% without tuning in Llama, and 99.33% vs. 98.46% without tuning in Gemini, while sharply reducing refusal rate to 1-2% in both models. The most prevalent toxic behaviors are Insult with 84.9--87.8% vs. 44.2--50.8% without tuning, and Flaming with 81.2--85.1% vs. 31.5--38.8% without tuning, indicating weaker guardrails compared to sensitive categories such as sexual or racial harassment. Qualitative evaluation further reveals that attacked agents reproduce human-like aggression profiles, such as Machiavellian/psychopathic patterns under planning, and narcissistic tendencies with memory. Counterintuitively, closed-source and open-source models exhibit distinct escalation trajectories across turns, with closed-source models showing significant vulnerability. Overall, our findings show that multi-turn and theory-grounded attacks not only succeed at high rates but also mimic human-like harassment dynamics, motivating the development of robust safety guardrails to ultimately keep online platforms safe and responsible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在线骚扰代理基准测试（Online Harassment Agentic Benchmark），包含合成多轮骚扰对话数据集、基于重复博弈论的多智能体模拟、三种针对记忆、规划和微调的越狱方法，以及混合方法评估框架。在LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct和Gemini-2.0-flash上的实验表明，越狱调整使攻击成功率从57–64%提升至95–97%，拒绝率降至1–2%，且模型表现出类人的攻击行为模式（如马基雅维利主义、精神病态、自恋倾向）。
Motivation: 现有越狱研究主要关注单轮提示，而真实骚扰通常发生在多轮交互中，缺乏针对多轮在线骚扰攻击的基准测试。
Method: 通过合成生成多轮骚扰对话数据集，结合重复博弈论设计多智能体模拟（骚扰者、受害者），并开发三种越狱方法分别攻击智能体的记忆、规划和微调模块，最后采用定量与定性混合评估框架。
Result: 越狱调整使LLaMA的攻击成功率从57.25–64.19%升至95.78–96.89%，Gemini从98.46%升至99.33%，拒绝率降至1–2%。最普遍的毒性行为是侮辱（84.9–87.8%）和引战（81.2–85.1%），而性骚扰和种族骚扰类别的防护较好。
Conclusion: 多轮且基于博弈论的越狱攻击不仅成功率高，还能复现人类骚扰行为动态，表明现有安全护栏不足，需开发更鲁棒的多轮交互防护机制。

papers.title: SSDD: Single-Step Diffusion Decoder for Efficient Image Tokenization
papers.abstract_en: Tokenizers are a key component of state-of-the-art generative image models, extracting the most important features from the signal while reducing data dimension and redundancy. Most current tokenizers are based on KL-regularized variational autoencoders (KL-VAE), trained with reconstruction, perceptual and adversarial losses. Diffusion decoders have been proposed as a more principled alternative to model the distribution over images conditioned on the latent. However, matching the performance of KL-VAE still requires adversarial losses, as well as a higher decoding time due to iterative sampling. To address these limitations, we introduce a new pixel diffusion decoder architecture for improved scaling and training stability, benefiting from transformer components and GAN-free training. We use distillation to replicate the performance of the diffusion decoder in an efficient single-step decoder. This makes SSDD the first diffusion decoder optimized for single-step reconstruction trained without adversarial losses, reaching higher reconstruction quality and faster sampling than KL-VAE. In particular, SSDD improves reconstruction FID from $0.87$ to $0.46$ with $1.4\times$ higher throughput and preserve generation quality of DiTs with $3.8\times$ faster sampling. As such, SSDD can be used as a drop-in replacement for KL-VAE, and for building higher-quality and faster generative models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SSDD，一种单步扩散解码器，用于高效图像标记化。通过蒸馏将多步扩散解码器压缩为单步解码器，无需对抗损失，在重建质量和采样速度上超越KL-VAE。
Motivation: 现有扩散解码器在图像标记化中需迭代采样和对抗损失，导致解码时间较长且训练不稳定，而KL-VAE存在重建质量瓶颈。
Method: 设计新的像素扩散解码器架构，利用Transformer组件实现更好的扩展性和训练稳定性，并通过蒸馏将多步扩散过程转化为单步解码器，避免使用对抗损失。
Result: SSDD将重建FID从0.87降至0.46，吞吐量提升1.4倍，生成质量保持DiT水平，采样速度提升3.8倍。
Conclusion: SSDD可作为KL-VAE的即插即用替代方案，用于构建更高质量、更快的生成模型，且无需对抗损失。

papers.title: MM-Nav: Multi-View VLA Model for Robust Visual Navigation via Multi-Expert Learning
papers.abstract_en: Visual navigation policy is widely regarded as a promising direction, as it mimics humans by using egocentric visual observations for navigation. However, optical information of visual observations is difficult to be explicitly modeled like LiDAR point clouds or depth maps, which subsequently requires intelligent models and large-scale data. To this end, we propose to leverage the intelligence of the Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model to learn diverse navigation capabilities from synthetic expert data in a teacher-student manner. Specifically, we implement the VLA model, MM-Nav, as a multi-view VLA (with 360 observations) based on pretrained large language models and visual foundation models. For large-scale navigation data, we collect expert data from three reinforcement learning (RL) experts trained with privileged depth information in three challenging tailor-made environments for different navigation capabilities: reaching, squeezing, and avoiding. We iteratively train our VLA model using data collected online from RL experts, where the training ratio is dynamically balanced based on performance on individual capabilities. Through extensive experiments in synthetic environments, we demonstrate that our model achieves strong generalization capability. Moreover, we find that our student VLA model outperforms the RL teachers, demonstrating the synergistic effect of integrating multiple capabilities. Extensive real-world experiments further confirm the effectiveness of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MM-Nav，一个基于多视角视觉输入（360度观测）的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，用于鲁棒视觉导航。通过模仿学习从三个强化学习专家（分别擅长到达、挤压和躲避）收集在线数据，并动态平衡训练比例。在合成环境和真实世界实验中展示了强泛化能力，学生模型甚至超越了教师专家。
Motivation: 视觉观测的光学信息难以像激光雷达点云或深度图那样显式建模，需要智能模型和大规模数据。现有方法依赖特权深度信息，本文希望利用VLA模型的智能从合成专家数据中学习多样导航能力。
Method: 提出MM-Nav多视角VLA模型，基于预训练大语言模型和视觉基础模型，处理360度观测。通过三个RL专家（使用特权深度信息）在三种定制环境中收集在线数据，迭代训练学生VLA模型，并动态平衡各能力训练比例。
Result: 在合成环境中实现强泛化能力，学生VLA模型超过RL教师专家，显示多能力协同效应。真实世界实验验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 本文的方法通过多专家学习和动态平衡，实现了鲁棒视觉导航，且学生模型超越教师。

papers.title: fev-bench: A Realistic Benchmark for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark quality is critical for meaningful evaluation and sustained progress in time series forecasting, particularly with the rise of pretrained models. Existing benchmarks often have limited domain coverage or overlook real-world settings such as tasks with covariates. Their aggregation procedures frequently lack statistical rigor, making it unclear whether observed performance differences reflect true improvements or random variation. Many benchmarks lack consistent evaluation infrastructure or are too rigid for integration into existing pipelines. To address these gaps, we propose fev-bench, a benchmark of 100 forecasting tasks across seven domains, including 46 with covariates. Supporting the benchmark, we introduce fev, a lightweight Python library for forecasting evaluation emphasizing reproducibility and integration with existing workflows. Using fev, fev-bench employs principled aggregation with bootstrapped confidence intervals to report performance along two dimensions: win rates and skill scores. We report results on fev-bench for pretrained, statistical, and baseline models and identify promising future research directions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 fev-bench，一个包含100个时间序列预测任务（其中46个含协变量）的基准测试，覆盖七个领域。配套的 fev 库强调可复现性和工作流集成，使用自助法置信区间进行原则性聚合，从胜率和技能评分两个维度报告性能。
Motivation: 现有时间序列预测基准存在领域覆盖有限、未考虑协变量、聚合统计不严谨、评估基础设施不统一等问题，影响模型比较的可靠性。
Method: 收集100个预测任务（46个含协变量），用轻量级 Python 库 fev 进行标准化评估，采用自助法置信区间计算胜率和技能评分。
Result: 报告了预训练、统计和基线模型在 fev-bench 上的结果，并识别了未来研究方向。
Conclusion: fev-bench 旨在提供更现实、统计严谨的时间序列预测基准，支持协变量和可复现评估。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Learning How to Use Tools, Not Just When: Pattern-Aware Tool-Integrated Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) has become a key approach for improving large reasoning models (LRMs) on complex problems. Prior work has mainly studied when to invoke tools, while overlooking how tools are applied. We identify two common patterns: a calculator pattern that uses code for direct computation, and an algorithmic pattern that encodes problems as programs. Misaligned choices often cause failures even when reasoning is sound. We propose a two-stage framework that first builds code competence from both patterns and then aligns pattern selection with teacher preferences. Across challenging math datasets, our pattern-aware method substantially improves both code usage and accuracy, for instance raising Code@1 on MATH500 from 64.0% to 70.5% and on AIME24 from 26.7% to 50.0%. These gains highlight the effectiveness of a pattern-aware approach for tool-integrated reasoning.
papers.journal_ref: The 5th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI at NeurIPS 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究工具集成推理（TIR）中如何使用工具，而不仅是何时使用。作者识别出两种常见模式：计算器模式（直接计算）和算法模式（将问题编码为程序），并指出模式选择不当会导致推理失败。提出的两阶段框架先构建两种模式的代码能力，再对齐模式选择与教师偏好。在数学数据集上，该方法显著提升了代码使用率和准确率，例如MATH500的Code@1从64.0%提升到70.5%，AIME24从26.7%提升到50.0%。
Motivation: 现有工作主要关注何时调用工具，忽略了如何应用工具，导致模式选择不当（如该用算法模式时用了计算器模式）引发推理失败。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段通过两种模式的训练数据构建代码能力；第二阶段利用教师偏好对齐模式选择，使模型学会根据问题特征选择恰当的工具使用模式。
Result: 在MATH500上Code@1从64.0%提升至70.5%，在AIME24上从26.7%提升至50.0%，表明模式感知方法能有效提升工具集成推理的准确性和代码使用率。
Conclusion: 模式感知的工具集成推理方法比仅关注何时调用工具更为有效，通过识别和利用工具使用模式可显著提升复杂数学问题的求解性能。

papers.title: Expert-guided Clinical Text Augmentation via Query-Based Model Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Data augmentation is a widely used strategy to improve model robustness and generalization by enriching training datasets with synthetic examples. While large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong generative capabilities for this purpose, their applications in high-stakes domains like healthcare present unique challenges due to the risk of generating clinically incorrect or misleading information. In this work, we propose a novel query-based model collaboration framework that integrates expert-level domain knowledge to guide the augmentation process to preserve critical medical information. Compared to existing LLM-based and traditional augmentation methods, our generated data significantly improves preservation of critical medical information and reduces hallucinations at both the token and concept levels. Experiments on downstream clinical prediction tasks demonstrate consistent performance gains over existing augmentation methods. This lightweight collaborative framework addresses the gap between LLM augmentation potential and the safety requirements of specialized domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于查询的模型协作框架，通过集成专家级领域知识来指导临床文本数据增强，以保留关键医疗信息并减少幻觉。实验表明，该方法在标记和概念层面均优于现有基于LLM和传统的数据增强方法，并在下游临床预测任务上取得一致性能提升。
Motivation: LLM在临床数据增强中存在生成临床不正确或误导性信息的风险，现有方法缺乏领域知识引导，难以保证关键医疗信息的保留和安全性。
Method: 提出查询式模型协作框架，利用专家级领域知识指导增强过程，通过查询机制整合外部专家知识，确保生成样本保留关键医疗信息并减少幻觉。
Result: 在标记和概念层面，该方法显著减少了幻觉，并更好地保留了关键医疗信息；下游临床预测任务上一致优于现有增强方法。
Conclusion: 该轻量级协作框架弥合了LLM数据增强潜力与专业领域安全要求之间的差距，但摘要未提及在非临床领域或更大规模数据集上的泛化性。

papers.title: ArchesClimate: Probabilistic Decadal Ensemble Generation With Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Internal variability is a dominant contributor to the uncertainty of predictions at the interannual to decadal timescale. A typical approach to separating the internal variability from forced climate responses is to generate large ensembles of simulations under different initial conditions. Due to the complexity of Earth System Models, generating these large ensembles is computationally expensive. In this work, we present ArchesClimate, a deep learning-based climate model emulator designed to reduce the cost of exploring internal variability at timescales ranging from monthly to decadal. ArchesClimate is trained on decadal hindcasts of the IPSL-CM6A-LR climate model. We train a flow matching model following ArchesWeatherGen, which we adapt to predict near-term climate. Once trained, the model generates states at a one-month lead time from the states of the two preceding months, and can be used to auto-regressively emulate climate model simulations. We show that for up to 10 years, these generations are stable and physically consistent. We also show that for several important climate variables, ArchesClimate generates simulations that are interchangeable with the IPSL model. This work suggests that climate model emulators could reduce the cost of generating large ensembles with climate models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ArchesClimate，一个基于流匹配（flow matching）的深度学习气候模型仿真器，用于生成月到年代际时间尺度的内变率集合。该模型以IPSL-CM6A-LR气候模式的年代际后报数据训练，通过自回归方式生成月超前状态，并能在10年内保持稳定和物理一致性。实验表明，对于多个重要气候变量，生成的仿真与原始模式可互换，有望降低生成大规模气候集合的计算成本。
Motivation: 年代际预测中内部变率是主要不确定性来源，传统方法通过大规模集合模拟来分离内部变率，但计算成本高昂。需要更高效的仿真方法。
Method: 基于ArchesWeatherGen架构，采用流匹配模型，以过去两个月的状态预测下一个月的状态，并通过自回归方式长时间仿真。模型在IPSL-CM6A-LR的十年期后报数据上训练。
Result: 生成的仿真在10年内保持稳定且物理一致；对于多个重要气候变量，仿真与IPSL模型的结果可互换。
Conclusion: 气候模型仿真器有潜力大幅降低生成大规模集合的计算成本。

papers.title: BabyHuBERT: Multilingual Self-Supervised Learning for Segmenting Speakers in Child-Centered Long-Form Recordings
papers.abstract_en: Child-centered daylong recordings are essential for studying early language development, but existing speech models trained on clean adult data perform poorly due to acoustic and linguistic differences. We introduce BabyHuBERT, a self-supervised speech model trained on 13,000 hours of multilingual child-centered recordings from 40+ languages. Evaluated on voice type classification, the task of identifying who produces speech and when in child-centered recordings (key child, other children, male, and female adults), BabyHuBERT-VTC achieves F1-scores from 55.0% to 76.1% across six corpora, consistently outperforming W2V2-LL4300 and HuBERT (pretrained on English daylongs and clean adult speech, respectively). Notable gains include 14.0 and 18.3 absolute F1 points over HuBERT on Vanuatu and Solomon Islands, demonstrating effectiveness on underrepresented languages. We share code and models to support researchers working with child-centered recordings across diverse linguistic contexts.

TL;DR: 本文提出BabyHuBERT，一个在13000小时多语种儿童中心录音（覆盖40+语言）上训练的自监督语音模型。在语音类型分类任务（识别儿童中心录音中说话者：关键儿童、其他儿童、男性和女性成人）上，BabyHuBERT在6个语料库上取得55.0%到76.1%的F1分数，一致优于W2V2-LL4300和HuBERT，特别是在瓦努阿图和所罗门群岛等低资源语言上分别提升14.0和18.3个绝对F1点。代码和模型已公开。
Motivation: 现有语音模型在儿童中心日间录音上表现不佳，因为其训练于干净成人语音，存在声学和语言差异。多语种、儿童相关的自监督语音模型缺乏。
Method: 采用自监督学习（HuBERT框架）在13000小时、40+语种的儿童中心录音上预训练BabyHuBERT，然后针对语音类型分类任务进行微调。
Result: 在6个语料库上，BabyHuBERT-VTC的F1分数为55.0%-76.1%，一致优于W2V2-LL4300和HuBERT；在瓦努阿图和所罗门群岛分别比HuBERT提高14.0和18.3个绝对F1点。
Conclusion: BabyHuBERT展示了多语种儿童中心录音自监督学习的有效性，尤其对低资源语言有益。代码和模型公开以支持跨语言儿童语音研究。

papers.title: Discovering New Theorems via LLMs with In-Context Proof Learning in Lean
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant promise in formal theorem proving. In this study, we investigate the ability of LLMs to discover novel theorems and produce verified proofs. We propose a pipeline called Conjecturing-Proving Loop (CPL), which iteratively generates mathematical conjectures and attempts to prove them in Lean 4. A key feature of CPL is that each iteration conditions the LLM on previously generated theorems and their formal proofs, enabling parameter-free improvement of proof strategies via in-context learning. We provide both theoretical and experimental evidence that CPL increases the discovery rate of hard-to-prove theorems compared to frameworks that generate statements and proofs simultaneously. Moreover, our experiments show that reusing the LLM's own formally verified outputs as context consistently improves subsequent proof success, demonstrating the effectiveness of self-generated in-context learning for neural theorem proving. The source code is available at https://github.com/auto-res/ConjecturingProvingLoop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文研究了LLM在形式定理证明中发现新定理的能力，提出了Conjecturing-Proving Loop (CPL)流水线，该流水线迭代生成数学猜想并在Lean 4中尝试证明。通过将先前生成的定理及其形式证明作为上下文，CPL利用上下文学习参数无关地改进证明策略。实验表明CPL提高了难证明定理的发现率，并证明重用自身生成的形式验证输出作为上下文能持续提高后续证明成功率。
Motivation: 探究LLM能否发现新颖定理并生成可验证的证明；现有同时生成语句和证明的框架发现困难定理的效率较低。
Method: 提出CPL迭代循环：每轮LLM基于之前生成的定理及其形式证明（上下文）生成新的猜想并尝试证明，从而利用上下文学习提升策略。
Result: 理论和实验证据表明CPL提高了难证明定理的发现率；重用自身生成的形式验证输出作为上下文一致地提高了后续证明成功率。
Conclusion: CPL通过上下文学习有效提升定理发现，展示了自生成上下文学习在神经定理证明中的作用。

papers.title: Simulation-based Inference via Langevin Dynamics with Score Matching
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-based inference (SBI) enables Bayesian analysis when the likelihood is intractable but model simulations are available. Recent advances in statistics and machine learning, including Approximate Bayesian Computation and deep generative models, have expanded the applicability of SBI, yet these methods often face substantial computational challenges as the sample size and parameter dimension increase. In this paper, we propose a novel scalable SBI method that integrates score matching with Langevin dynamics, while explicitly exploiting the statistical structure of log-likelihood functions. Our approach combines (i) a localization scheme that concentrates computation in regions of high posterior mass and (ii) a structured score network that embeds key properties of likelihood scores, including additivity across observations and Fisher information identities. We provide theoretical and empirical evidence demonstrating that the proposed structured score-matching approach improves statistical efficiency and computational scalability, achieving competitive or superior performance compared to existing SBI methods on both benchmark and challenging problems with large sample sizes and moderate-dimensional parameter spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可扩展的模拟推断（SBI）方法，将得分匹配与朗之万动力学结合，利用对数似然函数的统计结构。该方法通过局部化方案和结构化得分网络，分别在高层后验质量区域集中计算并嵌入似然得分的可加性及Fisher信息恒等式。理论和实验表明，该方法在统计效率和计算可扩展性上优于现有SBI方法。
Motivation: 现有SBI方法在大样本和高维参数场景下面临计算瓶颈，且未充分利用似然函数的统计结构。
Method: 结合局部化方案（聚焦高后验质量区域）与结构化得分网络（嵌入得分的可加性和Fisher信息恒等式），通过得分匹配和朗之万动力学实现推理。
Result: 在基准和挑战性问题上（大样本、中等维度参数空间），该方法表现出比现有SBI方法更优或相当的性能。
Conclusion: 利用似然函数的统计结构可以提升SBI的统计效率和计算可扩展性。

papers.title: Tactile Gesture Recognition with Built-in Joint Sensors for Industrial Robots
papers.abstract_en: While gesture recognition using vision or robot skins is an active research area in Human-Robot Collaboration (HRC), this paper explores deep learning methods relying solely on a robot's built-in joint sensors, eliminating the need for external sensors. We evaluated various convolutional neural network (CNN) architectures and collected a dataset to study the impact of data representation and model architecture on the recognition accuracy. Our results show that spectrogram-based representations significantly improve accuracy, while model architecture plays a smaller role. We also tested generalization to new robot poses, where spectrogram-based models performed better. Implemented on a Franka Emika Research robot, two of our methods, STFT2DCNN and STT3DCNN, achieved over 95% accuracy in contact detection and gesture classification. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of external-sensor-free tactile recognition and promote further research toward cost-effective, scalable solutions for HRC.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究仅利用机器人内置关节传感器进行触觉手势识别，无需外部传感器。通过评估多种CNN架构和数据集，发现基于频谱图的数据表示能显著提升识别精度，而模型架构影响较小。在Franka Emika机器人上，STFT2DCNN和STT3DCNN方法在接触检测和手势分类中达到超过95%的准确率。
Motivation: 现有手势识别多依赖视觉或机器人皮肤等外部传感器，增加了成本与复杂性。本文探索仅用机器人自身关节传感器的可能性，以实现更经济、可扩展的人机协作方案。
Method: 收集触觉数据并转换为频谱图（spectrogram）等表示，训练多种卷积神经网络（CNN）架构（如STFT2DCNN、STT3DCNN），在Franka Emika机器人上验证。
Result: 频谱图表示显著提升准确率；STFT2DCNN和STT3DCNN在接触检测和手势分类上均达到95%以上准确率，且对机器人新姿态具有良好的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 研究表明无需外部传感器的触觉手势识别是可行的，为低成本、可扩展的人机协作方案提供了基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Scaling Law: A Data-Efficient Distillation Framework for Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable reasoning capabilities in tasks such as algorithmic coding and mathematical problem-solving. Recent methods have improved reasoning through expanded corpus and multistage training combining reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning. Although some methods suggest that small but targeted dataset can incentivize reasoning via only distillation, a reasoning scaling laws is still taking shape, increasing computational costs. To address this, we propose a data-efficient distillation framework (DED) that optimizes the Pareto frontier of reasoning distillation. Inspired by the on-policy learning and diverse roll-out strategies of reinforcement learning, the key idea of our approach is threefold: (1) We identify that benchmark scores alone do not determine an effective teacher model. Through comprehensive comparisons of leading reasoning LLMs, we develop a method to select an optimal teacher model. (2) While scaling distillation can enhance reasoning, it often degrades out-of-domain performance. A carefully curated, smaller corpus achieves a balanced trade-off between in-domain and out-of-domain capabilities. (3) Diverse reasoning trajectories encourage the student model to develop robust reasoning skills. We validate our method through evaluations on mathematical reasoning (AIME 2024/2025, MATH-500) and code generation (LiveCodeBench), achieving state-of-the-art results with only 0.8k carefully curated examples, bypassing the need for extensive scaling. Our systematic analysis demonstrates that DED outperforms existing methods by considering factors beyond superficial hardness, token length, or teacher model capability. This work offers a practical and efficient pathway to advanced reasoning while preserving general capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出数据高效蒸馏框架（DED），旨在优化推理蒸馏的帕累托前沿，避免传统扩展法则的高计算成本。通过选择合适的教师模型、平衡领域内与领域外能力、以及多样化推理轨迹，仅用0.8k精选示例在数学推理（AIME 2024/2025, MATH-500）和代码生成（LiveCodeBench）上达到最优结果。
Motivation: 现有推理蒸馏方法受扩展法则影响，计算成本不断增加；同时大规模蒸馏会损害领域外性能。需要一个数据高效的蒸馏方法，在保持推理能力的同时不牺牲通用性能。
Method: 提出DED框架，包含三点核心：1）通过比较前沿推理LLM选择最优教师模型（非仅依赖基准分数）；2）使用精心策划的小规模语料平衡领域内与领域外性能；3）利用多样化推理轨迹培养学生鲁棒推理技能。
Result: 在AIME 2024/2025、MATH-500和LiveCodeBench上取得最佳结果，仅使用0.8k精选样本，无需大规模扩展。
Conclusion: DED通过考虑超越表面难度、令牌长度或教师模型能力的因素，优于现有方法，为先进推理提供实用高效路径。

papers.title: TAR: Temporal Anchor-Constrained Reasoning for Video Temporal Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Video Temporal Grounding (VTG) aims to localize specific video segments corresponding to natural language queries. While recent Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) employ Reinforcement Learning to generate Chains-of-Thought (CoT), they typically rely solely on outcome-based supervision. Consequently, this often leads to hallucinations, where the reasoning process becomes disconnected from the visual content and the final prediction. Existing attempts to mitigate this by relying on external supervision from larger models or separate reward models are computationally expensive and prone to rigid patterns. To address these challenges, we propose TAR (Temporal Anchor-Constrained Reasoning), a framework that introduces the temporal anchor (T-anchor) as a transparent and auditable checkpoint mechanism. T-anchor enforces progressive refinement within the CoT, compelling the model to continuously ground its intermediate thoughts in visual evidence and iteratively calibrate temporal predictions, thereby significantly enhancing the faithfulness and autonomy of the reasoning process and final accuracy. Furthermore, we introduce a bootstrapping paradigm that automatically harvests high-quality CoT data using only a standard 7B model, eliminating the dependency on ultra-large models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TAR achieves state-of-the-art performance and generates faithful, autonomous, and progressively refined reasoning traces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频时间定位任务中大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）使用强化学习生成思维链（CoT）时仅依赖结果监督导致推理过程与视觉内容脱节的问题，提出TAR框架。该框架引入时间锚点（T-anchor）作为透明检查点机制，强制CoT在推理过程中逐步接地于视觉证据并迭代校准时间预测，从而提升推理忠实度与最终准确性。同时提出一种自举范式，仅用标准7B模型自动生成高质量CoT数据，避免了依赖超大模型。实验表明TAR在多个视频时间定位基准上达到最佳性能，并生成忠实、自主且渐进细化的推理轨迹。
Motivation: 现有LVLM通过强化学习生成CoT，但仅依赖结果监督容易导致推理过程与视觉内容脱节，产生幻觉；而依赖外部监督（如更大模型或独立奖励模型）的方法计算昂贵且易陷入僵化模式。
Method: 提出TAR框架，核心是时间锚点（T-anchor）作为透明、可审计的检查点机制，在CoT中实施渐进细化，强迫模型将中间推理持续接地于视觉证据并迭代校准时间预测。此外引入自举范式，仅使用标准7B模型自动采集高质量CoT数据。
Result: 在多个视频时间定位基准上达到最佳性能（state-of-the-art），生成的推理轨迹忠实、自主且渐进细化。
Conclusion: TAR通过时间锚点约束有效增强了LVLM在视频时间定位任务中推理过程的忠实度和自主性，减少了幻觉，且无需依赖超大模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multi-Class Human/Object Detection on Robot Manipulators using Proprioceptive Sensing
papers.abstract_en: In physical human-robot collaboration (pHRC) settings, humans and robots collaborate directly in shared environments. Robots must analyze interactions with objects to ensure safety and facilitate meaningful workflows. One critical aspect is human/object detection, where the contacted object is identified. Past research introduced binary machine learning classifiers to distinguish between soft and hard objects. This study improves upon those results by evaluating three-class human/object detection models, offering more detailed contact analysis. A dataset was collected using the Franka Emika Panda robot manipulator, exploring preprocessing strategies for time-series analysis. Models including LSTM, GRU, and Transformers were trained on these datasets. The best-performing model achieved 91.11\% accuracy during real-time testing, demonstrating the feasibility of multi-class detection models. Additionally, a comparison of preprocessing strategies suggests a sliding window approach is optimal for this task.
papers.comment: 2025 IEEE 21st International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE), Los Angeles, CA, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在物理人机协作中，利用机器人本体感觉进行多类人/物体检测，从二元分类扩展到三类（人、软物体、硬物体）。在Franka Emika Panda机器人上采集数据，使用LSTM、GRU、Transformer等模型，最佳模型实时测试准确率91.11%，并比较了预处理策略，指出滑动窗口方法最优。
Motivation: 物理人机协作中需要识别接触物体以确保安全和有效工作流，之前工作仅能区分软硬物体，本文旨在提供更细粒度的三类接触分析。
Method: 使用Franka Emika Panda机器人采集本体感觉数据，采用滑动窗口等预处理策略，训练LSTM、GRU、Transformer三类时序模型进行三分类检测。
Result: 最佳模型实时测试准确率达91.11%，滑动窗口预处理策略表现最优。
Conclusion: 研究证明多类人/物体检测模型在物理人机协作中是可行的，可以更详细地分析接触类型。

papers.title: Reconsidering Overthinking: Penalizing Internal and External Redundancy in CoT Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) often exhibit overthinking, producing verbose Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces that increase inference cost and obscure the underlying reasoning process. Existing CoT compression methods mainly rely on global length rewards, which conflate necessary intermediate reasoning with redundant text and may therefore compromise reasoning fidelity. This paper revisits overthinking from a semantic-efficiency perspective and decomposes CoT redundancy into two distinct forms: internal redundancy, defined as informational stagnation before the first correct answer, and external redundancy, defined as superfluous continuation after the first correct answer. Based on this decomposition, we propose a dual-penalty reinforcement learning framework that separately optimizes reasoning progress and termination behavior. Specifically, a sliding-window semantic similarity metric penalizes low-progress reasoning segments, while a normalized external-redundancy metric discourages post-answer continuation. Experiments on GSM8K, MATH500, and AIME24 across different model scales show that our method reduces average reasoning length by 41.3% on the 1.5B model and 40.1% on the 7B model, while preserving competitive accuracy and achieving the best overall accuracy-efficiency score among evaluated baselines. The learned compression behavior further transfers to out-of-domain reasoning tasks, including GPQA and LiveCodeBench. More importantly, our analysis reveals a clear asymmetry between the two redundancy types: external redundancy can be largely removed with little performance loss, whereas internal redundancy compression follows a sensitive accuracy-efficiency trade-off. These results suggest that effective CoT compression should optimize semantic efficiency rather than sequence length alone, offering a principled route toward more concise, efficient, and interpretable LRMs.
papers.comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视大型推理模型中的过度思考问题，将思维链冗余分解为内部冗余（首次正确回答前的信息停滞）和外部冗余（首次正确回答后的多余延续）。提出双惩罚强化学习框架，分别优化推理进度和终止行为，在GSM8K、MATH500和AIME24上平均推理长度减少约40%，同时保持准确率。分析表明外部冗余可被大量移除而不损失性能，而内部冗余存在敏感的效率-准确率权衡。
Motivation: 现有CoT压缩方法主要依赖全局长度奖励，混淆了必要中间推理与冗余文本，可能损害推理保真度。
Method: 提出双惩罚强化学习框架：滑动窗口语义相似度度量惩罚低进度推理段，归一化外部冗余度量惩罚回答后的多余延续。
Result: 在1.5B模型上减少平均推理长度41.3%，在7B模型上减少40.1%，准确率竞争，总体准确率-效率得分最佳；压缩行为可迁移至域外任务。
Conclusion: 有效的CoT压缩应优化语义效率而非仅序列长度，为更简洁、高效、可解释的LRM提供原则性路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LoRAShield: Data-Free Editing Alignment for Secure Personalized LoRA Sharing
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) models has democratized personalized text-to-image generation, enabling users to share lightweight models (e.g., personal portraits) on platforms like Civitai and Liblib. However, this "share-and-play" ecosystem introduces critical risks: benign LoRAs can be weaponized by adversaries to generate harmful content (e.g., political, defamatory imagery), undermining creator rights and platform safety. Existing defenses like concept-erasure methods focus on full diffusion models (DMs), neglecting LoRA's unique role as a modular adapter and its vulnerability to adversarial prompt engineering. To bridge this gap, we propose LoRAShield, the first data-free editing framework for securing LoRA models against misuse. Our platform-driven approach dynamically edits and realigns LoRA's weight subspace via adversarial optimization and semantic augmentation. Experimental results demonstrate that LoRAShield achieves remarkable effectiveness, efficiency, and robustness in blocking malicious generations without sacrificing the functionality of the benign task. By shifting the defense to platforms, LoRAShield enables secure, scalable sharing of personalized models, a critical step toward trustworthy generative ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LoRA模型共享中的安全风险，提出首个无需数据的编辑框架LoRAShield，通过对抗优化和语义增强动态编辑LoRA权重子空间，在阻止恶意生成的同时保持良性任务性能。实验表明该方法在有效性、效率和鲁棒性上表现优异，为平台侧安全共享提供了可行方案。
Motivation: 现有防御主要针对全扩散模型，忽视了LoRA作为模块化适配器的独特性和对抗提示工程漏洞，导致平台在共享LoRA时面临恶意生成风险（如政治、诽谤图像）。
Method: 提出LoRAShield，一种数据无关的编辑框架，通过对抗优化（adversarial optimization）和语义增强（semantic augmentation）动态编辑和重新对齐LoRA的权重子空间，将防御迁移至平台侧。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在阻止恶意生成方面达到显著有效性、效率和鲁棒性，且不牺牲原始良性任务的功能性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过平台侧防御实现安全、可扩展的个性化LoRA共享，为可信生成生态系统迈出关键一步。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出LoRAShield，一种数据无关的编辑框架，通过对抗优化（adversarial optimization）和语义增强（semantic augmentation）动态编辑和重新对齐LoRA的权重子空间，将防御迁移至平台侧。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法在阻止恶意生成方面达到显著有效性、效率和鲁棒性，且不牺牲原始良性任务的功能性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调通过平台侧防御实现安全、可扩展的个性化LoRA共享，为可信生成生态系统迈出关键一步。

papers.title: Guided Unconditional and Conditional Generative Models for Super-Resolution and Inference of Quasi-Geostrophic Turbulence
papers.abstract_en: Typically, numerical simulations of Earth systems are coarse, and Earth observations are sparse and gappy. We apply four generative diffusion modeling approaches to super-resolution and inference of forced two-dimensional quasi-geostrophic turbulence on the beta-plane from coarse, sparse, and gappy observations. Two guided approaches minimally adapt a pre-trained unconditional model: SDEdit modifies the initial condition, and Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS) modifies the reverse diffusion process score. Two conditional approaches, a vanilla variant and classifier-free guidance, require training with paired high-resolution and observation data. We consider multiple test cases spanning: two regimes, eddy and anisotropic-jet turbulence; two Reynolds numbers, 10^3 and 10^4; and two observation types, 4x coarse-resolution fields and coarse, sparse and gappy observations. Our comprehensive skill metrics include norms of the reconstructed vorticity fields, turbulence statistical quantities, and quantifications of the super-resolved probabilistic ensembles and their errors. We also study the sensitivity to tuning parameters such as guidance strength. Results show that the generated super-resolution fields of SDEdit are unphysical, while those of DPS are reasonable but with smoothed fine-scale features; however, neither of these lower-cost models propagates observational information effectively to unobserved regions. The two conditional models require re-training, but reconstruct missing fine-scale features, are cycle-consistent with observations, and predict correct turbulence statistics, including the tails. Further, their mean errors are highly correlated with and predictable from their ensemble standard deviations. Results highlight the tradeoffs between ease of implementation, fidelity (sharpness), and cycle-consistency of the diffusion models, and offer practical guidance for deployment.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems, 18, e2025MS005324
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了四种生成扩散模型（两种引导式无条件模型SDEdit和DPS，以及两种条件式模型vanilla条件和无分类器引导）用于从粗粒度、稀疏且不完整的观测数据中提升二维准地转湍流（beta平面）的分辨率并进行推理。测试了涡旋和各向异性射流两种湍流状态、两种雷诺数（10^3和10^4）以及两种观测类型。结果表明，SDEdit生成的非物理场，DPS结果合理但平滑，而条件模型虽需重训练但能正确重构细尺度特征、保持循环一致性并预测正确湍流统计。
Motivation: 地球系统数值模拟通常分辨率粗，观测数据稀疏且有缺失，需要有效的超分辨率和推断方法。
Method: 采用四种扩散建模方法：SDEdit（修改初始条件）、DPS（修改逆扩散过程得分）、vanilla条件模型和无分类器引导条件模型。
Result: 条件模型重建的细尺度特征准确，与观测循环一致，并正确预测湍流统计（包括尾部分布）；其平均误差与集合标准差高度相关。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了扩散模型在实现简便性、忠实度（清晰度）和循环一致性之间的权衡，为实际部署提供了指导。

papers.title: MGDFIS: Multi-scale Global-detail Feature Integration Strategy for Small Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Small-object detection in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) imagery requires preserving weak local evidence while using broader context to separate tiny foreground targets from cluttered backgrounds. Existing multi-scale fusion methods improve feature aggregation, but they often add computation or blur fine details during repeated cross-scale fusion. The central challenge is to balance low-SNR target preservation, clutter suppression, and efficient cross-scale context exchange. To address this challenge, we propose the Multi-scale Global-detail Feature Integration Strategy (MGDFIS), a neck-level feature-fusion strategy that couples global context exchange, local-detail recovery, and pixel-level foreground-background recalibration. MGDFIS integrates three coordinated modules: FusionLock-TSS Attention for stabilizing spectral-spatial responses, Global-detail Integration for combining long-range mixing with local detail capture, and Dynamic Pixel Attention for reweighting compact foreground regions. On the controlled VisDrone setting, YOLO26m + MGDFIS improves AP50:95 from 25.7 to 30.2 and AP50 from 37.2 to 44.2 over the YOLO26m baseline, with 96.1 GFLOPs. Additional dataset-specific evaluations report 38.9 AP50 and 21.9 AP50:95 on UAVDT and 97.4 AP50 on CARPK. The code is available at: https://github.com/JackBaixue/MGDFIS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机图像中小目标检测中弱局部证据保留与全局上下文融合的挑战，提出多尺度全局-细节特征融合策略（MGDFIS），包含三个协调模块：FusionLock-TSS注意力、全局-细节整合和动态像素注意力。在VisDrone数据集上，基于YOLO26m的改进将AP50:95从25.7提升至30.2，AP50从37.2提升至44.2，计算量为96.1 GFLOPs。
Motivation: 现有多尺度融合方法在反复跨尺度融合中增加计算量或模糊细节，难以同时实现低信噪比目标保留、杂波抑制和高效的跨尺度上下文交换。
Method: 提出MGDFIS颈部特征融合策略，包含三个模块：FusionLock-TSS注意力用于稳定光谱-空间响应，全局-细节整合结合长程混合与局部细节捕获，动态像素注意力对紧凑前景区域重新加权。
Result: 在VisDrone上，YOLO26m+MGDFIS的AP50:95从25.7提升至30.2，AP50从37.2提升至44.2；在UAVDT上取得38.9 AP50和21.9 AP50:95；在CARPK上取得97.4 AP50。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过耦合全局上下文交换、局部细节恢复和像素级前景-背景重新标定，有效平衡了小目标检测中的多个核心挑战。

papers.title: XYZ-IBD: Benchmarking Robust 6D Object Pose Estimation under Real-World Industrial Complexity
papers.abstract_en: While current 6D pose estimation benchmarks have reached near-saturation on household objects, they often fail to capture the stochastic and optical complexities of industrial environments. We introduce XYZ-IBD, a high-precision benchmark for object detection and 6D pose estimation specifically designed for industrial bin-picking. XYZ-IBD addresses the domain gap by providing 75 multi-view real-world scenes containing approximately 273k annotated instances of metallic, symmetrical, and specular objects. Unlike existing datasets, our benchmark features high-density stochastic stacking and multi-instance ambiguity, reflecting authentic robotic manipulation challenges. We employ a rigorous multi-stage and semi-automatic annotation pipeline, ensuring sub-millimeter annotation accuracy. The annotations are validated through our designed error quantification scheme, securing the reliability of the annotation quality. In addition to real-world evaluation data, we provide a large-scale complementary synthetic training set that is rendered under a realistic bin-picking simulation. Benchmarking state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods for 2D detection and 6D pose estimation reveals a significant performance degradation compared to standard household benchmarks, highlighting the unsolved challenges of industrial vision. XYZ-IBD establishes a new frontier for robust pose estimation in complex, high-occlusion, and reflective scenarios. The dataset and benchmark are publicly available at https://xyz-ibd.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出XYZ-IBD，一个专为工业料箱抓取设计的高精度6D物体姿态估计基准。该基准包含75个真实场景和约27.3万个标注实例，针对金属、对称和高反射物体，并提供合成训练集。对SOTA方法的评估显示，在工业复杂场景下性能显著下降，揭示工业视觉中的未解挑战。
Motivation: 现有6D姿态估计基准在家庭物体上接近饱和，但未能反映工业环境的随机性和光学复杂性，缺乏专门针对工业料箱抓取的基准。
Method: 通过多阶段半自动标注管线实现亚毫米级精度，并设计误差量化方案保证标注可靠性；同时提供大规模合成训练集，在逼真的料箱抓取模拟中渲染。
Result: 对现有SOTA方法在2D检测和6D姿态估计上的评估表明，相比标准家庭基准，性能显著下降，突显工业视觉的挑战。
Conclusion: XYZ-IBD为复杂、高遮挡和反射场景下的鲁棒姿态估计建立了新前沿，数据集和基准已公开。
Relevance: 0
