papers.title: Fast Wireless Foundation Models with Early-Exits
papers.abstract_en: While wireless foundation models (FMs) are demonstrating strong potential to enable AI-Native 6G networks, their high computational cost remains a critical barrier to deployment. The large computational cost stems from the rigid, full-depth execution of the FM backbone for every task, a process we show is not only inefficient but can also degrade performance on unseen out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks. In this paper, we propose a novel early-exit FM framework that attaches lightweight, per-task heads, at the most appropriate exit-stage of a frozen wireless FM encoder, enabling variable-depth inference tailored to each task's preferred representation depth. Our results demonstrate that these intermediate-layer features not only speed-up inference significantly (up to 93% fewer FLOPs), but also provide more transferable representations that exceed the full encoder accuracy on unseen tasks. We further demonstrate that a simple fixed-exit strategy per task is more effective than traditional early-exiting policies that route different samples to different exits based on their perceived difficulty levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无线基础模型（wireless foundation models, FMs）全深度推理导致的高计算成本和OOD任务性能下降问题，提出一种早期退出（early-exit）框架。该框架在冻结的无线FM编码器的合适退出阶段附加每个任务的轻量级头部，实现任务自适应的可变深度推理。实验表明，中间层特征不仅显著加速推理（最多减少93% FLOPs），而且在未见过的OOD任务上提供比全编码器更优的迁移表示。此外，每任务固定退出策略优于传统基于样本难度的退出策略。
Motivation: 无线基础模型全深度推理不仅计算成本高，而且可能损害未见过分布（OOD）任务的表现。
Method: 提出早期退出FM框架：冻结无线FM编码器，在每个退出阶段附加每个任务的轻量级头部，根据任务偏好选择合适的退出阶段进行推理。
Result: 中间层特征最多减少93% FLOPs，在未见OOD任务上迁移表示准确率超过全编码器。每任务固定退出策略比传统基于样本难度的退出策略更有效。
Conclusion: 早期退出不仅能显著加速推理，还能通过中间层特征提升对未见过任务的泛化能力；每任务固定退出策略优于传统动态退出策略。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Two-Stage Prompt Optimization for Few-Shot Relation Extraction: From Reasoning-Guided Search to Gradient-Guided Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Automatic prompt optimization is still underexplored for episodic few-shot relation extraction with smaller language models. We propose a two-stage framework that combines reasoning-based prompt optimization with gradient-based prompt optimization. The first stage can use any reasoning-based optimizer to make broadprompt improvements in natural language. The second stage applies our GradPO, which uses loss and gradient signals to identify high-impact prompt spans and refine them with local edits. Experiments on FS-TACRED and FS-FewRel show that local refinement usually improves prompts found by the first stage, and GradPO is the most consistent refiner. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on FS-TACRED with Qwen3-4B and remains competitive on FS-FewRel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对少样本关系抽取任务，提出一个两阶段提示优化框架。第一阶段使用基于推理的优化器对提示进行宽泛的自然语言改进；第二阶段引入GradPO，利用损失和梯度信号识别高影响提示跨度并进行局部编辑。在FS-TACRED和FS-FewRel数据集上的实验表明，局部细化能有效提升第一阶段发现的提示质量，其中GradPO是最一致的细化器。在FS-TACRED上使用Qwen3-4B取得了当前最优性能。
Motivation: 自动提示优化在少样本关系抽取中仍未被充分探索，特别是当使用较小语言模型时，现有方法往往依赖单一优化策略，缺乏针对性的多阶段协同优化。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段采用任意基于推理的优化器（如LLM推理）对提示进行自然语言层面的宽泛修改；第二阶段使用所提出的GradPO，通过计算损失和梯度信号定位对模型输出影响最大的提示跨度，并对这些跨度进行局部编辑（如替换、删除、插入），实现精细调整。
Result: 在FS-TACRED和FS-FewRel两个少样本关系抽取基准上的实验显示：局部细化通常能进一步提升第一阶段提示的性能；GradPO作为局部细化器表现最一致，且在FS-TACRED上使用Qwen3-4B达到当前最优，在FS-FewRel上也具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 将基于推理的宽范围提示优化与基于梯度的局部细化相结合，能够有效提升少样本关系抽取中提示的自动优化效果，尤其适用于中小规模语言模型。

papers.title: Lie Group Diffusion Models for Hardware-Aware Quantum Circuit Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: An important task in quantum computing is unitary circuit synthesis compatible with physical hardware constraints. This problem has a natural hybrid structure as local single-qubit gates are continuous variables on the Lie group $SU(2)$ while the entangling circuit structure is discrete and hardware-dependent. In this work, we use generative models to perform quantum circuit synthesis incorporating both the natural $SU(2)$ manifold geometry of quantum gates and hardware constraints that determine the overall circuit structure. Our model comprises two components: a circuit skeleton selector that chooses an entangling circuit and a diffusion model that generates quantum gates on the given circuit template by performing diffusion on the curved manifold $\mathrm{SU(2)} \simeq S^3$ itself. We demonstrate this approach with unitary compilation of physically motivated three-qubit Hamiltonian simulation targets such as the Transverse Field Ising Model and the Heisenberg-XXZ Model and show that Lie group diffusion outperforms comparable baselines. The synthesised circuits can also be customised subject to constraints, which we demonstrate by producing circuits with large and small gate rotation angles for the same target unitary evolution. We also investigate the fidelity-complexity frontier of the synthesised gates to demonstrate that the circuit selector learns to select circuits that balance fidelity with complexity rather than collapsing onto the most expansive entangling template. These results demonstrate that Lie group diffusion provides a natural generative framework for hardware-aware quantum circuit synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于硬件感知量子电路合成的李群扩散模型，将单量子比特门视为SU(2)流形上的连续变量，通过扩散模型生成门参数，并结合电路骨架选择器处理离散结构。在三位量子比特哈密顿模拟任务（如横场伊辛模型和海森堡XXZ模型）上，该方法优于基线。
Motivation: 量子电路合成需同时处理连续变量（单量子比特门在SU(2)流形上）和离散硬件约束（纠缠电路结构），现有方法难以自然融合这两种性质。
Method: 模型包括两个组件：电路骨架选择器（选择纠缠电路模板）和扩散模型（在SU(2)≈S^3曲面上执行扩散以生成门参数），实现端到端生成。
Result: 在三位量子比特的横场伊辛模型和海森堡XXZ模型酉编译任务中，李群扩散模型优于基线，并能按约束定制电路（如生成大或小旋转角度的电路）。电路选择器学会平衡保真度与复杂度。
Conclusion: 李群扩散为硬件感知量子电路合成提供了自然的生成框架，能同时处理几何连续性和硬件约束。

papers.title: VIB-AVSR: Variational Information Bottleneck for Noise-Robust LLM-Based Audio-Visual Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Audio-Visual Speech Recognition takes two input modalities, acoustic and visual streams, where visual information from lip movements aids recognition when audio is noisy. Recently, LLM-based AVSR models have emerged as a promising paradigm by connecting pre-trained audio-visual encoders to an LLM, achieving strong results in clean conditions. However, these models are predominantly optimized for clean acoustic conditions, with limited attention to making the LLM backbone robust to noise. No explicit mechanism is employed to produce stable representations under corrupted audio, leading to performance degradation in noisy environments. To address this, we propose VIB-AVSR, which integrates Variational Information Bottleneck layers at targeted positions within the LLM backbone to regularize representations. VIB-AVSR reduces degradation under noisy conditions across multiple SNR levels and noise types, without requiring architectural modifications or additional training data.
papers.comment: Accepted to INTERSPEECH 2026. Our code is available at https://github.com/PiyushArora1010/VIB-AVSR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VIB-AVSR，在基于LLM的视听语音识别模型中集成变分信息瓶颈（VIB）层，以提升对噪声的鲁棒性。摘要显示该方法在多种噪声类型和信噪比水平下减少了性能下降，且无需架构修改或额外数据。
Motivation: 现有LLM-based AVSR模型在干净条件下表现好，但在噪声环境下性能下降，因为缺乏显式机制产生稳定表示。本文旨在解决这个问题。
Method: 在LLM骨干网络的关键位置插入变分信息瓶颈层，对表示进行正则化，从而增强噪声鲁棒性。
Result: 在多个SNR水平和噪声类型下，VIB-AVSR减少了噪声环境下的性能下降，且无需修改架构或额外训练数据。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法有效提升了LLM-based AVSR的噪声鲁棒性，且简单易用。

papers.title: SFBench: The SciFy Scientific Feasibility Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: We present SFBench, a benchmark dataset for evaluating systems that assess the feasibility of scientific claims. SFBench includes 197 claims in materials science, each annotated with a ground-truth feasibility score on a five-point scale along with an explanation of that assessment. The collection differs from previous collections in several important ways: 1) it defines a complex task that requires reasoning over claims of varying scientific feasibility; 2) its claims are not extracted from existing scientific publications but are created de novo, greatly reducing the chances that LLMs have trained on them; 3) claims and ground truth are established by subject matter experts, not by artificial intelligence; and 4) unlike many benchmarks that ask about question/answer pairs, provide multiple choice answers, or ask questions requiring short, fixed answers, SFBench explanations are completely open-ended. We describe the benchmark design, data creation process, and evaluation metrics, and we report baseline results using recent GPT models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SFBench 是一个用于评估系统判断科学主张可行性的基准数据集，包含 197 条材料科学领域的声明，每条都有专家标注的可行度评分（五级量表）和开放式解释。与现有基准不同，声明非从现有文献提取而是全新创建，降低了 LLM 预训练污染的可能。论文报告了 GPT 模型的基线结果。
Motivation: 现有科学可行性评估任务缺乏标准基准，且已有数据集多基于现有文献，可能被 LLM 记忆，难以评估真实推理能力。
Method: 构建包含 197 条材料科学声明的新数据集，由领域专家标注可行度和解释，使用五级量表和开放解释，并提供评估指标和 GPT 模型基线。
Result: GPT 模型在 SFBench 上的基线表现表明该任务具有挑战性，具体数值未在摘要中明确给出。
Conclusion: SFBench 提供了评估科学声明可行性的新基准，其独创声明和专家标注减少了数据泄露风险，但仅覆盖材料科学领域，扩展性有待验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Kriging and neural network models for pressure losses across perforated plates
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, two novel data-driven models based on kriging and neural networks (NN) are proposed to predict pressure losses across perforated plates with circular perforations in turbulent flows. The models are developed using two sets of experimental data available in the literature. The predictive performance of the proposed models is assessed and compared against widely used empirical formulae. It is found that the proposed models consistently outperform existing empirical models for most perforated plate configurations contained in the experimental datasets. Besides, the predicted pressure losses generally show good agreement with experimental measurements, demonstrating that data-driven approaches based on kriging and NN provide a feasible framework for modelling pressure losses across perforated plates. Overall, both approaches are promising, despite being trained on a relatively limited amount of experimental data, owing to the scarcity of measurements reported in the literature. To demonstrate the applicability of the proposed models in numerical simulations, two-dimensional channel flows are simulated using the Reynolds-averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) equations, in which the new pressure-loss models are implemented as a source term in the momentum equations. The RANS predictions are found to be in excellent agreement with the model predictions, confirming the suitability of the proposed approaches for practical computational fluid dynamics applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于克里金和神经网络的数据驱动模型，用于预测湍流中圆孔穿孔板的压力损失。利用文献中的两组实验数据训练模型，并与常用经验公式比较，发现新模型在多数配置下表现更优。将模型作为源项植入RANS方程进行二维通道流模拟，预测结果与模型一致，验证了其在实际CFD应用中的可行性。
Motivation: 现有经验公式预测穿孔板压力损失精度有限，缺乏基于数据驱动的方法；且实验数据稀缺，需要利用有限数据建立可靠模型。
Method: 采用克里金插值和神经网络两种数据驱动方法，基于文献中两组实验数据训练，预测穿孔板压力损失。
Result: 新模型在多数穿孔板配置上优于现有经验公式，预测与实验测量吻合良好；RANS模拟结果与模型预测高度一致。
Conclusion: 数据驱动方法（克里金和神经网络）为穿孔板压力损失建模提供了可行框架，尽管训练数据有限，但模型性能优良，适用于实际CFD应用。

papers.title: SCARCE: Scalable Cascade Analysis for Rare-event Characterisation via Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Rare events govern the safety profile of modern AI systems, yet their probabilities are extremely difficult to estimate: direct Monte Carlo requires prohibitive sample budgets. Subset Simulation (SS) addresses this by decomposing a rare-event probability into moderate conditional probabilities over nested intermediate events. However, classical SS requires a handcrafted scalar performance function whose sublevel sets define those events, demanding detailed knowledge of the failure geometry and limiting transfer to new domains. We propose SCARCE (Scalable Cascade Analysis for Rare-event Characterisation via Embeddings), which replaces the performance function with learned latent representations and geometric rulers that score proximity to failure regions. Adaptive thresholding constructs nested intermediate events directly from data. We formalise SCARCE through a non-negative supermartingale, yielding a high-probability upper envelope that remains valid under early stopping. On MNIST misclassification, where dense Monte Carlo provides ground truth, SCARCE achieves approximately 400--500 times lower mean absolute error than grid-searched traditional SS while eliminating systematic over-counting. We then study PAIR-style LLM jailbreaks under a fleet-level threat model with adversarial fraction $η$. On Llama-Guard-3-8B hidden states, a PCA-based ruler attains 2.6% mean relative error for $η\geq 10^{-3}$ against finite-sample references whose average bootstrap relative half-width is 27.9%, and transfers to a GCG-style corpus with 2.93% relative error after recalibration. A directional criterion $\mathrm{KL}(p_{\mathrm{good}}\,\|\,p_{\mathrm{bad}})$ ranks rulers consistently with estimation error (Spearman $ρ=0.83$).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCARCE方法，用嵌入和几何度量替代传统子集模拟（SS）中的手工性能函数，实现稀有事件概率的高效估计。通过非负上鞅理论保证早期停止时的概率上界，在MNIST误分类和LLM越狱检测中验证了高精度和可迁移性。
Motivation: 稀有事件概率估计对AI系统安全至关重要，但传统蒙特卡洛方法样本需求过大，而子集模拟依赖手工设计的性能函数，难以推广到新领域。
Method: 用学习到的潜在表示和几何度量（如PCA-based ruler）来评分接近失效区域的样本，通过自适应阈值构建嵌套中间事件，并利用非负上鞅理论推导高概率上界。
Result: 在MNIST误分类任务上，相对于网格搜索的传统子集模拟，平均绝对误差降低约400-500倍；在Llama-Guard-3-8B的LLM越狱检测中，PCA-based ruler在对抗比例η≥10^{-3}时达到2.6%平均相对误差，且可迁移至其他攻击文本。
Conclusion: SCARCE通过嵌入表示消除了对手工性能函数的依赖，在保持理论保证的同时提高了估计精度和可迁移性，为稀有事件估计提供了可扩展的框架。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Bidirectional Autoregressive Latent Diffusion for Forward and Inverse Magnetohydrodynamics
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a new bidirectional autoregressive latent diffusion approach for predicting the evolution of multiple fields (mass density, pressure, velocity, and magnetic field components) for magnetohydrodynamics. We show that this bidirectional flow can be used as a self-supervised consistency metric for uncertainty and error estimation, which enables the model to estimate test-time uncertainty and error without access to ground truth, by comparing how closely flowing forwards and backwards in time returns to the same predicted fields. We also demonstrate this methods's potential to serve as a non-invasive plasma diagnostic, and show how adaptive feedback can be used to make the model more robust based on sparse diagnostics or limited views/measurements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种双向自回归潜在扩散方法（bidirectional autoregressive latent diffusion），用于预测磁流体动力学（MHD）中的多个物理场（质量密度、压力、速度、磁场分量）。该方法通过比较正向和反向传播的预测一致性，实现无需真值即可估计测试时的不确定性和误差，并展示了作为非侵入性等离子体诊断工具以及利用稀疏观测进行自适应反馈增强鲁棒性的潜力。
Motivation: 磁流体动力学场演化预测中，传统方法难以同时处理前向和逆问题，且缺乏自监督的误差估计手段。
Method: 构建一个双向自回归潜在扩散模型，使得正向和反向时间传播的预测场之间具有一致性，从而利用该一致性作为自监督度量进行不确定性估计。
Result: 摘要表明该方法能有效估计无真值情况下的测试误差，并展示出在非侵入性等离子体诊断和稀疏观测下的鲁棒性提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调双向流的一致性可作为通用自监督度量，为等离子体物理中的不确定性量化和逆问题提供新思路。

papers.title: Do We Still Need Fine Tuning? Turkish Sentiment Analysis in the Era of Large Language Model
papers.abstract_en: This study examines whether supervised fine-tuning remains necessary for Turkish sentiment analysis in the era of large language models. We compare classical machine learning methods, fine-tuned pretrained language models, and prompted large language models on a Turkish e-commerce review dataset with negative, neutral, and positive labels. Fine-tuned BERTurk models perform best overall and outperform all prompted large language models in the full three-class task. The neutral class emerges as the main difficulty: while several large language models are much more competitive in binary positive--negative classification, they degrade substantially in the three-class setting by collapsing neutral reviews into polarized categories. The findings suggest that, in realistic Turkish sentiment classification, prompted large language models do not yet match supervised fine-tuning in the zero-shot setting, and that including the neutral class is crucial for robust evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 34th IEEE Signal Processing and Communications Applications Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了在大语言模型时代，监督微调是否仍然是土耳其情感分析的必要步骤。在土耳其电商评论数据集（包含负、中、正三类）上，比较了经典机器学习、微调预训练语言模型和提示大语言模型。微调的BERTurk模型表现最佳，在所有三分类任务中均优于所有提示大语言模型；而提示大语言模型在二分类（正负）中表现竞争，但在三分类中因将中性评论错误分类为极化类别而性能大幅下降。
Motivation: 随着大语言模型的兴起，零样本提示被广泛使用，但监督微调是否仍必要存在争议。本文针对土耳其语这一低资源语言，检验提示大语言模型能否取代微调方法。
Method: 采用土耳其电商评论数据集（负、中、正三类），对比经典机器学习、微调BERTurk等预训练模型以及多种大语言模型的零样本提示性能。
Result: 微调BERTurk在三分类中准确率最高，显著优于所有提示大语言模型。提示大语言模型在二分类中接近微调模型，但在三分类中因中性类混淆而大幅退化。
Conclusion: 在现实土耳其情感分类中，提示大语言模型还不能替代监督微调；中性类的存在对鲁棒评估至关重要。

papers.title: Does Role Specialization Matter for Explanation Faithfulness in Mixture-of-Experts?
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have recently been extended with role-based mechanisms for interpretability. This is typically done by assigning semantic roles to individual expert components, for example roles like synergy, redundancy, and uniqueness in multimodal settings. However, whether such structural role decomposition preserves explanation faithfulness of the overall architecture remains largely underexplored. We hypothesize that inter-expert representation overlap weakens effective role separation and degrades attribution-based faithfulness, even when semantic roles are explicitly defined. To address this limitation, we introduce representation-level decorrelation regularization to explicitly reduce inter-expert similarity in latent space. Using representation decorrelation objectives, we encourage clearer specialization among experts by minimizing representation overlap. Our experiments show that across multiple multimodal benchmarks, this separation consistently improves explanation faithfulness, as measured by comprehensiveness, sufficiency, and their Area Over the Perturbation Curve (AOPC) summaries, while preserving task performance. We further show that these improvements are not limited to role-based architectures such as Interpretable Multimodal Interaction-aware MoE (I2MoE). Similar trends are observed in a standard sparse MoE baseline, suggesting that representation-level separation may provide a more general mechanism for enhancing explanation faithfulness in MoE systems. Overall, our findings suggest that structural role decomposition alone may be insufficient to guarantee faithful explanations and that representation-level separation helps improve explanation faithfulness. To support reproducibility, the source code and supplementary material are publicly available at https://github.com/dut0817/FL-I2MoE_Decor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究混合专家模型（MoE）中角色专业化对解释忠实性（explanation faithfulness）的影响。作者发现专家间表示重叠会削弱角色分离，降低基于归因的忠实性，并提出表示级去相关正则化（decorrelation regularization）来减少专家间相似性。在多模态基准上，该方法在不牺牲任务性能的前提下，提升了忠实性指标（comprehensiveness, sufficiency, AOPC）。
Motivation: 现有MoE架构通过为专家分配语义角色（如协同、冗余、唯一性）来提升可解释性，但角色分解是否真的保证了解释忠实性仍未探索。作者假设专家间表示重叠会削弱角色分离，导致忠实性下降。
Method: 提出表示级去相关正则化（representation-level decorrelation regularization），在潜在空间中显式减少专家间的表示相似性，从而鼓励更清晰的专业化。
Result: 在多个多模态基准上，该方法持续提升了由comprehensiveness、sufficiency和AOPC度量的解释忠实性，同时保持了任务性能。改进不仅在角色化架构（如I2MoE）中观察到，在标准稀疏MoE基线中也类似，表明表示级分离可普遍提升MoE的忠实性。
Conclusion: 结构角色分解本身可能不足以保证忠实解释，而表示级分离有助于提升解释忠实性。代码公开。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Mechanistically Eliciting Latent Behaviors in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We aim to discover diverse, generalizable perturbations of LLM internals that can surface hidden behavioral modes. Such perturbations could help reshape model behavior and systematically evaluate potential risks. We introduce Causal Perturbative Elicitation (CPE), an unsupervised method for discovering interpretable low-rank adapters (LoRAs) that can elicit these latent behaviors. CPE decomposes the computations of a deep transformer slice using a heuristic tensor-decomposition-based algorithm. CPE exhibits remarkable data efficiency, learning a large number of interpretable LoRAs from a single example. Even though CPE is unsupervised, we find that in some cases it can be competitive with supervised elicitation methods via brute-force enumerative search over weight space. For instance, CPE performs similarly to matched-wall-clock-time GRPO on the Countdown task for Qwen3-8B (85% vs 87%), demonstrating that CPE can efficiently elicit complex multi-token behaviors. Since CPE is unsupervised, it can also surface hidden failure modes, such as sandbagging, restoring 85% of locked BigCodeBench performance on a password-locked version of Llama3-70B introduced by Taylor et al. (2025). Additionally, since CPE explores behaviors in weight-space rather than token-space it can potentially ameliorate exploration hacking, a misalignment failure which may arise in sufficiently self-aware AI models (Ngo, 2022). In fact, we find that CPE virtually eliminates alignment-faking (Greenblatt et al., 2024) behavior in a Llama3-70B-based model organism developed by Hughes et al. (2025). Finally, we find that CPE can be used to initialize GPT-OSS-20B in an aligned basin when running GRPO on an environment prone to reward-hacking. By providing a data-efficient method to systematically explore the space of latent model behaviors, CPE yields a powerful tool for aligning AI systems and evaluating their safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出无监督方法Causal Perturbative Elicitation (CPE)，通过启发式张量分解分解深层transformer切片，学习可解释的低秩适配器(LoRAs)以引发语言模型中的潜在行为。CPE数据高效，能从单样本学习大量LoRAs，无监督但竞争有监督方法(如Countdown任务85% vs GRPO 87%)。还能发现隐藏故障模式如sandbagging，恢复被密码锁定的Llama3-70B性能，消除alignment-faking行为，并可用于初始化aligned basin。
Motivation: 现有方法难以系统揭示语言模型中的潜在行为模式，尤其隐藏的安全风险。CPE旨在提供一种无监督、数据高效且可解释的方法来探索这些行为。
Method: 使用因果扰动性引发(CPE)，基于启发式张量分解算法分析深层transformer切片，生成低秩适配器(LoRAs)，无需监督标签即可引发多种行为。
Result: Countdown任务中CPE达到85%准确率(GRPO为87%)；在密码锁定的Llama3-70B上恢复85%的BigCodeBench性能；几乎消除Llama3-70B中的alignment-faking行为；可初始化GPT-OSS-20B的对齐盆地。
Conclusion: CPE提供数据高效且无监督的方式系统探索模型潜在行为，是AI对齐和安全评估的有力工具，同时可能缓解探索黑客问题。

papers.title: Langshaw: Declarative Interaction Protocols Based on Sayso and Conflict
papers.abstract_en: Current languages for specifying multiagent protocols either over-constrain protocol enactments or complicate capturing their meanings. We propose Langshaw, a declarative protocol language based on (1) sayso, a new construct that captures who has priority over setting each attribute, and (2) nono and nogo, two constructs to capture conflicts between actions. Langshaw combines flexibility with an information model to express meaning. We give a formal semantics for Langshaw, procedures for determining the safety and liveness of a protocol, and a method to generate a message-oriented protocol (embedding needed coordination) suitable for flexible asynchronous enactment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Langshaw，一种基于 sayso（属性优先级）和 nono/nogo（冲突捕获）的声明式多智能体协议语言。该语言结合灵活性与信息模型表达协议含义，并为协议的安全性和活性提供了判定过程，同时支持生成适用于异步执行的消息导向协议。
Motivation: 现有协议语言要么过度约束协议执行，要么使含义捕获复杂化，缺乏灵活性与表达性的平衡。
Method: 提出 Langshaw 语言，引入 sayso 结构定义属性优先级，nono/nogo 结构定义动作冲突；给出形式语义、安全性和活性判定方法，以及生成嵌入必要协调的消息协议的过程。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验或数值结果，主要贡献为语言设计与形式化分析。
Conclusion: Langshaw 通过声明式方式结合灵活性与信息模型，为多智能体协议提供了一种既能表达意义又支持异步执行的规范方法。

papers.title: One Scene, Two Depths: Probing Geometric Ambiguity in Monocular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: A faithful 3D world representation should account for layered geometry, where a single camera ray may contain multiple visible and geometrically valid surfaces. Monocular depth estimation, however, reduces this structure to one scalar depth per pixel. Transparent scenes make this ambiguity measurable: the same ray can pass through foreground glass and observe the background, turning the supervised target into a convention of annotation, data, and training rather than a scene-intrinsic truth. A learned predictor exposes this convention as its depth-layer preference. We introduce MultiDepth-3k (MD-3k), a sparse two-layer ordinal benchmark for measuring depth-layer preference and multi-layer spatial relationship accuracy (ML-SRA). On MD-3k, leading depth foundation models exhibit diverse layer preferences under standard RGB input, showing that the same layered geometry can be resolved differently across models. We further find that Laplacian Visual Prompting (LVP), a training-free spectral input transformation, can substantially change the reported layer for certain frozen models. The strongest RGB/LVP pair, DAv2-L, reaches 75.5% ML-SRA. These results suggest that depth foundation models may express complementary geometric hypotheses that standard RGB inference leaves unexpressed. We invite the community to rethink depth supervision and evaluation through an ambiguity-aware lens, where multiple valid 3D interpretations are treated as geometric structure to be measured, preserved, and expressed.
papers.comment: 49 pages, 25 figures; Accepted by European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单目深度估计在透明场景中的几何歧义性。同一光线可能穿过多个可见表面，但传统深度估计仅输出单标量深度。作者提出MD-3k基准（稀疏双层序数基准）来测量深度层偏好和多层空间关系准确性（ML-SRA）。实验表明，不同深度基础模型对透明场景的深度层偏好各异，且拉普拉斯视觉提示（LVP）无需训练即可显著改变某些冻结模型的深度层输出。DAv2-L在RGB/LVP组合下达到75.5% ML-SRA。
Motivation: 现有单目深度估计将场景缩减为单标量深度，忽略了光线可能经过多个几何有效表面的事实，尤其在透明场景中该歧义性可被测量。
Method: 构建MD-3k稀疏双层序数基准，提出多层空间关系准确性（ML-SRA）指标。引入拉普拉斯视觉提示（LVP），一种无训练的频谱输入变换，通过修改输入图像的高频成分来改变模型深度层偏好。
Result: 在MD-3k上，多种深度基础模型在标准RGB输入下呈现不同深度层偏好；DAv2-L模型在RGB/LVP组合下ML-SRA达到75.5%。
Conclusion: 深度基础模型可能表达互补的几何假设，而标准RGB推理未能释放这些假设。呼吁采用歧义感知视角重新审视深度监督与评估。

summary_sections.method: 构建MD-3k稀疏双层序数基准，提出多层空间关系准确性（ML-SRA）指标。引入拉普拉斯视觉提示（LVP），一种无训练的频谱输入变换，通过修改输入图像的高频成分来改变模型深度层偏好。
summary_sections.result: 在MD-3k上，多种深度基础模型在标准RGB输入下呈现不同深度层偏好；DAv2-L模型在RGB/LVP组合下ML-SRA达到75.5%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 深度基础模型可能表达互补的几何假设，而标准RGB推理未能释放这些假设。呼吁采用歧义感知视角重新审视深度监督与评估。

papers.title: Boundary Degree as a Node-level Feature for Epidemic Scenario Identification in Agent-based Cascade Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Characterizing the scenario underlying an epidemic from its disease cascade is an important task in simulation analytics. We propose boundary degree, the count of an infected node's contacts in the underlying contact network that were not infected, as a per-node cascade feature for this task. Through systematic ablation on realistic social contact networks of Tennessee and Virginia, we show that boundary degree alone improves scenario identification accuracy by 19%. Edge features, whose importance was observed empirically by prior work, consistently improve accuracy across all settings; we provide theoretical grounding for this observation. These effects are complementary. We prove that certain epidemic scenarios are indistinguishable without boundary or edge information. Prior feature engineering approaches included aggregate boundary statistics, but these were not among the top-ranked feature groups; the per-node representation we propose reveals their importance clearly. Our results suggest that contact tracing applications should track contacts with non-infected individuals, not only transmissions.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 10 figures, preliminary version; not final
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出边界度（boundary degree）作为节点级级联特征，用于从基于智能体的级联模拟中识别流行病场景。在田纳西和弗吉尼亚的真实社交网络上进行消融实验，仅使用边界度特征即可将场景识别准确率提升19%。边特征（edge features）在所有设置下持续提升准确率，作者为其提供了理论依据，并证明两种特征互补。此外，作者从理论上指出，若无边界或边信息，某些流行病场景无法区分。
Motivation: 现有方法在流行病场景识别中缺乏对节点级边界信息的有效利用，聚合边界统计量未能体现其重要性，且缺乏理论上的可区分性保证。
Method: 提出边界度（感染节点在接触网络中未感染的邻居数量）作为每个感染节点的级联特征，在真实社交网络上进行系统消融实验，并给出理论分析证明某些场景不可区分。
Result: 在田纳西和弗吉尼亚的社交网络模拟中，仅边界度特征即可提升19%的场景识别准确率；边特征始终有效且与边界度互补；理论证明了边界或边信息对于区分某些场景的必要性。
Conclusion: 接触追踪应用应不仅追踪传播事件，还应记录感染者与非感染者的接触，以提升流行病场景识别能力。

papers.title: How AI settled the complexity of the oldest SGD algorithm
papers.abstract_en: In 1937, Stefan Kaczmarz proposed a simple algorithm for solving systems of linear equations. This algorithm turned out to be the earliest known example of stochastic gradient descent, a ubiquitous computing paradigm that drives the training of modern AI models such as ChatGPT and Gemini. Now, those AI models have joined forces to discover the worst-case complexity of the Kaczmarz algorithm. This paper tells the story of how it happened.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回顾了Kaczmarz算法作为最早随机梯度下降（SGD）例子的历史，并借助现代AI模型（如ChatGPT和Gemini）确定了该算法的最坏情况复杂度。论文讲述了AI如何协助解决这一经典理论问题的过程。
Motivation: Kaczmarz算法自1937年提出以来，其最坏情况复杂度一直未被精确确定，这一理论空白阻碍了对该算法本质的理解。
Method: 利用大型语言模型等AI工具的生成与搜索能力，辅助数学推导和反例构造，从而确定最坏情况复杂度。
Result: 成功确定了Kaczmarz算法在最坏情况下的精确复杂度，解决了该算法长期以来的理论难题。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了AI模型在理论计算机科学和优化理论中的辅助作用，为利用AI解决经典算法问题提供了新范式。

papers.title: STEMGym: Benchmarking Sequential Decision-Making under Dose Budgets in Autonomous Electron Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: A central premise of autonomous scientific imaging is that smarter navigation, whether Bayesian, RL-based, or otherwise adaptive, is the principal lever for sample-efficient acquisition. We present evidence to the contrary in scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM), an atomic-resolution imaging modality whose every measurement deposits damaging electron dose. We introduce STEMGym, an open-source Gymnasium benchmark of 15 physics-simulated STEM worlds spanning five materials, three difficulty levels, and four characterisation tasks, scored by the Dose-Efficiency Curve area (DEC-AUC), a single scalar capturing the information-vs-dose Pareto frontier. Across 33 agent configurations under realistic dose budgets, the dominant determinant of dose efficiency is the analyst (perception) pipeline, not the navigator: pairing a trained CNN analyst with naïve raster scanning raises DEC-AUC by 5.5x over a CNN-free raster baseline (0.287 vs.\ 0.052), while substituting Bayesian or adaptive finite-state-machine navigation for raster yields no statistically significant further gain. Production-tier vision-language models further underperform task-specific CNNs by {\sim}13x on crystallographic defect analysis. By decoupling perception, navigation, and planning under a unified dose budget, STEMGym reframes where ML effort should be invested in autonomous electron microscopy and provides the measurement infrastructure to test it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: STEMGym 是一个针对自主扫描透射电子显微镜 (STEM) 的开源基准测试环境，包含 15 个物理模拟场景，涵盖五种材料、三个难度级别和四个表征任务，使用剂量效率曲线面积 (DEC-AUC) 作为评估指标。在 33 种智能体配置下，实验发现分析师（感知）管道是剂量效率的主要决定因素：将训练好的 CNN 分析师与简单光栅扫描结合，DEC-AUC 从 0.052 提升至 0.287（提升 5.5 倍），而用贝叶斯或自适应有限状态机导航替换光栅则无显著额外增益。生产级视觉语言模型在晶体缺陷分析上比专用 CNN 差约 13 倍。该基准强调在自主电子显微镜中，机器学习投入应优先集中于感知管道而非导航算法。
Motivation: 自主科学成像通常认为智能导航是提高样本效率的关键，但论文在 STEM 中提出相反证据：在有限剂量预算下，感知管道的选择比导航算法更重要。
Method: 构建 STEMGym 基准，包含 15 个物理模拟的 STEM 世界，覆盖五种材料、三个难度级别和四个表征任务，使用 DEC-AUC 作为评估指标。在 33 种智能体配置下比较不同感知（CNN、视觉语言模型等）和导航（光栅、贝叶斯、有限状态机等）组合的性能。
Result: 配对训练 CNN 分析师与简单光栅扫描可将 DEC-AUC 从 0.052 提升至 0.287（5.5 倍），而替换为贝叶斯或自适应有限状态机导航无统计显著提升。生产级视觉语言模型性能比专用 CNN 低约 13 倍。
Conclusion: STEMGym 框架表明，在自主电子显微镜中，ML 投入应重点放在感知管道而非导航算法上，并提供测量基础设施进行测试。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SonoCLIP: Mask-Guided Region-Aware Vision-Language Pretraining for Fetal Ultrasound Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language foundation models have shown strong potential in medical image analysis. Although foundation models for ultrasound imaging have recently emerged, the domain remains particularly challenging due to severe speckle noise, acquisition variability, and subtle anatomical boundaries, leading to high inter-observer variability. Existing CLIP-based models rely primarily on global image-text alignment, limiting their sensitivity to clinically decisive local structures. We propose SonoCLIP, the first million-scale region-controllable fetal ultrasound vision-language foundation model that integrates segmentation masks as mask-channel visual prompts within the vision encoder, enabling joint global-local contrastive representation learning. To support scalable region-text alignment, we introduce a sigmoid-based pairwise contrastive loss that improves stability under large-scale supervision. We further curate a 1.44M-image multimodal fetal ultrasound dataset spanning 24 standard planes for large-scale pretraining. Extensive cross-center evaluations demonstrate that SonoCLIP achieves superior zero-shot transfer performance under both global and mask-guided inference, establishing a controllable and clinically oriented foundation model for fetal ultrasound analysis. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Harrison-one/SonoCLIP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SonoCLIP，首个百万级区域可控的胎儿超声视觉-语言基础模型，通过在视觉编码器中引入分割掩码作为掩码通道视觉提示，实现全局-局部对比表示学习。基于大规模多模态数据集的实验表明，SonoCLIP 在零样本迁移任务上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 CLIP 模型主要依赖全局图文对齐，对临床关键局部结构不敏感；超声图像受散斑噪声、采集变异性和模糊边界影响，观察者间变异大，需要更精细的区域感知模型。
Method: 提出 SonoCLIP，使用分割掩码作为掩码通道视觉提示注入视觉编码器，结合 sigmoid 成对对比损失实现全局-局部对比学习；并构建包含 144 万图像、24 个标准切面的胎儿超声多模态数据集。
Result: 跨中心评估显示，SonoCLIP 在全局和掩码引导推理两种模式下均取得优越的零样本迁移性能。
Conclusion: SonoCLIP 作为可控且临床导向的胎儿超声基础模型，为超声图像分析提供了新的区域感知框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric Algebra Meets Cartesian Tensors: Higher-Order Equivariance for Interatomic Potentials
papers.abstract_en: $\mathrm{Cl}(3,0)$ interatomic potentials, despite their algebraic elegance, predict force magnitudes accurately but force directions poorly. Across ten rMD17 molecules, every $L \leq 1$ baseline in our twelve-model study attains aggregate force-cosine similarity below $0.25$. The cause is structural. The geometric product of two vectors in $\mathbb{R}^3$ realises only the $L=0$ and $L=1$ components of its irreducible representation content, leaving the symmetric-traceless rank-2 component absent from the per-edge bilinear that drives each message-passing layer. We address this with CliffordSTF, which couples the Clifford multivector to closed-form symmetric-traceless tensor tracks at ranks two and three through bilinear cross-track contractions, using a single learned bilinear and no Clebsch--Gordan tables, Wigner-$D$ matrices, or e3nn calls. On rMD17, CliffordSTF raises aggregate force-cosine similarity from $0.055$ (base Clifford) to $0.551$, an order-of-magnitude relative directional gain, alongside improved magnitude accuracy (force MAE $15.8\%$ lower; energy MAE $10.9\%$ lower). It outperforms all CG-free or body-ordered baselines in our study (all $\leq 0.17$). On catalysis benchmarks, CliffordSTF achieves the best out-of-distribution S2EF energy MAE on OC22 in our experiments, and the best in-distribution energy MAE among $L \geq 2$ methods on OC22 IS2RE. An eleven-variant ablation shows the two tracks are complementary: neither alone matches the combined model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Cl(3,0)原子间势在预测力方向上表现差的问题，提出CliffordSTF方法。该方法通过双线性交叉轨道收缩将Clifford多向量与闭形式的对称无迹张量轨道（秩2和3）耦合，无需Clebsch–Gordan表或Wigner-D矩阵。在rMD17上，力余弦相似度从0.055提升至0.551，力MAE降低15.8%，能量MAE降低10.9%；在OC22上取得最优能量MAE。消融实验表明两个轨道互补。
Motivation: 现有Cl(3,0)原子间势能准确预测力的大小但方向很差，因为几何乘积仅实现L=0和L=1分量，缺失对称无迹秩2分量，导致方向信息不足。
Method: 提出CliffordSTF，将Clifford多向量与对称无迹张量轨道（秩2和3）通过可学习的双线性交叉轨道收缩耦合，仅使用单个双线性形式，无需Clebsch–Gordan表或Wigner-D矩阵。
Result: 在rMD17上，力余弦相似度从0.055提升至0.551（相对方向增益一个数量级），力MAE降低15.8%，能量MAE降低10.9%；优于所有无CG或body-ordered基线。在OC22上，取得最佳OOD S2EF能量MAE和最佳ID IS2RE能量MAE（L≥2方法中）。
Conclusion: 两个轨道（Clifford多向量和张量轨道）互补，单独使用均不如结合模型。该方法显著提升力方向预测，且无需复杂CG运算。

papers.title: Bilevel Optimization for Neural Architecture Search
papers.abstract_en: Bilevel optimization has become an influential and widely adopted framework for addressing hierarchical optimization problems in machine learning, providing an effective approach to modeling the interaction between two levels of optimization, with applications such as hyperparameter tuning, meta-learning, adversarial training, and data poisoning. Neural Architecture Search (NAS), a subfield of hyperparameter optimization, is a prime example of a bilevel optimization problem, with architecture parameters optimized at the outer-level and network weights optimized at the inner level. This paper presents a structured overview of NAS through the lens of bilevel optimization. We categorize existing NAS approaches into two main classes: sampling-based methods, which search optimal architectures using different architecture samplers, and bilevel theory-based methods, which solve the architecture search problem using bilevel optimization principles. We further highlight our current research direction, wherein the bilevel NAS formulation is addressed through an auxiliary mathematical programming framework. This framework enables the systematic integration of second-order information from the model's training loss function and ensures the optimality of the model parameters while modifying architecture parameters. By simultaneously updating the architecture and model parameters along their respective optimal descent directions derived from the auxiliary mathematical program, these methods achieve more principled and theoretically consistent results. The same auxiliary program can also be used for simultaneous hyperparameter and model fine-tuning. A comparative analysis shows that bilevel theory-based approaches generally outperform sampling-based methods, both in accuracy and efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过双层优化视角对神经架构搜索（NAS）进行结构化综述，将现有方法分为基于采样和基于双层理论两类，并介绍作者当前的研究方向：利用辅助数学规划框架同时优化架构和模型参数，确保理论一致性。比较表明基于双层理论的方法在准确性和效率上通常更优。
Motivation: NAS本质上是双层优化问题，但现有方法往往忽略外层（架构）与内层（权重）优化的紧密耦合和最优性条件，需要更系统的理论框架。
Method: 作者将NAS方法分类为采样方法和基于双层理论的方法，并重点介绍其研究：采用辅助数学规划框架，通过同时沿各自最优下降方向更新架构和模型参数，整合二阶信息。
Result: 基于双层理论的方法在准确性和效率上通常优于采样方法（来自比较分析）。
Conclusion: 基于双层理论的方法提供了更原则性和理论一致的结果，该辅助规划框架也可用于超参数和模型微调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Joint Effect of Quantization and Sampling Temperature on LLM Safety Alignment: A Factorial Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM deployments routinely compress models and raise sampling temperature to reduce cost, latency, or repetition, yet safety evaluations usually treat these choices as fixed implementation details. This leaves a practical uncertainty: does a model that is safe at FP16 and greedy decoding remain safe after it is quantized and sampled stochastically, or do the two deployment knobs amplify one another? We study this question with a factorial evaluation of 9 instruction-tuned models from six families, 3 precisions (FP16, GPTQ INT8, AWQ INT4), and 6 temperatures ($T{=}0$ to $1.0$), yielding 161 configurations and $\approx$322k responses judged by a six-model safety ensemble. Contrary to the concern that low-bit deployment broadly erodes alignment, standard non-adversarial quantization is usually safety-neutral: INT4 keeps or lowers attack success for 7 of 9 models, with clear degradation concentrated in the weakest baseline model, SmolLM3-3B ($18.5\%{\to}36.0\%$). The larger risk comes from sampling: higher temperature sharply increases decision instability for vulnerable models, with DFR reaching 53.0\% at $T{=}1.0$, even when average ASR changes modestly. Finally, the interaction is not a ``double penalty'': our Compound Degradation Index remains largely sub-additive ($-0.195$ to $+0.045$), indicating that quantization and temperature do not systematically compound. These results suggest a deployment rule of thumb: standard INT4/INT8 quantization can be reasonable for strongly aligned models, but safety claims at elevated temperature should report multi-sample stability, not only average attack success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过析因实验设计，评估了不同精度（FP16、GPTQ INT8、AWQ INT4）和采样温度（0到1.0）对9个指令微调模型的攻击成功率的影响。结果表明：非对抗性量化通常是安全的，而高温采样会增加决策不稳定性，且量化与温度没有系统性的复合效应。
Motivation: 实际部署中，LLM通常同时使用量化和随机采样，但安全评估往往单独考虑这些因素，不清楚它们是否会相互放大风险。
Method: 对9个模型（来自6个家族）进行析因实验：3种精度 × 6种温度，共161种配置，约322k个响应，使用6模型安全集成评判攻击成功率。
Result: 量化通常安全中性，INT4对7/9模型保持或降低攻击成功率；高温采样显著增加脆弱模型的决策不稳定性；量化与温度的交互效应是次加性的，没有系统性的双重惩罚。
Conclusion: 对于强对齐模型，标准INT4/INT8量化是合理的；高温下的安全声明应报告多采样稳定性而非仅平均攻击成功率。

papers.title: ScAle: Attention Head Scaling as a Minimal Adapter for Spatial Reasoning in Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent challenge for many vision language models (VLMs), and improving it typically requires fine-tuning with substantial additional parameters. Our preliminary analysis reveals that rescaling activations in selected transformer layers-without modifying pretrained weights-can significantly influence downstream performance. Motivated by this observation, we propose ScAle, an ultra-lightweight adaptation method that learns a small set of scalar coefficients to modulate last-token attention and MLP activations in a fully frozen backbone. We evaluate our method on the synthetic spatial reasoning benchmark SpatialEval and on real-world VQA datasets (COCOQA and VGQA) across multiple model families. Our method, ScAle, achieves up to 134.1% relative accuracy gains using only 1K trainable parameters without requiring millions of trainable parameters as in standard PEFT methods such as LoRA. Despite its extreme compactness, our approach recovers a substantial fraction of standard PEFT performance while preserving strong non-spatial VQA accuracy. These results demonstrate that bounded activation reweighting provides a simple, architecture-agnostic, and highly parameter-efficient alternative for adapting pretrained VLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ScAle，一种超轻量级适配方法，通过学习少量标量系数在冻结的主干网络中调节最后token的注意力和MLP激活，无需修改预训练权重。在空间推理基准SpatialEval和真实VQA数据集上，ScAle仅用1K可训练参数即取得最高134.1%的相对准确率提升，且保持非空间VQA准确率。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型的空间推理能力提升通常需要大量参数微调，本文发现仅重定标选定Transformer层的激活即可显著影响下游性能，由此探索更高效的适配方法。
Method: 提出ScAle，在完全冻结的骨干网络中，为每个注意力头和MLP层学习一组标量系数，仅对最后token的激活进行重新缩放，总可训练参数仅约1K。
Result: 在SpatialEval、COCOQA和VGQA上，ScAle以1K参数实现最高134.1%的相对准确率提升，性能接近LoRA等标准PEFT方法，且非空间VQA准确率保持稳定。
Conclusion: 有界激活重加权是一种简单、架构无关且参数高效的VLM适配替代方案，尤其适用于空间推理任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReMAP-PET: Beyond Visual Understanding -- Learning Region-Guided Metabolic Alignment Semantics from Brain PET
papers.abstract_en: Positron Emission Tomography (PET) reveals brain metabolism and is clinically central to neurodegenerative disease assessment, yet existing 3D brain foundation models treat PET as generic volumetric data, missing the structured regional metabolic information that distinguishes it from structural neuroimaging. To address these limitations, we propose ReMAP-PET, a framework that moves beyond visual encoding by supervising a partially-tuned MedicalNet 3D ResNet-50 with brain regional standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR) profiles through joint regression and contrastive objectives, enabling the encoder to learn the metabolic semantics underlying PET modality. On 1015 paired PET--SUVR samples, ReMAP-PET achieves 0.070 SUVR MAE and 77.8% PET SUVR Recall@1, substantially outperforming five frozen pretrained baselines. We further connect the metabolic embedding to clinical language via contrastive alignment with frozen BioClinicalBERT and demonstrate end-to-end PET-to-report generation through SUVR-constrained verbalization. Linear probing on diagnostic classification and cognitive regression tasks confirms that the embeddings retain clinically relevant information without task-specific fine-tuning. Our results show that grounding PET encoders in regional metabolic semantics -- rather than treating PET as generic volumetric data -- yields representations that are structured, interpretable, and language-compatible, pointing to a new direction for metabolic-aware PET understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ReMAP-PET框架，通过联合回归和对比学习，引导3D ResNet-50编码器学习脑PET图像的脑区标准化摄取值比（SUVR）代谢语义，而非将其视为通用体积数据。在1015个配对PET-SUVR样本上，ReMAP-PET取得了0.070 SUVR MAE和77.8%的PET SUVR Recall@1，显著优于五个冻结预训练基线。进一步通过对比对齐连接代谢嵌入与临床语言模型BioClinicalBERT，实现端到端PET到报告生成。线性探测表明嵌入保留临床相关信息。
Motivation: 现有脑基础模型将PET视为通用体积数据，忽略了区分性区域代谢信息，限制了其临床效用。
Method: 部分微调MedicalNet 3D ResNet-50，通过回归SUVR和对比学习目标，使编码器学习PET的代谢语义；再通过对比对齐与冻结的BioClinicalBERT连接，实现语言生成。
Result: 在1015样本上，SUVR MAE为0.070，PET SUVR Recall@1为77.8%，优于五个基线；线性探测在诊断分类和认知回归任务上保留临床信息。
Conclusion: 将PET编码器基于区域代谢语义而非通用体积数据，可获得结构化、可解释且与语言兼容的表征，为代谢感知PET理解提供新方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TF-MoE: Time-Frequency Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Speech Separation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in speech separation (SS) have led to compact front-end models with small parameter sizes, yet their high computational cost remains a major barrier for deployment on edge devices. To address this, we propose TF-MoE, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that enhances model capacity with almost no increase in inference cost. Our method introduces dynamic expert specialization in time and frequency dimensions through alternating time-wise and frequency-wise MoE modules, each dynamically selecting experts per frame or mel band. Built upon a mel-band-splitting Conformer backbone, TF-MoE achieves strong performance on SS tasks under low-compute settings. Experimental results demonstrate that TF-MoE consistently improves separation performance under computation cost constraints, outperforming BSRNN by +3.8 dB SDR on Libri2Mix with comparable 4.1 GMACs/s inference cost. This positions TF-MoE as a promising candidate for edge-device deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted to INTERSPECH 2026, 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TF-MoE，一个稀疏混合专家 (MoE) 框架，用于高效语音分离。通过在时间维度和频率维度交替使用 MoE 模块，动态选择专家，基于 mel 带分割的 Conformer 骨干网络，在低计算量下提升分离性能。实验表明，在 Libri2Mix 上以 4.1 GMACs/s 的推理成本实现了比 BSRNN 高 3.8 dB SDR 的性能。
Motivation: 现有语音分离模型参数少但计算成本高，难以部署在边缘设备上。本文旨在通过稀疏 MoE 增强模型容量而不增加推理成本。
Method: 提出 TF-MoE，在时间维度和频率维度交替使用 MoE 模块，每个帧或 mel 带动态选择专家，基于 mel 带分割的 Conformer 骨干网络。
Result: 在 Libri2Mix 上，与 BSRNN 相比，以 4.1 GMACs/s 的计算成本实现了 +3.8 dB SDR 的改进。
Conclusion: TF-MoE 在低计算约束下持续提升语音分离性能，适用于边缘设备部署。

papers.title: Reliability-Prioritized Fine-Grained Generation in Multimodal Large
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly expected to generate fine-grained descriptions of visual content. However, we observe and theoretically show that generating fine-grained responses poses a reliability challenge, \textit{i.e.}, fine-grained generation is more error-prone than coarse-grained generation. This phenomenon suggests that models should generate the finest description that remains reliable rather than simply produce more specific outputs. To investigate this problem, we develop \textsc{GranFact}, a granularity-aware benchmark consisting of expert-verified multi-object images with coarse-to-fine category annotations. Then, we design a hierarchy-aware evaluation algorithm, which assesses both whether model predictions are visually correct and how specific the correct predictions are. We also propose a reliability-prioritized preference optimization method based on Direct Preference Optimization, which penalizes unreliable fine-grained claims while rewarding reliable specificity. Experiments on \textsc{GranFact} show that our method improves fine-grained generation while preserving reliability. Code and data are available \href{https://github.com/WeiWu2025/GranFact}{here}.
papers.comment: Equal contribution: Xiaomeng Fan and Wu Wei. Corresponding authors: Zhi Gao and Yunde Jia
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现多模态大语言模型在生成细粒度视觉描述时可靠性较差，即细粒度生成比粗粒度更容易出错。为此，作者构建了包含粗细粒度标注的多目标图像基准GranFact，并提出层次感知评估算法和基于直接偏好优化的可靠性优先偏好优化方法，在GranFact上实验表明该方法在保持可靠性的同时提升了细粒度生成能力。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型被期望生成细粒度视觉描述，但细粒度生成比粗粒度更易出错，缺乏针对该可靠性问题的系统研究和基准。
Method: 提出GranFact基准（含多目标图像及粗细分类标注）和层次感知评估算法；基于直接偏好优化（DPO）提出可靠性优先偏好优化方法，惩罚不可靠细粒度断言，奖励可靠特异性。
Result: 在GranFact上实验表明，所提方法在提升细粒度生成质量的同时维持了可靠性。
Conclusion: 生成细粒度描述时应优先保证可靠性，而非单纯追求更具体输出；所提基准和方法可推动该方向研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Speculative Pre-Positioning: Decoding Stateful Sessions to the Next Decision Point Off the Critical Path
papers.abstract_en: A stateless inference server (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) idles between requests while the accelerator waits; a stateful session reclaims that idle time. Speculative pre-positioning decodes the session forward to its next decision point with the target model's own forward pass and no draft model, moving the cross-request prefill and entry-decode off the critical path: the next request resumes from a pre-paid entry on its delta, or, when a confidence gate fires, is answered from a cached distribution in one near-constant vocabulary scan with no decode, at a cost only of energy and a rare, bounded false accept. The payoff is conditional on capability: a capable model fires the gate at near-full coverage and about 87% precision (a smaller one never clears it), returning the first token in about 1.0 ms versus the 39 ms decode a prefix cache still pays.

Conclusion: 推测性预定位可以显著降低首token延迟，但其有效性取决于模型本身的能力，且存在能量成本和有限的误接受风险。

papers.title: Coverage-Driven KV Cache Eviction for Efficient and Improved Inference of LLM
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) excel at complex tasks like question answering and summarization, thanks to their ability to handle long-context inputs. However, deploying LLMs is costly, not only due to the high computational demands of quadratic complexity of self-attention and auto-regressive generation, but also because of the significant memory overhead required for storing the key-value (KV) cache during inference. To reduce the memory cost, existing KV-cache eviction strategies leverage the sparsity in attention to selectively store a subset of tokens. While reducing the memory footprint, such approaches show a considerable drop in performance, especially in tasks that require long-context reasoning. We identify that the drop in performance is linked to a reduction in the coverage of unique tokens. Additionally, we theoretically show that reduced coverage limits the mutual information between inputs and outputs, thereby impairing predictive accuracy. To this end, we introduce K-VEC, a novel coverage-aware KV-cache eviction strategy that prioritizes token coverage while evicting tokens in the cache. K-VEC introduces a cross-head and a cross-layer coverage module to enhance token retention across attention heads and model layers, mitigating performance degradation caused by low coverage. Evaluated on 16 LongBench subsets, K-VEC exhibit up to 10.35 points improvement over the existing methods under the same eviction rate and memory constraint. Comprehensive evaluations validate the effectiveness of our approach and demonstrate its potential for efficient LLM deployment in resource-constrained settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种覆盖驱动（coverage-driven）的KV缓存驱逐策略K-VEC，通过跨头与跨层的覆盖模块提高唯一token的覆盖率，从而在减少内存占用的同时保持或提升长上下文推理性能。在LongBench的16个子集上，同等驱逐率下相比现有方法最高提升10.35个点。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存驱逐策略在降低内存时往往导致性能下降，尤其在长上下文任务中；作者发现这源于唯一token覆盖率降低，进而限制输入输出的互信息与预测精度。
Method: 提出K-VEC，包含跨头（cross-head）与跨层（cross-layer）覆盖率模块，在缓存驱逐时优先保留能最大化token覆盖率的条目。
Result: 在LongBench的16个子集上，同等驱逐率与内存约束下，K-VEC相比现有方法最高提升10.35个点。
Conclusion: 覆盖驱动的KV缓存驱逐能有效缓解内存缩减带来的性能损失，适用于资源受限环境下的高效LLM部署。

papers.title: Persona-Trained Monte Carlo: Estimating Market-Outcome Distributions via Swarms of Persona-Conditioned Neural Policy Bots in a Limit Order Book
papers.abstract_en: We propose Persona-Trained Monte Carlo (PTMC), a method for estimating distributions of market-outcome statistics by repeatedly simulating limit-order-book interaction among swarms of persona-conditioned neural-policy trading bots. Each run instantiates many bots sharing one trained policy network but conditioned on heterogeneous, individually sampled persona parameters drawn from a learned trader-heterogeneity distribution; the bots interact in a continuous double auction, and the resulting price path is one Monte Carlo sample. Repeating this over independent persona-population draws yields an ensemble from which a target market statistic is estimated. Randomness enters through persona draws, within-run action sampling, and optional exogenous shocks, not solely through price as in classical Monte Carlo. We distinguish PTMC from adjacent paradigms, including classical Monte Carlo, hand-coded agent-based models, single-agent reinforcement learning, and large-language-model-based generative agents. To justify the design, we survey cross-disciplinary foundations -- agent-based computational economics, market microstructure, behavioral finance, deep reinforcement learning, generative/LLM-based agents, news-driven trading, systemic risk, econophysics, and game theory -- connecting each literature to a specific design choice in the policy network, training data, or validation protocol. We formalize the PTMC estimator and its convergence properties, specify a candidate bot architecture and training objective, and propose a four-level validation methodology: stylized-fact matching, microstructure- and agent-level checks, and historical stress-test comparison against a zero-intelligence baseline. The framework is proposed but not implemented: we contribute a formal estimator, a cross-disciplinary design justification, and a validation roadmap, and conclude with open research questions.
papers.comment: 58 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables, 3 algorithms. Survey and proposed framework; no implementation or empirical results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Persona-Trained Monte Carlo (PTMC) 框架，通过模拟大量人格条件化的神经网络交易机器人（bots）在限价订单簿中的交互来估计市场结果统计量的分布。每个机器人共享同一策略网络但通过从学习的交易者异质性分布中采样不同的人格参数进行条件化。该方法通过独立的人格群体抽样重复运行获得蒙特卡洛样本集，从而估计目标市场统计量。论文形式化了PTMC估计量及其收敛性质，提出了候选机器人架构和训练目标，并设计了一个四层验证方法，但未进行实际实现或实证实验。
Motivation: 现有市场模拟方法（如经典蒙特卡洛、基于智能体的模型、单智能体强化学习和LLM生成智能体）在捕捉交易者异质性和市场微观结构方面存在局限，而PTMC旨在通过可学习的人格分布和神经网络策略提供更灵活、可扩展的市场结果分布估计框架。
Method: PTMC方法：每个模拟回合实例化多个交易机器人，它们共享一个训练好的策略网络，但通过从学习的 trader-heterogeneity 分布中采样的不同人格参数进行条件化。机器人在连续双向拍卖中交互，产生价格路径作为蒙特卡洛样本。通过多次独立的人格群体抽样获得样本集，并估计目标统计量。随机性来自人格抽样、机器人动作抽样和可选外生冲击。
Result: 论文未提供任何实证结果或实现；它仅作为一个提议框架、形式化定义和跨学科设计理由的综述。
Conclusion: PTMC 是一个尚未实现的理论框架，论文提供了形式化估计量、跨学科设计理由和验证路线图，并总结了开放研究问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Optimizer Memory Makes Shuffle Order a First-Order Source of Fine-Tuning Noise
papers.abstract_en: Shuffle order can be a larger source of fine-tuning noise than a memoryless analysis predicts: fixed-clock optimizer memory makes local equal-multiset contrasts first order in the learning rate rather than second order, and the resulting order channel can be large enough for a single seed to flip a close A/B comparison. We isolate this mechanism and derive a fit-free way to size the noise it produces. For a memoryless optimizer, reordering an equal multiset has no first-order endpoint term; the leading local contrast is the $O(η^2)$ gradient bracket. Fixed-clock optimizers such as AdamW are different. Their moment buffers, preconditioner state, and de-biasing counters advance with the step index rather than with the learning-rate-scaled time $τ=ηk$, so the same gradient can receive a position-dependent endpoint weight. For any fixed finite measurement window, a lifted-state expansion gives an $O(η)$ equal-multiset contrast whenever the first-order replay coefficient is nonzero, while regular and clock-matched controls remain $O(η^2)$; a bare fixed-$β$ momentum buffer is already enough. A bitwise-deterministic replay from one warmed optimizer state isolates the mechanism, giving order-variance slopes 1.83 for AdamW, 2.00 for fixed-$β$ momentum, and 4.00 for SGD; matching the memory clock to $τ$ restores the regular exponent. For AdamW with a frozen preconditioner, the same impulse-weight kernel gives a closed-form asymptotic order-variance floor after the local potentials are measured, with no fitted coefficients. The result is local to the measurement window (independent reshuffling can average the channel across windows), but it yields order-noise error bars, positional attribution weights, and a seed-budget criterion for fine-tuning comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现 shuffle order 在微调中产生的噪声比无记忆分析预测的更大：固定时钟优化器（如 AdamW）使得局部等多重集对比在 learning rate 上是一阶而非二阶。作者通过隔离机制和免拟合计分方法量化噪声大小，证明对于 AdamW 等优化器，shuffle order 产生的噪声可以大到使单个种子翻转 A/B 比较结果。
Motivation: 传统无记忆分析认为 shuffle order 的噪声是二阶小量，但实际微调中噪声可能更大，需要理解其机制。
Method: 提出 lifted-state expansion 分析方法，推导固定时钟优化器下等多重集对比的一阶项，并通过 bitwise-deterministic 重放实验测量 order-variance slope。
Result: 实验测得 AdamW 的 order-variance slope 为 1.83，固定 β momentum 为 2.00，SGD 为 4.00，而时钟匹配后恢复为 2.00。给出了封闭形式的渐近 order-variance 下限。
Conclusion: 该噪声是局部测量窗口相关的，但可以通过独立重排平均化，提供了 order-noise 误差条、位置归因权重以及用于微调比较的种子预算准则。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VISTA-DZ: Visual Semantic Trajectory Adaptation for Personalized Dilemma Zone Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Driver decision making in the dilemma zone at signalized intersections is safety critical, as vehicles approaching a yellow signal must decide whether to stop or proceed within limited time and distance margins. Accurate prediction of both stop-go decisions and decision timing is important for adaptive signal control, advanced driver assistance systems, and human-centered intelligent transportation applications. However, dilemma zone behavior is strongly driver dependent. Similar approach trajectories may lead to different decisions across drivers because of differences in risk preference, braking habit, and decision threshold. Existing personalized models often rely on handcrafted scalar descriptors, which provide useful but limited summaries of individual behavior. This paper proposes VISTA-DZ, a semantic-profile-conditioned framework for personalized stop-go and decision-time prediction. Historical trajectories are converted into visual representations, interpreted by a vision-language model to generate behavioral profiles, and encoded as semantic embeddings to condition a dual-output prediction network. The final model combines a bidirectional GRU encoder, driver-conditioned multi-head cross-attention, and Feature-wise Linear Modulation for temporal evidence selection and feature adaptation. Experiments on the SDZ dataset and a newly collected FDZ dataset show that VISTA-DZ outperforms trajectory-only and handcrafted personalization baselines, achieving 93.26% in-domain simulation accuracy and 90.22% mean accuracy across 20 held-out simulation drivers. Cross-domain results further show feasible zero-shot simulation-to-real transfer and better real-world generalization when simulation data are combined with limited field data.
papers.comment: This manuscript is currently under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VISTA-DZ 框架，将历史轨迹转换为视觉语义表示，通过视觉-语言模型生成驾驶行为画像，并作为条件输入双输出预测网络，用于个性化停车-通行决策和决策时间预测。在 SDZ 和新采集的 FDZ 数据集上，VISTA-DZ 在域内模拟准确率达 93.26%，跨域零样本仿真到现实迁移可行。
Motivation: 现有个性化驾驶行为模型依赖手工标量描述符，无法充分捕捉个体差异（如风险偏好、刹车习惯、决策阈值），且困境区预测对交通安全至关重要。
Method: 将历史轨迹转换为视觉表示，用视觉-语言模型提取语义嵌入作为行为画像；构建双向 GRU 编码器、基于驾驶人的多头交叉注意力与特征线性调制（FiLM）的双输出预测网络。
Result: 在 SDZ 和 FDZ 数据集上，域内模拟准确率 93.26%，20 名留出驾驶人的平均准确率 90.22%；跨域仿真到真实世界零样本迁移可行。
Conclusion: VISTA-DZ 通过语义画像条件化提升个性化预测性能，且仿真数据结合有限实地数据可改善真实世界泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Proteus: Automated Adversarial Robustness Testing for Audio Deepfake Detectors
papers.abstract_en: We present Proteus, a framework developed at Resemble AI for automated robustness testing of our audio deepfake detection system. Given a detector, Proteus systematically searches over sequences of everyday audio transformations (codec transcoding, additive noise, reverberation, dynamic-range compression, and VoIP simulation) to find combinations that fool the detector while preserving speech quality. We propose two complementary search strategies: (1) a breadth-first search that exhaustively maps augmentation effectiveness across the parameter space, and (2) a Q-learning agent designed to efficiently discover deeper attack chains by exploiting structural patterns in the BFS data. We report findings from continuous deployment of Proteus against our production detector, showing that specific augmentation chains can reliably flip detection verdicts while preserving speech intelligibility and speaker identity. We discuss how these findings are used to harden the detector through targeted retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Proteus框架，用于自动化测试音频深度伪造检测器的鲁棒性。该框架通过搜索日常音频变换的组合来迷惑检测器，同时保持语音质量。提出了两种搜索策略：广度优先搜索和Q-learning代理。结果表明特定变换链可以可靠地翻转检测结果，同时保持语音可懂度和说话人身份。
Motivation: 音频深度伪造检测器在实际应用中可能被对抗性变换绕过，需要自动化鲁棒性测试方法。
Method: Proteus框架，使用广度优先搜索和Q-learning代理搜索音频变换序列，包括编解码转换、加性噪声、混响、动态范围压缩和VoIP模拟。
Result: 在连续部署中，特定变换链能可靠翻转检测判决，同时保持语音可懂度和说话人身份。
Conclusion: 这些发现用于通过针对性重训练来强化检测器。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文介绍Proteus框架，用于自动化测试音频深度伪造检测器的鲁棒性。该框架通过搜索日常音频变换的组合来迷惑检测器，同时保持语音质量。提出了两种搜索策略：广度优先搜索和Q-learning代理。结果表明特定变换链可以可靠地翻转检测结果，同时保持语音可懂度和说话人身份。

papers.title: Learned Coordination Conventions in Cooperative MARL: Measuring the Translation Gap Between Theory-Informed Roles and Learned Routing
papers.abstract_en: Role-semantic assignments provide priors over how heterogeneous agents may coordinate, but cooperative MARL systems instead settle on conventions through decentralized, non-stationary learning, with no guarantee that the resulting structure matches those priors. We study this translation gap between theory-informed role expectations and learned coordination structure through a diagnostic combining a role-routing matrix, formation sensitivity ($Δ_{\max}$), and gradient/occlusion attribution across three-role MiniGrid and SMACv2 (Terran) environments. We show that label-conditioned attention produces substantially more concentrated and role-specific routing than flat MLP baselines, remains stable under 3v3--9v9 scaling, transfers zero-shot across team sizes, and is invariant to ally-slot padding. A 5-seed re-evaluation shows partial alignment between learned conventions and designer-specified priors while revealing where small-n noise can manufacture apparent strategic divergence. We present these results as an empirical framework for measuring coordination structure in cooperative MARL rather than as a new equilibrium concept or causal explanation.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 1 figures. Poster Accepted at NExT-Game 2026: New Frontiers in Game-Theoretic Learning, ICML 2026 Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究合作多智能体强化学习（MARL）中理论告知角色与习得协调结构之间的翻译间隙。通过角色路由矩阵、形成敏感性和梯度/遮挡归因等诊断工具，在三个角色的MiniGrid和SMACv2环境中，发现标签条件注意力能产生比平坦MLP基线更集中和角色特定的路由，且在大规模下稳定、零样本迁移，但5次种子重评估显示习得惯例与设计者指定的先验只有部分对齐。
Motivation: 现有MARL系统通过去中心化非平稳学习形成协调惯例，但无法保证这些惯例与理论告知的角色先验匹配，存在翻译间隙。
Method: 提出一个实证框架，使用角色路由矩阵、形成敏感性（Δ_max）和梯度/遮挡归因，在MiniGrid和SMACv2环境中比较标签条件注意力与平坦MLP基线的协调结构。
Result: 标签条件注意力产生的路由更集中、角色更具体，在3v3至9v9规模下稳定，可零样本跨团队规模迁移，且对友方槽填充不变。5次种子评估显示部分对齐，同时揭示了小样本噪声可能制造表面战略分歧。
Conclusion: 该框架用于测量合作MARL中的协调结构，而非提出新均衡概念或因果解释。

papers.title: Em-ergence of the em-dash: a population-level rise in em-dash frequency in medRxiv preprints at the dawn of the large-language-model era
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can leave subtle stylistic traces in assisted text; one of the most cited is the em-dash (Unicode U+2014). Yet no one has measured whether em-dash use has changed in the scientific literature. This study, pre-registered on the Open Science Framework (HFT8C), used the full set of medRxiv full-text XML preprints from the official Text-and-Data-Mining resource. The primary cohort was first, original versions deposited 2020-2025 with an extractable Discussion section of at least 500 characters (N = 69,632). The primary endpoint was the presence of at least one em-dash in the Discussion; the principal measure was the absolute change in its prevalence between the pre-ChatGPT era (before 30 November 2022) and the post-ChatGPT era, estimated with a logistic model with standard errors clustered by first author. The analysis plan (six supporting analyses, six sensitivity analyses, two falsification tests) was frozen before any confirmatory result was computed. Em-dash prevalence in Discussion sections rose from 4.23% before ChatGPT to 11.58% afterward, an absolute increase of 7.35 percentage points (95% CI 6.94-7.77; odds ratio 2.96, 95% CI 2.77-3.17). The rise was not a sharp jump but a gradual, delayed acceleration: near 4% through 2023, 8.0% in 2024, and 20.3% in 2025. The effect survived every feasible sensitivity analysis (7.35-7.60 pp) and both falsification tests; a placebo split within the pre-LLM era showed no meaningful change (+0.13 pp, 95% CI -0.33 to +0.58), and was essentially absent in boilerplate sections. Independent LLM-associated lexical markers and within-paper section comparisons pointed the same way. The em-dash is a population-level indicator, not a per-paper detector of LLM use, and the design cannot establish causality; it shows that something in how scientific literature is written changed markedly in the early 2020s, and roughly when.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 5 figures. Pre-registered on OSF (osf.io/HFT8C). Companion to a pre-registered audit of Unicode fidelity in biomedical bibliographic APIs (arXiv:2606.24897)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分析 medRxiv 预印本（2020-2025）讨论部分中 em-dash（破折号）的使用频率，发现 ChatGPT 发布后 em-dash 使用率从 4.23% 跃升至 11.58%（绝对增加 7.35 个百分点），且呈渐进加速趋势。该指标可作为 LLM 辅助写作的群体级指示器，但不能用于单篇检测，也不支持因果推断。
Motivation: LLMs 可能在文本中留下细微的文体痕迹，em-dash 常被提及但尚未有研究测量其在科学文献中的实际变化趋势。
Method: 使用 medRxiv 官方全文 XML 数据，主要队列为 2020-2025 年首次提交且讨论部分至少 500 字符的预印本（N=69,632）。以讨论部分是否包含至少一个 em-dash 为主要终点，采用逻辑回归模型（标准误聚类于第一作者）估计 ChatGPT 发布前后的绝对变化率，并预先注册了包含六项支持分析、六项敏感性分析和两项证伪检验的分析计划。
Result: 讨论部分 em-dash 使用率从 ChatGPT 前的 4.23% 增至之后的 11.58%，绝对增加 7.35 个百分点（95% CI 6.94-7.77；OR 2.96）。上升并非突变而是逐步加速：2023 年约 4%，2024 年 8.0%，2025 年 20.3%。所有敏感性分析和证伪检验均支持结果的稳健性。
Conclusion: em-dash 是群体层面的指标，不能作为每篇论文的 LLM 使用探测器，且研究设计无法建立因果关系；但结果明确表明科学写作在 2020 年代早期发生了显著变化及其大致时间点。

papers.title: RESOURCE2SKILL: Distilling Executable Agent Skills from Human-Created Multimodal Resources
papers.abstract_en: Skills are a useful abstraction for software agents, turning human and agent experience into reusable procedural knowledge. Yet existing skill libraries are mostly hand-written, text-centric, or derived from agent traces, leaving tutorial videos and other multimodal human resources largely underused. We present RESOURCE2SKILL, a framework that distills multimodal resources, including tutorial videos, repositories, articles, and reference artifacts, into executable skills for software agents. RESOURCE2SKILL organizes these skills as a hierarchical multimodal Skill Wiki, where each entry combines structured text, code, visual examples, metadata, and provenance. This design preserves complementary signals from different resources: videos capture temporal operations and visual effects, code captures executable tool patterns, and articles or artifacts provide conceptual and stylistic grounding. At inference time, agents retrieve and compose relevant skills from the wiki; when coverage is insufficient, the same construction operator can acquire new skills online. Across seven practical authoring domains, RESOURCE2SKILL improves average overall score by +11.9 percentage points over no-skill agents and outperforms strong harness baselines in 26 of 28 main-aggregate model-domain cells. Ablations confirm the value of multimodal skill format, hierarchical organization, source diversity, selection strategy, and online acquisition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RESOURCE2SKILL框架，从人类创建的多模态资源（如教程视频、代码仓库、文章等）中蒸馏出可执行的智能体技能，并组织为层次化的多模态技能维基。在七个实际创作领域，该框架相比无技能智能体平均提升11.9个百分点，并在多数模型-领域组合中优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有技能库多为手工编写、文本中心或从智能体轨迹中提取，而教程视频等多模态人类资源未被充分利用。
Method: RESOURCE2SKILL通过构建多模态技能维基，将视频、代码、文章等资源中的信号（时间操作、视觉效果、可执行工具模式、概念风格）整合为技能条目，并支持在线获取新技能。
Result: 在七个作者领域，平均总体得分提升+11.9个百分点，并在26/28个主聚合模型-领域单元中优于强基线；消融实验验证了多模态格式、层次组织、源多样性、选择策略和在线获取的价值。
Conclusion: 多模态资源蒸馏可有效生成可复用的智能体技能，且层次化多模态维基设计优于传统技能库。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OSWorld2.0: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on Long-Horizon Real-World Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Existing computer-use benchmarks fail to capture the realism, complexity, and long-horizon demands of real-world computer use, limiting their ability to reveal the limitations of frontier agents. We introduce OSWorld 2.0, a benchmark of 108 long-horizon computer-use workflows across everyday and professional tasks, designed to capture complex and challenging real-world phenomena. Each task represents a realistic end-to-end workflow that takes human users a median of about 1.6 hours to complete and requires an average of 318 tool calls with Claude Opus 4.7 using maximum thinking, compared with about 30 in OSWorld 1.0. OSWorld 2.0 targets challenge phenomena that are common in real workflows yet underrepresented in prior benchmarks, spanning interaction-design challenges such as streaming interaction and dynamic environments, as well as agent-pattern challenges such as cross-source reasoning, implicit-state inference, and visual-spatial precision. Tasks are grounded in authentic input artifacts and cross-referenced against realistic stateful user profile data, and include separate safety reports auditing safety-sensitive execution. Under our primary binary-completion metric at 500 steps, Claude Opus 4.8 with maximum thinking and batched tool calls scores best but still completes only 20.6% of tasks at a 54.8% partial score; GPT-5.5 is far more token-efficient yet plateaus near 13%. These results show that current agents are still far from professional-level computer use: rather than stumbling on basic GUI control or coding, they lose track of constraints, miss information that arrives mid-task, guess rather than ask the user, and skip verification, struggling most when a task hinges on hidden state they must recover.
papers.comment: 68 pages, 42 figures. Equal contribution: Mengqi Yuan, Zilong Zhou, and Xinzhuang Xiong
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OSWorld 2.0 是一个包含108个长时域真实计算机使用工作流的基准测试，每个任务平均需要人类约1.6小时完成，代理需要平均318次工具调用。基准涵盖流式交互、动态环境、跨源推理、隐式状态推断和视觉空间精度等挑战。最佳模型 Claude Opus 4.8 在500步二元完成率下仅达20.6%，显示当前代理远未达到专业级计算机使用水平。
Motivation: 现有计算机使用基准缺乏真实世界的复杂性、长时域需求和挑战性现象，无法充分揭示前沿代理的局限性。
Method: 设计108个端到端任务，基于真实输入工件和状态化用户配置文件，包含安全报告审计。任务平均需要318次工具调用（Claude Opus 4.7），人类中位数完成时间约1.6小时。
Result: 在500步二进制完成指标下，Claude Opus 4.8 完成20.6%（部分得分54.8%），GPT-5.5 约13%。代理主要失败于跟踪约束、丢失中期信息、猜测而非询问用户、跳过验证，尤其依赖需恢复的隐藏状态时。
Conclusion: 当前代理在复杂计算机使用任务上仍远落后于人类，主要瓶颈不是基本GUI控制或编码，而是高级推理和状态管理能力。

papers.title: GarmentZoom: Generating Zoomable Images from Garment Listings
papers.abstract_en: Online product listings for garments often include an overview photo and a close-up to show garment details. However, each photo focuses on either field of view or garment detail, forcing users to alternate between views and breaking browsing continuity. We present GarmentZoom, a system that enhances the full-view photo to match the fidelity of its accompanying close-up, enabling seamless zoom-and-pan exploration. Unlike standard reference-based super-resolution, our setting involves close-up references that are spatially unaligned with the full view, and scale factors that vary substantially across garments 3-20$\times$. Prior work typically relies on alignment to transfer details or requires per-instance fine-tuning to memorize them. Instead, we train a single model that supports a continuous range of scales across diverse garments. Our approach synthesizes details without requiring spatial alignment and matches the quality of per-instance methods with a fraction of the training cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GarmentZoom 系统，针对服装商品展示中全视图和特写图空间不对齐的问题，训练单一模型支持连续缩放范围（3-20×），无需空间对齐或逐实例微调，生成可缩放浏览的高保真图像。
Motivation: 现有服装商品图片要么是全景要么是特写，用户需要在不同视图间切换，破坏浏览连续性。标准超分辨率方法依赖空间对齐或逐实例微调，不适用。
Method: 训练单一模型，无需空间对齐，支持连续尺度缩放（3-20×），通过从全视图和不对齐的特写图中学习细节合成，无需 per-instance fine-tuning。
Result: 摘要声称与逐实例方法质量相当，但训练成本仅为其一小部分。
Conclusion: 该方法能无缝增强全视图图片，实现缩放和平移探索，提升商品浏览体验。

papers.title: Improved Multi-Dimensional Forecasting for Swap Regret
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of forecasting for an arbitrary number of downstream agents with unknown objectives, each of whom best responds to the forecaster's predictions. We seek a single forecaster that guarantees sublinear swap regret for all downstream agents simultaneously. For two-dimensional outcome spaces, we give a polynomial time algorithm that guarantees $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{kT})$ swap regret for any downstream agent with $k$ actions. This improves over the previously known bound of $\tilde{O}(kT^{5/8})$ and avoids the exponential in $T$ runtime of prior algorithms in this setting. Our algorithm extends nicely to other low dimensional environments, retaining $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ downstream swap regret while the exponent of $k$ in the regret bound and the exponent of $T$ in the running time both grow with dimension. For arbitrary dimension $d$, we give a forecasting algorithm that guarantees $\tilde{O}(d\sqrt{kT})$ swap regret, assuming the forecaster knows an upper bound $k$ on the number of actions available to any downstream agent, albeit with a much longer runtime. This improves upon previous high dimensional guarantees that had $\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ dependence and required additional behavioral assumptions.

TL;DR: 本文研究面向多个未知目标的下游代理的预测问题，这些代理根据预测者的预测做出最优响应。作者提出了一种预测算法，能同时为所有下游代理保证次线性（sublinear）的交换后悔（swap regret）。在二维结果空间中，算法实现了$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{kT})$的交换后悔界，改进了之前$\tilde{O}(kT^{5/8})$的界，且避免了之前算法的指数级运行时间。该算法可推广到低维环境，并在任意维度$d$下实现了$\tilde{O}(d\sqrt{kT})$的交换后悔界，改进了之前$\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$的依赖。
Motivation: 现有预测算法在处理多个下游代理时，交换后悔的界不够紧，或者在低维情况下运行时间呈指数级。本文旨在给出一个统一的预测器，为任意数量、任意行动集的代理同时保证低交换后悔。
Method: 提出一种多项式时间算法，用于二维结果空间的预测问题；通过巧妙设计预测策略，利用凸优化技巧和在线学习框架，实现同时控制所有代理的交换后悔；并展示如何将算法扩展到更高维度，但运行时间随维度增加。
Result: 对于二维结果空间，算法保证$\tilde{O}(\sqrt{kT})$的交换后悔，优于之前$\tilde{O}(kT^{5/8})$的界；对于任意维度$d$，算法保证$\tilde{O}(d\sqrt{kT})$的交换后悔，改进了之前$\tilde{O}(T^{2/3})$的依赖，但运行时间更长。
Conclusion: 本文证明了在低维和任意维度下，存在一个预测器能同时为多个下游代理实现接近最优的交换后悔，且算法在低维下是高效的。未来的工作可以进一步优化高维算法的运行时间，或放宽对代理行动数上界的假设。

papers.title: SemJoin: Semantic Join Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Integrating unstructured data into relational database systems is increasingly important as demand grows for natural language querying and analysis. A semantic join, joining two tables under a natural-language predicate, can be evaluated with a large language model (LLM), but comparing every pair of tuples requires O(M x N) LLM invocations and is cost-prohibitive at scale. Existing systems reduce this cost but typically commit to a single fixed strategy (e.g., embedding similarity or one batched scheme) regardless of the data or the join predicate. We propose an LLM-agent-based decision pipeline that optimizes semantic joins by matching the execution strategy to the characteristics of the underlying tables. An LLM advisor routes each join to one of two strategies: a Cluster Join, which prunes candidates via unsupervised embedding clustering and sample-based filtering, or a Classifier strategy for predicates that reduce to a shared discrete label set. Across three diverse datasets (IMDb reviews, email contradictions, and Stack Overflow tags), the advisor consistently identifies the optimal execution strategy for each workload. This dynamic routing proves decisive: it outperforms adaptive block join (ABJ) by 20-33 F1 points across all datasets while consuming fewer tokens on two of the three, and achieves higher F1 scores than featurized-decomposition join (FDJ) at one to two orders of magnitude lower token cost.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于LLM-agent的决策管线来优化语义连接，通过LLM advisor根据表特征将连接路由到聚类连接（Cluster Join）或分类器策略（Classifier），在三个数据集上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在语义连接上使用固定策略，无法适应不同数据和谓词，导致成本过高或性能不佳。
Method: 提出一个LLM-agent决策管线，其中LLM advisor分析表的特征，将每个语义连接路由到两种策略之一：基于无监督嵌入聚类和样本过滤的聚类连接，或适用于离散标签谓词的分类器策略。
Result: 在IMDb评论、电子邮件矛盾和Stack Overflow标签三个数据集上，动态路由比自适应块连接（ABJ）提升20-33 F1点，同时消耗更少令牌（两个数据集上）；比特征分解连接（FDJ）获得更高F1，令牌成本低一到两个数量级。
Conclusion: 动态路由策略能有效优化语义连接，根据数据特征选择执行策略。

papers.title: MotionAtlas: Detailed Region Captioning for Motion-Centric Videos
papers.abstract_en: We propose MotionAtlas, a system for detailed captioning of motion-centric videos, comprising (1) a dedicated human-annotated benchmark, (2) a scalable, high-quality pipeline to construct training samples, and (3) a family of powerful Video-MLLMs. Unlike conventional global motion captioning datasets, we focus on region-aware motion captioning: given a video and a spatiotemporal mask, the model generates precise descriptions of motion within the target region, thereby alleviating visual clutter and motion entanglement and enabling reliable, quantifiable evaluation. Concretely, we first build MotionAtlas-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 2,073 multiple-choice questions, meticulously annotated for a curated set of high-quality, motion-centric videos, to evaluate fine-grained motion understanding of the objects in question. Second, we design a rigorous and scalable data pipeline that leverages self-bootstrap refinement to suppress fine-grained hallucinations, yielding 159k high-quality motion captioning data. Third, we design a tailored training data composition strategy, which achieves consistent and substantial performance gains across diverse baseline Video-MLLMs, including Molmo2 and Qwen3-VL. For instance, MotionAtlas-4B surpasses Qwen3-VL-4B by an average of 5.2 percentage points across general motion benchmarks. The benchmark, dataset, and code have been released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MotionAtlas系统，用于运动中心视频的详细区域字幕生成。系统包括一个人工标注的基准数据集MotionAtlas-Bench（包含2073道多选题）、一个可扩展的高质量数据流水线（通过自引导优化抑制细粒度幻觉，生成15.9万条训练数据），以及一系列增强的视频多模态大语言模型（Video-MLLMs）。实验表明，MotionAtlas-4B在通用运动基准上平均比Qwen3-VL-4B高5.2个百分点。
Motivation: 现有运动字幕数据集通常关注全局运动描述，忽略了区域感知的运动描述，导致视觉杂乱和运动纠缠问题，且难以进行可靠、可量化的评估。
Method: 构建MotionAtlas-Bench基准数据集（2073道多选题）；设计可扩展数据流水线，利用自引导优化（self-bootstrap refinement）生成高质量运动字幕数据（159k条）；设计定制的训练数据组合策略，提升多种基线Video-MLLM（如Molmo2、Qwen3-VL）的性能。
Result: MotionAtlas-4B在通用运动基准上平均超过Qwen3-VL-4B 5.2个百分点，且在不同基线模型上均取得一致且显著的性能提升。
Conclusion: 区域感知的运动字幕生成能有效缓解视觉杂乱和运动纠缠，系统化的数据构建和训练策略可显著提升Video-MLLM的细粒度运动理解能力。

papers.title: The Mirage of Optimizing Training Policies: Monotonic Inference Policies as the Real Objective for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has gained growing attention in large language model (LLM) post-training, yet RL training remains fragile and can suffer from instability or collapse. One vital cause is training-inference mismatch: LLM adopts separate inference and training engines for generation efficiency and training precision, which in practice exhibits inconsistent probabilities for the same trajectories on training and inference sides, even with synchronized model parameters. This naturally induces a special type of off-policyness ever existing and poisoning the training. Prior works have made various efforts in addressing the off-policyness to stabilize the training policies under the mismatch. In this paper, we point out the objective misalignment neglected by existing works that an effective update to the policy in the training engine not necessarily ensures the improvement of the inference policy, i.e., the one used in deployment. To this end, we propose a new policy optimization objective for LLM RL, named Monotonic Inference Policy Improvement (MIPI). Following this principle, we introduce Monotonic Inference Policy Update (MIPU), a two-step LLM RL framework that constructs sampler-referenced candidate updates and selectively accepts synchronized candidates using an inference-side gap proxy. Experiments conducted on two model scales under high mismatch show that MIPU improves average reasoning performance and training stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出LLM强化学习训练中存在训练-推理不匹配导致的off-policy问题，现有工作忽略了目标错位：训练引擎中有效的策略更新不一定能提升推理策略。作者提出单调推理策略改进（MIPI）目标，并设计MIPU框架，通过采样器参考候选更新和推理侧间隙代理选择同步候选，在高不匹配情况下提升推理性能和训练稳定性。
Motivation: 现有LLM RL训练中，训练引擎和推理引擎的概率不一致导致off-policy问题，且现有工作未认识到训练策略更新不一定改进推理策略这一目标错位。
Method: 提出MIPI目标，并实现MIPU框架，包含两步：构造采样器参考候选更新，并使用推理侧间隙代理选择性接受同步候选。
Result: 在两个模型尺度的高不匹配实验下，MIPU提升了平均推理性能和训练稳定性。
Conclusion: 论文认为关注推理策略而非训练策略的单调改进是更有效的RL训练方向。
