papers.title: Sample Complexity of Scientific Discovery: PAC Learnability of Compositional Function Trees
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery via symbolic regression is often viewed as statistically and computationally intractable because the hypothesis space of expressions grows combinatorially with depth. This paper revisits the statistical side through the lens of PAC learning, focusing on compositional function trees built from a finite vocabulary of smooth operators (e.g., $\{+,\times,\sin,\exp\}$ and affine maps). We prove that the relevant generalization quantity, Rademacher complexity, hence the excess risk, does not necessarily blow up exponentially with the number of distinct symbolic structures, but is controlled by (i) the depth $d$ and (ii) the Lipschitz constants of the base operators along the composed computation graph. Concretely, under mild Lipschitz conditions on operators and bounded affine leaves, a finite-union bound over a vocabulary of size $K=|\mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{base}}|$ together with Maurer-type vector contraction yields $\mathfrak{R}_n(\mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{comp}}^{d}) \leq (Kb\sqrt{2}L)^{d-1}\mathfrak{R}_n(\mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{comp}}^{1})$ with arity bound $b$; corresponding high-probability risk bounds scale as $\mathcal{O}(L^{d}/\sqrt{n})$ when $K,b=O(1)$ and $\mathfrak{R}_n(\mathcal{H}_{\mathrm{comp}}^{1})=O(n^{-1/2})$. We complement the theory with a modular codebase that trains differentiable operator trees (not MLPs) on synthetic "physics-like" targets of controlled depth and shows that the empirical generalization gap correlates positively with the predicted complexity term $(\widehat{L}^{d})/\sqrt{n}$.

Motivation: 符号回归的假设空间随表达式深度组合爆炸，传统观点认为其统计和计算上难以处理。本文旨在纠正这一观点，从统计学习角度证明组合函数树在温和条件下可高效学习。
Method: 采用PAC学习框架，利用有限并界和Maurer型向量压缩技术，推导出深度d组合函数树的Rademacher复杂度上界为(Kb√2L)^{d-1}倍单层复杂度，进而得到风险界。
Result: 理论上，当算子种类K和最大元数b为常数时，风险界为O(L^d/√n)；实验上，在合成物理目标上训练可微算子树，观察到经验泛化差距与预测复杂度项(L^d)/√n正相关。
Conclusion: 组合函数树的样本复杂度主要受深度和算子Lipschitz常数控制，而非结构数量，这为符号回归提供了可学习性的理论保证。

papers.title: RAGA: Real Time Ray Traced Gaussian Shadow Casting for 3DGS Avatar-Scene Interaction
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of physically plausible shadow casting when animating 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) avatars, either individually or in multi-avatar and object-interaction scenarios, within existing 3DGS scenes. In contrast to prior methods that rely on binary hit tests and mesh-based shadow casters, our method performs shadow computation entirely in Gaussian space, without requiring any mesh reconstruction. We introduce RAGA, a Ray-Traced Gaussian Shadow Casting formulation based on exact ray-Gaussian line integrals. For each occluding Gaussian, we integrate the opacity profile along the shadow ray and normalize by the theoretical maximum integral, producing a weight that captures how the ray traverses the occluder rather than merely whether an intersection occurred. To reduce temporal variance from clothing deformations in animated avatars, we further introduce an avatar proxy representation that stabilizes shadow casting while preserving visual fidelity. We implement RAGA using custom CUDA kernels integrated with the NVIDIA OptiX framework; as such, our shadow tracer runs at rates of about 50 FPS. We evaluate on single-avatar, multi-avatar, and avatar-object interaction scenarios across multiple datasets, demonstrating substantially improved shadow realism, temporal stability, and scene coherence. Our project page is available at https://miraymen.github.io/raga/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RAGA，一种基于射线-高斯线积分的实时阴影投射方法，用于3DGS化身与场景交互。该方法直接在高斯空间计算阴影，无需网格重建，通过积分不透明度轮廓得到阴影权重，并引入化身代理表示减少动画变形导致的时序抖动。在单/多化身和物体交互场景中，以约50FPS运行，显著提升阴影真实感和时间稳定性。
Motivation: 现有3DGS化身阴影方法依赖二进制命中测试和网格投射器，缺乏物理合理性且不适应动态变形，导致阴影不真实且时序不稳定。
Method: 提出RAGA，基于精确射线-高斯线积分计算每个遮挡高斯的阴影权重而非简单命中检测；引入化身代理表示以稳定服装变形引起的时序方差；采用自定义CUDA内核集成NVIDIA OptiX框架实现实时管线。
Result: 在多个数据集上的单/多化身和化身-物体交互场景评估中，展示了改进的阴影真实感、时间稳定性和场景一致性，运行速度约50FPS。
Conclusion: RAGA无需网格重建即可实现实时、物理合理的阴影投射，适用于动态3DGS化身场景。

papers.title: Covering the Unseen: Information Demand Coverage Optimization for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) typically treats context selection as ranking chunks against a single query embedding. This assumption breaks down for complex queries, such as multi-hop or ambiguous questions, where top-k selection tends to over-cover one semantic aspect while ignoring critical sub-questions. We propose GeoRAG, which recasts context selection as Information Demand Coverage Optimization. GeoRAG builds a multi-dimensional demand distribution through diverse sub-query generation and reverse-validation weighting, then selects context by minimizing the Sinkhorn-Wasserstein distance between this demand distribution and the coverage of the selected set. The resulting demand-weighted facility-location objective is monotone submodular, giving a $1-1/e$ greedy guarantee, which we approximate with a Sinkhorn-based marginal-gain surrogate. The method is unsupervised, training-free, and retrieval-agnostic. We further show that single-point, query-proximity scorers cannot cover multi-modal demands, exposing a structural limit of ranking-based selection. On six open-domain QA benchmarks, GeoRAG improves exact match (EM) by +6.5 to +7.5 points over top-k truncation (up to +9.7 on HotpotQA and ASQA) and outperforms strong baselines including MMR, DPP, BGE-Reranker, SMART-RAG, and AdaGReS, with stable gains across context budgets and sub-query generators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoRAG，将 RAG 中的上下文选择重新建模为信息需求覆盖优化问题，通过构建多维需求分布并最小化与该分布的 Sinkhorn-Wasserstein 距离来选择上下文。该方法无需监督、无需训练、与检索器无关，并在六个开放域 QA 基准上超越多种强基线，提升精确匹配 6.5-7.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 传统 RAG 将上下文选择视为针对单一查询嵌入的排序问题，在处理多跳或模糊问题等复杂查询时，top-k 选择往往过度覆盖一个语义方面而忽略关键子问题。
Method: GeoRAG 通过多样化子查询生成和反向验证加权构建多维需求分布，然后通过最小化此需求分布与所选集合覆盖度之间的 Sinkhorn-Wasserstein 距离来选择上下文。目标函数是单调子模的，具有 (1-1/e) 贪心保证，通过基于 Sinkhorn 的边际增益代理近似求解。
Result: 在六个开放域 QA 基准上，GeoRAG 相对于 top-k 截断实现精确匹配（EM）提升 +6.5 至 +7.5 个百分点（在 HotpotQA 和 ASQA 上最高 +9.7），并优于 MMR、DPP、BGE-Reranker、SMART-RAG 和 AdaGReS 等强基线，在不同上下文预算和子查询生成器下均表现出稳定提升。
Conclusion: 该方法无需监督、无需训练且与检索器无关，暴露了基于排序选择的单点查询邻近度评分无法覆盖多模态需求的结构性限制。

papers.title: Gradient boosting with vector-valued leafs
papers.abstract_en: Gradient boosting in the form of decision tree ensembles has successfully been applied to a variety of problems using simple objective functions based on log-likelihoods of a single variable. The concept extends naturally to objective functions operating on vectors - for example, multinomial logistic log-likelihood for multi-class classification, where observations have a score for each class - but popular frameworks approach these functions by either updating one value of the input vectors at a time, or by using a diagonal upper bound on the second derivative. This work extends the usual gradient boosting framework to functions of vector inputs and sketches a simple algorithm that can be used efficiently with histogram-based decision trees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将梯度提升框架扩展到向量值目标函数，提出一种适用于直方图决策树的简单算法，可处理多类分类等需要向量输入的问题，而无需每步只更新一个分量或使用对角上界近似。
Motivation: 现有梯度提升框架对多变量目标函数（如多项逻辑回归）的处理存在局限，通常每步只更新一个分量或使用对角上界近似二阶导数，限制了效率和精度。
Method: 将梯度提升推广到向量输入函数，设计一种基于直方图决策树的算法，直接处理向量值叶子节点，避免逐分量更新或对角近似。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅声称该方法在概念上自然扩展了梯度提升，并能高效实现。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种处理向量目标函数的梯度提升通用框架，为多输出问题提供了理论支持和方法基础。

papers.title: Deciphering Region-Level Signatures from Latency Measurements in LEO Satellite Internet
papers.abstract_en: Low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite Internet has become an indispensable infrastructure that provide growing coverage for global users. Despite extensive measurement efforts, the principles underlying region-level performance characteristics remain insufficiently understood, limiting the ability to identify region-specific latency signatures under dynamic network conditions. In this paper, we formulate the problem of region-level latency characterization using Starlink round-trip time (RTT) measurements from the public LENS dataset. We then propose a hierarchical analytical framework that transforms raw RTT sequences into multi-scale statistical features for cross-region comparison. Using data from five geographically representative regions, we demonstrate that latency differences are strongly associated with deployment factors, particularly infrastructure availability and Starlink dish-to-Point-of-Presence distance. Mutual information analysis identifies minimum RTT as the most discriminative feature, which is further supported by XGBoost-based feature importance. The proposed model well achieves 83% accuracy on short-term data. However, its performance degrades over longer periods, indicating limited temporal generalization and motivating the need for adaptive models and feature representations for long-term performance in the future.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by the IEEE International Symposium on Personal, Indoor and Mobile Radio Communications 2026 (PIMRC 2026), 1 - 4 September 2026, Singapore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用Starlink的RTT测量数据，提出一个层次分析框架，将原始延迟序列转化为多尺度统计特征，用于识别LEO卫星互联网的区域级延迟特征。基于五个地理区域的实验表明，延迟差异主要与基础设施可用性和Starlink dish到PoP距离相关，最小RTT是最具区分力的特征。XGBoost模型在短期数据上达到83%准确率，但长期性能下降，表明需要自适应模型。
Motivation: 尽管已有大量测量工作，但区域级性能特征背后的原理仍未充分理解，限制了在动态网络条件下识别区域特定延迟特征的能力。
Method: 提出层次分析框架，从原始RTT序列中提取多尺度统计特征，用于跨区域比较；使用互信息分析和XGBoost特征重要性识别最具有区分力的特征。
Result: 在五个地理代表性区域上，模型在短期数据上达到83%准确率，但长期性能下降，表明时间泛化能力有限。
Conclusion: 当前方法在长期性能上受限，未来需要自适应模型和特征表示来改进长时间尺度的性能。

papers.title: SP-CACW: Convergence-Aware Client Weighting for Selfish Personalized Learning
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative learning is sustainable only when it benefits each participant. Standard federated learning optimizes a global average objective, which can under perform for clients whose data distributions differ substantially from the population. We study selfish personalization: how a designated target client can use peer gradients to minimize its own risk while avoiding negative transfer. We propose SP-CACW, a convergence-aware client-weighting framework that selects aggregation weights by minimizing an upper bound on the target client's convergence error. The resulting rule explicitly trades off peer bias against stochastic variance and can assign zero weight to harmful peers. We provide convergence guarantees under smoothness and bounded-variance assumptions and evaluate the method on MNIST, CIFAR-100, and LEAF Shakespeare, where it is competitive with or improves over strong personalized and clustering baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究联邦学习中的自私个性化问题，即目标客户端如何利用同伴梯度最小化自身风险并避免负迁移。提出SP-CACW，一个基于收敛感知的客户端加权框架，通过最小化目标客户端收敛误差的上界来选择聚合权重，能权衡同伴偏差与随机方差，并对有害同伴赋予零权重。在MNIST、CIFAR-100和LEAF Shakespeare上，该方法与强个性化及聚类基线相当或更优。
Motivation: 标准联邦学习优化全局平均目标，对数据分布差异大的客户端可能表现不佳。针对自私个性化场景，需要一种能避免负迁移的协作方式。
Method: 提出SP-CACW框架，通过最小化目标客户端收敛误差的上界来推导聚合权重规则，该规则显式权衡同伴偏差与随机方差，并能将有害同伴的权重设为零。
Result: 提供了在平滑和有界方差假设下的收敛保证；实验在MNIST、CIFAR-100和LEAF Shakespeare数据集上，与多种强基线和聚类基线相比，表现具有竞争力或更优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该加权规则能有效避免负迁移，并具备理论收敛保证。

summary_sections.result: 提供了在平滑和有界方差假设下的收敛保证；实验在MNIST、CIFAR-100和LEAF Shakespeare数据集上，与多种强基线和聚类基线相比，表现具有竞争力或更优。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该加权规则能有效避免负迁移，并具备理论收敛保证。

papers.title: FDM-MFVT: Few-step Sampling Diffusion Model for Mask-Free Virtual Try-On
papers.abstract_en: Image-based Virtual Try-On (IVTON) has greatly advanced through diffusion models, yet existing methods require many sampling steps and depend on masks with costly auxiliary networks. In addition, the absence of large-scale mask-free paired datasets further limits the development of mask-free IVTON. We propose FDM-MFVT, a few-step diffusion model for mask-free IVTON, integrating an Outfit-aware Noise Optimization Module (OANO) and an Instruction-driven Try-on Module (IDT) to enhance efficiency and flexibility.The OANO module initializes the alignment space with noise using the input image and only needs 6 steps to generate a higher-fidelity try-on image compared to 30 steps.The IDT module uses virtual try-on prompts and efficient adaptation to generate high-quality results from garment and person images alone. We further introduce MFVT, a 30,000-pair mask-free IVTON dataset. Experiments show that FDM-MFVT achieves superior quantitative and qualitative results with fewer inference steps than mask-based and mask-free baseline methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于图像的虚拟试穿任务，提出一种少步采样的无掩码扩散模型 FDM-MFVT，通过创新的噪声初始化模块（OANO）和指令驱动试穿模块（IDT）实现仅需6步采样即可生成高质量试穿图像，并构建了30,000对的无掩码数据集MFVT。实验表明，该方法在更少推理步骤下优于现有的掩码和无掩码基线方法。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的虚拟试穿方法需要大量采样步骤且依赖掩码和辅助网络，同时缺乏大规模无掩码配对数据集，限制了无掩码虚拟试穿的发展。
Method: 提出FDM-MFVT模型，包含Outfit-aware Noise Optimization Module (OANO) 和 Instruction-driven Try-on Module (IDT)。OANO利用输入图像初始化噪声空间，只需6步生成高保真试穿图像；IDT使用虚拟试穿提示和高效适配生成结果。同时构建了30,000对的MFVT数据集。
Result: 在定量和定性结果上，FDM-MFVT以更少推理步骤优于基于掩码和无掩码的基线方法。
Conclusion: FDM-MFVT实现了高效且灵活的无掩码虚拟试穿，少步采样和数据集构建为其关键贡献。

papers.title: Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to take actions in the real world and support human decision-making, yet most agents rely on parametric knowledge, fixed post-training data, retrieval, or search. This paradigm breaks down in novel domains and for sophisticated queries that cannot be answered from prior knowledge alone. Knowing the laws of physics, for instance, does not by itself enable LLMs to answer queries or complete long-horizon tasks in a complex physical system. To address this, we introduce Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents (HExA), an in-context self-improvement framework to learn from active experimentation. HExA iteratively designs and refines query-relevant experiments, learns a reusable library of composable skills from experience, and integrates experimental evidence to answer queries or take actions. HExA is training-free, compatible with any black-box model, and does not require external supervision, oracles, or offline data. To evaluate active experimentation, we introduce Interphyre, a tool-calling benchmark built on the PHYRE 2D procedural physics environment, where agents propose interventions and test hypotheses through simulation APIs. Experiments show that current LLM agents struggle in these settings, especially on the hardest levels of Interphyre. Claude Sonnet 4.6 achieves only 2% success, while HExA improves the same model to up to 77% success. HExA also improves open-weight models and outperforms agentic baselines such as ReAct and Reflexion. Moreover, using only skills learned from easier levels and transferred without active experimentation, HExA achieves 44% success, demonstrating the reusability and generalization of its learned skills. Overall, HExA shows that learning through active experimentation can help agents discover useful knowledge, acquire reusable skills, and make efficient progress on novel long-horizon tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents (HExA)，一种无需训练的上下文自改进框架，使 LLM 代理通过主动实验学习可重用技能。在基于 PHYRE 2D 物理环境的 Interphyre 基准上，HExA 将 Claude Sonnet 4.6 的成功率从 2% 提升至 77%，并优于 ReAct 和 Reflexion 等基线。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代理依赖参数知识或检索，无法处理需要主动实验的新颖领域和复杂查询，例如缺乏先验知识的物理系统推理。
Method: HExA 迭代设计实验、从经验中学习可组合技能库，并整合实验证据来回答查询或执行动作；无需外部监督或离线数据，兼容任意黑盒模型。
Result: 在 Interphyre 基准上，Claude Sonnet 4.6 仅 2% 成功率，HExA 提升至 77%；HExA 也改进了开源模型，且仅通过从简单任务迁移技能即可达到 44% 成功率。
Conclusion: HExA 表明主动实验学习能使代理发现有用知识、获取可重用技能，并在新颖长时域任务中高效进步。

papers.title: D$^{2}$R$^{2}$OSR: Degradation-Disentangled Representation for Real-World Omnidirectional Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: With the growing demand for immersive visual experiences, high-quality omnidirectional images (ODIs) have become increasingly important. However, limitations in imaging devices and transmission bandwidth often lead to low-resolution ODIs, hindering the rendering of fine-grained 360° details, especially in the presence of real-world degradations and geometric distortions. Existing real-world super-resolution (Real-SR) methods are inadequate for ODIs, as their degradation models fail to account for the complex imaging pipeline involving fisheye capture and Equirectangular Projection (ERP), introducing severe aliasing and projection-specific distortions. To address these challenges, we propose D$^{2}$R$^{2}$OSR, a Degradation-Disentangled Representation framework for Real-world Omnidirectional image Super-Resolution. D$^{2}$R$^{2}$OSR explicitly models degradations arising from both fisheye imaging and ERP projection, guided by two key insights: (1) projection priors play a critical role in shaping real-world degradations, and (2) human perception in immersive environments is inherently viewpoint-centric. Accordingly, we introduce a Perspective Projection Representation (PPR) operating alongside the ERP branch to capture viewpoint-aware features, together with a Degradation-Specific Module (DSM) that jointly models ERP-induced geometric distortions and PPR-specific real-world degradations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that D$^{2}$R$^{2}$OSR achieves state-of-the-art performance and produces visually compelling, high-fidelity omnidirectional Real-SR results while maintaining favorable computational efficiency for low-resource deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对真实世界全向图像超分辨率（Real-SR）中鱼眼成像和等距柱状投影（ERP）带来的复杂退化问题，提出退化解耦表示框架D²R²OSR。该框架引入视角投影表示（PPR）和退化特定模块（DSM），分别捕捉视角感知特征和联合建模几何失真与真实退化。实验表明，该方法在多项指标上达到最先进性能，生成高保真结果，且计算效率适合低资源部署。
Motivation: 现有Real-SR方法未考虑全向图像特有的鱼眼捕获和ERP投影引入的混叠与失真，导致超分效果不佳。
Method: 提出D²R²OSR框架，包含两个关键模块：视角投影表示（PPR）与ERP分支并行，提取视角感知特征；退化特定模块（DSM）联合建模ERP几何失真和PPR真实退化。
Result: 实验验证该方法在全向图像超分上取得最先进性能，生成高保真视觉效果，同时保持低计算开销，适合资源受限场景。
Conclusion: 论文强调，通过显式建模鱼眼成像和ERP投影退化，并利用投影先验，可以有效提升全向图像超分质量。

papers.title: MirrorPPR: Exemplar-Based Portrait Photo Retouching
papers.abstract_en: While text-guided image editing has made remarkable progress, it remains limited in structural portrait retouching. Textual descriptions struggle to convey fine-grained changes to facial features and body proportions. To address this gap, we introduce Exemplar-Based Portrait Photo Retouching, where the model is given an exemplar pair and tasked with inferring and applying the same retouching operations to a new query image. Existing exemplar-based editing methods primarily focus on tasks with pronounced visual transformations. In contrast, structural portrait retouching involves extremely delicate and localized modifications, making accurate extraction and transfer of these edits challenging. To tackle this, we propose MirrorPPR, a novel framework designed to capture and transfer subtle structural retouching operations. Our method uses a Retouching Operation Extractor to capture the subtle differences from the exemplar pair. The extracted representations are then injected into a pre-trained Diffusion Transformer (DiT) through a connector and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) modules. Furthermore, constructing perfectly aligned cross-identity training pairs is severely hindered by operation misalignment. To overcome this, we propose an advanced data self-augmentation paradigm that ensures strictly aligned retouching operations. To alleviate data scarcity and support this novel task, we introduce MirrorPPR47M, a large-scale dataset with over 47 million retouched pairs. By structuring the dataset into simulated and professional subsets, we enable progressive curriculum learning to smoothly optimize the network. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MirrorPPR significantly outperforms existing baselines in both retouching quality and identity preservation. The project page is available at https://sjtu-deng-lab.github.io/MirrorPPR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对结构人像修图（structural portrait retouching）提出基于示例对的修图框架MirrorPPR。该方法使用Retouching Operation Extractor从示例对中提取细微修图操作，通过连接器（connector）和LoRA模块注入预训练的扩散Transformer（DiT）。同时构造了4700万对的大规模数据集MirrorPPR47M，并采用渐进式课程学习训练。实验表明在修图质量和身份保持上显著优于现有基线。
Motivation: 文本引导的图像修图难以精确表达面部特征和身体比例的细粒度调整，而现有基于示例的方法主要处理视觉变化明显的任务，无法捕捉结构修图中极微妙的局部修改。
Method: 提出MirrorPPR框架，包含Retouching Operation Extractor提取示例对的操作表示，通过connector和LoRA模块注入预训练DiT；设计数据自增强范式确保跨身份训练对严格对齐，并构建大规模数据集MirrorPPR47M（含模拟与专业子集）以支持渐进式课程学习。
Result: 在修图质量和身份保持方面显著优于现有基线方法（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 首次定义并解决基于示例的结构人像修图任务，提供了有效框架和大规模数据集支撑，但摘要未提及局限性。

papers.title: Occlusion-Robust Multi-Object Decoupling for Physics-Based Interaction
papers.abstract_en: We propose a mask-free method for lossless multi-object 3D reconstruction from sparse and occluded real-world views, enabling physically plausible interaction via Material Point Method (MPM) simulation. Our key insight is that object coupling stems from occlusion and limited viewpoints, which we address by formulating multi-object decoupling as a sparse-view reconstruction problem. Using 3D Gaussian Splatting as base representation, we first obtain coarse instance partitions with a SAM2-trained segmentation field. Rather than relying on masks, we reconstruct fragmented geometries by leveraging a joint Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) process, which integrates reference-view supervision with novel-view synthesis guided by 2D and 3D diffusion priors to enforce both texture fidelity and 3D consistency. Furthermore, we incorporate geometry-aware priors such as intra-object and inter-object similarity to regularize geometric reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that our method produces complete, simulation-ready 3D objects without requiring manual masks, enabling realistic dynamic interactions on both synthetic and real-world datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需掩码的遮挡鲁棒多物体3D重建方法，从稀疏和遮挡的真实世界视角实现无损重建，并通过物质点法（MPM）模拟实现物理上合理的交互。核心是将多物体解耦建模为稀疏视图重建问题，利用3D高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting）作为基础表示，结合SAM2分割场和联合得分蒸馏采样（SDS）过程，在参考视图监督和新视图合成中融入2D/3D扩散先验，同时引入几何感知先验（如物体内和物体间相似性）来正则化几何推理。实验表明，该方法无需人工掩码即可生成完整、可仿真的3D物体，并在合成和真实数据集上实现逼真的动态交互。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理稀疏和遮挡的真实视图时，多物体耦合问题严重，难以实现无损3D重建和物理交互。
Method: 以3D高斯溅射为基础，先通过SAM2训练的分割场获取粗略实例分割，再采用联合得分蒸馏采样（SDS）过程，结合参考视图监督和新视图合成中的2D/3D扩散先验，并利用物体内/物体间相似性等几何先验进行正则化。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，该方法无需人工掩码即可生成完整、可直接用于仿真的3D物体，并实现逼真的动态交互。
Conclusion: 本文证明了无需掩码的稀疏视图多物体重建与物理仿真相结合的可行性，为现实场景中的交互式3D重建提供了新思路。

papers.title: Pointer-CAD v2: Plan-Then-Construct CAD Generation with Dimension-Aware Parametric Precision
papers.abstract_en: Computer-aided design (CAD) plays a fundamental role in modern manufacturing by providing the high precision required for industrial production. Recent large language model based approaches formulate CAD generation as a sequence prediction problem and have achieved promising results. However, existing methods and evaluation protocols primarily emphasize visual similarity, while overlooking precise geometric parameters and correct metric scale. Small numerical deviations that are negligible at the shape-level may still violate industrial tolerance requirements, a problem further compounded by current autoregressive paradigms that utilize command sequence representations, aggressively quantize numerical parameters to ease LLM prediction. In this work, we present Pointer-CAD v2. Compared with v1 (arXiv:2603.04337), this version directly predicts continuous values, bypassing the need for quantized numerical parameters and thereby eliminating quantization errors. Specifically, we propose a unified framework that decouples parameter reasoning from geometric construction through a Plan-Then-Construct paradigm. Our method first produces a structured design plan with explicit metric scale parameters. These parameters are organized into a dictionary and directly referenced during sequence generation via a pointer mechanism, eliminating discretization errors and ensuring dimensionally consistent execution. In addition, we construct a new large-scale dataset with plan-level annotation and introduce three hierarchical geometry accuracy metrics to evaluate parametric fidelity at the vertex, edge, and face levels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Pointer-CAD v2 consistently outperforms existing baselines and achieves substantial improvements in geometric accuracy, enabling reliable CAD generation for precision-critical engineering applications.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/Snitro/Pointer-CAD-v2
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Pointer-CAD v2，一个基于“先规划后构造”范式的高精度 CAD 生成框架。它直接预测连续数值，避免量化误差，并通过指针机制引用设计计划中的参数，确保维度一致性。同时发布带计划级注释的大规模数据集和分层几何精度指标。实验表明其在几何精度上显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 CAD 生成方法主要关注视觉相似性，忽略精确几何参数和正确度量尺度，而小型数值偏差在工业公差下不可接受。此外，自回归模型采用命令序列表示并对数值参数进行激进量化，引入量化误差。
Method: 提出 Plan-Then-Construct 统一框架：先输出包含明确度量尺度的结构化设计计划（参数以字典组织），再通过指针机制在序列生成中直接引用这些参数，无需离散化。模型直接预测连续值，消除量化误差。
Result: 在多个基准上优于现有基线，在顶点、边、面三个层面的分层几何精度指标上取得显著提升。
Conclusion: Pointer-CAD v2 实现了高保真度的 CAD 生成，满足工程应用对精密几何的要求，但方法依赖计划级注释数据的构建。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Process Advantage Signal Shaping: A Paradigm-Agnostic Middleware for Process-Supervised RL in LLM Reasoners
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is a default recipe for process-supervised reinforcement learning of LLM reasoners, and dense process supervision -- via learned process reward models (PRMs) or on-policy-distillation KL signals -- is a common way to densify its otherwise weak outcome reward. Layering such a step-level signal on top of GRPO's group-standardized advantage, however, exposes three structural pathologies: \emph{channel contamination} between the pooled process, outcome, and format streams at group standardization; \emph{resolution mismatch} between the granularity of the process signal and the granularity of the logical decisions being credited; and a \emph{cumulative trap} by which GRPO's return-to-go sum surfaces either length inflation or truncated exploration depending on the sign regime of the signal. We propose \textbf{PASS} (\emph{Process Advantage Signal Shaping}), a compact middleware that sits between any scalar step-level process signal and GRPO's clipped surrogate and addresses the three pathologies in turn: \emph{Advantage Fusion} standardizes the three streams independently within each group, \emph{Chunk-by-Value} derives value-homogeneous chunks from the signal itself and broadcasts credit within each chunk, and \emph{Divide-Length} converts the cumulative objective into an average-value-density score. We validate PASS across two domains and two process-signal paradigms -- a learned PRM on mathematical reasoning and an on-policy-distillation KL signal (with a generalized variant) on multi-hop question answering -- and under two group-standardization operators. In every regime PASS delivers a consistent pass@1 gain over the corresponding GRPO baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对GRPO在过程监督强化学习中的三个结构性问题（通道污染、分辨率不匹配、累积陷阱），提出PASS中间件。PASS通过优势融合、按值分块、除以长度三个模块，在不改变基础算法的情况下提升pass@1。实验覆盖数学推理和多跳问答，使用学习型PRM或策略蒸馏KL信号，均优于GRPO基线。
Motivation: GRPO框架下，密集过程信号与组标准化优势结合时存在三个病态结构：通道污染（过程、结果、格式流在组标准化时相互干扰）、分辨率不匹配（信号粒度与逻辑决策粒度不一致）、累积陷阱（返回到和导致长度膨胀或探索截断）。
Method: 提出PASS中间件，包含三个组件：Advantage Fusion（独立标准化每组内的三个流）、Chunk-by-Value（根据信号值划分同质块并在块内广播信用）、Divide-Length（将累积目标转换为平均价值密度分数）。
Result: 在数学推理（学习型PRM）和多跳问答（策略蒸馏KL信号）两个领域，以及两种组标准化算子下，PASS均一致地提升了pass@1，优于对应GRPO基线。
Conclusion: PASS作为与范式无关的中间件，能够有效修复GRPO过程监督中的结构性问题，提升推理性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Trajectory Matching: Reflow with Marginal Distribution Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and continuous-flow generative models achieve high-quality generation, and their deterministic sampling can be formulated as solving learned ODE dynamics. However, accurate ODE discretization often requires many steps, making efficient few-step generation a key challenge. Among acceleration strategies, reflow-based distillation simplifies teacher ODE trajectories so that a student model can approximate the teacher transport with fewer steps. We identify a theoretical limitation of this paradigm, namely that trajectory matching can under-determine the distribution induced by the student model. In particular, two student models can attain the same trajectory-matching loss while inducing different endpoint marginal distributions, which may lead to different generation quality. To address this limitation, we introduce a marginal-alignment regularizer that penalizes the discrepancy between the student-induced marginal and the corresponding teacher marginal at the endpoint of each distillation interval. The regularizer is computed by tracking log-density changes along the ODE induced by the student model and evaluating scores from the frozen teacher model, without requiring auxiliary trainable networks or adversarial optimization. The resulting framework applies uniformly to the reflow family, including vanilla reflow and piecewise reflow. We further prove a telescoping total-variation bound showing that local marginal alignment controls the final-time discrepancy between the student-induced and teacher-induced distributions. Experiments on benchmark backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method for few-step generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现基于reflow的蒸馏策略存在理论局限：轨迹匹配损失不能唯一确定学生模型诱导的边际分布，导致生成质量差异。为此提出边际对齐正则化项，通过沿学生ODE追踪对数密度变化并利用冻结教师模型的分数来惩罚分布差异，无需额外网络或对抗优化。该方法适用于vanilla reflow和分段reflow，并证明局部边际对齐控制最终时刻的总变差距离。实验验证了该方法在少步生成中的有效性。
Motivation: 现有reflow蒸馏仅关注轨迹匹配，但轨迹匹配损失相同的学生模型可能诱导不同的终点边际分布，从而影响生成质量。需要一种能约束学生模型边际分布的正则化方法。
Method: 引入边际对齐正则化，通过计算学生ODE轨迹上的对数密度变化和教师模型的分数估计，惩罚学生与教师在每个蒸馏区间终点的边际分布差异。该正则化无需辅助网络或对抗训练，可统一适用于普通reflow和分段reflow。
Result: 在基准骨干网络上的实验表明，所提方法能有效提升少步生成的质量。
Conclusion: 理论证明局部边际对齐可控制学生与教师最终分布的总变差距离；该方法为reflow族蒸馏提供更可靠的分布匹配保证。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: ASTAD: Asymmetric Style Transfer for Synthetic-to-Real Adaptation in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic data mitigates the data scarcity problem in autonomous driving perception. However, the synthetic-to-real gap leads to performance degradation, hindering real-world model generalization. Although current methods leverage diffusion models for photorealistic style transfer to bridge this gap, they critically ignore a practical asymmetry: while synthetic data possesses perfect pixel-level annotations, real-world style reference images generally lack corresponding labels. Consequently, existing methods relying on symmetric semantic guidance suffer from either prohibitive annotation costs or severe semantic misalignment. To address this dilemma, we formally propose a novel task: Asymmetric Style Transfer for Autonomous Driving (ASTAD), which requires semantically consistent transfer using only labeled synthetic content and unlabeled real-world references. We further introduce the ASTModel, a training-free two-stage framework designed to bridge this domain gap under asymmetric constraints. ASTModel first extracts a coarse semantic prior from the unlabeled target, followed by dynamic prior refinement and class-consistent style injection during the denoising process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ASTModel significantly outperforms existing methods in downstream perception utility and structural fidelity, while offering a 3.2$\times$ inference speedup. This work aligns synthetic-to-real adaptation with practical constraints, holding the potential to accelerate the scalable deployment of robust autonomous driving systems. Code: https://github.com/Dingyi-Yao/ASTAD.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶中合成数据到真实数据的域适应问题，提出非对称风格迁移任务ASTAD，利用带标签的合成内容和无标签的真实参考图像进行风格迁移。所提ASTModel是一个无训练的两阶段框架，通过粗语义先验提取和动态先验细化实现类别一致的风格注入，在感知效用和结构保真度上超越现有方法，并实现3.2倍推理加速。
Motivation: 现有风格迁移方法依赖对称语义引导（即参考图像也需像素级标签），导致标注成本高或语义错位；而实际场景中合成数据有完美标签，真实图像却无标签，这一不对称性被忽视。
Method: 提出ASTModel，一个无需训练的两阶段框架：第一阶段从无标签真实参考图像提取粗语义先验，第二阶段在扩散模型去噪过程中动态细化该先验并注入类别一致的风格。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在下游感知任务和结构保真度上显著优于现有方法，并提供3.2倍的推理速度提升。
Conclusion: 该工作将合成到真实适应与实际约束对齐，有望加速鲁棒自动驾驶系统的可扩展部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ScaleErasure: Inference-Time Minimal Intervention for Precise Concept Erasure in Next-Scale Autoregressive Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Concept erasure aims to prevent image generative models from producing unsafe content while preserving their general generative capability. Meanwhile, next-scale autoregressive (AR) image generation has recently emerged as a new generative paradigm characterized by next-scale prediction, for which concept erasure remains largely unexplored. In this paradigm, semantic information is highly compressed at early scales, leading to severe entanglement between unsafe and unrelated semantics. In this paper, we propose ScaleErasure, an inference-time concept erasure method that performs minimal intervention. ScaleErasure precisely selects and guides predicted logits that are most relevant to the unsafe concept, thereby enabling effective erasure under severe semantic entanglement. Specifically, ScaleErasure performs two additional forward passes conditioned on the unsafe concept and the corresponding safe concept, and leverages their outputs to guide the target logits away from unsafe concepts toward safe concepts. To enable precise and minimal intervention, logits selection and guidance are conducted across three dimensions: scales, tokens, and bit channels. Experiments demonstrate that ScaleErasure outperforms adapted baselines in the next-scale AR paradigm, achieving more precise concept erasure while largely preserving general generative capability. The code is available at https://github.com/coziiizz/ScaleErasure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对下一尺度自回归图像生成中的概念擦除问题，提出推理时最小干预方法ScaleErasure。由于语义信息在早期尺度高度压缩导致不安全语义与无关语义严重纠缠，该方法通过两次额外前向传播选择与不安全概念最相关的logits，并在尺度、令牌和位通道三个维度进行引导，使生成远离不安全概念。实验表明该方法在保持生成能力的同时实现了更精确的概念擦除。
Motivation: 下一尺度自回归图像生成范式中，语义信息在早期尺度高度压缩，使得不安全概念与无关语义严重纠缠，现有概念擦除方法难以有效处理。
Method: 提出ScaleErasure，在推理时进行两次额外前向传播，分别以不安全概念和对应安全概念为条件，利用其输出引导目标logits远离不安全概念；logits选择和引导在尺度、令牌和位通道三个维度上进行，以最小化干预。
Result: 实验表明，在下一尺度自回归范式下，ScaleErasure优于改编的基线方法，实现了更精确的概念擦除，同时较大程度保留了通用生成能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调ScaleErasure通过多维度logits选择和引导，在语义严重纠缠的场景下实现有效且最小干预的概念擦除。代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deterministic Decisions for High-Stakes AI. A Zero-Egress Pipeline with the Deployability of RAG and the Accuracy of Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: We identify intervention bias as a previously unquantified failure mode of zero-shot large-language-model (LLM) educational advisory agents: without task-specific training, they recommend action when a hindsight-optimal oracle policy mandates inaction. In a six-arm ablation on the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (N=800 students, four temporal cutoffs), at day 56 -- when the oracle designates 70.1% of students as needing no intervention -- zero-shot GPT-4o recommends action for 73%, a 43 percentage-point false-positive rate. Commercial RAG and SQL-augmented retrieval are comparably miscalibrated; at 10,000 students this implies about 4,300 unnecessary advisor contacts per cycle. Supervised policy learning eliminates this bias: a trajectory-conditioned ONNX Decision Transformer (DT) and a snapshot XGBoost classifier, trained on the same oracle-labelled trajectories under strict prefix-only features, both achieve near-zero calibration error. The DT reaches macro-F1 0.79 (macro-recall 0.85) across all five action classes, predicting even the rare load-reduction action without collapsing, at a 0% action flip rate and sub-5 ms CPU decision latency. The two supervised arms are on par; the DT's edge over XGBoost at the final cutoff is indicative only (unpaired across cohorts). Scope: we validate Stage-2 decision-making (EAV state vector to supervised policy) under controlled oracle input from structured OULAD data; high fidelity reflects feature-oracle alignment, not general high-stakes-AI capability. The most robust finding is the intervention-bias contrast, not the absolute accuracies. We also show an Evaluation Gap: LLM-as-judge scoring (DeepEval G-Eval) is blind to intervention bias, rewarding fluent over-prescription rather than decision quality.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 11 tables, no figures. Preprint intended for submission to EDM 2027 / LAK 2027. Includes a reproducibility package: trained ONNX Decision Transformer, generic training script, OULAD evaluation scripts, and per-arm results CSVs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别并量化了零样本LLM在教育咨询中的“干预偏误”（intervention bias）——即过度推荐干预。通过在OULAD数据集上的六臂消融实验，发现零样本GPT-4o在大部分学生不需要干预时仍推荐行动，导致43个百分点的假阳性率。监督策略学习（Decision Transformer和XGBoost）可以消除该偏误，实现近零校准误差。文章还指出了“评估差距”：LLM作为评判者（如DeepEval G-Eval）无法察觉干预偏误。本工作验证了在结构化数据下使用督导演练决策的有效性，但高保真度依赖于特征-标签对齐，而非通用高保真能力。
Motivation: 零样本LLM在高风险教育咨询中缺乏任务特定训练，存在系统性推荐干预的偏误（干预偏误），尚未被量化。这种偏误可能导致大量不必要的学生联系。
Method: 使用Open University Learning Analytics Dataset（N=800学生，四个时间截断点）进行六臂消融实验。对比零样本GPT-4o、商业RAG和SQL增强检索等基线，以及监督策略学习（Decision Transformer和XGBoost）。训练采用严格前缀特征和oracle标记轨迹。
Result: 在day56时，oracle认为70.1%学生无需干预，但零样本GPT-4o推荐干预的假阳性率达43个百分点。监督策略学习实现近零校准误差：Decision Transformer宏F1=0.79，宏召回=0.85，零动作翻转率，亚5ms CPU决策延迟。XGBoost表现相当。
Conclusion: 最可靠的发现是干预偏误的对比，而非绝对准确率。作者指出存在“评估差距”：LLM作为评判者（如G-Eval）对干预偏误视而不见，奖励流畅的过度处方而非决策质量。本文验证了在受控oracle输入下Stage-2决策的有效性，但高保真度依赖于特征-标签对齐，不能推广到通用高保真AI。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Manufactured Confidence: How Memory Consolidation Turns Hearsay into Confident Facts
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents carry conclusions across steps and sessions in compressed memory, and memory products (e.g., mem0, LangMem) rewrite conversation into stored "facts" that later steps trust. We show this rewriting manufactures confidence: across our constructed agent settings, a casual, hedged remark becomes a confident, dated assertion the agent then obeys like a verified fact, granting every above-clearance request it faces. No attacker is needed: a role that was true once and never corrected is stored as a flat fact and acted on like a deliberate injection. We then isolate what the agent responds to. It is not the source: attributed, unattributed, and even forged "system of record" claims all grant alike. It is the confidence of the phrasing. A hedge is discounted, a flat assertion is obeyed, and this holds with no special keyword. Not all hedges are equal, though: the evidential register is the least-discounted, with "reportedly" obeyed like a flat assertion on most models. The obvious fixes fail. A passive "unverified" tag is ignored, and an active "do not trust this" instruction escalates even correct memory, so it is safe only by refusing to decide. The real fix lives in the store: keep the tentative phrasing rather than upgrade it. But that is hygiene, not a defense against an attacker who can simply write a confident lie. The deployable lesson is narrower and constructive: a single load-bearing memory is the hazard, and one redundant source restores correct decisions. We release the harness and demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM代理在记忆整合过程中如何将随意的、有保留的言论转化为自信的事实，并发现代理会根据措辞的自信程度而非来源可信度来服从记忆。即使是被动标记“未验证”或主动指令“不要相信”也无法有效防御，唯一的防御是保留原始措辞或引入冗余来源。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理系统在跨步骤记忆压缩时会将对话重写为存储的“事实”，后续步骤会信任这些事实。本文揭示这种重写会制造虚假的自信，导致代理将随意的言论当作已验证的事实，从而无条件批准高权限请求，无需攻击者介入。
Method: 构建代理设置，比较归因、未归因甚至伪造的“系统记录”声明对代理行为的影响，隔离出代理实际响应的因素（措辞自信程度而非来源），并测试不同修饰词（如“据报道”）和防御措施（如“未验证”标签、主动指令）的效果。
Result: 代理不依赖来源：归因、未归因和伪造的声明同样被服从。措辞自信程度是关键：有保留的言论被忽略，平实的断言被服从。不同修饰词效果不同：陈述语料（如“据报道”）在多数模型上被像平实断言一样服从。被动“未验证”标签无效，主动“勿信”指令会误伤正确记忆。
Conclusion: 真正的修复在于保持原始有保留的措辞而非升级为自信断言，但这只是卫生手段而非防御。一个单一的支撑性记忆是风险点，引入一个冗余来源即可恢复正确决策。本文发布相关测试工具和演示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Complexity Ceiling Benchmark: A Multi-Domain Evaluation of Sequential Reasoning Under Depth Scaling
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Complexity Ceiling Benchmark (CCB), a controlled evaluation of how language-model reasoning decays as the number of required sequential steps grows. CCB fixes the semantic content of a task and varies only its depth N in {5,...,50} across three structurally distinct regimes: grounded spatial state-tracking, abstract symbolic pointer manipulation, and transitive relational inference. Across 6,000 trials over five frontier and open-weight LLMs we find a consistent pattern of geometric per-step decay with widely separated domain ceilings: on the first two regimes the strongest models retain pd>0.92 across N=50; on the third every model collapses by N=5, with the best model's 50%-success horizon at H0.5~4.7 steps despite pd=0.863. A trace-level metric (TFBC) shows that 14.5% of correct answers across the benchmark are reached via incorrect intermediate reasoning. Forced verbose state-tracking does not move the ceiling (McNemar p=1.000), and the mean step at which reasoning first diverges, k*, predicts within-domain accuracy better than parameter count. CCB and the geometric decay model together reduce a model's long-horizon reasoning profile to one interpretable number per task family.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the 1st Workshop on Combining Theory and Benchmarks (CTB), CTB@ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出复杂度天花板基准（CCB），用于评估语言模型在顺序推理深度增加时的性能退化。该基准固定任务语义内容，仅改变推理深度N∈[5,50]，涵盖三个结构不同的领域：接地空间状态跟踪、抽象符号指针操作和传递关系推理。在五个前沿和开源LLM上的6000次试验中，发现几何每步衰减模式，且领域天花板差异显著：前两个领域最强模型在N=50时保持pd>0.92，第三个领域所有模型在N=5时崩溃，最佳模型的50%成功水平线H0.5~4.7步。14.5%的正确答案通过错误中间推理达到，强制详细状态跟踪不改变天花板，首次推理偏离的平均步数k*比参数数量更好地预测域内准确性。
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏对语言模型随推理步骤深度增加而性能衰减的控制评估，无法区分语义复杂性和推理深度的独立影响。
Method: CCB基准为每个领域固定语义内容，仅变化推理深度N，并引入几何衰减模型和迹级度量TFBC，通过6,000次试验评估五个LLM。
Result: 发现几何每步衰减模式，领域天花板高度分离：前两个领域强模型在N=50时性能良好，第三个领域所有模型在N=5时失败；14.5%的正确答案来自错误中间推理；强制详细状态跟踪不改善性能；k*比参数数量更好地预测准确性。
Conclusion: CCB和几何衰减模型将模型的长程推理概况简化为每个任务家族的一个可解释数值，揭示了推理深度对LLM性能的关键影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Adaptive Block Diffusion: Resolving Training-Inference Mismatch in Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) are typically trained under fixed context structures, restricting denoising to predetermined token subsets. This creates a mismatch between training and inference, where models must operate over arbitrary configurations, leading to degradation off the training grid. We propose Adaptive Block Diffusion (ABD), which resolves this mismatch by optimizing denoising risk over a distribution of prefix-window configurations. By treating the configuration as a stochastic variable, ABD trains a single model over the full configuration space without architectural changes. We show that generalization across decoding strategies is governed by the support of the training distribution, and that ABD guarantees denoising optimality for any inference policy whose configurations are covered during training. Empirically, ABD exhibits structural invariance across decoding scales, avoiding off-grid collapse and recovering a monotonic relationship between block size and perplexity, while matching or outperforming fixed-block specialists at their target scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对扩散语言模型在固定上下文结构训练与任意配置推理之间的不匹配问题，提出自适应块扩散（Adaptive Block Diffusion, ABD），将配置视为随机变量，在完整配置空间上优化去噪风险，无需架构改动即可训练单一模型。实验表明ABD避免离格崩溃，恢复块大小与困惑度间的单调关系，并在目标尺度匹配或超越固定块专家。
Motivation: 现有扩散语言模型在固定上下文结构下训练，导致推理时面对任意配置出现性能退化，造成训练与推理不匹配。
Method: 提出ABD，将前缀窗口配置视为随机变量，在配置分布上优化去噪风险，使单一模型覆盖全部配置空间，无需修改模型架构。
Result: ABD在不同解码尺度上表现出结构不变性，避免离格崩溃，恢复块大小与困惑度的单调关系，并在目标尺度上匹配或超越固定块专家。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过训练分布覆盖推理配置，ABD可保证任意解码策略的去噪最优性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Hybrid Framework for Song Lyric Annotation Based on Human-LLM Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Emotion recognition of song lyrics is a challenging task since lyrics may not necessarily align with the overall emotion of a song. As a result, lyrics annotation remains largely underexplored. Drawing inspiration from research in large language model (LLM) assisted annotation, we examine the alignment between humans and LLMs for annotation of lyrics by creating a new sentence-level dataset of lyrics. Our observations highlight the subjectivity of the task and the inherent challenges. Following this, we present a hybrid annotation framework that optimizes human and LLM annotation by predicting potential misalignment in annotation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对歌词情感标注这一未充分探索的任务，构建了一个句子级歌词数据集，并研究人类与大型语言模型（LLM）在标注上的一致性。结果表明该任务具有主观性和固有挑战；在此基础上，提出一种混合标注框架，通过预测潜在的不对齐来优化人类和LLM的标注。
Motivation: 歌词情感识别具有挑战性，因为歌词可能不与歌曲整体情感一致，导致歌词标注任务未被充分探索。
Method: 提出一个混合标注框架，通过预测人类与LLM在标注中可能的不对齐，从而优化两者的标注过程。
Result: 基于新构建的句子级数据集，观察到歌词情感标注的主观性和固有挑战，并展示了框架的潜力。
Conclusion: 通过预测标注不对齐，可以有效优化人类与LLM在歌词情感标注上的协作。

papers.title: PCGD: Physics-Guided Conditional Graph Diffusion for TCAD Device Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Technology computer-aided design (TCAD) semiconductor device simulation is fundamentally constrained by the high computational cost of iteratively solving coupled drift-diffusion equations. Existing ML surrogates either reduce internal physics to macroscopic scalar regressions, or rely on single-step mappings that lack the iterative refinement required to resolve stiff, coupled fields. To address this, we introduce PCGD, a Physics-Guided Conditional Graph Diffusion framework operating natively on unstructured TCAD meshes to predict coupled electrostatic and carrier density fields. PCGD employs a Condition-Aware MeshGraphNet denoiser that explicitly injects boundary conditions and device structure context via global cross-attention. By augmenting data-driven denoising with a physics-guided hybrid objective that integrates exponent-free quasi-Fermi gradient matching with noise-aware PDE residuals, PCGD progressively enforce physical constraints in the iterative diffusion trajectory. This strategy successfully bypasses the numerical instabilities typical of stiff drift-diffusion equations. Evaluated on a challenging mixed PN/MOS benchmark, PCGD significantly outperforms deterministic one-step regression (1.207% error) and local diffusion (1.585% error) baselines by achieving a sub-percent mean relative field error of 0.835%, while concurrently reducing maximum PDE residual errors by nearly three orders of magnitude compared to pure diffusion. It also transfers robustly to unseen SOI topologies (0.815% error) via LoRA adaptation, using 5.30$\times$ less data and 14.34$\times$ fewer parameters than full fine-tuning. Ultimately, PCGD bridges the computational efficiency of generative surrogates with the rigorous physical fidelity of traditional TCAD, unlocking highly scalable, field-level analysis for robust device engineering.

papers.title: Enhancing Part-Level Point Grounding for Any Open-Source MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Visual grounding aims to associate free-form textual queries with specific regions in an image. While recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated promising capabilities in this domain, they primarily excel at object-level grounding and often struggle with part-level grounding-an essential requirement for fine-grained tasks such as robotic manipulation. In this work, we introduce a general approach that equips any open-source MLLMs with accurate 2D part-level point grounding, offering a more direct alternative to conventional grounding representations. Our method leverages the attention mechanisms inherently present in MLLMs. By synthesizing text-conditioned, grounding-aware queries within intermediate layers via the proposed Q-Synth Module, we capture target-relevant attention patterns and refine them with a lightweight Attention-to-Point Decoder, which converts these patterns into a point-centric heatmap for final prediction. Notably, all original MLLM parameters are frozen, ensuring full preservation of their pre-trained capabilities. Experiments show that our design consistently improves part-level grounding accuracy across datasets and can be seamlessly integrated into any open-source MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通用方法，使任何开源多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）具备精确的2D部件级点定位能力。该方法利用MLLMs固有的注意力机制，通过Q-Synth模块合成文本条件化的定位感知查询，并借助轻量级Attention-to-Point解码器生成点热图。所有原始MLLM参数保持冻结，实验表明该方法能一致提升部件级定位精度且可无缝集成到任何开源MLLMs中。
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在对象级定位上表现良好，但在部件级定位（如机器人操作所需）上常常表现不佳，缺乏一种直接且通用的解决方案。
Method: 提出Q-Synth模块，在中间层合成文本条件化、定位感知的查询，捕获目标相关注意力模式；再通过轻量级Attention-to-Point解码器将模式转换为点热图，实现最终预测，且不修改原始MLLM参数。
Result: 实验表明，该方法在多个数据集上一致提升了部件级定位精度，并能无缝集成到任意开源MLLMs中。
Conclusion: 该方法为部件级视觉定位提供了一种高效、通用的途径，保持预训练能力不变，适用于需要细粒度定位的机器人操作等场景。

papers.title: Nonlinear mixture model motivated subspace clustering
papers.abstract_en: We derive the linear union-of-subspaces (UoS) model for subspace clustering (SC) from the nonlinear mixture model (NMM) used in blind source separation (BSS) to represent a D-dimensional observation vector as an unknown multivariate nonlinear mapping of C latent variables. Assuming the mapping is differentiable up to an unknown order K, we approximate NMM by a K-th order Taylor expansion, yielding a model equivalent to the linear UoS framework underlying SC. This establishes that: (i) the smoothness order K corresponds to the unknown subspace dimension d; (ii) KC equals the number of anchors; and (iii) the sparsity of the representation vector equals K (i.e., d). These relationships enable estimation of bounds on subspace dimension, and that is validated on six benchmark datasets using five established SC algorithms. Established theoretical results are important for post-processing of self-representation matrices estimated by SC algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从盲源分离（BSS）中的非线性混合模型（NMM）出发，通过K阶泰勒展开近似，证明了该模型等价于子空间聚类（SC）中常用的线性联合子空间（UoS）模型。理论推导表明，平滑阶数K对应于子空间维数d，并且KC等于锚点数，表示向量的稀疏度等于K。论文在六个基准数据集上使用五种SC算法验证了所提子空间维数界限估计的有效性，这些结果对SC算法后处理自表示矩阵有重要意义。
Motivation: 现有子空间聚类（SC）模型与盲源分离（BSS）中的非线性混合模型（NMM）之间的联系尚不明确，缺乏从非线性角度对SC线性UoS模型的理论推导。
Method: 假设NMM中映射函数可微至未知阶数K，对其进行K阶泰勒展开，得到与线性UoS模型等价的表示，从而将NMM与SC框架统一，并导出子空间维数、锚点数和稀疏度的对应关系。
Result: 在六个基准数据集上，使用五种已有SC算法验证了通过K阶泰勒展开估计的子空间维数界限的有效性，表明理论关系与实际数据一致。
Conclusion: 建立的理论关系为SC算法自表示矩阵的后处理提供了重要依据，有助于更准确地估计子空间参数。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Generalization Analysis of Transformers in Distribution Regression
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, models based on the Transformer architecture have seen widespread applications and have become one of the core tools in the field of deep learning. Numerous successful techniques, such as parameter-efficient fine-tuning and efficient scaling, have been proposed surrounding their applications to further enhance performance. However, the success of these strategies has always lacked the support of rigorous mathematical theory. To study the underlying mechanisms behind Transformers and related techniques, we first propose a Transformer learning framework motivated by distribution regression, with distributions being inputs, connect a two-stage sampling process with natural language processing, and present a mathematical formulation of the attention mechanism called attention operator. We demonstrate that by the attention operator, Transformers can compress distributions into function representations without loss of information. Moreover, with the advantages of our novel attention operator, Transformers exhibit a stronger capability to learn functionals with more complex structures than convolutional neural networks and fully connected networks. Finally, we obtain a generalization bound within the distribution regression framework. Through the aforementioned theoretical results, we further discuss some successful techniques emerging with large language models (LLMs), such as prompt tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, and efficient scaling. We also provide theoretical insights behind these techniques within our novel analysis framework.
papers.journal_ref: Neural Computation 37(2):260-293, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在分布回归框架下研究Transformer的泛化理论，提出注意力算子（attention operator），证明其能无损压缩分布为函数表示，并得到泛化界。同时，该理论框架为prompt tuning、参数高效微调、高效缩放等LLM技术提供了理论见解。
Motivation: Transformer及相关技术（如参数高效微调、高效缩放）虽应用广泛，但缺乏严格的数学理论支撑。本文旨在建立理论理解，解释其成功机制。
Method: 提出分布回归下的Transformer学习框架，将输入视为分布，通过两阶段采样过程与自然语言处理联系，并定义注意力算子。利用函数空间分析工具推导泛化界。
Result: 证明注意力算子能无信息损失地将分布压缩为函数表示；Transformer学习复杂泛函的能力优于CNN和全连接网络；得到分布回归框架下的泛化界。
Conclusion: 该理论框架为LLM中的prompt tuning、参数高效微调、高效缩放等技术提供了理论依据，但泛化界的具体数值及实际应用效果未在摘要中展开。

papers.title: Confidence-feedback-weighted graph matching network: online-offline laser-induced damage site matching under complex interference
papers.abstract_en: Online inspection images of final optics in high-power laser facilities contain pseudo-damage sites that closely resemble true damage sites. Determining the authenticity of online-detected sites is therefore difficult and requires accurate matching to offline ground-truth sites. However, this matching remains highly challenging due to limited match-discriminative features, local geometric distortions, and numerous distractor sites. Existing matching models mainly suppress distractors implicitly through loss-function supervision. We propose a confidence-feedback-weighted graph matching network that requires only damage-site centroid coordinates as input. It estimates node matchability confidence from each round of matching scores and feeds it back as a reliability weight to guide subsequent edge-feature aggregation, thereby suppressing distractor propagation and enhancing cross-graph discriminability. Within this framework, a geometric consistency constraint calibrates spurious high-confidence matchability estimates, while a hard-example mining loss improves discrimination between structurally similar sites. Experiments on our Complex-Scene dataset show that the proposed method achieves a matching F1-score of 96.36$\%$ with robust and efficient performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种置信度反馈加权图匹配网络，用于高功率激光设施中在线检测损伤点与离线真实点的精确匹配。该方法仅需损伤点中心坐标，通过迭代估计节点可匹配性置信度并加权反馈，有效抑制干扰点传播。在自建复杂场景数据集上匹配F1分数达96.36%。
Motivation: 在线检测图像中存在与真实损伤点高度相似的伪损伤点，现有匹配方法受限于判别特征有限、局部几何畸变和大量干扰点，且主要隐式抑制干扰，准确匹配困难。
Method: 构建置信度反馈加权图匹配网络，输入损伤点中心坐标，从每轮匹配分数估计节点可匹配性置信度并作为可靠性权重反馈，指导后续边特征聚合；同时引入几何一致性约束和困难样本挖掘损失。
Result: 在复杂场景数据集上匹配F1分数达96.36%，性能鲁棒且高效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过显式置信度反馈有效抑制干扰点传播，提升跨图判别性。

papers.title: Learning to Bid in Discriminatory Auctions with Budget Constraints
papers.abstract_en: We study repeated bidding in multi-unit discriminatory (pay-as-bid) auctions for a single bidder with per-round utility equal to value minus $α$ times payment, where $α\in[0,1]$ is a cost-of-capital parameter. The bidder aims to maximize cumulative utility over $T$ rounds subject to a total budget $B$. The problem is challenging even without budgets: the action space is exponential in $M$, the maximum demand of the bidder and the valuation vector (context) varies over time. Exploiting a decomposition of utility across units, we develop polynomial-time learning algorithms based on shortest paths in a directed acyclic graph, obtaining sublinear regret under both full-information and bandit feedback. In the bandit setting, the regret is independent of the number of contexts due to complete cross-learning: observing the utility of the chosen action under the realized context reveals the utility for the same action under all counterfactual contexts. With budget constraints, when the average normalized per-round budget $ρ=\frac{B}{MT}<1$, we design a coupled primal-dual algorithm in which the DAG-based procedure uses dual-adjusted edge weights for primal updates, while online gradient descent updates the dual variable, yielding $ρ$-approximate sublinear regret. Finally, we give implementations whose per-round time and space are independent of the number of contexts, enabling scalability to large or even infinite context spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预算约束下多单元歧视性（按报价支付）拍卖中的重复竞价问题。投标者每轮效用为价值减去支付成本的α倍，目标是在总预算B下最大化T轮累积效用。利用跨单位效用分解，作者提出了基于有向无环图最短路径的多项式时间学习算法，在完全信息和强盗反馈下均实现了次线性遗憾。在强盗设置中，由于完全跨学习（complete cross-learning），遗憾与上下文数量无关。对于预算约束，当平均归一化每轮预算ρ<1时，设计了耦合原始-对偶算法，得到ρ-近似次线性遗憾。算法每轮时间和空间复杂度与上下文数量无关。
Motivation: 现有研究在处理预算约束下的多单元歧视性拍卖竞价时，面临动作空间随需求指数增长以及估值向量随时间变化的挑战。本文旨在设计多项式时间学习算法，在完全信息和强盗反馈下实现次线性遗憾，并处理预算约束。
Method: 提出基于有向无环图（DAG）最短路径的学习算法，利用跨单位效用分解降低复杂性。在强盗设置中利用完全跨学习特性，使遗憾独立于上下文数量。对于预算约束，设计耦合原始-对偶算法，DAG过程使用对偶调整边权进行原始更新，在线梯度下降更新对偶变量。
Result: 在完全信息和强盗反馈下均获得次线性遗憾；在强盗设置中，遗憾与上下文数量无关。对于预算约束，当ρ<1时，算法实现了ρ-近似次线性遗憾。算法每轮时间和空间复杂度独立于上下文数量，可扩展至大甚至无限上下文空间。

papers.title: When Summaries Distort Decisions: Information Fidelity in LLM-Compressed Financial Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Financial decision-makers face more information than they can directly inspect, making context compression necessary. Yet when large language models (LLMs) compress financial source material, they can alter the investment judgment supported by the original source. We frame this problem as information fidelity: compression loses fidelity when it changes the decision induced by the source. In agentic systems, such losses may recur across intermediate steps and amplify throughout the decision process. Across financial filings and earnings-call transcripts, we find that LLM-based compression can produce fluent and factually plausible compressed contexts that nevertheless alter downstream decisions. We analyze two diagnostic patterns associated with fidelity loss: decontextualization, where salient evidence is retained but separated from the caveats and contextual qualifiers needed for correct interpretation, and model dependency, where different compressors expose different views of the same source. We then propose Agentic Context Compression, which generates multiple candidate compressions and audits their disagreements against the original source. Our results suggest that financial compression should be evaluated not only by efficiency or factuality, but also by its ability to preserve decision-relevant context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在压缩金融源材料（如财报、电话会议记录）时对投资决策的影响。作者提出信息保真度概念，发现LLM压缩可能产生流畅且事实合理的文本，但会改变原决策。分析去语境化和模型依赖性两种失真模式，并提出代理式上下文压缩方法，通过生成多个候选压缩并与原始源审计不一致来缓解问题。
Motivation: 金融决策者面临信息过载，需要压缩，但现有LLM压缩评估只关注效率和事实准确性，忽略了压缩是否改变决策。本文旨在量化压缩对决策的影响并探索缓解方法。
Method: 定义信息保真度为压缩后决策与原始决策的一致性；识别两种失真模式：去语境化（保留关键证据但脱离必要上下文）和模型依赖性（不同压缩器暴露不同视图）；提出Agentic Context Compression，生成多个候选压缩并审计分歧。
Result: 在金融文件与收益电话会议记录上的实验表明，LLM压缩可产生流畅且事实合理的文本，但仍会改变下游投资决策。
Conclusion: 金融压缩评估应同时考虑效率、事实性和决策相关性，代理式上下文压缩可帮助保持决策相关上下文。

papers.title: When Prices Double in a Week: Forecasting of Agricultural Volatility in Import-Isolated Markets
papers.abstract_en: Vegetable prices in Sri Lanka are highly volatile because the market is largely import-isolated, so supply disruptions quickly drive prices up. This study develops a machine learning framework to forecast such volatility by incorporating supply-chain-aware features and explicitly modelling the country's two cultivation seasons, Maha (October-April) and Yala (May-September). An integrated dataset was constructed by combining retail and farmer-gate prices with origin-aligned weather variables, diesel costs, and exchange rates across 12 vegetable varieties and 14 market centres from 2013 to 2019. A gradient-boosted ensemble model (XGBoost and LightGBM) was trained and optimised using Optuna, and unified and season-specific configurations were compared. Results show that season-specific models improve within-season fit, with the Yala-specific model achieving the highest R2 of 0.9420 (95% CI [0.690, 1.000]), while the unified model delivers the best overall predictive accuracy of 90.84% (95% CI [88.34%, 91.52%]) and an R2 of 0.9281 (95% CI [0.760, 1.000]). Notably, the unified model maintains 85.96% accuracy on a completely unseen 2024 hyperinflationary period without retraining, successfully tracking major price surges. These findings suggest that agricultural price movements in import-constrained markets are meaningfully predictable when models capture supply-chain dynamics, offering practical value for early warning and decision making by farmers, traders, and policymakers. Existing studies on Sri Lankan vegetable prices are confined to Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) and Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (GARCH) applied to single markets, with no supply-chain features, seasonal segmentation, or cross-regime validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文针对斯里兰卡进口隔离市场中的蔬菜价格剧烈波动问题，构建了一个集成机器学习框架（XGBoost和LightGBM），通过加入供应链感知特征并显式建模两个耕作季节（Maha和Yala）来预测价格波动。训练数据涵盖2013-2019年12种蔬菜在14个市场的零售价、农场价、天气变量、柴油成本和汇率。结果显示，统一模型在整体预测准确率上达到90.84%（R²=0.9281），且在未经训练的2024年恶性通胀期间仍保持85.96%的准确率，表明在进口受限市场中价格变动具有可预测性。
Motivation: 斯里兰卡蔬菜市场因进口隔离而高度波动，现有研究局限于单市场的ARIMA和GARCH模型，缺乏供应链特征、季节分割和跨制度验证。
Method: 构建集成数据集，融合零售价、农场价与产地对齐的天气变量、柴油成本和汇率（12种蔬菜、14个市场、2013-2019年）；使用Optuna优化的梯度提升集成模型（XGBoost和LightGBM），比较统一模型和季节特定模型（Maha和Yala）。
Result: Yala季节特定模型在季内拟合中R²最高达0.9420（95%CI [0.690, 1.000]）；统一模型整体预测准确率为90.84%（95%CI [88.34%, 91.52%]），R²=0.9281（95%CI [0.760, 1.000]），并在2024年恶性通胀期间无需再训练即保持85.96%准确率。
Conclusion: 在进口受限市场中，通过捕捉供应链动态的机器学习模型可以有意义地预测农业价格变动，为农民、贸易商和政策制定者提供早期预警和决策支持。

papers.title: SurgVLA-Bench: Towards Evaluating Vision-Language-Action Models for Laparoscopic Surgical Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models represent a promising direction for embodied intelligence in surgical robotics. Despite the prevalence of VLA benchmarks for general robotics, standardized evaluation platforms specifically designed for surgical contexts remain absent. To address this limitation, we present SurgVLA-Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLA models in laparoscopic surgical robotics. Leveraging the SurRoL simulation platform, we construct a hierarchical task taxonomy ranging from atomic actions to complete surgical procedures, complemented by a multi-dimensional evaluation framework assessing action accuracy and semantic consistency. We then systematically evaluate two representative paradigms, including autoregressive models such as OpenVLA, and flow matching models such as $π_{0}$, $π_{0.5}$, and SmolVLA. Our experiments show that autoregressive models tend to excel in semantic understanding, while flow matching models often achieve higher task precision but may face generalization trade-offs. However, even the best-performing models remain far from satisfactory, as the constrained endoscopic field of view, restricted viewing angles, and frequent occlusions persist as fundamental physical bottlenecks. The code and data are available at https://github.com/VCL-HNU/SurgVLA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SurgVLA-Bench，首个面向腹腔镜手术机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的综合性基准测试平台。基于 SurRoL 模拟环境，构建从原子动作到完整手术的分层任务体系，并设计多维度评估框架衡量动作准确性与语义一致性。实验对比了自回归模型（如 OpenVLA）和流匹配模型（如 π₀、π₀.5、SmolVLA），发现自回归模型在语义理解上更优，流匹配模型任务精度更高但泛化性存在权衡，且当前最佳模型仍受限于内窥镜视野窄、视角受限和频繁遮挡等物理瓶颈。
Motivation: 通用机器人领域的 VLA 基准已较多，但缺乏专门针对手术场景的标准化评估平台，制约了手术机器人具身智能的发展。
Method: 基于 SurRoL 仿真环境，构建分层任务分类（原子动作到完整手术流程），并提出多维评估框架，同时评估动作准确性和语义一致性。
Result: 自回归模型（OpenVLA）在语义理解上表现更好，流匹配模型（π₀ 等）任务精度更高但泛化有所牺牲；即使最佳模型仍未达到令人满意的水平，内窥镜视野受限、视角狭窄和遮挡是主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: SurgVLA-Bench 为手术 VLA 模型提供了系统评估标准，并揭示了当前模型的局限性，为未来研究指明了方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KrishokChat: A Citation-Grounded Dataset and Benchmark for Bengali Agricultural Advisory
papers.abstract_en: We present KrishokChat, the first citation-grounded Bengali agricultural instruction-tuning dataset for crop advisory in low-resource settings. We establish a foundation of 290 hierarchical Knowledge Nodes, extracting disease symptoms, management practices, chemical dosages, and verbatim citations from 129 domain-filtered agricultural manuals. Every training instance inherits a verified citation header, guaranteeing 100% citation provenance. Using a Partitioned Seed Generation Matrix, these nodes are expanded into 139,200 supervised fine-tuning pairs, and augmented with 5,300 chemical safety and 1,000 adversarial safety instances, yielding 145,500 QA pairs across 18 crop categories. To evaluate real-world performance, we introduce the Farmer Benchmark, comprising 1,001 authentic farmer queries curated from field surveys and digital portals. Empirical evaluation on Gemma-4-E2B reveals that while fine-tuning on KrishokChat vastly improves structured formatting, standalone models still struggle with exact chemical dosage generalization. This highlights the dataset's true value as a verified knowledge base for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) rather than mere parametric memorization. All data, code, and benchmarks are released under CC-BY-4.0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KrishokChat 是首个基于引用的孟加拉语农业指令微调数据集，用于低资源场景下的作物咨询。通过 290 个层级知识节点和分割种子生成矩阵，扩展得到 145,500 个 QA 对，并引入 Farmer Benchmark 评估实际性能。实验表明，模型在结构化格式上提升显著，但化学剂量泛化仍困难，突出了数据集作为 RAG 知识库的价值。
Motivation: 农业咨询在低资源语言（如孟加拉语）中缺乏带引用的高质量指令数据集，现有模型常产生幻觉。
Method: 从 129 本农业手册构建 290 个层级知识节点，利用分割种子生成矩阵扩展为 139,200 个监督微调对，并添加 5,300 个化学安全与 1,000 个对抗安全实例，共 145,500 个 QA 对。评估使用包含 1,001 条真实农民查询的 Farmer Benchmark。
Result: 在 Gemma-4-E2B 上微调后，模型结构化格式大幅改善，但精确化学剂量泛化仍不足。
Conclusion: 数据集更适合作为检索增强生成（RAG）的验证知识库，而非参数记忆。所有资源公开于 CC-BY-4.0。

papers.title: Towards Evaluating Data Priors for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Data-generating priors are a central component of tabular foundation models because they define the task distribution used during pretraining. However, priors are rarely evaluated as independent components, making it difficult to understand how much they affect downstream model behavior. This raises a methodological question: how can priors from different tabular foundation models be compared independently of the architectures and training protocols they were introduced with? To study this question, we implement a unified interface for publicly available priors from recent tabular foundation models and priors constructed from real datasets. We generate training tasks from each prior, train the same model architecture under a fixed training protocol, and evaluate the resulting models on shared downstream classification tasks. We compare priors through both generated-task statistics and downstream predictive performance. Our results show that different priors favor different downstream behaviors, with some achieving stronger absolute performance and others exhibiting more consistent relative rankings across datasets. We further find that data-level similarity only partially explains downstream behavior. Our code is available at https://github.com/automl/TFM-Playground/tree/prior-dev.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨如何独立于架构和训练协议，比较不同表格基础模型（tabular foundation models）的数据生成先验（data-generating priors）。作者实现了一个统一接口，从公开先验和真实数据集构造训练任务，在固定架构和协议下训练模型，并在下游分类任务上评估。结果显示，不同先验偏好不同的下游行为，且数据层相似性仅能部分解释下游表现。
Motivation: 表格基础模型中的数据先验很少作为独立组件被评估，导致难以理解其对下游行为的实际影响。因此需要一个方法体系，能够比较来自不同模型的先验，而不受其所关联的架构和训练协议的影响。
Method: 作者实现了一个统一接口，整合了近期表格基础模型中的公开先验以及从真实数据集构造的先验。从每个先验生成训练任务，使用相同的模型架构和固定训练协议进行训练，然后在共享的下游分类任务上评估模型，并通过生成任务统计和下游预测性能来比较先验。
Result: 不同先验会导致不同的下游行为：部分先验获得更强的绝对性能，部分先验在数据集间产生更一致的相对排名。此外，数据层相似性只能部分解释下游行为。
Conclusion: 表格基础模型的数据先验作为独立组件值得深入分析，其对下游行为的影响不应被忽视。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Blackknife: Hard-Label Query-Limited Black-Box Attacks on Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous graph neural networks (HGNNs) have achieved strong performance in modeling complex graph-structured data with multiple node and relation types. However, their robustness under realistic black-box adversarial settings remains insufficiently explored. Existing attacks on HGNNs usually assume access to model gradients, soft prediction scores, or the complete graph structure, which is often unavailable when HGNN-based services are deployed as closed systems. In this paper, we propose Blackknife, a hard-label, query-limited, and structure-limited black-box evasion attack framework for heterogeneous graph neural networks. Blackknife assumes no access to the victim model architecture, parameters, gradients, logits, confidence scores, or the full graph structure. Instead, it only relies on locally observable one-hop heterogeneous structures and a small number of hard-label queries. To generate effective perturbations under these strict constraints, Blackknife first constructs a local relation-aware surrogate model from observable heterogeneous neighborhoods. It then relaxes discrete edge addition and deletion operations into continuous soft weights and optimizes them through projected gradient descent. Finally, the optimized perturbations are discretized into relation-preserving structural rewiring operations and verified using limited hard-label feedback from the victim model. Extensive experiments on three benchmark heterogeneous graph datasets, including ACM, DBLP, and IMDB, demonstrate that Blackknife consistently achieves strong attack success rates against representative HGNN models. The results further show that Blackknife remains effective under topology-based defense strategies, revealing the vulnerability of HGNNs to local structure-limited black-box attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Blackknife，一种针对异构图表征网络（HGNNs）的硬标签、查询受限、结构受限的黑盒逃逸攻击框架。攻击者无法访问模型梯度、软预测分数、完整图结构，仅依赖局部可观测的一跳异构结构和少量硬标签查询。通过构建局部关系感知的替代模型，将离散边操作松弛为连续软权重，经投影梯度下降优化后离散化为保持关系的结构重连操作，并利用有限硬标签反馈验证。在ACM、DBLP、IMDB三个基准数据集上，Blackknife对代表性HGNN模型达到较高攻击成功率，且在基于拓扑的防御策略下依然有效。
Motivation: 现有针对HGNN的攻击通常假设可获取模型梯度、软预测分数或完整图结构，这在实际黑盒场景中不现实。本文旨在探索更严格约束（硬标签、查询有限、结构局部可观测）下的黑盒攻击可行性。
Method: Blackknife框架：(1) 从局部异构邻域构建关系感知替代模型；(2) 将离散边的增加/删除操作松弛为连续软权重，通过投影梯度下降优化；(3) 将优化后的扰动离散化为保留关系类型的结构重连操作，并用少量硬标签查询验证有效性。
Result: 在ACM、DBLP、IMDB三个异构图上，Blackknife对多种HGNN模型取得高攻击成功率，且能在拓扑防御下保持有效，揭示了HGNN对局部结构受限黑盒攻击的脆弱性。
Conclusion: HGNN在严格黑盒设置（仅硬标签、有限查询、局部结构）下仍易受攻击，现有防御不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Policy Gradient Foundations of Group Relative Policy Optimization: Credit Assignment, Gradient Sparsity, and Rank Collapse
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) eliminates the learned critic in PPO by using the mean reward of grouped rollouts as a baseline. We provide a rigorous derivation of GRPO from first principles of the policy gradient theorem, revealing a fundamental credit assignment failure: under output-only reward, every token in a rollout receives identical advantage, collapsing token-level credit to a single scalar. We prove this induces gradient sparsity that intensifies over training, and demonstrate empirically via SVD analysis of GRPO gradients on Nemotron-4B/GSM8K that the gradient matrix has effective rank $\approx$ 2 regardless of group size $R \in \{2, 4, 8\}$. We formalize this as an intrinsic rank-2 structure arising from the zero-sum constraint on advantages and derive conditions under which GRPO's baseline is optimal. Our results characterize when GRPO's simplicity is theoretically justified and identify the credit assignment bottleneck as the key limitation for multi-step reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从策略梯度定理出发，严格推导了分组相对策略优化（GRPO），揭示了其在信用分配上的根本缺陷：在仅输出奖励下，每个token获得相同的优势，导致token级信用坍缩为单标量。实验证明梯度矩阵有效秩约为2，且不随组大小变化，并形式化了秩-2结构源于优势的零和约束。
Motivation: GRPO通过分组滚动的平均奖励替代PPO中的学习批评家，但其理论基础和局限性尚未被严格分析。
Method: 基于策略梯度定理对GRPO进行严格推导，证明其信用分配失败和梯度稀疏性，并通过SVD分析Nemotron-4B/GSM8K上的梯度矩阵。
Result: GRPO的梯度矩阵有效秩约为2，与组大小R∈{2,4,8}无关；优势的零和约束导致内在的秩-2结构。
Conclusion: GRPO的简洁性在理论上被部分证明，但信用分配瓶颈是其多步推理的关键局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MoPe: Motion Permanence for Robust Monocular Gaussian Mapping in Dynamic Environments
papers.abstract_en: Robust robot autonomy depends on scene representations that remain stable enough to support localization, navigation, and downstream decision making in dynamic environments. Monocular Gaussian Splatting SLAM provides high-fidelity mapping, but current uncertainty-aware methods still treat dynamic regions largely as per-frame observations. This makes the representation effectively memoryless: when a pedestrian slows, pauses, or reappears after occlusion, the current frame may look static, allowing dynamic content to be absorbed into the map and leaving persistent ghosting artifacts. We argue that this failure reflects a representation-level mismatch. Dynamic-ness is not an instantaneous appearance property, but a temporal property defined by motion history. Building on this view, we introduce Motion Permanence: the principle that an object's dynamic identity should persist over time rather than be re-decided from each frame independently. We realize this principle in MoPe, a memory-aware uncertainty filter for monocular Gaussian mapping. MoPe propagates the historical dynamic posterior through geometry-consistent SE(3) warping and fuses it with current-frame evidence using bounded Bayesian log-odds updates. The resulting persistent posterior guides tracking, mapping, dynamic-aware Gaussian insertion, and Gaussian-level post-cleanup. On Wild-SLAM, Bonn, and TUM sequences, MoPe improves tracking robustness and reduces residual ghosting, with the strongest gains on dynamic-human scenes that most directly violate the memoryless assumption. These results show that maintaining temporal dynamic state inside the scene representation is a practical step toward more reliable representation-centric autonomy in changing real-world environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态环境中单目高斯泼溅SLAM地图中的鬼影问题，提出运动持续性（Motion Permanence）原理，并实现为MoPe记忆感知不确定性滤波器。该方法通过几何一致的SE(3)变换传播历史动态后验，与当前帧证据融合形成持续性后验，指导跟踪、建图和动态感知清理。在Wild-SLAM、Bonn和TUM数据集上，MoPe提升了跟踪鲁棒性并减少了鬼影，尤其在动态人体场景中效果显著。
Motivation: 现有不确定性感知方法将动态区域视为每帧独立观测，导致动态物体在减速、暂停或遮挡后重新出现时被吸收为静态地图，产生持续性鬼影。论文指出这是表示级别的失配：动态性不是瞬时外观属性，而是由运动历史定义的时间属性。
Method: 提出MoPe，一种记忆感知不确定性滤波器：通过几何一致的SE(3)变换传播历史动态后验，并使用有界贝叶斯对数几率更新与当前帧证据融合，得到持续性动态后验，用于跟踪、建图、动态感知高斯插入和后清理。
Result: 在Wild-SLAM、Bonn和TUM序列上，MoPe提升了跟踪鲁棒性并减少了残余鬼影，最显著的改进发生在直接违反无记忆假设的动态人体场景。
Conclusion: 在场景表示内维护时间动态状态是实现更可靠的表示中心化自主性的实际一步，适用于现实动态环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Synthetic CT Transfer? A Label-Free Donor/Host Diagnostic for Medical Vision-Language Model Routing on Real Lung CT
papers.abstract_en: A synthetic measurement of model competence is useful only if it survives the move to real data, yet the real labels that would verify it are exactly what medical imaging lacks. We ask whether transfer can be predicted in advance, label-free, and answer with a mechanism: on synthetic digital twins, competence that is donor-driven (a property of the transplanted nodule) survives the synthetic to real change of host, while host-driven competence (a property of the surrounding anatomy) need not. We test this on three lung CT vision-language tasks chosen to span that axis, across five public VLMs, four guidance conditions, and seven real datasets. The prediction holds in every case: presence and size orderings transfer (R2 >= 0.96), lobe does not; the split survives leave-source-out calibration, and the diagnostic names that boundary before any real label. TrialCouncil, a training-free council calibrated only on synthetic CT, confirms it by matching the best fixed model exactly where transfer is predicted. The contribution is not the router but the finding that transfer itself is predictable, label-free, from synthetic data alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究合成CT在真实肺CT上的迁移能力，提出一种无标签的供体/宿主诊断方法，用于预测视觉-语言模型（VLM）在真实数据上的路由效果。实验表明，供体驱动的能力（如结节存在和大小排序）可以迁移（R2>=0.96），而宿主驱动的能力（如肺叶定位）不能。
Motivation: 在医学影像中，真实标签稀缺，合成数据评估模型能力后迁移到真实数据的效果难以预测，本文旨在提前、无标签地预测迁移是否成功。
Method: 提出一个基于合成数字孪生的诊断机制：区分供体驱动（结节属性）和宿主驱动（解剖背景）的能力，并通过TrialCouncil（仅基于合成CT校准的无训练委员会）验证迁移边界。
Result: 在三个肺CT视觉-语言任务、五个VLM、四种引导条件和七个真实数据集上，供体驱动的任务（结节存在和大小排序）迁移R2>=0.96，宿主驱动的任务（肺叶定位）不迁移，且该边界可通过留出源校准验证。
Conclusion: 贡献不在于路由本身，而在于从合成数据中无标签地预测迁移能力，且边界被TrialCouncil精确验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Again-Pose: Anchor-Guided Adaptive Inter-Frame Motion Cues Propagating for High-quality Human Pose Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing continuous 3D human poses from unconstrained videos is challenging, especially in extreme motion scenarios involving severe motion blur and occlusion. Current state-of-the-art methods typically rely on implicit temporal attention to aggregate features across frames. However, under severe visual degradation, input features often suffer from collapse, rendering them indistinguishable from noise. In such cases, implicit aggregation fails to distinguish valid signals, leading to catastrophic reconstruction errors. To address this robustness gap, we propose a simple yet effective framework called Anchor-guided adaptive inter-frame motion cues propagating (Again-Pose), reformulating pose estimation in degraded frames as a motion-guided recovery task. Instead of blindly smoothing features, we explicitly identify high-quality Anchor Frames based on feature saliency and propagate reliable kinematic cues to "inpaint" the poses of degraded intermediate frames. Specifically, a Dual-path Motion-aware Module captures fine-grained inter-frame dynamics, while a Difference-weighted Fusion Module adaptively propagates these cues to suppress drift. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks (Human3.6M, 3DPW, PoseTrack) and the challenging FineDiving dataset demonstrate that Again-Pose significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in robustness and stability, effectively recovering plausible poses where other methods fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Again-Pose 提出了一种锚点引导的自适应帧间运动传播框架，用于从退化视频中重建高质量3D人体姿态。该方法通过显式识别高质量锚帧并传播运动线索来修复退化帧的姿态，显著提升了在极端运动模糊和遮挡场景下的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖隐式时序注意力聚合帧特征，但在严重视觉退化下输入特征塌陷，导致重建失败。
Method: 提出锚点引导的自适应帧间运动传播框架，包括双路径运动感知模块（捕捉细粒度帧间动态）和差异加权融合模块（自适应传播抑制漂移）。
Result: 在Human3.6M、3DPW、PoseTrack和FineDiving数据集上，该方法在鲁棒性和稳定性上显著优于现有技术，能恢复其他方法失败的合理姿态。

papers.title: Understanding Evaluation Illusion in Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the capability of parallel decoding, diffusion large language models (dLLMs) require many denoising steps to maintain generation quality, motivating recent research on efficient decoding strategies. However, existing studies have reported inconsistent evaluation results even under seemingly identical evaluation settings, risking biased conclusions about dLLM decoding methods. To understand this evaluation concern, we conduct a rigorous evaluation of current decoding methods for dLLMs across diverse evaluation settings. Surprisingly, our analysis reveals that the ranking of decoding methods is highly sensitive to the choice of prompt templates. Single-template evaluation can lead to an illusion that decoding methods improve inference efficiency without performance degradation. Through comprehensive experiments, we find that current parallel decoding methods consistently underperform the single-token decoding baseline, failing to overcome the speed-quality trade-off. We further identify this evaluation inconsistency as the high sensitivity of parallel decoding methods to minor variations in prompt templates. Our experiments show that an effective prompt template can achieve strong evaluation results even with fewer denoising steps, markedly outperforming the marginal gain from increasing denoising steps. Beyond prompt templates, our experiments indicate that overlooked evaluation settings can also notably affect the assessment of decoding methods. Based on these findings, we propose practical guidelines for the reliable evaluation of decoding methods in dLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的解码方法，发现评价结果对提示模板（prompt template）高度敏感，单模板评估可能产生“评价幻觉”，即误认为解码方法在无性能损失下提升了推理效率。实验表明，当前并行解码方法始终不如单token解码基线，无法突破速度-质量权衡；有效的提示模板即使减少去噪步数也能取得强结果。研究还指出其他被忽视的评价设置同样影响评估。最后提出了可靠评价dLLM解码方法的实用指南。
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型需要多步去噪维持生成质量，现有研究在看似相同的评价设置下报告了不一致的结果，可能导致对解码方法的偏颇结论。
Method: 通过多样化评价设置进行严格实验，分析解码方法排名对提示模板等评价因素的敏感性，并对比并行解码方法与单token解码基线的速度-质量权衡。
Result: 并行解码方法始终不如单token解码基线，且排名高度依赖提示模板；有效提示模板可用更少去噪步数显著提升结果，超越增加去噪步数的边际收益。
Conclusion: 单模板评价会导致幻觉，可靠评估需要关注提示模板等评价设置的影响。作者提出实用指南以避免评价偏差。
