papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with a Bilevel World-Model Architecture for Scan-Order Optimisation in Laser Directed Energy Deposition
papers.abstract_en: Scan-order design in laser directed energy deposition (LDED) is a delayed, path-dependent thermo-mechanical decision problem, because sequence quality becomes observable only after the complete deposition and cooling cycle. This work formulates LDED scan-order optimisation as a finite-horizon, permutation-constrained reinforcement-learning problem and develops a bilevel finite-element-teacher-labelled AI workflow. A surrogate-assisted teacher-guided optimisation loop learns the Abaqus-labelled response landscape and provides a tractable terminal-reward environment for policy training. A frozen Maskable Proximal Policy Optimization (MaskablePPO) policy is then used to generate legal scan-order candidates, which are independently validated through Abaqus thermo-mechanical simulations. The results show bounded, N-dependent policy-generation value rather than record-level dominance over the mature surrogate-assisted optimiser. The strongest scan orders are obtained by the teacher-guided surrogate loop, whereas PPO autonomously reaches competitive regions of the native response landscape, with stronger rank concentration at smaller track counts and a clear reliability boundary at longer horizons. The teacher-labelled landscape further supports a physically gated lexicographic reward hierarchy in which warpage admissibility is the primary constraint, plastic strain acts as a safety filter and residual-stress-related improvement is pursued conditionally within the admissible region. Validated sequences also reveal an interpretable scale-separated ordering tendency that combines global spatial dispersion with local structured grouping. This workflow provides a route from fixed scan-rule selection toward finite-element-teacher-validated policy generation, while preserving independent finite-element validation as the final physical gate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对激光定向能沉积（LDED）中的扫描顺序优化问题，将其建模为有限时域、排列约束的强化学习问题，并开发了一个双层有限元教师标注的AI工作流。该方法利用代理辅助的教师引导优化循环学习Abaqus标注的响应景观，并为策略训练提供可处理的终端奖励环境。实验表明，策略生成的值是有界且依赖于轨迹数量的，最强扫描顺序由教师引导的代理循环获得，而PPO策略能自主达到响应景观中的竞争区域。工作流为从固定扫描规则选择向有限元教师验证的策略生成提供了路径。
Motivation: LDED中的扫描顺序设计是一个延迟的、路径相关的热力学决策问题，序列质量只有在整个沉积和冷却循环完成后才能观察到，传统方法难以优化。
Method: 提出双层有限元教师标注AI工作流：使用Abaqus仿真进行教师标注，构建代理辅助的响应景观；采用Maskable Proximal Policy Optimization (MaskablePPO) 生成合法扫描顺序候选，并通过Abaqus独立验证。
Result: 策略生成值有界且与轨迹数相关；教师引导的代理循环获得最强扫描顺序，PPO自主达到竞争区域，在小轨迹数下排名集中，长时域下有清晰可靠性边界；验证序列显示尺度分离的排序倾向，结合全局空间分散与局部结构化分组。
Conclusion: 该工作流结合有限元教师标注和强化学习，为LDED扫描顺序优化提供了可扩展的框架，并保留了独立有限元验证作为最终物理门控。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trust in Generative AI for Health Information Consumption and the Effect of Learned Dependency: An Experimental Investigation
papers.abstract_en: Background: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used for health information, yet its influence on users' trust calibration remains unclear. Objective: This study examines whether learned dependency on GenAI influences trust in AI-generated health information and whether text highlighting reduces overreliance on incorrect outputs. Methods: Two randomized controlled experiments were conducted with 338 college students and 563 Amazon Mechanical Turk participants. Both experiments used a 2 by 2 between-subjects design manipulating information accuracy (correct versus incorrect) and text highlighting (highlight versus no highlight). Trust and learned dependency were measured using validated scales, and linear regression models tested main and interaction effects. Results: In both experiments, information accuracy significantly increased trust (p < 0.001), while learned dependency was positively associated with trust (p < 0.05). The interaction between accuracy and dependency was significant (p < 0.001), indicating that highly dependent users were more likely to trust incorrect AI-generated information. Text highlighting had no significant effect on trust and did not moderate the relationship between dependency and trust. Conclusions: Learned dependency weakens trust calibration, increasing susceptibility to inaccurate AI-generated health information. Text highlighting alone is insufficient to reduce overreliance, highlighting the need for more effective interface designs that encourage critical evaluation of GenAI outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过两个随机对照实验（共901名参与者）研究用户对生成式AI健康信息的信任机制。实验发现信息准确性显著影响信任，而学习依赖（learned dependency）与信任正相关，且高依赖用户更易信任错误信息。文本高亮（text highlighting）未能有效减少过度依赖。
Motivation: 生成式AI在健康信息中广泛应用，但用户信任校准（trust calibration）机制不明确，尤其是学习依赖对信任的影响及界面干预措施的有效性未知。
Method: 两个2×2被试间随机对照实验，操作信息准确性（正确vs错误）和文本高亮（有vs无），使用验证量表测量信任和学习依赖，线性回归分析主效应和交互效应。
Result: 信息准确性显著增加信任（p<0.001），学习依赖与信任正相关（p<0.05），且两者的交互效应显著（p<0.001），表明高依赖用户更易信任错误信息。文本高亮无显著效应。
Conclusion: 学习依赖削弱信任校准，增加对错误AI健康信息的易感性；仅文本高亮不足以减少过度依赖，需要更有效的界面设计鼓励批判性评估。

summary_sections.motivation: 生成式AI在健康信息中广泛应用，但用户信任校准（trust calibration）机制不明确，尤其是学习依赖对信任的影响及界面干预措施的有效性未知。
summary_sections.method: 两个2×2被试间随机对照实验，操作信息准确性（正确vs错误）和文本高亮（有vs无），使用验证量表测量信任和学习依赖，线性回归分析主效应和交互效应。
summary_sections.result: 信息准确性显著增加信任（p<0.001），学习依赖与信任正相关（p<0.05），且两者的交互效应显著（p<0.001），表明高依赖用户更易信任错误信息。文本高亮无显著效应。
summary_sections.conclusion: 学习依赖削弱信任校准，增加对错误AI健康信息的易感性；仅文本高亮不足以减少过度依赖，需要更有效的界面设计鼓励批判性评估。

papers.title: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning under Imperfect Information in Big 2
papers.abstract_en: Imperfect-information multiplayer games test whether agents can act under hidden information, sparse rewards, and non-stationary opponents. We study these challenges in Big 2, a four-player imperfect-information card game. We develop a self-play RL framework for Big 2 that enables controlled comparisons between policy-gradient and value-approximating agents. Under a common environment, input representation, training budget, and evaluation protocol, PPO outperforms Monte Carlo Q approximation, SARSA, and Q-learning against random, greedy, and heuristic Big 2 opponents. We further find that moderate entropy regularization improves PPO by preventing the policy from becoming overly deterministic, and that current-policy self-play provides a stronger finite-budget curriculum than checkpoint self-play or fixed-opponent training. Together, these results show that Big 2 is a useful controlled setting for studying deep RL under imperfect information, multiplayer interaction, delayed rewards, and variable action sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在不完美信息多人纸牌游戏Big 2中构建自我对弈强化学习框架，系统比较了PPO、蒙特卡洛Q逼近、SARSA和Q-learning。实验表明PPO在随机、贪婪和启发式对手下均优于其他算法，适度熵正则化能防止策略过确定性，当前策略自我对弈相比检查点自我对弈或固定对手训练提供更强的有限预算课程。Big 2可作为一个受控环境研究不完美信息、多人交互、延迟奖励和可变动作集下的深度强化学习。
Motivation: 不完美信息多人游戏中的智能体需处理隐藏信息、稀疏奖励和非平稳对手，但缺乏系统比较不同RL算法在受控环境中的表现。Big 2作为一个四人不完美信息卡牌游戏，提供了研究这些挑战的合适平台。
Method: 开发统一的Big 2自我对弈RL框架，使用相同环境、输入表示、训练预算和评估协议，比较策略梯度（PPO）和值近似方法（蒙特卡洛Q逼近、SARSA、Q-learning），并研究熵正则化强度及不同训练对手（自对弈当前策略、检查点策略、固定对手）的影响。
Result: PPO在所有对手类型（随机、贪婪、启发式）上均优于其他算法；适度的熵正则化通过避免策略过于确定提升了PPO性能；当前策略自我对弈在有限训练预算下比检查点自我对弈或固定对手训练带来更优的课程效果。
Conclusion: Big 2可作为一个有用的受控测试平台，用于研究不完美信息、多人交互、延迟奖励和可变动作集下的深度强化学习算法，并验证了PPO结合熵正则化与当前策略自我对弈的有效性。

papers.title: FBOS-RL: Feedback-Driven Bi-Objective Synergistic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become a cornerstone for aligning and unlocking the reasoning capabilities of large-scale models. At its core, the training loop of GRPO and its variants alternates between rollout sampling and policy update: the policy first samples rollouts from its action space, and then updates its parameters according to the advantages computed over them. Unlike supervised learning, where each gradient step is anchored to an explicit ground-truth target, the optimal gradient direction for updating model parameters in this setting is not known a priori; the high-quality rollouts drawn during the sampling stage therefore act as the implicit "teacher" that guides every parameter update. However, mainstream RL algorithms such as GRPO adopt a simple sampling scheme that conditions all rollouts on the same original prompt. When a task lies beyond the policy model's current capability, this sampling scheme rarely yields a high-quality rollout, leaving the policy model without a meaningful gradient direction when updating its parameters, which causes training to stall. To address this issue, we propose FBOS-RL. Specifically, we let the model perform Feedback-Guided Exploration Enhancement based on the feedback provided by the environment, and on top of this we design two mutually reinforcing training objectives: EPA and ECC. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EPA and ECC can mutually reinforce each other, forming a positive flywheel effect that significantly improves both the training efficiency and the final performance ceiling of reinforcement learning. Specifically, under both an identical number of rollouts and the same number of training steps, FBOS-RL learns substantially faster than GRPO and feedback-based baselines and ultimately attains a higher performance ceiling, while exhibiting higher policy entropy and lower gradient norms throughout training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FBOS-RL，一种反馈驱动的双目标协同强化学习框架，旨在解决GRPO等算法在高难度任务中因采样质量不足导致的训练停滞问题。方法包括反馈引导的探索增强（Feedback-Guided Exploration Enhancement）以及两种相互促进的训练目标EPA和ECC。实验表明，在相同 rollout 数量和训练步数下，FBOS-RL 比 GRPO 和基于反馈的基线学习更快、最终性能上限更高，且训练中策略熵更高、梯度范数更低。
Motivation: 现有强化学习算法（如GRPO）在策略模型能力不足的任务中，简单采样很少产生高质量 rollout，导致模型更新时缺乏有意义的梯度方向，造成训练停滞。
Method: 提出FBOS-RL，包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于环境反馈的反馈引导探索增强 (Feedback-Guided Exploration Enhancement)；(2) 两个相互增强的训练目标 EPA 和 ECC，形成正反馈飞轮效应。
Result: 在相同 rollout 数量和训练步数下，FBOS-RL 比 GRPO 及基于反馈的基线学习速度更快，最终性能上限更高，且训练中策略熵更高、梯度范数更低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 EPA 和 ECC 目标可以相互增强，显著提升强化学习的训练效率和最终性能天花板。

papers.title: Towards Human-Level Book-Writing Capability
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are optimized for instruction following and agentic tasks remain poorly aligned with the requirements of high-quality creative writing. We show that a purpose-built creative writing model can outperform both GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8 on writing quality evaluation. Fiction frequently depends on behaviors that assistant-tuned models are explicitly trained to avoid, particularly deception, moral ambiguity, and unreliable narration. As a result, generated stories often appear structurally correct while remaining stylistically generic, overly explanatory, or weakly grounded in human literary behavior. We present a dataset construction and training framework for book-scale creative writing that reframes supervised fine-tuning as a prompt-to-book generation task grounded in human-authored fiction. Starting from public-domain novels, we derive a multi-resolution Planning Scaffold by summarizing each book at progressively finer levels, from a high-level premise to chapter- and scene-level structure. We then invert this hierarchy during training: the model learns to expand a prompt into increasingly detailed plans and finally into the original human-authored book text. This formulation preserves human prose as the final supervised target while using intermediate summaries to make book-scale generation learnable. We train a long-context language model on these prompt-to-book trajectories and show that this objective shifts generation away from assistant-style prose and toward human literary writing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型在创意写作中的不足，提出一个专为书籍规模写作设计的训练框架。通过从公共领域小说构建多分辨率规划脚手架，并反向训练模型从提示逐步生成书籍文本，该方法使得长上下文模型学会生成类人文学写作而非助手风格文本。实验表明，该模型在写作质量评估上超越了GPT-5.5和Claude Opus 4.8。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型优化于指令跟随和智能体任务，但产出高质量创意写作时往往风格平庸、过度解释或缺乏文学性，因为小说所需行为（如欺骗、道德模糊）与助手模型的训练目标相悖。
Method: 提出数据集构建和训练框架：从公共领域小说出发，通过多分辨率规划脚手架逐层总结（从全局前提到章/节结构），然后在训练中逆向展开，让模型学习从简短提示逐步扩展为完整书籍文本，保留人类原著作为监督目标。
Result: 摘要报告在写作质量评估上，该定制模型超越GPT-5.5和Claude Opus 4.8，且生成文本从助手风格转向人类文学写作。
Conclusion: 通过将监督微调重构为提示到书籍生成任务，并利用书籍的层次结构，可以使大语言模型掌握书籍规模的创造性写作，生成更贴近人类文学风格的文本。

papers.title: CADS: Conformal Adaptive Decision System for Cost-Efficient Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: While high-capacity AI models have advanced state-of-the-art performance, their practical deployment is often hindered by high inference costs, environmental impact, and a "one-size-fits-all" approach that ignores varying sample complexity. In clinical settings for instance, the waste of computational resources on routine cases is a significant barrier to sustainable AI. In this paper, we introduce the Conformal Adaptive Decision System (CADS), a sequential multi-model algorithm designed to optimize resource allocation by efficiently sampling models based on the estimated data complexity. CADS leverages conformal prediction to quantify image uncertainty at runtime. CADS provides a mathematically grounded framework for balancing the cost-accuracy dilemma that dynamically routes samples through a model cascade, ranging from lightweight "Scout" models to high-capacity "Oracle" architectures. Validated on two datasets, CADS demonstrated superior efficiency and accuracy at a computational cost that can be up to 12 times lower than heavy-model inference. By accurately routing samples based on real-time complexity, CADS ensures high diagnostic reliability while drastically reducing the economic and environmental footprint of AI.

papers.title: Objective-Specific Privileged Bases via Full-Prefix Matryoshka Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learned representations are often invariant to rotational transformations, leaving individual dimensions non-identifiable and interchangeable. We study how Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) induces a task-aligned privileged basis distinct from variance-based or regularizer-induced orderings. In the linear setting, we prove that full-prefix MRL recovers the ordered principal directions, and can be computed efficiently using shared statistics. Empirically, we demonstrate that MRL yields consistent per-dimension structure aligned with task signal, where coordinate magnitude reflects informativeness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Matryoshka表示学习（MRL）如何产生与任务对齐的特权基，证明在线性情况下全前缀MRL可以恢复有序主方向，并能通过共享统计量高效计算。实验表明MRL的逐维坐标大小与任务信号信息量正相关。
Motivation: 学习表示通常对旋转变换不变，导致单个维度不可识别且可互换，需要一种能产生任务对齐的有序基的方法。
Method: 提出全前缀Matryoshka表示学习（full-prefix MRL），在线性设置下证明其能恢复有序主方向，并利用共享统计量实现高效计算。
Result: 理论证明全前缀MRL恢复有序主方向；实验显示MRL产生与任务信号对齐的逐维结构，坐标大小反映信息量。
Conclusion: MRL能够诱导与任务相关的特权基，坐标大小可作为维度的信息量指标。

papers.title: BioProVLA-Agent: An Affordable, Protocol-Driven, Vision-Enhanced VLA-Enabled Embodied Multi-Agent System with Closed-Loop-Capable Reasoning for Biological Laboratory Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Biological laboratory automation can reduce repetitive manual work and improve reproducibility, but reliable embodied execution in wet-lab environments remains challenging. Protocols are often unstructured, labware is frequently transparent or reflective, and multi-step procedures require state-aware execution beyond one-shot instruction following. Existing robotic systems often rely on costly hardware, fixed workflows, dedicated instruments, or robotics-oriented interfaces. Here, we introduce BioProVLA-Agent, an affordable, protocol-driven, vision-enhanced embodied multi-agent system enabled by Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for biological manipulation. The system uses protocols as the task interface and integrates protocol parsing, visual state verification, and embodied execution in a closed-loop workflow. A Tailored LLM Protocol Agent converts protocols into verifiable subtasks; a VLM-RAG Verification Agent assesses readiness and completion using observations, robot states, retrieved knowledge, and success/failure examples; and a VLA Embodied Agent executes verified subtasks through a lightweight policy. To improve robustness under wet-lab visual perturbations, we develop AugSmolVLA, an online augmentation strategy targeting transparent labware, reflections, illumination shifts, and overexposure. We evaluate the system on a hierarchical benchmark covering 15 atomic tasks, 6 composite workflows, and 3 bimanual tasks, including tube loading, sorting, waste disposal, cap twisting, and liquid pouring. Across normal and high-exposure settings, AugSmolVLA improves execution stability over ACT, X-VLA, and the original SmolVLA, especially for precise placement, transparent-object manipulation, composite workflows, and visually degraded scenes. These results suggest a practical route toward accessible, protocol-centered, and verification-capable embodied AI for biological manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BioProVLA-Agent，一个基于视觉-语言-动作模型的可负担、协议驱动的具身多智能体系统，用于生物实验室操作。系统将实验协议作为任务接口，集成协议解析、视觉状态验证和闭环执行，由三个智能体协作完成：Tailored LLM Protocol Agent将协议转换为可验证子任务；VLM-RAG Verification Agent通过观察、机器人状态、检索知识和成功/失败示例评估准备和完成情况；VLA Embodied Agent通过轻量策略执行已验证的子任务。针对湿实验室视觉扰动，开发了在线增强策略AugSmolVLA。在15个原子任务、6个复合工作流和3个双手任务的层次化基准上评估，AugSmolVLA在正常和高曝光设置下提升了执行稳定性。
Motivation: 生物实验室自动化可减少重复人工操作并提高可重复性，但湿实验室中可靠的具身执行仍具挑战：协议常为非结构化，实验器具透明或反光，多步骤程序需状态感知执行。现有机器人系统多依赖昂贵硬件、固定工作流或专用仪器，缺乏协议中心和验证能力的方案。
Method: 提出BioProVLA-Agent系统，包含三个智能体：协议解析LLM、视觉语言模型RAG验证器、轻量VLA执行策略。开发AugSmolVLA在线增强策略，针对透明器具、反射、光照变化和过曝进行训练时数据增强。
Result: 在15个原子任务、6个复合工作流和3个双手任务上（含试管装载、分拣、弃置、旋盖、液体倾倒），AugSmolVLA在正常和高曝光条件下优于ACT、X-VLA和原始SmolVLA，尤其在精确放置、透明物体操作、复合工作流和视觉退化场景中。
Conclusion: 该工作为可及、协议中心且具验证能力的生物操纵具身AI提供了实用路线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tumor-aware augmentation with task-guided attention analysis improves rectal cancer segmentation from magnetic resonance images
papers.abstract_en: Although self-supervised pretraining is expected to learn broadly transferable representations, its effectiveness across imaging modalities substantially different from the pretraining domain, and on complex tumor-segmentation tasks, remains understudied. Evaluating CT-pretrained transformers on MRI rectal cancer segmentation, we identified two interacting failure modes in CT-to-MRI transfer: (a) inefficient token usage caused by zero-padding to match pretrained input dimensions, and (b) ineffective feature adaptation. We investigated these vulnerabilities using two primary CT-pretrained hierarchical shifted-window transformer backbones, SMIT and Swin UNETR, together with VoCo as a large-scale-pretrained supporting benchmark; these models differ in pretraining objectives and datasets. Mechanistic analysis leveraged an attention dilution index (ADI), an entropy-based metric quantifying attention diverted toward uninformative padding tokens, and centered kernel alignment (CKA) to measure feature reuse during MRI adaptation. ADI increased with zero-padding, while high feature reuse did not necessarily translate to improved downstream accuracy. To mitigate these issues, we introduced two interventions: a tumor-aware augmentation strategy to expand tumor appearance heterogeneity coverage, and an anisotropic cropping strategy to restore token efficiency. Fine-tuning with these strategies on identical rectal MRI datasets yielded detection rates of 91.1% (225/247) and 88.7% (219/247) for the primary SMIT and Swin UNETR backbones, with the supporting VoCo benchmark reaching 90.3% (223/247), demonstrating significantly improved robustness under CT-to-MRI transfer. This study is among the first to examine when pretrained transformers fail to transfer across imaging modalities and demonstrates how targeted mitigation strategies can systematically overcome cross-modality transfer limitations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了CT预训练transformer在MRI直肠癌分割任务中的跨模态迁移问题，发现零填充导致注意力稀释和特征适配不足两个失败模式。提出了肿瘤感知增强和异向裁剪策略，在直肠MRI数据集上实现了91.1%的检测率，显著提升了跨模态迁移的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 自监督预训练在跨模态（CT到MRI）肿瘤分割任务中的迁移效果尚不明确，存在零填充导致的无效token使用和特征适配不足的问题。
Method: 提出肿瘤感知增强（tumor-aware augmentation）扩大肿瘤外观多样性，以及异向裁剪（anisotropic cropping）恢复token效率，以缓解CT预训练transformer在MRI上的迁移失败。
Result: 在直肠MRI数据集上，SMIT和Swin UNETR骨干网络检测率分别达91.1%和88.7%，VoCo基准达90.3%。
Conclusion: 首次系统研究了预训练transformer在跨模态迁移中的失败模式，并证明针对性缓解策略可克服跨模态限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Spectral Structure and Objective Equivalence of Orthogonal Multilabel Fisher Discriminants
papers.abstract_en: We provide a unified theoretical analysis of Linear Discriminant Analysis with simultaneous multilabel scatter matrix formulations and Stiefel orthogonality constraints. Our contributions span both algebraic structure and statistical guarantees. On the algebraic side, we characterize the rank of the multilabel between-class scatter matrix, showing that the effective discriminant dimensionality can strictly exceed the classical single-label bound of $C-1$; we establish a multilabel partition of variance and prove that all four Fisher objectives are equivalent under the $W^\top S_t^{ML} W = I_r$ constraint while characterizing their divergence under the Stiefel constraint; and we prove a two-sided label-distance preservation bound relating projected distances to Hamming distances in label space. On the statistical side, we establish a finite-sample $O(k_{\max}\sqrt{d\log d/n}/gap_r)$ bound on the subspace estimation error under sub-Gaussian noise with a matching $Ω(σ^2 d/(n\,gap_r))$ minimax lower bound, establishing a near-minimax-optimal rate (matching up to logarithmic and $k_{\max}$ factors) for multilabel discriminant subspace estimation. We further provide high-probability distance concentration, robustness guarantees under label interactions, and a regularization analysis preserving the spectral structure when $d \gg n$. All results are verified numerically on synthetic data generated from the linear label-effect model, covering both the algebraic identities and the multilabel-specific quantities ($k_{\max}$, $κ(S_t^{ML})$, $\|Γ/n\|_2$, $Δ_r$) that govern the statistical bounds. The numerical experiments are designed as a sanity check for the theorems rather than as an empirical benchmark; evaluation on real multilabel datasets is left to future work targeting application-oriented venues.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对具有Stiefel正交约束的多标签线性判别分析（Multilabel Fisher Discriminants）进行了统一的理论分析，包括代数结构和统计保证。代数方面，刻画了多标签类间散布矩阵的秩，证明有效判别维度可超过经典单标签界限C-1，建立了方差分解，证明了四种Fisher目标在特定约束下的等价性，以及投影距离与标签空间汉明距离的双边保持界。统计方面，建立了子空间估计误差的有限样本上界（含子高斯噪声）和匹配的极小化下界，接近最优速率，并提供了高概率距离集中、标签相互作用下的鲁棒性以及正则化分析。数值实验在合成数据上验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 现有线性判别分析（LDA）理论主要针对单标签分类，缺乏对多标签场景下光谱结构和统计性能的深入刻画。本文旨在填补多标签Fisher判别子的代数与统计理论空白。
Method: 采用理论推导与证明的方法，分析多标签散布矩阵的秩、方差分解、Fisher目标等价性以及投影距离保持性质；在统计方面，建立子空间估计误差的非渐近界和极小化下界，并给出鲁棒性和正则化分析。
Result: 主要结果为代数定理（如秩特性、目标等价性、距离保持界）和统计界（子空间估计误差的 O(k_max√(d log d / n)/gap_r) 上界与匹配的 Ω(σ² d/(n gap_r)) 下界），所有理论均在合成数据上通过数值验证。
Conclusion: 本文为多标签线性判别分析提供了统一的理论框架，证明其有效判别维度可超越单标签限制，并建立了接近最优的统计估计率。但实验仅限于合成数据，真实多标签数据集上的验证留待未来应用导向的工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distributional Causal Mediation via Conditional Generative Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Mediation analysis has traditionally focused on outcome-level summary contrasts, such as mean effects, which may obscure substantial distributional changes induced by complex and nonlinear causal mechanisms. We propose Distributional Causal Mediation Analysis (DCMA), a generative learning framework for identifying and estimating treatment effects on entire outcome distributions transmitted through multiple mediators. DCMA learns conditional generative models for the mediators and the outcome, recovering the relevant conditional distributions from observational data. Leveraging the identification formulas, it reconstructs interventional outcome distributions via Monte Carlo forward simulation by noise resampling, enabling the capture of both classical summary effects and rich distributional contrasts such as energy distance and the Wasserstein distance. Analytical error bounds are derived to decompose how estimation errors in the learned conditional models propagate to the reconstructed interventional outcome distributions. The empirical effectiveness of DCMA is demonstrated through numerical experiments and real-world data applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分布因果中介分析（DCMA），一个基于条件生成模型的框架，用于识别和估计通过多个中介变量传递的治疗效应在整体结果分布上的影响。该方法通过噪声重采样进行蒙特卡洛前向模拟，重建干预结果分布，从而捕捉经典总结效应和丰富的分布对比（如能量距离和Wasserstein距离），并推导了误差传播的分析边界。
Motivation: 传统中介分析集中于结果层面的总结对比（如均值效应），可能忽视复杂非线性因果机制引起的实质性分布变化。
Method: DCMA学习中介变量和结果的条件生成模型，从观测数据中恢复相关条件分布；利用识别公式，通过噪声重采样的蒙特卡洛前向模拟重建干预结果分布。
Result: 通过数值实验和真实数据应用验证了DCMA的经验有效性，能够捕捉分布对比（如能量距离和Wasserstein距离）。
Conclusion: DCMA为中介分析提供了分布层面的视角，能够揭示传统均值方法无法捕获的分布变化，但依赖于条件生成模型的准确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: To Use AI as Dice of Possibilities with Timing Computation
papers.abstract_en: The dominant noun-based modeling paradigm, grounded in probability theory and committed to pre-specified noun entities as primitive modeling units, is insufficient as a \emph{grammar of thought}: It leaves \emph{timing} outside the computational scope, precluding any adequate representation of the future as an open space of possibilities. This paper addresses three foundational conceptual gaps absent from the existing literature: (1) possibility space -- a framework admitting co-existing possible timelines for the same event; (2) timing computation -- the treatment of timing as a computable rather than observed dimension; and (3) causal factum -- a cause identified post hoc from its effects, rather than assumed in advance. Together, these definitions dissolve the confounding problem inherent to noun-based causal inference and provide the foundation for a spontaneously growing causal-reasoning world model. As proof of concept, we instantiate the framework and apply it to longitudinal EHR data from 3,276 breast cancer patients, demonstrating for the first time, to our knowledge, automatic trajectory discovery and counterfactual timing deduction (i.e., a What-If Machine) in a purely data-driven manner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批判基于名词和概率论的建模范式无法处理时序计算，提出可能性空间、时序计算和因果事实三个新概念，以构建自发增长的因果推理世界模型。在3276名乳腺癌患者的纵向EHR数据上，首次实现了纯数据驱动的自动轨迹发现和反事实时序推断（What-If Machine）。
Motivation: 现有基于名词的建模框架将时序排除在计算范围之外，无法充分表示未来作为开放的可能性空间，且因果推断中混淆变量问题难以解决。
Method: 定义三个概念：可能性空间（同一事件可共存多条时间线）、时序计算（将时序视为可计算维度而非观测维度）、因果事实（事后从效应识别原因）。基于这些定义实例化一个框架，用于因果推理世界模型。
Result: 在3276名乳腺癌患者数据上，首次实现纯数据驱动的自动轨迹发现和反事实时序推断。
Conclusion: 所提出的框架为因果推理提供了新基础，但当前仅验证于乳腺癌数据，通用性尚需进一步检验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DMDSC: A Dynamic-Margin Deep Simplex Classifier for Open-Set Recognition on Medical Image Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Medical imaging datasets are often characterized by extreme class imbalances, where rare pathologies are significantly underrepresented compared to common conditions. This imbalance poses a dual challenge for Open-Set Recognition (OSR): models must maintain high classification accuracy on known classes while reliably rejecting unknown samples unseen during training in the clinical settings. While recently proposed Deep Simplex Classifier (DSC)~\cite{cevikalp2024reaching} and UnCertainty-aware Deep Simplex Classifier (UCDSC)~\cite{Aditya_2026_WACV} successfully leverage Neural Collapse to ensure maximal inter-class separation, they rely on a uniform margin that does not account for the varying densities of medical classes. In this paper, we propose DMDSC an enhanced framework featuring a dynamic margin approach. Our approach automatically adapts class-specific margins based on label frequency, enforcing a higher penalty and tighter feature clustering for rare pathologies to counteract the effects of data imbalance. Extensive experiments conducted on diverse medical benchmarks on BloodMNIST\cite{medmnistv2}, OCTMNIST\cite{medmnistv2}, DermaMNIST\cite{medmnistv2}, and BreaKHis~\cite{spanhol2015dataset} datasets, demonstrate that our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对医学图像开放集识别中类别不平衡的问题，提出DMDSC框架，通过动态调整每个类别的边界（margin）来增强稀有类别的特征聚类。在BloodMNIST、OCTMNIST、DermaMNIST和BreaKHis四个医学数据集上，该方法在已知类分类和未知类拒绝两方面均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有深度单纯形分类器（DSC）虽然利用神经坍缩实现最大类间分离，但采用统一边界，未考虑医学数据中各类别的密度差异，导致稀有病理类别性能下降。
Method: 提出动态边际深度单纯形分类器（DMDSC），根据标签频率自动调整类别特定边界，对稀有类别施加更高惩罚并强迫更紧密的特征聚类。
Result: 在BloodMNIST、OCTMNIST、DermaMNIST和BreaKHis数据集上的实验表明，DMDSC在开放集识别任务中优于包括DSC和UCDSC在内的现有方法。
Conclusion: 动态边际策略能有效缓解医学图像开放集识别中的类别不平衡问题，提升稀有类别的泛化能力和未知样本的拒绝能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Defeasible Conditional Obligation in a Two-tiered Preference-based Semantics (Extended Version)
papers.abstract_en: In response to a concern raised by Horty, this paper develops a two-tiered, preference-based semantic framework for modeling defeasible conditional obligations. The paper extends a Hansson-Lewis style preference semantics for dyadic deontic logic by incorporating a nonmonotonic reasoning mechanism that enables previously derived obligations to be withdrawn when new, potentially conflicting information comes in. The account is bi-preferential: two orderings--ideality and normality--on worlds are employed to address shortcomings in earlier approaches, with a separate ranking method for each. At the nonmonotonic layer, a number of postulates are considered, including antecedent strengthening, inclusion and no-drowning. A connection is established with so-called constrained input/output (I/O) logic--an existing standard for normative reasoning based on a different methodology.
papers.comment: 13 pages. Extended version of a paper presented at KR 2926
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Horty 提出的关注点，发展了一个双层偏好语义框架来建模可废止的条件义务。该框架扩展了 Hansson-Lewis 风格的偏好语义，通过引入非单调推理机制使得先前推导的义务可以在新信息出现时被撤回。框架使用两个排序（理想性和正常性）来克服早期方法的不足，并考虑了前提强化、包含和无淹没等公设，最终与约束输入/输出逻辑建立了联系。
Motivation: Horty 对现有可废止义务建模方法提出了关注，促使作者开发一个双层偏好语义框架以更合理地处理条件义务的撤回问题。
Method: 采用双层偏好语义：分别基于理想性和正常性对可能世界进行排序，每个排序使用不同的方法，并整合非单调推理机制以支持义务的撤回。
Result: 与基于不同方法论的约束输入/输出逻辑建立了理论联系。
Conclusion: 双层偏好语义能够弥补早期偏好语义的缺陷，并为非单调义务推理提供更合理的框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Residual-Shell-Based Lower Bound for Ollivier-Ricci Curvature
papers.abstract_en: Ollivier-Ricci curvature (ORC), defined via the Wasserstein distance that captures rich geometric information, has received growing attention in both theory and applications. However, the high computational cost of Wasserstein distance evaluation has significantly limited the broader practical use of ORC. To alleviate this issue, previous work introduced a computationally efficient lower bound as a proxy for ORC based on 1-hop random walks, but this approach empirically exhibits large gaps from the exact ORC. In this paper, we establish a substantially tighter lower bound for ORC than the existing lower bound, while retaining much lower computational cost than exact ORC computation, with practical speedups of tens of times. Moreover, our bound is not restricted to 1-hop random walks, but also applies to k-hop random walks (k > 1). Experiments on several fundamental graph structures demonstrate the effectiveness of our bound in terms of both approximation accuracy and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Ollivier-Ricci曲率（ORC）计算成本高的问题，提出一种基于残差壳（residual-shell）的更紧下界，保留低计算成本（数十倍加速），并适用于k跳随机游走。实验在几种基础图结构上验证了近似精度和效率。
Motivation: 现有ORC下界基于1跳随机游走，计算快但与真实ORC差距大，限制其实际应用。需要更紧且高效的下界。
Method: 建立基于残差壳的ORC下界，不限制于1跳随机游走，可扩展到k跳（k>1），计算成本远低于精确ORC。
Result: 摘要报告在多种基本图结构上，该下界的近似精度显著优于现有下界，同时保持数十倍的速度提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的下界在近似精度和计算效率之间取得了良好平衡，有望扩展ORC的实际应用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Colon-Bench: An Agentic Workflow for Scalable Dense Lesion Annotation in Full-Procedure Colonoscopy Videos
papers.abstract_en: Early screening via colonoscopy is critical for colon cancer prevention, yet developing robust AI systems for this domain is hindered by the lack of densely annotated, long-sequence video datasets. Existing datasets predominantly focus on single-class polyp detection and lack the rich spatial, temporal, and linguistic annotations required to evaluate modern Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). To address this critical gap, we introduce Colon-Bench, generated via a novel multi-stage agentic workflow. Our pipeline seamlessly integrates temporal proposals, bounding-box tracking, AI-driven visual confirmation, and human-in-the-loop review to scalably annotate full-procedure videos. The resulting verified benchmark is unprecedented in scope, encompassing 528 videos, 14 distinct lesion categories (including polyps, ulcers, and bleeding), over 300,000 bounding boxes, 213,000 segmentation masks, and 133,000 words of clinical descriptions. We utilize Colon-Bench to rigorously evaluate state-of-the-art MLLMs across lesion classification, Open-Vocabulary Video Object Segmentation (OV-VOS), and video Visual Question Answering (VQA). The MLLM results demonstrate surprisingly high localization performance in medical domains compared to SAM-3. Finally, we analyze common VQA errors from MLLMs to introduce a novel "colon-skill" prompting strategy, improving zero-shot MLLM performance by up to 9.7% across most MLLMs. The dataset and the code are available at https://abdullahamdi.com/colon-bench .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Colon-Bench，一个通过多阶段智能体工作流生成的结肠镜视频密集标注基准，包含 528 个视频、14 种病变类别、超过 30 万边界框和 21.3 万分割掩码。基于该基准评估了多模态大模型在病变分类、开放词汇视频目标分割和视频视觉问答上的性能，并提出“结肠技能”提示策略将零样本性能提升高达 9.7%。
Motivation: 现有结肠镜数据集主要关注单类息肉检测，缺乏密集标注的长序列视频，无法满足现代多模态大模型的评估需求。
Method: 提出多阶段智能体工作流，整合时间提议、边界框跟踪、AI 视觉确认和人工审核，实现全流程视频的可扩展密集标注。
Result: 构建的基准包含 528 个视频、14 种病变类别、超过 30 万边界框、21.3 万分割掩码和 13.3 万词临床描述。MLLM 在医学定位上表现优于 SAM-3，所提提示策略提升零样本性能达 9.7%。
Conclusion: Colon-Bench 为结肠镜视频密集标注提供了规模化方案，并展示了 MLLM 在该领域的潜力，但仅限于结肠镜场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VIGIL: Part-Grounded Structured Reasoning for Generalizable Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer a promising path toward interpretable deepfake detection by generating textual explanations. However, the reasoning process of current MLLM-based methods combines evidence generation and manipulation localization into a unified step. This combination blurs the boundary between faithful observations and hallucinated explanations, leading to unreliable conclusions. Building on this, we present VIGIL, a part-centric structured forensic framework inspired by expert forensic practice through a plan-then-examine pipeline: the model first plans which facial parts warrant inspection based on global visual cues, then examines each part with independently sourced forensic evidence. A stage-gated injection mechanism delivers part-level forensic evidence only during examination, ensuring that part selection remains driven by the model's own perception rather than biased by external signals. We further propose a progressive three-stage training paradigm whose reinforcement learning stage employs part-aware rewards to enforce anatomical validity and evidence--conclusion coherence. To enable rigorous generalizability evaluation, we construct OmniFake, a hierarchical 5-Level benchmark where the model, trained on only three foundational generators, is progressively tested up to in-the-wild social-media data. Extensive experiments on OmniFake and cross-dataset evaluations demonstrate that VIGIL consistently outperforms both expert detectors and concurrent MLLM-based methods across all generalizability levels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出VIGIL框架，一种基于部分引导的结构化推理方法，用于可泛化的深度伪造检测。该方法采用计划-检查流水线，先规划需检查的面部部位，再独立收集每个部位的取证证据，通过阶段门控注入机制确保部分选择不受外部信号干扰。提出渐进式三阶段训练范式和OmniFake基准测试集，实验表明VIGIL在泛化性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 当前基于多模态大语言模型的深度伪造检测方法将证据生成与操作定位合并为一步，模糊了忠实观察与幻觉解释的边界，导致不可靠结论。
Method: 提出VIGIL框架，包含计划-检查流水线：模型先根据全局视觉线索规划需检查的面部部位，然后对每个部位独立获取取证证据；采用阶段门控注入机制确保部位选择仅由模型自身感知驱动；并设计渐进式三阶段训练范式（强化学习阶段使用部位感知奖励来增强解剖有效性和证据-结论一致性）。
Result: 在OmniFake基准和跨数据集评估中，VIGIL在所有泛化性级别上均优于专家检测器和基于MLLM的现有方法。
Conclusion: VIGIL通过结构化的部分级推理实现了更可靠和可泛化的深度伪造检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Em-Garde: A Propose-Match Framework for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Streaming Video Understanding has enabled a new interaction paradigm where models respond proactively to user queries. Current proactive VideoLLMs rely on per-frame triggering decision making, which suffers from an efficiency-accuracy dilemma. We propose Em-Garde, a novel framework that decouples semantic understanding from streaming perception. At query time, the Instruction-Guided Proposal Parser transforms user queries into structured, perceptually grounded visual proposals; during streaming, a Lightweight Proposal Matching Module performs efficient embedding-based matching to trigger responses. Experiments on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench demonstrate consistent improvements over prior models in proactive response accuracy and efficiency, validating an effective solution for proactive video understanding under strict computational constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Em-Garde框架，用于主动流式视频理解。该框架将语义理解与流式感知解耦，通过指令引导的提案解析器将用户查询转换为结构化视觉提案，并在流式过程中使用轻量级提案匹配模块进行高效的嵌入匹配以触发响应，避免了逐帧触发决策的效率-准确率困境。在StreamingBench和OVO-Bench上的实验表明，该方法在主动响应准确率和效率上优于先前模型。
Motivation: 现有主动式视频语言模型依赖逐帧触发决策，存在效率与准确率的权衡问题。
Method: 提出Em-Garde框架，包含指令引导的提案解析器（Instruction-Guided Proposal Parser）和轻量级提案匹配模块（Lightweight Proposal Matching Module），实现查询时间-流式时间解耦。
Result: 在StreamingBench和OVO-Bench基准上，该方法在主动响应准确率和效率上一致优于先前模型。
Conclusion: 验证了在严格计算约束下，通过解耦语义理解与流式感知可实现高效的主动视频理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural Galerkin Normalizing Flow for Transition Probability Density Functions of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a new Neural Galerkin Normalizing Flow framework to approximate the transition probability density function of a diffusion process by solving the corresponding Fokker-Planck equation with an atomic initial distribution, parametrically with respect to the location of the initial mass. By using Normalizing Flows, we look for the solution as a transformation of the transition probability density function of a reference stochastic process, ensuring that our approximation is structure-preserving and automatically satisfies positivity and mass conservation constraints. By extending Neural Galerkin schemes to the context of Normalizing Flows, we derive a system of ODEs for the time evolution of the Normalizing Flow's parameters. Adaptive sampling routines are used to evaluate the Fokker-Planck residual in meaningful locations, which is of vital importance to address high-dimensional PDEs. Numerical results show that this strategy captures key features of the true solution and enforces the causal relationship between the initial datum and the density function at subsequent times. After completing an offline training phase, online evaluation becomes significantly more cost-effective than solving the PDE from scratch. The proposed method serves as a promising surrogate model, which could be deployed in many-query problems associated with stochastic differential equations, like Bayesian inference, simulation, and diffusion bridge generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经伽辽金归一化流（Neural Galerkin Normalizing Flow）框架，通过求解带有原子初始分布的Fokker-Planck方程，近似扩散过程的转移概率密度函数，并保证正性和质量守恒。该方法将神经伽辽金方案扩展到归一化流，导出参数演化的常微分方程组，并采用自适应采样评估残差。数值实验表明，该方法能捕捉解的关键特征，离线训练后在线评估比从头求解PDE更高效，适用于贝叶斯推断、模拟和扩散桥生成等多查询问题。
Motivation: 扩散过程的转移概率密度函数通常由高维Fokker-Planck方程描述，传统数值方法计算成本高，且难以保证概率密度函数的正性和归一化约束。
Method: 利用归一化流将参考随机过程的转移密度变换为目标解，通过扩展神经伽辽金方案导出参数时间演化的ODE系统，并结合自适应采样评估Fokker-Planck残差。
Result: 摘要报告数值结果展示了该方法能捕捉真实解的关键特征，并强制初始数据与后续密度间的因果关系；离线训练后在线评估显著比从头求解PDE更经济。
Conclusion: 该框架可作为扩散过程多查询问题的有效替代模型，但在实际应用中的可扩展性和对更复杂扩散过程的适用性仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: AHOY! Animatable Humans under Occlusion from YouTube Videos with Gaussian Splatting and Video Diffusion Priors
papers.abstract_en: We present AHOY, a method for reconstructing complete, animatable 3D Gaussian avatars from in-the-wild monocular video despite heavy occlusion. Existing methods assume unoccluded input-a fully visible subject, often in a canonical pose-excluding the vast majority of real-world footage where people are routinely occluded by furniture, objects, or other people. Reconstructing from such footage poses fundamental challenges: large body regions may never be observed, and multi-view supervision per pose is unavailable. We address these challenges with four contributions: (i) a hallucination-as-supervision pipeline that uses identity-finetuned diffusion models to generate dense supervision for previously unobserved body regions; (ii) a two-stage canonical-to-pose-dependent architecture that bootstraps from sparse observations to full pose-dependent Gaussian maps; (iii) a map-pose/LBS-pose decoupling that absorbs multi-view inconsistencies from the generated data; (iv) a head/body split supervision strategy that preserves facial identity. We evaluate on YouTube videos and on multi-view capture data with significant occlusion and demonstrate state-of-the-art reconstruction quality. We also demonstrate that the resulting avatars are robust enough to be animated with novel poses and composited into 3DGS scenes captured using cell-phone video. Our project page is available at https://miraymen.github.io/ahoy/
papers.comment: ECCV 2026. Project page is available at https://miraymen.github.io/ahoy/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AHOY方法，旨在从包含严重遮挡的野外单目视频中重建完整的、可动画化的3D高斯人体化身。通过身份微调的扩散模型生成未见区域的密集监督，结合两阶段规范到姿态依赖架构、姿态解耦以及头/体分离监督策略，在YouTube视频和多视角遮挡数据上取得了先进的生成质量。
Motivation: 现有方法假设输入无遮挡，无法处理现实中常见的人体被家具、物体或他人遮挡的情况，导致大范围身体区域不可见且缺乏姿态级多视角监督。
Method: 贡献包括：(i) 利用身份微调扩散模型生成未观察区域监督；(ii) 两阶段规范到姿态依赖的3D高斯映射架构；(iii) 地图-姿态/LBS-姿态解耦以吸收生成数据的多视角不一致性；(iv) 头/体分离监督策略保持面部身份。
Result: 在YouTube视频和多视角遮挡数据上，该方法在重建质量上优于现有方案，生成的化身可被动画化并融入手机视频捕获的3DGS场景。
Conclusion: AHOY展示了从严重遮挡视频中恢复完整可动画化人体化身的可行性，其扩散先验与3D高斯表示的结合是有效途径。

papers.title: DiscoGen: Procedural Generation of Algorithm Discovery Tasks in Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Automating the development of machine learning algorithms has the potential to unlock new breakthroughs. However, our ability to improve and evaluate algorithm discovery systems has thus far been limited by existing task suites. They suffer from many issues, such as: poor evaluation methodologies; data contamination; and containing saturated or very similar problems. Here, we introduce DiscoGen, a procedural generator of algorithm discovery tasks for machine learning, such as developing optimisers for reinforcement learning or loss functions for image classification. Motivated by the success of procedural generation in reinforcement learning, DiscoGen spans billions of tasks of varying difficulty and complexity from a range of machine learning fields. These tasks are specified by a small number of configuration parameters and can be used to optimise algorithm discovery agents (ADAs). We present DiscoBench, a fixed, small subset of DiscoGen tasks for principled evaluation of ADAs. Finally, we propose a number of ambitious, impactful research directions enabled by DiscoGen, and demonstrate its use for ADA optimisation through scaling experiments for automated prompt tuning. DiscoGen is released open-source at https://github.com/AlexGoldie/discogen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiscoGen 是一个程序化生成机器学习算法发现任务的工具，旨在解决现有任务套件在评估方法、数据污染和任务饱和方面的问题。它覆盖从强化学习优化器到图像分类损失函数等数十亿个不同难度的任务，并提供了一个固定小子集 DiscoBench 用于原则性评估。论文还展示了通过自动化提示调优进行算法发现代理优化的缩放实验。
Motivation: 现有算法发现系统受限于任务套件的缺陷：评估方法不佳、数据污染以及任务饱和或相似度过高，限制了系统的改进和评估。
Method: 提出 DiscoGen，一个程序化生成器，通过少量配置参数指定任务，覆盖多个机器学习领域，并生成数十亿个不同难度和复杂度的任务。同时提供 DiscoBench 作为固定小子集用于原则性评估。
Result: 论文通过自动化提示调优的缩放实验展示了 DiscoGen 在算法发现代理优化中的应用，并开源了工具。
Conclusion: DiscoGen 为算法发现提供了大规模、多样化的任务生成平台，并开启了多项有影响力的研究方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LoGSAM: Parameter-Efficient Cross-Modal Grounding for MRI Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Precise localization and delineation of brain tumors using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) are essential for planning therapy and guiding surgical decisions. To address this, we propose LoGSAM, a parameter-efficient, detection-driven framework that transforms radiologist dictation into text prompts for foundation-model-based localization and segmentation. Radiologist speech is first transcribed and translated using a pretrained Whisper ASR model, followed by negation-aware clinical NLP to extract tumor-specific textual prompts. These prompts guide text-conditioned tumor localization via a LoRA-adapted vision-language detection model, Grounding DINO (GDINO). The predicted bounding boxes are used as prompts for MedSAM to generate pixel-level tumor masks without any additional fine-tuning. On BRISC 2025, LoGSAM attains a Dice score of 80.32\%, reaching 98.6\% of a fully fine-tuned GDINO + MedSAM baseline while training fewer than 5\% of its parameters, indicating a favorable accuracy/parameter trade-off. In addition, we evaluate the full pipeline using German dictations from a board-certified radiologist on unseen MRI scans, achieving 91.7\% case-level class-extraction accuracy. These results highlight the feasibility of constructing a modular speech-to-segmentation pipeline from pretrained foundation models with minimal parameter updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LoGSAM是一个参数高效的跨模态MRI分割框架，通过将放射科医生的语音转录为文本提示，利用Grounding DINO进行肿瘤定位，并用MedSAM生成分割掩膜，无需额外微调。在BRISC 2025上获得80.32%的Dice分数，仅训练少于5%的参数，达到完全微调基线98.6%的性能。
Motivation: 精确的脑肿瘤定位和分割对于治疗规划和手术决策至关重要，但现有方法依赖大量手工标注或全参数微调，成本高且泛化性有限。
Method: 使用Whisper ASR转录语音，经否定感知的临床NLP提取肿瘤相关文本提示，通过LoRA适配的Grounding DINO检测边界框，再作为MedSAM的提示生成分割掩膜。
Result: 在BRISC 2025上Dice得分为80.32%，达到全微调基线的98.6%，但仅训练<5%的参数；德语听写测试中案例级类别提取准确率为91.7%。
Conclusion: LoGSAM展示了利用预训练基础模型构建模块化语音-分割管道的可行性，仅需最小参数更新即可达到接近全微调的性能。

papers.title: LatSearch: Latent Reward-Guided Search for Faster Inference-Time Scaling in Video Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: The recent success of inference-time scaling in large language models has inspired similar explorations in video diffusion. In particular, motivated by the existence of "golden noise" that enhances video quality, prior work has attempted to improve inference by optimising or searching for better initial noise. However, these approaches have notable limitations: they either rely on priors imposed at the beginning of noise sampling or on rewards evaluated only on the denoised and decoded videos. This leads to error accumulation, delayed and sparse reward signals, and prohibitive computational cost, which prevents the use of stronger search algorithms. Crucially, stronger search algorithms are precisely what could unlock substantial gains in controllability, sample efficiency and generation quality for video diffusion, provided their computational cost can be reduced. To fill in this gap, we enable efficient inference-time scaling for video diffusion through latent reward guidance, which provides intermediate, informative and efficient feedback along the denoising trajectory. We introduce a latent reward model that scores partially denoised latents at arbitrary timesteps with respect to visual quality, motion quality, and text alignment. Building on this model, we propose LatSearch, a novel inference-time search mechanism that performs Reward-Guided Resampling and Pruning (RGRP). In the resampling stage, candidates are sampled according to reward-normalised probabilities to reduce over-reliance on the reward model. In the pruning stage, applied at the final scheduled step, only the candidate with the highest cumulative reward is retained, improving both quality and efficiency. We evaluate LatSearch on the VBench-2.0 benchmark and demonstrate that it consistently improves video generation across multiple evaluation dimensions compared to the baseline Wan2.1 model.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project page: see https://zengqunzhao.github.io/LatSearch
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频扩散模型推理时间缩放效率低的问题，提出LatSearch，通过潜在奖励引导的搜索机制，在去噪轨迹中提供中间反馈，实现更高效的计算资源分配。方法包括奖励引导的重采样和剪枝，在VBench-2.0基准上相比基线Wan2.1模型在视频质量、运动质量和文本对齐等多个维度取得一致提升。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖于初始噪声采样先验或仅在最终解码视频上评估奖励，导致误差累积、奖励信号延迟稀疏且计算成本高，难以应用更强的搜索算法来提升视频扩散的控制性、采样效率和生成质量。
Method: 提出潜在奖励模型，对任意时间步的部分去噪潜在表示进行视觉质量、运动质量和文本对齐评分；基于此设计LatSearch，包含奖励引导的重采样（根据奖励归一化概率采样候选）和剪枝（保留累积奖励最高的候选）两个阶段。
Result: 在VBench-2.0基准上，LatSearch在多个评估维度上持续优于基线Wan2.1模型。
Conclusion: 潜在奖励引导的搜索可以高效实现视频扩散的推理时间缩放，减少误差累积和计算开销，提升生成质量。

papers.title: Deep probabilistic model synthesis enables unified modeling of whole-brain neural activity across individual subjects
papers.abstract_en: Many disciplines need quantitative models that synthesize experimental data across multiple instances of the same general system. For example, neuroscientists must combine data from the brains of many individual animals to understand the species' brain in general. However, typical machine learning models treat one system instance at a time. Here we introduce a machine learning framework, deep probabilistic model synthesis (DPMS), that leverages system properties auxiliary to the model to combine data across system instances. DPMS specifically uses variational inference to learn a conditional prior distribution and instance-specific posterior distributions over model parameters that respectively tie together the system instances and capture their unique structure. DPMS can synthesize a wide variety of model classes, such as those for regression, classification, and dimensionality reduction, and we demonstrate its ability to improve upon single-instance models on synthetic data and whole-brain neural activity data from larval zebrafish.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出深度概率模型综合（DPMS）框架，利用变分推断学习条件先验分布和实例特定的后验分布，从而融合多个系统实例的数据。在合成数据和斑马鱼全脑神经活动数据上展示了优于单实例模型的效果。
Motivation: 许多学科需要跨多个实例综合实验数据，但典型机器学习模型一次只处理一个实例，缺乏跨实例整合能力。
Method: DPMS使用变分推断学习条件先验分布和实例特定的后验分布，分别绑定系统实例并捕获其独特结构。
Result: 在合成数据和斑马鱼全脑神经活动数据上，DPMS优于单实例模型。
Conclusion: DPMS可综合多种模型类，如回归、分类和降维，为跨实例数据建模提供通用框架。

papers.title: SK-Adapter: Skeleton-Based Structural Control for Native 3D Generation
papers.abstract_en: Native 3D generative models have achieved remarkable fidelity and speed, yet they suffer from a critical limitation: inability to prescribe precise structural articulations, where precise structural control within the native 3D space remains underexplored. This paper proposes SK-Adapter, a simple yet efficient and effective framework that unlocks precise skeletal manipulation for native 3D generation. Moving beyond text or image prompts, which can be ambiguous for precise structure, we treat the 3D skeleton as a first-class control signal. SK-Adapter is a lightweight structural adapter network that encodes joint coordinates and topology into learnable tokens, which are injected into the frozen 3D generation backbone via cross-attention. This design allows the model to not only effectively ``attend'' to specific 3D structural constraints but also preserve its original generative priors. To bridge the data gap, we contribute the Objaverse-TMS dataset, a large-scale dataset of 24k text-mesh-skeleton pairs. Extensive experiments confirm that our method achieves robust structural control while preserving the geometry and texture quality of the foundation model, significantly outperforming existing baselines. Furthermore, we extend this capability to local 3D editing, enabling region-specific editing of existing assets with skeletal guidance, which is unattainable by previous methods. Project page: https://sk-adapter.github.io/

papers.title: AccelAes: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers for Training-Free Aesthetic-Enhanced Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) are a dominant backbone for high-fidelity text-to-image generation due to strong scalability and alignment at high resolutions. However, quadratic self-attention over dense spatial tokens leads to high inference latency and limits deployment. We observe that denoising is spatially non-uniform with respect to aesthetic descriptors in the prompt. Regions associated with aesthetic tokens receive concentrated cross-attention and show larger temporal variation, while low-affinity regions evolve smoothly with redundant computation. Based on this insight, we propose AccelAes, a training-free framework that accelerates DiTs through aesthetics-aware spatio-temporal reduction while improving perceptual aesthetics. AccelAes builds AesMask, a one-shot aesthetic focus mask derived from prompt semantics and cross-attention signals. When localized computation is feasible, SkipSparse reallocates computation and guidance to masked regions. We further reduce temporal redundancy using a lightweight step-level prediction cache that periodically replaces full Transformer evaluations. Experiments on representative DiT families show consistent acceleration and improved aesthetics-oriented quality. On Lumina-Next, AccelAes achieves a 2.11$\times$ speedup and improves ImageReward by +11.9% over the dense baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/xuanhuayin/AccelAes.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV2026; 34 pages, 19 tables, 12 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AccelAes，一种无需训练的框架，通过美学感知的空时缩减加速扩散Transformer (DiT) 的推理，同时提升生成图像的美学质量。核心思想是利用跨注意力信号构建美学焦点掩码 (AesMask)，在局部计算可行时将计算重分配到掩码区域，并通过轻量级步级预测缓存减少时间冗余。在Lumina-Next等模型上实现2.11倍加速，ImageReward提升11.9%。
Motivation: 扩散Transformer (DiT) 在高分辨率文本到图像生成中因密集空间token的二次自注意力导致推理延迟高，限制了部署。作者观察到去噪过程在空间上非均匀，与提示中的美学描述符相关，高美学区域需要更多计算，而低相关区域计算冗余。
Method: 提出AccelAes框架，包含两个组件：1) AesMask，从提示语义和跨注意力信号中一次性生成美学焦点掩码；2) SkipSparse，在局部计算可行时将计算和引导重新分配到掩码区域；3) 使用轻量级步级预测缓存周期替换完整Transformer评估以减少时间冗余。
Result: 在多个DiT系列上实现一致加速和美学质量提升。在Lumina-Next上达到2.11倍加速，ImageReward比密集基线提升11.9%。
Conclusion: AccelAes是一种训练免费、即插即用的加速方法，能同时提升DiT的推理速度和生成图像的美学感知质量，适用于需要高保真文本到图像生成的场景。论文提供了开源代码。

papers.title: HiAP: A Multi-Granular Stochastic Auto-Pruning Framework for Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers require significant computational resources and memory bandwidth, severely limiting their deployment on resource-constraint hardware. Most structured pruning methods reduce theoretical cost effectively, yet they typically operate at a single structural granularity and depend on multi-stage pipelines with importance ranking, auxiliary solvers or post-hoc magnitude thresholding, followed by a separate fine-tuning phase to recover accuracy. We propose Hierarchical Auto-Pruning (HiAP), which casts ViT pruning as a single budget-aware learning problem and jointly allocates sparsity across four granularities in one end-to-end phase. HiAP introduces stochastic Gumbel-Sigmoid gates at macro level (attention heads and FFN blocks) and micro level (intra-head dimensions and FFN neurons), and optimizes them against the task loss together with an analytical MAC cost term. The budget coefficient steers the network to a target compute level while the gates gradually harden into a dense, smaller sub-network at convergence. It does not require importance heuristics, ranking metrics, auxillary solvers or secondary fine-tuning. On ImageNet with DeiT small, HiAP automatically discovers hetergenous architectures, pruning depths, heads, and width by different amount across layers, and reaches competitive accuracies against substantially more complex pruning pipelines at comparable compute from a single training run.
papers.comment: V1:14 pages, 9 figures, 3 Tables V2:different layout, more ablations
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出层次化自动剪枝框架HiAP，将Vision Transformer的剪枝建模为单阶段预算感知学习问题，联合分配四个粒度的稀疏性（注意力头、FFN块、头内维度、FFN神经元），使用随机Gumbel-Sigmoid门控与MAC成本项，无需重要性排序或二次微调，在DeiT small上自动发现异构架构并达到有竞争力的精度。
Motivation: 现有ViT结构化剪枝方法通常只操作单一粒度，依赖多阶段流水线（重要性排序、辅助求解器或后处理阈值）和单独微调，复杂度高，且无法全局优化不同粒度的稀疏性。
Method: 设计层次化自动剪枝框架HiAP，在宏观（注意力头、FFN块）和微观（头内维度、FFN神经元）引入随机Gumbel-Sigmoid门控，将MAC成本项与任务损失联合优化，通过预算系数控制计算目标，门控在收敛时硬化形成稠密小子网络。
Result: 在ImageNet上使用DeiT small，HiAP自动发现跨层不同剪枝数量的异构架构，在相当计算量下达到与更复杂剪枝流水线竞争性的精度，且仅需单次训练。
Conclusion: HiAP表明将多粒度剪枝统一为单阶段预算感知学习是可行的，避免了手工启发式和多阶段管道，但摘要未讨论泛化到其他任务或更大模型的情况。

papers.title: Real-time Rendering-based Surgical Instrument Tracking via Evolutionary Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and efficient tracking of surgical instruments is fundamental for Robot-Assisted Minimally Invasive Surgery. Although vision-based robot pose estimation has enabled markerless calibration without tedious physical setups, reliable tool tracking for surgical robots still remains challenging due to partial visibility and specialized articulation design of surgical instruments. Previous works in the field are usually prone to unreliable feature detections under degraded visual quality and data scarcity, whereas rendering-based methods often struggle with computational costs and suboptimal convergence. In this work, we incorporate CMA-ES, an evolutionary optimization strategy, into a versatile tracking pipeline that jointly estimates surgical instrument pose and joint configurations. Using batch rendering to efficiently evaluate multiple pose candidates in parallel, the method significantly reduces inference time and improves convergence robustness. The proposed framework further generalizes to joint angle-free and bi-manual tracking settings, making it suitable for both vision feedback control and online surgery video calibration. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms prior approaches in both accuracy and runtime. Source code and data are available at https://github.com/hanyang-hu/online_dvrk_tracking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器人辅助微创手术中器械跟踪的准确性和效率问题，提出基于CMA-ES进化优化策略的实时渲染跟踪管线，联合估计手术器械的位姿和关节配置。通过批量渲染并行评估多个候选位姿，显著降低推理时间并提高收敛鲁棒性。方法在合成和真实数据集上均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有基于视觉的机器人位姿估计在部分可见性和特殊关节设计下容易产生不可靠的特征检测，而基于渲染的方法则面临计算成本和次优收敛的问题。
Method: 引入CMA-ES（协方差矩阵自适应进化策略）优化器，结合批量渲染技术，在跟踪管线下并行评估多个位姿候选，联合优化手术器械的6D位姿和关节角度。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，该方法在准确性和运行时间上均显著优于先前方法。
Conclusion: 该框架可推广到无关节角度和双器械跟踪场景，适用于视觉反馈控制和在线手术视频校准。

papers.title: AsyncMDE: Real-Time Monocular Depth Estimation via Asynchronous Spatial Memory
papers.abstract_en: Foundation-model-based monocular depth estimation offers a viable alternative to active sensors for robot perception, yet its computational cost often prohibits deployment on edge platforms. Existing methods perform independent per-frame inference, wasting the substantial computational redundancy between adjacent viewpoints in continuous robot operation. This paper presents AsyncMDE, an asynchronous depth perception system consisting of a frozen foundation model and a lightweight fast path that amortizes the foundation model's computational cost over time. The foundation model periodically produces high-quality spatial features in the background, while the lightweight fast path runs asynchronously in the foreground, fusing cached memory with current observations through complementary fusion, outputting depth estimates, and autoregressively updating memory. This enables cross-frame feature reuse with bounded accuracy degradation. With 3.83M trainable fast-path parameters and a 97.5M frozen slow path, AsyncMDE's fast path operates at 237 FPS on an RTX 4090, recovering 77% of the accuracy gap to the foundation model. Across indoor static, dynamic, and synthetic extreme-motion benchmarks, AsyncMDE degrades predictably and reaches 161 FPS fast-path inference on a TensorRT-optimized Jetson AGX Orin, supporting real-time edge deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AsyncMDE，一种异步深度估计系统，结合冻结的基础模型和轻量级快速路径，通过异步空间记忆实现跨帧特征重用，在边缘设备上实现实时单目深度估计。
Motivation: 现有基于基础模型的单目深度估计计算成本高，无法在边缘平台部署；连续机器人操作中相邻视角间的计算冗余未被利用。
Method: AsyncMDE包含一个冻结的基础模型（慢路径）周期性生成高质量空间特征，以及一个轻量级快速路径（3.83M可训练参数）异步运行，通过互补融合融合缓存记忆与当前观测，输出深度估计并自回归更新记忆。
Result: 快速路径在RTX 4090上达到237 FPS，恢复基础模型精度差距的77%；在TensorRT优化的Jetson AGX Orin上达到161 FPS，支持实时边缘部署。
Conclusion: AsyncMDE通过异步设计有效利用跨帧特征，在精度和速度间取得平衡，适用于机器人实时感知。

papers.title: PROBE: Probabilistic Occupancy BEV Encoding with Analytical Translation Robustness for 3D Place Recognition
papers.abstract_en: We present PROBE (PRobabilistic Occupancy BEV Encoding), a learning-free LiDAR place recognition descriptor that models each BEV cell's occupancy as a Bernoulli random variable. Rather than relying on discrete point-cloud perturbations, PROBE analytically marginalizes over continuous Cartesian translations via the polar Jacobian, yielding a distance-adaptive angular uncertainty $σ_θ= σ_t / r$ in $\mathcal{O}(R{\cdot}S)$ time. The primary parameter $σ_t$ represents the expected translational uncertainty in meters, a sensor-independent physical quantity that enhances cross-sensor generalization while reducing the need for extensive per-dataset tuning. Pairwise similarity combines a Bernoulli-KL Jaccard with exponential uncertainty gating and FFT-based height cosine similarity for rotation alignment. Evaluated on four datasets spanning four diverse LiDAR types, PROBE achieves the highest accuracy among handcrafted descriptors in multi-session evaluation and competitive single-session performance relative to both handcrafted and supervised baselines. The source code and supplementary materials are available at https://sites.google.com/view/probe-pr.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PROBE是一种无需学习的激光雷达地点识别描述子，将每个BEV格网的占据概率建模为伯努利随机变量。通过极坐标雅可比解析地边缘化连续笛卡尔平移，得到距离自适应的角不确定性，计算复杂度为O(R·S)。在四种不同类型的激光雷达数据集上，PROBE在多会话评估中达到手工描述子的最高精度，在单会话中与手工和监督方法竞争力相当。
Motivation: 现有激光雷达地点识别描述子依赖离散点云扰动或大量数据调参，跨传感器泛化差且训练成本高。
Method: 提出概率占据BEV编码（PROBE），将占据概率建模为伯努利变量，通过极坐标雅可比解析推导平移鲁棒的不确定性，用伯努利KL-Jaccard相似度结合指数不确定性门控和FFT高度余弦相似度进行旋转对齐。
Result: 在四种激光雷达类型（旋转、固态等）的四个数据集上，多会话评估中PROBE在手工描述子中准确率最高；单会话中与手工及监督方法性能相当。
Conclusion: PROBE作为无学习描述子，具有解析的平移鲁棒性，跨传感器泛化能力强，减少了对每数据集调参的依赖。

summary_sections.tldr: PROBE是一种无需学习的激光雷达地点识别描述子，将每个BEV格网的占据概率建模为伯努利随机变量。通过极坐标雅可比解析地边缘化连续笛卡尔平移，得到距离自适应的角不确定性，计算复杂度为O(R·S)。在四种不同类型的激光雷达数据集上，PROBE在多会话评估中达到手工描述子的最高精度，在单会话中与手工和监督方法竞争力相当。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有激光雷达地点识别描述子依赖离散点云扰动或大量数据调参，跨传感器泛化差且训练成本高。

summary_sections.result: 在四种激光雷达类型（旋转、固态等）的四个数据集上，多会话评估中PROBE在手工描述子中准确率最高；单会话中与手工及监督方法性能相当。
summary_sections.conclusion: PROBE作为无学习描述子，具有解析的平移鲁棒性，跨传感器泛化能力强，减少了对每数据集调参的依赖。

papers.title: CollabOD: Collaborative Multi-Backbone with Cross-scale Vision for UAV Small Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Small object detection in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) imagery is challenging because high-altitude viewpoints produce severe scale variation, weak structural cues, and tight computational budgets. Existing lightweight detectors usually fuse multi-scale features after downsampling, where boundary and texture details have already been attenuated and heterogeneous feature streams may be spatially misaligned. To address these issues, we propose CollabOD, a collaborative detection framework that preserves structural details, aligns cross-path features before fusion, and keeps the detection head lightweight at inference time. CollabOD combines a Dual-Path Fusion Stem, a Dense Aggregation Block, a Bilateral Reweighting Module, and a Unified Detail-Aware Head to strengthen localization-oriented representation while limiting extra computation. On VisDrone, CollabOD obtains 52.4 AP50, 30.8 AP75, and 29.9 AP50:95 with 65.5 GFLOPs; on UAVDT it reaches 31.2 AP50 and 17.4 AP50:95; and on AI-TOD it reaches 45.4 AP50 and 20.0 AP50:95 at 137 FPS. The code is available at: https://github.com/Bai-Xuecheng/CollabOD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CollabOD，一种针对无人机小目标检测的协作检测框架，通过双路径融合茎、密集聚合块、双边重加权模块和统一细节感知头，在保持轻量级的同时提升检测精度。在VisDrone、UAVDT和AI-TOD数据集上取得SOTA结果，代码已开源。
Motivation: 无人机图像中小目标检测面临尺度变化、弱结构线索和计算预算限制，现有轻量检测器在下采样后多尺度特征融合时边界纹理衰减且特征流空间未对齐。
Method: 提出CollabOD框架，包含双路径融合茎（Dual-Path Fusion Stem）、密集聚合块（Dense Aggregation Block）、双边重加权模块（Bilateral Reweighting Module）和统一细节感知头（Unified Detail-Aware Head），在推理时保持检测头轻量。
Result: 在VisDrone上达到52.4 AP50、30.8 AP75、29.9 AP50:95，GFLOPs 65.5；UAVDT上31.2 AP50、17.4 AP50:95；AI-TOD上45.4 AP50、20.0 AP50:95，137 FPS。
Conclusion: 该方法在多个无人机小目标检测基准上取得优异性能，代码已公开。

papers.title: OpenFrontier: General Navigation with Visual-Language Grounded Frontiers
papers.abstract_en: Open-world navigation requires robots to make decisions in complex everyday environments while adapting to flexible task requirements. Conventional navigation approaches often rely on dense 3D reconstruction and hand-crafted goal metrics, which limits their generalization across tasks and environments. Recent advances in vision-language navigation (VLN) and vision-language-action (VLA) models enable end-to-end policies conditioned on natural language, but typically require interactive training, large-scale data collection, or task-specific fine-tuning with a mobile agent. We formulate navigation as a sparse subgoal identification and reaching problem and observe that providing visual anchoring targets for high-level semantic priors enables highly efficient goal-conditioned navigation. Based on this insight, we select visual frontiers as semantic anchors and propose OpenFrontier, a navigation framework that requires no task-specific training or fine-tuning and seamlessly integrates diverse vision-language prior models. OpenFrontier enables efficient navigation with a lightweight system design, without dense 3D semantic mapping, task-specific policy training, or model fine-tuning. We evaluate OpenFrontier across multiple navigation benchmarks and demonstrate strong zero-shot performance, as well as effective real-world deployment on a mobile robot.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OpenFrontier 提出一种基于视觉语言语义边界（visual frontiers）的导航框架，将导航建模为稀疏子目标识别与到达问题。该框架无需任务特定训练或微调，无需密集3D语义地图，即可整合多种视觉语言先验模型。实验在多个导航基准上展示了强零样本性能，并在移动机器人上完成实际部署。
Motivation: 现有导航方法依赖密集3D重建和手工目标度量，难以泛化到开放世界环境；视觉语言导航（VLN）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要交互训练或大规模数据收集。本文旨在实现高效、无需任务特定训练的通用导航。
Method: 提出 OpenFrontier 框架，以视觉边界（visual frontiers）作为语义锚点，利用预训练的视觉语言模型提供高层语义先验，通过稀疏子目标识别与到达实现导航，无需密集3D语义映射、任务专用策略训练或模型微调。
Result: 在多个导航基准上达到强零样本性能，并在移动机器人上成功进行实际部署，证明其跨任务、跨环境的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 通过提供视觉锚定目标实现高效目标条件导航，无需任务特定训练或微调，展示了轻量级系统设计在开放世界导航中的潜力。

papers.title: Non-Euclidean Gradient Descent Operates at the Edge of Stability
papers.abstract_en: The Edge of Stability (EoS) is a phenomenon where the sharpness (largest eigenvalue) of the Hessian approaches and then hovers near the stability threshold $2/η$ during gradient descent (GD) with step size $η$. Despite (apparently) violating classical smoothness assumptions, EoS has been widely observed in deep learning, but its theoretical foundations remain incomplete. We provide an interpretation of EoS through the lens of Directional Smoothness [Mishkin et al., 2024]. This interpretation naturally extends to non-Euclidean norms, which we use to define generalized sharpness under an arbitrary norm. Our generalized sharpness measure includes previously studied vanilla GD and preconditioned GD as special cases, as well as methods for which EoS has not been studied, such as $\ell_{\infty}$-descent, Block CD, Spectral GD, and their normalized versions. Through experiments on neural networks, we show that non-Euclidean GD with our generalized sharpness also exhibits progressive sharpening followed by oscillations around or above the threshold $2/η$. Practically, our framework provides a geometry-aware spectral diagnostic that can be applied across a broad class of non-Euclidean gradient methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从方向光滑性（Directional Smoothness）的角度解释了梯度下降中的边缘稳定性（Edge of Stability, EoS）现象，并将其推广到非欧几里得范数，定义了广义的锐度（generalized sharpness）。实验表明，非欧几里得梯度下降方法也表现出渐进锐化及围绕阈值震荡的行为。该框架为多种非欧几里得梯度方法提供了几何感知的谱诊断。
Motivation: EoS现象在深度学习中广泛存在但其理论尚不完整，现有解释多基于欧几里得范数，缺乏对非欧几里得梯度方法的统一理解。
Method: 利用方向光滑性定义任意范数下的广义锐度，涵盖普通梯度下降、预处理梯度下降、ℓ∞下降、块坐标下降、谱梯度下降等方法，通过神经网络实验验证广义锐度在非欧几里得GD中的行为。
Result: 非欧几里得GD在广义锐度下也表现出渐进锐化和围绕阈值2/η的震荡；该框架提供了适用于广泛非欧几里得梯度方法的几何谱诊断。
Conclusion: 本文为EoS提供了非欧几里得范数下的理论解释和实用诊断工具，但主要针对确定性优化方法，随机性方法的推广未涉及。

papers.title: Feature-level Interaction Explanations in Multimodal Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Transformers often produce predictions without clarifying how different modalities jointly support a decision. Most existing multimodal explainable AI (MXAI) methods extend unimodal saliency to multimodal backbones, highlighting important tokens or patches within each modality, but they rarely pinpoint which cross-modal feature pairs provide complementary evidence (synergy) or serve as reliable backups (redundancy). We present Feature-level I2MoE (FL-I2MoE), a structured Mixture-of-Experts layer that operates directly on token/patch sequences from frozen pretrained encoders and explicitly separates unique, synergistic, and redundant evidence at the feature level. We further develop an expert-wise explanation pipeline that combines attribution with top-K% masking to assess faithfulness, and we introduce Monte Carlo interaction probes to quantify pairwise behavior: the Shapley Interaction Index (SII) to score synergistic pairs and a redundancy-gap score to capture substitutable (redundant) pairs. Across three benchmarks (MMIMDb, ENRICO, and MMHS150K), FL-I2MoE yields more interactionspecific and concentrated importance patterns than a dense Transformer with the same encoders. Finally, pair-level masking shows that removing pairs ranked by SII or redundancy-gap degrades performance more than masking randomly chosen pairs under the same budget, supporting that the identified interactions are causally relevant. Code is available at https://github.com/dut0817/FL-I2MoE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态Transformer中缺乏跨模态交互解释的问题，提出Feature-level I2MoE (FL-I2MoE)，通过结构化MoE层显式分离独特、协同和冗余的证据。在三个多模态基准上，FL-I2MoE比密集Transformer产生更交互特定和集中的重要性模式。通过逐对掩码验证了识别出的交互的因果相关性。
Motivation: 现有多模态可解释方法主要扩展单模态显著性，未能识别跨模态特征对之间的协同或冗余关系。
Method: 提出FL-I2MoE，一个结构化MoE层，操作冻结预训练编码器的token/patch，显式区分独特、协同和冗余特征；结合归因和Monte Carlo交互探针（Shapley Interaction Index和冗余差距分数）量化成对行为。
Result: 在MMIMDb、ENRICO、MMHS150K三个基准上，FL-I2MoE产生比相同编码器的密集Transformer更交互特定和集中的重要性模式；移除按交互排序的成对特征比随机移除更显著降低性能。
Conclusion: FL-I2MoE能够识别因果相关的跨模态交互，提供更可解释的多模态预测。代码已开源。

papers.title: Edit in 2D, Verify in 3D: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-view Consistent Scene Editing
papers.abstract_en: Leveraging the priors of 2D diffusion models for 3D editing has emerged as a promising paradigm. However, multi-view consistency remains challenging in edited results, and the extreme scarcity of paired 3D-consistent editing data makes supervised fine-tuning (SFT) impractical, despite its effectiveness for editing tasks. In this paper, we observe that, while generating multi-view consistent 3D content is highly challenging, verifying 3D consistency is tractable, naturally positioning reinforcement learning (RL) as a feasible solution. Motivated by this, we propose RL3DEdit, a single-pass framework driven by RL optimization with novel rewards derived from the 3D foundation model, VGGT. Specifically, we leverage VGGT's robust priors learned from massive real-world data, feed the edited images into it, and utilize the output confidence maps and pose estimation errors as reward signals, effectively anchoring the 2D editing priors onto a 3D-consistent manifold via RL. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RL3DEdit achieves stable multi-view consistency and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in editing quality with high efficiency. To promote the development of 3D editing, we will release the code and model.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026, 32 pages, 10 figures, with Appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RL3DEdit，一种基于强化学习（RL）的单次编辑框架，利用 3D 基础模型 VGGT 的奖励信号，将 2D 扩散模型先验锚定到 3D 一致流形上，实现多视图一致的场景编辑。摘要称该方法在编辑质量上优于现有方法，且推理高效。
Motivation: 现有的基于 2D 扩散先验的 3D 编辑方法常面临多视图不一致问题，而收集成对的 3D 一致编辑数据极其困难，使得监督微调（SFT）不可行，因此需要一种无监督或弱监督的方案。
Method: 采用强化学习优化，将编辑后的多视图图像输入预训练的 3D 基础模型 VGGT，利用其输出的置信度图和姿态估计误差作为奖励信号，通过 RL 更新 2D 编辑模型，使其生成的结果符合 3D 一致性。
Result: 实验表明 RL3DEdit 能稳定实现多视图一致性，并在编辑质量上超越当前最优方法，且推理效率高。
Conclusion: 作者将为社区公开代码和模型，以促进 3D 编辑领域的发展。

papers.title: What Capable Agents Must Know: Selection Theorems for Robust Decision-Making under Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: As artificial agents become increasingly capable, what internal structure is necessary for an agent to act competently under uncertainty? Classical results show that optimal control can be implemented using belief states or world models, but not that such representations are required. We prove quantitative "selection theorems" showing that strong task performance (low average-case regret) forces world models, belief-like memory and -- under task mixtures -- persistent regime-tracking variables resembling functional primitives of emotion, along with informational modularity under block-structured tasks. Our results cover stochastic policies, partial observability, and evaluation under task distributions, without assuming optimality, determinism, or access to an explicit model. Technically, we reduce predictive modeling to binary "betting" decisions and show that regret bounds limit probability mass on suboptimal bets, enforcing the predictive distinctions needed to separate high-margin outcomes. In fully observed settings, this yields approximate recovery of the interventional transition kernel; under partial observability, it implies necessity of predictive state and belief-like memory, addressing an open question in prior world-model recovery work.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 1 figure. To appear in Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明强任务性能（低平均后悔）迫使智能体必须拥有世界模型、信念类记忆以及任务混合下的持久状态跟踪变量（类似情感功能基元），并在块结构任务下需要信息模块化。结果覆盖随机策略、部分可观测性、任务分布评估，不假设最优性或显式模型。
Motivation: 经典结果表明最优控制可用信念状态或世界模型实现，但未证明这类表示是必要的。本文希望证明强性能必然要求这些内部结构。
Method: 将预测建模约简为二进制“下注”决策，通过后悔界限制约下注的概率质量，从而强制预测区分以分离高余量结果。在完全可观测下近似恢复干预转移核；在部分可观测下证明预测状态和信念类记忆的必要性。
Result: 证明了在任务分布下低平均后悔强制世界模型、信念类记忆和持久状态变量，以及信息模块化。
Conclusion: 本文提供了定量选择定理，确立了强鲁棒决策所需的必要内部结构，并解决了先前世界模型恢复工作中的开放问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Not Just How Much, But Where: Decomposing Epistemic Uncertainty into Per-Class Contributions
papers.abstract_en: In safety-critical classification, the cost of failure is often asymmetric, yet Bayesian deep learning summarises epistemic uncertainty with a single scalar, mutual information (MI), that cannot distinguish whether a model's ignorance involves a benign or safety-critical class. We decompose MI into a per-class vector $C_k(x)=σ_k^{2}/(2μ_k)$, with $μ_k{=}\mathbb{E}[p_k]$ and $σ_k^2{=}\mathrm{Var}[p_k]$ across posterior samples. The decomposition follows from a second-order Taylor expansion of the entropy; the $1/μ_k$ weighting corrects boundary suppression and makes $C_k$ comparable across rare and common classes. By construction $\sum_k C_k \approx \mathrm{MI}$, and a companion skewness diagnostic flags inputs where the approximation degrades. After characterising the axiomatic properties of $C_k$, we validate it on three tasks: (i) selective prediction for diabetic retinopathy, where critical-class $C_k$ reduces selective risk by 34.7\% over MI and 56.2\% over variance baselines; (ii) out-of-distribution detection on clinical and image benchmarks, where $\sum_k C_k$ achieves the highest AUROC and the per-class view exposes asymmetric shifts invisible to MI; and (iii) a controlled label-noise study in which $\sum_k C_k$ shows less sensitivity to injected aleatoric noise than MI under end-to-end Bayesian training, while both metrics degrade under transfer learning. Across all tasks, the quality of the posterior approximation shapes uncertainty at least as strongly as the choice of metric, suggesting that how uncertainty is propagated through the network matters as much as how it is measured.
papers.journal_ref: Forty-Second Annual Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence}, year={2026}, url={https://openreview.net/forum?id=cxuWscJmAr}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对安全关键分类中认知不确定性度量无法区分不同类别的问题，提出将互信息（MI）分解为每个类别的贡献向量C_k(x)=σ_k^2/(2μ_k)，其中μ_k和σ_k^2分别为后验样本中该类概率的均值和方差。该分解通过二阶泰勒展开推导，并引入偏度诊断指标。在糖尿病视网膜病变选择性预测中，关键类C_k将选择性风险降低34.7%（优于MI）和56.2%（优于方差基线）；在OOD检测中，∑C_k获得最高AUROC，且逐类视图能暴露MI无法检测的不对称偏移；在标签噪声研究中，端到端贝叶斯训练下∑C_k对噪声的敏感性低于MI。
Motivation: 标准贝叶斯深度学习使用单一标量MI汇总认知不确定性，无法区分模型对安全关键类别的无知，而安全关键任务中不同类别的失败代价不对称。
Method: 将MI分解为每个类别的C_k(x)=σ_k^2/(2μ_k)，基于后验样本的均值和方差，通过二阶泰勒展开推导，并引入偏度诊断指标以评估近似质量。
Result: 在糖尿病视网膜病变选择性预测中，关键类C_k将选择性风险降低34.7%（对比MI）和56.2%（对比方差基线）；OOD检测中∑C_k取得最高AUROC，逐类视图揭示MI无法捕获的不对称偏移；标签噪声实验中，端到端贝叶斯训练下∑C_k对噪音的敏感性低于MI。
Conclusion: 后验近似的质量对不确定性的影响至少与度量选择同样重要，建议关注不确定性在网络中的传播方式。

papers.title: Momentum Guidance: Plug-and-Play Guidance for Flow Models
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based generative methods offer a simple and effective framework for high-fidelity generation, yet pretrained flow models are rarely used in their vanilla conditional form: in image generation, samples without guidance often appear diffuse and lack fine-grained detail. Existing guidance techniques such as classifier-free guidance (CFG) improve fidelity but reduce sample diversity. We introduce Momentum Guidance (MG), a guidance method that improves sample quality by extrapolating the current velocity away from an exponential moving average of past velocities along the ODE trajectory, while preserving the standard one-evaluation-per-step cost. MG provides gains beyond CFG, improving the precision-recall Pareto frontier. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MG across benchmarks. On ImageNet-256, MG improves FID by 36.54% without CFG and 25.42% with CFG on average across sampling settings, attaining an FID of 1.553 at 16 sampling steps. Evaluations on large flow-based models, including Stable Diffusion 3 and FLUX.1-dev, further confirm improvements across standard metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动量引导（Momentum Guidance, MG），一种用于流模型（flow models）的即插即用引导方法。MG通过沿ODE轨迹将当前速度外推远离其指数移动平均来提升样本质量，且不增加每步计算成本。在ImageNet-256上，无CFG时FID改善36.54%，结合CFG时改善25.42%，16步达到FID 1.553；在Stable Diffusion 3和FLUX.1-dev上也验证了有效性。
Motivation: 预训练流模型在无引导时生成样本缺乏细节，现有引导技术（如classifier-free guidance）提升保真度但降低多样性，需要一种在不牺牲多样性的前提下提升质量的引导方法。
Method: 动量引导在ODE求解的每一步，将当前速度向量外推远离其指数移动平均（EMA），从而放大速度的偏离趋势；保持每步一次评估的标准成本。
Result: 在ImageNet-256上，MG使FID平均提升36.54%（无CFG）和25.42%（有CFG），16步采样FID达1.553；在Stable Diffusion 3和FLUX.1-dev上，标准指标也得到改善。
Conclusion: MG是一种即插即用的引导方法，能在不增加计算成本的情况下提升流模型的生成质量，并在多种基准和模型上取得一致改进。

papers.title: Enhanced Diffusion Sampling: Efficient Rare Event Sampling and Free Energy Calculation with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: The rare-event sampling problem has long been the central limiting factor in molecular dynamics (MD), especially in biomolecular simulation. Recently, diffusion models such as BioEmu have emerged as powerful equilibrium samplers that generate independent samples from complex molecular distributions, eliminating the cost of sampling rare transition events. However, a sampling problem remains when computing observables that rely on states which are rare in equilibrium, for example folding free energies. Here, we introduce enhanced diffusion sampling, enabling efficient exploration of rare-event regions while preserving unbiased thermodynamic estimators. The key idea is to perform quantitatively accurate steering protocols to generate biased ensembles and subsequently recover equilibrium statistics via exact reweighting. We instantiate our framework in three algorithms: UmbrellaDiff (umbrella sampling with diffusion models), MetaDiff (a batchwise analogue for metadynamics), and $Δ$G-Diff (free-energy differences via tilted ensembles). Across toy systems, protein folding landscapes and folding free energies, our methods achieve fast, accurate, and scalable estimation of equilibrium properties within GPU-minutes to hours per system-closing the rare-event sampling gap that remained after the advent of diffusion-model equilibrium samplers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分子动力学中稀有事件采样问题，提出增强扩散采样框架，将扩散模型与稀有事件采样技术结合。具体算法包括UmbrellaDiff（伞形采样+扩散模型）、MetaDiff（元动力学批量模拟）和ΔG-Diff（倾斜系综自由能差）。在玩具系统和蛋白质折叠自由能计算上，方法实现了快速、准确、可扩展的平衡性质估计，每个系统耗时GPU分钟到小时，弥合了扩散模型平衡采样器出现后残留的稀有事件采样差距。
Motivation: 稀有事件采样是分子动力学长期限制因素，扩散模型虽能生成平衡样本，但计算涉及稀有状态的观测量（如折叠自由能）仍有采样问题。
Method: 提出增强扩散采样框架，通过定量准确的引导协议生成有偏系综，然后通过精确重加权恢复平衡统计。具体实现三个算法：UmbrellaDiff（伞形采样+扩散模型）、MetaDiff（元动力学批量模拟）和ΔG-Diff（倾斜系综自由能差）。
Result: 在玩具系统、蛋白质折叠景观和折叠自由能上，方法实现了快速、准确、可扩展的平衡性质估计，每个系统耗时GPU分钟到小时。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法关闭了扩散模型平衡采样器出现后残留的稀有事件采样差距，实现了快速准确的平衡性质估计。
