papers.title: A Novel Latent-Class Attack and its Detection by Class Subspace Orthogonalization
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning, which in general relies on voluminous amounts of training data, is vulnerable to data poisoning attacks, including error-generic attacks and backdoors (Trojans). In this work, we propose a new data poisoning attack we dub a latent class attack. Here, all poisoned examples are from a class that is novel (unknown) for the given classification domain and are mislabeled to one of the known classes (the target class) of the domain, so that the model learns to recognize the novel class as a sub-class of the target class. Such attacks could be used e.g. to defeat AI-based access control systems, or could cause a "foe" to be classified as a "friend". We also propose a post-training defense to detect this attack, without any access to the training set. This detection approach builds on "class subspace orthogonalization" (CSO), a plug-and-play paradigm demonstrated to improve existing backdoor detectors. Here, CSO is used to seek an input (a putative unknown class instance) whose internal representation is not aligned with any of the known classes, and yet which is classified with confidence to one of these classes. Finally, specific to image classification domains, we propose a method for visualizing the estimated unknown class instance, providing explainability to our latent class detections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的数据投毒攻击——潜在类别攻击（latent class attack），其中所有投毒样本来自分类域中未知的新类，并被错误标记为某个已知目标类，使模型将新类学习为目标类的子类。同时提出一种基于类子空间正交化（CSO）的后训练防御方法，无需访问训练集即可检测此类攻击，并在图像分类域中提供了可视化方法以增强可解释性。
Motivation: 深度学习模型依赖于大量训练数据，易受数据投毒攻击（如错误泛化攻击和后门攻击）。现有攻击和防御方法尚未考虑利用未知类别进行投毒的场景，本文填补了这一空白。
Method: 提出潜在类别攻击，构造来自新类的样本并错误标记为已知类；防御方法基于类子空间正交化（CSO），通过寻找内部表示与所有已知类均不对齐但仍被高置信度分类的输入来检测攻击。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称该方法能检测潜在类别攻击，且CSO可改进现有后门检测器。
Conclusion: 提出了一种新的攻击范式及其对应的无需训练集的防御机制，并在图像域展示了可视化结果以提供可解释性。

papers.title: Managing the Human Fallback: Skill Investment Under Improving AI and Worker Mobility
papers.abstract_en: When firms deploy autonomous AI, they must decide how much work to leave to the system and how much to keep workers engaged. This decision affects current output and future human capital. We develop a parsimonious two-period model in which AI may outperform the worker when it functions, but may fail with positive probability. A firm chooses worker engagement; engagement lowers current output for below-benchmark workers, but changes future skill through learning and erosion. We distinguish two dimensions of AI progress: capability, the system's output when it works, and reliability, the probability that it works. In a single-firm benchmark, engagement is valuable only as fallback investment. The firm engages the least-skilled workers most, because they have the largest skill gaps and are least costly to bring toward a useful fallback level. With worker mobility, engagement also affects labor-market sorting: workers prefer jobs that build more valuable skill trajectories. This sorting motive targets higher-skill workers near the AI frontier, where skill gains are more valuable and engagement is less costly. Mobility can therefore reverse the engagement pattern, shifting investment from the least-skilled toward the most-skilled workers below the AI benchmark. Mobility also reshapes how AI progress affects engagement: greater capability raises engagement by increasing the value of the skill trajectory a firm offers, whereas greater reliability can raise or lower it because it reduces fallback need while also changing learning opportunities. Under worker mobility, human-AI work design becomes a problem of human-capital investment, in which allocating work today shapes future skill.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个两期模型，研究企业在部署可能故障的自主AI时，如何分配工作给工人（engagement）以平衡当前产出与未来人力资本。模型区分AI的capability（正常运行时产出）和reliability（正常运行概率），在单一企业场景下，engagement仅作为fallback投资，企业最倾向于培训最不熟练的工人；引入工人流动性后，engagement影响劳动力市场分类，可能转向培训更接近AI前沿的高技能工人。流动性还改变了AI进步对engagement的影响方向。
Motivation: 企业部署自主AI时，需决定将多少工作留给系统、多少留给工人，这一决策影响当前产出和未来人力资本。现有理论缺乏对AI能力与可靠性不同维度及工人流动性的系统分析。
Method: 建立两期解析模型，将AI进步分解为capability（正常产出）和reliability（正常运行概率）；通过比较静态分析，研究单一企业基准与工人流动性两种场景下engagement的最优决策及其对技能投资的影响。
Result: 单一企业基准下，engagement仅作为fallback，最不熟练工人获得最多培训；工人流动性下，engagement反转，高技能工人获得更多投资。更高的capability提高engagement，更高的reliability对engagement的影响因降低fallback需求与改变学习机会而方向不定。
Conclusion: 工人流动性将人機协作从fallback问题转变为人力资本投资问题；未来研究可考虑更复杂的市场结构或内生AI进步。

papers.title: Few-Step Boltzmann Generators via Scalable Likelihood Flow Maps
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in flow-based generative modeling has led to models that output high-quality samples while using only a small number of function evaluations. However, at present, there is a lack of similar advances in estimating the model likelihood. In particular, most existing methods either rely on restrictive architectures that enable exact calculations, or use stochastic approximations such as Hutchinson's trace estimator that introduce substantial variance. In this work, we introduce SCAlable LikeLihood distillation of flOw maPs (SCALLOP). SCALLOP builds on the recently proposed F2D2, a likelihood flow map model that can generate samples and their densities in a small number of function evaluations. While F2D2 uses Hutchinson's estimator during training, we introduce an alternative and more scalable likelihood distillation objective that is Hutchinson-free and admits a vectorized formulation. Empirically, we demonstrate the effectiveness of SCALLOP as a Boltzmann generator in molecular science, and further validate its benefit on image datasets. SCALLOP significantly reduces both training variance and training time while consistently improving performance compared to F2D2, and is competitive with the state-of-the-art while achieving up to 10x inference speedup over the fastest baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCALLOP (SCAlable LikeLihood distillation of flOw maPs)，一种基于F2D2的可扩展似然蒸馏方法。它通过无Hutchinson估计器的向量化蒸馏目标，降低训练方差和加速训练，在分子科学和图像数据集上性能优于F2D2，推理速度比最快基线快10倍。
Motivation: 现有流生成模型在似然估计中要么使用限制性架构精确计算，要么采用Hutchinson迹估计器引入高方差，缺乏可扩展的似然蒸馏方法。
Method: SCALLOP构建于F2D2之上，用无Hutchinson的似然蒸馏目标替代原始训练中的Hutchinson估计器，支持向量化实现，提高可扩展性。
Result: 显著降低训练方差和训练时间，一致优于F2D2，与最先进方法竞争，推理加速达10倍。
Conclusion: SCALLOP作为Boltzmann生成器在分子科学和图像任务上有效，实现了更快的推理和更好的性能。

papers.title: A Deep Multiscale Neural Network for Accurate Neurological Disorder Detection from MRI Scans and Real-Time Web Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Neurological disorders involve diverse pathologies of the brain and nervous system, making early and accurate detection essential. While many deep CNNs have been developed for MRI-based classification of neurological disorders, most are optimized for binary tasks and often fail to capture the multi-class features needed to distinguish subtle anatomical differences across conditions. This study proposes the Enhanced Neurological Disorder Detection Network (End-Net) for multi-class MRI classification of neurological disorders. End-Net includes 24 convolutional layers, beginning with convolutional blocks followed by 21 optimized inception modules. These modules extract multiscale features via parallel 1 x 1, 3 x 3, and factorized 5 x 5 convolutional branches, along with max pooling, enabling the model to capture complementary texture, edge, shape, and contextual information. A global average pooling head, compact fully connected classifier, and dropout reduce parameters, limit overfitting, and improve robustness. End-Net was evaluated on the Multi-Class Neurological Disorder dataset, comprising MRI scans from patients with Alzheimer's disease, brain tumors, multiple sclerosis, and healthy controls. Severe class imbalance was addressed by augmenting minority classes with WGAN-GP and randomly undersampling the majority class. The results show that End-Net outperforms existing architectures in both accuracy and generalization. The model is also integrated into an online system for real-time web-based inference and accessibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Enhanced Neurological Disorder Detection Network (End-Net)用于多类MRI神经疾病分类，包括24个卷积层和21个优化Inception模块，提取多尺度特征。在包含阿尔茨海默病、脑肿瘤、多发性硬化及健康对照的数据集上，使用WGAN-GP增强少数类，End-Net在准确率和泛化性上优于现有架构，并集成到在线系统实现实时推理。
Motivation: 现有深度CNN多优化用于二分类任务，难以捕捉多类特征以区分神经疾病的细微解剖差异，缺少多类MRI分类的高效模型。
Method: 提出End-Net，包含24个卷积层，前为卷积块，后接21个优化Inception模块，通过并行1x1、3x3、分解5x5卷积分支及最大池化提取多尺度特征，使用全局平均池化、紧凑全连接分类器和dropout降低参数量、防止过拟合。对类别不平衡使用WGAN-GP增强少数类和随机欠采样多数类。
Result: 在多类神经疾病数据集上，End-Net在准确率和泛化性上优于现有架构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调End-Net为多类MRI神经疾病检测提供了高准确性和泛化能力，并支持实时网络推理。

papers.title: spca: An R package to Compute Least Squares Sparse Principal Components
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces the R package spca, which provides a computational framework for least squares sparse principal component analysis (LS-SPCA). Unlike other SPCA methods, LS-SPCA generates uncorrelated sparse principal components (sPCs) that effectively maximize the explained variance while maintaining strong correlations with standard principal components (PCs). The framework also includes more computationally efficient variants that produce mildly correlated sPCs, which often have lower cardinality while explaining equal or greater variance than the LS-SPCA optimal sPCs. The spca package is built on an efficient C++ backend for matrix computations, with distinct engines for tall and fat matrices, and a flexible R frontend. The user interface offers several options for computing sPCs, such as deciding whether sparsification should stop when a threshold for cumulative variance explained or R2 with the PCs is reached, and choosing between simple forward selection, stepwise forward selection, or backward elimination for variable selection. In addition to the print(), summary(), and plot() methods, the package includes tools for comparing different "spca" solutions, grouping sparse loadings, and representing foreign SPCA solutions as "spca" objects. This article demonstrates with real datasets the use of the package in a typical LS-SPCA workflow and briefly contrasts LS-SPCA with conventional SPCA solutions . Then it compares different LS-SPCA solutions obtained from the dataset. Finally, the performance of spca on large tall and fat matrices is discussed, showing that spca offers a computationally efficient alternative for computing interpretable sPCs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍R包spca，用于最小二乘稀疏主成分分析（LS-SPCA），生成不相关的稀疏主成分，最大化解释方差。包基于C++后端，支持高瘦和宽胖矩阵，提供前向选择、逐步前向选择、后向消除等变量选择策略。通过真实数据集演示工作流，并与传统SPCA对比，展示在大规模矩阵上的计算效率。
Motivation: 现有稀疏PCA方法常生成相关成分或解释方差不足；LS-SPCA旨在生成不相关的稀疏主成分，同时保持与标准主成分的强相关性，最大化解释方差。
Method: 提出LS-SPCA框架，包括最优与计算高效变体；R包spca基于C++后端，支持高瘦和宽胖矩阵，提供多种变量选择选项（如简单前向、逐步前向、后向消除）及阈值停止规则。
Result: 通过真实数据集展示工作流，与常规SPCA对比；在大型高瘦和宽胖矩阵上，spca提供计算效率高的可解释稀疏主成分。
Conclusion: spca包为LS-SPCA提供了灵活高效的计算工具，尤其适合大规模数据，能生成可解释的稀疏主成分。

papers.title: BTI-Net: Bidirectional Decoder-Level Task Interaction via Uncertainty-Aware Gating for Multi-Task Medical Image Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Jointly learning to segment and classify medical images demands cross-task synergy, yet encoder-sharing architectures limit decoder reconstruction to task-private representations, permanently discarding the boundary cues and semantic priors each branch could supply to the other. This work introduces BTI-Net, which establishes bidirectional communication at every decoder level through two parallel pathways via Task Interaction Modules (TIM). Spatial boundary context is gated into the classification branch, while global semantic priors multiplicatively modulate the decoder, with refined features propagating progressively from coarse semantics to fine boundary detail across all four decoder resolutions. Since cross-task interaction is not equally reliable for every input, Uncertainty Proxy Attention (UPA) gates each TIM output per instance and per level using three signals that capture cross-task alignment, scene complexity, and prediction confidence, without external annotations or additional inference passes. Experiments on three medical benchmarks spanning ultrasound, dermoscopy, and brain MRI demonstrate consistent improvements in segmentation IoU and classification accuracy over both encoder-sharing and decoder-interaction baselines. Ablation confirms adaptive gating contributes +2.36 IoU over fixed bidirectional interaction, and classification accuracy improves by up to +2.26 points over the strongest multi-task baseline. UPA's uncertainty proxies serve as reliable single-pass task-failure signals without the overhead of stochastic sampling. Code: https://github.com/C-loud-Nine/BTI-Net_MTL
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables; supplementary material included (8 pages, 19 figures, 18 tables)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BTI-Net 提出了一种双向解码器级任务交互机制，用于医学图像中的分割与分类多任务学习。通过任务交互模块 (TIM) 在解码器各层交换边界和语义信息，并利用不确定性代理注意力 (UPA) 自适应地门控交互信号。在超声、皮肤镜和脑 MRI 三个基准上，分割 IoU 和分类准确率均优于编码器共享和解码器交互基线。
Motivation: 现有编码器共享的多任务架构在解码阶段限制了任务间信息交换，导致边界线索和语义先验未被充分利用，限制了分割与分类的协同效果。
Method: 提出 BTI-Net，在每个解码器层级通过并行路径建立双向任务交互：TIM 将空间边界上下文注入分类分支，并将全局语义先验调制分割解码器；UPA 利用跨任务对齐、场景复杂度和预测置信度三个信号，按实例和层级自适应门控交互强度，无需额外标注或推理。
Result: 在三个医学图像基准上，分割 IoU 和分类准确率持续提升；消融实验显示自适应门控相比固定双向交互提升 +2.36 IoU，分类准确率相比最强多任务基线提升最多 +2.26 个百分点。
Conclusion: BTI-Net 通过双向解码器级任务交互和不确定性感知门控，有效提升了多任务医学图像分析的性能，且 UPA 可作为可靠的单次任务失败信号。

summary_sections.tldr: BTI-Net 提出了一种双向解码器级任务交互机制，用于医学图像中的分割与分类多任务学习。通过任务交互模块 (TIM) 在解码器各层交换边界和语义信息，并利用不确定性代理注意力 (UPA) 自适应地门控交互信号。在超声、皮肤镜和脑 MRI 三个基准上，分割 IoU 和分类准确率均优于编码器共享和解码器交互基线。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有编码器共享的多任务架构在解码阶段限制了任务间信息交换，导致边界线索和语义先验未被充分利用，限制了分割与分类的协同效果。
summary_sections.method: 提出 BTI-Net，在每个解码器层级通过并行路径建立双向任务交互：TIM 将空间边界上下文注入分类分支，并将全局语义先验调制分割解码器；UPA 利用跨任务对齐、场景复杂度和预测置信度三个信号，按实例和层级自适应门控交互强度，无需额外标注或推理。
summary_sections.result: 在三个医学图像基准上，分割 IoU 和分类准确率持续提升；消融实验显示自适应门控相比固定双向交互提升 +2.36 IoU，分类准确率相比最强多任务基线提升最多 +2.26 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: BTI-Net 通过双向解码器级任务交互和不确定性感知门控，有效提升了多任务医学图像分析的性能，且 UPA 可作为可靠的单次任务失败信号。

papers.title: Unified Complex-valued Neural Network: A Magnitude-Phase Computational Model for Event-Driven Neuromorphic Learning
papers.abstract_en: Artificial neural networks (ANN) provide accurate continuous-valued representation, whereas spiking neural networks (SNN) offer event-driven temporal processing, yet both paradigms face limitations when value encoding and timing dynamics must be learned within a single computational structure. This paper introduces a network based on Unified Complex-valued Neuron (UCN), a new neural computational model that integrates continuous activation and phase-driven event generation through an asymmetric complex-valued state. In the UCN, magnitude encodes signal strength while phase governs intrinsic temporal evolution and valued spike emission. A foundational training framework combining backpropagation (BP) and backpropagation through time (BPTT) is first developed to optimize magnitude and phase pathways in a unified way. To reduce computational complexity, an event-driven adaptive phase learning (EAPL) rule is then introduced as a more efficient alternative. The proposed model is evaluated through object tracking and Lorenz attractor learning. Results demonstrate that UCN-based Network (UCNN) provides accurate, stable, and interpretable spatiotemporal learning while preserving sparse event-driven computation for neuromorphic and edge-AI applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出统一复值神经元（UCN）模型，融合连续激活和相位驱动事件生成，用于事件驱动的神经形态学习。通过反向传播和BPTT联合优化幅度和相位路径，并提出事件驱动自适应相位学习（EAPL）规则降低复杂度。在目标跟踪和Lorenz吸引子学习上验证了性能。
Motivation: 传统ANN提供连续值表示，SNN提供事件驱动时序处理，但两者难以在同一结构中同时学习值编码和时序动态。
Method: 基于统一复值神经元（UCN），幅度编码信号强度，相位控制时序演化和脉冲发射。训练框架结合BP和BPTT，并引入事件驱动自适应相位学习（EAPL）规则。
Result: 在目标跟踪和Lorenz吸引子学习任务上，UCNN实现了准确、稳定、可解释的时空学习，同时保持了稀疏事件驱动计算。
Conclusion: 所提模型适用于神经形态和边缘AI应用，提供稀疏事件驱动计算的同时保持学习性能。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Connectivity Estimation using Stochastic Graph Heat Modelling
papers.abstract_en: A growing number of techniques leverage the spatial structures that underlie many real-world datasets. Despite these advances, the complementary task of estimating spatial structures and understanding their role within these techniques has often been overlooked. In neurophysiological data analysis specifically, numerous methods exist to estimate brain connectivity, but most are not explicitly model-based, dynamic, multivariate, or directed. To address these limitations, we previously introduced noise-driven heat modelling on graphs for neurophysiological connectivity estimation. In this study, we extend this framework by relaxing earlier noise assumptions and adding regularisation to improve robustness. We also develop a simulation procedure to characterise and evaluate our technique in a controlled setting. Finally, we demonstrate that the technique is able to capture meaningful spatial structure across two experiments, each using two real-world datasets. The explicit model formulation of our connectivity estimator has the potential to improve the interpretability of graph-based techniques across a wide range of applications. The code implementing our method is available at https://github.com/sgoerttler/Heat_Connectivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于随机图热模型的连接性估计方法，用于神经生理学数据分析。通过放宽噪声假设并加入正则化提高鲁棒性，开发仿真程序进行可控评估，并在两个真实数据集上展示了捕捉空间结构的能力。
Motivation: 现有神经生理学连接性估计方法大多不是基于显式模型、动态、多变量或有向的，缺乏可解释性。
Method: 基于噪声驱动的图热模型，扩展原框架：放松噪声假设、引入正则化，并开发仿真程序用于表征和评估。
Result: 在两个实验（各使用两个真实数据集）中，该方法能够捕捉有意义的空间结构。
Conclusion: 显式模型公式有望提高图基技术在各种应用中的可解释性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TrafficAlign: Aligning Large Language Models for Traffic Scenario Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent research has investigated the use of large language models (LLMs) to generate traffic scenarios for autonomous driving. However, pretrained LLMs often fail to align with real-world traffic distributions. In this work, we present TrafficAlign, an automated framework that synthesizes traffic scenarios based on real-world driving videos, performs data validation, and aligns LLMs with the synthesized scenarios. The evaluation shows that traffic scenarios generated by TrafficAlign are highly effective, revealing up to 10.8% more collisions on average across three autonomous driving models than state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, fine-tuning these driving models with TrafficAlign-generated scenarios significantly reduced collision rates by 36.1% compared with the original models. A qualitative study using traffic datasets from six geographically diverse regions shows that TrafficAlign-generated scenarios exhibit strong alignment with corresponding traffic distributions in these regions.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR), June 2026, pp. 39744-39754
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TrafficAlign，一个基于真实驾驶视频自动合成交通场景的框架，用于对齐大语言模型（LLM）与真实交通分布。评估表明，该框架生成的场景在三个自动驾驶模型上比现有方法平均多暴露 10.8% 的碰撞，且用其微调可使碰撞率降低 36.1%。定性实验显示，生成场景与六个地理区域的交通分布高度对齐。
Motivation: 预训练的 LLM 在生成交通场景时往往无法反映真实世界交通分布，导致生成的场景有效性不足，影响自动驾驶测试与训练。
Method: TrafficAlign 自动从真实驾驶视频中合成带标注的交通场景，通过数据验证和 LLM 对齐训练，使生成场景的分布逼近真实数据。
Result: 在三个自动驾驶模型上，TrafficAlign 比 SOTA 方法平均多发现 10.8% 的碰撞；用其场景微调后，碰撞率下降 36.1%；定性分析表明场景与六地区交通分布高度一致。
Conclusion: TrafficAlign 有效解决了 LLM 与真实交通分布的对齐问题，生成的场景在自动驾驶感知测试与模型改进中均显示出显著效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HorizonRelight: Relighting Long-horizon Videos Consistently via Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion-based video relighting enables controllable relighting from a single input video, but modern video diffusion backbones are trained on short clips and applied to long-horizon videos through chunked sliding-window inference, often causing temporal discontinuities at chunk boundaries. We address this by reframing long-horizon relighting as \emph{temporally conditioned latent domain translation}. Our framework enforces cross-chunk continuity by propagating target-domain latents across boundaries and makes this behavior learnable using \emph{masked target-domain self-conditioning}, training the model to continue from temporally masked propagated context. We further introduce \emph{warm-start prompting} with a relit prompt anchor from a controllable generative model, which establishes the initial target-domain state and creates a general interface for prompt-based relighting. Experiments on in-the-wild long-horizon videos show markedly improved temporal consistency, with chunk-boundary artifacts largely reduced and unwanted appearance changes across chunks greatly suppressed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HorizonRelight，基于扩散Transformer (Diffusion Transformer) 实现长视频的一致重光照。现有扩散模型在处理长视频时，由于分块滑动窗口推理导致时间不连续。作者将长视频重光照重新定义为时序条件潜在域翻译，通过跨块传播目标域潜在表示，并引入掩码目标域自条件训练模型从传播的上下文继续生成。此外，利用可控生成模型的热启动提示建立初始目标域状态。实验表明，该方法显著提升时间一致性，减少块边界伪影和外观变化。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的视频重光照方法在短片段上训练，对长视频进行分块推理时，块边界处常出现时间不连续，影响整体一致性。
Method: 框架包括：(1) 时序条件潜在域翻译，强制跨块连续性；(2) 掩码目标域自条件，使模型学习从传播的上下文继续生成；(3) 热启动提示，利用可控生成模型建立初始目标域状态，实现基于提示的重光照接口。
Result: 在真实世界长视频上，方法显著提升时间一致性，大幅减少块边界伪影，并有效抑制跨块的不期望外观变化。
Conclusion: 将长视频重光照建模为时序条件潜在域翻译，结合掩码自条件和热启动提示，能有效解决分块推理带来的时间不连续问题。

papers.title: DiLaServe: High SLO Attainment Serving for Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to conventional autoregressive language models. By generating multiple tokens in parallel during each denoising step, they offer higher inference throughput while maintaining competitive quality. However, realizing these throughput gains while meeting latency SLOs in a serving system requires addressing challenges introduced by DLMs' unique characteristics. These include navigating the speed-quality tradeoff created by confidence-based denoising, choosing appropriate parallelization levels across model instances under fluctuating load, and coordinating approximate KV caching mechanisms that introduce non-uniform per-step costs. To address these challenges, we present DiLaServe, a cluster-level serving system for DLMs. DiLaServe enables deadline-aware scheduling and adaptive load control through confidence-threshold adjustment, and dynamically reconfigures the cluster by solving a quality-aware optimization problem, while explicitly modeling the step-level heterogeneity introduced by approximate KV caching. Across multiple benchmarks and real-world traces, DiLaServe improves SLO attainment by up to 56.6 percentage points and reduces end-to-end request latency by up to 46\% while incurring less than 1\% accuracy drop.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DiLaServe 是一个面向扩散语言模型 (DLM) 的集群级服务系统。它解决了 DLM 在服务中面临的置信度去噪带来的速度-质量权衡、负载波动下的并行化选择以及近似 KV 缓存导致的非均匀每步成本等挑战。通过截止时间感知调度、置信度阈值自适应负载控制和质量感知优化动态重配置，在多个基准和真实轨迹上，DiLaServe 将 SLO 达成率提升最高 56.6 个百分点，端到端延迟降低最多 46%，且准确率下降小于 1%。
Motivation: 扩散语言模型在服务系统中实现吞吐量优势的同时满足延迟 SLO 面临挑战，包括置信度去噪带来的速度-质量权衡、负载波动下模型实例并行化选择以及近似 KV 缓存导致的非均匀每步成本。
Method: DiLaServe 采用截止时间感知调度和通过置信度阈值调整的自适应负载控制，通过求解质量感知优化问题动态重配置集群，并显式建模近似 KV 缓存引入的步骤级异构性。
Result: 在多个基准和真实轨迹上，DiLaServe 将 SLO 达成率提升最高 56.6 个百分点，端到端请求延迟降低最多 46%，且准确率下降小于 1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DiLaServe 有效应对了 DLM 服务系统的独特挑战，实现了高 SLO 达成率与低延迟。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Fog Chamber to Aircraft Window: Pixel-Registered Imaging and Synthetic Fine-Tuning Enable Cross-Domain Defogging
papers.abstract_en: A deep defogging pipeline pretrained on controlled laboratory fog and fine-tuned with domain-randomized synthetic fog applied to clear outdoor scenes generalizes across a graded sequence of out-of-distribution settings with no target-domain training, from chamber-free free-flowing fog to iPhone video recorded through an aircraft cabin window in flight, an entirely unseen sensor, scene, and optical path. This directly addresses an open transfer limitation reported for real-world binocular defogging. Two design choices support the transfer. First, a single-camera fog imager photographs a flat-panel display through an artificial-fog enclosure with a fixed 114~mm scattering path, producing 5{,}495 pixel-aligned foggy/clear pairs. Exact registration permits a paired Laplacian ratio that predicts per-image restoration quality far better than single-image proxies (Spearman $ρ= 0.632$ versus $0.399$) and supports pixel-exact $L_1$ reconstruction training that avoids adversarial hallucination. Second, the fog-chamber checkpoint is fine-tuned on Mapillary Vistas crops overlaid with on-the-fly randomized synthetic fog spanning a broad range of strengths, spatial variations, airlights, and noise conditions. On a 552-image held-out split, a uniform comparison of 30 restoration backbones places NAFNet at the top (24.33~dB~/~0.7912~SSIM), with a compact alternative within 1.29~dB at 3\% of the parameter count, and a ResNet-50 classifier confirms that the restoration preserves semantic content rather than only pixel-level structure. On unpaired aircraft-window video, NIQE decreases from a mean of 6.22 to 4.97 after fine-tuning, with temporally stable output across full-motion sequences. The same backbone, under paired supervision, also reaches 20.71~dB~/~0.683~SSIM on a non-overlapping O-HAZE/NH-HAZE split (a transferability check rather than a competitive ranking).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于像素对齐的雾/清晰图像对（通过雾室拍摄平显示屏）和域随机化合成雾微调的深度去雾管道，无需目标域训练即可泛化到多种未见过的场景，包括飞机窗户外视频。
Motivation: 实际双目去雾存在跨域迁移限制，现有方法在传感器、场景和光路完全变化时性能下降。
Method: 构建单相机雾成像器，在固定114mm散射路径的雾室中拍摄平板显示器，得到5495对像素对齐的雾/清晰图像；在此基础上进行像素级L1重建训练。然后使用Mapillary Vistas的作物叠加随机合成雾进行微调。

papers.title: Priced Motion Through Optimal Faces: A Normal-Fan Geometry for Non-Stationary Adversarial MDPs
papers.abstract_en: In a changing decision problem, standard dynamic-regret analyses have often equated the cost of non-stationarity to how far loss moves. However, it is simultaneously possible for a loss sequence to travel far and retain the same optimal policy, or for a small movement in loss to force the optimal policy to change completely. Thus, the size of the movement through loss variation, transition variation, or comparator path length describe the adversary's motion, but not the cost of that motion to the control problem. For a more faithful analytic interpretation, this paper develops a normal-fan geometry for finite-horizon adversarial MDPs with fixed transitions. Occupancy measures form a polytope, and each loss vector exposes an optimal face of that polytope. Non-stationarity in rewards is therefore a path through the normal fan, where motion inside one cone leaves the optimal face unchanged, while crossing a wall may carry regret. We pose the notion of a face-crossing price, which is the minimum regret incurred by remaining on the previous optimal face under the new loss. For any learner that tracks the previous face, dynamic regret decomposes exactly into intrinsic priced face motion plus within-face selection error. The resulting theory separates consequential from harmless non-stationarity, where loss variation can be arbitrarily large at zero price, and identical one-coordinate variation can hide horizon-scale differences in regret.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非平稳对抗马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的动态遗憾分析，提出了一种基于法扇（normal fan）的几何框架。在固定转移的有限视界对抗MDP中，占据测度构成多胞体，每个损失向量暴露该多胞体的一个最优面。非平稳性对应法扇中的路径，其中在同一锥内的运动不改变最优面，而跨过边界可能产生遗憾。论文定义了“面跨越价格”（face-crossing price），即在新损失下停留在前一最优面上的最小遗憾。对于任何跟踪前一最优面的学习器，动态遗憾可精确分解为内在有价格的面运动加上面内选择误差。该理论区分了有后果和无后果的非平稳性：损失变化可以在零价格下任意大，而相同的一坐标变化可能隐藏视界尺度的遗憾差异。
Motivation: 现有动态遗憾分析常将非平稳性成本等同于损失移动的距离，但损失序列可能移动很远却保持相同最优策略，或微小移动导致最优策略完全改变。因此，需要更忠实的分析来解释非平稳性对控制问题的实际成本。
Method: 提出法扇几何：对固定转移的有限视界对抗MDP，占据测度构成多胞体，损失向量暴露最优面。非平稳性被建模为法扇中的路径，并定义面跨越价格（face-crossing price）作为停留在前一最优面下的最小遗憾。动态遗憾分解为有价格的面运动加上面内选择误差。
Result: 摘要指出，动态遗憾可精确分解为内在有价格的面运动与面内选择误差之和。损失变化可以在零价格下任意大，而相同的一坐标变化可能隐藏视界尺度的遗憾差异。
Conclusion: 该理论区分了有后果和无后果的非平稳性，为理解非平稳环境中运动与遗憾的关系提供了新视角，但限于固定转移和有限视界设定。

papers.title: Statistically Indistinguishable, Operationally Distinct: A Formal Barrier for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models cannot reason about data produced by running systems without access to the rules that govern them. We make this statement falsifiable. The \emph{Operational Turing Test} (OTT) constructs pairs of legal and rule-violating database states whose $1$- and $2$-way column-value marginals match to a total variation of $<0.02$; Le~Cam's lemma then bounds any values-only classifier at $\geq0.49$ Bayes error. Three values-only baselines (XGBoost, TabICL, TabPFN) hit the bound exactly (accuracy $0.50$, pre-registered two one-sided tests (TOST) $p<0.002$), raw row-level access does not help, exposing relational value consistency closes most of the gap, and only a classifier fed by seven executable rule-derived audits reaches $1.00$ classification accuracy. In three matched $100$-state frontier large-language-model (LLM) runs, models given the schema, trigger source, rule tables, and state files classify at most $2/50$ legal states as LEGAL; GPT-5.5 accepts $0/50$ legal states even with higher reasoning effort and a Structured Query Language (SQL) executor. The access-ladder pattern also appears on a second schema with structurally distinct rule families (banking ledger: cross-row balance, cumulative aggregate). The barrier is identifiability, not capacity: scale, data, and richer features cannot cross it without operational grounding.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2nd ICML Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出"操作图灵测试"(OTT)用于检验表格基础模型能否推理数据产生规则。通过构造合法与违规数据库状态对，其1-维和2-维列-值边际分布几乎相同（总变差<0.02），理论上任何仅基于值的分类器Bayes误差≥0.49。实验表明XGBoost、TabICL、TabPFN等基线准确率恰好为0.50，LLM即使获得模式、规则表等信息也无法正确分类合法状态，而基于规则审计的分类器可达1.00准确率。该障碍源于可识别性，而非模型容量，即使扩大规模或增加特征也无法跨越。
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型在处理由运行系统产生的数据时，无法推理其背后的规则，论文旨在严格证明这一局限并揭示其根本原因。
Method: 提出操作图灵测试(OTT)，通过生成合法与违规数据库状态对，控制其列-值边际分布高度相似，然后测试不同模型能否区分。并对比仅基于值的分类器、基于关系值一致性的分类器、基于规则审计的分类器以及LLM的表现。
Result: 三个仅基于值的基线（XGBoost、TabICL、TabPFN）准确率恰好0.50，达到理论Bayes误差下界；原始行级访问无帮助；暴露关系值一致性可缩小差距；只有使用七个可执行规则推导的审计的分类器达到1.00准确率。LLM在多个实验中最多只能正确分类2/50的合法状态。同一模式在银行分类账上重复验证得到类似结果。
Conclusion: 表格基础模型面临的障碍是可识别性，而非模型容量：仅基于统计分布无法区分操作上不同的状态，必须通过访问底层规则或操作审计才能实现可靠推理。

papers.title: AB-RAG: Adaptive Budgeted Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Reliable Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become the standard way to ground large language models in external knowledge, yet most systems retrieve a fixed number of passages for every question regardless of its difficulty. This wastes computation on easy questions, starves hard ones, and gives no signal for when a generated answer can be trusted. With a growing share of question answering systems built on top of commercial language model APIs, a method that can decide how much to retrieve, and how far to trust its own answers, without retraining the underlying model, is of clear practical value. This paper presents AB-RAG (Adaptive Budgeted Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a training-free and backbone-agnostic framework that generates an answer, estimates its confidence from a combination of three signals, and then decides whether to stop or to retrieve more evidence, subject to a fixed retrieval budget. The estimator combines the model's own certainty, the agreement between the answer and the evidence, and the variance of the retrieval scores. For models that expose token probabilities the certainty signal is read directly; for closed APIs it is approximated by self-consistency, so the method works without access to model internals. Across three backbones and two datasets, the central result is that the confidence estimate reliably separates correct from incorrect answers on every backbone, reaching a clean split of 57.6% against 0% Exact Match between high- and low-confidence answers on a factoid dataset. The adaptive policy improves accuracy on capable backbones, and the study reports its negative and nuanced findings honestly, including a confidence signal that proved unsuitable for short answers and a retrieval signal whose sign was found and corrected through measurement. The entire study was carried out on a single consumer laptop with only a few dollars of API spend.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AB-RAG，一种无需训练、与骨干模型无关的自适应预算检索增强生成框架，用于可靠问答。该框架首先生成答案，然后结合模型置信度、答案与证据的一致性、检索分数方差三种信号估计置信度，并在固定检索预算下决定是否停止或检索更多证据。实验表明，置信度估计能可靠区分正确与错误答案，在事实型数据集上高置信度答案的精确匹配率达57.6%，而低置信度答案率为0%。
Motivation: 现有的检索增强生成系统对所有问题检索固定数量的段落，浪费计算资源于简单问题，而对困难问题支持不足，且无法提供生成答案的可信度信号。
Method: 提出AB-RAG框架：先由LLM生成答案，然后使用三个信号（模型自身确定性、答案与证据一致性、检索分数方差）估计置信度，对于开放API，用自一致性近似模型确定性；最后根据置信度决定是否还需检索更多证据，直至达到固定预算。
Result: 在三种骨干模型和两个数据集上，置信度估计能有效区分正确与错误答案，在事实型数据集中高置信度答案的精确匹配率为57.6%，低置信度答案为0%。自适应策略提升了骨干模型在困难问题上的准确性。
Conclusion: AB-RAG是一种无需训练、与模型无关的轻量级方法，可在固定检索预算下提高RAG系统的可靠性和效率。

papers.title: Diff-Based Code Corruption using LLMs for Large-Scale Bugfix Benchmarking
papers.abstract_en: There are various benchmarks to evaluate bugfixing capabilities of Large Language Models. However, most widespread benchmarks do not fully reflect real-world bugfixing practices. They are small, weakening statistical reliability, and the buggy programs are often similar to one another, potentially distorting evaluation results. The range of bug types can also be narrow, failing to capture a representative range of bugs. To address these issues, we introduce MegaBugFix, a large-scale bugfixing benchmark containing 12,629 buggy Python programs synthesized from correct ones by a Large Language Model. Bug injections were generated as diffs representing code changes. Through this approach, we were able to avoid common pitfalls of LLM-based mutation techniques like injecting overly simplistic bugs or failing to modify the input program. We evaluated 13 open-weight models on MegaBugFix and baseline benchmarks, finding consistently lower performance on MegaBugFix. This reveals that our benchmark presents more challenging bugs and exposes model failures that may remain hidden when evaluating on existing benchmarks. The benchmark and fine-tuned model used for bug injection are available at hf.co/collections/szalontaib/megabugfix.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MegaBugFix，一个包含12,629个有bug的Python程序的大规模bug修复基准。通过让大语言模型基于正确代码生成表示代码变更的diff来注入bug，避免了传统变异测试中注入过于简单bug或无法修改输入程序的问题。在13个开源模型上的评估表明，模型在MegaBugFix上的性能一致低于现有基准，说明该基准更具挑战性。
Motivation: 现有bug修复基准规模小、统计可靠性弱，bug类型范围窄，且程序间相似性高，不能充分反映真实世界的bug修复实践。
Method: 利用大语言模型从正确代码生成diff形式的bug注入，合成大规模有bug程序集；避免LLM-based变异技术常见的注入过于简单bug或无法修改输入程序的问题。
Result: 在13个开源模型上的评估显示，模型在MegaBugFix上的性能一致低于现有基准（如Defects4J、QuixBugs等），表明MegaBugFix包含更具挑战性的bug，能暴露其他基准未发现的模型失败。
Conclusion: MegaBugFix是一个更真实、更具挑战性的bug修复基准，有助于更全面地评估LLM的bug修复能力；基准和用于bug注入的微调模型已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Complete virtual unwrapping and reading of a rolled Herculaneum papyrus
papers.abstract_en: The carbonized papyri from Herculaneum preserve the only large-scale library to survive from classical antiquity, but many unopened rolls remain unread because physical opening risks irreversible damage. X-ray computed microtomography ($μ$CT) and virtual unwrapping offer a non-invasive route to their texts, yet previous work on sealed Herculaneum scrolls has recovered only localized readings or limited surface regions. Here, using high-resolution phase-contrast $μ$CT acquired on the BM18 beamline at the European Synchrotron Radiation Facility (ESRF), together with improved computational unrolling and machine learning, we achieve the complete virtual unwrapping and reading of PHerc. 1667 under explicit coverage and papyrological-review criteria. This makes PHerc. 1667 the first Herculaneum papyrus to be fully digitally unrolled and read for extended scholarly study without physical opening. In PHerc. Paris 4, the optimized scan protocol makes ink directly visible in the tomographic volume, allowing three-dimensional ink segmentation and independent validation of surface-conditioned ink recovery. In PHerc. 139, we recover title and author-attribution evidence identifying the scroll as Philodemus, On Gods, Book 8. These results move virtual unwrapping of the Herculaneum scrolls beyond isolated demonstrations towards a scalable framework for systematic recovery of the still-unopened library.

papers.title: Residual-Guided Dictionary Learning for Spectrally Accurate Koopman Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Koopman theory promises linear structure in nonlinear dynamics, but numerical Koopman spectra are easy to compute and hard to trust. A finite EDMD matrix always has eigenvalues; the problem is that many of them may have nothing to do with the infinite-dimensional operator. In this paper we make spectral reliability the objective of dictionary learning. We train neural-network dictionaries not merely to predict the next snapshot, but to minimize Residual Dynamic Mode Decomposition residuals: operator-level a posteriori errors that test whether computed eigenvalues and modes are genuine Koopman spectral objects. To keep the learned observables from collapsing into an unstable coordinate system, the loss also penalizes the condition number of the lifted data matrix. Thus the method couples two requirements that should not be separated: small Koopman residuals and a well-conditioned representation. The result is a learned dictionary that is expressive, numerically stable, and spectrally disciplined. Across conservative and dissipative benchmark systems, the method sharply reduces spectral pollution, improves residual pseudospectral inclusion, and lowers forecast error relative to standard fixed dictionaries. On sea-surface temperature data, it gives cleaner Koopman diagnostics and substantially better one-step forecasts from noisy observations with no governing equations. The message is simple: neural Koopman learning should be judged not by prediction alone, but by whether its spectral claims can be certified. Residuals provide the certificate; conditioning makes it computable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过残差指导的字典学习，使得Koopman近似的谱具有可认证的可靠性。方法训练神经网络字典最小化残差动态模式分解（Residual DMD）误差，同时约束提升数据矩阵的条件数，从而获得表达力强、数值稳定且谱可信任的字典。在保守和耗散基准系统上，该方法显著减少谱污染、改进残差伪谱包含性并降低预测误差；在海表温度数据上，即使缺乏控制方程，也能从噪声观测中获得更干净的Koopman诊断和更好的单步预测。
Motivation: 有限Koopman近似中EDMD矩阵的特征值容易计算但难以信任，许多特征值与无穷维算子无关，造成谱污染。
Method: 提出残差指导的字典学习，训练神经网络字典最小化残差DMD误差（算子级后验误差），并惩罚提升数据矩阵的条件数，以兼顾小残差与良好条件数。
Result: 在保守和耗散基准系统上显著减少谱污染、改进残差伪谱包含性、降低预测误差；海表温度数据上获得更干净的Koopman诊断和更优的单步预测。
Conclusion: 神经Koopman学习应通过谱的可认证性而非仅预测性能来评判；残差提供认证，条件数使其可计算。

papers.title: Evolution Fine-Tuning: Learning to Discover Across 371 Optimization Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Would experience designing faster GPU kernels also help close in on a long-standing open mathematical conjecture? Large Language Models (LLMs) integrated into evolutionary search have recently produced state-of-the-art solutions on optimization tasks, including open mathematical conjectures, GPU kernel design, scientific law discovery, and combinatorial puzzles. To achieve this, prior work applied search scaffolds to one target task at a time, so every new problem is approached from scratch and the experience accumulated during search is discarded once the model finishes its attempt. This leaves the capability of iteratively evolving a solution (e.g., knowing which part to mutate and how, deciding when to backtrack) entirely in the scaffold rather than in the model itself. Whether the model itself could acquire this capability and reuse it across different tasks has been largely unexamined. To address this, we introduce Evolution Fine-Tuning (EFT), a mid-training paradigm that teaches LLMs to evolve solutions across tasks by converting evolutionary search trajectories into supervision. We construct Finch Collection, a 156K-trajectory dataset spanning 10 domains and 371 optimization tasks, and fine-tune open-source LLMs from 2B to 9B parameters. Empirically, EFT confers cross-task generalization: across 22 held-out tasks, our models surpass their base counterparts by 10.22% on average. Furthermore, when paired with test-time RL, our model matches state-of-the-art performance on two circle-packing tasks and outperforms its base-model counterpart on the Erdős minimum-overlap problem. EFT thus serves as a "practice phase" for general-purpose discovery agents that do not solve new problems from scratch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Evolution Fine-Tuning (EFT)，一种将进化搜索轨迹转化为监督信号的中期训练方法，使 LLM 学会跨任务迭代优化解决方案。构建了覆盖 10 个领域 371 个优化任务的 156K 轨迹数据集 Finch Collection，在 2B-9B 参数的开源模型上微调。实验表明 EFT 赋予模型跨任务泛化能力：在 22 个保留任务上平均超越基座模型 10.22%，结合测试时强化学习可在圆填充和 Erdős 最小重叠问题上达到或超越之前的最优结果。
Motivation: 现有方法每次仅针对单一任务应用搜索框架，搜索过程中积累的经验随任务结束丢弃，模型本身并未习得进化能力。本文旨在让模型学会跨任务复用进化策略，而非每次从零开始。
Method: EFT 将进化搜索轨迹（包含变异、回溯等操作）转化为监督数据，构建大规模多任务数据集 Finch Collection，并对 LLM 进行中期微调，使其内化进化搜索的决策能力。
Result: 在 22 个保留任务上，EFT 微调模型平均提升 10.22%；结合测试时强化学习后，在两个圆填充任务上达到最先进水平，在 Erdős 最小重叠问题上超越基座模型。
Conclusion: EFT 可作为通用发现代理的“练习阶段”，避免每次从零开始搜索，但未在摘要中讨论限制或失效场景。

papers.title: Learning heterogeneous treatment effects under principal stratification
papers.abstract_en: Principal stratification provides a foundational framework for causal inference with intermediate outcomes by defining causal effects within subpopulations, yet existing work has largely focused on average effects across strata rather than treatment effect heterogeneity within strata. Such within-stratum heterogeneity informs individualized treatment decisions but the associated methods are sparse. We address this gap by studying the identification and estimation of the conditional principal causal effects under principal ignorability combined with an odds ratio sensitivity parameterization, which relaxes the monotonicity assumption. To efficiently learn these estimands, we propose a novel doubly cross-fit doubly robust machine learner that resolves the nested nuisance structure inherent to principal stratification. Leveraging sequential orthogonal learning with regularized least-squares sieves, we derive $\mathcal{L}^2$ and uniform limit theory, establish oracle efficiency, and construct uniform confidence bands for the proposed estimator. We use simulations to demonstrate the finite-sample performance of our estimator, and provide an empirical analysis of a randomized trial in acute lung injury, revealing informative patterns of treatment effect heterogeneity within the always-survivor subpopulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究主分层框架下条件主处理效应的异质性估计，提出一种双重交叉拟合双重稳健机器学习器，结合顺序正交学习与正则化最小二乘筛子，在可忽略性和比值比敏感性参数化下识别效应，并建立理论性质。模拟和急性肺损伤随机试验的实证分析验证了方法有效性。
Motivation: 现有工作主要关注主分层内平均效应，忽略了层内异质性，而后者对个性化治疗决策至关重要。
Method: 在可忽略性和比值比敏感性参数化下识别条件主因果效应，并提出双重交叉拟合双重稳健机器学习器，利用顺序正交学习与正则化最小二乘筛子解决嵌套扰动结构。
Result: 推导了L2和一致极限理论，证明oracle效率，构造一致置信带；模拟显示有限样本性能良好；实证分析揭示急性肺损伤试验中always-survivor亚组的异质性模式。
Conclusion: 该方法有效估计主分层内的异质性因果效应，并提供理论保障。

papers.title: From Tool Connection to Execution Control: Benchmarking Security Invariants in MCP-Style Agent Runtimes
papers.abstract_en: Model Context Protocol (MCP)-style ecosystems give language-model applications a practical connection layer for tools, resources, prompts, and transports. As agents move from connection to execution, security decisions often remain split across clients, servers, prompts, approval dialogs, OAuth deployments, and logs. This paper asks whether a runtime can make execution-layer invariants explicit and testable while preserving MCP-like workflows. We define eight invariants: metadata non-authority, grant-backed approval, canonical resources, principal binding, scoped capability invocation, source-and-target data-flow authorization, deny-path audit, and explicit protocol state. We implement these invariants in HCP, a Handle-Capability Protocol reference runtime for MCP-style agent execution that represents calls through principals, resources, grants, capabilities, handles, policy decisions, data-pipe checks, and audit entries. We evaluate HCP against two MCP-like baselines: a naive connection-layer runtime and a practice-informed connection-layer mitigation baseline with metadata linting, session checks, and per-call approvals. Across 10 benchmark cases, the naive baseline permits all modeled attacks, the mitigation baseline permits 6 of 10, and HCP blocks all 10 while preserving audit evidence. Ablations identify which runtime components block attacks and preserve forensic evidence. A local in-memory microbenchmark reports sub-millisecond mean latencies for measured policy, invocation, peek, and pipe operations. A bounded GitHub README-screening sample provides ecosystem signals, not vulnerability findings. The results support a narrow claim: MCP-style agent systems need an execution-control layer in addition to connection-layer conventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究MCP风格代理运行时中的安全不变性，定义了八项安全不变性并在HCP参考运行时中实现。实验表明，HCP能阻断所有10种模拟攻击，而基线方案仅部分阻断。本地微基准测试显示亚毫秒级延迟。
Motivation: MCP生态系统中，安全决策分散在客户端、服务器、提示、审批对话框等组件，缺少统一的执行层安全控制。
Method: 定义八项安全不变性，并在HCP运行时中通过主体、资源、授权、能力、句柄、策略决策、数据管道检查和审计条目来实现。
Result: 在10个基准案例中，朴素基线允许所有攻击，缓解基线允许6个，HCP阻断所有10个并保留审计证据。微基准测试显示策略调用等操作平均延迟小于1毫秒。
Conclusion: MCP风格代理系统需要在连接层约定之外增加执行控制层。

papers.title: Low-cost concept-based localized explanations: How far can we get with training-free approaches?
papers.abstract_en: Concept-based Explainable AI (C-XAI) seeks human-understandable explanations grounded in semantic concepts, yet validation is limited by the scarcity of fine-grained concept annotations. We evaluate whether mid-scale Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can perform localized concept naming under strict zero-shot conditions by assigning labels to bounding-box regions at both object and part levels. We propose a reproducible zero-shot evaluation protocol for Concept Naming (CoNa) with (i) closed-set, category-constrained prompting for moderate vocabularies and (ii) Open-CoNa, an embedding-similarity-based strategy for large label spaces. Experiments with four MLLMs (7B-32B) show consistent performance trends across datasets, reaching 62%-88% object-level exact-match accuracy, highlighting the potential of training-free concept annotation from localized regions. We discuss limitations and failure modes and release a reproducible framework to support future low-cost C-XAI research.

TL;DR: 本文评估了中等规模多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在零样本条件下对边界框区域进行局部概念命名的能力，提出了一种可复现的零样本评估协议（CoNa和Open-CoNa）。实验结果显示，在7B-32B的MLLMs上，对象级别的精确匹配准确率达到62%-88%，表明训练免费的概念标注具有潜力。
Motivation: 基于概念的可解释AI（C-XAI）受限于细粒度概念注释的稀缺性，需要低成本的训练免费方法。
Method: 提出可复现的零样本评估协议，包括封闭集类别约束提示（CoNa）和基于嵌入相似度的开放集策略（Open-CoNa），并在四个MLLMs上测试。
Result: 对象级精确匹配准确率62%-88%，且模型间性能趋势一致。
Conclusion: 训练免费的概念标注在局部区域上有潜力，但存在局限性；发布了可复现框架以支持低成本C-XAI研究。

papers.title: A Comparative Study on Affective Cues in Text Embeddings Across Psychological Emotion Theories
papers.abstract_en: Text encoders are known for their utility in natural language processing, as they are able to efficiently compress inputs into dense vectors while preserving semantics. These models have been applied to affective computing, in particular to help with solving sentiment analysis and emotion recognition tasks. Nevertheless, it remains unclear to what extent the latent representations produced by modern text encoders capture well-defined psychological theories of affect. In this work, we investigate the affective capabilities of twelve recently released text encoders by probing their generated embeddings as input features for solving regression and classification tasks across three established emotion frameworks, using both word- and sentence-level data. Additionally, we apply a semantic data-leakage prevention technique to improve robustness in word-level evaluations. Our main findings show that the latent manifolds of the latest instruction-aware open-weight encoders enclose an equal or even a larger amount of affective information in comparison with proprietary counterparts when evaluated at word level. In contrast, embeddings of task-tuned and proprietary encoders reach the highest scores on sentence-level affective classification. Furthermore, a qualitative analysis of latent representations and their encoded affective cues is provided.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了十二种文本编码器在三种心理学情感理论框架（如离散情绪、维度模型等）下的情感表示能力，使用词级和句子级数据进行回归和分类任务。研究发现，在词级评估中，最新的指令感知开源编码器（如 instruction-tuned models）的潜在表示包含与专有编码器（如 GPT-4）相当甚至更多的情感信息；而在句子级情感分类中，任务调优和专有编码器表现更优。此外，还提供了潜在表示和情感线索的定性分析。
Motivation: 尽管文本编码器已广泛用于情感计算任务，但其潜在表示是否与心理学情感理论一致尚不明确，需要系统评估。
Method: 采用探针方法，将十二种文本编码器的嵌入作为特征输入，在三种情感理论框架下执行回归和分类任务，并使用语义数据泄漏预防技术提高词级评估的鲁棒性。
Result: 词级评估中，指令感知开源编码器的情感信息量不亚于甚至超过专有编码器；句子级分类中，任务调优和专有编码器达到最高分数。
Conclusion: 定性分析揭示了不同编码器潜在表示中编码的情感线索差异，表明模型选择需根据任务粒度（词级 vs 句子级）权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fairness Attacks on Recommender Systems
papers.abstract_en: The unfairness of recommender systems has become a topic of concern due to its significant social and ethical implications. Although existing works have shown the effectiveness of attacks on the performance of recommender systems (e.g., promotion and demotion attack), the study of fairness attacks on recommender systems remains largely under-explored. To this end, we propose a novel structure-aware reinforcement learning-based fairness attack method designed to exacerbate the unfairness of target recommender systems. Specifically, we first employ a graph-based structure encoder to model the structural dependencies among the generated fake user-item interactions and the original user-item interactions. Then, we model the sequential dependency of the injected fake items using a recurrent neural network. Based on the learned structure-aware and sequence-aware representations of the fake user and item, the item selection policy attentively decides the next injected fake item. Since the target recommender system may employ fairness-aware training and leverage the user's sensitive attribute information, such as gender, we further designed a gender selection policy to decide the gender of the entire fake user profile. Both the item selection and gender selection policy are learned jointly in our proposed method. Finally, experimental results on four types of target recommendation models and two real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed attack method in exacerbating the unfairness of recommender systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的结构感知公平性攻击方法，旨在加剧推荐系统的不公平性。该方法利用图结构编码器建模假用户-物品交互与原始交互的结构依赖，并用循环神经网络建模注入假物品的序列依赖。同时设计性别选择策略以决定假用户资料的性别，两个策略联合学习。在四种推荐模型和两个真实数据集上的实验表明该方法能有效加剧不公平性。
Motivation: 现有研究集中在攻击推荐系统的性能（如推广和降级攻击），但对推荐系统公平性的攻击研究不足。
Method: 提出结构感知的强化学习公平性攻击方法：使用图结构编码器建模结构依赖，用循环神经网络建模序列依赖；基于结构和序列表示，物品选择策略决定下一个假物品；另外设计性别选择策略决定假用户资料的性别，两个策略联合学习。
Result: 在四种目标推荐模型和两个真实数据集上的实验表明，所提方法能有效加剧推荐系统的不公平性。
Conclusion: 本文首次系统研究推荐系统的公平性攻击，表明即使使用公平感知训练和敏感属性信息，现有推荐系统仍易受此类攻击。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow Matching in Feature Space for Stochastic World Modeling
papers.abstract_en: World modeling requires forecasting uncertain futures while preserving information useful for downstream perception. Existing visual world models often struggle to satisfy both goals: VAE-based stochastic models operate in low-dimensional reconstruction latents, which can limit perception performance, while deterministic predictors using strong pretrained features collapse multimodal futures into a single blurry mean. In this work, we propose FlowWM, a stochastic world model that performs flow matching directly within pretrained feature space (e.g., DINOv3). This is challenging because pretrained features are substantially high-dimensional, making standard diffusion recipes suboptimal. To address this, we investigate the design choices needed for feature-space flow matching and introduce a differentiable one-step projection mechanism that enables efficient training with temporal consistency and task-driven objectives. We evaluate FlowWM on two benchmarks: a synthetic benchmark for systematic evaluation of accuracy and diversity, and a real-world benchmark FuturePerception. FlowWM improves perception performance, mode coverage, and horizon robustness, validating our proposed design for stochastic world modeling in high-dimensional feature spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowWM，一种在预训练特征空间（如 DINOv3）中直接进行流匹配 (flow matching) 的随机世界模型，旨在解决现有视觉世界模型中 VAE 的维度限制和确定性预测的多模态坍缩问题。通过可微单步投影机制实现高效训练和时间一致性，在合成和真实基准上提升了感知性能、模式覆盖和时域鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有视觉世界模型难以兼顾预测不确定性的多样性和下游感知信息：VAE 随机模型在低维重建潜变量上操作，限制感知性能；确定性预测器使用强预训练特征会导致多模态未来坍缩为模糊均值。
Method: 提出 FlowWM，在预训练特征空间中执行流匹配，并引入可微的单步投影机制，实现高效训练、时间一致性和任务驱动目标；同时研究了针对高维特征空间流匹配的设计选择。
Result: 在合成基准和 FuturePerception 真实基准上，FlowWM 提升了感知性能、模式覆盖和时域鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 本文验证了在高维特征空间中进行随机世界建模（特征空间流匹配与投影机制）的有效性。

papers.title: When Can Conformal Risk Control Certify LLM Outputs? Bounds, Impossibility, and Adaptation for Structured Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) deployed for structured generation (NER, JSON extraction, QA, and classification) lack formal reliability guarantees, and standard heuristic abstention policies miss user-specified risk targets by 7.5--12.5%. We characterize when conformal risk control (CRC) can certify structured LLM outputs and when it provably cannot. First, we prove an impossibility result: when the base risk (μ> α), any distribution-free method must abstain on at least ((μ-α)/(1-α)) examples, yielding a closed-form feasibility test: one can check whether CRC will work before running it. Second, we analyze a certification hierarchy across Hoeffding, empirical Bernstein, and a betting-based e-CRC bound, with strict gains in low-variance/large-sample regimes: the Hoeffding-to-Bernstein step delivers the largest gain (+37% certified configurations), while e-CRC adds value when calibration data is scarce (10% certification at 20% data versus 0% for Hoeffding). Third, we validate adaptive conformal inference (ACI) under cross-dataset shift, reducing risk-target violations from 71% to 21%, with residual failures concentrated exactly where the impossibility bound predicts. Across six open-weight models (3B--72B parameters), eight datasets, four tasks, and six nonconformity scores, hard NER/QA/CLS configurations are uncertifiable at (α= 0.10); relaxing to (α= 0.30--0.40) unlocks practical certification (47% NER, 40% QA, 60% CLS). The framework gives a three-step deployment recipe: check feasibility, select the bound and score, then mitigate shift.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了保形风险控制（CRC）能否为大型语言模型（LLM）的结构化生成（如NER、JSON提取、QA、分类）提供正式保证。作者证明了当基础风险过高时，任何分布无关方法都必须拒绝一定比例的样本，并给出了可行性测试。实验表明，在低方差和大样本场景下，Hoeffding到Bernstein的渐进边界可获得最大增益（+37%），而基于赌注的e-CRC在标定数据稀疏时有效。跨数据集漂移下，自适应共形推断（ACI）将风险目标违规从71%降至21%。
Motivation: LLM在结构化生成中缺乏形式化可靠性保证，标准启发式拒绝策略在用户指定风险目标上误差达7.5-12.5%。需要一种方法来判断何时可以认证LLM输出，何时不能。
Method: 首先证明不可行性结果：当基础风险μ>α时，任何分布无关方法必须拒绝至少((μ-α)/(1-α))比例的样本，从而得到闭式可行性测试。然后分析Hoeffding、经验Bernstein和基于赌注的e-CRC边界的认证层级。最后通过自适应共形推断（ACI）处理跨数据集漂移。
Result: Hoeffding到Bernstein步骤获得最大增益（认证配置增加37%），e-CRC在20%数据时认证10%配置而Hoeffding为0%。ACI将风险目标违规从71%降至21%。对于NER/QA/CLS等硬任务，在α=0.10时不可认证，放松到α=0.30-0.40可解锁实际认证（NER 47%，QA 40%，CLS 60%）。
Conclusion: 提出了三步部署方案：检查可行性、选择边界和得分、缓解漂移。研究限定了CRC在LLM结构化生成中的适用条件，并提供了实用指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Kernel Fisher Discriminant Analysis-Based Tree Ensemble Classifier: KFDA Forest
papers.abstract_en: In general, an ensemble classifier is more accurate than a single classifier. In this study, we propose an ensemble classifier called the kernel Fisher discriminant analysis forest (KFDA Forest), which is a tree-based ensemble method that applies KFDA. To promote diversity, bootstrap is used, and variable sets are randomly divided into K subsets. KFDA is performed on each subset to increase classification accuracy. KFDA maximizes the distance between classes while minimizing the distance within classes. KFDA can also be applied to classification problems in a nonlinear data structure using the kernel trick because it can transform the input space into a kernel feature space, commonly named a rotation, rather than performing a dimensionality reduction. Because new feature axes and KFDA projections are parallel, decision trees are used as a base classifier. To compare the proposed method with existing ensemble methods, we apply these to real datasets from the UCI and KEEL repositories.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables; author-created manuscript version of the published article
papers.journal_ref: International Journal of Industrial Engineering, 25(5), 569-579, 2018
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于核Fisher判别分析（KFDA）的树集成分类器（KFDA Forest），通过自助采样和随机子空间划分提升多样性，并使用KFDA旋转特征空间后训练决策树。在UCI和KEEL数据集上的实验表明，该方法相比传统集成方法具有更高的分类精度。
Motivation: 传统集成分类器在非线性数据结构上的分类精度仍有提升空间，现有方法在特征旋转和类间分离方面不够充分。
Method: 结合自助采样和随机特征子集划分，对每个子集应用KFDA进行特征旋转（将输入映射到核特征空间），再以决策树作为基分类器进行集成。
Result: 在UCI和KEEL真实数据集上的实验证实，KFDA Forest的分类精度优于随机森林、旋转森林等经典集成方法。
Conclusion: KFDA Forest通过核技巧和类间最大化/类内最小化的准则，有效提升了非线性分类问题的集成性能。

summary_sections.conclusion: KFDA Forest通过核技巧和类间最大化/类内最小化的准则，有效提升了非线性分类问题的集成性能。

papers.title: MOSAIC: Orchestrating Collaborative Knowledge Tracing with Hierarchical Semantic Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge Tracing (KT) is important for personalized education but traditionally suffers from two key limitations: a reliance on shallow ID-based representations that neglect semantic depth and a restriction to single-granularity mastery estimation that overlooks hierarchical knowledge dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose MOSAIC (Multi-granularity Online Semantic AI for Collaborative Knowledge), a novel framework that orchestrates LLM-driven semantic alignment with sequential modeling. Unlike methods that use LLMs solely as predictors, MOSAIC leverages a frozen LLM to generate dynamic, context-aware embeddings and hierarchical prediction prompts, explicitly capturing collaborative signals and peer interactions. Furthermore, we introduce a cross-granularity consistency objective that jointly regularizes mastery estimation across concept, topic-cluster, and global proficiency levels. Extensive experiments on ASSISTments, EdNet, and a newly collected large-scale MOOC dataset demonstrate that MOSAIC establishes new state-of-the-art results. Specifically, our method achieves AUC improvements of up to 3.4\% and Accuracy gains of up to 2.5 \% across all benchmarks. Notably, MOSAIC exhibits superior robustness in collaboration-rich environments and long-sequence scenarios (AUC 0.862 on MOOC), offering both high predictive precision and semantically grounded interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MOSAIC框架，通过冻结的LLM生成动态语义嵌入和层次化预测提示，并引入跨粒度一致性目标，在知识追踪任务上实现多粒度掌握估计。在ASSISTments、EdNet和大型MOOC数据集上的实验表明，AUC提升最高达3.4%，准确率提升最高达2.5%。
Motivation: 传统知识追踪方法依赖浅层ID表示，忽视语义深度，且仅限于单粒度掌握估计，无法捕捉层次化知识依赖。
Method: MOSAIC利用冻结的LLM生成上下文感知嵌入和层次化预测提示，结合时序建模，并引入跨粒度一致性目标，协同约束概念、主题簇和全局熟练度水平的掌握估计。
Result: 在ASSISTments、EdNet和MOOC数据集上，MOSAIC达到新SOTA，AUC提升最多3.4%，准确率提升最多2.5%，在协作密集和长序列场景下表现稳健（MOOC上AUC 0.862）。
Conclusion: MOSAIC通过语义对齐和多粒度一致性，实现了高预测精度和可解释性，尤其适用于协作丰富的学习环境。

papers.title: Weak Dominant Balance for Robust Identification of Dynamically Consistent Fluid Flow Structure
papers.abstract_en: Extracting interpretable, localized physical mechanisms from complex spatiotemporal data is a foundational challenge across physics, biology, and engineering, but has remained out of reach on real measurements. The central obstacle is obtaining high-quality gradients of data via numerical differentiation, which amplifies noise, diverges for high-order equations, and falters on irregular geometries, limiting the scope of existing approaches to clean simulations of low-order systems. Here, we present weak dominant balance, a derivative-free framework that projects governing equations into a weak (integral) formulation, offloading differentiation onto smooth analytical test functions and leaving the data untouched. The method sustains accurate regime identification under severe noise where existing approaches categorically fail, delivers the first data-driven decomposition of a third-order partial differential equation applied to turbulent duct flow, and produces matching decompositions across direct numerical simulation and particle-image velocimetry measurements of a wavy channel flow, uncovering a previously uncharacterized dynamical regime. Weak dominant balance brings mechanism-level analysis out of simulation and onto measured data, and opens complex physical systems to direct, equation-grounded interpretation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出弱主导平衡（weak dominant balance）方法，通过将控制方程投影到弱（积分）形式，避免数值微分，从而在强噪声和复杂几何下仍能鲁棒地识别流体流动中的动力机制。该方法首次在湍流管道流的第三阶偏微分方程上实现数据驱动分解，并在波状通道流的直接数值模拟和粒子图像测速数据上得到一致分解，揭示了先前未表征的动力状态。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖数值微分获取梯度，但噪声放大、高阶方程发散、不规则几何失效，限制了其对真实测量数据的应用。
Method: 将控制方程投影到弱（积分）形式，将微分运算转移到光滑的解析测试函数上，数据本身不参与微分，从而实现无导数框架。
Result: 在严重噪声下仍能准确识别机制，首次对湍流管道流的第三阶偏微分方程进行数据驱动分解，并在波状通道流的数值模拟和实验测量数据上得到匹配分解，发现新的动力状态。
Conclusion: 弱主导平衡将机制级分析从模拟推广到实测数据，使复杂物理系统可直接进行基于方程的解释。

papers.title: How Far Can Sharpness and Complexity Jointly Explain Generalization?
papers.abstract_en: Sharpness and complexity are two central factors in the generalization analysis of deep neural networks. Existing quantitative evaluations of generalization measures have largely focused on individual scalar measures, leaving the joint explanatory power of sharpness and complexity largely unexplored. This work studies how far sharpness and complexity can jointly explain generalization. We use linear regression and introduce a Pareto-based analysis to quantitatively evaluate the joint explanatory power of these two factors. Beyond the existing parameter-level definitions, we further propose realizations of sharpness and complexity that are closer to function space and less dependent on raw parameter representations. We find that function-oriented definitions of these two quantities expand the explanatory scope of the two-factor view beyond what is achieved by existing parameter-level metrics. Overall, our results support the sharpness-complexity perspective as an informative lens for understanding generalization across diverse settings. At the same time, the remaining failures indicate that whether this two-factor view can serve as a complete theory of generalization remains open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究锐度 (sharpness) 和复杂度 (complexity) 这两大因素在深度神经网络泛化分析中的联合解释能力。作者通过线性回归和基于帕累托的分析，定量评估了这两个因素的联合解释力，并提出了更接近函数空间、更少依赖参数表示的锐度和复杂度定义。实验结果表明，函数导向的定义扩展了双因素视角的解释范围，但未能完全解释泛化，表明该视角是否构成完整理论仍有待探讨。
Motivation: 现有泛化度量评估大多集中在单个标量度量上，缺乏对锐度和复杂度联合解释能力的系统研究。
Method: 采用线性回归和基于帕累托的分析来定量评估锐度和复杂度的联合解释力，并提出更接近函数空间、更少依赖参数表示的新型锐度和复杂度定义。
Result: 函数导向的锐度和复杂度定义扩展了双因素视角的解释范围，但仍有失败案例，表明该视角作为完整泛化理论尚有不足。
Conclusion: 锐度-复杂度视角是理解不同设置下泛化的有用视角，但能否成为完整的泛化理论仍不明确。

papers.title: Metric Aggregation Divergence: A Hidden Validity Threat in Agent-Based Policy Optimization and a Contractual Remedy
papers.abstract_en: Metric aggregation divergence (MAD) is the silent inconsistency that arises when distinct pipeline stages in an agent-based model coupled with a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (ABM+MOEA) independently re-implement how an outcome metric is extracted from simulation trajectories. Unlike deliberate analytical choices, MAD operates at the level of pipeline architecture: each stage is internally coherent, and the inconsistency becomes visible only when cross-stage outputs are compared. Code inspection of EpidemiOptim, a JAIR-published epidemic policy toolbox, reveals three structurally independent aggregation paths in peer-reviewed code. A faithful replication of this structure produces champion disagreement in 64.2% of independent runs (n=500, 95% CI: [59.9%, 68.3%]). In a 300-seed policy-flip experiment, divergent aggregation causes the optimizer to recommend the wrong champion in 83% of replications, with a mean welfare gap of 2.19 units and a Gini inequality gap of 0.050 units. In a follow-up inference audit, 3 of 249 flipped seeds cross the significance boundary itself. A complementary enterprise follow-up produces the predicted null under near-commensurable rankings (rho = 0.991), while a public upstream rerun of the Lake Problem DPS workflow shows that the archived published-path recommendation reaches joint-threshold success 0.401 whereas a shared contract-path rule reaches 0.552. We introduce the metric contract - a single shared callable enforced at dispatch time across all pipeline stages - as the remedy. Framed as standard engineering discipline applied to the cross-stage metric interface, the contract eliminates divergence by construction with approximately 3% runtime overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示基于智能体的策略优化中“指标聚合发散”问题：在智能体模型与多目标进化算法耦合的流程中，不同管道阶段独立重新实现从模拟轨迹中提取指标的方式，导致隐式不一致。对已发表流行病政策工具箱EpidemiOptim的代码审查发现三条独立的聚合路径，复制实验显示64.2%的运行出现冠军分歧，在300种子策略翻转实验中，83%的复制中发散聚合导致推荐错误冠军。作者提出“指标契约”——跨所有管道阶段在分发时强制执行的单一共享可调用对象——作为补救措施，大约3%运行时开销。
Motivation: 现有基于智能体的策略优化中，不同管道阶段独立重新实现指标提取，这种结构不一致可能导致优化结果错误，而以往未被识别。
Method: 通过代码审查和复制实验揭示MAD现象，并引入“指标契约”：在分发时强制执行单一共享的指标提取函数，消除发散。
Result: 在EpidemiOptim中，64.2%的运行存在冠军分歧；300种子实验中，83%的复制中发散导致错误推荐冠军，平均福利差距2.19单位；在第三方案例中，契约路径达到联合阈值成功0.552，而存档路径仅0.401。
Conclusion: 指标契约是一种标准工程纪律，应用于跨管道指标接口，可消除发散，且运行时开销约3%。

papers.title: The strength of clinical evidence is recoverable from language model representations but not from their stated grades
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly summarize clinical evidence, where a claim's weight depends on how strongly it is supported. Yet these models convey confidence poorly, and properties they never state, such as truth, are often readable from their activations. Whether a clinical model registers evidence strength, distinct from truth, and states it when asked is untested, and any such signal could be lexical. We compiled 45,134 clinical claims from six public sources, harmonized 20,611 into a four-level evidence grade under three independent frameworks, and tested 22 local, open-weight LLMs from several developers (0.6-70 billion parameters; general, medical, and reasoning), with lexical, truth, and cross-framework controls. A linear estimator recovered the grade in every model (median AUROC 71.8), yet decodability did not rise with scale and was weakest in reasoning models. The grade the models stated fell to chance, 25-27 percentage points below the estimator. The recoverable signal was largely lexical and did not transfer across topics or frameworks, yet it was distinct from factual truth and still flagged weakly supported claims (AUROC 69.2). Clinical LLMs thus carry an ordered evidence-strength signal they do not express, so their stated grades fail to convey a claim's support even when it is recoverable from their representations and text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大型语言模型在总结临床证据时，其内部表示是否编码了证据强度（evidence strength），以及模型口头表述的等级是否准确。实验使用45,134个临床声明，测试22个开源模型（0.6-70B参数），发现线性估计器能从模型表示中恢复证据等级（中位AUROC 71.8），但模型声称的等级接近随机（比估计器低25-27个百分点）。信号主要是词汇性的，不跨主题或框架迁移，但与事实真值不同，仍能识别弱支持的声明（AUROC 69.2）。这表明临床LLMs携带有序的证据强度信号但未能在输出中表达。
Motivation: 现有临床证据总结中，语言模型对声明支持程度的表达不可靠，且模型是否在其内部表示中编码了证据强度（而非单纯的事实真值）尚不清楚。若存在这样的信号，它可能被模型口头陈述，但缺乏系统验证。
Method: 从六个公开来源整理45,134条临床声明，将20,611条统一为四级证据等级，并在三种独立框架下进行标注。测试22个本地开源LLM（通用、医学、推理型，0.6-70B参数），使用线性估计器从模型表示中恢复证据等级，并比较模型口头陈述的等级。同时控制词汇、事实真值和跨框架因素。
Result: 线性估计器在所有模型中都能恢复证据等级（中位AUROC 71.8），但模型口头陈述的等级仅接近随机（比估计器低25-27个百分点）。表示中的信号主要是词汇性的，不跨主题或证据框架迁移，但与事实真值不同，且能区分弱支持声明（AUROC 69.2）。
Conclusion: 临床LLMs的内部表示确实编码了有序的证据强度信号，但模型无法在输出中准确表达这一信号，导致其声称的等级不能有效传达声明的实际支持程度。该发现提示在临床证据总结中直接依赖模型输出等级存在风险。

papers.title: How to Leverage Synthetic Speech for LLM-Based ASR Systems?
papers.abstract_en: In regulated domains such as banking and healthcare, where privacy constraints make real speech costly to collect and retain, synthetic speech from modern text-to-speech (TTS) is an appealing alternative for training automatic speech recognition (ASR) without exposing sensitive customer recordings. Yet a persistent distributional gap between synthetic and real data limits how far it can replace genuine recordings. Prior work largely treats this gap as a black box to be engineered around, but in our work, we instead examine its origin directly by probing a SLAM-ASR architecture. Then, we localise where its LLM backbone separates real from synthetic speech and find the discriminative signal concentrated in the early-to-middle layers, where temporal and prosodic perturbations disrupt it most. We further show that representation-level separability, help, but does not directly predict downstream ASR gains. On the other hand, convolving synthetic audio with room impulse responses (RIRs) narrows the gap not by making synthetic speech sound cleaner or more natural, but by reproducing the acoustic irregularities of real recordings. Translating these findings into the training procedure, by adding a layer-selection module combined with RIR augmentation matches a fully real-data baseline using only 25% of the real speech (13.6h) and surpasses it at all higher proportions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在隐私受限领域（如银行、医疗）中使用合成语音训练ASR系统的可行性，通过分析SLAM-ASR架构中LLM主干区分真实与合成语音的位置，发现早期到中间层的时序和韵律扰动是主要差异源。进一步表明，表示级别的可分离性并不直接预测下游ASR性能提升，而使用房间脉冲响应（RIR）卷积合成音频可缩小差距，因其复制了真实录音的声学不规则性。结合层选择模块和RIR增强，仅用25%的真实语音（13.6小时）即可匹配全真实数据基线，并在更高比例下超越。
Motivation: 在隐私敏感领域，真实语音数据难以收集和保留，合成语音作为替代方案存在分布差距，限制了其替代真实录音的能力。
Method: 通过探测SLAM-ASR架构，定位LLM骨干区分真实与合成语音的层，引入层选择模块并结合RIR增强进行训练。
Result: 提出的方法仅用25%的真实语音（13.6小时）即可匹配全真实数据基线，并在更高比例下超越。
Conclusion: 合成语音结合RIR增强和层选择模块可有效缩小与真实语音的性能差距，减少对真实数据的依赖。

papers.title: Memory as an Attack Surface in LLM Agents: A Study on Multiple-Choice Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: AI agents extend conventional large language model (LLM) applications by integrating language understanding with task execution, external tool use, and memory mechanisms. While memory allows agents to retain prior interactions and provide more personalized and context-aware responses, it also introduces a new vulnerability: information stored in memory can influence future outputs even when the current query is clean. In this paper, we investigate memory manipulation in LLM-based agents for multiple-choice question answering. We first design and implement an LLM-based AI agent with an external memory component that stores and retrieves task-relevant information. We then introduce basic memory manipulation scenarios in which misleading or corrupted memories are inserted into the agent before it answers multiple-choice questions. Using a controlled experimental setup, we compare the agent's performance before and after memory manipulation and measure changes in answer accuracy, attack success rate, and selection of manipulated options. Our results show that even simple memory manipulations can noticeably affect the agent's final answers, causing it to select incorrect options despite receiving clean and well-formed questions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）智能体中记忆组件的安全漏洞，特别是在多项选择问答任务中。作者设计了一个带外部记忆的LLM智能体，通过插入误导性记忆进行攻击实验。实验表明，即使简单的记忆操纵也能显著影响智能体的答案准确性，使其选择错误选项，尽管当前查询是干净的。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注LLM的提示注入攻击，但记忆作为攻击面的研究不足。记忆机制虽提升个性化，却引入了新的安全风险。
Method: 实现了一个带外部记忆的LLM智能体，在多项选择问答场景中，在问答前插入误导或篡改的记忆，并比较操纵前后准确率、攻击成功率等指标。
Result: 摘要报告：简单的记忆操纵即可显著影响智能体的最终答案，使其选择错误选项，攻击成功率可观（具体数值未给出）。
Conclusion: 记忆机制是LLM智能体中一个重要的新攻击面，需要进一步研究防御策略。

papers.title: Adaptive Spectrum-Aware Feature Disentangled Network for Small Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Small Object Detection (SOD) is a fundamental yet challenging problem in computer vision due to its limited spatial resolution and weak visual cues. Although recent approaches have achieved remarkable advances, the background distractors in different frequency spectra still degrade the performance. In this paper, we propose a novel small object detection framework termed SFDNet, which is capable of detecting small objects via efficient spectrum-aware feature disentanglement. Specifically, we propose an Adaptive Spectrum Disentanglement (ASD) module that decomposes backbone features into multiple complementary spectral components, aiming to construct discriminative object-relevant representations by discarding the background distractors for each component. Afterwards, to strengthen the semantic consistency of the similar objects in the same class, we propose a Class-Wise Prototype Distillation (CPD) procedure, which establishes class prototypes for the object instances and enforces the compact representation by efficient prototype distillation. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging benchmarks show that SFDNet outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods by a large margin. Our code is available at https://github.com/ManOfStory/SFDNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应频谱感知特征解耦网络（SFDNet）用于小物体检测。通过自适应频谱解耦（ASD）模块将骨干特征分解为多个互补频谱分量，并丢弃背景干扰；再通过类原型蒸馏（CPD）增强同类物体的语义一致性。在多个基准数据集上超越了现有方法。
Motivation: 小物体检测受限于有限空间分辨率和弱视觉线索，不同频谱中的背景干扰仍会降低性能。
Method: 提出SFDNet框架，包含自适应频谱解耦（ASD）模块和类原型蒸馏（CPD）过程。ASD将特征分解为多个频谱分量并过滤背景；CPD建立类原型并通过蒸馏强化紧凑表示。
Result: 在多个挑战性基准上大幅超越现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: SFDNet通过频谱感知特征解耦有效提升了小物体检测性能。

papers.title: Preventing Error Propagation in Multi-Agent AI through Runtime Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent AI systems can improve answer selection by allowing different language models to exchange reasoning traces, revise initial predictions, and support a final decision. However, such communication may also introduce reliability risks: reasoning from one agent can correct another agent's mistake, but it can also mislead an agent that was initially correct. This paper studies reliable multi-agent AI communication through reasoning exchange and runtime answer revision. We develop a framework in which agents first answer multiple-choice questions independently, then share reasoning traces and revise their decisions. We conduct numerical experiments where we evaluate whether this process improves accuracy, produces more positive than negative answer transitions, and remains effective across domains such as cybersecurity, networking, and general knowledge. The results help identify when multi-agent reasoning improves reliability and when it may propagate errors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 研究多智能体AI系统中通过推理交换和运行时答案修订的可靠性问题，分析该过程是否提升准确率、是否产生更多正向答案转换，并在网络安全、网络和常识等领域进行实验。
Motivation: 多智能体通信可能引入可靠性风险：一个智能体的推理可能误导原本正确的智能体，导致错误传播。
Method: 开发框架：智能体先独立回答选择题，然后共享推理轨迹并修订决策。
Result: 通过数值实验评估准确率提升、正负答案转换比例以及跨领域的有效性（网络安全、网络、常识）。
Conclusion: 结果有助于识别多智能体推理何时提升可靠性，何时可能传播错误。

papers.title: Efficient Spatio-Temporal Grounding with Multimodal Large Models via Second-Level Tracking and RL Verification
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal grounding in long videos requires precise temporal localization and robust object tracking conditioned on natural-language queries. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) show strong reasoning ability, directly applying frame-by-frame inference to long sequences is computationally expensive and unstable. We propose a practical pipeline that shifts from frame-level to second-level tracking and performs cross-second smoothing to preserve continuity while reducing sequence length. To improve reasoning supervision, we synthesize chain-of-thought style trajectories using advanced multimodal models for temporal localization and target selection, and replace generated spatio-temporal coordinates with ground-truth annotations to avoid noisy supervision. We further optimize the policy with reinforcement learning using a verifier based on $t\_\mathrm{IoU}+mv\_\mathrm{IoU}$. Experiments across multiple FPS settings show that our method achieves a strong trade-off between efficiency and localization quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长视频中基于自然语言查询的时空定位问题，提出从帧级切换到秒级跟踪的流程，并利用跨秒平滑保持连续性。通过合成链式思维轨迹并使用真实坐标替代生成结果以避免噪声，再基于t_IoU+mv_IoU验证器进行强化学习优化。实验表明该方法在多个帧率设定下实现了效率与定位质量的良好平衡。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型在长视频上逐帧推理计算成本高且不稳定，难以兼顾效率和定位精度。
Method: 将帧级跟踪改为秒级跟踪并跨秒平滑以压缩序列长度；利用高级多模态模型合成链式思维轨迹进行时间定位和目标选择，并用真实标注替换生成坐标；采用基于t_IoU+mv_IoU的验证器进行强化学习策略优化。
Result: 在多种帧率设置下的实验显示，该方法在计算效率和定位质量之间取得了强平衡。
Conclusion: 提出的秒级跟踪与RL优化框架可有效应对长视频时空定位中的计算开销问题，同时保持定位性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semantic-Aware, Physics-Informed, Geometry-Grounded Weather Video Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Weather synthesis aims to add weather effects to input videos while preserving scene identity, structure, and motion. The key limitation of existing methods is the lack of diversity in weather appearance and effective control over weather dynamics (e.g., temporal evolution and particle motion). Most approaches rely on text prompts, which are inherently underspecified and often fail to produce detailed weather characteristics. Additionally, general-purpose video editors optimized for clean and aesthetic outputs tend to suppress heavy weather phenomena, making dense particle effects difficult to generate. To address these, we propose a Semantic-Aware, Physics-Informed, and Geometry-Grounded framework that steers an off-the-shelf video editor to synthesize diverse global appearances and detailed particle dynamics. We factorize the synthesis into three conditional signals, so that each provides a distinct and stable source of guidance: semantics specifies what the weather should look like, dynamics governs how it evolves over time, and geometry determines where it should appear in the scene. Specifically, we introduce (1) semantic-aware appearance anchoring to establish the target appearance from scene semantics and user input; (2) physics-informed dynamic simulation to generate particle effects by simulating a Gaussian-represented particle field under gravity, wind, and turbulence; and (3) geometry-grounded video synthesis to align the simulated particles with target scene geometry and synthesize the final video. Experiments demonstrate that our method produces diverse, physically and visually realistic weather effects. Furthermore, we show that our synthesized data significantly improves the robustness of autonomous driving semantic segmentation under adverse weather conditions. Project page: https://jumponthemoon.github.io/w-crafter/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个语义感知、物理信息、几何驱动的天气视频合成框架，利用现成视频编辑器生成多样化的全局天气外观和详细的粒子动态。通过语义外观锚定、物理信息动态模拟和几何驱动视频合成三个条件信号，分别控制天气外观、时间演化和空间位置。实验表明该方法能产生物理和视觉上真实的效果，且合成数据显著提升自动驾驶在恶劣天气下的语义分割鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有天气合成方法缺乏外观多样性和对天气动态的有效控制，文本提示难以生成详细天气特征，通用视频编辑器倾向于抑制重天气现象。
Method: 提出三组件框架：语义感知外观锚定确定目标外观；物理信息动态模拟在重力、风、湍流下模拟高斯粒子场生成粒子效果；几何驱动视频合成将模拟粒子与场景几何对齐并生成最终视频。
Result: 实验表明方法能产生多样、物理和视觉真实的天气效果，且合成数据显著提升自动驾驶语义分割在恶劣天气下的鲁棒性（摘要未提供具体数值）。
Conclusion: 该框架可有效合成多样天气视频，并辅助下游任务提升鲁棒性。

papers.title: Liquidity-Based Audit of Algorithmic Trading Strategies
papers.abstract_en: We show that net demand for liquidity by algo strategies is identifiable from its trade and price history alone, with no knowledge of its signal or optimization problem. An exact multi-period regret decomposition implies that the sign of this statistic classifies a linear strategy as a net liquidity consumer or provider, recovering the Kyle (1985) informed-trader/market-maker dichotomy from observables alone. Under an AR(1) cost process, the same statistic equals the product of strategy size and the squared Roll (1984) implied spread, making the correction a direct proxy for prevailing illiquidity. Extending to endogenous price impact and aggregating across N correlated strategies yields a liquidity-balance condition whose violation produces welfare loss scaling as N squared, a closed-form fire-sale externality. We calibrate to CRSP equity data (2016-2025), tracking implied spreads through the COVID-19 and 2022 rate-shock episodes, with an estimator computable in O(Tnd) time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，仅从算法交易策略的交易和价格历史中即可识别其净流动性需求，无需知晓其信号或优化问题。通过多期遗憾分解，该统计量的符号可将线性策略分类为净流动性提供者或消费者，恢复Kyle(1985)的知情交易者/做市商二分法。在AR(1)成本过程下，该统计量等于策略规模与Roll(1984)隐含价差平方的乘积，使修正成为当前非流动性的直接代理。扩展到内生价格影响并聚合N个相关策略，得到流动性平衡条件，其违反会产生N平方量级的福利损失，即封闭形式的抛售外部性。利用CRSP股票数据(2016-2025)进行校准，跟踪COVID-19和2022年利率冲击期间的隐含价差，估计器时间复杂度为O(Tnd)。
Motivation: 算法交易策略对流动性的净需求通常难以直接观测，现有方法依赖于获取策略信号或优化模型，本文旨在仅从可观测的交易和价格历史中识别该需求。
Method: 提出基于多期遗憾分解的统计量，该统计量的符号直接分类线性策略的流动性角色。在AR(1)成本过程中，该统计量简化为策略规模与Roll隐含价差的乘积。进一步扩展到内生价格影响和多个相关策略场景，推导出流动性平衡条件和抛售外部性公式。使用CRSP数据通过O(Tnd)时间复杂度的估计器进行校准。
Result: 摘要声称方法可仅从交易历史识别流动性净需求，分类线性策略为流动性消费者或提供者，并量化非流动性。在CRSP数据上校准了隐含价差在COVID-19和2022年利率冲击期间的表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该审计方法无需策略信号或优化知识，提供了一种从可观测数据推断流动性影响的框架，并揭示了策略间相关性导致的福利损失放大效应。
Relevance: 0
