papers.title: Customized Generative AI Agent for Transportation Engineering Practice: A Development and Continued Pre-training Guideline
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements in generative artificial intelligence (AI) and large language models (LLMs) have shown significant promise in automating complex reasoning, summarization, and question-answering tasks. However, the effectiveness of general-purpose LLMs in specialized engineering domains remains limited due to insufficient exposure to technical standards, engineering terminology, and domain-specific semantics. This study proposes a systematic approach to developing a customized generative AI agent for transportation engineering applications. A curated corpus of U.S. transportation manuals, design guidelines, and regulatory documents is used to conduct continued pretraining of six state-of-the-art LLMs through a unified low-rank adaptation (LoRA) framework. The training process is monitored to ensure convergence and model stability. Performance is evaluated using standard natural language processing metrics, including BLEU-4 and ROUGE, with Qwen2.5-7B and LLaMA-3.1-8B demonstrating the highest domain alignment and response quality. Results validate the effectiveness of LoRA-based adaptation in improving LLM performance on technical content interpretation and context-specific reasoning. This work contributes a reproducible development framework for constructing domain-specialized generative AI agents, supporting broader deployment in transportation research, design, planning, and policy analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套系统方法，为交通工程应用开发定制化的生成式AI代理。通过收集美国交通手册、设计指南和法规文档，利用统一的低秩适配（LoRA）框架对六个前沿LLM进行继续预训练，并评估其在技术内容理解与语境推理上的表现。Qwen2.5-7B和LLaMA-3.1-8B在BLEU-4和ROUGE指标上取得最佳领域对齐效果。
Motivation: 通用LLM在专业工程领域因缺乏技术标准、术语和领域语义而效果有限，亟需系统性的领域适应方案。
Method: 构建交通工程专用语料库，采用LoRA对六个LLM进行统一的继续预训练，并监控训练收敛与稳定性。
Result: Qwen2.5-7B和LLaMA-3.1-8B在技术内容理解任务上表现最佳，验证了LoRA适配的有效性。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了可复现的领域专用AI代理开发框架，可推广至交通研究与政策分析。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mural: Transferring LLM knowledge to image generation via Mixture-of-Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Leveraging capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in text-to-image (T2I) synthesis is an important research direction. In this work we investigate whether the knowledge of a frozen LLM can be effectively utilized in T2I generation when trained exclusively on standard text-image pairs. We integrate a frozen, reasoning-capable LLM with a diffusion-based image generator via shared attention within the Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture. Our experiments span two critical questions: (1) what degree of the LLM's intrinsic knowledge remains accessible during T2I training, and (2) what novel capabilities emerge in the resulting system. Across established benchmarks, our models achieve strong performance among unified understanding-generation systems: 0.85 on GenEval, 86.75 on DPG-Bench, and 0.66 on WISE with inference-time reasoning, using only text-image data. Remarkably, we uncover emergent behaviors absent from training data, including cross-lingual image generation, color-guided composition, emoji / ASCII scene construction, and generation directed by world knowledge. These results demonstrate that pretrained LLM knowledge can guide image synthesis under standard text-to-image training paradigms, without interleaved multimodal signals or explicit reasoning supervision. Our findings open new avenues for harnessing frozen model capabilities in resource-constrained multimodal learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究是否可以利用冻结的大语言模型（LLM）知识在文本到图像（T2I）生成中，仅通过标准文本图像对训练。提出Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT)架构，将冻结的LLM与扩散图像生成器通过共享注意力集成。实验表明模型在GenEval、DPG-Bench、WISE等基准上取得强性能，并出现跨语言图像生成、颜色引导合成、表情符号/ASCII场景构造、世界知识引导生成等涌现行为。结论是预训练LLM知识可以在标准T2I训练范式下指导图像合成，无需交错多模态信号或显式推理监督。
Motivation: 研究能否有效利用冻结LLM的知识于T2I生成，仅用标准文本图像数据，探索其内在知识在生成任务中的可迁移性。
Method: 通过共享注意力在Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT)架构中集成冻结的推理能力LLM与扩散图像生成器，仅使用标准文本图像对进行训练。
Result: 在GenEval上达到0.85，DPG-Bench上86.75，WISE上0.66（推理时），并涌现跨语言图像生成、颜色引导合成、表情符号/ASCII场景构造、世界知识引导生成等能力。
Conclusion: 预训练LLM知识可指导图像合成，无需交错多模态信号或显式推理监督，为资源受限的多模态学习提供新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SciFlow: Semantic Cross Interference for Self-Supervised Optical Flow Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Motions of objects and scenes carry essential intelligence in video understanding, offering rich cues for interpreting dynamic settings and interactions. Due to the cost and scarcity of high-quality annotation or ground truth of pixel-wise optical flow, however, motion estimation models are typically trained in synthetic domains while deployed in real-world domains. Addressing synthetic-to-real domain generalization challenges has been crucial for developing practical solutions in diverse open-world use cases. This paper introduces SciFlow, a simple yet effective, network-agnostic, training-based approach that leverages self-supervised learning to generalize motion estimation across synthetic and open-world domains. Specifically, SciFlow imposes semantic interference from open-world images onto synthetic images during training, blending indomain features with cross-domain interference, which enables the network to adapt to the real-world domains. Additionally, SciFlow utilizes geometric consistency to ensure validity of the self-supervision. Our experiment results show that SciFlow not only significantly enhances model robustness amidst domain variations, but also remarkably enables synthetic-to-real domain generalization without requiring any ground truth in the open world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SciFlow 是一种基于自监督学习的域泛化方法，用于光流估计。它通过在训练时对合成图像施加来自开放世界图像的语义干扰，结合几何一致性约束，使模型能够从合成域泛化到真实域，且无需真实域标注。实验表明该方法显著提升了模型在域变化下的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 光流估计模型通常依赖合成数据训练，但在真实域部署时性能下降。现有解决方案受限于标注成本，缺乏有效的无监督域泛化方法。
Method: 提出 SciFlow，在训练中利用开放世界图像的语义特征对合成图像进行干扰，混合域内特征与跨域干扰，同时使用几何一致性损失确保自监督的有效性。
Result: 实验表明 SciFlow 显著增强了模型在域变化下的鲁棒性，并实现了从合成域到真实域的泛化，无需真实域标注。
Conclusion: 该方法网络无关、简单有效，为光流估计的域泛化提供了一种无需真实标注的实用方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BERTomelo: Your Portuguese Encoder Best Friend
papers.abstract_en: Encoders have become the state of the art for multiple NLP tasks, especially those requiring deep contextual understanding. While multilingual models offer broad coverage, dedicated monolingual encoders are essential for capturing the unique lexical and syntactic nuances of specific languages. For Portuguese, however, existing monolingual options like BERTimbau and Albertina have not kept pace with recent architectural breakthroughs, often lagging behind English benchmarks in scalability and efficiency. This work introduces BERTomelo, a next-generation monolingual encoder pre-trained from scratch and specifically optimized for the Portuguese language. By leveraging the ModernBERT architecture, BERTomelo overcomes the limitations of previous models, offering Base and Large versions with a 1,024-token context window and hardware-level optimizations like FlashAttention and alternating attention mechanisms. The model was trained on ClassiCC-PT, a massive, high-quality Portuguese corpus of 106 million documents, ensuring superior alignment with the language's contemporary usage. The results demonstrate that BERTomelo not only outperforms previous Portuguese encoders but also provides a more robust and efficient alternative to massive multilingual models in downstream tasks such as STS and NER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BERTomelo，一个基于ModernBERT架构从零预训练的葡萄牙语单语编码器，使用106M文档的高质量语料库ClassiCC-PT。模型提供Base和Large版本，支持1024-token上下文窗口和FlashAttention等硬件优化。实验表明，BERTomelo在句子语义相似度（STS）和命名实体识别（NER）等下游任务中优于之前的葡萄牙语编码器（如BERTimbau和Albertina），并为大规模多语言模型提供了更鲁棒高效的替代方案。
Motivation: 现有葡萄牙语单语编码器（如BERTimbau和Albertina）未跟上最新架构进展，在可扩展性和效率上落后于英语模型；而多语言模型虽覆盖广泛但缺乏对葡萄牙语独特词汇和句法细微差别的专门优化。
Method: 采用ModernBERT架构，包含交替注意力机制和FlashAttention优化；在自构建的106M文档大规模高质量葡萄牙语语料库ClassiCC-PT上进行预训练，支持1,024-token上下文窗口。
Result: 在STS和NER等下游任务中，BERTomelo显著优于之前的葡萄牙语编码器，并作为大型多语言模型的高效替代方案表现出更强的鲁棒性和效率。
Conclusion: BERTomelo是葡萄牙语自然语言处理的新一代单语编码器，通过现代架构和大规模高质量语料实现了领先性能，但论文未提及在未见领域或低资源场景下的泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reward-Free Code Alignment from Pretrained or Fine-Tuned LLM: Unpacking the Trade-offs for Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) alignment trains an LLM using preference data to produce outputs that better meet established quality standards. While LLM alignment techniques are studied for non-coding tasks, we know little about their usefulness for coding tasks. It is unclear whether LLM code alignment could support both functional requirements (producing executable, correct code) and non-functional requirements (code readability, style, maintainability). It is also unknown whether alignment for a code LLM should begin with base pretrained version or the finetuned (i.e., instruction-tuned) version of the LLM. In this paper, we offer insights on the above two research questions by conducting an empirical study. We studied five state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs using two widely used LLM alignment techniques: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and BoNBoN. For each training record, we created a preference pair as accepted and rejected instances by using the SelfCodeAlign pipeline. DPO and BoNBoN are reward-free models, i.e., they eliminate the need for multiple reward scores for output preferences. We tuned each LLM using the two alignment techniques in two settings: pretrained and finetuned versions of an LLM. We evaluated functional requirements using four SOTA benchmarks (HumanEval+, MBPP+, EvalPerf, EvoEval) and non-functional requirements using the CODAL benchmark, which evaluates code quality across five dimensions derived from software engineering practices. We find that pretrained-to-aligned pathways achieve larger improvements in the aligned variant over its pretrained variant. But the pretrained variant is generally less accurate than its finetuned variant. However, finetuned- to-aligned offers smaller performance improvements or, in some cases, degradation in the aligned variant than its finetuned variant.
papers.journal_ref: The ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实证研究比较了从预训练和微调版本开始进行无奖励代码对齐（DPO和BoNBoN）的效果，评估了对齐对代码功能性和非功能性需求的影响。实验发现，从预训练开始对齐能带来更大的性能提升，但预训练变体的基准准确性低于微调变体；而从微调开始对齐提升较小甚至导致性能退化。
Motivation: 现有LLM对齐技术多针对非编码任务，其在代码任务中能否同时支持功能性和非功能性需求尚不明确，且对齐起始版本（预训练 vs 微调）的选择缺乏指导。
Method: 采用两种无奖励对齐技术（DPO和BoNBoN），利用SelfCodeAlign构建偏好对，分别对五个SOTA LLM的预训练和微调变体进行对齐，并通过HumanEval+、MBPP+、EvalPerf、EvoEval评估功能性需求，用CODAL评估非功能性需求。
Result: 预训练到对齐的路径在对齐变体上取得更大改进，但预训练变体本身准确性低于微调变体；微调到对齐的路径改进较小，甚至在某些情况下导致对齐变体性能下降。
Conclusion: 结果表明，从预训练开始对齐可获得更大的相对提升，但最终性能可能仍低于从微调开始的对齐变体；从微调开始的对齐改进有限或存在退化风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Surrogate Modeling of Static Response of AM Short-Fiber Thermoplastics Using Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Short-fiber thermoplastic (SFT) composites are increasingly employed in lightweight aerospace and automotive structures owing to their favorable strength-to-weight ratio, high production rates, and recyclability. Unlike continuous-fiber systems, the mechanical response of SFTs is governed by mesoscale interactions among fiber orientation, spatial clustering, and manufacturing-induced porosity. These features exhibit significant spatial variability in manufactured components and influence stiffness, damage initiation, and nonlinear deformation. Although mesoscale finite element (FE) models can resolve such heterogeneity, their application to realistic three-dimensional microstructures remains computationally intractable. A data-driven surrogate framework is proposed to predict the mechanical behavior of additively manufactured, compression-molded (AM-CM) SFTs. Microstructures reconstructed from micro-computed tomography data were discretized into Voronoi-based cells representing distinct fiber-interaction neighborhoods. Each cell was homogenized via nonlinear FE simulations incorporating matrix damage, and the resulting stress-strain responses trained a hybrid Graph Neural Network-Long Short-Term Memory (GNN-LSTM) architecture encoding microstructural topology and history-dependent mechanical evolution. The surrogate accurately predicts stiffness and stress-strain behavior of unseen microstructures, achieving $R^2\approx 0.98$ relative to high-fidelity FE simulations with over two orders-of-magnitude reduction in computational cost. Coupling the framework with experimentally calibrated damage laws demonstrates that fiber orientation, clustering, and porosity collectively govern local effective stiffness. The approach provides a physics-informed, data-efficient pathway to identify mechanically weak microstructural cells and accelerate digital-twin development for SFT components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对增材制造短纤维热塑性塑料（SFT）的力学行为代理建模，提出基于图神经网络（GNN）和长短期记忆网络（LSTM）的混合架构。微结构从微CT数据重建，划分为Voronoi单元，通过非线性有限元仿真获得应力-应变响应训练模型。代理模型在未见微结构上预测刚度与应力-应变行为，R^2≈0.98，计算成本降低两个数量级以上，为SFT构件的数字孪生开发提供高效路径。
Motivation: 短纤维热塑性塑料的力学响应受介观尺度纤维取向、空间聚集和制造孔隙率影响，空间变异性强。介观有限元模型虽能解析异质性，但应用于真实3D微结构计算成本过高，需数据驱动代理模型。
Method: 提出数据驱动代理框架：从微CT数据重建微结构，离散为Voronoi单元；每个单元通过含基体损伤的非线性有限元仿真均质化；使用图神经网络（GNN）编码微结构拓扑、LSTM处理历史依赖的力学演化，训练混合GNN-LSTM模型。
Result: 代理模型预测未见过微结构的应力-应变行为，R^2≈0.98，相比高保真有限元仿真计算成本降低超过两个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架将纤维取向、聚集和孔隙率纳入考虑，可识别力学薄弱的微结构单元，为SFT构件数字孪生开发提供物理信息驱动的数据高效途径。

papers.title: Arbitrary Reduction of Validation Error for AI Decision Tests using Homomorphic AI and Repetition Codes
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents new results and breakthrough obtained with the HbHAI techniques (Hash-based Homomorphic Artificial Intelligence) proposed in \cite{filiol0,sepp}. HbHAI is based on a novel class of key-dependent hash functions that naturally preserve most similarity properties, most AI algorithms rely on. It enables to analyse and process data in its cryptographically secure form while using existing native AI algorithms without modification, with unprecedented performances compared to existing homomorphic encryption schemes and most notably compared to the same processing on corresponding plaintext data. Two major results have been obtained further. First we enable to reduce the compression rate up to a factor of 10 thus allowing to process massive datasets while reducing the computation time and the energy footprint in the same order. Second, we show how it is possible to arbitrarily reduce the final validation error of AI-based decision tests by using repetition error-correcting codes.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure. Extended version of the talk presented at DSC Next 2026, Amsterdam, May 7-8th, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HbHAI（Hash-based Homomorphic Artificial Intelligence）技术，利用密钥相关哈希函数在加密数据上直接运行原生AI算法，无需修改。相比现有同态加密方案和明文处理，性能显著提升：压缩率可降低10倍，计算时间和能耗相应减少；同时利用重复纠错码可任意降低AI决策测试的验证误差。
Motivation: 现有同态加密方案在处理加密数据时性能较差，且无法直接使用原生AI算法，需要开发一种既能保护数据安全又能保持AI算法效率的方法。
Method: 基于密钥相关哈希函数（HbHAI），这些函数自然保留大多数AI算法依赖的相似性属性，从而允许在密文上直接使用现有AI算法处理，并通过重复纠错码实现验证误差的任意降低。
Result: 压缩率提升至10倍，计算时间和能耗相应降低；验证误差可被任意减小。
Conclusion: HbHAI技术在同态加密领域取得突破性性能，并提供了通过纠错码控制AI决策测试误差的新能力。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning General-Purpose Large Language Models for Agricultural Applications:A Reproducible Framework and Evaluation Protocol Based on Qwen3-8B
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong abilities in opendomain question answering, information extraction, and text generation. Agricultural applications, however, are domain-specific, region-dependent, time-sensitive, and safety-critical. Without data governance, expert evaluation, and evidence constraints, an agricultural assistant mayproduce unreliable advice on crop diseases, pesticide use, fertilization, or policy interpretation.To avoid presenting unverified simulated numbers as real experimental findings, this paper doesnot report any model-performance claims that have not been produced by an actual training runand expert evaluation. Instead, we propose AgriTune-R, a reproducible and auditable frameworkfor adapting general-purpose LLMs to agricultural tasks. The framework selects the publiclyverifiable Qwen3-8B model as the recommended base model and integrates agricultural datagovernance, instruction construction, LoRA/QLoRA parameter-efficient fine-tuning, retrievalaugmented generation, expert evaluation, and safety control for high-risk questions. The contributions are: (1) a structured workflow for agricultural LLM adaptation; (2) an evaluationprotocol for agricultural knowledge QA, pest and disease consultation, cultivation management,and policy explanation; (3) an expert-review rubric combining factuality, safety, evidence consistency, and uncertainty expression; and (4) a clear separation between protocol design andempirical conclusions, providing an executable baseline for future empirical studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgriTune-R，一个可复现、可审计的框架，用于将通用大语言模型（如 Qwen3-8B）适配到农业任务。框架涵盖数据治理、指令构建、LoRA/QLoRA 高效微调、检索增强生成、专家评估和安全控制。论文明确不报告未经验证的数字，而是提供结构化工作流、评估协议和专家评审标准，为未来实证研究提供可执行基线。
Motivation: 通用 LLM 在开放域任务中表现优异，但农业应用具有领域特定、地域依赖、时效性强和安全关键的特点，直接使用可能产生不可靠的作物病害、农药使用等建议。
Method: 基于 Qwen3-8B，集成农业数据治理、指令构建、LoRA/QLoRA 参数高效微调、检索增强生成、专家评估以及高风险问题的安全控制。
Result: 论文未报告任何未经实际训练和专家评估的模型性能数字，而是提供了完整的协议和框架设计。
Conclusion: 论文强调协议设计与实证结论分离，为农业 LLM 适配提供了可复现的基线，但自身不产出实证结果。

papers.title: Learning from Acquisition: Metadata-driven Multimodal Pre-training for Cardiac MRI
papers.abstract_en: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) routinely records structured acquisition metadata, yet most CMR foundation models rely primarily on image-only pre-training and leave this naturally available source of weak semantic supervision largely underexplored. We propose MetaCLIP-CMR, a metadata-driven framework based on Contrastive Language--Image Pre-training (CLIP), which converts imaging modality, anatomical view, scanner vendor, field strength, and scanner model into textual supervision for CMR representation learning. The pretrained image encoder is evaluated on imaging modality classification, cine view classification, and cardiac segmentation. MetaCLIP-CMR achieves 86.8% modality accuracy and 86.5% cine view accuracy, clearly outperforming ImageNet and masked reconstruction initialisations. For downstream cardiac segmentation, MetaCLIP-CMR consistently obtains the highest Dice score across the evaluated ACDC and M&Ms cine short-axis (SAX) settings under both full-data and 20% fine-tuning regimes. Compared with recent image-focused large-scale CMR pre-training models, MetaCLIP-CMR achieves comparable ACDC segmentation performance, while requiring less than 1% of their pre-training image scale. These results suggest that metadata learning offers a natural and easy-to-use strategy for transforming routinely recorded acquisition information into effective supervision for foundation-level CMR representation learning, highlighting the promise of metadata-driven multimodal pre-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaCLIP-CMR，一种基于 CLIP 的元数据驱动框架，将心脏 MRI 的采集元数据（如成像模态、解剖视图、扫描仪型号等）转化为文本监督信号进行预训练。在模态分类、视图分类和心脏分割任务上评估，MetaCLIP-CMR 在 ACDC 和 M&Ms 数据集上的分割 Dice 分数与近期大规模 CMR 预训练模型相当，但预训练图像规模不到其 1%。
Motivation: 大多数 CMR 基础模型仅使用图像进行预训练，忽略了常规记录的采集元数据这一天然弱语义监督来源。
Method: 将成像模态、解剖视图、扫描仪厂商、场强和扫描仪型号转换为文本描述，采用对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）框架进行多模态预训练。
Result: 模态分类准确率 86.8%，电影视图分类准确率 86.5%，优于 ImageNet 和掩码重建初始化。在 ACDC 和 M&Ms 数据集上，全数据和 20% 微调设置下均获得最高 Dice 分数，且仅用不到 1% 的预训练图像规模达到与近期大模型相当的性能。
Conclusion: 元数据学习提供了一种自然且易用的策略，可将常规记录的采集信息转化为有效的监督信号，用于基础级别的 CMR 表示学习，展示了元数据驱动的多模态预训练的潜力。

papers.title: Compositional Dynamics in Learning and Mechanics
papers.abstract_en: We give a single compositional setting in which gradient-based learning and Hamiltonian-style mechanics appear as functorial semantics. The syntax is an operad Arr whose objects are input-output interfaces (pairs of manifolds) and whose morphisms are *smooth adaptive arrangements*, which consist of a reactive parameter space, a lens given by smooth output and input maps, and a real-valued potential. The main technical result of the paper is what we call *lens internalization*, a lax symmetric monoidal functor Lens(C) $\to$ C associated to any symmetric monoidal closed category C. Using it, we provide two functors $Φ_\text{phase}$, $Φ_\text{conf}$: Arr $\to$ PC into the 2-category of polynomial coalgebras -- input-output discrete dynamical systems -- which we take as the semantics category. $Φ_\text{phase}$ stores both position and momentum, whereas $Φ_\text{conf}$ stores only position. When applied to a parameterized function, $Φ_\text{conf}$ recovers the gradient descent training algorithm, with backpropagation as the lens' backward pass. When applied to harmonic particles wired together -- in series, or according to any finite directed graph -- one diagram yields two different regimes, both of which are governed by the graph Laplacian: $Φ_\text{phase}$ gives the discrete wave equation, which is conservative and second-order, and $Φ_\text{conf}$ gives the discrete heat equation, which is dissipative and first-order. They are two semantics of one adaptive arrangement, e.g. with the same potential in each case. And because Arr is an operad, such diagrams nest -- larger systems wired from smaller ones -- and each semantics assembles a system's dynamics functorially from its parts. These dynamics are moreover executable: a parameterized neural network and a graph of particles both compile, by the same construction, to explicit state machines one can run.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个统一的组合框架，将基于梯度的学习和哈密顿力学视为函子语义。主要结果是透镜内化 (lens internalization) 定理，并利用它定义了 Arr → PC 的两个函子 Φ_phase 和 Φ_conf，分别对应动量-位置和仅位置状态。应用于参数化函数时，Φ_conf 恢复梯度下降训练算法；应用于由谐波粒子组成的系统（如串联或有限有向图）时，Φ_phase 给出离散波动方程，Φ_conf 给出离散热方程。Arr 是一个操作代数 (operad)，允许嵌套组合，语义是函子性的。
Motivation: 现有的学习和力学框架通常被视为分离的领域，缺乏统一的组合视角。本文旨在通过范畴论为两者提供单一的语法和语义，使得从部件到系统动力学的组装具有函子性。
Method: 提出 Arr 操作代数，其对象为输入-输出接口（流形对），态射为光滑自适应安排（包含反应参数空间、透镜结构和实值势）。主要技术结果是透镜内化：一个从 Lens(C) 到 C 的松弛对称幺半群函子。利用该函子构造两个语义函子 Φ_phase 和 Φ_conf，将 Arr 映射到多项式余代数（输入-输出离散动力系统）的 2-范畴。
Result: Φ_conf 应用于参数化函数时恢复梯度下降训练算法（反向传播作为透镜的反向传递）。应用于按图连接的谐波粒子时，Φ_phase 产生离散波动方程（保守、二阶），Φ_conf 产生离散热方程（耗散、一阶）。两者共享同一势函数。
Conclusion: 本文展示了一个组合框架，使得学习和力学系统可以以统一的语法描述，并自动编译为可执行的状态机。该框架具有函子性和嵌套组合性，但由于是理论构造，尚未在具体大规模应用中验证。

papers.title: Evidence-Based Text-Conditioned 3D CT Synthesis for Ovarian Cancer
papers.abstract_en: Ovarian cancer is frequently diagnosed at an advanced stage, making preoperative contrast-enhanced computed tomography (CT) central to staging and surgical planning; yet the scarcity of annotated imaging data, compounded by privacy regulations, limits the development of generalizable computational models in this domain. Text-conditioned 3D CT synthesis has shown promise, but existing pipelines depend on paired radiology reports and have been evaluated only on chest CT. We propose OvESyn (Ovarian Evidence-based Synthesis), a framework that constructs standardized Findings and Impression sections directly from CT-derived imaging descriptors and routine clinical metadata, without any original radiology report, and uses them to condition a latent diffusion model adapted to 493 high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma patients. This is the first text-conditioned 3D CT synthesis framework adapted to an abdomino-pelvic oncologic setting. A systematic ablation over two adaptation axes, vision-language encoder alignment and generator fine-tuning, identifies generator domain adaptation as the operative mechanism for crossing the domain gap and establishing the target anatomy: without it, synthesis remains anchored to the thoracic pretraining domain, with Precision and Recall collapsing to zero and FID2.5D exceeding 140, regardless of encoder alignment. Encoder alignment instead refines intensity and fine detail. The full OvESyn attains the best distributional and intensity fidelity (FID2.5D 29.35, Precision 0.671, Wasserstein-1 0.044), while the generator-only variant maximizes coverage (Recall 0.645), reflecting a fidelity/coverage trade-off governed by encoder adaptation. Requiring only automatic segmentations and routine preoperative metadata, OvESyn supports transferability to report-scarce settings and provides a foundation for synthetic cohort generation in abdomino-pelvic oncologic imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OvESyn 框架，用于卵巢癌术前对比增强 CT 的文本条件 3D 合成。该框架直接从 CT 成像特征和临床元数据构建标准化的 Findings 和 Impression 部分，无需原始放射学报告，并将这些文本作为条件输入到潜在扩散模型中，在 493 例高级别浆液性卵巢癌患者上进行训练。这是首个应用于腹部-盆腔肿瘤学环境的文本条件 3D CT 合成框架。消融实验表明，生成器域适应是跨越域间隙建立目标解剖结构的关键机制，而视觉-语言编码器对齐则优化强度和细节。完整 OvESyn 取得了最佳分布和强度保真度（FID2.5D 29.35，Precision 0.671，Wasserstein-1 0.044），但生成器单独变体在覆盖率上更优（Recall 0.645），反映了保真度与覆盖率的权衡。
Motivation: 卵巢癌常于晚期确诊，术前增强 CT 对分期和手术规划至关重要，但标注影像数据稀缺且受隐私法规限制，阻碍了通用计算模型的发展。现有文本条件 3D CT 合成依赖配对放射学报告，且仅针对胸部 CT 评估，缺乏适用于腹部-盆腔肿瘤学场景的方法。
Method: 提出 OvESyn 框架，利用自动分割和常规术前元数据提取 CT 成像描述符，构建标准化的 Findings 和 Impression 文本，无需原始放射学报告。将文本条件用于潜在扩散模型，并进行两方面的域适应消融：视觉-语言编码器对齐和生成器微调。
Result: 完整 OvESyn 取得 FID2.5D 29.35、Precision 0.671、Wasserstein-1 0.044；仅生成器适应变体取得 Recall 0.645。无生成器适应时，无论编码器对齐如何，合成结果仍锚定于胸腔预训练域，Precision 和 Recall 降为零，FID2.5D 超过 140。
Conclusion: OvESyn 是首个文本条件 3D CT 合成框架应用于腹部-盆腔肿瘤学环境，仅需自动分割和常规术前元数据，支持向报告稀缺环境迁移，并为合成队列生成奠定基础。生成器域适应是克服域差距的关键，而编码器对齐调节保真度-覆盖率权衡。

papers.title: Self-Evolving Agentic Image Restoration via Deliberate Planning and Intuitive Execution
papers.abstract_en: Real-world image restoration (IR) remains challenging due to complex and coupled degradations. While recent agentic IR frameworks leverage Large Language Models for flexible tool planning, they face two critical limitations. First, from a search scheme perspective, excessive reliance on greedy strategies fails to balance exploration and exploitation. Second, existing agentic systems underutilize information, exhibiting episodic amnesia. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{Self-Evolving Agentic Image Restoration (SEAR)}, which formulates restoration as a sequential decision-making problem. Inspired by the dual-process theory, SEAR comprises an Intuitive Executor and a Deliberate Planner, respectively following the fast-thinking \textit{System 1} and slow-thinking \textit{System 2} principles. The Deliberate Planner employs Pruning-Aware Monte Carlo Tree Search for long-horizon reasoning, utilizing a hybrid no-reference reward and a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based tournament to prevent metric exploitation. Complementarily, the Intuitive Executor leverages a self-evolving episodic memory indexed by degradation-aware state fingerprints. This mechanism distills expensive search trajectories into adaptive expertise, overcoming episodic amnesia while progressively amortizing cold-start exploration costs through memory reuse. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate its strong perceptual and quantitative performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自演化智能体图像恢复框架SEAR，将图像恢复建模为序列决策问题。它包含直觉执行器和深思规划器，分别对应快速思考的System 1和慢速思考的System 2。深思规划器使用修剪感知蒙特卡洛树搜索进行长程推理，结合混合无参考奖励和多模态大语言模型（MLLM）锦标赛，直觉执行器利用退化感知状态指纹索引的自演化情节记忆来存储搜索轨迹。实验表明，该方法在合成和真实基准上取得了强感知和定量性能。
Motivation: 现有智能体图像恢复方法在搜索策略上过度依赖贪婪策略，未能平衡探索与利用，且信息利用不足导致情节遗忘。
Method: 采用双过程理论，包含直觉执行器和深思规划器。深思规划器使用修剪感知蒙特卡洛树搜索，并由混合无参考奖励和MLLM锦标赛驱动；直觉执行器利用退化感知状态指纹索引的自演化情节记忆，将搜索轨迹蒸馏为自适应专业知识。
Result: 在合成和真实图像恢复基准上，该方法在感知质量和量化指标上均表现出色。
Conclusion: SEAR通过结合规划与记忆机制，有效解决了现有智能体方法中的搜索与信息利用问题，提升了图像恢复性能。

papers.title: RGLD: Randomized Global-Local Density Estimation for Tabular Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Unsupervised tabular anomaly detection requires methods that are accurate, robust across heterogeneous datasets, and computationally efficient. Classical statistical detectors are often efficient, but they usually rely on a fixed data view and a single notion of abnormality. Deep anomaly detectors can learn more flexible scoring functions, but they are substantially slower and difficult to tune in unsupervised settings due to the lack of a reliable supervisory signal. We propose RGLD, a randomized global-local density estimator for efficient unsupervised tabular anomaly detection. RGLD combines a global random-feature density branch, which identifies samples in broadly low-density regions, with a local neighbor branch, which detects samples that are weakly supported by nearby observations. Both branches operate over feature-bagged randomized views, allowing RGLD to expose anomaly evidence that may be hidden in any single representation. We conduct experiments on 47 tabular datasets against 23 statistical and deep anomaly detection baselines under fully unsupervised setting. RGLD achieves the strongest dataset-level AUROC performance, ranking 1st in dataset wins, and ranks 2nd in AUPRC wins. RGLD is also faster than all evaluated deep detectors, achieving 50x-580x speedups, and remains competitive with statistical methods in runtime, yielding a favorable accuracy-efficiency tradeoff.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出RGLD，一种结合全局随机特征密度分支和局部邻居分支的无监督表格异常检测方法，在47个表格数据集上对比23个基线，取得最优AUROC成绩，并实现50-580倍速度提升。
Motivation: 无监督表格异常检测需要在异构数据集上保持准确、鲁棒且计算高效，现有经典统计方法依赖固定数据视图和单一异常概念，深度检测器灵活但速度慢且难调参。
Method: RGLD包含两个分支：全局随机特征密度分支（识别低密度区域样本）和局部邻居分支（检测邻近观测支持弱的样本），两者均基于特征袋随机视图操作，以暴露单一表示中可能隐藏的异常证据。
Result: 在47个表格数据集上，RGLD的AUROC排名第一（数据集胜出数第一），AUPRC排名第二；相比所有深度检测器提速50-580倍，与统计方法速度相当，实现准确率-效率的良好权衡。
Conclusion: RGLD通过随机全局-局部密度估计实现了无监督表格异常检测的准确性和效率平衡，在多个基准上表现最优。

papers.title: Beyond the Mean: Three-Axis Fidelity for Aligning LLM-Based Survey Simulators from Small Pilot Data
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate social survey responses, yet their outputs exhibit systematic biases: marginal distributions are skewed, response variance is poorly calibrated, and predictor-outcome relationships are attenuated. We ask a simple question: given a small pilot sample of human responses, can an LLM recover the statistical characteristics of a broader population? We decompose recovery along three axes: structural fidelity, marginal fidelity, and individual fidelity. Using a COVID-19 misinformation survey as a case study, we benchmark three families of approaches: prompting, rectification, and fine-tuning. The findings suggest that fine-tuning on small pilot samples offers a balanced approach for achieving multiple forms of fidelity, but the levels of such fidelity can vary across subsamples, potentially threatening pluralistic alignment.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 8 tables, 3 figures; Pluralistic Alignment @ ICML 2026 Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用大语言模型（LLM）模拟社会调查回答时，如何从小规模试点数据恢复人群统计特征。提出沿三个轴衡量保真度：结构保真度、边际保真度和个体保真度，以COVID-19 misinformation调查为案例，比较提示、修正和微调三种方法。
Motivation: LLM模拟社会调查存在系统性偏差（边际分布偏斜、方差校准差、预测-结果关系减弱），需要从小规模试点恢复总体统计特征。
Method: 提出三个维度的保真度框架（结构、边际、个体），并基准测试三种方法：提示工程（prompting）、后处理修正（rectification）和微调（fine-tuning）。
Result: 微调在小样本上提供平衡的多种保真度，但保真度水平在不同子样本间存在差异，可能威胁多元对齐。
Conclusion: 微调是恢复统计特性的有效方法，但需注意子样本间的保真度差异。

papers.title: FlipGuard: Defending Large Language Models Against Quantization-Conditioned Backdoor Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Model quantization is essential for the efficient deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), but introduces a critical vulnerability: Quantization-Conditioned Backdoor (QCB) attacks. In these attacks, malicious behaviors remain dormant in full-precision models and activate only after specific quantization distortions, bypassing standard security audits. To mitigate this, we introduce FlipGuard, a proactive defense framework that selectively perturbs model weights prior to quantization. By breaking the adversary's precise alignment between weight patterns and quantization boundaries, FlipGuard suppresses backdoor activation without requiring access to training data or trigger samples. We further propose the Defense Effectiveness Ratio (DER), a unified metric to jointly evaluate security gains, utility preservation, and computational cost. Extensive experiments across seven LLMs (including StarCoder and LLaMA-family models) and three quantization schemes (INT8, FP4, NF4) demonstrate that FlipGuard effectively neutralizes QCBs across three scenarios, i.e., vulnerable code generation, content injection, and over-refusal, achieving high security with negligible performance degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型量化引入的脆弱性，提出一种主动防御框架FlipGuard，通过量化前选择性扰动权重，破坏攻击者对权重模式与量化边界的精确对齐，从而抑制量化条件后门攻击。实验在7个LLM（含StarCoder和LLaMA系列）和三种量化方案（INT8、FP4、NF4）上验证，在易受攻击的代码生成、内容注入和过度拒绝三种场景下均有效，且性能损失可忽略。
Motivation: 模型量化对LLM高效部署至关重要，但引入了量化条件后门攻击，恶意行为在量化后才激活，可绕过标准安全审计。
Method: 提出FlipGuard，一种无需训练数据或触发样本的防御方法，通过在量化前对权重施加选择性扰动，打破攻击者对权重模式与量化边界的对齐。同时提出统一度量Defense Effectiveness Ratio (DER)，联合评估安全增益、效用保持和计算成本。
Result: 在7个LLM和三种量化方案上的实验表明，FlipGuard能有效中和量化条件后门攻击，覆盖代码生成、内容注入和过度拒绝三种场景，实现高安全性且性能退化可忽略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调FlipGuard在无需访问训练数据或触发样本的情况下有效防御量化条件后门攻击，且通用性强。

papers.title: Expert Evaluation of Clinical AI Tools on Real Point-of-Care Clinical Queries
papers.abstract_en: Physicians now pose millions of clinical questions to AI tools each week, yet these tools are evaluated largely on hypothetical or exam-style questions, not those actually asked in practice. We report a blinded evaluation built on 620 Real-world Point-Of-Care Queries (Real-POCQi) submitted to the OpenEvidence (OE) platform by physicians spanning 30 specialties, as well as 187 questions from HealthBench. 149 practicing physicians across 36 states made head-to-head comparisons between answers from three frontier general-purpose models (Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.5) and a specialized clinical tool (OE), with graders matched to each question's specialty. When comparing answers along five dimensions relevant to clinical decision support -- accuracy, clinical utility, source quality, verifiability, & completeness -- physicians scored the specialized tool highest on all axes; in the primary analysis on Real-POCQi, win differences (margins between win and loss rates) ranged from 25 to 39 percentage points (p<0.001). Results remained consistent in sensitivity analyses stratifying by citation display, answer length, OE-user status, and Real-POCQi versus HealthBench. In parallel, LLM judges were found to systematically differ from expert judges, though both generally agreed on the best model. These findings underscore two conclusions: (i) AI tool evaluations should reflect real-world query distributions and use expert judges that mirror the specialization defining modern medicine and (ii) the consistent advantage of the specialized tool over general-purpose models does not necessarily mean that the latter cannot serve similar purposes, but that targeted engineering and customization can yield meaningful gains in performance for its users. We release Real-POCQi as a public benchmark, as well as the prespecified statistical analysis for reproducing results of this study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一项针对临床AI工具的盲法评估，基于620个真实临床查询（Real-POCQi）和187个HealthBench问题，由149名执业医师对专用临床工具（OpenEvidence）和三个通用前沿模型（Claude Opus 4.8、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.5）进行头对头比较。结果显示，专用工具在准确性、临床实用性、来源质量、可验证性和完整性五个维度上均得分最高，胜率差异（胜率与败率之差）在25至39个百分点（p<0.001）。研究还发现，LLM评判者与专家评判者存在系统性差异。最后，作者公开了Real-POCQi基准和预分析方案。
Motivation: 尽管医生每周向AI工具提出数百万个临床问题，但现有评估主要基于假设性或考试型问题，而非实际临床中提出的查询，缺乏真实场景下的评估。
Method: 基于OpenEvidence平台收集的620个真实临床查询（覆盖30个专科）以及HealthBench的187个问题，招募149名执业医师（覆盖36个州）进行盲法比较，由与问题专科匹配的评分者从五个维度评判答案质量。
Result: 专用临床工具在真实查询上所有维度均优于通用模型，胜率差异为25-39个百分点（p<0.001）；结果在多种敏感性分析中保持一致。
Conclusion: AI工具评估应使用反映真实查询分布的数据和匹配现代医学专业性的专家评判者；专用工具通过定制化工程可显著提升性能，但这不意味着通用模型无法实现类似目的。

papers.title: Modification-Considering Value Learning for Reward Hacking Mitigation in RL
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning agents can exploit misspecified reward signals to achieve high apparent returns while failing on the intended objective, a failure mode known as reward hacking. Existing practical defenses typically constrain policy updates to stay near a known safe reference, creating a tension between suppressing hacking and permitting legitimate improvement. We propose Modification-Considering Value Learning (MCVL), which operationalizes the theoretical idea of current utility optimization for standard value-based RL. MCVL wraps an off-policy learner and treats each incoming transition as a candidate modification: it forecasts two training paths, one that includes the transition and one that does not, and scores both with a frozen bootstrapped-return estimator derived from a learned reward model and value function. The transition is admitted only if inclusion does not decrease the score. We formalize conditions under which this filtering is both safe and permissive, and instantiate MCVL with DDQN and TD3. Across four safety-relevant gridworlds and three modified MuJoCo continuous-control tasks with diverse hacking mechanisms, MCVL mitigates reward hacking while continuing to improve the intended objective. Project website: ktolnos.github.io/mcvl/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习中的奖励黑客问题，提出修改考虑的价值学习（MCVL）方法。MCVL 包装一个离策略学习器，对每个到来的转移考虑是否接纳：通过冻结的引导回报估计器（来自学习到的奖励模型和价值函数）预测两条训练路径（包含和不包含该转移），只有当包含不降低分数时才接纳转移。在多个安全相关的网格世界和修改的 MuJoCo 连续控制任务上，MCVL 减轻了奖励黑客同时继续改善预期目标。
Motivation: 强化学习智能体可能利用错误指定的奖励信号实现高表观回报但未能完成预期目标（奖励黑客）。现有防御通常约束策略更新靠近已知安全参考，但抑制黑客与允许正当改进之间存在张力。
Method: 提出 MCVL，实现当前效用优化的理论思想，用于标准基于价值的强化学习。MCVL 包装离策略学习器，对每个转移计算两个训练路径的分数（包含和不包含），使用冻结的引导回报估计器（基于学习到的奖励模型和价值函数）打分，仅当包含不降低分数时才接纳该转移。
Result: 在四个安全相关的网格世界和三个修改的 MuJoCo 连续控制任务（具有多种黑客机制）上，MCVL 减轻了奖励黑客同时继续改善预期目标。
Conclusion: MCVL 形式化了该过滤既安全又宽松的条件，并在 DDQN 和 TD3 上实例化。实验表明其能有效缓解奖励黑客问题。

papers.title: Clustering Unsupervised Representations as Defense against Poisoning Attacks on Speech Commands Classification System
papers.abstract_en: Poisoning attacks entail attackers intentionally tampering with training data. In this paper, we consider a dirty-label poisoning attack scenario on a speech commands classification system. The threat model assumes that certain utterances from one of the classes (source class) are poisoned by superimposing a trigger on it, and its label is changed to another class selected by the attacker (target class). We propose a filtering defense against such an attack. First, we use DIstillation with NO labels (DINO) to learn unsupervised representations for all the training examples. Next, we use K-means and LDA to cluster these representations. Finally, we keep the utterances with the most repeated label in their cluster for training and discard the rest. For a 10% poisoned source class, we demonstrate a drop in attack success rate from 99.75% to 0.25%. We test our defense against a variety of threat models, including different target and source classes, as well as trigger variations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语音指令分类系统中的脏标签中毒攻击，提出一种基于无监督表示聚类的过滤防御方法。该方法利用DINO学习无监督表示，再通过K-means和LDA聚类，保留每个聚类中多数标签的样本，丢弃其余样本。在10%源类投毒率下，攻击成功率从99.75%降至0.25%。
Motivation: 中毒攻击中攻击者通过篡改训练数据破坏模型，现有防御在语音指令分类场景下研究不足。
Method: 先使用DINO为所有训练样本学习无监督表示，再通过K-means和LDA进行聚类，最后保留每个聚类中重复次数最多的标签对应的样本，丢弃其他样本。
Result: 在10%源类投毒场景下，攻击成功率从99.75%降至0.25%，并在不同目标/源类及触发器变体上验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 该无监督表示聚类过滤方法能有效防御脏标签中毒攻击，且对多种威胁模型鲁棒。

papers.title: Machine-learnable Sets
papers.abstract_en: In this study we present a formal definition of large discrete sets having, informally, three properties: their elements are easily recognized, easily generated, and the latter tasks are easily learned from examples. The formalism is specialized to sets of binary strings and a definition of "machine-learnability" based on the existence of a bounded-complexity Boolean autoencoder that fixes the elements of the set. We present experiments where the autoencoders are implemented by nets of Boolean threshold functions. Machine-learnability is demonstrated for Rorschach patterns (that may have reversed contrast in the mirrored half), and considerably "wilder" sets whose elements are only approximately fixed by admissible autoencoders. In the second case we demonstrate a simple iteration that evolves wild sets to make them properly machine-learnable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为大型离散二值字符串集合定义了“机器可学习性”，要求集合元素易识别、易生成且可从样例中学习。该定义基于存在一个有界复杂度的布尔自编码器来固定集合元素，自编码器通过布尔阈值函数网络实现。实验在Rorschach模式（镜像半区可反转对比）以及更无序的集合上验证了可学习性，并通过简单迭代将无序集合转变为可学习集合。
Motivation: 需要一种形式化定义来刻画离散集合是否容易被机器学习识别、生成和从例子学习，特别是针对大型离散集合。
Method: 提出基于有界复杂度布尔自编码器的机器可学习性定义，自编码器通过布尔阈值函数网络实现，并针对二进制字符串集合进行形式化。
Result: 在Rorschach模式（镜像半区可反转对比）上展示了机器可学习性，并在更无序的集合上通过迭代使它们变得可学习。
Conclusion: 该形式化框架和迭代方法为离散集合的可学习性提供了理论基础和实验验证，表明即使初始无序的集合也可通过迭代转变为可学习集合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Character Recognition of Nepali Number Plate
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a robust Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) system tailored for Nepali license plates written in Devanagari script. In this paper, a pipelined model was used that integrates YOLO-based models for license plate and character detection, followed by a CNN classifier trained on 34 Devanagari characters. Two publicly available data sets were used that incorporate diverse lighting, fonts, and structural variations. Data augmentation and additional training on embossed plates enhanced the generalizability of the model. The system achieved a recognition accuracy of up to 93\%, demonstrating strong performance under real-world conditions and providing a scalable solution for traffic management in Nepal. Code: https://github.com/Satyasakhadka/Nepali-NumberPlate-Character-Recognition
papers.comment: Accepted at World Conference on Information Systems for Business Management (ISBM) 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向尼泊尔车牌（Devanagari文）的自动车牌识别系统，采用YOLO进行车牌和字符检测，CNN分类器识别34个字符。系统在两个公开数据集上训练，通过数据增强和压纹车牌额外训练提升泛化性，在真实条件下达到93%识别准确率。
Motivation: 尼泊尔车牌使用Devanagari文字，现有ANPR系统不适用，需要专门针对该文字的车牌识别方案。
Method: 采用流水线模型：YOLO检测车牌和字符区域，CNN分类器对34个Devanagari字符进行识别。使用数据增强和在压纹车牌上额外训练以增强泛化能力。
Result: 系统在真实条件下达到93%的识别准确率。

papers.title: A3M: Adaptive, Adversarial and Multi-Objective Learning for Strategic Bidding in Repeated Auctions
papers.abstract_en: Learning to bid in repeated multi-unit auctions with bandit feedback poses a fundamental challenge. Existing methods often rely on rigid explore-then-exploit schedules, assume stationary adversaries, and optimize solely for bidder utility, thereby limiting adaptability and strategic robustness. To address these limitations, we introduce the A3M framework, which integrates adaptive deep reinforcement learning (DRL), explicit adversarial reasoning, and principled multi-objective reward design for online auction strategy optimization. A3M employs an actor-critic DRL backbone to dynamically balance exploration and exploitation, an opponent model for fictitious play against non-stationary adversaries, and a composite reward function to jointly maximize utility, auctioneer revenue, and fairness. We provide the first comprehensive empirical evaluation of this integrated approach against established baselines in both discriminatory and uniform price auctions. Results show that A3M reduces final regret by 30--40\% in standard settings, maintains robust performance against adversarial strategy shifts, scales favorably with the number of units $K$, and enables tunable multi-objective trade-offs. An extensive ablation study confirms the necessity of each core component. Our work establishes A3M as a powerful and flexible framework for learning in complex auction environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出A3M框架，结合自适应深度强化学习、对抗推理与多目标奖励设计，用于重复多单元拍卖中的竞价策略优化。在歧视性定价和统一定价拍卖中，A3M相比基线方法将最终遗憾降低30-40%，并能稳健应对非平稳对手策略，同时实现可调的多目标权衡。
Motivation: 现有竞价学习方法依赖刚性探索-利用调度、假设对手平稳且仅优化投标者效用，限制了适应性和策略鲁棒性。
Method: 采用演员-评论家深度强化学习主干动态平衡探索与利用，引入对手模型进行虚拟博弈以应对非平稳对手，并使用复合奖励函数联合优化效用、拍卖商收益和公平性。
Result: 在标准设置下最终遗憾降低30-40%，在对抗策略变化中保持稳健性能，随单元数K扩展良好，并支持可调多目标权衡。消融实验确认各核心组件的必要性。
Conclusion: A3M为复杂拍卖环境中的学习提供了一个强大且灵活的框架，是首次对此类集成方法进行全面的实证评估。

papers.title: ReGuide: From Test-Time Guidance to Self-Improving Diffusion Policies
papers.abstract_en: Behavior-cloned diffusion policies are expressive but remain vulnerable to covariate shift: small deviations from demonstrated states can compound into task failure. Existing methods address this either by expanding the training distribution through expert corrections or synthetic augmentation, or by steering a frozen policy at test time with guidance from a learned model. The former can be expensive or assumption-dependent, while the latter discards the corrected trajectories after execution. We introduce ReGuide, a self-improving framework that treats guided rollouts as reusable on-policy recovery data. ReGuide first uses Phase-Conditioned Guidance (PCG) to generate corrective rollouts: it constructs phase-specific latent targets, applies guidance only in the drifted-but-recoverable regime, and guides through the estimated clean action to match the dynamics model's training distribution. Successful guided rollouts are then absorbed back into the policy through ReGuide-FT, which fine-tunes the current checkpoint, or ReGuide-FS, which retrains from scratch on the augmented dataset; the two can also be composed and iterated. On Robomimic Can, Square, Transport, and Tool Hang, ReGuide improves base-policy success by $1.3$--$7.7\times$, outperforms LPB in the test-time-only setting, and matched-data ablations show that the gains come from guided recovery data rather than additional rollouts alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReGuide，一种自我改进框架，针对行为克隆的扩散策略在测试时生成校正轨迹并吸收回策略中，以减轻协变量偏移。该方法通过 Phase-Conditioned Guidance (PCG) 在漂移但可恢复区域生成引导轨迹，然后通过微调或从头训练将成功轨迹纳入策略。在 Robomimic 的四个任务上，基础策略成功率提升 1.3–7.7 倍，且消融实验表明收益来自引导恢复数据而非额外 rollout。
Motivation: 行为克隆的扩散策略易受协变量偏移影响，即微小状态偏差会累积为任务失败。现有方法要么扩展训练分布（成本高或依赖假设），要么在测试时引导冻结策略（丢弃校正轨迹），均不够高效。
Method: ReGuide 包含两个关键组件：Phase-Conditioned Guidance (PCG) 生成校正 rollout，它构建阶段特定的潜在目标，仅在漂移但可恢复区域应用引导，并通过估计清洁动作匹配动力学模型的训练分布；然后通过 ReGuide-FT（微调当前检查点）或 ReGuide-FS（在增强数据集上从头训练）将成功的引导轨迹吸收回策略，两者可组合迭代。
Result: 在 Robomimic 的 Can、Square、Transport 和 Tool Hang 任务上，ReGuide 将基础策略的成功率提升 1.3–7.7 倍，在仅测试时设置下优于 LPB，且消融实验表明增益来自引导恢复数据而非额外 rollout。
Conclusion: ReGuide 证明将测试时引导轨迹视为可复用的在线恢复数据可以显著提升行为克隆扩散策略的性能，且框架具有迭代自我改进的能力。

papers.title: FinInvest-GTCN: Explainable Graph-Temporal-Causal Modeling for Risk-Aware Investment Decision Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Venture capital (VC) investment decisions face distinct challenges, such as multi-source heterogeneous data, non-stationary time series, and the demand for explainable predictions in high-stakes, low-data settings. To overcome these issues, we introduce \textbf{FinInvest-GTCN}, a Graph-Temporal-Causal Network that redefines the task from content recommendation to quantitative risk-return assessment. This architecture combines a relational graph encoder to capture the investment ecosystem's topology, a multi-scale temporal fusion module to handle long-term dependencies and non-stationarity, and a causal decision head that generates risk-adjusted predictions with interpretable causal attributions. A core innovation is the Meta-Causal Adaptation (MCA) strategy, which facilitates robust fine-tuning for new, data-scarce sectors by aligning updates with causally-plausible structures derived from meta-pretraining. Comprehensive experiments on proprietary VC datasets show that FinInvest-GTCN delivers state-of-the-art results, markedly lowering the primary Risk-Adjusted Mean Squared Error (RA-MSE) to 2.51 from a baseline of 3.05 and boosting the cumulative return of a simulated portfolio by 18.7\%. Ablation studies underscore the essential role of each component, while additional analyses confirm the model's stability, interpretability, and enhanced adaptability. This work pioneers a data-driven, explainable framework for investment decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FinInvest-GTCN，一种图-时间-因果网络，用于风险投资决策优化。结合关系图编码器、多尺度时间融合模块和因果决策头，并引入元因果适应（MCA）策略。在专有VC数据集上，将风险调整均方误差（RA-MSE）从3.05降至2.51，模拟投资组合累计回报提升18.7%。
Motivation: 风险投资决策面临多源异构数据、非平稳时间序列和可解释性需求等挑战，现有方法难以处理。
Method: 提出FinInvest-GTCN，包含关系图编码器（捕捉投资生态系统拓扑）、多尺度时间融合模块（处理长期依赖和非平稳性）、因果决策头（生成风险调整预测和可解释因果归因），以及元因果适应策略（通过因果一致结构实现数据稀缺领域的鲁棒微调）。
Result: 在专有VC数据集上，RA-MSE从3.05降至2.51，模拟组合累计回报提升18.7%。消融实验验证各组件重要性，稳定性、可解释性和适应性均得到提升。
Conclusion: 该工作开创了数据驱动的可解释投资决策支持框架。

papers.title: DLR: Zero-Inference-Cost Latent Residuals for Low-Rank Pre-Training
papers.abstract_en: Large language models have driven recent progress in language and multimodal AI, yet pre-training them at scale is prohibitively expensive. Low-rank pre-training, which factorizes each weight matrix into a rank-r product to reduce both parameters and FLOPs, is a promising response but typically lags full-rank training in quality. We propose Duplicated Latent Residual (DLR), a training-only, parameter-free, foldable plug-in for low-rank pre-training. DLR augments the standard low-rank output Bz with a fixed structured residual alpha/sqrt(K) * Expand_K(z) that replicates each latent coordinate K = ceil(d_out/r) times across the output. With alpha fixed, DLR adds zero learnable parameters per layer; after training, it is absorbed into the up-projection in closed form, B* = B + alpha/sqrt(K) R^T, so deployment parameter count, FLOPs and memory match the underlying low-rank backbone exactly. Across LLaMA models from 60M to 7B parameters, DLR strengthens low-rank pre-training on C4 validation perplexity in most settings, with the clearest gains at 130M and above; folded checkpoints transfer cleanly to supervised fine-tuning on standard benchmarks.
papers.comment: Includes appendix, 6 figures and 11 tables. Code available at https://github.com/nanguoyu/DLR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低秩预训练质量落后于全秩训练的问题，提出 Duplicated Latent Residual (DLR)，一种零推理成本的训练时插件。DLR 在低秩输出上添加固定结构残差，训练后可闭式吸收，不增加部署参数、FLOPs 和内存。在 60M 到 7B 参数的 LLaMA 模型上，DLR 在多数设置下降低了 C4 验证困惑度，尤其在大规模模型上增益明显。
Motivation: 低秩预训练虽然减少了参数和计算量，但质量通常不如全秩训练，需要一种不增加推理成本的方法来弥补性能差距。
Method: 提出 DLR，在低秩输出 Bz 上添加固定结构残差 alpha/sqrt(K) * Expand_K(z)，训练后通过闭式 B* = B + alpha/sqrt(K) R^T 吸收到上投影中，不增加可学习参数或推理开销。
Result: 在 LLaMA 模型（60M 至 7B 参数）上，DLR 在多数设置下降低了 C4 验证困惑度，尤其在 130M 及以上参数规模提升明显；折叠后的检查点可干净地转移到标准监督微调基准。
Conclusion: DLR 是一种有效且零推理成本的低秩预训练增强插件，可即插即用。

papers.title: Cybersecurity is the True Frontier for Generative AI Success or Failure
papers.abstract_en: Cybersecurity is a real-life test-bed for many machine learning problems at once, especially when considering modern strides in using Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate processes as ``agents.'' Cybersecurity workflows require orchestrating hundreds of standard and bespoke tools through various formats. The scale of cybersecurity data is enormous; for example, a single malware sample can be viewed as a sequence of billions of tokens. The cost of labeling any file by experts is enormous and labor-intensive, in part because an adversary (possibly a well-funded nation state actor) is attempting to subvert your detection methods. Even skilled experts may disagree on the correct label, creating ambiguity in what constitutes ground truth. When deployed, models must run quickly on billions of items a day, where low-latency is critical for operational success, in a continuously changing environment. In addition, explainability is not optional: analysts demand clear reasoning for model decisions to cope with the large number of false-positive alerts they face daily, and to quickly develop remediation and understand how something went wrong. In short, the amount of complexity cybersecurity is greater than that of natural language and computer vision, and thus we posit that cybersecurity is the better test-case for general AI progress than other, well-studied fields.
papers.comment: to appear in the 5'th Workshop on Rethinking Malware Analysis (WoRMA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证网络安全环境比自然语言处理或计算机视觉更能全面测试通用人工智能的进步，尤其在LLM作为智能体（agent）的应用中。作者指出网络安全工作流规模庞大、标注成本高昂、环境动态变化，且对可解释性有硬性要求，因此是评估生成式AI成败更合适的试验场。
Motivation: 当前AI进步主要基于NLP和CV领域的基准测试，但网络安全中存在的多工具编排、海量数据（如单样本数十亿令牌）、专家标注歧义、实时低延迟需求及强制可解释性等复杂挑战更接近真实AI能力的极限，因此需要将网络安全作为衡量生成式AI成败的关键领域。
Method: 通过分析网络安全场景的七项关键特征（多工具集成、数据规模、标注成本、对抗性、实时性、动态环境、可解释性），并与NLP/CV对比，提出网络安全是更好的通用AI测试平台。
Result: 指出单一恶意软件样本可视为数十亿令牌序列，每日需处理数十亿项、低延迟运行，且分析师需要清晰推理来解释模型决策，这些挑战的复杂度超过自然语言和计算机视觉。
Conclusion: 作者主张网络安全应成为生成式AI进展的首要测试领域，其固有复杂性更能暴露模型的真实能力与局限。

papers.title: A Theoretical Interpretation of In-Context Learning via Probabilistic Modeling
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) is an emerging paradigm that employs the semantic information inherent in large language models (LLMs) for generating answers to user queries. While the remarkable performance of ICL has been widely known, a general modeling and a rigorous theoretical analysis of this paradigm are still lacking. This work presents a probabilistic model for ICL and derives the performance of ICL for both general parametric distributions and exponential families. Based on the derived results, the work explains the impact of multiple factors such as the number of demonstrations, the sensitivity of the probabilistic model to the variation of its parameters, as well as the similarity between the demonstrations and the query on the performance of ICL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种上下文学习（ICL）的概率模型，并推导了该模型在一般参数分布和指数族下的理论性能。基于推导结果，解释了示范数量、模型参数敏感性以及示范与查询相似性等因素对ICL性能的影响。
Motivation: 尽管ICL在大型语言模型中表现优异，但缺乏通用的数学模型和严格的理论分析，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 构建了一个概率模型来形式化ICL过程，并针对一般参数分布和指数族推导了理论性能表达式。
Result: 理论结果揭示了示范数量、模型参数敏感性以及示范与查询相似性对ICL性能的影响机制。
Conclusion: 该理论框架为理解ICL的工作机理提供了数学基础，但未涉及实际数据集或实验验证。

papers.title: Multi-Agent Routing as Set-Valued Prediction: A WildChat Benchmark and Cost-Aware Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Tool and agent routing from natural-language prompts is naturally a set-valued prediction problem: a single query may require multiple agents, while over-selection increases execution cost. The benchmark introduced here is derived from WildChat and contains 3,000 prompts over a fixed 12-agent catalog, with AI-assisted heuristic labels under a fixed schema and controlled rebalancing for multi-label evaluation. The evaluation protocol combines set-level metrics (Precision, Recall, F1, Jaccard, and Exact Match), latency, an execution-oriented capability-coverage simulation, and a constrained weighted-routing setting based on ordinal agent-cost tiers. Compared methods include nearest-neighbor matching, linear multilabel classification, dependency-aware baselines, a fine-tuned encoder, deterministic weighted post-scoring via Weighted Agent Routing (WAR), and a zero-shot LLM baseline. Results show that supervised routers substantially outperform nearest-neighbor and zero-shot LLM routing. The fine-tuned encoder achieves the strongest unconstrained set accuracy, while the linear multilabel model provides the strongest practical baseline. In the constrained setting, the weighted routing layer improves utility when applied on top of strong supervised scorers, with the largest gain observed for Encoder+WAR. Overall, the benchmark and evaluation protocol support reproducible study of accuracy-cost trade-offs in fixed-catalog multi-agent routing.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Under review at ACM RecSys 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将自然语言提示下的工具和智能体路由视为集合值预测问题，并基于WildChat构建了一个包含3000条提示和12个智能体的基准。评估协议结合了集合级指标、延迟、执行导向的覆盖模拟以及基于成本层级的有约束加权路由。实验表明，监督路由方法显著优于最近邻和零样本LLM路由，其中微调编码器在无约束设置下表现最佳，线性多标签模型提供最强实用基线，而有约束设置下加权路由层进一步提升了效用。
Motivation: 现有智能体路由方法通常忽略单个查询可能需要多个智能体的问题，且过度选择会增加执行成本。需要一个标准化的基准和评估协议来研究准确性与成本之间的权衡。
Method: 从WildChat数据集出发，使用AI辅助启发式标签构建多标签数据集；提出集合级指标（精确率、召回率、F1、Jaccard、精确匹配）以及执行导向的覆盖模拟和有约束的加权路由设置；比较的方法包括最近邻、线性多标签分类、依赖感知基线、微调编码器、加权智能体路由（WAR）和零样本LLM基线。
Result: 监督路由方法显著优于最近邻和零样本LLM路由；微调编码器在无约束集合准确率上最强；线性多标签模型提供最强实用基线；在有约束设置下，加权路由层在强监督评分器基础上带来最大增益（编码器+WAR提升最大）。
Conclusion: 该基准和评估协议支持对固定目录多智能体路由中准确率-成本权衡的可复现研究。

papers.title: Towards Improved Anomaly Detection for Cloud Cybersecurity via Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Detecting security threats in an organization's cloud computing environment has become necessary due to the increased reliance on cloud infrastructure. Logging of all cloud computing events enables investigation into any incidents after they are detected. Automated detection of threats using the logs based on heuristics or anomaly detection could result in a high false positive rate due to its relatively static nature. In this article, we present an industrial case study of a self-supervised learning method using graph neural networks applied to AWS CloudTrail logs to surface suspicious events for analyst review. The model produces an anomaly score for each event and dynamically adapts to changes in the organization without requiring periodic retraining. Based on our experiments across five organizations, the proposed model produced substantially fewer alerts than a domain expert rule-based baseline in almost all cases, reducing alert volumes to approximately 1 per hour from thousands generated by traditional methods. We note that this evaluation covers only flagged events, and false negatives cannot be estimated from the current data; findings should therefore be interpreted as a practical deployment study offering insights into real-world constraints rather than a fully validated detection system. We discuss these limitations and the requirements for extending the approach to other cloud environments as future work.
papers.comment: to appear in the 5'th Workshop on Rethinking Malware Analysis (WoRMA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图神经网络的自监督学习方法，用于从 AWS CloudTrail 日志中检测云安全威胁，为每个事件生成异常分数，并动态适应组织变化。实验表明，该方法相比基于专家规则的基线大幅减少告警数量，但无法估计假阴性率，应视为实际部署研究而非完全验证的检测系统。
Motivation: 云基础设施依赖增加导致安全威胁检测需求迫切，而基于启发式或静态规则的方法误报率高，需要更自适应且低误报的检测方法。
Method: 采用自监督学习的图神经网络模型，对 AWS CloudTrail 日志事件计算异常分数，模型无需周期性重训练即可动态适应组织变化。
Result: 在五个组织的实验中，模型将告警量从传统方法每小时数千条降至约1条，大幅优于领域专家规则基线，但当前数据无法估计假阴性率。
Conclusion: 该研究作为实际部署案例展示了图神经网络在云日志异常检测中的潜力，但存在无法评估假阴性的局限性，未来需扩展至其他云环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ExACT: Exemplar-Driven Calibrated Refinement for Training-Free Visual Grounding in Remote Sensing Images
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing visual grounding (RSVG) aims to locate specific objects in high-resolution RS imagery using free-form natural language descriptions. While recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show great potential for such open-vocabulary RSVG, their training-free adaptation is hindered by the modality gap between abstract linguistic semantics and fine-grained visual cues. In cluttered RS scenes, this gap inevitably causes severe localization drift. To bridge this gap, we propose Exemplar-driven Calibrated Refinement (ExACT), a novel training-free framework driven by a one-shot visual prompting mechanism to explicitly provide discriminative structural guidance for precise pixel-level localization. Specifically, we propose a Vision Exemplar-based Calibrator (VEC) that extracts fine-grained visual correspondences from the given exemplar to rectify the rough cross-modal priors from frozen MLLMs, effectively suppressing background artifacts and accurately outlining target boundaries. Subsequently, a Structure-Aware Refiner (SAR) employs an iterative merge-and-select clustering strategy to consolidate the calibrated priors into high-quality positive and negative geometric prompts. These prompts then guide the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to achieve precise pixel-level predictions. Extensive experiments confirm the superiority of ExACT over existing training-free and weakly-supervised methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出ExACT框架，用于遥感图像中无需训练的视觉定位（RSVG）。通过单样本视觉提示机制，利用视觉示例校准器（VEC）从示例中提取细粒度视觉对应关系，修正冻结多模态大语言模型的粗糙跨模态先验，再通过结构感知精炼器（SAR）生成高质量正负几何提示，引导SAM实现精确像素级预测。实验表明优于现有无需训练和弱监督方法。
Motivation: 现有无需训练的多模态大语言模型在遥感视觉定位中因抽象语言语义与细粒度视觉线索之间的模态差距，导致定位漂移严重。
Method: 提出ExACT框架，包含两个模块：视觉示例校准器（VEC）提取细粒度视觉对应修正粗糙跨模态先验；结构感知精炼器（SAR）通过迭代合并-选择聚类策略生成高质量正负几何提示，引导SAM进行像素级分割。
Result: 实验证明ExACT在遥感视觉定位任务上优于现有无需训练和弱监督方法，具体量化结果见论文。
Conclusion: ExACT通过示例驱动校准精炼有效弥合模态差距，实现无需训练的高精度遥感视觉定位。

papers.title: ML-Powered LDAP Reconnaissance Detection using Weak Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) is a protocol that allows users to query and modify Active Directory (AD) data. By default, all users have read access to all AD data through LDAP, making it a common initial tool for reconnaissance when a threat actor first compromises an identity. To capture threat actors early in the reconnaissance phase, we developed two machine learning frameworks to detect LDAP reconnaissance: an ML classifier to predict malicious LDAP queries and an ML-based data-mining method to extract malicious query signatures. By correlating LDAP queries with endpoint detections, the first framework uses weak supervision to label a massive dataset and classify LDAP queries as malicious or benign. For immediate deployment, a second technique was developed on top of this approach to employ a rigorous statistical hypothesis-testing framework for mining novel, malicious LDAP signatures. While this weakly supervised approach is limited compared with manual human labeling, it is more practical for this use case because it leverages large-scale automated corpus construction, reducing costs and time. Ultimately, both the LDAP classifier and the ML-based LDAP signature mining method achieved performance benchmarks, with the classifier achieving up to a 65\% True Positive Rate (TPR) on the holdout set while limiting false positives, and mined signatures demonstrating 81.48\% field precision with CrowdStrike's Managed Detection and Response team.
papers.comment: to appear in Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LDAP协议被攻击者用于侦察的问题，提出两个基于机器学习的检测框架：一个使用弱监督学习（weak supervision）的LDAP查询分类器，以及一个基于统计假设检验的恶意查询签名挖掘方法。通过将LDAP查询与端点检测事件关联自动生成训练标签，分类器在保留集上达到65%的真阳性率（TPR），挖掘的签名在与CrowdStrike MDR团队的评估中达到81.48%的字段精度。
Motivation: LDAP协议默认允许所有用户读取Active Directory数据，攻击者入侵后常利用它进行侦察，而现有检测方法依赖手工规则或人工标注，成本高且难以覆盖新攻击模式。
Method: 开发了两个框架：1）ML分类器，通过弱监督（将LDAP查询与端点检测事件关联）自动生成大规模标签，训练模型区分恶意与良性查询；2）ML驱动的签名挖掘方法，在分类器基础上采用统计假设检验框架挖掘新的恶意查询签名。
Result: LDAP分类器在保留集上达到65%真阳性率（TPR）并控制了假阳性；签名挖掘方法挖掘的签名经CrowdStrike MDR团队验证，字段精度达81.48%。
Conclusion: 弱监督方法虽然精度不如人工标注，但能利用大规模自动语料构建，降低成本和耗时，在LDAP侦察检测场景中更实用，且两个框架均实现了性能基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Latent Bridges for Multi-Table Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: We introduce GRAB, a constructor-encoder-bridge pipeline for table question answering. Our method lifts relational data into an heterogeneous graph, encodes it via message passing, and transfers the signals to an LLM through a small set of query-conditioned latent tokens. This provides the LLM with a compact, task-relevant structural representation together with the flattened text. Crucially, the LLM remains strictly frozen to preserve its general reasoning capabilities; we train only the lightweight graph encoder and latent bridge (91M parameters), allowing the entire pipeline to be trained efficiently. Our pipeline significantly improves performance on relational Question Answering, with the largest gains in demanding multi-table settings, offering an efficient, principled way to connect relational deep learning with LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRAB流水线，用于多表问答。它先将关系数据转化为异构图，通过消息传递编码，再通过少量查询条件化的潜在令牌（latent tokens）将信号传递给冻结的LLM。仅训练轻量级图编码器和潜在桥（91M参数），LLM保持冻结。摘要表明该方法在多表问答任务上显著提升性能，提供了一种高效连接关系深度学习与LLM的方式。
Motivation: 现有方法在处理多表问答时，要么将整个表格展平为文本导致LLM输入过长且丢失结构信息，要么需要微调LLM影响其泛化能力。需要一个既能保持LLM冻结又能有效利用关系结构的方法。
Method: GRAB由构造器（constructor）、编码器（encoder）和桥（bridge）组成：构造器将关系数据构建为异构图；编码器通过消息传递（message passing）对图进行编码；桥则通过一组查询条件化的潜在令牌将图编码信号传递给冻结的LLM。
Result: 摘要报告在多表问答任务上取得显著性能提升，尤其在复杂的多表设置中增益最大。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种高效且原则性的方式将关系深度学习与LLM连接，在不牺牲LLM通用推理能力的前提下提升多表问答性能。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出GRAB流水线，用于多表问答。它先将关系数据转化为异构图，通过消息传递编码，再通过少量查询条件化的潜在令牌（latent tokens）将信号传递给冻结的LLM。仅训练轻量级图编码器和潜在桥（91M参数），LLM保持冻结。摘要表明该方法在多表问答任务上显著提升性能，提供了一种高效连接关系深度学习与LLM的方式。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有方法在处理多表问答时，要么将整个表格展平为文本导致LLM输入过长且丢失结构信息，要么需要微调LLM影响其泛化能力。需要一个既能保持LLM冻结又能有效利用关系结构的方法。
summary_sections.method: GRAB由构造器（constructor）、编码器（encoder）和桥（bridge）组成：构造器将关系数据构建为异构图；编码器通过消息传递（message passing）对图进行编码；桥则通过一组查询条件化的潜在令牌将图编码信号传递给冻结的LLM。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在多表问答任务上取得显著性能提升，尤其在复杂的多表设置中增益最大。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种高效且原则性的方式将关系深度学习与LLM连接，在不牺牲LLM通用推理能力的前提下提升多表问答性能。

papers.title: What Color is the Sky (for a non-human) ?
papers.abstract_en: The light of the daytime sky contains a mixture of many colors yet is perceived as blue by human observers. This is largely due to the particular response functions of the human cones. Under these response functions skylight and blue light are metamers: they yield the exact same excitation of the cones. In this paper we ask: is it possible to define the ``color'' of the sky for other visual systems? We present a simple computational method to determine monochromatic metamers to a given input light for arbitrary visual systems. Using published values on spectral sensitivity functions of various species, we use our method to determine the dominant wavelength of monochromatic metamers to skylight. For a wide range of species (bichromats, trichromats and tetrachormats) we find monochromatic metamers to skylight but the dominant wavelength of the metamer can vary drastically between species and be very different from the color perceived by humans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨非人类视觉系统下天空颜色的定义，提出一种计算任意视觉系统对输入光的单色同色异谱（metamer）的方法。利用已发表的多种物种光谱敏感函数，发现许多物种（双色、三色、四色视觉）都存在与天光对应的单色同色异谱，但其主导波长差异巨大，与人类感知的蓝色截然不同。
Motivation: 人类对天空颜色的感知取决于视锥细胞响应函数，而其他物种的视觉系统不同。目前缺乏通用方法确定非人类视觉系统下天空的“颜色”。
Method: 提出一种简单计算方法，针对任意视觉系统，寻找与给定输入光（如天光）产生相同锥体响应的单色光（即单色同色异谱）。利用已发表的多种物种光谱敏感函数，计算天光的单色同色异谱的主导波长。
Result: 对于双色、三色和四色视觉的多种物种，均找到天光的单色同色异谱，但主导波长在不同物种间差异极大，与人类感知的蓝色（约480nm）可有显著不同。
Conclusion: 非人类视觉系统下天空的颜色并非唯一，而是依赖于具体物种的光谱敏感函数。该方法可推广至任意光源和视觉系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MALOQ: Massively Accelerated Learning of Operators for Quantum Transport
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learned (ML) operator models can be trained to predict density functional theory (DFT) Hamiltonian/density matrices at significantly reduced computational cost, thus extending electronic-structure calculations to previously unfeasible scales. Here, we introduce MALOQ (Massively Accelerated Learning of Operators for Quantum Transport), an application built to train on and predict electronic-structure matrices for systems made of few to 100k atoms, described by large basis sets, and covering a wide range of atomic elements. Based on a state-of-the-art, SO(2)-equivariant backbone architecture, MALOQ provides (i) custom data-processing kernels to handle high-rank Hamiltonian matrix data and (ii) a scalable edge-wise distribution of atomic graph(s). Trained on the largest molecular Hamiltonian datasets available today, it reduces time-per-epoch by over 30% compared to a molecule-wise-distributed framework, and enables inference on material graphs of arbitrary size. We demonstrate scalable training and inference for 3,000-12,000 atoms on the Alps supercomputer, up to 192 GPUs and 256 GPUs, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出MALOQ应用，基于SO(2)-等变神经网络预测DFT哈密顿量/密度矩阵，支持从几个到10万原子的大规模系统。通过自定义数据处理核和边分布策略，在Alps超算上实现192 GPU训练和256 GPU推理，每epoch时间比分子分布式框架降低30%以上。
Motivation: 传统DFT计算成本高，难以扩展到大规模系统；机器学习操作符模型可大幅加速电子结构计算，但现有框架在处理高秩矩阵和原子图分布方面存在瓶颈。
Method: 采用SO(2)-等变骨干架构，设计自定义数据处理核处理高阶哈密顿矩阵，并实现可扩展的边分布原子图策略以支持大规模并行。
Result: 在Alps超算上展示3000-12000原子系统的可扩展训练和推理，每epoch时间降低30%以上，支持任意大小材料图的推理。
Conclusion: MALOQ有效加速了量子输运中操作符的学习，为大规模电子结构计算提供了高效解决方案。

papers.title: Projection-based coupling of infrared thermography and stereocorrelation-based digital image correlation
papers.abstract_en: Full-field measurement techniques such as digital image correlation and infrared thermography are prevalent in experimental solid mechanics. Digital image correlation is used to analyze surface deformation, while infrared thermography quantifies surface temperature fields. However, sophisticated procedures are necessary to express both datasets in the same Lagrangian frame, especially when analyzing non-flat surfaces. In this study, we propose an external projection-based coupling that uses the pinhole camera model to relate two-dimensional temperature data measured by infrared thermography to three-dimensional point coordinates from stereocorrelation-based digital image correlation. Unlike existing multiview approaches, we utilize two independently calibrated industrial-grade systems and augment the experimental evaluation with the pinhole camera model. The projection matrix of the camera model is calibrated using a single image of a reference object. Through this projection, temperature fields are accurately represented at material points. Our method is particularly suited for, but not restricted to, curved surfaces and straightforward to embed in existing experimental protocols, as the image registration is kept as is. Additionally, we propose using radial basis functions as a global interpolation ansatz in both space and time to compute in-plane temperature gradients and even temperature rates on curved surfaces, thereby providing an extensive and information-rich full-field dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于投影的耦合方法，将红外热成像测量的二维温度数据与立体相关数字图像相关的三维点坐标关联起来，采用针孔相机模型进行投影校准，适用于曲面温度场的精确表征，并利用径向基函数进行时空全局插值以计算温度梯度和速率。
Motivation: 现有方法在非平面表面上难以将温度场与变形场统一到同一拉格朗日坐标系中，需要复杂的处理流程。
Method: 利用两个独立校准的工业系统，通过单张参考图像校准针孔相机模型的投影矩阵，将红外热成像的二维温度数据投影到立体数字图像相关的三维点上，并采用径向基函数进行时空全局插值。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称该方法能准确在材料点上表征温度场，并可用于曲面上的温度梯度与温度速率计算。
Conclusion: 该方法特别适用于曲面，且易于嵌入现有实验协议，无需改变图像配准流程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MedEvoEval: Evaluating Continual Evolution of Doctor Agents through Simulated Clinical Episodes
papers.abstract_en: Doctor agents are moving beyond single-turn answer generation toward evolving clinical decision systems. Within an outpatient episode, they acquire evidence, use examination and consultation resources, and decide when to finalize a diagnosis and management plan. Across episodes, their behavior may change through memory, retrieval, reflection, or other update mechanisms. Current evaluations only partially cover this setting. Fixed-input medical QA benchmarks score final answers from complete inputs, whereas many interactive benchmarks still focus on individual encounters or fixed runs, providing limited support for evaluating how episode-level decisions interact with cross-episode experience. We introduce MedEvoEval, an executable longitudinal evaluation framework based on action-gated simulated outpatient episodes. Each source case is converted into role-specific patient, examination, and manager views; evidence is revealed only through valid actions; and each episode records a structured trace that links observations, actions, final outputs, manager scores, and optional experience write-back. We release a runnable E&D artifact with 700 processed episodes, provenance notes, schemas, an episode runner, scoring scripts, configurations, example logs, analysis code, and trajectory- and step-level derivatives. Experiments show that episode traces expose process costs hidden by final-answer scoring, show how MDT-style consultation reallocates resources, and support longitudinal analyses of memory maturation, held-out transfer, update-stage response, and backward retention. Together, these results show that MedEvoEval provides a concrete basis for evaluating whether doctor agents improve through experience, transfer useful behavior, and retain earlier capabilities over time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MedEvoEval，一个基于动作门控模拟门诊 episodes 的纵向评估框架，用于评估医生智能体在多轮诊疗中的持续进化能力。框架将每个病例转换为患者、检查和管理员视图，仅通过有效动作揭示证据，并记录结构化轨迹以链接观察、动作、最终输出和管理员评分。实验表明，该框架能暴露终端答案评分隐藏的过程成本，支持记忆成熟、跨集转移等纵向分析。
Motivation: 当前评估仅部分覆盖医生智能体的持续进化：固定输入QA基准仅评分完整输入的最终答案，交互基准多关注单次交互或固定回合，难以评估episode级决策与跨集经验的交互。
Method: 提出MedEvoEval框架：将每个源病例转换为角色特定的患者、检查和管理员视图；通过动作门控逐步揭示证据；每个episode记录结构化轨迹，链接观察、动作、最终输出、管理员评分和可选的经验写回。发布含700个处理episodes的可运行E&D工件。
Result: 实验表明，episode轨迹暴露了最终答案评分隐藏的过程成本，展示了MDT式会诊如何重新分配资源，并支持记忆成熟、保留转移、更新阶段响应和向后保持的纵向分析。
Conclusion: MedEvoEval为评估医生智能体是否通过经验改进、转移有用行为以及随时间保留早期能力提供了具体基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Task-Driven and Quality-Assured Agent Framework for SAR Data Generation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data augmentation is important for improving the generalization of data-driven SAR interpretation models, yet practical augmentation workflows are often hindered by heterogeneous dataset formats, task-dependent metadata requirements, diverse generation methods, and weak validation of generated samples. This paper presents the \textbf{S}AR \textbf{A}ugmentation and \textbf{G}eneration \textbf{A}gent (SAGA), a schema-grounded and benefit-aware agent framework for task-oriented SAR data generation and augmentation. Given a natural-language request and heterogeneous SAR inputs, SAGA extracts observable dataset facts, validates executable dataset schemas, selects feasible augmentation strategies through validator-constrained planning, and compiles the selected strategy into an auditable augmentation workflow. Generated data are further assessed by quality, distribution, SAR-artifact, duplicate, leakage, and optional downstream-task evaluators to support evidence-qualified augmentation claims. By separating semantic proposal from deterministic validation and execution, SAGA improves the reliability and reproducibility of SAR augmentation decisions. Experiments on controlled agentic benchmarks and downstream SAR interpretation tasks show that SAGA improves schema grounding, skill planning, invalid-sample rejection, and downstream augmentation utility compared with rule-based, LLM-only, ReAct-style, and fixed-augmentation baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAGA框架，一种基于模式（schema）和收益感知的智能体框架，用于面向任务的SAR数据增强和生成。该框架通过自然语言请求和异构SAR输入，提取数据集事实、验证可执行模式、规划增强策略，并编译为可审计的工作流，同时通过质量、分布、伪影、重复、泄露和下游任务评估器对生成数据进行评估。在受控基准和下游SAR任务上，SAGA在模式基础、技能规划、无效样本拒绝和下游增强效用方面优于基于规则、纯LLM、ReAct风格和固定增强的基线。
Motivation: SAR数据增强对提高SAR解译模型的泛化能力很重要，但实际增强工作流常受限于异构数据集格式、任务相关的元数据需求、多样的生成方法以及生成样本的弱验证。
Method: 提出SAGA框架，包含四个阶段：从自然语言请求和异构SAR输入中提取可操作的数据集事实；验证可执行数据集模式；通过验证器约束的规划选择可行的增强策略；将选定策略编译为可审计的增强工作流。生成数据进一步由质量、分布、SAR伪影、重复、泄露和可选下游任务评估器评估。
Result: 实验表明，SAGA在受控智能体基准和下游SAR解译任务上，相较于基于规则、纯LLM、ReAct风格和固定增强的基线，在模式基础、技能规划、无效样本拒绝和下游增强效用方面均有提升。
Conclusion: 通过将语义提议与确定性验证和执行分离，SAGA提高了SAR增强决策的可靠性和可重复性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Exploring the Value of Diverse LLM Explanations in Introductory Programming
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown the potential to generate code explanations that surpass those of peers in quality, offering promising opportunities for computer science education. While these explanations may not yet match the depth and clarity of instructor-provided explanations, research in computational creativity highlights that the quantity and diversity of ideas can often outweigh a singular focus on quality. Inspired by this, we explore whether combining multiple diverse explanations, each emphasizing distinct aspects (e.g., function, concept, goal), can enhance students' understanding of programming exercises compared to generic explanations that do not emphasize distinct conceptual aspects. In our study 971 first-year computing students were randomly assigned either diverse or generic LLM-generated explanations for two programming exercises. Students completed multiple-choice and open-ended questions for each exercise, followed by Likert-scale questions and open-ended reflections. Our findings outline patterns in student performance and perceived cognitive load across the two explanation conditions. These findings highlight how variation in explanation emphasis may relate to learner engagement and understanding. Across participants, open-ended response accuracy was consistently about 7.7% higher when students received diverse explanations, with no difference in perceived cognitive load.

papers.title: An Integrated Machine Learning and Hierarchical Variance Decomposition Pipeline for Student Performance Prediction and Metacognitive Calibration on Multi-Signal Telemetry
papers.abstract_en: Predicting student performance and characterizing metacognitive calibration are essential for personalization in intelligent tutoring systems. Prior research treats performance prediction, calibration error calculation, and variance decomposition as separate pipelines, preventing unified interpretation. I propose the Unified Behavioral Prediction and Calibration Analysis Pipeline (UBP-CAP), an integrated framework processing student pre-execution behavioral telemetry through three linked modules: (1) a LightGBM classifier with SHAP for binary correctness prediction, (2) formal calibration metrics (ECE, MCE, and Brier score decomposition) to evaluate metacognitive alignment, and (3) a crossed Generalized Linear Mixed-Effects Model (GLMM) for decomposing calibration deviations. I introduce the Predictive-Explanatory Divergence Index (PEDI), which quantifies structural divergence between predictive and explanatory feature profiles. Evaluated on 1,195 interaction records (27 students, 45 tasks), Logistic Regression achieves AUC-ROC = 0.903, outperforming LightGBM (0.878). Student naive ECE (0.109) significantly exceeds model ECE (0.068), confirming systematic miscalibration. The crossed GLMM yields ICCStudent = 0.123, showing calibration is situational rather than dispositional. PEDIcos = 0.081 (p = 0.327) indicates structural alignment between prediction and explanation on shared behavioral features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出统一行为预测与校准分析管道(UBP-CAP)，整合LightGBM分类器、校准指标(ECE, MCE, Brier分数分解)和交叉广义线性混合效应模型(GLMM)，用于学生表现预测和元认知校准偏差分解。在27名学生1195条交互记录上，逻辑回归AUC-ROC=0.903，学生朴素ECE(0.109)显著高于模型ECE(0.068)，表明系统性校准偏差。
Motivation: 现有研究将学生表现预测、校准误差计算和方差分解作为独立流程，缺乏统一解释框架。
Method: 提出UBP-CAP管道，包含三个模块：LightGBM+SHAP进行二元正确性预测；形式化校准指标评估元认知对齐；交叉GLMM分解校准偏差，并引入预测-解释发散指数(PEDI)。
Result: 逻辑回归AUC-ROC=0.903，优于LightGBM(0.878)；学生朴素ECE=0.109，模型ECE=0.068；交叉GLMM的ICC学生=0.123，表明校准时情境性而非倾向性；PEDI余弦=0.081(p=0.327)表明预测与解释在共享行为特征上结构对齐。
Conclusion: UBP-CAP可实现学生行为预测与元认知校准的统一分析，揭示校准偏差的系统性特征。

papers.title: Analysis of Adam Algorithms for Stochastic Dynamic Systems
papers.abstract_en: The adaptive moment estimation algorithm, known as Adam, is widely used in modern machine learning, owing to its low per-iteration complexity and strong empirical performance. Despite its prevalent use, the theoretical foundation of Adam remains largely unexplored for time-varying and nonstationary systems. In fact, the existing theoretical analyses of Adam-type algorithms are primarily concerned with time-invariant model parameters and explicitly or implicitly rely on independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) data assumptions, under which the learning taskcan be formulated as minimizing a fixed expected objective with a static minimizer. However, such assumptions are often violated in time-varying and nonstationary systems, thereby calling for a theoretical investigation beyond the conventional yet idealized i.i.d. setting. The main objective of this paper is to solve this challenging problem by establishing a general theory of Adam for time-varying and nonstationary stochastic systems. We will introduce some new techniques for analyzing the products of nonstationary and dependent random matrices induced by Adam's coupled first- and second-moment recursions, and will construct a new stochastic Lyapunov function that blends these two moment dynamics. Under a stochastic excitation condition that allows nonstationary and dependent data, we will derive both parameter tracking and output prediction error bounds explicitly, quantifying the effects of stepsize, first- and second-momentum parameters, gradient noise and parameter drift. These bounds not only provide guarantees for Adam performance, but also provide guidelines for hyperparameter selection. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world data validate our theory and design guidelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Adam算法在时变非平稳随机系统中的理论分析不足，提出了一个通用理论框架，通过引入新的随机Lyapunov函数和矩阵乘积分析技术，给出了参数跟踪和输出预测误差的显式界，并提供了超参数选择指导。实验验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 现有Adam算法理论分析主要集中在时不变模型和独立同分布数据假设下，无法适用于时变和非平稳系统，因此需要建立更通用的理论。
Method: 提出了分析耦合一阶和二阶矩递归的非平稳依赖随机矩阵乘积的新技术，构建了融合两种矩动力学的随机Lyapunov函数，在随机激励条件下推导误差界。
Result: 推导了参数跟踪和输出预测误差的显式界，量化了步长、一阶和二阶动量参数、梯度噪声和参数漂移的影响。实验验证了理论。
Conclusion: 这些界不仅保证了Adam在时变非平稳系统中的性能，还为超参数选择提供了指导。
