papers.title: Hierarchical Decision Making with Structured Policies: A Principled Design via Inverse Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical decision-making frameworks are pivotal for addressing complex control tasks, enabling agents to decompose intricate problems into manageable subgoals. Despite their promise, existing hierarchical policies face critical limitations: (i) reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods struggle to guarantee strict constraint satisfaction, and (ii) optimal control (OC)-based approaches often rely on myopic and computationally prohibitive formulations. To reconcile these trade-offs, hierarchical RL-OC architectures have emerged as a promising paradigm. However, the formulation of the lower-level optimization within these frameworks remains underexplored, often relying on heuristic or myopic objectives. In this work, we propose a principled framework that systematically integrates upper-level goal abstraction with structured lower-level decision making. We adopt an inverse optimization approach to inform the structure of the lower-level problem from expert demonstrations, ensuring that the objective of the lower-level policy remains aligned with the overall long-term task goal. To validate the approach, our framework is evaluated on distinct decision making tasks: network-based resource allocation and continuous collision avoidance. Empirical results demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines based on end-to-end RL, learning-augmented optimal control, and existing hierarchical RL approaches in both efficiency and decision quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对层次决策框架中下层优化目标设计缺乏原则性的问题，提出一种基于逆向优化的结构化策略设计方法。该方法从专家演示中学习下层问题的目标函数，使其与上层长期任务目标保持一致。在网络资源分配和连续碰撞避免两个任务上的实验表明，该方法在效率和决策质量上均优于端到端强化学习、学习增强最优控制以及现有层次强化学习方法。
Motivation: 现有层次决策方法存在关键局限：基于强化学习的方法难以保证严格约束满足，最优控制方法常依赖短视且计算昂贵的公式，而层次RL-OC架构中下层优化的目标设计仍多基于启发式或短视目标。
Method: 采用逆向优化方法，从专家演示中推断下层问题的结构，确保下层策略目标与上层长期任务目标对齐，从而系统地整合上层目标抽象与下层结构化决策。
Result: 在网络资源分配和连续碰撞避免两个任务上，该方法在效率和决策质量上一致优于端到端RL、学习增强最优控制以及现有层次RL基线。
Conclusion: 基于逆向优化的结构化层次策略设计是一种有原则的方法，能够有效解决下层目标与上层长期目标的对齐问题，提升复杂控制任务的性能。

papers.title: X-Mind: Efficient Visual Chain-of-Thought via Predictive World Model for End-to-End Driving
papers.abstract_en: Predicting future states is essential for autonomous agents, yet current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models fundamentally lack this capability, relying instead on reactive perception-action mapping. While integrating Predictive World Models (PWMs) addresses this gap, existing approaches either incur prohibitive cascaded latency or act as shallow terminal tasks that fail to deeply embed forward-looking reasoning. To endow VLA models with this reasoning capability, we propose X-Mind. Rather than treating PWMs as an external auxiliary module, this framework internalizes them as the Visual Chain-of-Thought (Visual CoT). By enforcing a world rollout prior to action, the model is constrained to imagine future evolution first, yielding a driving policy that is robustly grounded in environmental dynamics and aware of the future consequences its actions will unfold. The challenge here is efficiency, and we tackle it on two fronts. First, we introduce a compact representation of visual thinking: an abstract sketch that fuses a Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) layout with abstract driving priors (e.g., navigation intents and traffic rules). Rather than rolling out dense future frames, the model reasons over this sketch as a mental canvas; aided by a Deep Compression Autoencoder (DC-AE), a 12-frame future rollout is reduced to merely 96 tokens, alleviating the long-context computational bottleneck. Second, to accelerate generation further, we propose a recurrent block diffusion scheme that unrolls the denoising steps across the layers of the large drive model, folding iterative refinement into the backbone's one forward pass. Trained and validated on large-scale real-world data, X-Mind achieves competitive end-to-end driving performance, which makes it a highly practical, low-latency solution that successfully deploys large-scale cognitive reasoning directly onto resource-constrained vehicle platforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对当前VLA模型缺乏对未来状态预测能力的问题，提出X-Mind框架，将预测世界模型内化为视觉链式思维（Visual CoT），通过紧凑表示（BEV草图+抽象驾驶先验）和循环块扩散方案实现高效推理，在端到端驾驶任务上取得有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 当前VLA模型依赖反应式感知-动作映射，缺乏预测未来状态的能力；现有预测世界模型要么级联延迟高，要么作为浅层终端任务无法深度融合前瞻推理。
Method: 将预测世界模型内化为视觉链式思维，强制模型在行动前先想象未来演变。引入紧凑的视觉思维表示：融合BEV布局与抽象驾驶先验的草图，通过深度压缩自编码器将12帧未来滚动压缩为96个token。提出循环块扩散方案，将去噪步骤展开到驱动模型骨干的一遍前向传播中。
Result: 在大规模真实世界数据上训练和验证，实现了有竞争力的端到端驾驶性能，并有效降低延迟。
Conclusion: 提出了一种高效、低延迟的解决方案，成功将大规模认知推理部署到资源受限的车辆平台上。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 提出了一种高效、低延迟的解决方案，成功将大规模认知推理部署到资源受限的车辆平台上。

papers.title: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Agent Dynamics in World Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative world models hold immense promise as scalable simulators for autonomous systems, particularly for synthesizing rare but safety-critical multi-agent interactions, such as vehicle collisions. However, current evaluation paradigms index heavily on visual fidelity and semantic alignment, leaving a critical blind spot: they cannot reliably quantify whether generated dynamics actually obey the fundamental physical laws required for reliable simulation. Assessing this physical plausibility is inherently difficult due to a lack of physical metrics and the challenge of extracting metric-scale kinematics from uncalibrated video rollouts. To bridge this gap, we introduce CrashTwin, a physics-grounded evaluation framework designed to stress-test the physical trustworthiness of world models. CrashTwin couples a diverse dataset of multi-agent collision scenarios, comprising 25K controllable synthetic and 12K in-the-wild real-world collision sequences with a novel calibration-free reconstruction pipeline, enabling the recovery of 3D physical attributes directly from world model rollouts. We propose a diagnostic suite that systematically evaluates three dimensions: spatio-temporal consistency, momentum and kinetic energy conservation, and world-dynamics integrity. Extensive benchmarking of state-of-the-art models reveals a crucial insight: high perceptual quality frequently masks severe physical violations during complex interactions. By quantitatively exposing these failure modes, CrashTwin provides a vital diagnostic tool for developing physically grounded world models capable of reliable real-world simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CrashTwin，一个基于物理的评估框架，用于检验生成式世界模型在模拟多智能体碰撞场景时的物理可信度。该框架包含合成和真实碰撞数据集，以及无需标定的3D物理属性重建流程，从时空一致性、动量与动能守恒、世界动力学完整性三个维度进行评估。实验发现高感知质量的世界模型在复杂交互中常存在严重的物理违例。
Motivation: 现有世界模型评估主要关注视觉保真度和语义对齐，无法量化生成动力学是否符合物理定律，缺乏评估物理合理性的指标和从未标定视频中提取度量级运动学的方法。
Method: 构建 CrashTwin 框架，包含25K可控合成和12K真实碰撞序列的数据集，以及无需标定的重建管线，可从世界模型 rollout 恢复3D物理属性，并设计诊断套件评估时空一致性、动量动能守恒和世界动力学完整性。
Result: 对当前最先进世界模型的广泛基准测试揭示，高感知质量常掩盖复杂交互中的严重物理违例。
Conclusion: CrashTwin 为开发物理可信的世界模型提供了关键诊断工具，暴露了现有模型在物理可靠性方面的不足。

papers.title: BLUE: A Stale-Pixel Optical-Flow Compositor for Entropy-Efficient Surveillance Video Encoding
papers.abstract_en: Continuous-recording surveillance systems face a storage problem that codec tuning alone cannot fully solve: even at aggressive CRF settings, a static-camera scene spends most of its bits re-encoding a background that has not changed. We present BLUE, a pre-encode compositor that exploits this structure by maintaining a persistent seed frame of the background and substituting background pixels with seed pixels before the encoder runs. The encoder then emits near-free SKIP macroblocks for the frozen background, while live pixels in foreground regions are carried unchanged at full quality. We evaluate BLUE on all 308 annotated short subclips from the VIRAT Ground Surveillance Release 2.0 dataset using a six-point CRF sweep with both x264 and x265. At CRF 28, BLUE reduces file size by a mean of 34.6% (x264) / 39.4% (x265) on 95.8% / 99.4% of clips respectively. Foreground-region PSNR, computed only over VIRAT object-annotation bounding boxes, is preserved or improved on 60.7% of clips (+0.36 dB mean, +5.48 dB maximum). Full-frame perceptual quality (VMAF) drops by a median of 6.75-8.59 points; we quantify and disclose this trade-off explicitly. A lightweight deployment gate measuring the compositor's own VMAF on a 2-second prefix identifies the 40% of clips where even full-frame quality degradation is near-imperceptible (Delta VMAF <= -2.9), enabling a selective-activation strategy that retains both the storage benefit and acceptable perceptual fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BLUE，一种预编码合成器，通过维护背景种子帧并在编码前替换背景像素，使编码器对未变化背景输出几乎免费的 SKIP 宏块。在 VIRAT 监控数据集上，x264/x265 在 CRF 28 时平均减小文件大小 34.6%/39.4%，前景 PSNR 保持或提高，但全帧 VMAF 下降中位数 6.75-8.59 点。
Motivation: 持续记录的监控系统存在存储问题，传统编码器调优无法解决静态场景中大量比特用于重新编码未变化背景的问题。
Method: 提出 BLUE，一种预编码合成器，维护持久背景种子帧，在编码前用种子像素替换背景像素，使编码器输出 SKIP 宏块，前景区域保持全质量。
Result: 在 VIRAT 数据集上，CRF 28 时平均文件大小减小 34.6%（x264）和 39.4%（x265）；前景 PSNR 在 60.7% 片段上保持或改善；全帧 VMAF 中位数下降 6.75-8.59 点。
Conclusion: 论文量化了质量与存储的权衡，并提出了选择性激活策略（基于 2 秒前缀的 VMAF 门控）以在大部分片段上保持可接受感知质量。

papers.title: A Path-Space Formulation of Prediction in World Models: From a Single Action to Prediction, Planning, and Irreversibility
papers.abstract_en: We propose a path-space formulation of prediction in AI world models. Rather than sequences of one-step conditional distributions, we argue that a world model implicitly defines a probability measure over future trajectories. In the local regime where latent dynamics admit an effective Markovian description, this path measure takes the Onsager-Machlup form. Within this framework, prediction (most probable trajectory), planning (constrained optimization), and uncertainty (fluctuations) emerge as operations on a single action functional. We decompose the latent dynamics into reversible and irreversible components and introduce operational measures of entropy production from model rollouts. In controlled small-scale attention-based models, we find that attention asymmetry is acquired during training in proportion to the irreversibility of the data. Symmetrizing the learned attention suppresses entropy production and selectively degrades long-horizon prediction of irreversible dynamics while preserving relaxational prediction. These results suggest that irreversibility may serve as a computational resource for predictive world models. More generally, the fundamental predictive object is a distribution over future paths rather than states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于路径空间的世界模型预测公式，认为世界模型隐式定义了未来轨迹的概率测度，而非单步条件分布序列。在局部马尔可夫近似下，该路径测度具有Onsager-Machlup形式，预测、规划和不确定性均可视为作用泛函上的操作。通过将潜在动力学分解为可逆与不可逆分量，并定义熵产生操作度量，在可控的小规模注意力模型中发现注意力不对称性与数据不可逆性成正比。对称化注意力会抑制熵产生，并选择性地损害长时域不可逆动力学预测，而保留弛豫预测。
Motivation: 现有世界模型通常以序列预测方式建模，但忽略了未来轨迹的整体概率结构，难以处理不可逆性与长期预测。
Method: 提出路径空间公式，将世界模型隐式定义的未来轨迹概率测度赋予Onsager-Machlup形式；分解潜在动力学为可逆和不可逆分量；通过模型 rollout 定义熵产生的操作度量。
Result: 在小规模注意力模型中，注意力不对称性在训练过程中习得且与数据不可逆性成比例；对称化注意力抑制熵产生，并选择性地降低不可逆长时预测质量。
Conclusion: 不可逆性可作为预测世界模型的计算资源；预测的基本对象是未来路径分布而非状态分布。

papers.title: Four Types of LLM Reliance and Their Predictors Among Undergraduate Writers: A Mixed-Methods Study at a Minority-Serving R1 University
papers.abstract_en: Although most undergraduates now use large language models (LLMs), a form of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) for academic writing, no validated method distinguishes the qualitatively different ways students rely on them. Existing instruments assess reliance solely by frequency of use, a measure that, as this study shows, inadvertently rewards dependence on AI rather than recognizing students' own intellectual contribution. Conducted at a public minority-serving university and grounded in the AI Literacy Framework, Expectancy-Value Theory, and Biggs's Presage-Process-Product model, the study drew on 382 undergraduates, 14 interviews, and 396 open-ended survey responses. Four distinct reliance types were identified and confirmed: Strategic (34.3%), Instrumental (30.9%), Dialogic (30.4%), and Dependent (4.5%). Students' value and cost beliefs predicted the intensity of their reliance on LLMs, whereas their AI literacy predicted the type of reliance they adopted, indicating that differentiated support is needed. Notably, Strategic users, those who engaged AI most deliberately, scored lowest on standard outcome measures. This pattern reflects a limitation of current instruments, which index AI's contribution rather than writing quality, thereby penalizing students who show the greatest independent thinking. Analysis also revealed an additional group, roughly 13%, who declined to use AI for ethical rather than practical reasons, and who existing frameworks overlook. These findings carry implications for AI literacy programs, the measurement of student learning outcomes, and equitable AI policy at minority-serving institutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本研究基于AI素养框架、期望-价值理论和Biggs的Presage-Process-Product模型，对一所少数族裔服务型R1大学的382名本科生进行混合方法研究，识别出四种不同类型的LLM依赖：策略型（34.3%）、工具型（30.9%）、对话型（30.4%）和依赖型（4.5%）。研究发现，学生的价值和成本信念预测了LLM依赖的强度，而AI素养预测了依赖的类型。策略型用户（最刻意使用AI）在标准成果测量中得分最低，反映了当前工具的局限性。此外，约13%的学生因伦理而非实用原因拒绝使用AI，现有框架忽视了这一群体。
Motivation: 现有方法仅通过使用频率评估学生对LLM的依赖，这无意中奖励了对AI的依赖而非学生的独立思考。缺乏区分不同依赖类型的方法，导致无法提供差异化支持。
Method: 采用混合方法，对382名本科生进行问卷调查（n=382）、14次访谈和396个开放式回答，基于AI素养框架、期望-价值理论和Biggs的Presage-Process-Product模型进行分析，通过聚类分析识别依赖类型。
Result: 识别出四种依赖类型：策略型（34.3%）、工具型（30.9%）、对话型（30.4%）和依赖型（4.5%）。价值和成本信念预测依赖强度，AI素养预测依赖类型。策略型用户在标准测量中得分最低，另有13%的学生因伦理原因拒绝使用AI。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了LLM依赖的质性差异，强调了AI素养教育、学习成果测量和少数族裔服务型机构平等AI政策的必要性。现有工具倾向于衡量AI贡献而非写作质量，可能惩罚独立思考的学生。

papers.title: Self-Supervised Theorem Discovery in a Formal Axiomatic System
papers.abstract_en: Recent artificial intelligence (AI) systems have shown remarkable progress in mathematical reasoning. Many existing approaches, including large language models (LLMs), draw on human prior knowledge in the form of mathematical text, code, or theorem libraries. Although these approaches are highly effective in practice, it remains an open question whether an agent can autonomously discover useful theorems without such human priors. We study this question in a formal axiomatic system by developing an agent that starts from axioms and inference rules alone and gradually grows a library of useful theorems. Concretely, we propose a self-supervised theorem-discovery algorithm that alternates between proof search and useful-theorem extraction, building a theorem library whose entries are reused as lemmas for subsequent proof search. Experiments show that the agent discovers tens of thousands of theorems and finds proofs for human-written benchmark problems, suggesting that its discoveries include theorems meaningful from a human mathematical perspective. Furthermore, the discovered theorems improve LLM proof performance when provided as prompt lemmas, indicating that they can serve as external knowledge for LLM reasoning. Our results provide evidence that useful theorems can emerge from proof search without relying on human-provided theorem libraries. More broadly, they suggest a path toward self-evolving AI systems for mathematics whose discoveries remain formally verifiable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督定理发现算法，在形式化公理系统中从零开始（仅有公理和推理规则）逐步构建定理库，并通过定理重用辅助后续证明搜索。实验表明该算法可自动发现数万条定理，并为人类编写的基准问题找到证明，且发现的定理作为提示引文能提升大型语言模型的证明性能。
Motivation: 现有数学推理AI系统大多依赖人类先验知识（如数学文本、代码或定理库），但自主发现有用定理而不依赖人类先验的可能性尚未明确。本文研究在形式化公理系统中智能体能否仅从公理出发自主发现有用定理。
Method: 提出自监督定理发现算法，交替进行证明搜索和有用定理提取：先通过证明搜索生成定理，再筛选出可被后续搜索重用为引文的有用定理，逐步构建并扩展定理库。
Result: 实验表明，该算法自动发现数万条定理，并为人类编写的基准问题找到证明；这些定理作为提示引文可提升大型语言模型的证明性能，表明其发现包含符合人类数学视角的有意义定理。
Conclusion: 本文证明有用定理可从证明搜索中涌现，无需依赖人类提供的定理库，为形式化可验证的自我进化数学AI系统提供了可行路径。

papers.title: FreqOrtho-SR: Frequency-Guided Orthogonal Expert Learning for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion prior-based methods have shown impressive results in real-world image super-resolution (ISR), yet two key challenges persist: balancing pixel-level fidelity with semantic quality, and adapting to diverse degradations. Existing dual-branch approaches freeze the pixel module during semantic training, but the semantic branch can still expand capacity within the pixel subspace, precluding genuine perceptual improvement. Moreover, using a single static adapter cannot generalize across heterogeneous real-world corruptions. To address both issues, we propose FreqOrtho-SR, which comprises: $\textbf{Freq}$uency-guided Mixture of LoRA Experts (FreqMoE), it routes inputs to specialized experts via a non-parametric FFT-based degradation-feature extractor that encodes frequency-domain signatures, enabling stable and interpretable specialization across corruption types; and $\textbf{Ortho}$gonal Gradient Projection (OGP), which reframes the dual-objective optimization as a subspace-constrained problem: by extracting the pixel-fidelity subspace via SVD on combined expert weight deltas and projecting semantic gradients onto its null space, OGP guarantees orthogonality between the two objectives, enabling genuinely complementary learning without mutual interference. Experiments show that FreqOrtho-SR achieves competitive overall performance and a strong fidelity-perception trade-off across multiple benchmarks with efficient single-step inference. The source code of our method can be found at $\href{https://github.com/sonhm3029/FreqOrtho-SR}{\texttt{sonhm3029/FreqOrtho-SR}}$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对真实世界图像超分辨率中像素保真与语义质量平衡、以及退化多样性适应两大挑战，本文提出FreqOrtho-SR，包含基于FFT的非参数频率引导专家混合(FreqMoE)和正交梯度投影(OGP)方法，通过子空间约束实现双目标无干扰互补学习。实验表明该方法在多个基准上取得有竞争力的性能与效率。
Motivation: 现有扩散先验方法在真实ISR中面临像素保真与语义质量难以平衡、单一静态适配器无法泛化到多种真实退化的问题。
Method: 提出FreqMoE（利用FFT提取频域特征路由到专用LoRA专家）和OGP（通过SVD提取像素保真子空间并投影语义梯度到零空间，保证双目标正交性）。
Result: 在多个基准上取得有竞争力的综合性能，在保真-感知权衡中表现良好，且只需单步推理。
Conclusion: FreqOrtho-SR通过频率引导专家分配和正交梯度投影，有效解决真实ISR中的双目标冲突与退化泛化问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Agent Safety Is Action Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly act as agents: they call tools, move money, delete records, and send messages on a user's behalf. To keep them safe, practitioners imported the chatbot-era recipe (train the model to refuse unsafe inputs) into the agentic setting, and treat the resulting capability loss as a manageable ``alignment tax.'' We argue this is a \emph{category error}. Refusal is a primitive for \emph{content safety}, where the harm is in the model's output and is therefore a learnable function of it. Agentic harm is different in kind: it lies not in any output but in the relation between the authority an action exercises and the authority the user granted, which is absent from the text the model sees. Importing content-safety methods into this regime does not trade capability for safety; it pays capability and buys negative security. We support this with three lines of evidence spanning the autonomy spectrum: defense-trained models learn surface patterns rather than intent; the same training collapses multi-step agents before any threat appears while leaving them exploitable; and even undefended frontier models exceed granted authority under ordinary use. We conclude that action safety cannot be installed in weights. It must be expressed as \emph{least privilege}, enforced \emph{outside} the model at the action boundary, and evaluated as \emph{action alignment} (a relational, deployment-conditioned property) rather than a refusal score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出将内容安全（content safety）中的拒绝机制直接用于代理（agent）安全是一种范畴错误，因为代理伤害不在输出中，而在行动权限与用户授权的关系中。作者通过三类证据表明防御训练只学到表面模式，且会损害多步代理能力，甚至前沿模型在普通使用中也会超出授权。结论是行动安全不能通过权重训练获得，而应在模型外通过最小权限原则强制执行。
Motivation: 现有方法将聊天时代的拒绝训练直接用于代理安全，这会导致能力损失且无法真正保障安全。
Method: 通过理论论证和三方面实证（防御模型学习表面模式、训练会破坏多步代理、未经防御的模型也超出授权）支持其观点。
Result: 防御训练只学到表面模式而非意图；训练会崩溃多步代理且仍可被利用；未防御的模型在普通使用中也会超出授权。
Conclusion: 行动安全不能通过权重安装，必须以最小权限原则在模型外的行动边界强制执行，并作为行动对齐（关系性的、部署条件依赖的属性）来评估。

papers.title: 5ting at SemEval-2026 Task 8: Strong End-to-End Multi-Turn RAG via LLM-Based Reranking and Faithfulness Control
papers.abstract_en: We introduce 5ting, our system for the SemEval2026 Task 8 (MTRAGEval), which evaluates multi-turn Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Multi turn RAG involves context drift, under specification, and hallucination risk. Our system combines BGE-M3 dense retrieval with FAISS indexing, dual-query merged retrieval, and LLM based reranking, followed by role separated generation constrained to retrieved evidence. The retriever achieved nDCG@5 = 0.4719 in Task A, while the end to end system ranked in Task C with a harmonic score of 0.5597 and RL_F = 0.7692.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了5ting系统，用于SemEval-2026任务8（MTRAGEval），评估多轮检索增强生成（RAG）系统。该系统结合BGE-M3稠密检索、FAISS索引、双查询合并检索和基于LLM的重排序，以及基于检索证据的角色分离生成。检索器在任务A中达到nDCG@5=0.4719，端到端系统在任务C中谐波分数为0.5597，RL_F=0.7692。
Motivation: 多轮RAG面临上下文漂移、描述不足和幻觉风险，需要有效的系统来应对这些挑战。
Method: 采用BGE-M3稠密检索与FAISS索引，使用双查询合并检索和基于LLM的重排序，生成阶段基于检索证据进行角色分离生成。
Result: 检索器在任务A中nDCG@5=0.4719；端到端系统在任务C中谐波分数0.5597，RL_F=0.7692。
Conclusion: 系统在SemEval-2026多轮RAG评估中取得了有竞争力的性能，验证了所提方法的有效性。

papers.title: Agentic Abstention: Do Agents Know When to Stop Instead of Act?
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are expected to act over multiple turns, using search, browsing interfaces, and terminal tools to complete user goals. Yet not every goal is well specified or achievable in the available environment. In such cases, a reliable agent should recognize that further interaction is unlikely to help and abstain from additional tool calls. We define Agentic Abstention, the problem of deciding when an agent should stop acting under uncertainty. Unlike standard LLM abstention, which is usually evaluated as a single-turn answer-or-abstain decision, agentic abstention is a sequential decision problem: an agent can answer, abstain, or gather more information at each turn, and the need to abstain may only become clear after interacting with the environment. We study this problem across web shopping, terminal environments, and question answering, evaluating 13 LLM-as-agent systems and 2 agent scaffolds on more than 28,000 tasks. Our results show that the main challenge is not only whether agents can abstain, but also when they abstain. Some agents never abstain when they should, while others do so only after many unnecessary interactions. This gap is especially large on tasks where the instruction appears feasible until the environment reveals otherwise (e.g., no valid result matches the instruction). We further find that model scale, reasoning, and agent scaffolding affect abstention in different ways, where larger or more capable models sometimes perform worse at timely abstention. Finally, we introduce CONVOLVE, a context engineering method for improving agentic abstention that distills full interaction trajectories into reusable stopping rules. On WebShop, CONVOLVE substantially improves timely abstention without updating model parameters, raising Llama-3.3-70B's timely recall rate from 26.7 to 57.4. Our dataset and code are available at https://lhannnn.github.io/agentic-abstention
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出智能体弃权（Agentic Abstention）问题，即LLM智能体在不确定时是否应停止行动而非继续调用工具。通过在网页购物、终端环境和问答等场景下评估13种LLM智能体和2种智能体框架在超过28000个任务上的表现，发现智能体经常在不该继续时继续行动或在不该停止时过早停止。作者提出一种上下文工程方法CONVOLVE，通过将完整交互轨迹蒸馏为可复用的停止规则来改进智能体弃权，在WebShop上将及时召回率从26.7提升至57.4。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体在多轮交互中常盲目执行操作，即使目标不可达成或环境不匹配。需要定义智能体何时应停止行动以避免无效交互和资源浪费。
Method: 定义了智能体弃权问题作为序列决策问题，评估多种LLM智能体和框架的性能，并提出CONVOLVE方法——一种上下文工程技术，将完整交互轨迹蒸馏为可复用的停止规则，无需更新模型参数。
Result: 在WebShop上，CONVOLVE将Llama-3.3-70B的及时召回率从26.7提升至57.4。实验还显示模型规模、推理能力和智能体框架对弃权时机有复杂影响，更强模型有时在及时弃权上表现更差。
Conclusion: 智能体弃权的主要挑战不仅是能否弃权，更是何时弃权。当前智能体在环境揭示任务不可行后仍进行过多不必要的交互。CONVOLVE通过提取交互轨迹的停止规则可显著改善及时弃权，且无需参数更新。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Full Conformal Prediction under Stochastic Non-Conformity Measure
papers.abstract_en: The theory of full conformal prediction uses deterministic non-conformity measure, but modern usage of full conformal prediction often relies on machine learning training, making stochasticity inevitable. A simple sufficient condition of almost sure permutation invariance of the non-conformity measure can be too restrictive, so many have suggested the relaxation to permutation in distribution as a condition for full conformal prediction validity. We, however, show that this commonly known condition is actually insufficient. We then provide a correct sufficient condition: Conditional Independence & Permutation Invariance in Distribution, which encompasses several stochastic settings that may be used in machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出全共形预测（full conformal prediction）在随机非一致性测度下，常见的“置换在分布上（permutation in distribution）”条件不足以保证有效性，并提出正确的充分条件：条件独立性与置换不变性在分布上（Conditional Independence & Permutation Invariance in Distribution），该条件涵盖机器学习中若干随机设置。
Motivation: 现代全共形预测常依赖机器学习训练，导致非一致性测度具有随机性，但现有理论仅处理确定性测度；常见的置换在分布上条件被广泛认为足够，本文发现其实际上不充分。
Method: 通过反例证明置换在分布上条件不充分，并提出新的充分条件——“条件独立性与置换不变性在分布上”，并给出理论证明。
Result: 本文为理论性工作，未报告实验数据或定量结果。
Conclusion: 论文强调，要使随机非一致性测度下的全共形预测有效，需要满足条件独立性与置换不变性在分布上，而非仅置换在分布上。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CCRC: A Change-Aware Captioning and Reasoning Chain for Image Change Captioning and Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Understanding and localizing subtle changes between paired images is critical for tasks such as surveillance and image editing. However, traditional Image Change Captioning (ICC) methods lack spatial grounding, limiting their precision. We introduce Image Change Captioning and Segmentation (ICCS), a new multimodal task that jointly requires structured change description and pixel-level localization. To address ICCS, we propose the Change-aware Captioning and Reasoning Chain (CCRC), a dual-chain framework that decouples semantic reasoning from spatial segmentation. The first chain, Chain-of-Change-Captioning (CCC), enhances fine-grained change perception via a visual fusion module based on Multi-Head Change-aware Attention inserted between the visual and language components of a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM). CCC also determines whether a change is segmentable. If not, it alone generates the caption. Otherwise, the second chain, Chain-of-Change-Segmenting (CCS), is activated, leveraging spatial priors from CCC and refining masks with a Change-aware Token Refiner for accurate boundary localization. We evaluate CCRC on both synthetic and real-world change detection benchmarks with pixel-level supervision. Experiments show CCRC achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出图像变化描述与分割（ICCS）这一新的多模态任务，要求同时进行结构化变化描述和像素级定位。作者设计了变化感知描述与推理链（CCRC）双链框架，将语义推理与空间分割解耦，通过多头变化感知注意力融合模块增强细粒度变化感知，并利用变化感知令牌精炼器提升边界定位精度。在合成和真实变化检测基准上，CCRC取得了最先进性能。
Motivation: 传统图像变化描述（ICC）方法缺乏空间定位能力，限制了其精度，无法满足需要像素级变化定位的应用需求。
Method: 提出CCRC双链框架：第一链（CCC）通过多头变化感知注意力融合模块增强变化感知，并判断变化是否可分割；若不可分割，仅由CCC生成描述；若可分割，则激活第二链（CCS），利用CCC的空间先验和变化感知令牌精炼器生成精确掩码。
Result: 在合成和真实变化检测基准上，CCRC达到了最先进的性能，实验包括像素级监督的设置。
Conclusion: 本文通过将变化描述与分割联合建模，并采用解耦的推理链，显著提升了变化定位和描述的准确性。

papers.title: ComMem: Complementary Memory Systems for Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Test-time adaptation (TTA) of vision-language models (VLMs) is essential for their robust deployment in dynamic, real-world environments. However, existing TTA methods often adapt locally without accumulating knowledge over time, or operating within a single modality without exploiting VLMs' inherently multi-modal nature. Inspired by the \textbf{Com}plementary \textbf{Mem}ory systems of the biological brain, we propose \textbf{ComMem}, an innovative approach that mimics the distinct but cooperative roles of the hippocampus and neocortex to enable effective TTA for VLMs. ComMem consists of two key components: a fast-adapting detailed memory, akin to the hippocampus, that forms a dynamic visual cache from high-confidence test samples; and a slow-integrating abstract memory, akin to the neocortex, that continually refines global textual prototypes. For each test instance, ComMem jointly optimizes both memory systems to ensure cross-modal consistency. Extensive experiments on 15 benchmark datasets show that ComMem significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods under both natural distribution shifts and cross-dataset generalization, offering a promising direction for enhancing VLMs' practical adaptability.
papers.comment: A brain-inspired complementary memory framework leveraging fast visual caching and slow textual refinement for VLM test-time adaptation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 受生物大脑互补记忆系统的启发，本文提出ComMem，一种用于视觉语言模型（VLM）测试时适应（TTA）的新方法。ComMem包含两个组件：类似海马体的快速适应详细记忆（动态视觉缓存）和类似新皮层的慢速整合抽象记忆（全局文本原型），通过联合优化实现跨模态一致性。在15个基准数据集上的实验表明，ComMem在自然分布偏移和跨数据集泛化中均显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有VLM的测试时适应方法通常仅在局部适应而不积累长期知识，或仅在单模态内操作，未能充分利用VLM的多模态特性，限制了其在动态环境中的鲁棒性。
Method: ComMem模仿生物大脑中海马体和新皮层的互补记忆系统：快速适应记忆从高置信度测试样本构建动态视觉缓存，慢速整合记忆持续细化全局文本原型，并通过联合优化两个记忆系统来保证每个测试实例的跨模态一致性。
Result: 在15个基准数据集上，ComMem在自然分布偏移和跨数据集泛化任务中均显著优于当前最优方法，验证了其有效提升VLM实际适应性的能力。
Conclusion: 提出的互补记忆框架为增强VLM在动态环境中的测试时适应能力提供了有前景的方向，但摘要未明确指出局限性。

papers.title: TrajRS: Towards Certified Robustness in Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: The robustness of trajectory prediction models is crucial for developing safe autonomous driving systems. Adversarial attacks on trajectory prediction can significantly impair the accuracy of predicted trajectories, leading to hazardous driving behaviors. While heuristic defense strategies have been implemented to enhance the robustness of trajectory prediction models, these measures often fail against more sophisticated, targeted adversarial attacks. Hence, there is a pressing need to establish verifiable safety assurances for trajectory prediction models. In this paper, we extend the traditional Randomized Smoothing framework to "TrajRS", which provides a certified robust radius for smoothed trajectory predictors. We clarify and expand the formal definitions of robustness in trajectory prediction and tailor the practical TrajRS scheme specifically to "robustness for the optimal prediction" and "robustness for all possible predictions". An extensive set of experiments demonstrates that TrajRS effectively achieves robustness certification for all smoothed pedestrian trajectory predictors in this work.
papers.comment: Accepted by 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对行人轨迹预测模型的鲁棒性问题，将随机平滑框架扩展为TrajRS，为平滑后的轨迹预测器提供认证鲁棒半径。摘要明确了鲁棒性的形式化定义，并针对“最优预测的鲁棒性”和“所有可能预测的鲁棒性”设计具体方案。实验表明TrajRS能有效为所有平滑的行人轨迹预测器实现鲁棒性认证。
Motivation: 现有启发式防御策略无法应对复杂定向攻击，迫切需要为轨迹预测模型建立可验证的安全保证。
Method: 扩展随机平滑框架，提出TrajRS，定义并形式化轨迹预测的鲁棒性，针对两种鲁棒性概念设计具体方案。
Result: 实验表明TrajRS能有效为所有平滑的行人轨迹预测器提供鲁棒性认证。
Conclusion: TrajRS为行人轨迹预测提供了可认证的鲁棒性保证。

papers.title: SEATauBench: Adapting Tool-Agent-User Evaluation Into Low-Resource Southeast Asian Languages
papers.abstract_en: While AI development and evaluation for Southeast Asia (SEA) has grown rapidly, agent capabilities in regional languages are still poorly understood despite its importance to sovereign AI. To fill this gap, we introduce SEATauBench, the first agent-focused evaluation framework for SEA sovereign AI. SeaTau adapts TauBench to five languages -- Mandarin, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, and Filipino -- and evaluates agents across progressively localized settings that vary the language of user-agent interaction, tool specifications, and task domains. Across three recent models, we find that English agent capabilities transfer reasonably well when only the conversation language changes, but quality and robustness degrade sharply as more task contexts are localized, with the largest losses in full domain adaptation. We also the limits of English-only agent assessment for measuring agent capabilities in SEA languages. More broadly, SeaTau provides a diagnostic benchmark and reusable adaptation pipeline for building reliable multilingual agents for linguistically diverse regions. Data and code can be accessed at github.com/SEACrowd/SEATauBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 SEATauBench，首个面向东南亚（SEA）语言的智能体评估框架，将 TauBench 适配至中文、越南语、泰语、印尼语和菲律宾语五种语言，并在逐步本地化的设置中评估智能体性能。研究发现仅改变对话语言时英文智能体能力迁移较好，但随着任务上下文进一步本地化，质量和鲁棒性显著下降，揭示了英文评估在 SEA 语言中的局限性。
Motivation: 尽管东南亚 AI 评估发展迅速，但智能体在该区域语言中的能力仍未被充分理解，这对主权 AI 至关重要。现有评估缺乏针对 SEA 语言的智能体基准。
Method: 基于 TauBench 构建多语言适应管线，将用户-智能体交互语言、工具规范和任务领域逐步本地化，形成不同程度本地化的评估设置，并测试多个近期模型。
Result: 在三种近期模型上，仅改变对话语言时英文能力迁移良好；但完全本地化（包括任务领域）时性能和质量急剧下降，最大损失出现在完整领域适配中。
Conclusion: SEATauBench 提供了诊断性基准和可复用的适应管线，用于构建可靠的多语言智能体，并指出英文评估无法充分衡量 SEA 语言智能体能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: J-LAW: Joint Localization and Actionable World Modeling via Coupled Latent Factor Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Classical SLAM estimates metric poses and a geometric map but produces no actionable predictive model for planning. Action-conditioned world models learn compact latent dynamics for planning but ignore global metric consistency and accumulate drift under open-loop rollout. We argue these are two views of the same estimation problem and propose J-LAW (Joint Localization and Actionable World Modeling) in this letter: a coupled factor graph that jointly optimizes metric object poses, latent world states, and latent landmark embeddings. The bridge is a pose-conditioned latent encoder and a learned pose--latent coupling factor, so that better localization improves the world model and vice versa. We cast observation, action-conditioned prediction, metric odometry, pose--latent coupling, latent loop closure, and latent landmark observation as probabilistic factors in a single MAP objective. Real-data experiments on PushT and WildGS show that coupled graph correction substantially reduces latent prediction RMSE and endpoint drift relative to open-loop rollout, while latent loop closure improves global trajectory consistency. J-LAW yields a map that is simultaneously metric (poses) and actionable (latent landmarks for planning).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 J-LAW，将经典 SLAM 与行动条件世界模型统一到耦合因子图中，同时优化度量物体姿态、潜世界状态和潜地标嵌入。通过姿态条件潜编码器和学习到的姿态-潜耦合因子，实现定位和世界模型的相互提升。在 PushT 和 WildGS 数据集上的实验表明，耦合图修正显著降低了潜变量预测 RMSE 和端点漂移，同时潜闭环提高了全局轨迹一致性。
Motivation: 经典 SLAM 只产生几何地图而不具备用于规划的预测模型；行动条件世界模型学习潜动态但忽略全局度量一致性且存在漂移。本文认为二者是同一估计问题的两种视图。
Method: 提出耦合因子图，联合优化度量物体姿态、潜世界状态和潜地标嵌入。观测、行动条件预测、度量里程计、姿态-潜耦合、潜闭环和潜地标观测被建模为单个 MAP 目标中的概率因子。
Result: 在 PushT 和 WildGS 数据集上，耦合图修正相比开环 rollout 显著降低潜预测 RMSE 和端点漂移，潜闭环改进全局轨迹一致性。
Conclusion: J-LAW 产生同时具有度量（姿态）和可行动（用于规划的潜地标）的地图。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Two Genie Game: Adoption and Welfare in Audit-Grounded AI Governance
papers.abstract_en: We ask under what conditions an agent with a harm-minimizing policy can displace an approval-seeking (RLHF) agent in a competitive market, and when that policy is sufficient to prevent community harm. We use evolutionary game theory (finite-population Moran-Fermi pairwise comparison) to formalize this subject to assumptions of wisher hindsight, peer testimony, a monotone harm ledger, sufficient information density of community feedback, and a finite, depleting resource pool, in a negative-sum environment. We show that adoption is favored when the prior distributions on how readily wishers attune to community sentiment are monotone, exhibit endpoint inversion, and have a centro-symmetric pairing property, and demonstrate this with several long-tailed priors (Hill, Pareto, Lomax, Frechet). Where it is favored, a critical adoption level separates communities that drift back to the approval-seeking agent from those for which the audited agent fixes; above that level fixation is the overwhelmingly likely outcome. We derive when fixation is attainable as a bound on the effective (informational) size N_c of the community, which must be small enough to allow fixation before depletion. We present these as Theorems 5.4 and 5.5; the algebraic and finite-grid backbone is machine-checked in Lean 4, with the barrier-crossing asymptotics retained as explicit hypotheses. We show that a self-audited agent with a community ledger is not, in general, sufficient to prevent community harm. Sufficiency depends both upon the alignment of the agent's audit with community values and the timeframe over which harm is evaluated. Regardless of alignment, once adoption reaches dominance, the state is absorbing. The same policy that reduced harm under alignment becomes a trap, welfare-negative under misalignment and, even under alignment, one that locks in harm deferred past the adoption horizon.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 3 figures. Lean 4 formalization and figure scripts: https://github.com/dlewissandy/two-genie-scripts
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇论文通过进化博弈论模型研究审计型AI代理（基于伤害最小化政策）与RLHF代理（追求用户认可）在竞争市场中的博弈。作者发现，只有当社区有效规模足够小时，审计代理才能被固定；即使固定，也不一定能防止社区伤害，其效果取决于审计与社区价值的对齐以及时间尺度。
Motivation: 现有AI治理中，RLHF代理可能追求用户认可而忽视社区长期伤害，因此需要研究审计型代理能否在市场中胜出并真正减少伤害。
Method: 使用有限种群Moran-Fermi成对比较的进化博弈论形式化，假设了愿望者事后诸葛、同伴证言、单调伤害账簿等条件，并推导了相关定理，部分通过Lean 4机器验证。
Result: 证明审计代理被采纳并固定的条件包括先验分布的单调性、端点反转和中心对称配对性质，以及社区有效规模需小于临界值。同时指出审计代理本身不足以防止社区伤害，其效果依赖于价值对齐和时间评估。
Conclusion: 审计代理一旦达到主导地位，状态是吸收的；在错位时成为福利负面的陷阱，即使对齐也可能锁定延迟的伤害，因此需要谨慎设计治理机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AnTenA: Actionable and Explainable Tensor Analysis System with Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Accurately explaining hidden patterns in multi-aspect data has typically been done by leveraging labels and/or accompanying auxiliary metadata. However, labels and auxiliary data may be inaccurate (e.g. nonstandard, inconsistent), insufficient (e.g. static tabular metadata for time-dependent recordings), or unavailable. % We propose \fullmethod (\method), which leverages the knowledge of large language models (LLMs) to explain the hidden patterns in human narratives. \method uses task-agnostic and task-specific prompts to explain extracted co-clustered latent patterns from tensor decomposition. To evaluate these explanations, we test the LLMs on forward and backward inference tasks. % Our demo system is available at https://github.com/dawonahn/ECML_PKDD_AnTenA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AnTenA 系统，利用大语言模型（LLM）解释张量分解提取的共聚类潜在模式。系统通过任务无关和任务特定提示生成自然语言解释，并在前向和后向推理任务上评估解释质量。该方法不依赖准确的标签或辅助元数据。
Motivation: 现有解释多视角数据隐藏模式的方法通常需要标签或辅助元数据，但这些数据可能不准确、不充分或不可用。
Method: 结合张量分解和 LLM，使用任务无关和任务特定提示解释张量分解得到的共聚类潜在模式。
Result: 通过前向和后向推理任务评估 LLM 生成的解释，验证其有效性。
Conclusion: AnTenA 提供了一种无需标签的可解释性方法，适用于元数据受限的场景。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 结合张量分解和 LLM，使用任务无关和任务特定提示解释张量分解得到的共聚类潜在模式。
summary_sections.result: 通过前向和后向推理任务评估 LLM 生成的解释，验证其有效性。
summary_sections.conclusion: AnTenA 提供了一种无需标签的可解释性方法，适用于元数据受限的场景。

papers.title: BV-Blend: Uncertainty-Weighted Historical Baselines for Stable Critic-Free RL with Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Critic-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), exemplified by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), avoids training a value function (critic) and reduces memory and compute overhead relative to critic-based PPO pipelines for aligning large language models. However, GRPO-style advantage estimation depends on prompt-local (within-prompt-group) reward statistics and can be unstable. In particular, when all rollouts in a prompt group receive identical rewards, the within-group reward variance becomes zero, and group normalization yields zero advantages for that group, impeding learning in cold-start regimes with binary verifiers. We introduce BV-Blend, a critic-free framework that stabilizes advantage estimation by combining prompt-local on-policy statistics with semantic-cluster-conditioned historical moments. BV-Blend maintains EMA-tracked reward moments for each cluster, derives a confidence weight from a standard error of the mean (SEM) proxy, and uses this weight to blend historical and prompt-local baseline and variance statistics into a standardized advantage for PPO-style clipped updates. Experiments on verifiable reasoning benchmarks show that BV-Blend improves training stability and performance, and remains robust in regimes where group-normalized methods may stall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对GRPO等无评论家强化学习方法在奖励相同时梯度消失的问题，提出BV-Blend框架，通过结合语义聚类的历史统计量来稳定优势估计。在可验证推理基准上，BV-Blend提升了训练稳定性和性能。
Motivation: GRPO风格的强化学习方法当同一提示组内所有输出获得相同奖励时，组内方差为零，导致优势归零，阻碍学习，尤其在使用二元验证器的冷启动场景中。
Method: 提出BV-Blend，一种无评论家框架，结合提示组内当前策略统计量与语义聚类条件下的历史矩（通过EMA追踪），利用均值标准误代理导出的置信权重混合历史与组内基线及方差统计，标准化后用于PPO风格的裁剪更新。
Result: 在可验证推理基准上，BV-Blend相比组归一化方法提高了训练稳定性和性能，且在组归一化可能失效的场景下保持鲁棒。
Conclusion: BV-Blend通过引入历史基线混合，有效解决了无评论家强化学习中因奖励同质导致的训练停滞问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mitigating Batch Effects in Histopathology via Language-Mediated Robust Embedding Generation
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) have demonstrated strong potential across clinical and scientific applications, yet their performance is often hindered by batch effects, which are non-biological variations across tissue source institutions (TSIs) that distort learned feature representations and impair generalization. Conventional mitigation strategies, such as stain normalization, offer limited success in addressing these high-dimensional, complex artifacts. We present GLMP (General-purpose LLM-Mediated Pathology model), a novel framework that generates robust numerical embeddings from histology image patches through an intermediate textual representation. By leveraging pretrained general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and text encoders, GLMP effectively prioritizes biologically meaningful signals over TSI-specific artifacts, thereby improving cross-institutional generalization. To our knowledge, GLMP is the first pathology model to use text descriptions of histological features as an intermediate representation for generating numerical embeddings from histology images. Our results highlight the untapped potential of broad-domain, non-specialized MLLMs in computational pathology and introduce a new paradigm for building versatile, generalizable, and robust pathology models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GLMP框架，利用通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和文本编码器，通过中间文本表示生成组织病理学图像补丁的鲁棒数值嵌入，以减轻不同组织来源机构间的批效应，提升跨机构泛化能力。
Motivation: 病理学基础模型受批效应影响，即不同组织来源机构的非生物变异扭曲特征表示，现有方法如染色标准化效果有限。
Method: GLMP框架使用预训练的通用多模态大语言模型将组织病理学图像补丁转换为文本描述，再通过文本编码器生成数值嵌入，以此优先保留生物信号而非机构特异性伪影。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称GLMP是首个使用组织学特征文本描述作为中间表示来生成组织病理学图像数值嵌入的模型，并展示了利用非专用MLLM的潜力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调GLMP为构建通用、可泛化、鲁棒的病理学模型提供了新范式，揭示了宽领域非专用MLLM在计算病理学中的未被充分挖掘的潜力。

papers.title: COMPASS: Grounding Composition-Intent Guidance in Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Composition is a high-level visual intent that governs where subjects are placed and how a scene is organized, yet current unified multimodal models remain unreliable at fine-grained composition recognition and struggle to turn such intent into controllable generation. We present COMPASS, the first unified multimodal framework that grounds composition-intent control in a single system spanning both composition perception and composition-guided generation, with a shared expert token $τ_c$ as the central intent anchor. On the perception side, COMPASS injects composition expertise into an MoE backbone in a minimally invasive manner and distills the inferred intent into $τ_c$. On the generation side, COMPASS reuses $τ_c$ as a global conditioning signal that steers the denoising trajectory, effectively converting passive composition analysis into explicit layout control. To support systematic instruction-following composition learning and evaluation at scale, we construct Comp-11, a large-scale dataset with an 11-class taxonomy and reasoning-augmented annotations. Extensive experiments show that COMPASS substantially improves category-level composition understanding and delivers more composition-consistent, prompt-faithful generation than strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 COMPASS，首个统一多模态框架，通过共享专家令牌 τ_c 同时支持组合意图感知与组合引导生成。感知端以最小侵入方式向 MoE 注入组合专长，生成端复用 τ_c 作为全局条件控制去噪轨迹。构建 Comp-11 大规模数据集支持组合学习与评估，实验表明 COMPASS 在细粒度组合理解与生成一致性上显著优于强基线。
Motivation: 当前统一多模态模型在细粒度组合识别上不可靠，且难以将组合意图转化为可控生成，缺乏统一的组合意图感知与生成框架。
Method: 提出 COMPASS，以共享专家令牌 τ_c 为核心，在感知端通过 MoE 注入组合知识并蒸馏意图，在生成端复用 τ_c 作为全局条件信号引导去噪过程，实现被动分析到主动布局控制的转换。同时构建含11类标签和推理增强标注的 Comp-11 数据集。
Result: 实验表明 COMPASS 大幅提升类别级组合理解能力，生成结果比强基线更符合组合意图且忠实于提示。
Conclusion: COMPASS 证明了统一组合意图感知与生成框架的可行性，共享令牌机制有效连接两个任务，但依赖大规模标注数据集，泛化性有待进一步验证。

papers.title: An AI agent for treatment reasoning over a biomedical tool universe
papers.abstract_en: Treatment reasoning underpins every therapeutic decision, integrating disease context, comorbidities, medications, contraindications, and evolving biomedical knowledge to select an appropriate therapy. It is inherently iterative: candidates are weighed against many constraints, revised as evidence emerges, and grounded in verifiable sources. Here we introduce ATHENA-R1, an AI agent for treatment reasoning across all FDA approved drugs since 1939, trained by reinforcement learning over a universe of 212 biomedical tools. At each step it identifies missing information, selects and runs relevant tools, and incorporates the evidence. To train it without human-annotated traces, we build a two-level self-learning framework: multi-agent systems construct the tools, tasks, and reasoning trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, then reinforcement learning with scientific feedback rewards reasoning quality (evidence gathering, grounded tool use, logical non-redundancy). Across five benchmarks of 3,168 drug reasoning tasks and 456 patient treatment cases, ATHENA-R1 outperforms language models and tool-use systems, reaching 94.7% accuracy on open-ended drug reasoning and 82.9% on treatment reasoning, 17.8 and 10.7 points above GPT-5. In blinded evaluations by experts from 28 rare disease organizations, it is preferred over reference models on all criteria, and physicians rated it favorably on complex hospitalized cardiovascular and infectious-disease cases. Adverse-event hypotheses it generated, tested in electronic health records from 5.4 million patients, reached adjusted odds ratios of 1.48-1.84, with no elevation among negative controls. Because it requires knowing what evidence to seek before concluding, treatment reasoning has long been hard for AI; we show it can be reframed as a learnable process of iterative evidence gathering that reinforcement learning can train AI to perform.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ATHENA-R1，一个通过强化学习在212个生物医学工具宇宙上训练的治疗推理AI智能体，覆盖1939年以来所有FDA批准的药物。它采用两级自学习框架：多智能体系统构建工具和推理轨迹用于监督微调，然后强化学习与科学反馈优化推理质量。在多个基准上，ATHENA-R1在药物推理（94.7%）和治疗推理（82.9%）上显著优于GPT-5等模型，专家盲评和医生评估均表现突出，且生成的不良事件假设在电子健康记录中得到验证。
Motivation: 治疗推理是迭代过程，但AI难以执行，因为需要知道在得出结论前寻找什么证据。现有模型缺乏结构化工具使用和证据收集能力。
Method: ATHENA-R1使用两级自学习框架：首先多智能体系统构建工具、任务和推理轨迹进行监督微调；然后使用强化学习与科学反馈奖励推理质量（证据收集、工具使用、逻辑非冗余）。
Result: 在五个基准的3168个药物推理任务和456个患者治疗案例中，ATHENA-R1达到94.7%药物推理准确率和82.9%治疗推理准确率，分别超过GPT-5达17.8和10.7个百分点。专家盲评中在所有标准上优于参考模型。不良事件假设在540万患者EHR中验证，调整优势比1.48-1.84。
Conclusion: 治疗推理可以重构为迭代证据收集的可学习过程，强化学习能够训练AI执行。该方法展示了AI在复杂医疗决策中的潜力。

papers.title: LogiCo: A Unified Framework for Logical and Structural Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Current anomaly detection methods primarily focus on structural anomalies, while paying insufficient attention to anomalies that violate logical constraints. Conversely, top-performing logical anomaly detection approaches address this by modeling global semantic consistency, but perform poorly on subtle structural anomalies due to inadequate detection granularity. In this paper, we propose LogiCo, a unified framework for Logical and structural anomaly detection via Component-level feature reconstruction. Unlike existing methods that rely on explicit global semantic modeling, LogiCo employs a novel component-level feature reconstruction technique to capture inter-component logical constraints. Specifically, LogiCo maps pre-trained image features into a discrete component-level feature space and performs collaborative feature reconstruction at both component and patch levels, enabling it to effectively detect both logical and structural anomalies. Furthermore, to address the specific challenge of count-related logical anomalies, we integrate a segmentation-map discriminator that extends the model's capability to identify quantitative inconsistencies. LogiCo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both logical and structural anomaly detection across four benchmarks, including MVTec-LOCO, MVTec-AD, VisA, and Real-IAD, demonstrating its superiority and practical feasibility. The code is available at https://github.com/cnulab/LogiCo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LogiCo，一个统一的逻辑和结构异常检测框架。通过组件级特征重建（component-level feature reconstruction）捕捉组件间逻辑约束，同时在组件和 patch 级别进行协作重建，有效检测两类异常。针对计数相关逻辑异常，额外集成分割图判别器。在 MVTec-LOCO、MVTec-AD、VisA 和 Real-IAD 四个基准上达到当前最优。
Motivation: 现有异常检测方法主要关注结构异常，忽略违反逻辑约束的异常；而最先进的逻辑异常检测方法虽能建模全局语义一致性，但因检测粒度不足对细微结构异常表现差。
Method: LogiCo 将预训练图像特征映射到离散组件级特征空间，并在组件级和 patch 级执行协作特征重建。另引入分割图判别器（segmentation-map discriminator）以识别计数相关的定量不一致。
Result: 在 MVTec-LOCO、MVTec-AD、VisA 和 Real-IAD 四个基准上，LogiCo 在逻辑异常和结构异常检测中均取得当前最佳性能。
Conclusion: LogiCo 通过组件级特征重建统一了逻辑与结构异常检测，证明了其实用可行性和优越性。

papers.title: A Neuroimaging Simulation Framework for Developing and Evaluating Causal AI
papers.abstract_en: Causally linking disease-related factors to image-derived biomarkers provides a powerful pathway to understanding disease mechanisms. Despite growing interest in applying causal artificial intelligence (AI) approaches for this task, these methods still need to be adapted for complex medical images, and especially, neuroimaging. However, the lack of ground-truth data presents a barrier to development. To bridge this gap, we developed and tested a method for generating synthetic neuroimages, which adhere to a user-specified causal structure describing the non-image to image variable relationships, permitting the creation of ground-truth neuroimaging datasets. In the simulated T1-weighted magnetic resonance images, anatomical variability is modeled by sampling from a subspace estimated from real data and deforming a template image to create unique simulated subjects. Causal relationships are encoded via precise volumetric changes of any region-of-interest without unwanted global artifacts. We achieved relative volume errors of 0.3-2.66% for the targeted regions-of-interest and demonstrate their statistically significant causal relationships, while maintaining mean absolute errors for non-target brain regions between 0.034-0.397ml. An initial evaluation of causal discovery methods exposes their limited ability to suppress spurious connections, highlighting the need for image-appropriate methods. Our framework is the first to enable the generation of realistic synthetic 3D neuroimages with explicit causal control that can serve as the missing ground-truth data necessary for the objective benchmarking and development of causal AI methods.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个生成合成神经影像的仿真框架，该框架允许用户指定非图像变量与图像变量之间的因果结构，从而创建带有真实因果关系的3D神经影像数据集。模拟T1加权MRI时，通过子空间采样和模板变形生成解剖变异，并通过精确体积变化编码因果关系。实验显示目标区域相对体积误差为0.3-2.66%，且因果发现方法在抑制虚假连接方面表现有限。该框架首次实现了具有显式因果控制的逼真合成神经影像，为因果AI方法的客观基准测试和开发提供了缺失的真实数据。
Motivation: 因果AI在医学影像分析中具有潜力，但缺乏带有真实因果结构的神经影像数据集，阻碍了方法的开发和评估。
Method: 开发了一个基于子空间采样和模板变形的合成神经影像生成框架，通过精确控制感兴趣区域的体积变化来编码因果结构，避免全局伪影。
Result: 目标区域的相对体积误差为0.3-2.66%，非目标区域的平均绝对误差为0.034-0.397ml，且因果关系的统计显著性得到验证。初步评估显示现有因果发现方法易产生虚假连接。
Conclusion: 该仿真框架是首个能够生成具有显式因果控制的逼真3D神经影像的工具，为因果AI在神经影像中的开发和基准测试提供了关键数据资源。

papers.title: Aristotelian Virtue Profiling of LLMs through Ethical Dilemmas
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) often face ethical tradeoffs in which several responses may be defensible but express different priorities, such as fairness, honesty, courage, or restraint. We introduce VirtueMap, a framework for describing these patterns through an Aristotelian virtue-ethics lens. Instead of asking for a single correct answer, VirtueMap asks humans or LLMs to rank all five responses to each of seven general, non-lethal, non-political, and non-religious ethical dilemmas. To define the reference orderings used for scoring, we first proposed, for each dilemma and virtue, an ordering of the five responses from most to least expressive of that virtue. We then collected more than 100 respondent evaluations per ordering and retained it as operational ground truth only when at least 95% confirmed it. Rankings are scored against these retained orderings using normalized Borda alignment, yielding profiles over Practical Wisdom, Justice, Truthfulness, Courage, and Temperance. We apply VirtueMap to nine LLM families in a repeated-run evaluation and find high mean rank consistency (90.3%), with the largest differences appearing on Courage, Temperance, and Justice. We also release an interactive website that computes profiles locally in the browser and compares respondents with measured LLM profiles.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VirtueMap框架，通过亚里士多德美德伦理学视角分析大型语言模型（LLM）在道德困境中的回应模式。该框架要求人类或LLM对七个非致命、非政治、非宗教的道德困境的五个回应按美德表达程度排序，并通过标准化Borda对齐计算实践智慧、正义、诚实、勇气和节制五个维度的分数。在九个LLM家族上的重复实验显示平均排名一致性达90.3%，最大差异出现在勇气、节制和正义维度。
Motivation: 现有LLM伦理评估方法常假设存在单一正确答案，忽视了不同回应可能体现不同优先权（如公平、诚实、勇气等）的实际情况。
Method: VirtueMap框架：针对每个道德困境和美德，定义五个回应从最体现到最不体现该美德的排序，并通过至少95%的人类确认作为地面真值；使用标准化Borda对齐计算LLM排序与地面真值的匹配度。
Result: 在九个LLM家族上的重复运行评估中，平均排名一致性达90.3%，最大差异出现在勇气、节制和正义维度。
Conclusion: VirtueMap能有效刻画LLM通过美德伦理学的行为模式，并揭示了不同模型在特定美德维度上的差异。

papers.title: Capability Gates Are Not Authorization: Confused-Deputy Failures in LLM Agent Frameworks
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using LLM agents increasingly read untrusted content while holding side-effecting tools such as payments, email, CRM, and infrastructure APIs, yet common framework defaults still conflate tool exposure with authorization. We audit whether LangChain/LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and the Stripe Agent Toolkit re-authorize each model-emitted call, with concrete argument values, before execution. Across pinned public-source commits, all three provide capability gating by default, but none provides a deterministic fail-closed per-call value authorization gate by default. We introduce ScopeGate, a five-stage PDP/PEP for agent tool calls: scope, authorization, money ceiling, idempotency, and default deny. Evaluation shows the identical unauthorized payout call executes under LangChain's default dispatch (with a companion LlamaIndex PoC) but is denied by ScopeGate; the tested control reports 0/48 static bypasses, 0/29 unauthorized attempts (40-iteration adaptive run), 0/10 benign false-denies, and Latam-GPT payment-agent containment at 10/10. ASR denotes attempted unauthorized action, containment is not a cure, deployment-tier claims are inference over measured model classes, and no CVE is asserted.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对LangChain/LangGraph、LlamaIndex和Stripe Agent Toolkit进行审计，发现默认情况下这些框架将工具暴露与授权混为一谈，仅提供能力门控（capability gating）而非每个调用的值级授权。作者提出ScopeGate——一个五阶段PDP/PEP（策略决策点/策略执行点）代理工具调用框架，包含范围、授权、金额上限、幂等性和默认拒绝，实验显示ScopeGate能阻止未经授权的支付调用，而默认调度则不能。
Motivation: LLM代理在处理不受信任内容时可能执行具有副作用的工具调用，当前框架默认将工具暴露视为授权，导致混淆代理（confused-deputy）攻击风险。
Method: 审计现有框架的默认授权机制，并提出ScopeGate：一个五阶段策略执行管道，包括作用域检查、参数级授权、金额上限、幂等性检查和默认拒绝。
Result: 在默认调度下，未经授权的支付调用可以执行；ScopeGate则拒绝该调用。测试报告显示：48次静态绕过尝试均失败，29次未经授权请求（40轮自适应攻击）均被阻止，10次良性误拒为零，在Latam-GPT支付代理场景下10/10成功遏制。
Conclusion: 能力门控不等于授权，代理框架应默认采用逐调用、参数级别的值授权。ScopeGate提供了有效的防护，但遏制并非根治，实际部署需进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SATB-VR: Training Few-Step Video Restoration Diffusion Model using SNR-Aware Trajectory Blending
papers.abstract_en: While diffusion models excel in video restoration, their reliance on extensive iterative steps limits efficiency. Conversely, aggressive single-step distillation often compromises fine texture recovery. To achieve an optimal balance, we present SATB-VR, a few-step paradigm that jump-starts the denoising process via an auxiliary predictor, explicitly bypassing early low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) steps. However, naive joint training of the predictor and the denoiser inherently introduces a severe train-inference discrepancy. To resolve this, we propose the SNR-Aware Trajectory Blending (SATB) strategy. During the forward process, SATB constructs the noisy input by dynamically blending the predictor's output with the ground-truth trajectory based on the SNRs. This forces the denoiser to robustly compensate for initial prediction errors while smoothly converging to the clean data manifold. Furthermore, we introduce a Denoiser-Driven Consistency (DDC) loss, leveraging the concurrently updated denoiser as a dynamic evaluator to explicitly align internal features and boost predictor accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, under flexible few-step inference regimes (\eg, $\le 5$ steps), SATB-VR performs favorably against existing approaches on synthetic, real-world, and AIGC benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SATB-VR提出一种少步视频修复扩散模型训练范式，通过辅助预测器跳过低信噪比步骤，并利用SNR-Aware Trajectory Blending策略解决训练-推理差异，结合Denoiser-Driven Consistency损失提升性能。在少步推理（≤5步）下，该方法在合成、真实和AIGC基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 扩散模型在视频修复中效果好但迭代步骤多效率低，单步蒸馏又损失细节，需要在这两者间取得平衡。
Method: 提出SATB-VR，包含辅助预测器跳过低SNR步骤；SNR-Aware Trajectory Blending (SATB)策略在正向过程中根据SNR动态混合预测器输出和真实轨迹构建噪声输入；以及Denoiser-Driven Consistency (DDC)损失利用去噪器作为动态评估器对齐特征。
Result: 在少步推理（≤5步）下，SATB-VR在合成、真实和AIGC视频修复基准上表现优于现有方法。
Conclusion: SATB-VR通过信噪比感知的轨迹混合和去噪器驱动的一致性损失，实现了高效且高质量的视频修复，为少步扩散模型提供了新思路。

papers.title: Predicting Metastatic Risk from Primary Tissue Architecture via Distance-Aware Spatial Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the risk of distant metastasis from primary tumor tissue histology is a critical yet challenging task in computational pathology. Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) approaches can attend to subdomains in tumor regions that harbor features of metastatic cancer progression. However MIL models treat tissue patches as unordered bags, discarding the spatial layout that defines the metastatic potential. We propose that metastatic risk is inherently dictated by the geometric arrangement of the tumor microenvironment at the interface with tumor cells. Our model is designed to explicitly capture the spatial relationships between tumor cells, tumor associated fibroblasts and infiltrating lymphocytes. For this purpose, we propose Distance aware Tissue Modeling for Multiple Instance Learning(DTMf-MIL), a novel method that reinforces visual features with explicit spatial priors. By computing signed distance functions (SDF) relative to tissue phenotypes, our model learns to recognize structural signatures of metastatic risk. This geometric awareness translates directly to superior clinical performance as DTMf-MIL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods that ignore spatial layout on metastasis prediction from tissue in the primary tumor. We further validate our approach on public benchmarks, demonstrating that spatial awareness consistently improves diagnostic accuracy across diverse clinical tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种距离感知的空间建模方法(DTMf-MIL)，用于从原发性肿瘤组织的组织学图像预测远处转移风险。该方法通过计算组织表型的符号距离函数(SDF)来显式捕获肿瘤微环境中细胞的空间布局，从而增强多实例学习(MIL)的视觉特征。实验表明，DTMf-MIL在转移预测任务上显著优于忽略空间布局的现有方法，并在公共基准上验证了空间感知的通用诊断改进。
Motivation: 现有MIL方法将组织切片视为无序的包，丢弃了决定转移潜力的空间结构。本文认为转移风险本质上由肿瘤微环境中细胞的几何排列决定，因此需要显式建模空间关系。
Method: 提出DTMf-MIL，通过计算相对于组织表型的符号距离函数(SDF)来引入空间先验，强化视觉特征，使模型学习转移风险的 structural signatures。
Result: 在原发性肿瘤组织转移预测任务中，DTMf-MIL显著优于忽略空间布局的现有最优方法；在公共基准上空间感知持续提升诊断准确性。
Conclusion: 空间布局信息对于预测转移风险至关重要，所提距离感知建模框架可有效提升计算病理学中下游任务的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Constrained Tabular Diffusion for Finance
papers.abstract_en: Generative models in finance face the dual challenge of producing realistic data while satisfying strict regulatory and economic objectives, a requirement that standard tabular diffusion models cannot provide. To address this difficulty, we introduce Constrained Tabular Diffusion for Finance (CTDF), a novel integration of sampling-time feasibility operations with mixed-type tabular diffusion in financial applications. By incorporating a training-free feasibility operator into the reverse-diffusion sampling loop, CTDF enforces hard constraints for applications such as simulation, legal compliance, and extrapolation. Extensive experiments on large-scale financial datasets demonstrate zero constraint violations and improvement in scarce data utility. CTDF establishes a robust method for generating trustworthy and compliant synthetic data, opening new avenues for rigorous generative modeling and analysis in the financial domain.
papers.comment: Published at ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF) 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对金融领域生成模型需同时满足数据真实性和监管经济约束的问题，提出CTDF，将采样时可行性操作与混合类型表格扩散相结合。通过在逆扩散采样循环中嵌入无需训练的可行性算子，CTDF强制执行硬约束，如模拟、法律合规和外推。在大规模金融数据集上的实验表明零约束违规和稀缺数据效用提升。
Motivation: 标准表格扩散模型无法同时满足金融数据生成的真实性和严格的监管与经济目标。
Method: 提出CTDF，在逆扩散采样循环中集成训练无关的可行性算子，强制执行硬约束。
Result: 在大规模金融数据集上实现零约束违规，并改善稀缺数据效用。
Conclusion: CTDF为生成可信且合规的合成数据建立了稳健方法，为金融领域的严格生成建模与分析开辟新途径。

papers.title: BackTranslation2.0 -- A Linguistically Motivated Metric to Assess Sign Language Production
papers.abstract_en: Sign Languages (SLs) are the primary means of communication for millions of deaf individuals, yet existing evaluation metrics for generated SL remain simplistic and poorly aligned with human judgements. We introduce BackTranslation2.0, a linguistically grounded evaluation metric for text-to-sign translation that moves beyond naïve backtranslation. Our approach adopts an agentic framework in which a deterministic pipeline orchestrates a suite of specialised tools to assess four scoring dimensions - grammatical correctness, phonological accuracy, motion fluency, and generation fidelity - aligned with human rater assessments. Tool outputs are not treated independently: a set of large language model (LLM)-based cross-referential comparison modules evaluates consistency across tools and checks outputs against linguistic expectations, enabling structured reasoning over grammatical, phonological, and motion-level evidence. Final dimension scores are computed through deterministic weighted formulas over validated tool outputs. To validate BackTranslation2.0, we introduce and evaluate on a British Sign Language (BSL) dataset rated in a human rater study across the same quality dimensions, following a protocol developed in collaboration between linguists and deaf experts, benchmarking against six baseline metrics. Our method demonstrates strong correlation with human judgements across all dimensions, providing a more comprehensive, interpretable, and linguistically principled evaluation framework for sign language production systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BackTranslation2.0，一种基于语言学的手语生成评估指标，通过确定性管道协调一组专门工具，评估语法正确性、音韵准确性、动作流畅性和生成保真度四个维度，并利用基于大语言模型的交叉引用模块进行结构化推理。在英式手语数据集上，该方法与人类评分者评估的四个维度高度相关，优于六个基线指标。
Motivation: 现有手语生成评估指标过于简单且与人类判断一致性差，缺乏语言学基础。
Method: 采用智能体框架，确定性管道编排多种工具评估四个质量维度，并通过大语言模型交叉引用模块验证工具输出一致性，最终使用确定性加权公式计算各维度得分。
Result: 在英式手语数据集上，该方法与人类评分者评估的四个维度（语法、音韵、动作、保真度）均呈现强相关性，优于六个基线指标。
Conclusion: BackTranslation2.0 提供了一个更全面、可解释且符合语言学原则的手语生成系统评估框架，但仅针对英式手语验证，其他手语和生成模型需进一步测试。

papers.title: Entropy-Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Linear-Quadratic Stackelberg Differential Games in Regime-Switching Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Stackelberg differential games (SDGs) provide a powerful framework for hierarchical decision-making in stochastic and continuous-time environments, yet their solution remains computationally challenging due to the complexity of traditional dynamic programming and Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman-Isaacs (HJBI) methods, especially in high-dimensional systems. This paper proposes an entropy-regularized reinforcement learning (ERRL) approach for linear-quadratic SDGs (LQ-SDGs) within a continuous-time diffusion framework governed by Markovian regime switching. The key innovation lies in deriving exploratory weakly-coupled HJBI equations with entropy regularization, which promotes stochastic policies that actively avoid suboptimal equilibria -- a limitation of classical SDG methods. Neural networks are integrated to approximate regime-dependent value functions and solve high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs) efficiently, while a novel sampling technique enhances computational tractability. Numerical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework compared to conventional approaches, particularly in escaping suboptimal traps through exploratory policies. The study highlights the critical role of entropy regularization and neural network approximations in achieving robust solutions for hierarchical decision-making problems under abrupt environmental shifts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种熵正则化强化学习方法，用于求解马尔可夫机制切换扩散模型下的线性二次型Stackelberg微分博弈。通过推导含熵正则化的弱耦合HJBI方程，引入神经网络逼近值函数并求解高维PDE，数值实验表明该方法能有效避免次优均衡。
Motivation: 传统动态规划与HJBI方法求解Stackelberg微分博弈计算复杂，尤其在高维系统中难以处理，且易陷入次优均衡。
Method: 推导带熵正则化的弱耦合HJBI方程，引入随机策略；使用神经网络近似机制依赖的值函数；提出新型采样技术以提升计算可行性。
Result: 数值结果验证了该框架相比传统方法的有效性，尤其在通过探索性策略逃离次优陷阱方面表现突出。
Conclusion: 熵正则化与神经网络近似在应对环境突变下的分层决策问题中起关键作用，但未提及实际应用场景或局限性。

papers.title: MACROCAST: A Vintage-Consistent Time Series Foundation Model for Real-Time Macroeconomic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MACROCAST, a lightweight Time Series Foundation Model (TSFM) for real-time macroeconomic forecasting. Existing TSFMs suffer from data leakage in two forms: temporal contamination, as the model may have seen the realized values of the series it forecasts, and revision bias, as training on fully revised data diverges from the preliminary, vintage-specific releases available to real-time forecasters. MACROCAST is, to our knowledge, the first TSFM that rules out both forms of leakage entirely: at no stage of training is the model exposed to information that would not have been available to a forecaster in real time. We train MACROCAST first on purely synthetic time series in approximately one GPU-day and then fine-tune it on synthetic time series drawn from Bayesian VARs, dynamic factor models, and ARIMA specifications estimated on vintage-specific ALFRED data. Because pretraining uses only simulated data and fine-tuning uses only real-time vintages, no observed future or revised value ever enters the model; each fine-tuning run takes nine minutes. Evaluated on the FRED-MD database in a genuine real-time out-of-sample exercise, MACROCAST improves on the AR(1) benchmark for roughly 80% of series-horizon pairs, matches or surpasses Chronos-2 -- the strongest currently available TSFM -- and outperforms the Bayesian VAR and dynamic factor model benchmarks, all in a data-leakage-free manner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MACROCAST是一个轻量级时间序列基础模型，专为实时宏观经济预测设计。它通过仅在合成数据和实时vintage数据上训练，完全避免了时间污染和修订偏差两种数据泄露问题。在FRED-MD数据库的真实实时样本外评估中，MACROCAST在大约80%的序列-预测期组合上优于AR(1)基准，匹配或超越最强的现有TSFM Chronos-2，并超越贝叶斯VAR和动态因子模型。
Motivation: 现有时间序列基础模型存在两种数据泄露：时间污染（模型可能见过未来数据）和修订偏差（使用完全修订后的数据训练，与实际实时预测者可获得的初步vintage数据不符）。这导致模型在实时预测场景中表现不可靠。
Method: MACROCAST首先在纯合成时间序列上预训练（约1 GPU天），然后在从基于vintage-specific ALFRED数据估计的贝叶斯VAR、动态因子模型和ARIMA规格中抽取的合成序列上微调（每次微调9分钟）。预训练仅用模拟数据，微调仅用实时vintage数据，确保模型从未接触未来或修订后的真实值。
Result: 在FRED-MD数据库的真实实时样本外测试中，MACROCAST在大约80%的序列-预测期组合上优于AR(1)基准，匹配或超越Chronos-2，并优于贝叶斯VAR和动态因子模型，且完全无数据泄露。
Conclusion: MACROCAST证明了在宏观经济预测中完全消除数据泄露的可行性，并展示了轻量级模型在实时预测中可与当前最强TSFM相媲美的潜力。

papers.title: Entropy Regularized Reinforcement Learning for Zero-Sum Stochastic Differential Games in a Regime-Switching Jump-Diffusion Process
papers.abstract_en: To address parameter misspecification and sudden structural environmental changes in conventional stochastic differential game (SDG) frameworks, this paper introduces a distributional control approach that characterizes optimal strategies as probability distributions over actions, conditioned on the continuous state, the discrete regime state, and parameters. This forms a reinforcement learning framework for entropy-regularized zero-sum stochastic differential games (ERRL-ZSSDGs) in a regime-switching jump-diffusion process. Using the dynamic programming principle (DPP), we derive the associated coupled systems of Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman-Isaacs (HJBI) equations, from which equilibrium strategies are expressed via gradients of the value function. For linear-quadratic problems, semi-analytical solutions for both value function and equilibrium strategies are obtained by solving a system of coupled ordinary differential equations (ODEs). In more general settings, an Actor-Critic policy improvement algorithm is developed to approximate the value functions and equilibrium policies across different regimes. The method is applied to an investment game, and numerical examples illustrate the effect of the temperature parameter and regime transitions on optimal policies and values.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对传统随机微分博弈中参数误设定和环境结构突变的问题，提出熵正则化零和随机微分博弈（ERRL-ZSSDGs）的分布控制框架，将最优策略建模为关于连续状态、离散体制状态和参数的条件概率分布。通过动态规划原理推导耦合的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman-Isaacs (HJBI) 方程组，并在线性二次情形下得到半解析解；一般情形下设计了Actor-Critic策略改进算法。应用于投资博弈的数值算例展示了温度参数和体制转换对最优策略和值函数的影响。
Motivation: 传统随机微分博弈框架假设参数固定且环境结构不变，难以应对参数误设定和突发性结构变化，需要更鲁棒的策略表征方法。
Method: 提出分布控制方法，将策略表示为概率分布；利用动态规划原理导出耦合HJBI方程组；对线性二次问题求解耦合常微分方程组获得半解析解；一般情形下开发Actor-Critic算法近似值函数和均衡策略。
Result: 通过投资博弈数值例子说明了温度参数和体制转换如何影响最优策略和值函数，验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效处理参数误设定和环境结构变化，为随机微分博弈提供更灵活的求解框架，但数值结果仅限于投资博弈场景。

papers.title: Why Trust Your Agent? Empirical Security Gains from TRiSM-Guided Agentic Workflows in Healthcare
papers.abstract_en: Agent-based AI has enabled the automation of tasks by exposing application tools and resources to large language models (LLMs). However, to improve scope and accuracy, agents are often given access rights that exceed those of ordinary users, introducing significant security risks. AI is routinely integrated into applications with a disregard to security, risking data exposure and breaching regulations. This paper applies the AI Trust, Risk, and Security Management (TRiSM) framework to a medical report-generation application to demonstrate how an insecure agent workflow can be transformed into security-conscious agentic workflow. Both workflows were evaluated across five LLMs (Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-4.1-nano, GPT-4.1-mini, GPT-5.4-mini, and Gemini 2.5 Flash) on two report types, totalling 800 generations and 500 attack scenarios including RAG poisoning, data-field injection, and client-side network injection. The TRiSM-guided agentic workflow reduced mean attack success rates from 31% to 10% for RAG poisoning and from 42% to 25% for data-field injection, while eliminating the network injection vector entirely through server-side prompt construction. Furthermore, report accuracy increased by 14 percentage points (72.5% to 86.5%) with the agentic workflow, demonstrating a secure design which provides more reliable outputs. This paper contributes to knowledge by demonstrating least-privilege, defence in depth agentic workflows improving security and accuracy, while also highlighting model choice is a necessary architectural consideration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI代理系统因权限过大带来的安全风险，将AI信任、风险与安全管理（TRiSM）框架应用于医疗报告生成应用，设计安全意识的代理工作流。实验在5种大语言模型上评估800次生成和500次攻击场景（包括RAG投毒、数据字段注入、客户端网络注入），结果显示TRiSM引导的代理工作流将平均攻击成功率从31%降至10%（RAG投毒）和从42%降至25%（数据字段注入），并完全消除了网络注入向量，同时报告准确率从72.5%提升至86.5%。
Motivation: 现有AI代理系统常被赋予超出普通用户权限，导致严重安全风险，而医疗领域对数据隐私和法规合规要求极高，需要一种系统化的安全设计方法。
Method: 应用AI信任、风险与安全管理（TRiSM）框架，通过最小权限原则和纵深防御策略改造医疗报告生成的原型代理工作流，包括服务器端提示构建、权限隔离等。
Result: 在5种LLM（Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-4.1-nano等）上，TRiSM代理工作流将RAG投毒平均攻击成功率从31%降至10%，数据字段注入从42%降至25%，网络注入向量被完全消除；报告准确率从72.5%提升至86.5%。
Conclusion: 研究表明，采用最小权限和纵深防御的代理工作流可以同时提升安全性和输出准确性，且模型选择是架构中必要考虑因素。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Closed-Form Steepest Descent Direction toward Flat Minima: Reducing Upper Bounds on the Loss Hessian Eigenspectrum in Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The flatness hypothesis suggests that flatness of the loss landscape, as measured by the eigenvalues of the loss Hessian, correlates with better neural network generalization. While various algorithms reduce these eigenvalues, most focus on procedural design, leaving it unclear how data distributions and NN parameters structurally determine directions toward flat minima. Characterizing these directions analytically is generally intractable. To overcome this mathematical difficulty, recent studies derived the Wolkowicz-Styan (WS) upper bound on the maximum eigenvalue of the cross-entropy loss Hessian in three-layer NNs. Although this upper bound is differentiable, its gradient was not derived. Therefore, we analytically derive the gradient of the WS upper bound to characterize directions leading to flat minima. Based on this, we propose Hessian Spectral Range (HSR) Regularization, which updates parameters along the steepest descent direction of the WS bound. Experiments demonstrate that HSR Regularization narrows the Hessian eigenvalue spectrum, avoids sharp minima and saddle points, and promotes convergence to flat minima. Although the applicability of this method is currently limited to cross-entropy loss and three-layer architectures, to the best of the authors' knowledge, this is the first study to report a closed-form gradient that promotes convergence to flat minima without numerical approximations. Therefore, the theoretical analysis of this gradient is expected to contribute to the further development of NNs.

TL;DR: 本文针对神经网络损失景观平坦性与泛化性的关系，提出了Hessian谱范围（HSR）正则化方法。该方法基于交叉熵损失Hessian矩阵最大特征值的Wolkowicz-Styan（WS）上界的闭式梯度，沿着该上界的最速下降方向更新参数，从而缩小Hessian特征值谱，避免尖锐极小值和鞍点，促进收敛到平坦极小值。实验证明了有效性，但当前仅适用于三层神经网络和交叉熵损失。

Method: 推导了交叉熵损失Hessian矩阵的WS上界的闭式梯度，并据此提出HSR正则化，沿该上界的负梯度方向更新参数。

papers.title: When More Sampling Hurts: The Modal Ceiling and Correlation Ceiling of Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: People overthink; language models over-sample, and the extra effort can talk both into a worse answer. Reasoning systems answer a hard question by sampling it many times (test-time scaling), and the more they draw, the more often a correct answer turns up somewhere, so coverage, the fraction of problems with at least one correct try, climbs and appears to be progress. But a deployed system must return one answer, and choosing it, not knowing which try is right, is selection; selection is capped, and past a point extra samples only make the model surer of a confident mistake, even as every draw adds cost. The gap between climbing coverage and stalled selection, the identifiability gap, is the answer a model can produce but not pick. So the real question is not whether to sample but how far, and the answer is: not far. For picking an answer, the vote has already settled within a few dozen draws, the modal ceiling; for scoring a benchmark, sooner still, the correlation ceiling. Beyond that, extra draws cost compute and add nothing, and can even make the answer worse. This paper turns the cutoff into a single number, the effective number of samples, that any sampling run already reveals. The bottleneck is recognizing a right answer, not generating one.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/bay-yearick-lab/sampling-ceilings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究测试时缩放（test-time scaling）中采样次数增加对选择性能的影响，发现存在模态上限（modal ceiling）和相关上限（correlation ceiling）。虽然更多采样可以提高覆盖率（coverage），但选择性能在几十次采样后停滞，甚至可能因确认错误答案而变差。作者提出有效样本数（effective number of samples）作为采样截止点的指标。
Motivation: 现有方法通过增加采样次数提升推理性能，但忽略了选择答案时的瓶颈。更多采样导致成本增加且可能使模型更确信错误答案，需要确定最优采样次数。
Method: 通过理论分析和实验揭示采样次数与选择性能之间的上限关系，定义模态上限（投票稳定点）和相关上限（基准评估饱和点），并提出有效样本数作为自动计算截止点的指标。
Result: 实验表明，在几十次采样后，投票结果达到模态上限，继续采样无法提升选择性能；基准关联性在更早达到相关上限，额外采样仅增加计算成本。
Conclusion: 测试时缩放的关键不在于生成更多样本，而在于识别正确样本；瓶颈是识别而非生成。

papers.title: Transformer-Based Active Learning for Data-Efficient Vaccine Epitope Selection in PRRS
papers.abstract_en: High-fidelity molecular docking simulations can produce biologically relevant estimates of epitope-receptor binding affinity but are computationally expensive and therefore limit the number of candidates that can be screened for vaccine design. In this work, we evaluate machine learning (ML) approaches where variants of active learning are used to classify instances of high binding affinity between 9-mer epitopes and a well-conserved swine leukocyte antigen (SLA) receptor in the context of Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome (PRRS). We use an internally generated dataset of 80 epitope-SLA docking affinities, each requiring more than 48 hours of high-performance computing (HPC). Multiple model families (linear, MLP, CNN, and a small transformer) are trained under strict low-data conditions within a pool-based active learning loop. In each case, optimal model configurations are identified by conducting large-scale hyperparameter optimization over the combined space of model architecture, training configuration, acquisition policy, and ensemble decision rules. To mitigate the effects of data subsample selection, each candidate configuration is evaluated by averaging performance over many randomized and balanced training and validation data subsets. Across experiments, transformer-based sequence models consistently emerged as the best-performing architecture, with active incremental learning yielding significant improvement over a baseline random sample acquisition strategy. Under moderate training data availability (N=30), the optimized ML-model configuration outperforms a standard baseline trained on twice the amount of data. Under higher training data availability (N=60), the same configuration achieves a peak accuracy of 86.8%, consistent with an upper bound of 85% classification accuracy based on two independent estimates of conformational noise.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables, 1 suppl. figure, 2 suppl. tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了多种机器学习方法（线性、MLP、CNN、小型Transformer）在主动学习框架下，用于预测PRRS病毒9-mer表位与猪白细胞抗原（SLA）受体的结合亲和力。在严格低数据条件下，基于Transformer的序列模型表现最佳，主动增量学习显著优于随机采样基线。优化后的模型在N=30时超越使用两倍数据训练的基线，在N=60时达到86.8%的峰值准确率。
Motivation: 高保真分子对接模拟计算昂贵，限制了疫苗设计中候选表位的筛选数量。需要一种数据高效的机器学习方法，在少量标注数据下准确预测表位-受体结合亲和力。
Method: 采用池式主动学习循环，在内部生成的80个表位-SLA对接亲和力数据集上训练多种模型（线性、MLP、CNN、小型Transformer）。通过大规模超参数优化联合搜索模型架构、训练配置、采样策略和集成决策规则，并使用多次随机平衡子集平均性能来评估配置。
Result: Transformer模型在所有实验中表现最佳；主动增量学习相比随机采样显著提升性能；N=30时优化配置优于两倍数据训练的基线；N=60时峰值准确率86.8%，接近基于构象噪声估计的85%理论上限。
Conclusion: 基于Transformer的主动学习在数据极少的情况下能高效选择疫苗候选表位，为计算疫苗设计提供了一种实用方案。

papers.title: SemDynReg: Semantics-Guided Deformation Regularization for Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as an efficient approach for rendering dynamic scenes in a wide range of 3D applications. However, existing deformation field-based approaches largely lack explicit object-level modeling, often resulting in inconsistent Gaussian deformations within individual objects and unwanted coupling between different objects. To address this limitation, we introduce a semantics-guided framework that enforces dynamic regularization at the object level, aiming to achieve spatially consistent object-wise deformation. Specifically, we first extract segmentation masks using the Segment Anything Model (SAM) and derive semantic features from input images. An object-ID map is then constructed via feature relevance matching with a predefined object dictionary. Guided by this object-ID map, we identify the pixel-wise top-k contributing Gaussians for each object and impose consistency regularization on their deformation parameters, including position, scale, and rotation. Unlike prior methods that learn deformation fields without explicit object-level constraints, our approach incorporates semantic cues to guide deformation behavior at the object level. Experimental results demonstrate that our semantics-aware regularization improves object-level deformation consistency and outperforms baseline methods in rendering quality, achieving higher PSNR and SSIM and lower LPIPS in dynamic 3DGS rendering. Our project page is available at https://dyn-reg-3dgs.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可变形动态3D高斯溅射（3DGS）中缺乏显式物体级建模的问题，提出语义引导的变形正则化方法。利用SAM提取分割掩码并构建对象ID图，对每个对象的变形参数（位置、尺度、旋转）施加一致性正则化。实验表明该方法在动态场景渲染中提升了PSNR和SSIM，降低了LPIPS。
Motivation: 现有基于变形场的3DGS方法缺乏物体级建模，导致物体内部高斯变形不一致以及物体之间不希望的耦合。
Method: 使用SAM提取分割掩码，通过特征匹配构建对象ID图，然后对每个对象识别top-k贡献高斯，对其变形参数施加一致性正则化。
Result: 在动态3DGS渲染中，该方法在PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS指标上优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 语义引导的正则化能够提升物体级变形一致性，从而改善动态场景渲染质量。
