papers.title: Falsifying Discriminant Validity of Predictive Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Empirical investigations into unintended model behavior often show that the algorithm is predicting another outcome than what was intended. These exposés highlight the need to identify when algorithms predict unintended quantities - ideally before deploying them into consequential settings. We propose a falsification framework that provides a principled statistical test for discriminant validity: the requirement that an algorithm predict intended outcomes better than impermissible ones. Drawing on falsification practices from causal inference, econometrics, and psychometrics, our framework compares calibrated prediction losses across outcomes to assess whether the algorithm exhibits discriminant validity with respect to a specified impermissible proxy. In settings where the target outcome is difficult to observe, multiple permissible proxy outcomes may be available; our framework accommodates both this setting and the case with a single permissible proxy. Throughout we use nonparametric hypothesis testing methods that make minimal assumptions on the data-generating process. We illustrate the method in an admissions setting, where the framework establishes discriminant validity with respect to gender but fails to establish discriminant validity with respect to race. This demonstrates how falsification can serve as an early validity check. We also provide analysis in a criminal justice setting, where we highlight the limitations of our framework and emphasize the need for complementary approaches to assess other aspects of construct validity and external validity.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT '26), 3105--3128, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个证伪框架，用于统计检验预测算法的判别效度（discriminant validity），即算法是否更好地预测预期结果而非不可允许的替代结果。通过比较校准后的预测损失，并采用非参数假设检验，框架可应用于单个或多个可允许代理结果的情景。在招生和刑事司法案例中展示了方法，发现对性别具有判别效度，但对种族未能建立。
Motivation: 算法常常在无意中预测了非预期的变量，但缺乏系统性的统计检验来在部署前识别这一问题。现有方法依赖直觉或事后分析，需要更严格的判别效度检验。
Method: 借鉴因果推断、计量经济学和心理测量学中的证伪实践，提出一个比较校准后预测损失的统计检验框架。使用非参数假设检验，对数据生成过程做最小假设，支持单一或多个可允许代理结果。
Result: 在招生设置中，框架对性别建立了判别效度，但对种族未能建立；在刑事司法设置中，突出了框架的局限性并强调需要补充方法评估构念效度和外部效度。
Conclusion: 证伪框架可作为早期效度检查，但需要与其他方法结合以全面评估算法行为。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个证伪框架，用于统计检验预测算法的判别效度（discriminant validity），即算法是否更好地预测预期结果而非不可允许的替代结果。通过比较校准后的预测损失，并采用非参数假设检验，框架可应用于单个或多个可允许代理结果的情景。在招生和刑事司法案例中展示了方法，发现对性别具有判别效度，但对种族未能建立。

summary_sections.method: 借鉴因果推断、计量经济学和心理测量学中的证伪实践，提出一个比较校准后预测损失的统计检验框架。使用非参数假设检验，对数据生成过程做最小假设，支持单一或多个可允许代理结果。
summary_sections.result: 在招生设置中，框架对性别建立了判别效度，但对种族未能建立；在刑事司法设置中，突出了框架的局限性并强调需要补充方法评估构念效度和外部效度。
summary_sections.conclusion: 证伪框架可作为早期效度检查，但需要与其他方法结合以全面评估算法行为。

papers.title: Diff-MN: Diffusion Parameterized MoE-NCDE for Continuous Time Series Generation with Irregular Observations
papers.abstract_en: Time series generation (TSG) is widely used across domains, yet most existing methods assume regular sampling and fixed output resolutions. These assumptions are often violated in practice, where observations are irregular and sparse, while downstream applications require continuous and high-resolution TS. Although Neural Controlled Differential Equation (NCDE) is promising for modeling irregular TS, it is constrained by a single dynamics function, tightly coupled optimization, and limited ability to adapt learned dynamics to newly generated samples from the generative model. We propose Diff-MN, a continuous TSG framework that enhances NCDE with a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) dynamics function and a decoupled architectural design for dynamics-focused training. To further enable NCDE to generalize to newly generated samples, Diff-MN employs a diffusion model to parameterize the NCDE temporal dynamics parameters (MoE weights), i.e., jointly learn the distribution of TS data and MoE weights. This design allows sample-specific NCDE parameters to be generated for continuous TS generation. Experiments on ten public and synthetic datasets demonstrate that Diff-MN consistently outperforms strong baselines on both irregular-to-regular and irregular-to-continuous TSG tasks. The code is available at the link https://github.com/microsoft/TimeCraft/tree/main/Diff-MN.
papers.comment: This paper is accepted by ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Diff-MN框架，用于不规则观测的连续时间序列生成。通过将神经控制微分方程（NCDE）与混合专家（MoE）动力学函数结合，并采用解耦架构进行动力学训练，同时利用扩散模型参数化NCDE的MoE权重，从而生成样本特定的连续时间序列。在10个公开和合成数据集上，Diff-MN在非规则到规则及非规则到连续时间序列生成任务中持续优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有时间序列生成方法通常假设规则采样和固定输出分辨率，但在实际中观测往往不规则且稀疏，且下游应用需要连续高分辨率时间序列。NCDE虽有潜力但受限于单一动力学函数、紧密耦合的优化以及难以将学到的动力学泛化到生成模型的新样本。
Method: 提出Diff-MN，增强NCDE：1) 使用MoE动力学函数代替单一函数；2) 采用解耦架构优化动力学训练；3) 利用扩散模型学习时间序列数据和MoE权重的联合分布，从而生成样本特定的NCDE参数。
Result: 在10个数据集上，Diff-MN在非规则到规则和非规则到连续TSG任务中持续超越强基线。
Conclusion: Diff-MN为不规则观测的连续时间序列生成提供了一种有效框架，代码已开源。
Relevance: 40

papers.title: CoLR-Det: Collaborative Latent Restoration for Small Object Detection in Low-Resolution Remote Sensing Images
papers.abstract_en: Low-resolution remote sensing small object detection is limited by both missing visual details and the ambiguity of how details serve detection. Existing super-resolution-assisted detectors generally follow a restoration-first paradigm to explicitly enhance inputs before detection, which implicitly assumes visual fidelity benefits recognition. Yet super-resolution favors dense texture and edge recovery, while object detection relies on sparse instance-level semantics, making restoration amplify visually plausible but semantically irrelevant background textures. To tackle this issue, we propose CoLR-Det, a Collaborative Latent-Restoration-Assisted Small Object Detection framework that treats super-resolution supervision as detection-oriented latent regularization rather than explicit image-level enhancement. Instead of reconstructing high-resolution images for inference, CoLR-Det uses a training-only restoration branch to impose auxiliary reconstruction constraints on shared multiscale representations, and the inference pathway remains purely detection-driven. We further design a saliency-guided object-preserving token routing mechanism, which prioritizes high-saliency tokens for attention-based refinement while retaining information of bypassed tokens. Besides, a detection-prioritized two-stage optimization strategy is developed: it first builds stable object-level semantics before introducing restoration supervision, and assigns a smaller learning rate to the SR decoder to keep its updates conservative and reduce perturbations in collaborative training. With this design, CoLR-Det transforms restoration from an explicit visual enhancement operator into an implicit semantic regularizer. Experiments on resolution-degraded NWPU VHR-10-Split, DOTAv1.5-Split and HRSSD-Split show that CoLR-Det outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with code available at https://github.com/qiruo-ya/CoLR-Det.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoLR-Det 是一个针对低分辨率遥感图像小目标检测的框架，将超分辨率监督作为检测导向的潜在正则化，而非显式图像增强。它通过训练阶段的恢复分支对共享多尺度表示施加辅助重建约束，推理路径保持纯检测驱动；还设计了显著性引导的目标保留令牌路由机制和检测优先的两阶段优化策略。在分辨率退化的 NWPU VHR-10-Split、DOTAv1.5-Split 和 HRSSD-Split 数据集上，该方法优于现有技术。
Motivation: 现有的超分辨率辅助检测器遵循“恢复优先”范式，先增强输入再检测，但超分辨率偏向密集纹理恢复，可能放大视觉上合理但语义无关的背景纹理，不利于依赖稀疏实例级语义的目标检测。
Method: 提出协作潜在恢复辅助小目标检测框架（CoLR-Det），包含三个关键设计：（1）训练专用的恢复分支，对共享多尺度表示施加辅助重建约束，推理时不使用；（2）显著性引导的目标保留令牌路由，优先处理高显著性令牌；（3）检测优先的两阶段优化策略，先建立稳定的目标级语义，再引入恢复监督，并对超分辨率解码器采用较小学习率以减少扰动。
Result: 在 NWPU VHR-10-Split、DOTAv1.5-Split 和 HRSSD-Split 三个分辨率退化遥感数据集上，CoLR-Det 超越现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 将超分辨率恢复从显式视觉增强转换为隐式语义正则化，可有效改善低分辨率遥感图像中小目标检测的性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CytoCLIP: Learning Cytoarchitectural Characteristics in Developing Human Brain Using Contrastive Language Image Pre-Training
papers.abstract_en: The functions of different regions of the human brain are closely linked to their distinct cytoarchitecture, which is defined by the spatial arrangement and morphology of the cells. Identifying brain regions by their cytoarchitecture enables various scientific analyses of the brain. However, delineating these areas manually in brain histological sections is time-consuming and requires specialized knowledge. An automated approach is necessary to minimize the effort needed from human experts. To address this, we propose CytoCLIP, a suite of vision-language models derived from pre-trained Contrastive Language-Image Pre-Training (CLIP) frameworks to learn joint visual-text representations of brain cytoarchitecture. CytoCLIP comprises two model variants: one is trained using low-resolution whole-region images to understand the overall cytoarchitectural pattern of an area, and the other is trained on high-resolution image tiles for detailed cellular-level representation. The training dataset is created from NISSL-stained histological sections of developing fetal brains of different gestational weeks. It includes 86 distinct regions for low-resolution images and 379 brain regions for high-resolution tiles. We evaluate the model's understanding of the cytoarchitecture and generalization ability using region classification and cross-modal retrieval tasks. Multiple experiments are performed under various data setups, including data from samples of different ages and sectioning planes. Experimental results demonstrate that CytoCLIP outperforms existing methods. It achieves a weighted F1 score of 0.87 for whole-region classification and 0.91 for high-resolution image tile classification.
papers.journal_ref: Neuroinformatics, Volume 24, article number 38 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CytoCLIP，一个基于对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）的视觉-语言模型套件，用于学习人脑细胞结构（cytoarchitecture）的联合表征。模型在发育中胎儿大脑的NISSL染色组织切片上训练，包含低分辨率全区域和高分辨率图像块两种变体。在区域分类任务中，CytoCLIP在低分辨率和高分辨率图像上分别取得了0.87和0.91的加权F1分数，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 手动描绘脑组织切片中的细胞结构区域耗时且需要专业知识，亟需自动化方法以减少专家工作量。
Method: 利用预训练CLIP框架进行对比学习，构建两种模型变体：低分辨率全区域图像和高分辨率图像块，分别捕捉整体细胞结构模式和细节细胞级表征。训练数据来自不同孕周发育中胎儿大脑的NISSL染色切片，涵盖86个低分辨率区域和379个高分辨率脑区。
Result: 在区域分类和跨模态检索任务中，CytoCLIP优于现有方法，低分辨率全区域分类加权F1为0.87，高分辨率图像块分类加权F1为0.91。
Conclusion: CytoCLIP能够有效学习脑细胞结构的视觉-语言表征，自动化识别脑区，减少人工标注负担。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Segment Liquids in Real-world Images
papers.abstract_en: Liquids like water, wine and medicine are everywhere. However, limited attention has been given to the task of segmenting liquids, hindering the ability of robots to safely avoid and interact with them. The segmentation of liquids is difficult because liquids come in diverse appearances and shapes; moreover, they can be both transparent or reflective, taking on arbitrary objects and scenes from their background and surroundings. To take on this challenge, we construct a liquid dataset, LQDS, consisting of 5000 real-world images annotated into 14 distinct classes, and design a novel liquid detection model, LQDM, which leverages cross-attention between a dedicated boundary branch and the main segmentation branch to enhance mask predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of LQDM on the testing set of LQDS, outperforming state-of-the-art methods to establish a strong baseline for the semantic segmentation of liquids. We believe that LQDS and LQDM will facilitate future research in liquid segmentation and enable practical applications in robotics. Our dataset and code is released at https://lonaslee.github.io/LQDM/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对液体分割任务缺乏数据集和模型的问题，构建了包含5000张真实世界图像、14个类别的LQDS数据集，并提出LQDM模型，通过边界分支与主分割分支的交叉注意力提升掩膜预测准确性。实验表明LQDM在LQDS测试集上优于现有方法，为液体语义分割建立了强基线。
Motivation: 液体（如水、酒、药液）在日常生活中常见，但机器人因缺乏分割能力难以安全避让或交互；现有工作对液体分割关注不足，且液体外观多样、可透明或反光，分割极具挑战。
Method: 构建LQDS数据集（5000张真实图像，14类液体），设计LQDM模型，利用专用边界分支与主分割分支之间的交叉注意力机制增强掩膜预测。
Result: 在LQDS测试集上，LQDM超越现有最先进方法，为液体语义分割建立强基线。
Conclusion: LQDS和LQDM将促进液体分割的未来研究，并推动机器人在实际场景中的应用；数据集和代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EraseLoRA: MLLM-Driven Foreground Exclusion and Background Subtype Aggregation for Dataset-Free Object Removal
papers.abstract_en: Object removal must prevent the masked target from reappearing and reconstruct the occluded background with structural and contextual fidelity, rather than merely filling a hole plausibly. Recent dataset-free approaches manipulate the diffusion model's internal self-attention to prevent it from referencing the masked region, yet they fail in two critical ways: (i) they treat the masked region as the sole foreground, misinterpreting non-target objects as background and regenerating them, and (ii) they apply uniform attention constraints without distinguishing diverse background subtypes, leading to textural blurring and structural misalignment. Both failures stem from the absence of explicit background-aware reasoning. We propose EraseLoRA, a dataset-free framework that replaces attention surgery with background-aware reasoning and test-time adaptation. The first stage, Background-aware Foreground Exclusion (BFE), leverages a multimodal large-language model to separate target foreground, non-target foregrounds, and clean background from a single image-mask pair. The second stage, Background-aware Reconstruction with Subtype Aggregation (BRSA), performs test-time optimization that treats inferred background subtypes as complementary pieces, enforcing their consistent integration through reconstruction and alignment objectives without explicit attention intervention. As a model-agnostic plug-in applicable to diverse diffusion backbones, EraseLoRA reconstructs backgrounds at least 23% more faithful to the original scene than previous dataset-free methods while nearly halving unwanted foreground re-generation, and surpasses all dataset-driven approaches in both aspects despite requiring no training data. Code is available at https://shjo-april.github.io/EraseLoRA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出EraseLoRA，一种无数据集的物体移除框架，通过背景感知推理和测试时自适应替代注意力手术。第一阶段利用多模态大语言模型分离目标前景、非目标前景和干净背景；第二阶段通过推理背景子类型并强制一致性整合来重建背景，无需显式注意力干预。在多个指标上优于现有无数据集方法和有数据集方法。
Motivation: 现有无数据集物体移除方法将遮罩区域视为唯一前景，误将非目标对象当作背景并重新生成，同时均匀施加注意力约束导致背景纹理模糊和结构错位，缺乏显式的背景感知推理。
Method: 提出EraseLoRA，包含两阶段：背景感知前景排除（BFE）利用多模态大语言模型从单张图像-遮罩对中分离目标前景、非目标前景和干净背景；背景感知子类型聚合重建（BRSA）在测试时优化，将推断的背景子类型视为互补部分，通过重建和对齐目标强制其一致整合，无需显式注意力干预。
Result: 相比于之前无数据集方法，背景保真度至少提升23%，不需要的前景再生几乎减半；在两项指标上均超过所有基于数据集的方法，且无需训练数据。
Conclusion: EraseLoRA作为模型无关的插件，可应用于多种扩散主干，证明了背景感知推理和测试时自适应在物体移除中的有效性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 提出EraseLoRA，一种无数据集的物体移除框架，通过背景感知推理和测试时自适应替代注意力手术。第一阶段利用多模态大语言模型分离目标前景、非目标前景和干净背景；第二阶段通过推理背景子类型并强制一致性整合来重建背景，无需显式注意力干预。在多个指标上优于现有无数据集方法和有数据集方法。

summary_sections.method: 提出EraseLoRA，包含两阶段：背景感知前景排除（BFE）利用多模态大语言模型从单张图像-遮罩对中分离目标前景、非目标前景和干净背景；背景感知子类型聚合重建（BRSA）在测试时优化，将推断的背景子类型视为互补部分，通过重建和对齐目标强制其一致整合，无需显式注意力干预。
summary_sections.result: 相比于之前无数据集方法，背景保真度至少提升23%，不需要的前景再生几乎减半；在两项指标上均超过所有基于数据集的方法，且无需训练数据。
summary_sections.conclusion: EraseLoRA作为模型无关的插件，可应用于多种扩散主干，证明了背景感知推理和测试时自适应在物体移除中的有效性。

papers.title: Text-Conditioned Background Generation for Editable Multi-Layer Documents
papers.abstract_en: We present a framework for document-centric background generation with multi-page editing and thematic continuity. To ensure text regions remain readable, we employ a latent masking formulation that softly attenuates updates in the diffusion space, inspired by smooth barrier functions in physics and numerical optimization. In addition, we introduce Automated Readability Optimization (ARO), which automatically places semi-transparent, rounded backing shapes behind text regions. ARO determines the minimal opacity needed to satisfy perceptual contrast standards (WCAG 2.2) relative to the underlying background, ensuring readability while maintaining aesthetic harmony without human intervention. Multi-page consistency is maintained through a summarization-and-instruction process, where each page is distilled into a compact representation that recursively guides subsequent generations. This design reflects how humans build continuity by retaining prior context, ensuring that visual motifs evolve coherently across an entire document. Our method further treats a document as a structured composition in which text, figures, and backgrounds are preserved or regenerated as separate layers, allowing targeted background editing without compromising readability. Finally, user-provided prompts allow stylistic adjustments in color and texture, balancing automated consistency with flexible customization. Our training-free framework produces visually coherent, text-preserving, and thematically aligned documents, bridging generative modeling with natural design workflows.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向文档的背景生成框架，支持多页编辑和主题连贯性。通过潜在掩码公式（受物理和数值优化中平滑障碍函数启发）柔和地减弱扩散空间中的更新来确保文本区域可读性。引入自动化可读性优化（ARO），自动在文本区域后放置半透明圆角背景形状，根据 WCAG 2.2 感知对比度标准确定最小不透明度，无需人工干预。多页一致性通过摘要-指令流程维持，每页被浓缩为紧凑表示，递归指导后续生成。该方法将文档视为结构化组合，文本、图形和背景作为独立层保留或重新生成，允许有针对性的背景编辑而不影响可读性。用户提示可实现颜色和纹理的风格调整，平衡自动一致性与灵活定制。该无训练框架生成视觉连贯、保留文本且主题一致的文档。
Motivation: 现有文档背景生成方法难以同时保证文本可读性、多页主题一致性和编辑灵活性。
Method: 提出无训练框架，包含潜在掩码（平滑障碍函数）、自动化可读性优化（ARO，基于 WCAG 2.2）、多页一致性（摘要-指令递归）和分层编辑。
Result: 框架生成视觉连贯、文本可读且主题一致的文档，支持多页编辑和风格定制。
Conclusion: 该方法桥接生成模型与自然设计工作流，实现可编辑的多层文档背景生成。

papers.title: AI4EOSC: a Federated Cloud Platform for Artificial Intelligence in Scientific Research
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in scientific research has highlighted a gap between industry-standard MLOps tools and platforms, and the unique requirements of modern and Open Science, particularly regarding the FAIR (Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable) principles. This paper presents AI4EOSC, a federated, open-source platform designed to operationalize the full AI/ML lifecycle within the European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) ecosystem. Our methodology tackles the fragmentation of distributed research infrastructures by integrating a modular and distributed architecture comprising an AI development platform, a serverless AI-as-a-Service layer, and a federated orchestration model that is able to integrate heterogeneous compute and storage resources from distributed e-Infrastructures. AI4EOSC also introduces a ``FAIR-by-design'' approach that enforces metadata standardization (via MLDCAT-AP) and W3C PROV-compliant provenance tracking through a platform-integrated CI/CD pipeline. AI4EOSC added value is demonstrated through the delivery of a diverse set of community installations, showing consistent and seamless deployment across heterogeneous cloud providers. These installations are validated by a set of scientific cases, showing how our work reduces the manual burden on researchers while ensuring high levels of reproducibility and interoperability and providing an unified environment for development, training, and production of AI/ML models in the EOSC.
papers.journal_ref: Future Generation Computer Systems (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AI4EOSC 是一个面向欧洲开放科学云 (EOSC) 的联邦开源平台，旨在支持 AI/ML 的完整生命周期。该平台通过模块化架构、无服务器 AI 服务层和联邦编排模型，集成异构计算与存储资源，并采用“FAIR-by-design”方法强制元数据标准化和溯源追踪。平台已在多个社区部署，验证了其在可重复性和互操作性方面的优势。
Motivation: 现有工业级 MLOps 工具和平台未能满足现代开放科学（尤其是 FAIR 原则）对 AI/ML 工作流的特殊需求，且分布式研究基础设施碎片化。
Method: 提出一个包含 AI 开发平台、无服务器 AI-as-a-Service 层和联邦编排模型的模块化分布式架构，通过 MLDCAT-AP 元数据标准和 W3C PROV 溯源追踪实现 FAIR 合规，并集成 CI/CD 流水线。
Result: 在多个社区安装中实现跨异构云提供商的一致无缝部署，并通过科学案例验证，表明该方法减少了研究人员的手动负担，同时确保了高可重复性和互操作性。

papers.title: Agentic AI for ISAC: Analysis, Framework, and Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) has emerged as a key development direction in the sixth-generation (6G) era, which provides essential support for the collaborative sensing and communication of future intelligent networks. However, as wireless environments become increasingly dynamic and complex, ISAC systems require more intelligent processing and more autonomous operation to maintain efficiency and adaptability. Meanwhile, agentic artificial intelligence (AI) offers a feasible solution to address these challenges by enabling continuous perception-reasoning-action loops in dynamic environments to support intelligent, autonomous, and efficient operation for ISAC systems. As such, we delve into the application value and prospects of agentic AI in ISAC systems in this work. Firstly, we provide a comprehensive review of agentic AI and ISAC systems to demonstrate their key characteristics. Secondly, we show several common optimization approaches for ISAC systems and highlight the significant advantages of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI)-based agentic AI. Thirdly, we propose a novel agentic ISAC framework and prensent a case study to verify its superiority in optimizing ISAC performance. Finally, we clarify future research directions for agentic AI-based ISAC systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了智能体人工智能（Agentic AI）在集成感知与通信（ISAC）系统中的应用。文章回顾了Agentic AI和ISAC的关键特征，比较了几种常见的ISAC优化方法，并提出了一个基于生成式人工智能（GenAI）的Agentic ISAC框架。通过案例研究验证了该框架在优化ISAC性能方面的优越性，最后指出了未来研究方向。
Motivation: 随着无线环境日益动态和复杂，ISAC系统需要更智能、更自主的处理能力以维持效率和适应性。Agentic AI通过持续的感知-推理-行动循环为这一挑战提供了可行解决方案。
Method: 提出一个基于GenAI的Agentic ISAC框架，该框架利用生成式人工智能的优势来优化ISAC系统性能，并通过案例研究进行验证。
Result: 案例研究结果表明，所提出的Agentic ISAC框架在优化ISAC性能方面具有优越性。
Conclusion: 文章最后明确了基于Agentic AI的ISAC系统的未来研究方向。

papers.title: Towards Spatial Trace with Reasoning in Vision-Language Models for Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Spatial tracing, as a fundamental embodied interaction ability for robots, is inherently challenging as it requires multi-step metric-grounded reasoning compounded with complex spatial referring and real-world metric measurement. However, existing methods struggle with this compositional task. To this end, we propose RoboTracer, a 3D-aware VLM that first achieves both 3D spatial referring and measuring via a universal spatial encoder and a regression-supervised decoder to enhance scale awareness during supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Moreover, RoboTracer advances multi-step metric-grounded reasoning via reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) with metric-sensitive process rewards, supervising key intermediate perceptual cues to accurately generate spatial traces. To support SFT and RFT training, we introduce TraceSpatial, a large-scale dataset of 30M QA pairs, spanning outdoor/indoor/tabletop scenes and supporting complex reasoning processes (up to 9 steps). We further present TraceSpatial-Bench, a challenging benchmark filling the gap to evaluate spatial tracing. Experimental results show that RoboTracer surpasses baselines in spatial understanding, measuring, and referring, with an average success rate of 79.1%, and also achieves SOTA performance on TraceSpatial-Bench by a large margin, exceeding Gemini-2.5-Pro by 36% accuracy. Notably, RoboTracer can be integrated with various control policies to execute long-horizon, dynamic tasks across diverse robots (UR5, G1 humanoid) in cluttered real-world scenes. Please see the project page at https://zhoues.github.io/RoboTracer.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoboTracer，一种 3D 感知的视觉语言模型，用于机器人空间跟踪任务。通过通用空间编码器和回归监督解码器增强监督微调（SFT）中的尺度感知，并通过基于度量敏感过程奖励的强化微调（RFT）监督关键中间感知线索，以精确生成空间轨迹。构建了包含 3000 万 QA 对的大规模数据集 TraceSpatial 和基准 TraceSpatial-Bench。实验表明 RoboTracer 在空间理解、测量和指代方面平均成功率达 79.1%，在 TraceSpatial-Bench 上准确率超过 Gemini-2.5-Pro 36%，并可与多种控制策略集成，在真实场景中执行长时域动态任务。
Motivation: 机器人需要多步度量基础推理的空间跟踪能力，现有方法难以处理这类组合任务。
Method: 提出 RoboTracer，通过通用空间编码器和回归监督解码器增强 SFT 中的尺度感知，并通过基于度量敏感过程奖励的 RFT 监督关键中间感知线索，以生成空间轨迹。同时构建大规模数据集 TraceSpatial 和基准 TraceSpatial-Bench 以支持训练和评估。
Result: RoboTracer 在空间理解、测量和指代方面平均成功率达 79.1%，在 TraceSpatial-Bench 上准确率超过 Gemini-2.5-Pro 36%，并可在 UR5、G1 人形机器人等平台上执行长时域动态任务。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 RoboTracer 通过 3D 感知 VLM 结合 SFT 和 RFT 有效实现了机器人空间跟踪，并在真实场景中展现出通用性和有效性。

papers.title: xGR: Efficient Generative Recommendation Serving at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Recommendation system delivers substantial economic benefits by providing personalized predictions. Generative recommendation (GR) integrates LLMs to enhance the understanding of long user-item sequences. Despite employing attention-based architectures, GR's workload differs markedly from that of LLM serving. GR typically processes long prompt while producing short, fixed-length outputs, yet the computational cost of each decode phase is especially high due to the large beam width. Furthermore, since the beam search involves a vast item space, the sorting overhead becomes particularly time-consuming. We propose xGR, a GR-oriented serving system that meets strict low-latency requirements under high-concurrency scenarios. First, xGR unifies the processing of prefill and decode phases through staged computation and separated KV cache. Second, xGR enables early sorting termination and mask-based item filtering with data structure reuse. Third, xGR reconstructs the overall pipeline to exploit multi-level overlap and multi-stream parallelism. The experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that xGR achieves at least 2.89x throughput compared to the state-of-the-art baseline under strict latency constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 xGR，一个面向生成式推荐（GR）的推理服务系统，针对 GR 工作负载与 LLM 服务不同的特点（长 prompt、短输出、大 beam width 导致解码计算和排序开销高）进行优化。xGR 通过分阶段计算和分离 KV 缓存统一 prefill 和 decode 阶段处理，采用提前排序终止和基于掩码的物品过滤及数据结构复用，并重构整体流水线以利用多级重叠和多流并行。实验表明，在严格延迟约束下，xGR 相比最先进基线实现至少 2.89 倍吞吐量提升。
Motivation: 生成式推荐（GR）虽然采用基于注意力的架构，但其工作负载与 LLM 服务显著不同：GR 处理长 prompt 但生成短固定长度输出，且由于 beam width 大，解码阶段计算成本高；同时，beam search 涉及巨大物品空间，排序开销耗时。现有系统未针对这些特性优化，难以满足高并发场景下的低延迟需求。
Method: 提出 xGR 系统，包含三个关键设计：1) 通过分阶段计算和分离 KV 缓存统一 prefill 和 decode 处理；2) 实现提前排序终止和基于掩码的物品过滤，并复用数据结构以降低排序开销；3) 重构整体推理流水线，利用多级重叠和多流并行提升吞吐量。
Result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，xGR 在严格延迟约束下相比最先进基线（未明确名称）至少实现 2.89 倍吞吐量提升。
Conclusion: 论文强调 xGR 针对 GR 工作负载特性设计的优化方法能有效提升推理吞吐量并满足低延迟要求，但未讨论泛化到其他领域或更大规模数据集的局限性。

summary_sections.motivation: 生成式推荐（GR）虽然采用基于注意力的架构，但其工作负载与 LLM 服务显著不同：GR 处理长 prompt 但生成短固定长度输出，且由于 beam width 大，解码阶段计算成本高；同时，beam search 涉及巨大物品空间，排序开销耗时。现有系统未针对这些特性优化，难以满足高并发场景下的低延迟需求。
summary_sections.method: 提出 xGR 系统，包含三个关键设计：1) 通过分阶段计算和分离 KV 缓存统一 prefill 和 decode 处理；2) 实现提前排序终止和基于掩码的物品过滤，并复用数据结构以降低排序开销；3) 重构整体推理流水线，利用多级重叠和多流并行提升吞吐量。
summary_sections.result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，xGR 在严格延迟约束下相比最先进基线（未明确名称）至少实现 2.89 倍吞吐量提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文强调 xGR 针对 GR 工作负载特性设计的优化方法能有效提升推理吞吐量并满足低延迟要求，但未讨论泛化到其他领域或更大规模数据集的局限性。

papers.title: When, How Long and How Much? Interpretable Neural Networks for Time Series Regression by Learning to Mask and Aggregate
papers.abstract_en: Time series extrinsic regression (TSER) refers to the task of predicting a continuous target variable from an input time series. It appears in many domains, including healthcare, finance, environmental monitoring, and engineering. In these settings, accurate predictions and trustworthy reasoning are both essential. Although state-of-the-art TSER models achieve strong predictive performance, they typically operate as black boxes, making it difficult to understand which temporal patterns drive their decisions. Post-hoc interpretability techniques, such as feature attribution, aim to to explain how the model arrives at its predictions, but often produce coarse, noisy, or unstable explanations. Recently, inherently interpretable approaches based on concepts, additive decompositions, or symbolic regression, have emerged as promising alternatives. However, these approaches remain limited: they require explicit supervision on the concepts themselves, often cannot capture interactions between time-series features, lack expressiveness for complex temporal patterns, and struggle to scale to high-dimensional multivariate data. To address these limitations, we propose MAGNETS (Mask-and-AGgregate NEtwork for Time Series), an inherently interpretable neural architecture for TSER. MAGNETS learns a compact set of human-understandable concepts without requiring any annotations. Each concept corresponds to a learned, mask-based aggregation over selected input features, explicitly revealing both which features drive predictions and when they matter in the sequence. Predictions are formed as combinations of these learned concepts through a transparent, additive structure, enabling clear insight into the model's decision process. The code implementation and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/FlorentF9/MAGNETS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAGNETS，一种用于时间序列外在回归（TSER）的可解释神经网络架构。它通过学习一组无需标注的、基于掩码聚合的隐式概念，显式揭示哪些特征何时驱动预测，并通过可加的线性组合生成预测，提供透明决策过程。在多个基准上展示了与黑箱模型相当的预测性能，同时提供更清晰的解释。
Motivation: 现有TSER模型预测性能强但缺乏可解释性，事后解释方法常产生粗糙或不稳定的结果。内在可解释方法受限于需要概念标注、无法捕捉特征交互、难以扩展至高维数据。
Method: MAGNETS 学习一组紧凑的、人类可理解的概念，每个概念通过可学习的掩码对选定输入特征进行聚合，形成时间上的关注区域。预测通过概念的线性组合（带可学习权重）生成，结构透明。
Result: 在多个TSER基准数据集上，MAGNETS 达到与黑箱模型相当的预测准确性，同时提供了关于特征重要性和时间重要性的清晰解释。
Conclusion: MAGNETS 在不需要概念标注的情况下实现了内在可解释性，适用于需要高预测精度和可信推理的TSER任务，尤其适合高维多元时间序列数据。

papers.title: A Comparative Study of Student Perspectives on Technical Writing Feedback Quality: Evaluating LLMs, SLMs, and Humans in Computer Science Topics
papers.abstract_en: To address the scalability of feedback in computer science while mitigating the privacy and cost limitations of commercial Large Language Models (LLMs), this study evaluates a locally hosted Small Language Model (SLM). We deployed a quantized Llama-3.1, GPT-4, and human instructors across introductory programming (N=176), operating systems (N=80), and a writing seminar (N=7). Mixed-methods analysis of student perceptions reveals that while the local SLM matched commercial LLMs and was rated higher by students for readability and actionability in technical courses, human feedback remained more favoured for highly specialized writing tasks. We demonstrate that local SLMs offer a privacy-preserving, zero-marginal-cost alternative for foundational feedback, supporting a tiered pedagogical framework where AI handles structural guidance while instructors focus on high-level conceptual scaffolding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了学生对于本地部署的小语言模型（SLM）、商用大语言模型（LLM）和人类教师提供的技术写作反馈质量的看法。在计算机科学课程（编程导论、操作系统）和写作研讨班中，量化后的Llama-3.1在可读性和可操作性方面获得学生较高评价，但人类反馈在高度专业化的写作任务中仍更受青睐。研究表明本地SLM可以作为保护隐私、零边际成本的替代方案，支持分层次教学框架。
Motivation: 为了解决计算机科学中反馈的可扩展性问题，同时减轻商业LLM的隐私和成本限制，本研究评估了本地托管的SLM在技术写作反馈中的效果。
Method: 在编程导论（N=176）、操作系统（N=80）和写作研讨班（N=7）中，部署量化版Llama-3.1、GPT-4和人类教师，通过混合方法分析学生感知。
Result: 本地SLM在技术课程中可读性和可操作性评分高于商业LLM，但人类反馈在高度专业化写作任务中仍更受欢迎。
Conclusion: 本地SLM提供了一种保护隐私、零边际成本的反馈方案，支持AI处理结构性指导、教师专注于高层次概念构建的分层教学框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LaGen: Towards Autoregressive LiDAR Scene Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generative world models for autonomous driving (AD) are of great value in applications such as data augmentation, closed-loop simulation, and safety-critical scenario evaluation. Unlike the widely studied image modality, in this work we explore generative world models for LiDAR data. Existing generation methods for LiDAR predominantly focus on single frame generation or lack the capacity for interactive simulation, while existing prediction approaches require multiple frames of historical input and can only deterministically predict multiple frames at once. Both paradigms fail to support long-horizon interactive generation. To this end, we introduce \textbf{LaGen}, which, to the best of our knowledge is the first autoregressive framework capable of generating long-horizon LiDAR scenes in a frame-by-frame, interactive manner. LaGen is able to take a single-frame input as a starting point and effectively utilize bounding box information as conditions to generate high-fidelity 4D scene. In addition, we introduce a scene decoupling estimation module to enhance the model's interactive generation capability for object-level content, as well as a noise modulation module to mitigate error accumulation during long-horizon generation. We extensively evaluate LaGen's performance in controlled data generation and long-horizon scene generation on the nuScenes dataset. The experimental results demonstrate that LaGen achieves state-of-the-art performance, especially on later frames. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/szzhou88/LaGen.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LaGen，首个自回归框架，能够以帧序方式进行长时程、交互式的LiDAR场景生成。LaGen以单帧输入为起点，利用边界框信息作为条件生成高保真4D场景，并引入场景解耦估计模块和噪声调制模块以提升交互生成能力和缓解误差累积。在nuScenes数据集上的实验表明，LaGen在长期场景生成任务上达到当前最优性能。
Motivation: 现有LiDAR生成方法主要聚焦于单帧生成或缺乏交互模拟能力，而预测方法需要多帧历史输入且只能一次性确定性预测多帧，均无法支持长时程交互式生成。
Method: 提出自回归框架LaGen，包含场景解耦估计模块以增强对象级内容的交互生成能力，以及噪声调制模块以缓解长时程生成中的误差累积。
Result: 在nuScenes数据集上，LaGen在控制数据生成和长时程场景生成任务中取得最优性能，尤其是在后期帧上的表现突出。
Conclusion: LaGen首次实现了LiDAR场景的长时程交互式自回归生成，为自动驾驶中的生成式世界模型提供了新范式。

papers.title: DAPS++: Rethinking Diffusion Inverse Problems with Decoupled Posterior Annealing
papers.abstract_en: From a Bayesian perspective, score-based diffusion solves inverse problems through joint inference, embedding the likelihood with the prior to guide the sampling process. However, this formulation fails to explain its practical behavior: the prior offers limited guidance, while reconstruction is largely driven by the measurement-consistency term, leading to an inference process that is effectively decoupled from the diffusion dynamics. We show that the diffusion prior in these solvers functions primarily as a warm initializer that places estimates near the data manifold, while reconstruction is driven almost entirely by measurement consistency. Based on this observation, we introduce \textbf{DAPS++}, which fully decouples diffusion-based initialization from likelihood-driven refinement, allowing the likelihood term to guide inference more directly while maintaining numerical stability and providing insight into why unified diffusion trajectories remain effective in practice. By requiring fewer function evaluations (NFEs) and measurement-optimization steps, \textbf{DAPS++} achieves high computational efficiency and robust reconstruction performance across diverse image restoration tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从贝叶斯视角重新审视基于分数的扩散逆问题求解器，发现先验主要起初始化作用，重建几乎完全由测量一致性驱动。提出DAPS++，将扩散初始化与似然驱动精化完全解耦，从而在减少函数评估次数的同时保持数值稳定性和重建性能。实验在多个图像恢复任务上验证了该方法的计算效率和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有扩散逆问题求解器的实际行为与理论贝叶斯公式不符：先验贡献有限，重建主要依赖测量一致性项，导致推理过程与扩散动态有效解耦。需要更高效且稳定的解耦方法。
Method: 提出DAPS++，将扩散模型仅用作初始化器以将估计置于数据流形附近，随后独立执行似然驱动的精化步骤，实现完全解耦。
Result: 在多种图像恢复任务上，DAPS++通过更少的函数评估（NFEs）和测量优化步骤，实现了高计算效率和鲁棒的重建性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，解耦扩散初始化与似然精化的方法有效，并解释了统一扩散轨迹在实践中保持有效的原因。

papers.title: SWITCH: Benchmarking Modeling and Handling of Tangible Interfaces in Long-horizon Embodied Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Tangible control interfaces (TCIs), such as appliance panels, remotes, elevators, and embedded GUIs, are a fundamental component of everyday human-built environments. Interacting with these interfaces requires agents not only to ground language in visual observations,but also to execute actions, track temporally evolving state changes, and verify whether intended outcomes have been achieved. However, existing benchmarks predominantly evaluate open-loop perception or single-step action execution, failing to capture this continuous cycle of interaction, feedback, and correction. We introduce SWITCH, a benchmark for closed-loop interactive reasoning with TCIs in realistic egocentric environments1. SWITCH comprises 1,170 temporally interactive videos across diverse functional categories, providing structured annotations of instructions, actions, state transitions, outcomes, and recovery behaviors over time. To probe generative world modeling, SWITCH also evaluates video generation models on interaction-centered tasks using both LLM-as-judge and human evaluation2.Experiments with frontier proprietary and opensource multimodal models reveal persistent weaknesses in fine-grained visual-temporal perception, outcome verification, and error recovery, highlighting SWITCH as a testbed for closed-loop embodied intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SWITCH是一个针对真实环境中实体控制界面（如家电面板、遥控器、电梯等）的闭环交互推理基准，包含1170个时间交互视频，涵盖多种功能类别，提供指令、动作、状态转换、结果和恢复行为的结构化标注。实验表明现有顶级多模态模型在细粒度视觉-时间感知、结果验证和错误恢复方面存在持续弱点。
Motivation: 现有基准主要评估开环感知或单步动作执行，无法捕捉交互、反馈和修正的连续循环。
Method: 构建了SWITCH基准，包含1170个第一人称视角的交互视频，标注了指令、动作、状态转换、结果和恢复行为；同时利用LLM作为裁判和人类评估来评价视频生成模型。
Result: 实验发现前沿专有和开源多模态模型在细粒度视觉-时间感知、结果验证和错误恢复方面表现持续薄弱。
Conclusion: SWITCH可作为具身智能闭环交互推理的测试平台，揭示当前模型在闭环场景中的核心缺陷。

papers.title: DCC: Data-Centric Compilation of Machine Learning Kernels for Processing-In-Memory Architectures
papers.abstract_en: High-performance Host processors can integrate Processing-In-Memory (PIM) devices, which can accelerate memory-intensive kernels of Machine Learning (ML) models, including Large Language Models (LLMs), by leveraging the large memory bandwidth available at PIM cores. However, Host processor needs consecutive elements distributed across DRAM banks, while PIM cores need consecutive elements within their local banks. This necessitates data rearrangements in ML kernel execution that pose significant performance and programmability challenges, further exacerbated by the need to support diverse PIM devices. Current compilation approaches lack systematic optimization for diverse ML kernels and multiple PIM devices, and may largely ignore data rearrangement costs during the compute code optimization step. We show that data rearrangements and compute code optimization are interdependent, and need to be jointly optimized during the tuning process. Therefore, we design DCC, the first data-centric ML compiler for PIM systems that jointly co-optimizes data rearrangements and compute code in a unified tuning process. DCC integrates a multi-layer PIM abstraction to support multiple PIM backends. DCC enables effective co-optimization of data partitioning strategies with compute loop partitioning schemes. DCC applies PIM-specific code optimizations, and leverages a fast and accurate performance prediction model to select the bestperforming code schedule for a given kernel on a target PIM architecture. Our evaluations in various individual ML kernels show that DCC achieves up to 7.68x speedup (2.21x average) on HBM-PIM, and up to 13.17x speedup (3.92x average) on AttAcc PIM, over GPU-only execution. In end-to-end LLM inference, DCC on AttAcc accelerates GPT-3 and LLaMA-2 by 4.52x average (up to 7.71x in LLaMA-2) over GPU. DCC is open-sourced at https://github.com/SPIN-Research-Group/DCC.

papers.title: Concentration bounds on response-based vector embeddings of black-box generative models
papers.abstract_en: Generative models, such as large language models or text-to-image diffusion models, can generate relevant responses to user-given queries. Response-based vector embeddings of generative models facilitate statistical analysis and inference on a given collection of black-box generative models. The Data Kernel Perspective Space embedding is one particular method of obtaining response-based vector embeddings for a given set of generative models, already discussed in the literature. In this paper, under appropriate regularity conditions, we establish high probability concentration bounds on the sample vector embeddings for a given set of generative models, obtained through the method of Data Kernel Perspective Space embedding. Our results tell us the required number of sample responses needed in order to approximate the population-level vector embeddings with a desired level of accuracy. The algebraic tools used to establish our results can be used further for establishing concentration bounds on Classical Multidimensional Scaling embeddings in general, when the dissimilarities are observed with noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对黑盒生成模型的响应向量嵌入，通过Data Kernel Perspective Space方法，在正则条件下建立了样本向量嵌入的高概率浓度界，给出了达到期望精度所需样本数。代数工具可推广至带噪声的经典MDS嵌入。
Motivation: 对一组黑盒生成模型进行统计分析需要可靠的向量嵌入，但现有方法缺乏样本复杂度保证。
Method: 采用Data Kernel Perspective Space嵌入，在正则条件下推导了样本嵌入的浓度不等式。
Result: 得到了概率界限，表明样本大小如何影响向量嵌入的近似精度。
Conclusion: 所提出的代数工具也可用于带噪声相异性的经典MDS嵌入的浓度界建立。

papers.title: SWE-fficiency: Can Language Models Optimize Real-World Repositories on Real Workloads?
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing the performance of large-scale software repositories demands expertise in code reasoning and software engineering (SWE) to reduce runtime while preserving program correctness. However, most benchmarks emphasize what to fix rather than how to fix code. We introduce SWE-fficiency, a benchmark for evaluating repository-level performance optimization on real workloads. Our suite contains 498 tasks across nine widely used data-science, machine-learning, and HPC repositories (e.g., numpy, pandas, scipy): given a complete codebase and a slow workload, an agent must investigate code semantics, localize bottlenecks and relevant tests, and produce a patch that matches or exceeds expert speedup while passing the same unit tests. To enable this how-to-fix evaluation, our automated pipeline scrapes GitHub pull requests for performance-improving edits, combining keyword filtering, static analysis, coverage tooling, and execution validation to both confirm expert speedup baselines and identify relevant repository unit tests. Empirical evaluation of state-of-the-art agents reveals significant underperformance. On average, agents achieve less than 0.23x the expert speedup: agents struggle in localizing optimization opportunities, reasoning about execution across functions, and maintaining correctness in proposed edits. We release the benchmark and accompanying data pipeline to facilitate research on automated performance engineering and long-horizon software reasoning.
papers.comment: Appearing at ICML 2026. Data, code, and leaderboard are available at https://swefficiency.com/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SWE-fficiency 基准，用于评估大语言模型在真实仓库上的性能优化能力。该基准包含 498 个任务，涵盖 numpy、pandas、scipy 等九个常见数据科学和机器学习仓库，要求模型定位瓶颈并生成加速补丁。实验发现当前最优智能体的平均加速仅达到专家加速的 0.23 倍，在定位优化机会、跨函数推理和保持正确性方面存在显著不足。
Motivation: 现有性能优化基准多关注修复什么（what to fix）而非如何修复（how to fix），缺乏对仓库级代码性能优化能力的系统评估。
Method: 通过自动流水线从 GitHub PR 中提取性能改进编辑，结合关键词过滤、静态分析、覆盖工具和执行验证，确认专家加速基线并识别相关单元测试，构建包含 498 个任务的 SWE-fficiency 基准。
Result: 评估显示，现有智能体平均加速不足专家的 0.23 倍，在定位优化机会、跨函数推理和提案编辑的正确性方面表现不佳。
Conclusion: 发布基准和数据流水线，旨在推动自动化性能工程和长时软件推理的研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Fine-Tuning Erase Your Edits? On the Fragile Coexistence of Knowledge Editing and Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge editing (KE) offers a lightweight alternative to retraining for updating large language models (LLMs). Meanwhile, fine-tuning remains the default operation for adapting LLMs to new domains and tasks. Despite their widespread adoption, these two post-training interventions have been studied in isolation, leaving open a crucial question: if we fine-tune an edited model, do the edits survive? This question is motivated by practical objectives: removing covert or malicious edits, and preserving beneficial edits. If fine-tuning impairs edits (Fig.1), current KE methods become less efficient, as a newly fine-tuned model requires re-editing; if edits persist, fine-tuned models risk propagating hidden malicious edits, raising serious safety concerns. To this end, we systematically quantify edit decay after fine-tuning across 254 experimental configurations. Our results show that in general, edits decay substantially after subsequent fine-tuning. AlphaEdit exhibits the greatest decay on the zsRE benchmark when applied to GPT-J, where 25.27% of previously successful edits become unsuccessful after fine-tuning. We further find that fine-tuning only the edited layers is sufficient to effectively remove edits, while incurring only modest degradation in downstream performance. Surprisingly, fine-tuning non-edited layers leads to greater edit decay than all-layer fine-tuning. Besides, our activation space analysis reveals that fine-tuning produces a larger and more coherent representational shift, both in magnitude and direction, than KE. Overall, our study underscores the necessity of evaluating KE within the broader LLM application pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了知识编辑（KE）与大语言模型（LLM）微调之间的相互作用，发现微调会显著削弱之前成功应用的编辑效果。通过254种实验配置，作者量化了编辑衰减程度，并发现仅微调编辑层即可有效移除编辑，而微调非编辑层反而导致更大衰减。激活空间分析表明，微调产生的表示变化在幅度和方向上均大于知识编辑。
Motivation: 知识编辑和微调是LLM的两种常见后训练操作，但此前研究将它们孤立对待。实际应用中，编辑后的模型可能被微调，编辑是否存活这一关键问题尚不明确：若微调破坏编辑，则需重复编辑，效率降低；若编辑持续存在，则可能传播隐藏恶意编辑，产生安全风险。
Method: 作者设计了254种实验配置，涵盖不同模型、编辑方法和微调策略，系统量化了编辑在后续微调后的衰减程度。通过控制微调层（仅编辑层、仅非编辑层、全层）和编辑方法（如AlphaEdit），并辅以激活空间分析（比较表示变化的大小和方向），揭示编辑衰减的机制。
Result: 在zsRE基准上使用GPT-J时，AlphaEdit编辑有25.27%在后续微调后失效。仅微调编辑层足以有效移除编辑，且下游性能下降较小；微调非编辑层反而比全层微调导致更大的编辑衰减。
Conclusion: 研究表明，知识编辑在微调后普遍显著衰减，这揭示了当前KE方法在实际LLM应用流水线中的脆弱性，强调了在更广泛的LLM部署场景中评估KE的必要性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Automatic Extraction of Road Networks by using Teacher-Student Adaptive Structural Deep Belief Network and Its Application to Landslide Disaster
papers.abstract_en: An adaptive structural learning method of Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) and Deep Belief Network (DBN) has been developed as one of prominent deep learning models. The neuron generation-annihilation algorithm in RBM and layer generation algorithm in DBN make an optimal network structure for given input during the learning. In this paper, our model is applied to an automatic recognition method of road network system, called RoadTracer. RoadTracer can generate a road map on the ground surface from aerial photograph data. A novel method of RoadTracer using the Teacher-Student based ensemble learning model of Adaptive DBN is proposed, since the road maps contain many complicated features so that a model with high representation power to detect should be required. The experimental results showed the detection accuracy of the proposed model was improved from 40.0\% to 89.0\% on average in the seven major cities among the test dataset. In addition, we challenged to apply our method to the detection of available roads when landslide by natural disaster is occurred, in order to rapidly obtain a way of transportation. For fast inference, a small size of the trained model was implemented on a small embedded edge device as lightweight deep learning. We reported the detection results for the satellite image before and after the rainfall disaster in Japan. This version of the article was improved the search algorithm at the border around image.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing, Vol.16, pp.6310-6324 (2023)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于教师-学生自适应深度信念网络（Teacher-Student Adaptive DBN）的道路网络自动提取方法，应用于滑坡灾害后的可用道路检测。该方法在七大城市测试集上将道路检测准确率从40.0%提升至89.0%，并实现了在边缘设备上的轻量化部署。
Motivation: 现有道路提取方法在处理复杂特征时精度不足，且滑坡等自然灾害后需要快速获取可用道路信息。
Method: 采用教师-学生集成学习框架的自适应DBN，通过RBM的神经元生成-消除算法和DBN的层生成算法自动构建最优网络结构，并针对图像边界改进搜索算法。
Result: 在七大城市测试集上平均检测准确率从40.0%提升至89.0%；在边缘设备上实现了轻量级模型，成功应用于日本降雨灾害前后的卫星图像道路检测。
Conclusion: 提出的自适应DBN方法能有效提升道路检测精度，且轻量模型适用于边缘设备，为灾害应急响应提供快速道路识别。

papers.title: Attribution Graphs and Causal Probing for Mechanistic Discovery and Bias Repair in Multimodal Generative Learning
papers.abstract_en: We treat the internals of generative models as mechanistic objects rather than black boxes. We introduce \textbf{Attribution Graphs} (AGs), which extend GradCAM++ to circuit-level representations, and \textbf{Causal Probing}, a do-calculus intervention method for identifying causal latent structures, enabling detection and correction of spurious correlations, demographic biases, and misaligned decision circuits during training. We further propose the \textbf{Cognitive Alignment Score (CAS)}, quantifying agreement between model-internal representations and human concepts, a \textbf{saliency-first privacy mechanism} sharing only thresholded attribution nodes, a bias-aware regularizer aligning subgroup statistics, and a Reveal-to-Revise loop integrating attribution signals into parameter updates without separate fine-tuning. Evaluated on CelebA, FairFace, Jigsaw, and HateXplain, our method achieves \textbf{94.1\%} accuracy, \textbf{92.3\%} macro F1, \textbf{79.4\%} IoU-XAI, and \textbf{12.7} FID at 72--76\% adversarial robustness, while reducing subgroup disparity $Δ_{\mathrm{bias}}$ by \textbf{41\%}, demonstrating that mechanistic interpretability, fairness, and generative performance can be jointly optimized.
papers.comment: We are recently authors in conflict with this work; I am heartily requesting to withdraw this paper as soon as possible
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Attribution Graphs (AGs) 和 Causal Probing 方法，将生成模型内部视为机械对象而非黑箱，用于检测和修正虚假相关、人口统计偏差及对齐错误的决策回路。在 CelebA、FairFace、Jigsaw 和 HateXplain 数据集上，该方法达到 94.1% 准确率、92.3% 宏 F1、79.4% IoU-XAI 和 12.7 FID，同时将子群差异降低 41%，表明机制可解释性、公平性和生成性能可联合优化。
Motivation: 当前生成模型常被当作黑箱，难以发现和纠正内部的虚假相关、人口统计偏差及对齐错误的决策回路，缺乏对模型内部机制的细粒度理解。
Method: 引入 Attribution Graphs 将 GradCAM++ 扩展到电路级表示；提出 Causal Probing 进行 do-calculus 干预以识别因果潜在结构；提出 Cognitive Alignment Score (CAS) 量化模型内部表示与人类概念的一致性；设计显著性优先的隐私机制、偏差感知正则化器和 Reveal-to-Revise 循环，无需单独微调即可集成归因信号。
Result: 在 CelebA、FairFace、Jigsaw 和 HateXplain 数据集上，取得 94.1% 准确率、92.3% 宏 F1、79.4% IoU-XAI 和 12.7 FID，同时达到 72-76% 对抗鲁棒性，子群偏差 Δ_bias 降低 41%。
Conclusion: 实验表明，通过机械可解释性方法可以同时提升模型公平性和生成性能，实现多目标联合优化。

summary_sections.method: 引入 Attribution Graphs 将 GradCAM++ 扩展到电路级表示；提出 Causal Probing 进行 do-calculus 干预以识别因果潜在结构；提出 Cognitive Alignment Score (CAS) 量化模型内部表示与人类概念的一致性；设计显著性优先的隐私机制、偏差感知正则化器和 Reveal-to-Revise 循环，无需单独微调即可集成归因信号。
summary_sections.result: 在 CelebA、FairFace、Jigsaw 和 HateXplain 数据集上，取得 94.1% 准确率、92.3% 宏 F1、79.4% IoU-XAI 和 12.7 FID，同时达到 72-76% 对抗鲁棒性，子群偏差 Δ_bias 降低 41%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 实验表明，通过机械可解释性方法可以同时提升模型公平性和生成性能，实现多目标联合优化。

papers.title: Spatial Deconfounder: Interference-Aware Deconfounding for Spatial Causal Inference
papers.abstract_en: Causal inference in spatial domains faces two intertwined challenges: (1) unmeasured spatial factors, such as weather, air pollution, or mobility, that confound treatment and outcome, and (2) interference from nearby treatments that violate standard no-interference assumptions. While existing methods typically address one by assuming away the other, we show they are deeply connected: interference reveals structure in the latent confounder. Leveraging this insight, we propose the Spatial Deconfounder, a two-stage method that reconstructs a substitute confounder from local treatment vectors using a conditional variational autoencoder (C-VAE) with a spatial prior, then estimates causal effects with a flexible outcome model. We show that this enables nonparametric identification of direct and spillover effects under weak assumptions--without multiple treatment types or a known latent-field model. Empirically, we extend SpaCE, a benchmark suite for spatial confounding, to include treatment interference, and show that the Spatial Deconfounder consistently improves effect estimation across real-world environmental health and social science datasets. By turning local interference into a multi-cause proxy for latent spatial confounding, our framework advances robust causal inference for spatial data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出空间去混淆器（Spatial Deconfounder），一种两阶段方法，通过条件变分自编码器（C-VAE）和空间先验从局部处理向量中重构替代混淆变量，从而同时处理空间因果推断中的未测量空间混淆和相邻处理干扰问题。该方法在扩展后的SpaCE基准（包含处理干扰）上，对环境健康和社会科学数据集的效果估计有持续改进。
Motivation: 现有空间因果推断方法通常分别处理未测量空间混淆或干扰，但本文证明两者深度相关：干扰揭示了潜在混淆的结构，因此需要联合建模。
Method: 提出Spatial Deconfounder，第一阶段使用带空间先验的条件变分自编码器（C-VAE）从局部处理向量中重构替代混淆变量；第二阶段用灵活的结果模型估计因果效应，实现非参数识别直接效应和溢出效应。
Result: 在扩展后的SpaCE基准（包含处理干扰）上，Spatial Deconfounder在真实环境健康和社会科学数据集上一致改进了效果估计。
Conclusion: 通过将局部干扰转化为潜在空间混淆的多原因代理，该方法为空间数据提供了鲁棒的因果推断框架。

papers.title: Robust Tangent Space Estimation via Laplacian Eigenvector Gradient Orthogonalization
papers.abstract_en: Estimating the tangent spaces of a data manifold is a fundamental problem in geometric data analysis. The standard approach, Local Principal Component Analysis (LPCA), struggles in high-noise setting due to a critical trade-off in choosing the neighborhood size. Selecting an optimal size requires prior knowledge of the geometric and noise characteristics of the data that are often unavailable. In this paper, we propose a spectral method, Laplacian Eigenvector Gradient Orthogonalization (LEGO), that utilizes the global structure of the data to guide local tangent space estimation. Instead of relying solely on local neighborhoods, LEGO estimates the tangent space at each data point by orthogonalizing the gradients of low-frequency eigenvectors of the graph Laplacian. We provide two theoretical justifications of our method. First, a differential geometric analysis on the tubular neighborhood of a manifold shows that gradients of the low-frequency Neumann eigenfunctions of the tube align closely with the manifold's tangent bundle, while an eigenfunction with high gradient in directions orthogonal to the manifold lie deeper in the spectrum. Second, a random matrix theoretic analysis also demonstrates that low-frequency eigenvectors are robust to sub-Gaussian noise. These results allow us to derive the asymptotic scaling and stability of the estimated eigenvector gradients. Numerical experiments demonstrate that LEGO yields tangent space estimates that are significantly more robust to noise than those from LPCA, resulting in marked improvements in downstream tasks such as manifold learning, boundary detection, and local intrinsic dimension estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于谱方法的切空间估计算法 LEGO，通过正交化图拉普拉斯低频特征向量的梯度来估计数据流形的切空间，避免了局部主成分分析在高噪声下邻域选择的难题。理论分析表明低频 Neumann 本征函数梯度与切丛对齐且对亚高斯噪声鲁棒，实验证明 LEGO 在流形学习、边界检测等下游任务中显著优于 LPCA。
Motivation: 局部主成分分析在高噪声环境下因邻域大小选择困难而性能退化，而现有方法需要先验的几何与噪声信息，这通常不可得。
Method: 利用图拉普拉斯低频特征向量的梯度，通过正交化得到每个数据点的切空间估计，结合微分几何与随机矩阵理论提供理论保证。
Result: 摘要报告 LEGO 在噪声下切空间估计的鲁棒性显著优于 LPCA，并在流形学习、边界检测和局部本征维数估计等下游任务中带来明显改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用全局结构指导局部估计可以有效缓解高噪声下的邻域选择难题，并给出了低频谱梯度与切空间对齐的理论依据。

papers.title: VLOD-TTA: Test-Time Adaptation of Vision-Language Object Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language object detectors (VLODs) such as YOLO-World and Grounding DINO exhibit strong zero-shot generalization, but their performance degrades under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical way to adapt models online using only unlabeled target data. However, despite substantial progress in TTA for vision-language classification, TTA for VLODs remains largely unexplored. The only prior method relies on a mean-teacher framework that introduces significant latency and memory overhead. To this end, we introduce \textsc{VLOD-TTA}, a TTA method that leverages dense proposal overlap and image-conditioned prompts to adapt VLODs with low additional overhead. \textsc{VLOD-TTA} combines (i) an IoU-weighted entropy objective that emphasizes spatially coherent proposal clusters and mitigates confirmation bias from isolated boxes, and (ii) image-conditioned prompt selection that ranks prompts by image-level compatibility and aggregates the most informative prompt scores for detection. Our experiments across diverse distribution shifts, including artistic domains, adverse driving conditions, low-light imagery, and common corruptions, indicate that \textsc{VLOD-TTA} consistently outperforms standard TTA baselines and the prior state-of-the-art method using YOLO-World and Grounding DINO. Code : https://github.com/imatif17/VLOD-TTA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VLOD-TTA，一种用于视觉-语言目标检测器（如YOLO-World、Grounding DINO）的测试时自适应方法。该方法结合IoU加权熵目标和图像条件提示选择，在多种分布偏移（艺术领域、恶劣驾驶条件、低光图像、常见损坏）下持续优于标准TTA基线和先前最优方法，且额外开销低。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言目标检测器在分布偏移下性能下降，而测试时自适应在目标检测领域探索不足，先前唯一方法基于均值教师框架，带来显著延迟和内存开销。
Method: VLOD-TTA包含两部分：(i) IoU加权熵目标，强调空间一致的提议聚类并缓解孤立框的确认偏差；(ii) 图像条件提示选择，根据图像级兼容性对候选提示排序并聚合最有信息量的提示分数进行检测。
Result: 在艺术领域、恶劣驾驶条件、低光图像和常见损坏等多种分布偏移下，VLOD-TTA使用YOLO-World和Grounding DINO均一致优于标准TTA基线和先前最优方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法以低额外开销实现了鲁棒的测试时自适应，并开源了代码。

papers.title: Predicting Effects, Missing Distributions: Evaluating LLMs as Human Behavior Simulators in Operations Management
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human behavior in business, economics, and the social sciences, offering a low-cost complement to laboratory experiments, field studies, and surveys. This paper evaluates how well LLMs replicate human behavior in operations management. Using nine published behavioral-operations experiments, we assess LLM performance along two dimensions: whether LLM-generated data reproduce the original hypothesis-test outcomes, and whether their full response distributions align with human data, measured by Wasserstein distance. We find that LLMs often replicate hypothesis-level effects, suggesting that they can capture salient decision biases and behavioral regularities. However, their response distributions frequently diverge from human data, even for strong proprietary models, with dispersion mismatch playing an important role. We also examine two lightweight mitigation strategies: chain-of-thought prompting and hyperparameter tuning. Both can reduce distributional misalignment, and appropriate tuning can sometimes allow smaller or open-source models to match or outperform larger proprietary systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了大语言模型（LLM）在运营管理领域模拟人类行为的能力。基于9个已发表的行为运营实验，从两个维度进行测试：LLM生成数据是否复现原始假设检验结果，以及其完整响应分布与人类数据的对齐程度（以Wasserstein距离衡量）。结果表明，LLM通常能复现假设层面的效应，捕捉显著决策偏差和行为规律，但其响应分布与人类数据经常存在差异，分散度不匹配是关键问题。链式思考提示和超参数调整两种轻量策略可减少分布偏差，适当调整甚至能让较小的开源模型匹配或超越大型专有模型。
Motivation: LLM被越来越多地用于模拟人类行为，但在运营管理中的有效性缺乏系统评估。
Method: 采用9个已发表的行为运营实验，从两个维度评估：假设检验结果复现和Wasserstein距离衡量的完整响应分布对齐；并测试链式思考提示和超参数调整两种轻量缓解策略。
Result: LLM能复现假设层面的效应，但响应分布常偏离人类数据，分散度不匹配是关键；适当调整可让小型或开源模型匹配甚至超越大型专有模型。
Conclusion: LLM在运营管理中作为人类行为模拟器有潜力，但需注意分布差异，轻量策略可改善对齐。

papers.title: Shoot from the HIP: Hessian Interatomic Potentials without derivatives
papers.abstract_en: Fundamental tasks in computational chemistry, from transition state search to vibrational analysis, rely on molecular Hessians, which are the second derivatives of the potential energy. Yet, Hessians are computationally expensive to calculate and scale poorly with system size, with both quantum mechanical methods and neural networks. In this work, we demonstrate that Hessians can be predicted directly from a deep learning model, without relying on automatic differentiation or finite differences. We observe that one can construct SE(3)-equivariant, symmetric Hessians from irreducible representations (irrep) features up to degree $l$=2 computed during message passing in graph neural networks. This makes HIP Hessians one to two orders of magnitude faster, more accurate, more memory efficient, easier to train, and enables more favorable scaling with system size. We validate our predictions across a wide range of downstream tasks, demonstrating consistently superior performance for transition state search, accelerated geometry optimization, zero-point energy corrections, and vibrational analysis benchmarks. We open-source the HIP codebase and model weights to enable further development of the direct prediction of Hessians at https://github.com/BurgerAndreas/hip
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需导数计算的深度学习模型（HIP），直接从图神经网络的消息传递中提取不可约表示（irrep）特征，构造SE(3)-等变对称Hessian矩阵。该方法在计算速度、精度、内存效率和系统扩展性上相比传统方法提升1-2个数量级，并在过渡态搜索、几何优化、零点能校正和振动分析等基准测试中表现优越。
Motivation: 计算化学中Hessian矩阵的计算成本高昂且随系统规模扩展差，现有量子力学方法和神经网络方法均受此限制。
Method: 通过SE(3)-等变图神经网络在消息传递中计算至l=2的irrep特征，直接构造对称Hessian，避免使用自动微分或有限差分。
Result: Hessian预测速度提升1-2个数量级，精度更高，内存效率更好，在过渡态搜索、加速几何优化、零点能校正和振动分析基准测试中一致优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 直接预测Hessian的方法在计算成本和性能上具有显著优势，开源代码和模型权重以促进进一步发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Invisible Yet Detected: PelFANet with Attention-Guided Anatomical Fusion for Pelvic Fracture Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Pelvic fractures pose significant diagnostic challenges, particularly in cases where fracture signs are subtle or invisible on standard radiographs. To address this, we introduce PelFANet, a dual-stream attention network that fuses raw pelvic X-rays with segmented bone images to improve fracture classification. The network employs Fused Attention Blocks (FABlocks) to iteratively exchange and refine features from both inputs, capturing global context and localized anatomical detail. Trained in a two-stage pipeline with a segmentation-guided approach, PelFANet demonstrates superior performance over conventional methods. On the AMERI dataset, it achieves 88.68% accuracy and 0.9334 AUC on visible fractures, while generalizing effectively to invisible fracture cases with 82.29% accuracy and 0.8688 AUC, despite not being trained on them. These results highlight the clinical potential of anatomy-aware dual-input architectures for robust fracture detection, especially in scenarios with subtle radiographic presentations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PelFANet 是一种双流注意力网络，用于骨盆骨折诊断。它融合原始骨盆 X 光片与分割后的骨骼图像，利用 Fused Attention Blocks (FABlocks) 迭代交换和细化特征。在 AMERI 数据集上，对可见骨折达到 88.68% 准确率和 0.9334 AUC，对不可见骨折（未训练）达到 82.29% 准确率和 0.8688 AUC。
Motivation: 骨盆骨折在标准 X 光片上常表现为细微或不可见征象，现有方法诊断困难。
Method: 提出 PelFANet 双流注意力网络，使用 Fused Attention Blocks (FABlocks) 融合原始 X 光与分割骨骼图像，并采用两阶段分割引导训练。
Result: 在 AMERI 数据集上，可见骨折准确率 88.68%、AUC 0.9334；不可见骨折准确率 82.29%、AUC 0.8688。
Conclusion: 解剖感知的双输入架构在细微骨折检测中具有临床潜力，且能泛化至不可见骨折。

papers.title: EfficientUICoder: A Bidirectional Token Compression Framework for Efficient MLLM-Based UI Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models have demonstrated exceptional performance in UI2Code tasks, significantly enhancing website development efficiency. However, these tasks incur substantially higher computational overhead than traditional code generation due to the large number of input image tokens and extensive output code tokens required. Our comprehensive study identifies significant redundancies in both image and code tokens that exacerbate computational complexity and hinder focus on key UI elements, resulting in excessively lengthy and often invalid HTML files. We propose EfficientUICoder, a compression framework for efficient UI code generation with three key components. First, Element and Layout-aware Token Compression preserves essential UI information by detecting element regions and constructing UI element trees. Second, Region-aware Token Refinement leverages attention scores to discard low-attention tokens from selected regions while integrating high-attention tokens from unselected regions. Third, Adaptive Duplicate Token Suppression dynamically reduces repetitive generation by tracking HTML/CSS structure frequencies and applying exponential penalties. Extensive experiments show EfficientUICoder achieves a 55%-60% compression ratio without compromising webpage quality and delivers superior efficiency improvements: reducing computational cost by 44.9%, generated tokens by 41.4%, prefill time by 46.6%, and inference time by 48.8% on 34B-level MLLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/WebPAI/EfficientUICoder.
papers.comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 2026 ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EfficientUICoder框架，通过元素布局感知的token压缩、区域感知的token精炼和自适应重复token抑制，减少UI代码生成中的图像和代码token冗余。在34B级多模态大模型上实现55%-60%的压缩率，同时降低44.9%的计算成本和48.8%的推理时间。
Motivation: 现有MLLM在UI2Code任务中因大量图像和代码token导致计算开销巨大，且存在冗余token影响关键元素聚焦，生成冗长无效的HTML文件。
Method: 提出三项核心组件：元素布局感知的token压缩（检测元素区域并构建UI元素树）、区域感知的token精炼（基于注意力分数丢弃低关注token并整合高关注token）、自适应重复token抑制（跟踪HTML/CSS结构频率并施加指数惩罚）。
Result: 在34B级MLLM上实现55%-60%的压缩率，计算成本降低44.9%，生成token减少41.4%，预填充时间减少46.6%，推理时间减少48.8%。
Conclusion: 该框架有效降低了UI代码生成的计算开销，同时保持网页质量，为高效UI代码生成提供了新思路。

papers.title: PlantExpertVQA: A Visual Question Answering Dataset for Benchmarking Vision-Language Models in Plant Science
papers.abstract_en: Existing plant-disease datasets target classification and detection, leaving vision-language models unable to support interactive, reasoning-based diagnosis. To address this, we present PlantExpertVQA, a large-scale visual question answering (VQA) dataset designed to advance vision-language models for agricultural decision-making. It is compiled from 45 open-source datasets, including the widely used PlantVillage corpus, and comprises 765,186 high-quality question-answer (QA) pairs grounded over 150,841 images spanning 38 crop species and 89 disease conditions. Questions are organized into 3 levels of cognitive complexity and 9 distinct categories. Each was phrased following expert guidance and generated via an automated two-stage pipeline: template-based QA synthesis from image metadata, followed by multi-stage linguistic re-engineering. The dataset was iteratively reviewed by domain experts for scientific accuracy and relevance. We find that current frontier vision-language models, including recent open-source instruction-tuned multimodal LLMs, perform poorly on PlantExpertVQA. However, parameter-efficient fine-tuning of a compact 2B-parameter model on a small fraction of the dataset yields substantial improvements across all question categories, demonstrating its effectiveness for domain adaptation.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 9 figures, 14 tables and Submitted to Nature Scientific Data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了PlantExpertVQA，一个大规模植物科学视觉问答数据集，包含765,186个QA对，覆盖38种作物和89种病害条件。数据集通过两阶段自动化管道生成，并经领域专家审查。实验表明，当前前沿视觉语言模型在该数据集上表现不佳，但参数高效微调一个小型2B参数模型即可显著提升性能。
Motivation: 现有植物病害数据集仅支持分类和检测，无法支撑基于推理的交互式诊断，缺乏针对农业决策的视觉问答基准。
Method: 从45个开源数据集（包括PlantVillage）中收集150,841张图像，通过模板合成和语言工程的两阶段管道自动生成QA对，并由领域专家迭代审查科学准确性。
Result: 当前前沿视觉语言模型（包括开源指令微调多模态大模型）在PlantExpertVQA上表现差；但参数高效微调一个仅2B参数的小模型在少量数据上即可在所有问题类别上取得显著提升。
Conclusion: PlantExpertVQA可作为评估农业领域视觉语言模型的基准，且小模型微调足以实现有效的领域适应。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Vivid-VR: Distilling Concepts from Text-to-Video Diffusion Transformer for Photorealistic Video Restoration
papers.abstract_en: We present Vivid-VR, a DiT-based generative video restoration method built upon an advanced T2V foundation model, where ControlNet is leveraged to control the generation process, ensuring content consistency. However, conventional fine-tuning of such controllable pipelines frequently suffers from distribution drift due to limitations in imperfect multimodal alignment, resulting in compromised texture realism and temporal coherence. To tackle this challenge, we propose a concept distillation training strategy that utilizes the pretrained T2V model to synthesize training samples with embedded textual concepts, thereby distilling its conceptual understanding to preserve texture and temporal quality. To enhance generation controllability, we redesign the control architecture with two key components: 1) a control feature projector that filters degradation artifacts from input video latents to minimize their propagation through the generation pipeline, and 2) a new ControlNet connector employing a dual-branch design. This connector synergistically combines MLP-based feature mapping with cross-attention mechanism for dynamic control feature retrieval, enabling both content preservation and adaptive control signal modulation. Extensive experiments show that Vivid-VR performs favorably against existing approaches on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks, as well as AIGC videos, achieving impressive texture realism, visual vividness, and temporal consistency. The codes and checkpoints are publicly available at https://github.com/csbhr/Vivid-VR.
papers.comment: Accepted by ICLR 2026; ICLR version of the paper: https://openreview.net/pdf?id=YV5Zgv8pdg
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Vivid-VR 是一种基于扩散Transformer（DiT）的生成式视频修复方法，利用预训练的文本到视频（T2V）基础模型和ControlNet架构。通过概念蒸馏训练策略，从T2V模型合成训练样本以保持纹理和时序质量，并重新设计了控制架构，包括控制特征投影器和双分支ControlNet连接器。实验表明在合成和真实基准以及AIGC视频上优于现有方法，实现了纹理真实感和时间一致性。
Motivation: 现有可控的视频修复管线在微调时因多模态对齐不完美而遭受分布漂移，导致纹理真实性和时间连贯性受损。
Method: 提出概念蒸馏训练策略，利用预训练T2V模型合成带有文本概念的训练样本，蒸馏其概念理解以保持纹理和时间质量。重新设计控制架构：控制特征投影器滤除输入视频潜变量中的退化伪影；双分支ControlNet连接器结合MLP特征映射和交叉注意力机制进行动态控制特征检索。
Result: 在合成和真实世界基准以及AIGC视频上，Vivid-VR 在纹理真实感、视觉生动性和时间一致性方面优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 该方法通过蒸馏T2V模型的概念理解和改进控制架构，有效提升了视频修复的纹理和时间质量。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: A Conditional GAN for Tabular Data Generation with Probabilistic Sampling of Latent Subspaces
papers.abstract_en: The tabular form constitutes the standard way of representing data in relational database systems and spreadsheets. But, similarly to other forms, tabular data suffers from class imbalance, a problem that causes serious performance degradation in a wide variety of machine learning tasks. One of the most effective solutions dictates the usage of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) in order to synthesize artificial data instances for the under-represented classes. Despite their good performance, none of the proposed GAN models takes into account the vector subspaces of the input samples in the real data space, leading to data generation in arbitrary locations. Moreover, the class labels are treated in the same manner as the other categorical variables during training, so conditional sampling by class is rendered less effective. To overcome these problems, this study presents ctdGAN, a conditional GAN for alleviating class imbalance in tabular datasets. Initially, ctdGAN executes a space partitioning step to assign cluster labels to the input samples. Subsequently, it utilizes these labels to synthesize samples via a novel probabilistic sampling strategy and a new loss function that penalizes both cluster and class mis-predictions. In this way, ctdGAN is trained to generate samples in subspaces that resemble those of the original data distribution. We also introduce several other improvements, including a simple, yet effective cluster-wise scaling technique that captures multiple feature modes without affecting data dimensionality. The exhaustive evaluation of ctdGAN with 14 imbalanced datasets demonstrated its superiority in generating high fidelity samples and improving classification accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ctdGAN，一种用于缓解表格数据类别不平衡的条件生成对抗网络。该方法通过空间划分分配聚类标签，利用概率采样策略和新的损失函数在潜在子空间中生成样本，并引入聚类尺度缩放技术。在14个不平衡数据集上的评估表明，ctdGAN能生成高保真样本并提升分类准确率。
Motivation: 现有GAN模型处理表格数据时未考虑输入样本的向量子空间，导致在任意位置生成数据；且训练中类标签与其他类别变量处理方式相同，降低了按类条件采样的有效性。
Method: 提出ctdGAN：先执行空间划分为输入样本分配聚类标签，然后利用这些标签通过概率采样策略和新损失函数（惩罚聚类和类预测错误）生成样本，同时引入聚类尺度缩放技术捕获多种特征模式。
Result: 在14个不平衡数据集上的评估表明，ctdGAN在生成高保真样本和提高分类准确率方面优于现有方法。
Conclusion: ctdGAN通过考虑潜在子空间和条件采样，有效缓解了表格数据的类别不平衡问题，但主要针对通用表格数据，未涉及时空序列数据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Model Directions, Not Words: Mechanistic Topic Models Using Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Traditional topic models are effective at uncovering latent themes in large text collections. However, due to their reliance on bag-of-words representations, they struggle to capture semantically abstract features. While some neural variants use richer representations, they are similarly constrained by expressing topics as word lists, which limits their ability to articulate complex topics. We introduce Mechanistic Topic Models (MTMs), a class of topic models that operate on interpretable features learned by sparse autoencoders (SAEs). By defining topics over this semantically rich space, MTMs can reveal deeper conceptual themes with expressive feature descriptions. Moreover, uniquely among topic models, MTMs enable controllable text generation using topic steering vectors. To properly evaluate MTM topics against word list approaches, we propose \textit{topic judge}, an LLM-based pairwise comparison evaluation framework. Across eight datasets, MTMs match or exceed traditional and neural baselines on coherence metrics, are consistently preferred by topic judge, and enable effective LLM steering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）可解释特征的机械主题模型（MTM），能够在语义丰富的特征空间中定义主题，从而揭示更深层次的概念主题，并首次在主题模型中实现可控文本生成。在八个数据集上，MTM在一致性指标上匹配或超越传统和神经基线，并在基于LLM的成对比较评估框架 topic judge 中获得一致偏好。
Motivation: 传统主题模型依赖词袋表示，难以捕捉语义抽象特征，且主题局限于词列表，表达能力有限。
Method: 提出机械主题模型（MTM），在SAE学习到的可解释特征上定义主题，并利用主题转向向量实现可控文本生成；同时提出基于LLM的 topic judge 评估框架用于成对比较。
Result: 在八个数据集上，MTM在主题一致性指标上匹配或超越传统和神经基线，在 topic judge 评估中持续被偏好，并有效实现LLM转向。
Conclusion: MTM通过利用SAE特征空间能揭示更丰富的主题结构，并具备独特的可控生成能力，topic judge 为公平比较提供了新范式。

papers.title: Inexact calculus of variations on the hyperspherical tangent bundle with connections to the attention mechanism
papers.abstract_en: We offer a theoretical mathematical background through Lagrangian optimization on the unit hyperspherical manifold and its tangential structure. Our methods can be categorized as inexact since our methods are projection-based and since we will perturb the functional optimization with epsilon-type quantities. We draw connections to the attention mechanism and the Transformer since it exists as a flow map in the tangent fiber for each token along the high-dimensional unit sphere. Our motivation for this work is primarily twofold: we study the attention mechanism under its flow map and its relations to traditional calculus of variations and Lagrangian optimization; and we study a range of calculus of variations on the unit hypersphere that appeal to a broader mathematical lens in approximating, variational contexts.

papers.title: Fast Equivariant Imaging: Accelerating Unsupervised Learning and Model Adaptation via Inexact Splitting
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we propose Fast Equivariant Imaging (FEI), a novel unsupervised learning framework to rapidly and efficiently train deep imaging networks without ground-truth data. FEI reformulates the EI objective through an inexact variable-splitting scheme, decoupling network training from an auxiliary restoration step implemented with a plug-and-play denoiser, this novel unsupervised scheme shows superior efficiency and performance compared to the standard Equivariant Imaging paradigm. In particular, our FEI schemes achieve an order-of-magnitude (10x) acceleration over standard EI on training U-Net for X-ray CT reconstruction and image inpainting, with improved generalization performance. Beyond offline training, the proposed scheme also enables efficient test-time adaptation of a pretrained model to individual samples, to secure further performance improvements. Extensive experiments show that the proposed approach provides a noticeable efficiency and performance gain over existing unsupervised methods and model adaptation techniques.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fast Equivariant Imaging (FEI)，一种无监督学习框架，通过非精确变量分裂方案（inexact variable-splitting）解耦网络训练与辅助恢复步骤，使用即插即用去噪器加速训练。FEI 在 X 射线 CT 重建和图像修补任务上相比标准 EI 实现约 10 倍加速，且泛化性能更好，并支持测试时自适应。
Motivation: 标准等变成像（EI）无监督学习框架训练速度慢，难以在无真实数据场景下高效训练深度成像网络。
Method: 提出 FEI 框架，采用非精确变量分裂方案将 EI 目标函数分解，利用即插即用去噪器（plug-and-play denoiser）辅助恢复步骤，从而分离网络训练与图像恢复过程。
Result: 在 U-Net 训练中，FEI 相比标准 EI 在 X 射线 CT 重建和图像修补任务上实现约 10 倍加速，并提升泛化性能；测试时自适应可进一步改善效果。
Conclusion: FEI 在无监督学习和模型适应中提供了显著的效率和性能提升，优于现有方法。

papers.title: Stochastic and Non-local Closure Modeling for Nonlinear Dynamical Systems via Latent Score-based Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a latent score-based generative AI framework for learning stochastic, non-local closure models and constitutive laws in nonlinear dynamical systems of computational mechanics. This work addresses a key challenge of modeling complex multiscale dynamical systems without a clear scale separation, for which numerically resolving all scales is prohibitively expensive, e.g., for engineering turbulent flows. While classical closure modeling methods leverage domain knowledge to approximate subgrid-scale phenomena, their deterministic and local assumptions can be too restrictive in regimes lacking a clear scale separation. Recent developments of diffusion-based stochastic models have shown promise in the context of closure modeling, but their prohibitive computational inference cost limits practical applications in many real-world settings. This work addresses this limitation by jointly training convolutional autoencoders with conditional diffusion models in latent space, significantly reducing the dimensionality of the sampling process while preserving essential physical characteristics. Numerical results demonstrate that the joint training approach helps discover a proper latent space that not only guarantees small reconstruction errors but also ensures good performance of the diffusion model in the latent space. When integrated into numerical simulations, the proposed stochastic modeling framework via latent conditional diffusion models achieves significant computational acceleration while maintaining comparable predictive accuracy to standard diffusion models in physical space.
papers.journal_ref: Journal of Computational Physics 563 (2026) 115082
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于潜在分数生成模型的随机非局部闭合建模框架，用于模拟非线性动力学系统中的亚网格尺度现象，解决缺乏清晰尺度分离的多尺度系统建模难题。通过联合训练卷积自编码器和潜在条件扩散模型，降低了采样维度，在保持预测精度的同时实现计算加速。数值实验表明该方法在计算力学中具有潜力。
Motivation: 经典闭合建模依赖确定性和局部假设，在缺乏明确尺度分离的系统中过于局限；现有扩散模型计算成本高，难以实际应用。
Method: 联合训练卷积自编码器与条件扩散模型，在潜在空间进行降维采样，学习随机非局部闭合模型。
Result: 摘要报告潜在空间方法在保证重建误差小的同时，保持了扩散模型性能，集成到数值模拟中获得计算加速且预测精度与物理空间标准扩散模型相当。
Conclusion: 该框架为计算力学中的多尺度系统提供了一种高效随机闭合建模途径，但摘要未提及在气象或降水任务上的直接验证。

papers.title: Code Reasoning for Software Engineering Tasks: A Survey and A Call to Action
papers.abstract_en: The rise of large language models (LLMs) has led to dramatic improvements across a wide range of natural language tasks. Their performance on certain tasks can be further enhanced by incorporating test-time reasoning techniques. These inference-time advances have been adopted into the code domain, enabling complex software engineering (SWE) tasks such as code generation, test generation and issue resolution. However, the impact of different reasoning techniques on code-centric SWE tasks has not been systematically explored. In this work, we survey code reasoning techniques that underpin these capabilities, with a focus on test-time compute and inference-time reasoning paradigms. We examine a variety of code-specific reasoning methods and progressively build up to SWE agents, which combine planning, tool use, and multi-step interaction. We also compare the impact of different techniques on coding tasks, highlighting their relative importance and outlining open challenges and future research directions. Across commonly used models and benchmarks, we find that approaches exploiting code-specific signals (e.g., structure and execution feedback) are frequently associated with improved performance, motivating a dedicated study of code reasoning beyond natural-language reasoning.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (06/2026) 40 pages, 8 figures, 11 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对软件工程任务中的代码推理技术进行了综述，重点考察测试时计算和推理时推理范式，包括代码特定推理方法、SWE智能体（结合规划、工具使用和多步交互），并比较不同技术对编码任务的影响，发现利用代码特定信号（如结构和执行反馈）的方法通常能提升性能。
Motivation: 尽管大语言模型在自然语言任务中表现出色，并已应用于软件工程任务，但不同推理技术对代码中心的任务的影响尚未被系统探索。
Method: 通过综述代码推理技术，从测试时计算和推理时推理范式入手，逐步构建到SWE智能体，并对常用模型和基准进行比较。
Result: 发现利用代码特定信号（如结构和执行反馈）的方法通常能提升性能。
Conclusion: 强调需要专门研究代码推理，超越自然语言推理，并指出未来研究方向和开放挑战。
