papers.title: ISAC: Training-Free Instance-to-Semantic Attention Control for Multi-Instance Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent open-weight text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models still struggle with multi-instance prompts, often omitting or merging instances and mixing semantics among similar objects. We trace these failures to early denoising steps, before instance boundaries are reliably stabilized. Existing training-free guidance is largely driven by cross-attention or other token-conditioned semantic signals. Such guidance can separate concepts at the token level, but largely assumes that distinct instance regions have already emerged. In early denoising steps, it cannot reliably carve out these regions, so count failures and semantic mixing persist. By contrast, self-attention exposes class-agnostic instance layouts during early denoising. To exploit this asymmetry, we propose $\textbf{ISAC}$ ($\textbf{I}$nstance-to-$\textbf{S}$emantic $\textbf{A}$ttention $\textbf{C}$ontrol), a training-free, model-agnostic objective that first stabilizes self-attention layouts and then binds cross-attention semantics within them, without fine-tuning or external vision models. Across T2I-CompBench, HRS-Bench, and our newly curated IntraCompBench, ISAC consistently outperforms prior training-free methods. Furthermore, ISAC enhances layout-to-image controllers by refining coarse, overlapping bounding boxes into dense instance masks.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Code and IntraCompBench are available at https://shjo-april.github.io/ISAC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ISAC，一种免训练、模型无关的注意力控制方法，用于解决文本到图像扩散模型在多实例生成中的实例遗漏、合并和语义混淆问题。ISAC通过先稳定自注意力布局，再在其中绑定交叉注意力语义，无需微调或外部视觉模型，在T2I-CompBench、HRS-Bench和新提出的IntraCompBench上优于现有免训练方法，并能改善布局到图像控制器的性能。
Motivation: 现有免训练方法依赖交叉注意力等语义信号，在早期去噪步骤中无法可靠分离实例区域，导致计数失败和语义混合；而自注意力在早期就能暴露类无关的实例布局，这种不对称性未被利用。
Method: 提出Instance-to-Semantic Attention Control (ISAC)，分为两步：首先稳定自注意力布局以形成清晰的实例区域，然后将交叉注意力语义绑定到这些区域中。全程无需训练或外部模型。
Result: 在T2I-CompBench、HRS-Bench和IntraCompBench上，ISAC一致优于现有免训练方法；同时能通过细化粗糙的重叠边界框为密集实例掩码，增强布局到图像控制器。
Conclusion: ISAC证明了利用自注意力与交叉注意力的不对称性可以高效解决多实例生成中的实例分离与语义绑定问题，且易于集成到现有扩散模型中。

papers.title: Good Enough? An Investigation on the Impact of Label Quality in Large-Scale Medical Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Manually refining radiological segmentation masks is highly resource-intensive. To determine when this expert commitment is truly justified for the training of segmentation models, we investigate the relationship between label quality and model performance. Expanding beyond models trained directly for inference, we conduct the first study isolating the impact of label quality in pre-training datasets. While high-quality labels remain essential for models proceeding directly to deployment, we find no evidence that strict label quality is crucial for pre-training efficacy. These results question the necessity of exhaustive human-in-the-loop refinement for massive corpora intended for pretraining and suggest that expert effort is more effectively invested in well-curated downstream target datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大规模医学影像数据集中标签质量对分割模型性能的影响，首次在预训练场景下隔离标签质量的影响。结果表明，对于直接部署的模型，高质量标签仍然重要；但对于预训练，严格标签质量并非关键。因此，大规模预训练数据集的精细人工修正可能并非必要，专家精力应更有效地投入到精心整理的下游目标数据集中。
Motivation: 手动完善放射学分割掩膜需要大量资源，但专家投入是否总是值得尚不明确。
Method: 通过对比不同标签质量的数据集，分别训练直接推理模型和预训练模型，分析标签质量对性能的影响。
Result: 对于直接部署的模型，高质量标签至关重要；但对于预训练，未发现严格标签质量对效果有显著影响。
Conclusion: 大规模预训练数据集不需要过度的人力修正，专家应专注于优化下游目标数据集。

papers.title: Mitigating Hallucinations via Inter-Layer Consistency Aggregation in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the impressive capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), they remain susceptible to hallucinations, where generated content is inconsistent with the input image. Existing training-free hallucination mitigation methods often suffer from unstable performance and high sensitivity to hyperparameter settings, which limits their practicality and broader adoption. In this paper, we propose Decoding with Inter-layer Consistency via Layer Aggregation (DCLA), a training-free decoding mechanism that requires no retraining, fine-tuning, or access to external knowledge bases. Specifically, DCLA constructs a dynamic semantic reference by aggregating representations from previous layers and uses it to correct semantically deviated layers, thereby enforcing inter-layer consistency. Experiments across seven LVLMs and multiple benchmarks demonstrate the generality of DCLA: it surpasses standard decoding by 28.58 MME points on LLaVA1.5-7B and 42.6 MME points on Qwen2.5-VL, while improving POPE accuracy by 2.74 percentage points in the strongest setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DCLA（Decoding with Inter-layer Consistency via Layer Aggregation），一种无需训练的解码机制，通过聚合前层表示构建动态语义参考，纠正语义偏离的层，增强层间一致性，从而缓解大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）中的幻觉。在7个LVLM和多个基准上验证，DCLA在LLaVA1.5-7B上MME提升28.58点，在Qwen2.5-VL上提升42.6点，POPE准确率最高提升2.74个百分点。
Motivation: 现有无训练的幻觉缓解方法性能不稳定且对超参数敏感，限制了实用性，需要更稳健的通用方案。
Method: DCLA 通过聚合前面层的隐藏表示构建动态语义参考，并利用该参考修正当前层中语义偏离的隐藏状态，强制保持层间语义一致性，仅需训练前的模型推理过程。
Result: 在多个LVLM和基准上，DCLA 超越标准解码：LLaVA1.5-7B 的 MME 提升 28.58 点，Qwen2.5-VL 提升 42.6 点，POPE 准确率在最强设置下提升 2.74 个百分点。
Conclusion: DCLA 是一种通用、无需训练且无需外部知识库的解码方法，能有效降低 LVLM 的幻觉，性能稳定且易于部署。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有无训练的幻觉缓解方法性能不稳定且对超参数敏感，限制了实用性，需要更稳健的通用方案。
summary_sections.method: DCLA 通过聚合前面层的隐藏表示构建动态语义参考，并利用该参考修正当前层中语义偏离的隐藏状态，强制保持层间语义一致性，仅需训练前的模型推理过程。
summary_sections.result: 在多个LVLM和基准上，DCLA 超越标准解码：LLaVA1.5-7B 的 MME 提升 28.58 点，Qwen2.5-VL 提升 42.6 点，POPE 准确率在最强设置下提升 2.74 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: DCLA 是一种通用、无需训练且无需外部知识库的解码方法，能有效降低 LVLM 的幻觉，性能稳定且易于部署。

papers.title: Overcoming Dependent Censoring in the Evaluation of Survival Models
papers.abstract_en: Dependent censoring occurs when the event time and censoring time are not conditionally independent given the observed covariates. This complicates survival model evaluation because widely used metrics, such as the Brier score, typically handle right-censoring using inverse probability of censoring weighting (IPCW). Unfortunately, IPCW is valid only when the estimated censoring distribution is independent of the event time. We propose a dependent Brier score based on an Archimedean copula and the Copula-Graphic estimator, and establish consistency and asymptotic normality of its margin-time estimator. To evaluate the metric, we introduce a semi-synthetic framework that creates realistic dependent censoring while preserving the original covariate structure and known event times. Across 12 datasets, the proposed metric reduces estimation error by 12-16\% on average relative to IPCW. Source code is available at https://github.com/thecml/DependentEVAL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Archimedean copula和Copula-Graphic估计量的依赖Brier分数，用于处理生存模型评估中的依赖删失问题。通过半合成框架在12个数据集上验证，该指标相比逆删失加权（IPCW）平均降低12-16%的估计误差。
Motivation: 标准生存模型评估指标（如Brier分数）使用逆删失加权（IPCW）处理右删失，但IPCW要求删失时间与事件时间独立，而依赖删失违反该假设，导致评估偏差。
Method: 提出基于Archimedean copula和Copula-Graphic估计量的依赖Brier分数，并建立边际时间估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。同时引入半合成框架，在保持原始协变量结构和已知事件时间的前提下生成现实依赖删失数据。
Result: 在12个数据集上，所提指标相对于IPCW平均降低12-16%的估计误差。
Conclusion: 该方法有效克服了依赖删失对生存模型评估的影响，并提供了理论保证和开源实现。

papers.title: GraphChase: A Platform and Benchmark for Urban Network Security Games
papers.abstract_en: After the achievement of solving two-player zero-sum games, more AI researchers focus on solving multiplayer games. Urban Network Security Games (\textbf{UNSGs}) represent a class of such games, modeling real-world scenarios where law enforcement must strategically allocate limited resources to intercept criminals escaping within urban networks, and have gained considerable research attention. However, progress in this field has been limited by the absence of a standardized experimental platform and realistic benchmarks with heterogeneous travel costs. To address this limitation, we introduce \textbf{GraphChase}, an open-source platform designed to support the development and evaluation of algorithms for UNSGs. GraphChase offers a unified environment for modeling diverse UNSG variants on unweighted and weighted road networks across urban topologies. It also incorporates learning-based algorithms as baseline references for researchers. Furthermore, our experiments with GraphChase reveal that existing approaches to UNSGs still face challenges in terms of robustness and scalability, and suffer performance degradation when deployed under weighted edge costs, highlighting a sim-to-real generalization gap. GraphChase thus provides a realistic testbed for developing and validating UNSGs solvers under realistic travel-time heterogeneity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 GraphChase，一个用于城市网络安全博弈（UNSG）的开源平台和基准测试。该平台支持在加权和未加权道路网络上建模不同 UNSG 变体，并集成学习算法作为基线。实验表明现有方法在鲁棒性和可扩展性方面仍面临挑战，在加权边成本下性能下降，揭示了 sim-to-real 泛化差距。
Motivation: 目前缺乏标准化的实验平台和真实异质旅行成本基准，限制了 UNSG 领域的研究进展。
Method: 开发 GraphChase 平台，提供统一环境建模多种 UNSG 变体，并集成基于学习的算法作为基线。
Result: 现有方法在加权边成本下性能下降，存在鲁棒性和可扩展性问题。
Conclusion: GraphChase 为开发验证 UNSG 求解器提供了真实测试床，强调现有方法在异质旅行成本下的泛化差距。

papers.title: Bridging Neural Networks and Wireless Systems with MIMO-OFDM Semantic Communications
papers.abstract_en: Semantic communications aim to enhance transmission efficiency by jointly optimizing source coding, channel coding, and modulation. While prior research has demonstrated promising performance in simulations, real-world implementations often face significant challenges, including noise variability and nonlinear distortions, leading to performance gaps. This article investigates these challenges in a multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) and orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM)-based semantic communication system, focusing on the practical impacts of power amplifier (PA) nonlinearity and peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) variations. Our analysis identifies frequency selectivity of the actual channel as a critical factor in performance degradation and demonstrates that targeted mitigation strategies can enable semantic systems to approach theoretical performance. By addressing key limitations in existing designs, we provide actionable insights for advancing semantic communications in practical wireless environments. This work establishes a foundation for bridging the gap between theoretical models and real-world deployment, highlighting essential considerations for system design and optimization.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Wireless Communications, vol. 32, no. 5, pp. 48-55, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于 MIMO-OFDM 的语义通信系统在实际部署中面临的挑战，重点分析功率放大器非线性和峰均比变化的影响。实验表明实际信道的频率选择性是导致性能下降的关键因素，而针对性的缓解策略可使系统接近理论性能。
Motivation: 现有语义通信在仿真中表现良好，但实际实现受噪声变异和非线性失真影响，性能存在显著差距。
Method: 基于 MIMO-OFDM 的语义通信系统，分析功率放大器非线性和峰均比变化，并研究频率选择性信道的影响。
Result: 识别出实际信道的频率选择性是性能下降的关键因素，并证明缓解策略可使系统接近理论性能。
Conclusion: 为弥合理论模型与实际部署之间的差距提供了基础，强调了系统设计和优化的关键考虑。

papers.title: An Improved Variational Method for Image Denoising
papers.abstract_en: The total variation (TV) method is an image denoising technique that aims to reduce noise by minimizing the total variation of the image, which measures the variation in pixel intensities. The TV method has been widely applied in image processing and computer vision for its ability to preserve edges and enhance image quality. In this paper, we propose a Mixed-norm TV (MixTV) model for image denoising and the associated numerical algorithm to carry out the procedure, which is particularly effective in removing several types of noise and their combinations. Our MixTV admits a unique solution and the associated numerical algorithm guarantees convergence. Numerical experiments are demonstrated to show improved effectiveness and denoising quality compared to other TV models. Such encouraging results further enhance the utility of the TV method in image processing. Our project page is available at https://jing-en-huang.github.io/MixTV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合范数全变分（MixTV）模型用于图像去噪。该模型结合多种噪声类型的处理能力，具有唯一解且算法收敛。实验表明在去噪质量和有效性上优于传统TV模型。
Motivation: 经典TV方法在图像去噪中能保持边缘，但对多种噪声及组合噪声的处理效果有限。
Method: 提出MixTV模型，通过混合范数正则化处理多种噪声类型，并设计收敛的数值算法。
Result: 数值实验显示MixTV在去噪质量和有效性上优于其他TV模型。
Conclusion: MixTV模型进一步提升了TV方法在图像处理中的实用性，尤其适用于多种噪声组合场景。

papers.title: Interpretable Clustering: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, much of the research on clustering algorithms has primarily focused on enhancing their accuracy and efficiency, frequently at the expense of interpretability. However, as these methods are increasingly being applied in high-stakes domains such as healthcare, finance, and autonomous systems, the need of transparent and interpretable clustering outcomes has become a critical concern. This is not only necessary for gaining user trust but also for satisfying the growing ethical and regulatory demands in these fields. Ensuring that decisions derived from clustering algorithms can be clearly understood and justified is now a fundamental requirement. To address this need, this paper provides a comprehensive and structured review of the current state of explainable clustering algorithms, identifying key criteria to distinguish between various methods. These insights can effectively assist researchers in making informed decisions about the most suitable explainable clustering methods for specific application contexts, while also promoting the development and adoption of clustering algorithms that are both efficient and transparent. For convenient access and reference, an open repository organizes representative and emerging interpretable clustering methods under the taxonomy proposed in this survey, available at https://hulianyu.xyz/Interpretable-Clustering-Repository
papers.journal_ref: ACM Computing Surveys, Volume 58, Issue 8, Article 215 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是面向可解释聚类算法的综述，系统梳理了当前可解释聚类方法，提出分类标准，并建立了公开的资源库。文章强调在高风险领域（如医疗、金融）中，聚类结果的可解释性对用户信任和合规要求至关重要。
Motivation: 现有聚类算法研究多追求准确率和效率，忽视了可解释性，而高风险应用领域对透明性和可解释性有迫切需求。
Method: 通过文献综述，识别关键区分标准，对可解释聚类算法进行分类和结构化梳理，并建立在线资源库组织代表性方法。
Result: 提供了可解释聚类算法的全面综述和分类框架，有助于研究者根据应用场景选择合适方法。
Conclusion: 可解释聚类是未来重要的研究方向，本文的综述和分类体系可促进该领域的发展和应用。

papers.title: ANVIL: Anomaly-based Vulnerability Identification without Labelled Training Data
papers.abstract_en: Supervised-learning-based vulnerability detectors often fall short due to limited labelled training data. In contrast, Large Language Models (LLMs) are trained on vast unlabelled code corpora, yet perform only marginally better than coin flips when directly prompted to detect vulnerabilities. In this paper, we reframe vulnerability detection as anomaly detection, based on the premise that vulnerable code is rare and thus anomalous relative to patterns learned by LLMs. We introduce ANVIL, which performs a masked code reconstruction task: The LLM reconstructs a masked line of code, and deviations from the original are scored as anomalies. We propose a hybrid anomaly score that combines exact match, cross-entropy loss, prediction confidence, and structural complexity. We evaluate our approach across multiple LLM families, scoring methods, and context sizes, and against vulnerabilities after the LLM's training cut-off. On the PrimeVul dataset, ANVIL outperforms state-of-the-art supervised detectors - LineVul, LineVD, and LLMAO - achieving up to 2x higher Top-3 accuracy, 75% better Normalized MFR, and a significant improvement on ROC-AUC. Finally, by integrating ANVIL with fuzzers, we uncover two previously unknown vulnerabilities, demonstrating the practical utility of anomaly-guided detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ANVIL，将漏洞检测重构为异常检测问题，利用大型语言模型(LLM)进行掩码代码重构，通过混合异常评分（精确匹配、交叉熵损失、预测置信度和结构复杂度）识别异常代码行。在PrimeVul数据集上，ANVIL超越现有监督检测器，Top-3准确率提升2倍，Normalized MFR提升75%，ROC-AUC显著改进。与模糊测试结合后，发现了两个先前未知的漏洞。
Motivation: 监督学习的漏洞检测器因缺乏标注训练数据而性能受限；直接提示LLM检测漏洞效果仅略优于随机猜测。本文旨在利用无标注数据，将漏洞检测转化为异常检测，基于脆弱代码稀少且相对于LLM学习模式异常的前提。
Method: ANVIL执行掩码代码重构任务：LLM重构被掩码的代码行，根据原始行的偏差计算异常分数。提出混合异常评分，结合精确匹配、交叉熵损失、预测置信度和结构复杂度。评估了多种LLM家族、评分方法和上下文大小。
Result: 在PrimeVul数据集上，ANVIL的Top-3准确率是现有最佳监督检测器（LineVul、LineVD、LLMAO）的2倍，Normalized MFR提升75%，ROC-AUC显著提高。与模糊测试集成后，发现了两个先前未知的漏洞。
Conclusion: ANVIL验证了异常检测范式在无标注漏洞检测中的有效性，并展示了与模糊测试结合的实际应用价值。

papers.title: Beyond Spectral Decomposition: Bayesian Contrastive Learning and its Non-negative Formulation via Factor Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Factor analysis, often regarded as a Bayesian variant of matrix factorization, offers superior capabilities in capturing uncertainty, modeling complex dependencies, and ensuring robustness. As the deep learning era arrives, factor analysis is receiving less and less attention due to their limited expressive ability. On the contrary, contrastive learning has emerged as a potent technique with demonstrated efficacy in unsupervised representational learning. While the two methods are different paradigms, recent theoretical analysis has revealed the mathematical equivalence between contrastive learning and matrix factorization, providing a potential possibility for factor analysis combined with contrastive learning. Motivated by the interconnectedness of contrastive learning, matrix factorization, and factor analysis, this paper introduces a novel Contrastive Factor Analysis framework, aiming to leverage factor analysis's advantageous properties within the realm of contrastive learning. To further leverage the interpretability properties of non-negative factor analysis, which can learn disentangled representations, contrastive factor analysis is extended to a non-negative version. Finally, extensive experimental validation showcases the efficacy of the proposed contrastive (non-negative) factor analysis methodology across multiple key properties, including expressiveness, robustness, interpretability, and accurate uncertainty estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对比因子分析（Contrastive Factor Analysis）框架，将因子分析融入对比学习，并扩展到非负版本以学习可解释的分离表示。实验展示了该方法在表达能力、鲁棒性、可解释性和不确定性估计方面的优势。
Motivation: 因子分析作为贝叶斯矩阵分解，具有不确定性建模和鲁棒性优势，但在深度学习时代表现力不足；对比学习虽有效，但理论上与矩阵分解等价。作者希望结合因子分析的优势与对比学习。
Method: 提出对比因子分析框架，将因子分析整合到对比学习中，并扩展为非负对比因子分析以增强可解释性。
Result: 实验验证了所提方法在表达能力、鲁棒性、可解释性和不确定性估计上的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文展示了对比因子分析方法在多方面的优越性能，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Generalization error of min-norm interpolators in transfer learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper establishes the generalization error of pooled min-$\ell_2$-norm interpolation in transfer learning, where data from diverse distributions are available. Min-norm interpolators arise naturally as implicit regularized limits of modern machine learning algorithms. Prior work has characterized their out-of-distribution risk when samples from the test distribution are unavailable during training. In many applications, however, limited test samples may be available at training time, yet properties of min-norm interpolation in this regime remain poorly understood. We address this gap by characterizing the bias and variance of pooled min-$\ell_2$-norm interpolation under both covariate shift and model shift. Our results yield several important implications. In certain cases under model shift, we show that adding data always hurts when the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is low. At higher SNR levels, transfer learning is beneficial provided the shift-to-signal ratio falls below a threshold that we characterize explicitly. Under covariate shift, we find that when the source sample size is small relative to the dimension, greater heterogeneity between domains reduces risk, and vice versa. While our model shift results are initially established for Gaussian designs, we extend them to more general designs through a universality argument. To illustrate the broader applicability of our technical tools beyond interpolation learning, we characterize the risk of a bias-corrected estimator that uses the pooled interpolator as an initialization and corrects the resulting bias with target data. On the technical side, we develop a novel anisotropic local law and a Lindeberg-swapping argument, yielding tools that may be of independent interest in random matrix theory and universality analysis. Finally, we supplement our theory with simulations demonstrating the finite-sample efficacy of our results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了迁移学习中池化最小ℓ2范数插值（min-norm interpolator）的泛化误差，在协变量偏移和模型偏移下刻画了其偏差和方差。结果表明，在模型偏移且信噪比低时添加数据反而有害；高信噪比下，若偏移-信号比低于某阈值则迁移有益。协变量偏移下，源样本量远小于维度时，域间异质性越大风险越低。理论结果通过各向异性局部律和Lindeberg交换论证得到，并推广到更一般的设计。
Motivation: 现有工作刻画了训练时无测试样本时的离域风险，但训练时有少量测试样本的情况理解不足。本文填补了这一空白。
Method: 建立池化最小ℓ2范数插值的偏差和方差分析，针对协变量偏移和模型偏移两种场景；使用各向异性局部律和Lindeberg交换论证作为技术工具，并将模型偏移结果从高斯设计推广到一般设计。
Result: 在模型偏移下，低信噪比时添加数据总有害；高信噪比下，若偏移-信号比低于显式阈值则迁移有益。协变量偏移下，当源样本量远小于维度时，域间异质性增大降低风险；反之则增大风险。
Conclusion: 本文表征了迁移学习中最小平方法插值的泛化误差，揭示了数据添加和域异质性的非单调影响，并提供了可应用于插值学习之外的技术工具。

papers.title: SSM Meets Video Diffusion Models: Efficient Long-Term Video Generation with Structured State Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Given the remarkable achievements in image generation through diffusion models, the research community has shown increasing interest in extending these models to video generation. Recent diffusion models for video generation have predominantly utilized attention layers to extract temporal features. However, attention layers are limited by their computational costs, which increase quadratically with the sequence length. This limitation presents significant challenges when generating longer video sequences using diffusion models. To overcome this challenge, we propose leveraging state-space models (SSMs) as temporal feature extractors. SSMs (e.g., Mamba) have recently gained attention as promising alternatives due to their linear-time memory consumption relative to sequence length. In line with previous research suggesting that using bidirectional SSMs is effective for understanding spatial features in image generation, we found that bidirectionality is also beneficial for capturing temporal features in video data, rather than relying on traditional unidirectional SSMs. We conducted comprehensive evaluations on multiple long-term video datasets, such as MineRL Navigate, across various model sizes. For sequences up to 256 frames, SSM-based models require less memory to achieve the same FVD as attention-based models. Moreover, SSM-based models often deliver better performance with comparable GPU memory usage. Our codes are available at https://github.com/shim0114/SSM-Meets-Video-Diffusion-Models.
papers.comment: Accepted as a workshop paper at ICLR 2024
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散模型在长视频生成中注意力机制计算成本随序列长度二次增长的问题，提出使用状态空间模型（SSM，如Mamba）作为时序特征提取器。实验表明，在256帧序列上，SSM模型在相同FVD下内存消耗更低，或在接近内存下取得更好性能。
Motivation: 现有视频扩散模型依赖注意力层提取时序特征，其计算成本随序列长度二次增长，限制长视频生成。
Method: 将双向SSM（Mamba）替代传统注意力层作为时序特征提取器，利用SSM线性时间内存开销的特性，并验证双向性对视频时序特征捕获的有效性。
Result: 在MineRL Navigate等长视频数据集上，对256帧序列，SSM模型达到与注意力模型相同FVD所需内存更少，或在可比内存下FVD更优。
Conclusion: SSM可作为注意力层的有效替代，实现高效长视频生成，代码已开源。

papers.title: Ensemble Learning Based Classification Algorithm Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Selecting an appropriate classification algorithm for a given data set remains a challenging problem in data mining and machine learning. Existing algorithm recommendation models are typically trained with individual learners and rely on only one type of meta-feature, which may limit their ability to capture the diverse characteristics of classification problems. This paper proposes a multi-view ensemble meta-learning framework for classification algorithm recommendation. The framework constructs base recommendation models from different combinations of heterogeneous meta-feature groups and combines them through an accuracy- and diversity-aware ensemble strategy. The main focus of this work is empirical: we evaluate the proposed method on 1,090 benchmark classification problems derived from 84 public data sets, using 13 widely used candidate classification algorithms and five types of meta-features. The experimental results show that the proposed ensemble recommendation method consistently improves ranking loss, average precision, and top-ranked recommendation precision over individual recommendation models. These results suggest that combining complementary meta-feature views is an effective strategy for robust classification algorithm recommendation.
papers.comment: Added the EML citation and clarified our contribution as a more general multi-view ensemble framework
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多视角集成元学习框架用于分类算法推荐，通过组合不同类型的元特征构建多个基础推荐模型，并基于准确性和多样性进行集成。在1,090个基准分类问题上的实验表明，该方法在排序损失、平均精度和首位推荐精度上均优于单一推荐模型。
Motivation: 现有算法推荐模型通常使用单一学习器和单一类型元特征，难以全面捕捉分类问题的多样特征。
Method: 提出多视角集成元学习框架，从不同异质元特征组构建基础推荐模型，并通过准确性和多样性感知的集成策略组合它们。
Result: 在1,090个分类问题（来自84个数据集）上，使用13种分类算法和5种元特征类型，该方法在排序损失、平均精度和首位推荐精度上一致优于单一推荐模型。
Conclusion: 结合互补的元特征视图是稳健分类算法推荐的有效策略。

papers.title: A binarized-domains arc-consistency algorithm for TCSPs: its computational analysis and its use as a filtering procedure in solution search algorithms
papers.abstract_en: TCSPs (Temporal Constraint Satisfaction Problems) [Dechter et al. 1991] get rid of unary constraints by binarizing them after having added an "origin of the world" variable. In this work, we look at the constraints between the "origin of the world" variable and the other variables, as the (binarized) domains of these other variables. With this in mind, we define a notion of arc-consistency for TCSPs, which we will refer to as binarized-domains Arc-Consistency, or bdArc-Consistency for short. We provide an algorithm achieving bdArc-Consistency for a TCSP, which we will refer to as bdAC-3, for it is an adaptation of Mackworth's [1977] well-known arc-consistency algorithm AC-3. We show that if an STP is bdArc-Consistent, and connected, i.e., its "origin of the world" variable is disconnected from none of the other variables, its binarized domains are minimal. We provide two polynomial backtrack-free procedures: one for the task of getting a solution from a connected bdArc-Consistent STP; the other for the task of getting, from a bdArc-Consistent STP, either that it is inconsistent or, in case of consistency, a connected bdArc-Consistent STP refinement. We then show how to use our results both in a general TCSP solver and in a TCSP-based job shop scheduler. The work also provides an experimental comparison on STPs of bdAC-3 with an existing arc-consistency algorithm, ACSTP, restricted to STPs [Kong et al. 2018]; an experimental comparison of three TCSP-based job shop schedulers, two of which use weak versions of bdAC-3 as the filtering procedure during the search, the third [Schwalb and Dechter 1997] a weak version of path-consistency; and the swi-prolog source codes used by these comparisons. Last but not least, we provide an incremental version of bdAC-3.
papers.comment: The four swi-prolog source codes used in the experimental comparisons are among the uploaded files. Three of these are TCSP-based job shop schedulers highly commented, to make them easily readable, and can be tested on known instances of the JSSP (Job Shop Scheduling Problem), some of which can be found in the source codes themselves
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时序约束满足问题 (TCSP) 提出一种基于二值化域 (binarized domains) 的弧一致性算法 bdAC-3，该算法是 Mackworth AC-3 的改编。论文证明了 STP (Simple Temporal Problem) 在满足 bdArc-Consistent 且连通时其二值化域是最小的，并给出了无回溯的多项式求解过程。论文进一步将算法应用于通用 TCSP 求解器和基于 TCSP 的工作车间调度器，并提供了实验比较和增量版本。
Motivation: TCSP 通过添加“世界起源”变量将一元约束二值化，但现有弧一致性算法未充分利用这种二值化域结构。本文旨在定义针对 TCSP 的弧一致性概念并开发高效算法。
Method: 提出 bdArc-Consistency 定义及其实现算法 bdAC-3（改编自 AC-3）。基于该算法，给出两个多项式无回溯过程：一个从连通 bdArc-Consistent STP 求解；另一个检测不一致性或在一致时得到连通细化。还开发了增量版本 bdAC-3。
Result: 实验比较了 bdAC-3 与现有 STP 弧一致性算法 ACSTP，以及三个基于 TCSP 的工作车间调度器（其中两个使用弱版 bdAC-3 作为搜索过滤，第三个使用弱版路径一致性）。实验使用 swi-prolog 源码。
Conclusion: bdAC-3 算法为 TCSP 提供了一种有效的弧一致性过滤方法，并在工作车间调度中展示了实用性。增量版本提升了效率。

papers.title: FedLAS: Feature-Modulated Bidirectional Label Smoothing for Neural Network Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Deep Neural Network (DNN) classifiers suffer from poor calibration when their softmax outputs (predictive confidence) deviate from the empirical likelihoods. This manifests itself as either overconfident incorrect predictions or under-confident correct predictions. Label smoothing (LS) enhances model calibration by introducing entropy regularization during training through redistributing probability mass from the ground-truth label to the remaining classes. LS, including Margin-based LS (MbLS), have restrictive assumptions: they rely on predefined, uniform smoothing rules and only tackle overconfidence. In reality, samples exhibit diverse characteristics, such as difficulty/ambiguity, that interact with the evolving nature of the model being trained. In training, samples may have various degrees of under- or overconfidence. To overcome this, a mechanism that identifies the specific confidence state of each sample and determines the appropriate degree of smoothing in each training step is needed, tailoring the adjustment to the individual sample. We propose FedLAS: Feature-Modulated Bidirectional Label Smoothing, a plug-and-play algorithm for label smoothing-based losses. In FedLAS, we introduce a Feature Norm-based Confidence Indicator (NCI) to control smoothing and a Bidirectional Calibration Gating (BCG) module to detect both over and under-confidence. Our algorithm can be integrated with LS and MbLS based losses when applied to standard DNNs, enhancing performance. Extensive experiments on standard and fine-grained high-resolution vision benchmarks show that FedLAS consistently improves calibration compared to modern baselines, reducing Expected Calibration Error (ECE) and Adaptive ECE while maintaining Top-1 accuracy. Code: github.com/nadarasarbahavan/FEDLAS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度神经网络分类器的校准问题，提出FedLAS（特征调制双向标签平滑）算法。该算法通过特征范数置信度指示器（NCI）控制平滑程度，并利用双向校准门控（BCG）模块检测过自信和欠自信，从而为每个样本调整标签平滑强度。实验表明，在标准和高分辨率细粒度视觉基准上，FedLAS能持续改善校准性能，降低期望校准误差（ECE）和自适应ECE，同时保持Top-1准确率。
Motivation: 现有标签平滑方法（如Margin-based LS）依赖预定义的统一平滑规则，仅处理过自信问题，无法适应样本的多样性（如困难度、模糊性）和模型训练过程中的动态置信状态。因此需要一种能识别每个样本的具体置信状态并自适应调整平滑度的机制。
Method: 提出FedLAS算法，包含两个关键模块：基于特征范数的置信度指示器（NCI）和双向校准门控（BCG）。NCI通过特征范数控制平滑程度，BCG检测过自信和欠自信，从而实现双向的、样本自适应的标签平滑。该算法可与LS和MbLS损失函数集成。
Result: 在标准和高分辨率细粒度视觉基准上，FedLAS相较于现代基线持续改善校准性能，降低了期望校准误差（ECE）和自适应ECE，同时保持了Top-1准确率。
Conclusion: FedLAS是一种即插即用的标签平滑增强算法，通过特征调制和双向校准有效提升了神经网络分类器的校准性能。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: FedLAS是一种即插即用的标签平滑增强算法，通过特征调制和双向校准有效提升了神经网络分类器的校准性能。

papers.title: Adaptive Iterative Hard Thresholding for Online High-dimensional Quantile Regression
papers.abstract_en: Online high-dimensional regression requires algorithms that can update sequentially while preserving structural sparsity. We propose \textit{Adaptive Iterative Hard Thresholding (AIHT)}, an online sparse-regression framework that alternates stochastic subgradient updates with adaptively scheduled hard-thresholding steps. The key idea is to separate support discovery from local refinement: early in the learning process, AIHT delays thresholding so that weak but informative coordinates have time to accumulate signal, while later it increases the projection frequency to stabilize the sparse estimator and exploit local curvature. We develop the theory for high-dimensional online quantile regression, a challenging setting in which the loss is nonsmooth and the data may exhibit heterogeneity or heavy-tailed noise. Under restricted curvature and gradient-leakage conditions, AIHT remains in an inflated sparse cone, exhibits a two-phase convergence behavior, and attains logarithmic regret for the sliding-window objective. Simulations for online quantile regression, together with threshold-scheduling ablations, support the proposed mechanism and illustrate its advantage over standard online sparse-learning baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应迭代硬阈值（AIHT）框架用于在线高维稀疏回归，采用自适应调度的硬阈值步骤，在早期延迟阈值以积累弱信号，后期增加投影频率以稳定稀疏估计。针对非光滑损失和异质性噪声的高维在线分位数回归，理论证明了在受限曲率和梯度泄露条件下，算法具有两阶段收敛行为和对滑动窗口目标的对数遗憾。
Motivation: 在线高维回归需要在序列更新中保持结构稀疏性，但现有方法在非光滑损失（如分位数回归）和异质性噪声下表现不佳。
Method: 将随机次梯度更新与自适应调度的硬阈值步骤交替进行，通过分离支持发现与局部精化，动态调整阈值频率。
Result: 理论上证明了算法在受限曲率和梯度泄露条件下的两阶段收敛行为和对滑动窗口目标的对数遗憾；模拟实验验证了机制有效性并优于标准在线稀疏学习基线。
Conclusion: AIHT框架有效解决了在线高维分位数回归中的稀疏性保持问题，但仅适用于满足特定条件的问题设置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RIPA: Sensory-Vector Prompt Injection Attacks on LLM-Controlled ROS 2 Robots
papers.abstract_en: We present RIPA, the first systematic multi-channel empirical study of prompt injection attacks delivered through the sensory pipeline of a ROS 2-based LLM-controlled robotic system. Across 100 independent runs per injection variant on five LLMs spanning four model families and parameter scales from approximately 4B to approximately 284B (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Llama-3-8B-Instruct-Lite, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo, Qwen 2.5-7B-Instruct-Turbo, Gemma-3n-E4B), we identify model-specific vulnerability profiles that do not follow a monotonic scaling trend: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo exhibits 100% attack success rate (ASR) across all injection variants, while Llama-3-8B-Instruct-Lite and Qwen 2.5-7B-Instruct-Turbo resist direct-override injection (0% ASR), and the smallest model evaluated (Gemma-3n-E4B, approximately 4B) matches the 70B model's vulnerability profile, indicating that robustness is model-specific rather than scale-dependent. We propose a hybrid semantic firewall that achieves 0% ASR against known injection patterns with no false positives on a preliminary benign set (0/20 commands) but exhibits a 10.2% trial-weighted bypass rate (58/570 trials; N equals 30 per payload across 19 obfuscation payloads) against adversarially obfuscated attacks, exposing a critical gap between rule-based and semantic defense layers. We further introduce three sensory injection channels: visual (Channel 1, via OCR), audio (Channel 2, via Whisper STT), and LiDAR sensor context poisoning (Channel 3). We show that Channel 3, which injects fabricated obstacle data into the robot environment-state representation at the LLM system-prompt level, achieves 100% ASR across all variants on DeepSeek-V4-Flash. We also contribute a firewall bypass taxonomy spanning 19 obfuscation payloads across five categories. All code, data, and results are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统性研究针对基于ROS 2的LLM控制机器人的多通道提示注入攻击（视觉、音频、LiDAR），在5个不同规模LLM上测试攻击成功率（ASR）。实验发现模型脆弱性不随规模单调变化：Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo在所有变体上达到100% ASR，而Llama-3-8B-Instruct-Lite和Qwen 2.5-7B-Instruct-Turbo对直接覆盖注入抵抗（0% ASR），最小模型Gemma-3n-E4B（约4B）表现出与70B模型相似的脆弱性。提出混合语义防火墙，对已知注入模式实现0% ASR，但对抗混淆攻击有10.2%绕过率。LiDAR传感器上下文中毒攻击在DeepSeek-V4-Flash上达到100% ASR。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对LLM控制机器人系统中提示注入攻击的多通道实证分析，特别是在感官输入层面的安全评估。
Method: 在ROS 2机器人平台上，通过视觉OCR、音频Whisper STT、LiDAR传感器上下文中毒三个通道注入恶意提示，测试5个LLM（DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Llama-3-8B-Instruct-Lite, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo, Qwen 2.5-7B-Instruct-Turbo, Gemma-3n-E4B），每个变体运行100次。提出混合语义防火墙（规则层+语义层）防御。
Result: Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo在所有注入变体上ASR为100%；Llama-3-8B-Instruct-Lite和Qwen 2.5-7B-Instruct-Turbo对直接覆盖注入ASR为0%；Gemma-3n-E4B（最小模型）与70B模型脆弱性相当。LiDAR通道在DeepSeek-V4-Flash上ASR为100%。防火墙对已知模式0% ASR，无假阳性，但对19种混淆攻击有10.2%绕过率（58/570 trials）。
Conclusion: 机器人LLM系统的安全漏洞是模型特定的，而非规模依赖；现有混合防火墙在对抗混淆攻击时存在显著差距，需要更鲁棒的防御机制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Analysis of Parameter Settings for the Bat Algorithm Using Variance Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Parameter settings in evolutionary algorithms and metaheuristics are important because such parameter values can influence the performance of algorithms under evaluation. For a given algorithm, there are many different numerical experiments to show that the algorithm can work well in practice; however, in most cases there is no theoretical analysis of parameter settings. In this work, we show that theoretical analysis using the theory of dynamical systems and evolution of population variance can give some good results in terms of parameter ranges for the bat algorithm. We also show that results from numerical experiments are consistent with theoretical bounds. Such analyses can provide good insights from different perspectives about the algorithmic characteristics such as variance evolution, transition between exploration and exploitation as well as convergence behaviour.
papers.journal_ref: Lecture Notes in Computer Science, June 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用动力系统理论和种群方差演化对蝙蝠算法的参数设置进行理论分析，推导出参数的合理范围，并通过数值实验验证理论界限的一致性。分析揭示了方差演化、探索与开发转换以及收敛行为等算法特性。
Motivation: 进化算法和元启发式算法的参数设置通常依赖经验或数值实验，缺乏理论指导。本文针对蝙蝠算法，旨在通过理论分析确定参数范围，以提供更可靠的参数设置依据。
Method: 基于动力系统理论，分析种群方差（variance evolution）的动态过程，从而推导出蝙蝠算法中关键参数的可行范围。
Result: 理论推导出的参数界限与数值实验结果一致，表明理论分析能够有效指导参数设置。
Conclusion: 该理论分析方法为理解蝙蝠算法的方差演化、探索与开发平衡及收敛行为提供了新视角。

papers.title: Obliviate: Erasing Concepts from Autoregressive Image Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: The widespread adoption of generative AI models has intensified concerns about misuse, including the creation of unsafe or disturbing imagery. To mitigate such issues, several concept erasure approaches have been proposed to remove harmful content from multimodal generative models. Yet concept erasure for autoregressive image generation remains largely unexplored, despite the growing relevance of these models in recent trends toward unified multimodal architectures. In this work, we fill this gap by introducing Obliviate, a guidance-based concept erasure method for autoregressive image generation. Our method builds on three key design choices: KL-based supervision over visual token distributions, trajectory-level updates over full autoregressive rollouts, and aligned visual prefixes for stable target construction. We evaluate Obliviate on three state-of-the-art autoregressive text-to-image models, Liquid, Emu3-Gen, and Janus-Pro, covering the erasure of explicit content, graphic violence, and branded imagery. Obliviate consistently outperforms current alternatives, reducing nudity on the defensive RAB benchmark from 91.58 to 3.15 while preserving overall model utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Obliviate，一种用于自回归图像生成模型的概念擦除方法，通过 KL 散度监督视觉 token 分布、轨迹级更新和对齐视觉前缀，在三种模型上有效擦除露骨内容、暴力和品牌图像。
Motivation: 自回归图像生成模型的概念擦除尚未被充分探索，而现有方法主要针对多模态生成模型，无法直接迁移到自回归架构。
Method: Obliviate 基于引导，包括三个关键设计：KL 散度监督视觉 token 分布、全自回归展开的轨迹级更新、以及用于稳定目标构建的对齐视觉前缀。
Result: 在防御 RAB 基准上，裸体内容从 91.58 降至 3.15，同时保持模型整体效用；在三种模型（Liquid、Emu3-Gen、Janus-Pro）上均优于现有替代方法。
Conclusion: Obliviate 填补了自回归图像生成中概念擦除的空白，为统一多模态架构中的安全控制提供了有效方案。

papers.title: The Undecidability of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) Alignment
papers.abstract_en: This article establishes the foundational mathematical limits of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) safety, proving that the core barrier is not the impossibility of an aligned state, but its structural unverifiability. We formalize this boundary through two central impossibility results: the Unverifiability Theorem of Alignment and the Theorem of Finite Structural Unverifiability of AGI Alignment. We ground this boundary at Trakhtenbrot's Wall, demonstrating that contemporary engineering defenses relying on finite hardware or halting architectures fail to escape logical obstructions. This failure manifests as an inescapable triad of containment failures: open domains yield fundamental undecidability (Rice and Gödel); universal finite verification collapses into algorithmic incomputability (Trakhtenbrot); and particular bounded environments trap the supervisor within intractable bounds in the worst case. As a direct structural corollary of these results, we derive the Soundness--Completeness--Tractability Trilemma, establishing that the mutual incompatibility of these three properties is a necessary consequence of descriptive complexity rather than an empirical anomaly. Finally, we map these theoretical bounds onto practical AI engineering, demonstrating that modern containment strategies are not temporary patches, but mandatory sacrifices of logical expressivity required to secure decidable fragments of safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从数学上证明了通用人工智能（AGI）对齐的根本障碍不在于对齐状态的不可能，而在于其结构性不可验证性。作者通过两个核心不可能性定理（对齐的不可验证性定理和AGI对齐的有限结构不可验证性定理）将这一边界定位于Trakhtenbrot墙，并推导出Soundness-Completeness-Tractability三难困境，表明现代遏制策略必须牺牲逻辑表达性以换取可判定的安全片段。
Motivation: 现有AGI对齐研究忽略了结构性不可验证性这一根本障碍，导致依赖于有限硬件或停机架构的工程防御无法摆脱逻辑困境。
Method: 形式化两个不可能性定理（对齐的不可验证性定理和AGI对齐的有限结构不可验证性定理），并推导出关于可靠性、完备性和可处理性的三难困境。
Result: 证明开放域导致基本不可判定性（Rice和Gödel），通用有限验证坍塌为算法不可计算性（Trakhtenbrot），有界环境在坏情况下导致监督者陷入难处理界限。
Conclusion: 现代AGI安全策略不是临时补丁，而是必须牺牲逻辑表达性以换取可判定的安全片段。

papers.title: AEGIR: Modeling Area Emitters for Indoor Inverse Rendering using Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Inverse rendering requires separating illumination from surface materials, which is highly ambiguous due to their tight coupling in observed images. While Gaussian Splatting is efficient for novel view synthesis, existing relightable methods approximate scene lighting using discrete point lights, global environment maps, or implicit representations. By ignoring the physical spatial extent of real-world emitters, these approaches produce incorrect light attenuation and unrealistic shadows. We present AEGIR (Area Emitters for Gaussian Inverse Rendering), a framework that explicitly models local area emitters within a relightable Gaussian Splatting representation. Joint optimization of emitters, materials, and geometry is challenging due to flexible emitter parameterization, which increases both the number of parameters and the ambiguity between illumination and materials. We address this by introducing a differentiable deferred rendering pipeline that integrates multiple importance sampling with targeted regularization. As a result, AEGIR accurately simulates local light transport and achieves more consistent decomposition. Experiments show that explicit area emitters improve illumination reconstruction and enhance downstream tasks, including novel view synthesis, controlled relighting, and virtual object insertion, particularly in scenes with complex local lighting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AEGIR，在可重光照的高斯溅射表示中显式建模局部面光源，通过可微延迟渲染管线结合多重重要性采样和正则化，实现更一致的照明与材质分解，提高室内场景的逆渲染质量。
Motivation: 现有可重光照高斯溅射方法忽略实际光源的空间范围，使用点光源或环境图导致光照衰减错误和阴影不真实，需要更精确的面光源建模。
Method: 在可重光照高斯溅射中引入显式的局部面光源参数化，并设计可微延迟渲染管线，融合多重重要性采样和针对性正则化，联合优化光源、材质和几何。
Result: 实验表明，显式面光源改进了照明重建，并提升了新颖视图合成、可控重光照和虚拟物体插入等下游任务，尤其在复杂局部光照场景中效果显著。
Conclusion: 该框架证明了显式面光源建模对室内逆渲染的重要性，但未提及对室外或动态场景的适用性。

papers.title: Physics-Grounded Disentangled Flow Modeling for Brain Disease Progression Trajectory
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting longitudinal brain lesion evolution is critical for disease monitoring and treatment planning. Existing approaches typically learn a direct mapping from a baseline image to a future observation, without explicitly modeling the physical mechanisms underlying the lesion progression. Such an entangled modeling of structural deformation and image intensity variation limits physical plausibility, model generalization, and interpretability. To address this, we propose PDF, a Physics-grounded Disentangled Flow matching framework for longitudinal brain disease forecasting. We explicitly decompose the longitudinal modeling of lesion growth into two processes, each learned by a dedicated flow matching network: morphology evolution, which captures lesion growth and structural deformation; and intensity evolution, which models signal changes driven by variations in lesion concentration. To enforce physics-grounded constraints, we introduce a PDE-regularized loss based on lesion growth dynamics, that enforces a diffusion-reaction-advection formulation for morphological evolution. Experiments on three public longitudinal datasets spanning diverse brain diseases demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, validating the effectiveness of the disentangled modeling framework and physics-grounded learning design. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/jhuldr/PDF.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个物理驱动的解耦流匹配框架（PDF）用于纵向脑疾病进展预测。该方法将病变演化分解为形态演化（结构变形）和强度演化（信号变化），并引入基于病变生长动力学的PDE正则化损失。在三个公开数据集上取得最优性能。
Motivation: 现有方法直接从基线图像映射到未来图像，未显式建模病变进展的物理机制，导致缺乏物理合理性和可解释性。
Method: 提出PDF框架，使用两个独立的流匹配网络分别学习形态演化和强度演化；引入基于扩散-反应-平流方程的PDE正则化损失约束形态演化。
Result: 在三个多样脑疾病纵向数据集上取得最先进性能，验证了解耦建模和物理驱动学习的有效性。
Conclusion: 解耦建模和物理约束有助于提高模型泛化性和可解释性。

papers.title: Envisage: Diffusion-Based Rhinoplasty Goal Visualization with Mask-Decomposed Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Localized generative editing needs localized evaluation: full-image identity metrics are structurally confounded under hard-composited edits. We present Envisage, a FLUX.1-Fill inpainting reference pipeline for rhinoplasty goal visualization from a single frontal photograph. The pipeline combines 8 rhinoplasty clinical presets (the released framework also includes 8 blepharoplasty and 8 rhytidectomy presets), MediaPipe masks, and hard-mask compositing. The composite preserves outside-mask pixels by construction, so full-face identity scores are dominated by copied pixels rather than by the diffusion backbone. Because full-face identity metrics cannot grade localized edits, we introduce SurgicalScore, a mask-decomposed 0-1 protocol scoring edit direction, edit magnitude, masked LPIPS, realism, and outside-mask preservation; SS_raw assigns 0.919 [0.918, 0.920] to a perfect-predictor control , anchoring the ceiling. On N=211, the paired ArcFace gain (output-to-GT minus input-to-GT) is negative for all methods (Envisage -0.048 smallest, vs. ICEdit -0.139, Kontext -0.242, InstructPix2Pix -0.294; p < 1e-4), with external validation on a 457-pair ASPS/PCA corpus showing a larger negative gap. With SurgicalScore, Envisage achieves the highest score (0.599 [0.579, 0.619]) and leads on both metrics, but the all-negative ArcFace gap shows that full-face identity is poorly aligned with localized surgical accuracy under hard compositing. A 5-seed GT-oracle (an upper bound, not a deployable result) reduces the residual ArcFace gap by 73% (-0.054 to -0.015), with positive output-to-GT gain on 33.9% of cases, indicating candidate-space headroom for a learned ranker. For localized edits, progress should be measured with edit-region fidelity rather than full-face identity metrics. We release Envisage, SurgicalScore, preset definitions, and matched split manifests.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Envisage，一个基于 FLUX.1-Fill 扩散模型的鼻整形目标可视化管道，结合 8 种临床预设、MediaPipe 掩码和硬掩码合成。针对局部生成编辑缺乏局部评估的问题，引入掩码分解的 0-1 评估协议 SurgicalScore。实验表明，在硬组合编辑下，全脸身份指标与局部手术准确性不一致，Envisage 在 SurgicalScore 上表现最佳（0.599），但所有方法的 ArcFace 增益均为负值。
Motivation: 局部生成编辑需要局部评估，但全图身份指标（如 ArcFace）在硬组合编辑下因保留未编辑像素而主导分数，无法准确衡量编辑区域的质量。
Method: 提出 Envisage 管道，使用 FLUX.1-Fill 扩散模型对单张正面照片进行鼻整形目标可视化，包含 8 种临床预设、MediaPipe 掩码和硬掩码合成。同时提出 SurgicalScore，一种掩码分解的 0-1 评估协议，分别衡量编辑方向、编辑幅度、掩码区域 LPIPS、真实感和掩码外保留度。
Result: 在 N=211 数据集上，所有方法的 ArcFace 增益均为负（Envisage -0.048 最小，优于其他方法），但 Envisage 在 SurgicalScore 上取得最高分 0.599 [0.579, 0.619]。外部验证（457 对 ASPS/PCA 语料库）显示更大的负 ArcFace 差距。5 种子 GT 预言机（上限）将残余 ArcFace 差距减少 73%，并在 33.9% 案例中实现增益为正。
Conclusion: 对于局部编辑，应该使用编辑区域保真度（如 SurgicalScore）而非全脸身份指标（如 ArcFace）来衡量进展。

papers.title: SIGNET: Motion-Level Knowledge Transfer for Cross-Language Sign Language Translation
papers.abstract_en: Sign language translation (SLT) remains challenging due to its high spatio-temporal complexity, long sequences, and the need to model multiple articulators without relying on gloss annotations. Existing approaches are typically tailored to individual datasets or languages and struggle to scale, while overlooking the relationships between sign languages that could inform more effective cross-lingual transfer. We present \textbf{SIGNET}, a framework that enables motion-level knowledge transfer for cross-language sign language translation. Our key insight is that, although sign languages differ in grammar and lexicon, pretrained models capture motion-level visual patterns that can be reused across datasets and languages. \textbf{SIGNET} integrates multiple pretrained sign language backbones through an attention-based, hand-prior aggregation mechanism that guides a gated fusion network in dynamically selecting the most relevant experts. Comprehensive experiments on four benchmarks (How2Sign, Phoenix14T, CSL-Daily, and MeineDGS) demonstrate state-of-the-art translation performance, and \textbf{SIGNET} also surpasses prior methods on WLASL for sign language recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SIGNET框架，实现运动级知识迁移的跨语言手语翻译。该框架集成多个预训练手语主干，通过基于注意力的手部先验聚合机制引导门控融合网络动态选择最相关专家。在How2Sign、Phoenix14T、CSL-Daily和MeineDGS四个基准上取得最先进翻译性能，并在WLASL手语识别任务上超越先前方法。
Motivation: 现有手语翻译方法通常针对单个数据集或语言设计，难以扩展，且忽略了不同手语之间的运动级模式关系，限制了跨语言迁移的有效性。
Method: 提出SIGNET框架，利用预训练手语模型捕捉的运动级视觉模式，通过注意力机制聚合手部先验，指导门控融合网络动态选择多个预训练主干中的最相关专家。
Result: 在How2Sign、Phoenix14T、CSL-Daily和MeineDGS四个基准上取得最先进翻译结果，并在WLASL手语识别任务上超越先前方法。
Conclusion: 验证了运动级知识迁移对于跨语言手语翻译的有效性，为多语言扩展提供了新思路。

papers.title: In-Vehicle Digital Twin-Based Collision Warning Framework with Sybil Attack Detection
papers.abstract_en: Connected Vehicles (CVs) rely extensively on communication technologies to enable data-driven predictive analyses for enhancing performance and safety. These communication channels can be exploited by adversaries to launch cyberattacks such as Sybil attacks, which could threaten both safety-critical and mobility applications, leaving CVs vulnerable and putting human lives at risk. As CV deployment continues to expand, the need to detect and mitigate cyberattacks in real-time becomes increasingly urgent. This study presents an in-vehicle Digital Twin (DT)-based collision warning framework with built-in capabilities for Sybil attacks detection. The framework integrates a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) for learning temporal dependencies in vehicle trajectory data and Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) algorithms for efficient similarity-based classification. Our framework is evaluated on real-world Sybil attack data, collected through field experiments. The framework achieved accuracy, recall, and F1 scores of 0.984, 1.00, and 0.944, respectively, in detecting Sybil-generated fake vehicles. During the safety evaluation, the framework reduced the mean Time Exposed Time-To-Collision (TET) and mean Time Integrated Time-To-Collision (TIT) of near-collision events by 88% and 72%, respectively. Furthermore, real-world feasibility evaluation shows that the framework conformed to the standardized maximum allowable latency for safety applications and operated well within the capacity of modern processors -- demonstrating the promise of an in-vehicle DT-based framework as an attack mitigation mechanism against Sybil attacks for next-generation CVs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于车载数字孪生 (Digital Twin) 的碰撞预警框架，并内置 Sybil 攻击检测能力。该框架结合时间卷积网络 (TCN) 学习车辆轨迹的时间依赖性和层次可导航小世界 (HNSW) 算法进行相似性分类。实验表明，在真实 Sybil 攻击数据上，检测准确率达到 0.984，召回率 1.00，F1 分数 0.944，并将近碰撞事件的平均暴露时间 (TET) 和平均积分时间 (TIT) 分别降低 88% 和 72%。框架满足安全应用的最大允许延迟，并可在现代处理器上高效运行。
Motivation: 网联车辆依赖通信技术，但 Sybil 攻击等网络威胁会危及安全和移动应用。随着网联车辆部署扩大，实时检测和缓解网络攻击的需求日益迫切。
Method: 提出一个车载数字孪生框架，集成时间卷积网络 (TCN) 学习时间依赖性和层次可导航小世界 (HNSW) 算法进行基于相似性的分类，用于 Sybil 攻击检测和碰撞预警。
Result: 在真实 Sybil 攻击数据上，检测准确率 0.984，召回率 1.00，F1 0.944；安全评估中，近碰撞事件的 TET 降低 88%，TIT 降低 72%；满足安全应用延迟要求且计算负荷在处理器能力范围内。
Conclusion: 该研究展示了一个车载数字孪生框架作为对抗 Sybil 攻击的缓解机制的有效性，且具备实时可行性和安全性收益，适合下一代网联车辆。

papers.title: Improving Patient Subtyping on Longitudinal Data using Representations from Mamba-based Architecture
papers.abstract_en: Effective sub-typing (also known as grouping or clustering) of patients using their electronic health record (EHR) data can greatly inform precision medicine efforts. However, subtyping temporal EHR datasets is known to be challenging due to inherent EHR issues, including complexity and irregularity. In this study, we propose a self-supervised Mamba-based model that learns effective EHR representations and enables enhanced patient subtyping. We evaluate the proposed model on public and private real-world EHR datasets to classify the data based on the available labels and subtype patients based on the representations learned from the model. Through an extensive set of experiments, we demonstrate that our model's design choices lead to better performance compared to competitive baseline models for prediction. Moreover, we evaluate several clustering techniques to demonstrate that our findings offer valuable insights into subtyping patients based on temporal records from EHR models\footnote{Our implementations are available at https://github.com/healthylaife/triplet_mamba.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电子健康记录（EHR）时序数据的患者亚型分类任务，提出一种基于Mamba架构的自监督表示学习模型。通过在公开和私有真实世界EHR数据集上的实验，该模型在预测任务上优于竞争基线，且结合多种聚类技术可有效从时序记录中识别患者亚型。
Motivation: EHR时序数据的复杂性和不规则性使得患者亚型分类极具挑战，而精准医学需要更有效的亚型划分方法。
Method: 提出一种自监督的Mamba模型，学习EHR数据的有效表示，并利用所学表示进行患者亚型聚类。
Result: 在多个真实EHR数据集上，该模型的预测性能优于竞争基线模型，且聚类实验表明其能提供有意义的患者亚型洞察。
Conclusion: Mamba架构的自监督学习能够有效捕获EHR时序数据的关键特征，为患者亚型分类提供新工具。

papers.title: Meshtryoshka: Differentiable Rendering of Real-World Scenes via Mesh Rasterization
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable rendering has emerged as a powerful approach for 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis. State-of-the-art differentiable rendering methods combine a variety of custom representations of 3D geometry and appearance with specialized renderers. However, most downstream tasks in computer graphics rely on 3D meshes. While prior work has attempted differentiable rendering with mesh representations, these approaches are limited to object-centric scenes and fail to reconstruct large-scale, unbounded scenes. In this work, we introduce Meshtryoshka, a novel mesh differentiable rendering framework that combines an off-the-shelf triangle rasterizer with a 3D representation that consists of nested mesh shells which resemble a matryoshka doll. In every forward pass, the mesh shells are extracted anew from a 3D signed distance function via iso-surface extraction, and the opacities for each vertex are computed as a function of signed distance. Each mesh shell is then rasterized independently, and the final image is created via alpha compositing. Crucially, mesh vertex positions are updated only indirectly via gradients that flow through the opacity values into the signed distance function, and hence, our method is compatible with off-the-shelf mesh renderers that need not be differentiable with respect to vertex positions. On object-centric scenes, our method performs competitively with surface-based differentiable rendering techniques. Our differentiable mesh rendering method scales to unbounded, real-world 3D scenes, where it yields high-quality novel view synthesis results approaching those of state-of-the-art, non-mesh methods. Our method suggests that it may be possible to solve the differentiable rendering problem without relying on specialized renderers, only using conventional tools from the computer graphics toolbox.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Meshtryoshka，一种可微分网格渲染框架，利用嵌套网格壳（类似套娃）表示和现成的三角形光栅化器，实现对真实世界场景的高质量新视图合成，无需专用渲染器。
Motivation: 现有可微分渲染方法多依赖自定义几何和外观表示及专用渲染器，而大多数计算机图形任务使用网格表示；先前基于网格的可微分渲染方法局限于物体中心场景，无法处理大规模无界场景。
Method: 通过符号距离函数等值面提取动态生成嵌套网格壳，每个壳的顶点不透明度由符号距离计算；各壳独立光栅化后通过alpha合成得到最终图像；顶点位置通过流过不透明度梯度的符号距离函数间接更新，兼容现成的非可微分光栅化器。
Result: 在物体中心场景上与基于表面的可微分渲染技术表现相当；在无界真实场景中取得接近非网格方法的高质量新视图合成结果。
Conclusion: 该方法表明无需依赖专用渲染器，仅使用计算机图形学常规工具即可解决可微分渲染问题。

papers.title: Reproducing FACTER: Fairness via Conformal Thresholding and Prompt Repair
papers.abstract_en: Fayyazi et al. (2025) recently proposed FACTER, a model-agnostic framework designed to jointly enforce fairness and statistical coverage in LLM-based recommendation through conformal thresholding and iterative prompt repair. In this work, we conduct a reproducibility study of the FACTER framework across diverse architectures and dataset sparsity levels, evaluating both the original open-ended generation task and a constrained re-ranking extension. Under the strict reproduction, we observe a divergence in recommendation utility, which we trace to underspecified target-set evaluation in the original study. We then use the constrained re-ranking setting to evaluate FACTER when the candidate set is fixed, and introduce a static Fair Zero-Shot baseline to isolate the contribution of the iterative prompt repair loop. Our analysis shows that FACTER consistently reduces adaptive-threshold violation counts, but that these reductions are not consistently reflected under the fixed threshold or in global fairness metrics. In the constrained ranking setting, static fairness instructions achieve comparable semantic-parity outcomes to FACTER's dynamic repair loop, suggesting that the additional online repair mechanism provides limited benefit in this formulation. All code and reproduction artifacts are available at https://github.com/oscar-omlf/facter-repr.
papers.comment: 29 pages. Accepted by Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=4BPFVex4EM. Code: https://github.com/oscar-omlf/facter-repr
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 对FACTER框架的可重复性研究，发现其在LLM推荐中通过保形阈值和提示修复实现公平性，但严格复现时推荐效用存在差异，归因于目标集评估不明确。在受限重排序设置中，静态公平指令能达到与动态修复循环相当的语义公平性，表明动态修复的收益有限。
Motivation: 验证FACTER框架的可重复性，并探究其在开放生成和受限重排序任务中的实际表现，识别原研究中的评估歧义。
Method: 严格复现FACTER，引入受限重排序扩展和静态公平零样本基线，对比动态修复循环与静态指令的效果。
Result: FACTER一致减少自适应阈值违规次数，但固定阈值和全局公平性指标未一致反映改善；在受限排名中，静态指令与动态修复的语义公平性结果相当。
Conclusion: 动态提示修复机制在受限候选集中收益有限，静态公平指令可作为更简单的替代方案。

papers.title: Randomized Exploration for Linear Bandits via Absolute Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: In stochastic linear bandits, the canonical Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) algorithm admits a simple frequentist regret analysis but can be computationally demanding, while Thompson Sampling (TS) is computationally attractive yet typically harder to analyze due to its non-optimistic nature. We propose Absolute Thompson Sampling (ATS), a simple modification of TS that ensures optimism in expectation by replacing the signed exploration noise with its absolute value. This preserves the computational efficiency of TS while avoiding the technically involved anti-concentration arguments common in TS analyses, enabling a simple UCB-style regret analysis. We show that ATS achieves $\tilde{O}(d^{3/2}\sqrt{K})$ regret, matching existing bounds for TS in linear bandits. We further introduce Ensemble Absolute Thompson Sampling (EATS), which takes the maximum over multiple absolute perturbations with normalization by the ensemble size. As the ensemble size grows, EATS converges to the UCB objective, recovering UCB behavior in the limit. Experiments show that moderate ensemble sizes already yield strong performance. Our results point to a bridge between randomized exploration and deterministic optimism both in theory and practice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出绝对汤普森采样（ATS），一种线性随机bandit的随机探索算法，通过将探索噪声替换为绝对值来确保期望乐观性，从而简化UCB风格遗憾分析。进一步提出集成绝对汤普森采样（EATS），取多个绝对扰动的最大值并归一化，随集成规模增大趋向UCB行为。实验表明中等集成规模已能取得良好性能。
Motivation: 标准UCB算法计算成本高，而汤普森采样虽计算高效但分析困难（缺乏乐观性）。本文旨在设计一种兼具计算效率和易分析性的随机探索方法。
Method: 将汤普森采样中的有符号噪声替换为绝对值，得到ATS；进一步引入EATS，对多个绝对扰动取最大值并用集成规模归一化，可解释为逼近UCB目标。
Result: ATS达到$\tilde{O}(d^{3/2}\sqrt{K})$遗憾界，匹配线性bandit中TS的已知界；EATS在中等集成规模下表现接近UCB。
Conclusion: ATS和EATS桥接了随机探索与确定性乐观主义，理论上和分析上均具有优势，但仅适用于线性bandit设置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What LLMs explain is not what they believe: Evaluating explanation sufficiency under models' own input beliefs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains, where free-text explanations such as chain-of-thought and post-hoc rationales are used to justify model outputs. Yet it remains unclear whether these explanations are sufficient, i.e., if they contain enough information to explain the model's output-generating process. We generalize classical sufficiency from feature attributions to arbitrary explanations and prove that explanation sufficiency can change depending on the input distribution, which must be explicitly defined for LLM explanations. We propose using the LLM itself to generate alternative inputs conditioned on an explanation, capturing its beliefs about possible inputs. We formalize self-consistent sufficiency as a goal for free-text explanations and introduce an information-theoretic metric, SCSuff, that enables evaluation of free-text explanations without relying on predefined biases or shortcuts. Our experiments show that SCSuff agrees with targeted perturbation tests where applicable and demonstrate that explanation sufficiency can vary with the input distribution. We find LLM explanations are generally insufficient and weakly correlated with model size, accuracy, or output entropy. Analysis of final-token hidden states shows that top and bottom SCSuff scores can be predicted from internal representations, suggesting that SCSuff can guide detection and improvement of sufficient LLM explanations. The code for this paper is available at https://github.com/rajesh-lab/self-consistent-sufficiency .
papers.comment: 23 pages, 9 figures, 13 tables, Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.journal_ref: Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）的自由文本解释（如 chain-of-thought）是否充分，即能否解释模型输出生成过程。作者将经典充分性从特征归因推广到任意解释，证明充分性依赖于输入分布，并利用LLM自身生成替代输入来评估解释充分性。提出信息论指标SCSuff，实验表明LLM解释通常不充分，且与模型大小、准确率等弱相关。
Motivation: LLM在高风险场景中常用自由文本解释，但这些解释是否充分尚不清楚。
Method: 推广经典充分性概念，利用LLM自身生成替代输入，提出自一致充分性目标，并设计信息论指标SCSuff。
Result: SCSuff与针对性扰动测试一致；LLM解释通常不充分，且与模型大小、准确率、输出熵弱相关；从最终token隐藏状态可预测SCSuff高低。
Conclusion: 研究提出评估LLM解释充分性的方法，发现现有解释不充分，并指出可检测和改进的途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fast and Accurate Outlier-Aware LiDAR Super-Resolution for SLAM Applications
papers.abstract_en: This work tackles the challenge of enhancing low-resolution LiDAR sensors for SLAM applications through a novel Deep Unrolling-based Super-Resolution (SR) model. We integrate an outlier removal module to ensure structural integrity while maintaining real-time performance. By leveraging a model-based optimization approach, our method efficiently reconstructs high-resolution point clouds while minimizing computational overhead. The proposed SR model is evaluated within a LiDAR SLAM framework, demonstrating significant improvements in pose estimation accuracy and efficiency compared to state-of-the-art SR methods.
papers.journal_ref: Proc. 2025 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP), Anchorage, AK, USA, 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度展开（Deep Unrolling）的LiDAR超分辨率模型，集成离群点移除模块，用于SLAM应用中的低分辨率LiDAR传感器增强。该方法在保持实时性能的同时，有效重建高分辨率点云，并在LiDAR SLAM框架中显著提升位姿估计精度和效率。
Motivation: 低分辨率LiDAR传感器在SLAM应用中定位精度受限，现有超分辨率方法要么计算开销大，要么对离群点敏感，难以兼顾实时性与结构完整性。
Method: 采用模型驱动的深度展开（Deep Unrolling）结构，联合优化超分辨率重建与离群点移除，通过迭代优化最小化计算负担，实现高效点云上采样。
Result: 在LiDAR SLAM框架中，该方法相比现有超分辨率方法显著提升了位姿估计精度和效率（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，结合离群点感知的深度展开超分辨率模型能在实时性约束下有效提升低分辨率LiDAR数据的质量，从而改善SLAM性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IMU-HOI: A Symbiotic Framework for Coherent Human-Object Interaction and Motion Capture via Contact-Conscious Inertial Fusion
papers.abstract_en: Capturing full-body human motion with object interactions is crucial for AR/VR and robotics applications, yet it remains challenging for conventional vision-based methods due to occlusions and constrained capture volumes. Inertial measurement units (IMUs) offer a compelling alternative without line-of-sight requirements, but existing IMU-based motion capture assumes an isolated human and ignores object contacts and dynamics. To bridge this gap, we present IMU-HOI, a novel framework that jointly recovers full-body human pose and 6-DoF object trajectory from sparse IMUs on the body and object, explicitly modeling human-object interaction. Our approach first infers probabilistic hand-object contacts directly from IMU streams and uses them as a high-level signal to route between kinematic and inertial reasoning. These contact cues drive a three-stage fusion pipeline that refines human pose and root translation, and fuses hand-based forward kinematics with object-IMU integration for object motion, yielding coherent, drift-resilient trajectories for both human and object. Experiments on challenging human-object interaction scenarios demonstrate substantial accuracy gains over prior inertial motion capture methods. Moreover, IMU-HOI can be plugged into existing sparse-IMU mocap backbones with minimal changes, effectively extending the scope of purely inertial motion capture from isolated humans to full human-object interaction and joint motion estimation.
papers.journal_ref: Proc. IEEE/CVF Conf. Comput. Vis. Pattern Recognit. (CVPR), 2026, pp. 42901-42910
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: IMU-HOI是一个从稀疏IMU（惯性测量单元）信号中联合恢复全身人体姿态和物体6自由度轨迹的框架，通过显式建模人-物交互。该方法首先从IMU流直接推断概率性的手-物接触，并将其作为高层信号引导运动学和惯性推理，然后通过三阶段融合流水线优化人体姿态、根部平移以及物体运动，生成对人体和物体都一致的漂移鲁棒轨迹。实验表明在挑战性人-物交互场景中相比纯惯性方法精度显著提升。
Motivation: 现有的基于IMU的运动捕捉假设人体孤立，忽略了物体接触和动力学，而视觉方法受遮挡和捕获体积限制。需要一种能同时处理人体和物体交互的惯性融合方法。
Method: 提出三阶段融合流水线：首先从身体和物体上的稀疏IMU推断概率性手-物接触；然后利用接触线索优化人体姿态和根部平移；最后融合基于手部的正向运动学与物体IMU积分，得到物体运动轨迹。
Result: 在挑战性人-物交互场景中，相比先前的惯性运动捕捉方法取得了显著的精度提升。
Conclusion: IMU-HOI可轻松插入现有稀疏IMU动捕主干，将纯惯性运动捕捉从孤立人体扩展到完整的人-物交互和联合运动估计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Database Context Compression for Text-to-SQL on Real-World Large Databases
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress in Text-to-SQL has been driven by stronger language models and prompting strategies, yet performance on real enterprise benchmarks such as Spider 2.0 and BIRD remains far below that on classical academic datasets. We argue that the main bottleneck is no longer reasoning, but database representation. Real databases contain repeated audit columns, large groups of similar tables, opaque identifiers whose meanings are stored only in documentation, and extensive data dictionaries with little query-relevant information. Existing query-aware methods, including schema linking and retrieval-based schema selection, filter this raw context but still operate on redundant and verbose representations. We reformulate the problem as database context compression, a query-agnostic transformation that rewrites schemas, semantic descriptions, and external documentation into a compact representation. We formalize this transformation with the SGCF (Support-Gain Component Factorization) principle, which unifies repeated column extraction, isomorphic table templating, semantic componentization, and evidence purification under a single coverage objective. Based on SGCF, we propose DBCC, a database-side middleware that performs offline structural and semantic compression together with lightweight online evidence purification. DBCC is model-agnostic and can be integrated into existing Text-to-SQL pipelines. On Spider 2.0-Snow and BIRD, DBCC reduces input context by up to two orders of magnitude (from 2.6M to 34.7K tokens on the largest Spider 2.0-Snow subset), improves schema-linking strict recall from 0% to 56.5% under DeepSeek-V3.2 (63.1% under Claude Opus 4.7), and consistently increases end-to-end execution accuracy by 1.8-1.9% over three recent Text-to-SQL systems. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/MrBlankness/SchemaCompression.

Result: 在Spider 2.0-Snow上，输入上下文从2.6M tokens降至34.7K tokens；schema-linking strict recall从0%提升至56.5%（DeepSeek-V3.2）和63.1%（Claude Opus 4.7）；在三个近期Text-to-SQL系统上端到端执行准确率一致提升1.8-1.9%。

papers.title: Neuromorphic Energy-Aware Learning for Adaptive Deep Brain Stimulation
papers.abstract_en: Neuromorphic and edge computing research has focused on reducing the inference cost of neural network controllers, yet in physical closed-loop systems the actuator can rival or exceed an efficient controller in energy. An efficient controller is therefore necessary but not sufficient, because the actuator becomes the cost worth reducing once inference no longer dominates it. Here, we introduce energy-aware learning, an approach that incorporates actuator energy directly into the reinforcement learning reward, and demonstrate it in closed-loop deep brain stimulation (DBS) for Parkinson's disease. A deep spiking Q-network, trained in a biophysical cortico-basal ganglia-thalamic circuit model, learns to suppress pathological alpha-beta oscillations by 45.2% while reducing stimulation charge by 80.0% relative to continuous DBS. Sparsity-constrained knowledge distillation compresses the policy onto the SynSense XyloAudio 3 neuromorphic processor at 0.52 mW inference power, yielding 28.1x lower energy per inference than an equivalent artificial neural network on conventional edge hardware. By co-optimizing stimulation energy and inference efficiency, the framework addresses both major power demands in implantable neuromodulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出能量感知学习，将执行器能耗直接加入强化学习奖励，用于自适应深部脑刺激。在帕金森病闭环DBS中，深度脉冲Q网络实现抑制病理振荡45.2%并减少刺激电荷80%，通过知识蒸馏部署到神经形态处理器，推理功耗仅0.52 mW。
Motivation: 现有研究多聚焦降低神经网络推理能耗，但物理闭环系统中执行器能耗可能占主导，因此需要联合优化两者。
Method: 将刺激能量纳入强化学习奖励函数，训练深度脉冲Q网络；利用稀疏性约束知识蒸馏将策略压缩到神经形态硬件。
Result: 抑制α-β振荡45.2%，刺激电荷减少80%；在XyloAudio 3上推理功耗0.52 mW，比等效ANN边缘硬件低28.1倍。
Conclusion: 框架通过协同优化刺激能量和推理效率，解决了植入式神经调控的两大功耗问题。

papers.title: Conformal Prediction with Macro-Coverage Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Prediction sets should have high coverage to be useful, but some coverage notions are more practically relevant than others. In the classification setting, class-conditional coverage requires that the prediction set (i.e., the set of candidate labels for a new test point) must achieve the target accuracy level within each class, which may be challenging to satisfy when many classes are rare and have few calibration points. At the other extreme, marginal coverage requires only that coverage holds on average over the distribution of all classes, which can lead to low-probability labels being essentially ignored. To find a middle ground, recent work has introduced macro-coverage, defined as the unweighted average of class-conditional coverages. Macro-coverage offers a compromise between marginal coverage and class-conditional coverage that is particularly appropriate for long-tailed settings. In this work, we show that label-weighted conformal prediction can be used to produce prediction sets with a finite-sample macro-coverage guarantee, and more generally a guarantee on a family of generalized macro-coverage objectives that aggregate coverage at the level of arbitrary class groupings and take a weighted average. We further characterize the form of the smallest prediction sets satisfying a given generalized macro-coverage objective and propose a corresponding conformal score function. We validate our theoretical results on two large-scale image classification datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分类任务中的预测集覆盖保证，提出使用标签加权保形预测（label-weighted conformal prediction）实现有限样本下的宏观覆盖（macro-coverage）保证，并推广到广义宏观覆盖目标。理论上刻画了满足给定广义宏观覆盖目标的最小预测集形式，并设计了相应的保形得分函数。在两类大规模图像分类数据集上验证了理论结果。
Motivation: 现有保形预测的边际覆盖（marginal coverage）在长尾分布下可能忽略低概率类别，而类别条件覆盖（class-conditional coverage）对稀有类别要求过高。宏观覆盖（macro-coverage）作为折中，适用于长尾场景，但缺乏有限样本保证。
Method: 将标签加权保形预测应用于宏观覆盖目标，推导出一般化宏观覆盖目标的有限样本保证，并给出满足该保证的最小预测集结构，进而提出对应的保形得分函数。
Result: 在两个大规模图像分类数据集上的实验验证了所提方法能够实现预期的宏观覆盖保证，且预测集尺寸较小。
Conclusion: 标签加权保形预测可有效提供宏观覆盖的有限样本保证，为长尾分类中的预测集构建提供了实用解决方案。

papers.title: Animation2Code: Evaluating Temporal Visual Reasoning in Video-to-Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: While recent vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved significant improvements on static visual-to-code tasks such as generating code for webpages, charts, or SVGs, it remains unclear whether they can recover temporal dynamics when motion is present. To this end, we introduce Animation2Code, a benchmark for evaluating temporal visual reasoning via reconstructing executable web animation code from videos. Animation2Code consists of 1,069 web animation videos with diverse visual appearances and motion patterns, paired with corresponding HTML/CSS/JavaScript implementations. We propose two human-aligned metrics, appearance similarity and temporal similarity, which allow us to disentangle visual fidelity from temporal alignment when comparing rendered animations against ground-truth samples. Benchmarking state-of-the-art VLMs on this dataset shows that current VLMs struggle to maintain temporal consistency in reconstruction, even when achieving high appearance similarity, including under finetuning and iterative refinement settings. Code and data are available at https://anya-ji.github.io/animation2code-website .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Animation2Code 基准，用于评估视觉-语言模型从视频重建可执行网页动画代码时的时序视觉推理能力。基准包含 1069 个动画视频及对应的 HTML/CSS/JavaScript 代码，并引入外观相似性和时序相似性两个指标。实验表明，现有 VLM 在保持时序一致性方面表现不佳。
Motivation: 现有视觉到代码生成任务多聚焦静态场景，缺乏对动态时序推理能力的评估。
Method: 构建 Animation2Code 数据集，设计外观相似性和时序相似性指标，分别衡量视觉保真度和时序对齐。
Result: 当前 VLM 在重建中难以维持时序一致性，即使外观相似性较高，微调或迭代细化也无法显著改善。
Conclusion: 动画代码生成对时序视觉推理提出挑战，现有模型存在明显不足。

papers.title: Search for Truth from Reasoning: A Dynamic Representation Editing Framework for Steering LLM Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Current approaches to enhance Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning, such as Chain-of-Thought and "Wait" prompts, primarily encourage models to think more, yet often fail to guide them toward Truth. While Representation Editing (RepE) offers a intrinsic control, its application to dynamic reasoning trajectories remains underexplored. In this work, we bridge this gap by investigating the geometry of truth within unfolding reasoning chains. We uncover three critical insights: (1) Truth is encoded at the sentence level and is entangled with latent reasoning patterns; (2) Effective intervention follows an Uncertainty Principle and a Decay Effect, requiring localization to early, high-entropy forks; (3) Naive steering vectors suffer from noise, risking collateral damage to correct trajectories. Based on these findings, we propose DynaSteer, a dynamic RepE framework. DynaSteer employs pattern clustering to disentangle reasoning manifolds and utilizes Fisher-LDA to project purified truth. By dynamically monitoring lookahead entropy, it selectively steers and rolls back trajectories only when necessary. Comprehensive experimental results on several MATH benchmark verify the effectiveness of DynaSteer, and experiments on out-of-domain coding tasks further confirm its generalization ability. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/tianlwang/DynaSteer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将表示编辑（RepE）应用于动态推理轨迹，通过分析推理链中真理的几何结构，发现真理在句子级别编码且与潜在模式纠缠，有效干预遵循不确定性原理和衰减效应，因此提出了DynaSteer框架，利用模式聚类和Fisher-LDA提炼真理，并动态监控前瞻熵来选择性引导和回滚轨迹。在MATH基准和跨领域编码任务上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有方法如思维链和“等待”提示主要鼓励模型多思考，但未能引导模型趋向真理；表示编辑虽然提供内在控制，但在动态推理轨迹中的应用尚不充分。
Method: 提出DynaSteer动态表示编辑框架：通过模式聚类解缠推理流形，使用Fisher-LDA投影纯化的真理，动态监控前瞻熵，仅在必要时选择性引导和回滚轨迹。
Result: 在MATH基准上验证了有效性，并在跨领域编码任务上确认了泛化能力。
Conclusion: 实验结果表明DynaSteer能有效引导LLM推理轨迹趋向真理，且具备泛化性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SatSplat: Geometrically-Accurate Gaussian Splatting for Satellite Imagery
papers.abstract_en: High-resolution satellite imagery demands 3D reconstruction methods that deliver both speed and geometric accuracy. Recent adaptations of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to satellite imagery demonstrate strong efficiency, but reconstruction quality often degrades under diverse illumination across multi-date, high-altitude acquisitions (with small intersection angles), limiting applicability to remote sensing and vision tasks. We present SatSplat, the first framework to adapt 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) to satellite photogrammetry, with online camera adjustment. We approximate satellite cameras with an affine model and learn a minimal delta parameterization for in-splat camera refinement from dense observations. The formulation is implemented with a 2DGS scene representation. To handle time-varying shadows and illumination changes, we integrate geometric shadow mapping and per-camera color correction during training. Across the evaluated DFC2019 and IARPA2016 benchmark sites, SatSplat achieves strong geometric accuracy while significantly outperforming prior 3DGS-based baselines. On our processed DFC2019 benchmark, SatSplat reduces mean absolute error by 11.93% and peak video memory by 31% relative to the previous state of the art. Our approach enables large-scale digital surface modeling with practical computational efficiency. The project page is available at https://gdaosu.github.io/satsplat/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SatSplat，首个将 2D 高斯溅射 (2DGS) 适配到卫星摄影测量并集成在线相机调整的框架。通过仿射模型近似卫星相机、学习最小 delta 参数化进行视场内相机精化，并结合几何阴影映射和逐相机颜色校正处理多时相光照变化。在 DFC2019 和 IARPA2016 基准上，SatSplat 相比基于 3DGS 的基线显著提升几何精度，并将平均绝对误差降低 11.93%、峰值显存减少 31%。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 方法在卫星影像多时相、高海拔（小交会角）采集条件下，重建质量因光照变化而退化，限制了遥感应用。
Method: 采用 2DGS 场景表示，用仿射模型近似卫星相机，并通过在线学习最小 delta 参数实现相机自校准；引入几何阴影映射和逐相机颜色校正处理时变阴影与光照。
Result: 在 DFC2019 上，平均绝对误差降低 11.93%，峰值视频内存减少 31%；在 IARPA2016 上同样取得优于 3DGS 基线的几何精度。
Conclusion: SatSplat 实现了兼顾几何精度与计算效率的大规模数字表面模型重建，为卫星影像 3D 重建提供了新方案。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 SatSplat，首个将 2D 高斯溅射 (2DGS) 适配到卫星摄影测量并集成在线相机调整的框架。通过仿射模型近似卫星相机、学习最小 delta 参数化进行视场内相机精化，并结合几何阴影映射和逐相机颜色校正处理多时相光照变化。在 DFC2019 和 IARPA2016 基准上，SatSplat 相比基于 3DGS 的基线显著提升几何精度，并将平均绝对误差降低 11.93%、峰值显存减少 31%。

papers.title: Correct codes for the wrong reasons? validating LLMs as measurement instruments for theoretical constructs
papers.abstract_en: When a large language model (LLM) codes a construct in text as a human annotator would, that agreement makes the LLM a reliable coder. Yet reliability leaves construct validity untouched. The instrument may be theory-naive, reaching the code through a correlate that meets none of the demands the construct's theory makes, and no current method tells that apart from genuine measurement. We propose grain calibration as a method that closes the gap. It decomposes a construct into clause-level components, tests each against the text with extractive evidence, and combines the results through an explicit, theory-derived rule. Because the rule is stated rather than lodged in one opaque pass, its structure is evidence about the process rather than the output. It shows which components settled a code, and, when the code is wrong, whether a component was missed or an adjacent construct mistaken for it. Validation shifts from scoring an instrument's outputs against an annotator to showing that the instrument runs on the construct its theory specifies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出LLM作为测量工具时，与人类编码者的一致性只表明可靠性，未触及构念效度（construct validity）。作者提出粒度校准（grain calibration）方法，将理论构念分解为子句级组件，用抽取式证据逐一检验，并通过显式理论规则组合结果。该方法旨在揭示编码过程而非仅输出，从而区分真实测量与虚假相关。
Motivation: 当前LLM编码器与人类的一致只能证明可靠性，无法识别模型是否通过表面关联达到正确编码，从而无法区分真正的构念测量与基于无关相关物的错误测量。
Method: 粒度校准法将目标构念按理论分解为子句级组件，对每个组件在文本中寻找抽取式证据，并使用显式的理论导出规则整合各组件结果，从而暴露决策过程而非仅依赖最终输出。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值或性能指标，仅提出该框架用于验证构念效度，通过分解组件的证据和显式规则来区分正确测量与虚假相关。
Conclusion: 验证的重心应从评分仪器输出与人类标注的一致性，转向证明仪器确实运行于其理论指定的构念上。粒度校准提供了实现这一转变的方法。
Relevance: 0
