papers.title: SMaRT: Online Reusable Resource Assignment and an Application to Mediation in the Kenyan Judiciary
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the problem of assigning mediators to cases in the Kenyan judicial system, we study an online resource allocation problem where incoming tasks (cases) must be immediately assigned to available, capacity-constrained resources (mediators). The resources differ in their quality, which may need to be learned. In addition, resources can only be assigned to a subset of tasks that overlaps to varying degrees with the subset of tasks other resources can be assigned to. The objective is to maximize task completion while satisfying soft capacity constraints across all the resources. The scale of the real-world problem poses substantial challenges, since there are over 2000 mediators, and a multitude of combinations of geographic locations (87) and case types (12) that each mediator is qualified to work on. Together, these features-unknown quality of new resources (newly onboarded mediators), soft capacity constraints (due to the mandate to assign cases without delay), and high-dimensional state space-make existing scheduling and resource allocation algorithms either inapplicable or inefficient. We formalize the problem in a tractable manner, using a quadratic program formulation for assignment and a multi-agent bandit style framework for learning. We demonstrate the key properties and advantages of our new algorithm, SMaRT (Selecting Mediators that are Right for the Task), compared with baselines on some stylized instances of the mediator allocation problem. We then turn to considering its application to real-world data on cases and mediators from the Kenyan Judiciary. SMaRT outperforms baselines and allows for controlling the tradeoff between the strictness of the capacity constraints and overall case resolution rates, both in situations where mediator quality is known beforehand and when the problem is bandit-like in that learning is part of the problem definition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线可重用资源分配问题，受肯尼亚司法系统中调解员分配案件的启发。问题特点包括：任务需立即分配、资源容量软约束、资源质量未知且需学习、资源仅能处理部分重叠的任务子集。作者形式化为二次规划分配与多智能体 bandit 学习框架，提出 SMaRT 算法。在模拟和肯尼亚司法真实数据上，SMaRT 优于基线，并能平衡容量约束严格性与案件解决率。
Motivation: 肯尼亚司法系统有超过2000名调解员、87个地理位置和12种案件类型组合，现有调度算法因资源质量未知、软容量约束和高维状态空间而无法直接应用或效率低下。
Method: 将问题形式化为在线资源分配，采用二次规划（quadratic program）进行分配决策，并引入多智能体 bandit 框架来学习新调解员的质量。提出 SMaRT 算法，在每轮分配中求解优化问题，同时利用历史反馈更新质量估计。
Result: 模拟实例和肯尼亚司法真实数据实验显示，SMaRT 在案件解决率上优于多个基线，并能通过调整约束严格程度控制容量违规与案件解决率的权衡，在已知质量和 bandit 学习场景下均有效。
Conclusion: SMaRT 能够处理大规模、动态的在线资源分配问题，为肯尼亚司法调解提供可部署的方案，且框架具有通用性可拓展至其他类似场景。

papers.title: General and Efficient Steering of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Steering diffusion models toward conditions unseen during training typically requires either retraining with conditional inputs or per-step gradient computations, both of which incur substantial computational overhead. We present Noise-Aligned RFM Steering (NA-RFM), a general recipe for efficiently steering diffusion models without gradient guidance during inference, enabling fast controllable generation. The method combines two offline-computed signals: noise alignment, a high-noise correction from PCA statistics of the target examples and the full data, and Recursive Feature Machine (RFM) activation steering, which learns a target-discriminative direction from labeled forward-process activations. During sampling, noise alignment provides coarse control at high noise, while the RFM direction is reused over intermediate/late timesteps through lightweight activation edits. Experiments on CIFAR-10, ImageNet, CelebA, and fine-grained bird species show improved target accuracy over gradient-based post-hoc guidance baselines, improved FID on the class-guidance benchmarks, and substantial inference speedups. Code: https://github.com/isotrivial/na-rfm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出噪声对齐RFM引导（NA-RFM）方法，无需梯度引导即可高效引导扩散模型，结合噪声对齐和递归特征机激活引导，在CIFAR-10、ImageNet等数据集上提升目标精度和FID，并大幅加速推理。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型引导方法需重新训练或逐步梯度计算，计算开销大，缺乏高效通用的无梯度引导方案。
Method: 结合两种离线信号：噪声对齐（基于目标样本和全数据的PCA统计高噪声校正）和RFM激活引导（从带标签前向过程激活中学习目标判别方向），采样时高噪声阶段用噪声对齐，中后期用RFM方向进行轻量激活编辑。
Result: 在CIFAR-10、ImageNet、CelebA和细粒度鸟类数据集上，相比梯度后验引导基线，目标精度提升，类引导基准FID改善，推理速度大幅加快。
Conclusion: NA-RFM为扩散模型提供了一种通用、高效的无梯度推理时引导方案，适用于可控生成。

papers.title: ImprovEvolve: Basin-Hopping Meets LLM-Guided Evolutionary Search
papers.abstract_en: LLM-guided evolutionary computation, most notably AlphaEvolve, has been remarkably successful in discovering novel mathematical constructions by solving challenging optimization problems. The standard approach is to evolve a monolithic program that directly outputs a candidate solution. We present ImprovEvolve, an algorithmic alternative that drastically reduces cognitive load on the LLM. Instead of prompting the model for an end-to-end optimizer, we evolve a program with three specialized operators of initialization, local improvement, and perturbation. We then approach the optimum by iteratively applying local improvements and intensity-scheduled perturbations, effectively driving a basin-hopping search with LLM-evolved subroutines. For hexagon in hexagon packing, ImprovEvolve discovers new state-of-the-art packings of 11, 12, 15, and 16 hexagons, and additionally for 14, 17, and 23 hexagons after minimal expert tuning of the generated code. For the second autocorrelation inequality, the evolved and human-scaled program pushes the lower bound from 0.96102 to 0.96258. For spherical codes, the ImprovEvolve program lowers the best-known maximum cosine for the majority of 90 randomly chosen diverse state-of-the-art spherical codes, achieving relative improvements of up to 2.4%.
papers.comment: 40 pages, 14 figures, AI for Math Workshop at ICML 2026

Motivation: 现有LLM引导演化方法（如AlphaEvolve）要求模型直接输出端到端优化器，认知负荷大。本文旨在通过分解算子降低对LLM的依赖。

Conclusion: 摘要强调该架构显著降低LLM认知负荷，并在多个数学优化问题上取得实质性改进，表明分解式演化算子的有效性。

papers.title: Aligning Language Model Benchmarks with Pairwise Preferences
papers.abstract_en: Language model benchmarks are pervasive and computationally-efficient proxies for real-world performance. However, many recent works find that benchmarks often fail to predict real utility. Towards bridging this gap, we introduce benchmark alignment, where we use limited amounts of information about model performance to automatically update offline benchmarks, aiming to produce new static benchmarks that predict model pairwise preferences in given test settings. We then propose BenchAlign, the first solution to this problem, which learns preference-aligned weightings for benchmark questions using the question-level performance of language models alongside ranked pairs of models that could be collected during deployment, producing new benchmarks that rank previously unseen models according to these preferences. Our experiments show that our aligned benchmarks can accurately rank unseen models according to models of human preferences, even across different sizes, while remaining interpretable. Overall, our work provides insights into the limits of aligning benchmarks with practical human preferences, which stands to accelerate model development towards real utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基准对齐（benchmark alignment）问题，旨在利用有限模型性能信息自动更新离线基准，使其预测模型在给定测试设置中的成对偏好。作者提出BenchAlign方法，通过学习问题级别的偏好对齐权重，利用模型在问题上的表现和部署中收集的模型排名对，生成能根据偏好对未见模型排序的新基准。实验表明对齐后的基准能准确根据人类偏好模型排序，跨模型大小有效且可解释。
Motivation: 现有语言模型基准常未能预测实际效用，本文旨在弥合这一差距。
Method: 提出BenchAlign，利用模型在问题上的表现和模型排名对，学习偏好对齐的问题权重，生成预测成对偏好的新基准。
Result: 实验显示对齐后的基准能准确根据人类偏好模型对未见模型排序，跨模型大小仍有效，且保持可解释性。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了将基准与实际人类偏好对齐的局限性，有助于加速面向实际效用的模型开发。

papers.title: Inference-Time Diversity in RL-Trained Lean Theorem Provers: A Diagnostic Study
papers.abstract_en: RL-trained Lean theorem provers mode-collapse at inference time: on miniF2F-test with DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL, doubling the i.i.d.\ sampling budget from $k{=}32$ to $k{=}64$ produces zero additional solved theorems (42/244 in both cases). A fixed schedule of 15 tactic skeletons breaks this plateau and recovers a $+45%$ relative improvement at $k{=}16$ (mean $Δ= +12.3 \pm 4.2$ theorems across $n{=}3$ seeds, sign preserved in every seed). A controlled diversity ablation rules out the prompt-diversity confound: tactic skeletons help, paraphrases match the baseline, and irrelevant Lean comments actively degrade. A leave-one-out formalization-difficulty stratification reveals a structural-content gradient across the three perturbations. The phenomenon is RL-specific: V1.5-Base proves zero theorems regardless of intervention, identifying RL as the stage that creates the proof capability which subsequently collapses; extending to two additional 7B Lean provers, RL-trained DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B contributes $+3$ frontier solves no i.i.d. baseline can reach despite a flat aggregate, while SFT-trained Goedel-Prover does not ( $-10.0$ $\pm 4.4$ theorems, $n{=}3$, sign preserved every seed). Inference-time structural diversity is a cheap, complementary axis for RL-trained provers, orthogonal to scaling model size or training compute.
papers.comment: 9 pages, accepted at the ICML AI4Math Workshop 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断了RL训练的Lean定理证明器在推理时的模式坍缩（mode-collapse）问题：在miniF2F-test上，将DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL的i.i.d.采样预算从k=32翻倍至k=64并未额外解决任何定理（42/244）。固定15个策略骨架（tactic skeletons）打破了这一平台，在k=16时带来+45%的相对改进（平均Δ=+12.3±4.2，n=3个种子，每个种子均显著）。控制实验排除了提示多样性的混杂因素：策略骨架有效，改写（paraphrases）与基线持平，无关的Lean注释则显著退化。逐项留出的形式化难度分层揭示了三种扰动间的结构性内容梯度。该现象是RL特有的：V1.5-Base无论何种干预都解决零定理，表明RL创建了证明能力但随后坍缩；扩展到另外两个7B Lean证明器，RL训练的DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B贡献了+3个前沿解（i.i.d.基线无法达到），而SFT训练的Goedel-Prover则没有（-10.0±4.4，n=3，每个种子均显著）。推理时结构多样性是RL训练证明器的一种廉价、正交的补充维度，与缩放模型大小或训练计算量正交。
Motivation: RL训练的Lean定理证明器在推理时会出现模式坍缩，增加采样预算无法带来新的定理证明，这限制了证明能力的上限，且该现象的成因尚不明确。
Method: 通过固定策略骨架（15个）、改写提示、插入无关注释三种干预手段，在DeepSeek-Prover-V1.5-RL上系统诊断推理时多样性的影响，并扩展至其他7B模型（DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B和Goedel-Prover）验证RL特异性。
Result: 在miniF2F-test上，固定策略骨架使k=16时相对提升+45%（平均+12.3个定理）；改写与基线持平；无关注释降低性能。RL特有的现象：V1.5-Base无任何成功；DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B贡献+3个前沿解，而Goedel-Prover表现更差（-10.0个）。
Conclusion: 推理时结构多样性（如策略骨架）是一种廉价、正交的改进方式，适用于RL训练的先验证明器，与缩放模型或计算量互补。模式坍缩主要归因于RL训练阶段而非预训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Monte Carlo Query Search: Active Capability Assessment of AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Black-box AI (BBAI) systems, including foundation-model agents, are increasingly used for sequential decision making. Safe deployment requires methods for characterizing what such systems can do, when they can do it, and what outcomes may result. We introduce Monte Carlo Query Synthesis (MCQS), an active query-synthesis method for learning symbolic stochastic capability models of BBAIs. MCQS models capabilities as conditional probability distributions over outcomes and formulates capability learning as an active learning problem over policies. Our approach uses Monte Carlo tree search to synthesize queries that induce BBAI execution trajectories with high discriminative value between extremal hypothesis models: the lattice meet and join corresponding to the most pessimistic and optimistic hypotheses consistent with the observations. Executing these queries with the agent yields information-rich state-action trajectories that speed up learning by pruning inconsistent hypotheses. We prove soundness, completeness, and convergence properties under standard realizability and sampling assumptions. Experiments with multiple BBAI systems show that MCQS learns accurate capability models more efficiently than baseline query strategies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出蒙特卡洛查询合成（MCQS）方法，用于主动学习黑盒AI系统的符号随机能力模型。MCQS通过蒙特卡洛树搜索合成高判别性查询，快速剪枝不一致假设，并证明了完备性和收敛性。实验显示MCQS比基线查询策略更高效地学习准确能力模型。
Motivation: 黑盒AI系统在序列决策中的应用日益广泛，安全部署需要表征其能力、适用条件及可能结果，但缺乏系统性的主动能力评估方法。
Method: 提出MCQS方法，将能力建模为结果的条件概率分布，并通过主动查询策略选择具有高判别性的策略，利用蒙特卡洛树搜索合成查询，使用格论中的最小上界和最大下界作为极值假设来加速学习。
Result: 在多个黑盒AI系统上的实验表明，MCQS比基线查询策略更高效地学习准确的能力模型，且具备可靠性理论保证。
Conclusion: MCQS为黑盒AI系统的能力评估提供了一种主动、高效且理论完备的方法，适用于基础模型代理等复杂系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Investigating ECG Diagnosis with Ambiguous Labels using Partial Label Learning
papers.abstract_en: Label ambiguity is an inherent and largely unaddressed challenge in real-world electrocardiogram (ECG) diagnosis, arising from overlapping conditions and diagnostic disagreements. However, current ECG models are trained assuming clean and non-ambiguous annotations, limiting both the development and meaningful evaluation of models under real-world conditions. Although Partial Label Learning (PLL) frameworks are designed to learn from ambiguous labels, their effectiveness in medical time-series domains, ECG in particular, remains largely underexplored. We present the first systematic study of PLL methods for ECG diagnosis under both real and controlled ambiguity. First, we adapt nine PLL algorithms to multi-label ECG diagnosis under label ambiguity, and perform detailed evaluations on real clinical settings with multi-annotator diagnostic disagreements. Next, to study PLL effects on ECG in more depth under controlled settings, we introduce a diverse set of clinically motivated synthetic label ambiguities. Our experiments demonstrate that PLL methods vary substantially in robustness across ambiguity types and levels. Moreover, we observe that PLL generally outperforms standard supervised training under label ambiguity, highlighting the value of such frameworks. Through extensive analysis, we identify key limitations of current PLL approaches for clinical settings and outline future directions for developing robust and clinically aligned ambiguity-aware learning frameworks for ECG diagnosis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了部分标签学习（PLL）在心电图（ECG）诊断中的应用，应对标签歧义问题。作者将九种PLL算法适配到多标签ECG诊断，并在真实临床多标注者歧义和受控合成歧义下进行评估。实验表明PLL在标签歧义下优于标准监督训练，但也识别了当前PLL方法在临床环境中的关键局限。
Motivation: 当前ECG模型假定标注干净无歧义，但真实世界ECG诊断存在固有的标签歧义，如重叠病症和诊断分歧。PLL框架虽设计用于模糊标签，但在医学时间序列领域（特别是ECG）尚未充分探索。
Method: 将九种现有的部分标签学习（PLL）算法适配到多标签ECG诊断任务；引入一组临床驱动的合成标签歧义，用于受控实验；在真实临床多标注者诊断分歧数据上进行评估。
Result: PLL方法在不同歧义类型和水平下的鲁棒性差异显著；总体而言，PLL在标签歧义下优于标准监督训练。
Conclusion: 作者指出了当前PLL方法在临床环境中的关键局限，并为开发鲁棒且临床对齐的歧义感知学习框架提出了未来方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoSPlan: Corrective Sequential Planning via Scene Graph Incremental Updates
papers.abstract_en: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown promising planning capabilities, yet their success remains confined to the text domain, leaving visual decision-making relatively underexplored. Addressing this gap, we introduce Corrective Sequence Planning (CoSPlan) benchmark, where VLMs must plan a sequence of visual actions from an initial scene to a target scene. CoSPlan evaluates models on their ability to imagine and execute a coherent set of visual steps required to reach the goal (Step Completion). To prevent any shortcuts that simply describe the final scene, we introduce an erroneous action in decision-making, which must be detected (Error Detection) and corrected to reach the goal, enabling a deeper understanding of the task. CoSPlan spans across 4 tasks: maze navigation, block re-arrangement, image reconstruction, and object re-organization. Despite using advanced reasoning strategies such as Chain-of-Thought and Scene Graphs, VLMs struggle on CoSPlan, while still showing promising performance in the text domain. Addressing this, we propose Scene Graph Incremental updates (SGI), a novel training-free method to transform images into `textual' scene graphs, enabling step-by-step reasoning through iterative scene graph refinement. SGI yields an average of ~4.4% improvement on CoSPlan w/ generalization on PlanBench and VQA. Link for solving puzzles on the project page.

papers.title: Warm-Starting Iterative Gaussian Processes for Faster Sequential Inference
papers.abstract_en: Efficient Gaussian process (GP) inference is critical for sequential decision-making tasks such as active learning, online prediction, and Bayesian optimization. Iterative approaches of approximating the GP posterior using solvers like conjugate gradients, stochastic gradient descent, or alternating projections avoid cubic costs, but often require many iterations to converge, limiting their efficacy when the posterior is updated frequently with new data. To address this, we introduce three warm-start strategies that exploit solutions of smaller linear systems to substantially speed-up convergence when updating the posterior with new data. Our methods are supported by theoretical analysis showing reduced initialization error in reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) distance, and by empirical results on regression benchmarks and Bayesian optimization tasks. Across solvers, warm-starting achieves speed-ups of up to 19x when solving to tolerance, and produces more accurate posterior estimates under fixed compute budgets, directly improving optimization performance. These results establish warm-starting as a simple, effective, and broadly applicable tool for scaling Gaussian processes in sequential settings.
papers.comment: Previous version appeared as Improving Iterative Gaussian Processes via Warm Starting Sequential Posteriors in SPIGM Workshop, NeurIPS 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高斯过程在顺序推断中每次更新后验时迭代求解收敛慢的问题，提出三种热启动策略，利用先前较小线性系统的解来初始化当前求解过程。理论分析表明该方法降低了RKHS距离的初始化误差，实验在回归和贝叶斯优化任务上实现最高19倍的加速，并在固定计算预算下获得更准确的后验估计。
Motivation: 高斯过程的迭代近似方法（如共轭梯度、SGD）虽避免了立方复杂度，但在数据频繁更新的顺序场景中需要大量迭代才能收敛，限制了其效率。
Method: 提出三种热启动策略，通过重用之前较小线性系统的解来初始化当前迭代求解，减少收敛所需的迭代步数。
Result: 在回归和贝叶斯优化基准上，热启动在达到容差时加速高达19倍，并在固定计算预算下输出更准确的后验估计，直接提升优化性能。
Conclusion: 热启动被证明是一种简单、有效且广泛适用的工具，可用于扩展高斯过程在顺序推断场景中的应用。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Skin-R1: Clinical Knowledge-Guided Dermatological Diagnosis Using Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision--language models (VLMs) have recently shown promise for assisting clinical reasoning in dermatological diagnosis. However, their trustworthiness and clinical utility remain limited by three key challenges: heterogeneous datasets with inconsistent diagnostic labels and concept annotations, the lack of grounded diagnostic rationales for reliable reasoning supervision, and limited scalability when transferring knowledge from small, densely annotated datasets to large collections with sparse labels. To address these challenges, we propose Skin-R1, a dermatology-oriented VLM that integrates textbook-grounded clinical reasoning supervision with reinforcement learning (RL) to improve the accuracy and robustness of diagnostic prediction. First, we construct a textbook-based reasoning generator that synthesizes hierarchy-aware and differential-diagnosis (DDx) diagnostic trajectories derived from authoritative dermatology knowledge. Second, these trajectories are used for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), establishing a clinically grounded reasoning foundation for the model. Finally, we introduce an RL training framework that incorporates the hierarchical structure of dermatological diseases into the reward design, enabling the model to generalize grounded diagnostic reasoning to large-scale datasets with sparse annotations. Extensive experiments across multiple dermatology benchmarks demonstrate that Skin-R1 consistently improves diagnostic accuracy and robustness compared to state-of-the-art Med-VLM baselines. Ablation studies further highlight the critical role of grounded reasoning supervision introduced during the SFT stage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Skin-R1 是一种针对皮肤病诊断的视觉-语言模型 (VLM)，通过整合基于教科书的临床推理监督和强化学习 (RL) 来提高诊断准确性和鲁棒性。它构建了教科书推理生成器，合成层级感知和鉴别诊断 (DDx) 轨迹，用于监督微调 (SFT)，并通过 RL 框架将疾病层级结构纳入奖励设计，以泛化到大规模稀疏标注数据集。在多个皮肤病基准测试上，Skin-R1 一致优于现有 Med-VLM 基线。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 在皮肤病诊断中面临三个挑战：数据集标签不一致、缺乏可解释的诊断推理监督、从小规模标注数据集向大规模稀疏标注数据集迁移时扩展性差。
Method: 提出三阶段方法：1）基于权威教科书生成层级感知和 DDx 诊断轨迹；2）用这些轨迹进行 SFT，建立临床推理基础；3）设计 RL 训练框架，将皮肤病层级结构融入奖励，使模型泛化到稀疏标注数据。
Result: 在多个皮肤病基准上，Skin-R1 一致提升了诊断准确性和鲁棒性，消融实验表明 SFT 阶段引入的基于推理的监督至关重要。
Conclusion: Skin-R1 通过整合教科书推理监督和 RL，有效提升了皮肤病 VLM 的临床推理能力和泛化性，但实验仅局限于皮肤病领域，泛化到其他医学领域尚未验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable Synthesis of distributed LLM workloads through Symbolic Tensor Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing the performance of large language models (LLMs) on large-scale AI training and inference systems requires a scalable and expressive mechanism to model distributed workload execution. Such modeling is essential for pre-deployment system-level optimizations (e.g., parallelization strategies) and hardware design-space explorations. While recent efforts have proposed collecting execution traces from real systems, access to large-scale infrastructure remains limited to major cloud providers. Moreover, traces capturing execution on a specific platform cannot be easily adapted to study alternate software and/or hardware configurations, especially at scale. We introduce STAGE, a framework that synthesizes high-fidelity execution graphs to accurately model distributed AI workloads (including LLMs and MoEs). STAGE supports a comprehensive set of parallelization strategies, allowing users to systematically explore a wide spectrum of model architectures and system configurations. STAGE demonstrates its scalability by synthesizing high-fidelity LLM traces spanning over 128K GPUs, while preserving tensorlevel accuracy in compute, memory, and communication. STAGE is publicy available at https://github.com/astra-sim/stage
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出STAGE框架，通过符号张量图合成高保真执行图，用于建模大规模分布式LLM和MoE工作负载。支持多种并行策略，可扩展至128K GPU，并保持张量级精度。框架已开源。
Motivation: 分布式AI系统优化需要可扩展的建模机制，但大规模基础设施访问受限，且现有轨迹难以适配不同软硬件配置。
Method: STAGE框架，基于符号张量图合成执行图，支持数据、张量、流水线等多种并行策略，并模拟计算、内存和通信。
Result: 可合成超过128K GPU的高保真LLM轨迹，保持张量级精度。
Conclusion: STAGE可用于预部署并行策略优化和硬件设计空间探索，已开源。

papers.title: Gradient Boosted Mixed Models: Flexible Estimation of Mean and Variance Components for Clustered Data
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Gradient Boosted Mixed Models (GBMixed), a framework which extends boosting to clustered data by jointly modeling the mean and variance components in a linear mixed model via likelihood-based gradients. GBMixed estimates a nonparametric fixed effects function characterizing the overall mean of the response, while also allowing the random effects covariance matrix along with the residual variance to depend on covariates in a flexible manner. We demonstrate how GBMixed facilitates covariate-dependent random effect predictions, and subsequently point predictions and prediction intervals for individual treatment effects, that can adapt between population-level and cluster-level information. Simulations and applications to two real-world datasets demonstrate that GBMixed can accurately recover complex nonlinear fixed effect functions and covariate-dependent covariances in a linear mixed model, while also improving point and probabilistic predictive performance compared with several existing approaches such as parametric linear mixed models, Natural Gradient Boosting, and Gaussian Process Boosting.
papers.comment: 35 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出梯度提升混合模型（GBMixed），将提升方法扩展到聚类数据，通过似然梯度联合建模线性混合模型中的均值和方差分量。GBMixed可估计非参数固定效应函数，并允许随机效应协方差矩阵和残差方差随协变量灵活变化。模拟和两个真实数据集表明，GBMixed能准确恢复复杂的非线性固定效应和协变量依赖的协方差，并在点预测和概率预测上优于参数线性混合模型、自然梯度提升和高斯过程提升等方法。
Motivation: 现有提升方法主要针对独立数据，无法有效处理聚类数据中的方差分量建模，且缺乏对协变量依赖的随机效应协方差的灵活性。
Method: 提出GBMixed框架，基于似然梯度同时更新固定效应和方差分量（包括随机效应协方差和残差方差），并通过boosting迭代实现非参数估计。
Result: 模拟和两个真实数据集实验表明，GBMixed在恢复非线性固定效应和协方差结构方面表现准确，在点预测和概率预测上优于参数线性混合模型、自然梯度提升和高斯过程提升。
Conclusion: GBMixed为聚类数据提供了一种灵活的均值和方差分量建模方法，可生成适应群体和聚类信息的预测，但未提及在降水或气象领域的应用。

papers.title: The Alignment Auditor: A Bayesian Framework for Verifying and Refining LLM Objectives
papers.abstract_en: The objectives that Large Language Models (LLMs) implicitly optimize remain dangerously opaque, making trustworthy alignment and auditing a grand challenge. While Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) can infer reward functions from behaviour, existing approaches either produce a single, overconfident reward estimate or fail to address the fundamental ambiguity of the task (non-identifiability). This paper introduces a principled auditing framework that re-frames reward inference from a simple estimation task to a comprehensive process for verification. Our framework leverages Bayesian IRL to not only recover a distribution over objectives but to enable three critical audit capabilities: (i) Quantifying and systematically reducing non-identifiability by demonstrating posterior contraction over sequential rounds of evidence; (ii) Providing actionable, uncertainty-aware diagnostics that expose spurious shortcuts and identify out-of-distribution prompts where the inferred objective cannot be trusted; and (iii) Validating policy-level utility by showing that the refined, low-uncertainty reward can be used directly in RLHF to achieve training dynamics and toxicity reductions comparable to the ground-truth alignment process. Empirically, our framework successfully audits a detoxified LLM, yielding a well-calibrated and interpretable objective that strengthens alignment guarantees. Overall, this work provides a practical toolkit for auditors, safety teams, and regulators to verify what LLMs are truly trying to achieve, moving us toward more trustworthy and accountable AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个贝叶斯审计框架（Alignment Auditor），用于验证和精炼大型语言模型（LLM）的隐含目标。该框架通过贝叶斯逆强化学习（Bayesian IRL）恢复目标分布，支持量化与降低非可辨识性、提供不确定性感知的诊断以及验证策略层面的效用。实验表明，该方法能成功审计一个去毒化的LLM，生成校准且可解释的目标，增强对齐保障。
Motivation: LLM隐含优化的目标不透明，现有逆强化学习方法要么给出单一过度自信的奖励估计，要么未能解决任务根本的模糊性（非可辨识性），使得可信对齐和审计成为难题。
Method: 将奖励推理从简单估计任务重新定义为验证过程，利用贝叶斯IRL恢复目标的分布，通过多轮证据的后验收缩来量化非可辨识性，并提供不确定性诊断来识别虚假捷径和分布外提示，最后用精炼的低不确定性奖励直接用于RLHF。
Result: 对去毒化LLM的审计显示，该方法能产生校准良好且可解释的目标，并实现与真实对齐过程相当的训练动态和毒性降低。
Conclusion: 该框架为审计人员、安全团队和监管者提供了实用工具，用于验证LLM真正追求的目标，推动更可信和可问责的AI。

summary_sections.result: 对去毒化LLM的审计显示，该方法能产生校准良好且可解释的目标，并实现与真实对齐过程相当的训练动态和毒性降低。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架为审计人员、安全团队和监管者提供了实用工具，用于验证LLM真正追求的目标，推动更可信和可问责的AI。

papers.title: Geometrically Principled Randomized Optimization for Efficient LLM Training
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank gradient optimization for large language models is currently divided into two categories: structured methods that rigorously identify subspaces, and randomized approaches employed primarily for computational efficiency. In this work, we question the intuition behind why random projections are effective. We trace this phenomenon to the geometry of the gradient subspaces, which exhibits subspace optimization landscape has a nearly flat curvature, while a significant portion of gradient information lies outside the core subspace. Leveraging these insights, and drawing on randomized linear algebra, we theoretically establish that random low-rank projections preserve the geometry, and we introduce GrassWalk and GrassJump, algorithms that navigate the Grassmannian manifold via random walks and jumps. By coupling this randomized exploration with subspace-aware optimizer and recovering the lost gradient signals, we achieve state-of-the-art results on LLaMA-1B, LLaMA-7B, and Qwen-1.5B pretraining. Our findings reframe randomization not merely as a computational shortcut, but as a geometrically principled approach to high-dimensional optimizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究低秩梯度优化中随机投影有效的几何原因，发现梯度子空间具有近乎平坦的曲率，且大量梯度信息位于核心子空间之外。基于此，作者提出GrassWalk和GrassJump算法，通过Grassmann流形上的随机游走和跳跃来探索子空间，并结合子空间感知优化器恢复丢失的梯度信号。在LLaMA-1B、LLaMA-7B和Qwen-1.5B预训练中取得当前最优结果。
Motivation: 现有的低秩梯度优化方法中，结构化方法严格识别子空间，随机化方法仅用于计算效率；本文旨在理解随机投影为何有效，从而将随机化提升为几何上有原则的方法。
Method: 通过分析梯度子空间几何（平坦曲率和外部梯度信息），利用随机线性代数理论证明随机低秩投影能保持几何结构；提出GrassWalk和GrassJump算法，在Grassmann流形上执行随机游走和跳跃以探索子空间，并耦合子空间感知优化器恢复丢失梯度信号。
Result: 在LLaMA-1B、LLaMA-7B和Qwen-1.5B的预训练任务上取得当前最优结果。
Conclusion: 随机化不应仅被视为计算捷径，而是高维优化中一种几何上有原则的方法。

papers.title: Actively Learning Halfspaces without Synthetic Data
papers.abstract_en: In the classic point location problem, one is given an arbitrary dataset $X \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ of $n$ points with query access to an unknown halfspace $f : \mathbb{R}^d \to \{0,1\}$, and the goal is to learn the label of every point in $X$. This problem is extremely well-studied and a nearly-optimal $\widetilde{O}(d \log n)$ query algorithm is known due to Hopkins-Kane-Lovett-Mahajan (FOCS 2020). However, their algorithm is granted the power to query arbitrary points outside of $X$ (point synthesis), and in fact without this power there is an $Ω(n)$ query lower bound due to Dasgupta (NeurIPS 2004). In this work our goal is to design efficient algorithms for learning halfspaces without point synthesis. To circumvent the $Ω(n)$ lower bound, we consider learning halfspaces whose normal vectors come from a set of size $D$, and show tight bounds of $Θ(D + \log n)$. As a corollary, we obtain an optimal $O(d + \log n)$ query deterministic learner for axis-aligned halfspaces, closing a previous gap of $O(d \log n)$ vs. $Ω(d + \log n)$. In fact, our algorithm solves the more general problem of learning a Boolean function $f$ over $n$ elements which is monotone under at least one of $D$ provided orderings. Our technical insight is to exploit the structure in these orderings to perform a binary search in parallel rather than considering each ordering sequentially, and we believe our approach may be of broader interest. Furthermore, we use our exact learning algorithm to obtain nearly optimal algorithms for PAC-learning. We show that $O(\min(D + \log(1/\varepsilon), 1/\varepsilon) \cdot \log D)$ queries suffice to learn $f$ within error $\varepsilon$, even in a setting when $f$ can be adversarially corrupted on a $c\varepsilon$-fraction of points, for a sufficiently small constant $c$. This bound is optimal up to a $\log D$ factor, including in the realizable setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在没有合成数据（point synthesis）的情况下主动学习半空间（halfspaces）的查询复杂度。作者考虑法向量来自大小为D的集合的半空间，证明了紧的Θ(D + log n)查询界，并由此得到轴对齐半空间的最优O(d + log n)确定性学习器，改进了先前的O(d log n)上界。算法还扩展到学习在至少一个给定序关系下单调的布尔函数。进一步，利用精确学习算法得到PAC学习的近最优算法，在可容忍cε比例对抗性损坏的情况下，使用O(min(D + log(1/ε), 1/ε)·log D)个查询达到误差ε。
Motivation: 经典点定位问题中，无合成数据查询的下界为Ω(n)，而现有最优算法依赖点合成。为绕过此下界，本文研究法向量受限的半空间学习，旨在设计无合成数据的有效算法。
Method: 通过并行二分搜索利用多个序关系的内在结构，而非顺序处理每个序关系，从而得到精确学习算法；并基于此设计PAC学习算法，能容忍对抗性损坏。
Result: 证明了法向量来自大小为D的集合的半空间学习查询复杂度为Θ(D + log n)；轴对齐半空间得到最优O(d + log n)确定性学习器；PAC学习方面，在可容忍cε比例对抗性损坏时，查询复杂度为O(min(D + log(1/ε), 1/ε)·log D)，最优至多一个log D因子。
Conclusion: 本文给出了无合成数据下半空间学习的紧界，所提出的并行二分搜索方法可能具有更广泛的应用价值。

papers.title: Friend or Foe
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental challenge in microbial ecology is determining whether bacteria compete or cooperate in different environmental conditions. With recent advances in genome-scale metabolic models, we are now capable of simulating interactions between thousands of pairs of bacteria in thousands of different environmental settings at a scale infeasible experimentally. These approaches can generate tremendous amounts of data that can be exploited by state-of-the-art machine learning algorithms to uncover the mechanisms driving interactions. Here, we present Friend or Foe, a compendium of 64 tabular environmental datasets, consisting of more than 26M shared environments for more than 10K pairs of bacteria sampled from two of the largest collections of metabolic models. The Friend or Foe datasets are curated for a wide range of machine learning tasks -- supervised, unsupervised, and generative -- to address specific questions underlying bacterial interactions. We benchmarked a selection of the most recent models for each of these tasks and our results indicate that machine learning can be successful in this application to microbial ecology. Going beyond, analyses of the Friend or Foe compendium can shed light on the predictability of bacterial interactions and highlight novel research directions into how bacteria infer and navigate their relationships.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了Friend or Foe数据集，包含64个表格环境数据集，涵盖来自两个最大代谢模型集合的超过1万对细菌在超过2600万共享环境下的相互作用。该数据集用于监督、无监督和生成式机器学习任务，旨在揭示细菌相互作用的机制。基准测试表明机器学习在微生物生态学中的应用是有效的。
Motivation: 微生物生态学中确定细菌在不同环境条件下是竞争还是合作是一个基本挑战。先前实验方法难以大规模研究，而基因组规模代谢模型可以模拟大量细菌对在多种环境下的相互作用，产生大量数据，但需要机器学习方法来挖掘机制。
Method: 构建了Friend or Foe数据集，包含64个表格环境数据集，超过2600万共享环境和1万对细菌样本，并针对监督、无监督和生成式机器学习任务进行整理，以解决细菌相互作用的具体问题。
Result: 基准测试表明，一系列最新的机器学习模型在这些任务上取得了成功，表明机器学习可以应用于微生物生态学。数据集的分析有助于揭示细菌相互作用的可预测性并指出新的研究方向。
Conclusion: Friend or Foe数据集和基准测试展示了机器学习在理解细菌相互作用方面的潜力，但具体预测能力和局限性需进一步研究。

papers.title: Efficient Unlearning with Privacy Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Privacy protection laws, such as the GDPR, grant individuals the right to request the forgetting of their personal data not only from databases but also from machine learning (ML) models trained on them. Machine unlearning has emerged as a practical means to facilitate model forgetting of data instances seen during training. Although some existing machine unlearning methods guarantee exact forgetting, they are typically costly in computational terms. On the other hand, more affordable methods do not offer forgetting guarantees and are applicable only to specific ML models. In this paper, we present \emph{efficient unlearning with privacy guarantees} (EUPG), a novel machine unlearning framework that offers formal privacy guarantees to individuals whose data are being unlearned. EUPG involves pre-training ML models on data protected using privacy models, and it enables {\em efficient unlearning with the privacy guarantees offered by the privacy models in use}. Through empirical evaluation on four heterogeneous data sets protected with $k$-anonymity and $ε$-differential privacy as privacy models, our approach demonstrates utility and forgetting effectiveness comparable to those of exact unlearning methods, while significantly reducing computational and storage costs. Our code is available at https://github.com/najeebjebreel/EUPG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EUPG框架，在保护隐私数据上预训练ML模型，实现高效遗忘并具有形式化隐私保证。实验证明在k-匿名和差分隐私保护下，遗忘效果接近精确遗忘，计算和存储成本显著降低。
Motivation: GDPR等隐私法规要求删除个人数据，现有机器遗忘方法要么计算成本高（精确遗忘），要么缺乏保证且适用性有限。
Method: EUPG框架在隐私模型（如k-匿名和差分隐私）保护的数据上预训练ML模型，从而高效实现遗忘，且继承隐私模型的保障。
Result: 在四个异构数据集上，与精确遗忘方法相比，效用和遗忘效果相当，但计算和存储成本显著降低。
Conclusion: EUPG提供了高效且具有隐私保证的遗忘方案，可适用于多种ML模型。

papers.title: PLOT: Pseudo-Labeling via Object Tracking for Monocular 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Monocular 3D object detection is crucial for scalable perception across fields like autonomous driving, robotics, and surveillance. However, progress is hindered by limited 3D annotations and the inherent ambiguity of single-image geometry. Existing methods often rely on strong geometric assumptions or carefully curated datasets, which limit their applicability to real-world scenarios. In this paper, we present PLOT (Pseudo-Labeling via Object Tracking), a framework that generates 3D annotations from monocular videos without auxiliary sensors or model retraining. PLOT tracks object and background trajectories to estimate camera motion and perform object association in pose-unknown settings. These trajectories provide point correspondences that align frame-wise pseudo-LiDARs, which are then fused via simple optimization into a unified object shape robust to occlusion and viewpoint shifts. Recognizing temporal coherence as a fundamental requirement for reliable shape fusion and video perception, we design a global object memory that preserves consistent object identities across frames. PLOT achieves robust annotation quality and strong generalization on both M3OD video benchmarks and in-the-wild videos, proving its effectiveness across diverse and unconstrained domains. Project page: https://plot-eccv.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PLOT框架，利用目标跟踪从单目视频生成3D伪标签，无需辅助传感器或模型重训练。通过跟踪目标和背景轨迹估计相机运动并进行目标关联，融合帧间伪激光雷达点云得到鲁棒的目标形状。全局目标记忆保持跨帧身份一致性，在M3OD视频基准和野外视频上验证了标注质量和泛化能力。
Motivation: 单目3D目标检测受限于3D标注稀缺和单视图几何歧义，现有方法依赖强几何假设或精心筛选的数据集，难以适应真实场景。
Method: 利用目标跟踪估计相机运动并关联目标，通过轨迹提供点对应关系对齐帧间伪激光雷达，经简单优化融合成统一的物体形状。设计全局目标记忆保持跨帧身份一致性。
Result: 在M3OD视频基准和野外视频上取得鲁棒的标注质量和强泛化性。
Conclusion: PLOT通过时序一致性生成高质量3D伪标签，有效适用于多样化无约束场景。

papers.title: GeNeRT: A Physics-Informed Approach to Intelligent Wireless Channel Modeling via Generalizable Neural Ray Tracing
papers.abstract_en: Neural ray tracing (RT) has emerged as a promising paradigm for channel modeling by integrating physical propagation principles with neural networks. However, existing neural RT methods remain limited by strong spatial dependence and weak adherence to electromagnetic laws. We propose GeNeRT, a generalizable neural RT framework that improves generalization and accuracy through relative geometric features, scatterer semantics, and a Fresnel-inspired polarization-driven architecture. GeNeRT is trained through a three-stage strategy: polarization-specific module-wise pre-training captures general ray-surface interaction behavior; system-wise end-to-end training uses only receiver-side channel impulse responses to learn site-specific propagation characteristics; and measurement-based fine-tuning employs sparse measured multipath components (MPCs) to adapt polarization-related modules to real-world environments. Extensive outdoor simulations demonstrate robust intra-scenario transferability and inter-scenario zero-shot generalization. In an unseen scenario, GeNeRT achieves an overall error of $-35.36$ dB and an average-delay error of 4.91 ns, compared with $-10.85$ dB and 32.38 ns for the best baseline. With only 75 measured reflected MPCs, fine-tuning further reduces the overall error from $-14.48$ to $-22.90$ dB and the average-delay error from 6.28 to 3.58 ns. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of the proposed architecture and training strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeNeRT，一种结合物理原理和神经网络的通用神经射线追踪框架，用于无线信道建模。通过相对几何特征、散射体语义和 Fresnel 启发的极化驱动架构，以及三阶段训练策略（预训练、端到端训练、基于测量的微调），实现了跨场景零样本泛化。在室外模拟中，GeNeRT 在未见场景下达到 -35.36 dB 的整体误差和 4.91 ns 的平均时延误差，显著优于基线。
Motivation: 现有神经射线追踪方法存在空间依赖性过强、对电磁定律遵守不足的问题，限制了其泛化能力和准确性。
Method: 提出通用神经射线追踪框架 GeNeRT，使用相对几何特征、散射体语义和 Fresnel 启发的极化驱动架构，并结合三阶段训练：模块级预训练、系统级端到端训练、基于稀疏测量多径分量（MPCs）的微调。
Result: 在室外模拟中，GeNeRT 在未见场景下整体误差为 -35.36 dB，平均时延误差为 4.91 ns，优于最佳基线（-10.85 dB 和 32.38 ns）。仅用 75 个测量反射 MPC 微调后，整体误差从 -14.48 dB 降至 -22.90 dB，平均时延误差从 6.28 ns 降至 3.58 ns。
Conclusion: GeNeRT 通过结合物理先验和神经网络，显著提升了无线信道建模的泛化能力和精度，微调策略能有效适应真实环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stimulus Motion Perception Studies Imply Specific Neural Computations in Human Visual Stabilization
papers.abstract_en: Even during fixation the human eye is constantly in low amplitude motion, jittering over small angles in random directions at up to 100Hz. This motion results in all features of the image on the retina constantly traversing a number of cones, yet objects which are stable in the world are perceived to be stable, and any object which is moving in the world is perceived to be moving. A series of experiments carried out over a dozen years revealed the psychophysics of visual stabilization to be more nuanced than might be assumed, say, from the mechanics of stabilization of camera images, or what might be assumed to be the simplest solution from an evolutionary perspective. The psychophysics revealed by the experiments strongly implies a specific set of operations on retinal signals resulting in the observed stabilization behavior. The presentation is in two levels. First is a functional description of the action of the mechanism that is very likely responsible for the experimentally observed behavior. Second is a more speculative proposal of circuit-level neural elements that might implement the functional behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过一系列实验研究人眼注视时微小运动下的视觉稳定化感知，发现其心理物理学比简单相机稳定或进化简单解更复杂。摘要暗示视网膜信号的具体操作组合导致稳定化行为。论文分为两个层次：功能描述和推测的神经电路实现。
Motivation: 研究人眼注视时视网膜图像持续运动但世界感知稳定且运动物体仍能感知运动的神经机制，探索其背后的心理物理学和神经计算。
Method: 基于十多年的系列实验揭示了视觉稳定化的心理物理学，提出可能负责稳定化行为的功能描述和推测的神经电路级实现。
Result: 实验发现视觉稳定化的心理物理学比预期更微妙，强烈暗示特定视网膜信号操作。
Conclusion: 论文提出两个层次：功能描述和推测的电路实现，但未给出最终结论或应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Never Skip a Batch: Dense Learning of Temporal GNNs via Adaptive Pseudo-Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Temporal graph networks suffer from irregular supervision in realworld dynamic graphs, as most minibatches contain few labeled events. The lack of labels leads to high-variance gradient updates and, consequently, slow wall-clock convergence. To constructively reduce sparsity, our Moving-Averaged Labels (MAL) assigns soft pseudo-targets based on past supervised signals using a running label distribution while leaving the loss and the model architecture unchanged. Thus, supervision gaps are replaced with informative signals independent of a temporal graph model and the message passing or memory components used. Theoretical analysis supports our insight that aggregating historical supervision into moving average targets reduces stochastic gradient variance, yielding faster convergence under mild assumptions. Experimentally, for TGNv2 and DyRepv2 (our modification of DyRep) models, MAL boosts predictive performance, establishing a new SOTA, and improves time-to-accuracy (on average 6x faster to reach the top score) for a common suite of Temporal Graph Benchmark datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时序图网络在动态图中标签稀疏导致的梯度方差大、收敛慢的问题，提出Moving-Averaged Labels (MAL)方法，利用历史监督信号的移动平均分配软伪标签，在不改变损失结构和模型架构的情况下填补监督间隙。理论分析表明MAL降低了随机梯度方差，加速收敛。实验上，在TGNv2和DyRepv2模型上，MAL提升了预测性能，达到新SOTA，并在时序图基准数据集上平均实现6倍加速达到最佳准确率。
Motivation: 实际动态图中大部分小批次只有少量标记事件，导致梯度更新高方差和慢收敛，现有方法未能有效利用未标记事件中的有用信息。
Method: 提出MAL，基于过去监督信号的运行标签分布为未标记事件分配软伪目标，作为移动平均标签，不修改损失函数或模型架构，可适用于任意时序图模型。
Result: 在TGNv2和DyRepv2上，MAL在时序图基准数据集上达到新SOTA，且平均加速6倍达到最佳准确率（time-to-accuracy）。
Conclusion: 该方法通过聚合历史监督作为移动平均目标，减少了随机梯度方差，在温和假设下加速收敛，且模型无关。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Regret Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) is widely used for decision-making under uncertainty, but its adversarial focus on worst-case loss can lead to overly conservative policies. To mitigate this, we study ex-ante Distributionally Robust Regret Optimization (DRRO) with Wasserstein ambiguity sets, designed to balance robustness with upside potential. We develop a theory of Wasserstein DRRO (WDRRO) paralleling Wasserstein DRO. Under smoothness and regularity, WDRRO selects among ERM optima by a first-order gradient-discrepancy rule. If the ERM optimizer is unique, first-order sensitivity vanishes and a second-order expansion governs deviations. For convex quadratics ERM and DRRO coincide for any radius. We then study regimes where these assumptions fail: nondifferentiable max-affine losses, discrete references, and larger radii, where WDRRO can differ from ERM and WDRO. We show that computing WDRRO regret is NP-hard even without bilinear terms. Nevertheless, we develop exact algorithms, a tractable convex relaxation with guarantees, and experiments showing tightness and loss-dependent behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Wasserstein分布鲁棒后悔优化（WDRRO），旨在平衡鲁棒性与潜在收益。在光滑性和正则性条件下，WDRRO通过一阶梯度差异规则选择ERM最优解；若ERM最优解唯一，则一阶敏感性消失，二阶展开主导偏差。对于凸二次损失，ERM与WDRRO在任何半径下等价。在不满足假设的情况下（非可微最大仿射损失、离散参考、较大半径），WDRRO与ERM和WDRO不同。计算WDRRO后悔是NP难的，但提出了精确算法和可处理的凸松弛，实验表明紧性和损失依赖性。
Motivation: 分布鲁棒优化（DRO）虽然广泛应用于不确定性决策，但其对抗性聚焦于最坏情况损失可能导致过于保守的策略。为此，本文研究具有Wasserstein模糊集的事前分布鲁棒后悔优化（DRRO），旨在平衡鲁棒性与潜在收益。
Method: 发展了一套与Wasserstein DRO平行的Wasserstein DRRO（WDRRO）理论。在光滑性和正则性条件下，WDRRO通过一阶梯度差异规则选择ERM最优解；若ERM最优解唯一，则一阶敏感性消失，二阶展开主导偏差。针对不可微最大仿射损失、离散参考和较大半径等情况，分析了WDRRO与ERM和WDRO的差异，并提出了精确算法和可处理的凸松弛。
Result: 对于凸二次损失，ERM与WDRRO在任何半径下等价。计算WDRRO后悔是NP难的（即使没有双线性项）。提出的凸松弛有保证，实验显示紧性和损失依赖行为。
Conclusion: WDRRO为平衡鲁棒性和潜在收益提供了一种理论框架，但计算复杂度高，需借助凸松弛等方法实现精确或近似求解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Clustering with Non-adaptive Subset Queries
papers.abstract_en: Recovering the underlying $k$-clustering of a set $U$ of $n$ points by asking pair-wise same-cluster queries has garnered significant interest in the past few years. Given a query $S \subset U$, $|S|=2$, the oracle returns "yes" if the points are in the same cluster and "no" otherwise. For adaptive algorithms, the query complexity is known to be $Θ(nk)$, while non-adaptive algorithms are extremely limited: even for $k=3$, such algorithms require $Ω(n^2)$ queries, matching the trivial upper bound. However, non-adaptivity is highly desirable since it allows queries to be asked in parallel. To break the quadratic barrier for non-adaptive queries, we study a natural generalization of this problem to subset queries for $|S|>2$, where the oracle returns the number of clusters intersecting $S$. Previous work obtained an $O(n)$ query adaptive algorithm, but the realm of non-adaptive algorithms remained completely unknown. In this paper, we give the first non-adaptive algorithms for clustering with subset queries. Our main result is a non-adaptive algorithm making $O(n \log k \cdot (\log k + \log\log n)^2)$ queries, improving to $O(n \log \log n)$ when $k$ is constant. In addition to non-adaptivity, we make other practical considerations, such as enforcing a bound, $s$, on the query size. We show $Ω(\max(n^2/s^2,n))$ queries are necessary and obtain algorithms making $\smash{\widetilde{O}(n^2k/s^2)}$ queries for any $s \leq \sqrt{n}$ and $\smash{\widetilde{O}(n^2/s)}$ queries for any $s \leq n$. Finally, we obtain improved upper bounds when the clusters are roughly balanced, and when the algorithm is allowed two rounds of adaptivity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非自适应子集查询（subset queries）下的聚类恢复问题。传统两两查询非自适应需要Ω(n^2)次查询，本文通过查询子集（|S|>2）得到聚类交集数量，给出首个非自适应算法，查询复杂度为O(n log k (log k + log log n)^2)，对于常数k为O(n log log n)。同时考虑查询大小上界s，给出上下界结果。
Motivation: 非自适应查询允许并行，但在两两查询情形下二次下界限制了实际应用。本文通过引入子集查询（返回聚类交集数）来突破非自适应查询的二次障碍。
Method: 提出非自适应子集查询算法，主要思想是利用子集查询获取更多信息，结合分组测试（group testing）等技术。同时考虑查询大小限制s，给出不同参数下的算法。
Result: 主要结果是非自适应算法在无查询大小限制时达到O(n log k (log k + log log n)^2)查询复杂度；常数k时为O(n log log n)。同时证明Ω(max(n^2/s^2, n))的下界，并给出~O(n^2 k/s^2)和~O(n^2/s)的上界。
Conclusion: 本文首次给出了非自适应子集查询聚类的算法，打破了二次屏障，并考虑了查询大小和轮次等实际约束。摘要未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OptiMUS-0.3: Using Large Language Models to Model and Solve Optimization Problems at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Optimization problems are pervasive in sectors from manufacturing and distribution to healthcare. However, most such problems are still solved heuristically by hand rather than optimally by state-of-the-art solvers because the expertise required to formulate and solve these problems limits the widespread adoption of optimization tools and techniques. We introduce a Large Language Model (LLM)-based system designed to formulate and solve (mixed integer) linear programming problems from their natural language descriptions. Our system can develop mathematical models, write and debug solver code, evaluate the generated solutions, and improve efficiency and correctness of its model and code based on these evaluations. OptiMUS is designed as a productivity tool for optimization practitioners who understand the problem domain and can describe it precisely, but seek to accelerate the modeling and implementation workflow. OptiMUS-0.3 utilizes a modular structure to process problems, allowing it to handle problems with long descriptions and complex data without long prompts. Experiments demonstrate that OptiMUS-0.3 outperforms direct-prompting baselines by over 43% on easy and 18% on hard instances. It remains competitive with fine-tuned specialist models on benchmark problems, and outperforms them on real-world case studies (28.6% vs. 0%) where fine-tuned models fail to generalize. Ablation studies show that modular architecture with error correction is central to these gains. A key finding is that system architecture is a stronger driver of performance than model capability. Structured decomposition with targeted error correction enables weaker models to match stronger models under naive prompting, and remains competitive with fine-tuned specialist models without retraining costs.
papers.comment: This paper documents OptiMUS-0.3, improving on OptiMUS-0.1 (arXiv:2310.06116) and OptiMUS-0.2 (arXiv:2402.10172). arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2402.10172
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个基于大型语言模型（LLM）的系统OptiMUS-0.3，旨在从自然语言描述中建模并求解（混合整数）线性规划问题。系统能自动构建数学模型、编写和调试求解器代码、评估生成解，并基于评估改进模型和代码。模块化架构使其能够处理长描述和复杂数据。实验表明，OptiMUS-0.3在简单和困难实例上分别比直接提示基线高出43%和18%，在基准问题上与微调专家模型竞争力相当，在真实案例研究中胜出（28.6% vs. 0%）。消融研究显示，系统架构比模型能力对性能提升更关键。
Motivation: 优化问题在制造、物流、医疗等领域广泛存在，但由于需要专业知识来建模和求解，大多数问题仍靠人工启发式解决。目标是为领域专家提供加速建模和实现流程的工具。
Method: OptiMUS-0.3采用模块化结构处理问题，通过分解长描述和数据，避免长提示；系统包含建模、编码、评估和错误纠正循环，能自动改进模型和代码。
Result: 在基准上，简单实例比直接提示基线提升43%以上，困难实例提升18%；与微调专家模型竞争力相当；在真实案例中，OptiMUS-0.3解决28.6%的问题，而微调模型为0%。
Conclusion: 系统架构（模块化分解和定向纠错）是性能的主要驱动力，甚至能让较弱模型在简单提示下匹配较强模型，且无需微调成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Complete Causal Explanation with Expert Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of restricting a Markov equivalence class of maximal ancestral graphs (MAGs) to only those MAGs that contain certain edge marks, which we refer to as expert or orientation knowledge. Such a restriction of the Markov equivalence class can be uniquely represented by a restricted essential ancestral graph. Our contributions are several-fold. First, we prove certain properties for the entire Markov equivalence class including a conjecture from Ali et al. (2009). Second, we present several new sound graphical orientation rules for adding orientation knowledge to an essential ancestral graph. We also show that some orientation rules of Zhang (2008b) are not needed for restricting the Markov equivalence class with orientation knowledge. Third, we provide an algorithm for including this orientation knowledge and show that in certain settings the output of our algorithm is a restricted essential ancestral graph. Finally, outside of the specified settings, we provide an algorithm for checking whether a graph is a restricted essential graph and discuss its runtime. This work can be seen as a generalization of Meek (1995) to settings which allow for latent confounding.
papers.comment: 86 pages (main paper 26 pages, supplementary material 60 pages), 21 figures, 7 algorithms, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用专家知识（edge marks）来约束极大祖先图（MAGs）的马尔可夫等价类，使得等价类仅包含符合特定边标记的图。作者证明了整个马尔可夫等价类的某些性质，包括对 Ali et al. (2009) 中猜想的证实；提出了多种添加定向知识的图定向规则，并证明 Zhang (2008b) 的部分规则在约束等价类时不再需要；提供了包含这些定向知识的算法，在某些设置下输出为受限本质祖先图；此外，还给出了判断一个图是否为受限本质图的算法并讨论了其运行时间。本文可视为 Meek (1995) 在允许潜在混杂下的推广。
Motivation: 现有因果结构学习通常从观测数据中学习马尔可夫等价类，但无法区分等价类中不同图的方向歧义。引入专家知识（如部分边方向已知）可以缩小等价类，但如何系统性地加入这些知识并保持等价类表示尚不明确。
Method: 定义受限本质祖先图（restricted essential ancestral graph），提出若干新的图定向规则用于融合专家知识；证明某些已有规则不再需要；给出算法将专家知识逐步添加到本质祖先图中，并在特定条件下保证输出为受限本质图；另提供算法用于验证图是否为受限本质图。
Result: 证明了整个马尔可夫等价类的一个猜想（Ali et al., 2009）；新规则在包含专家知识时能有效缩小等价类；算法输出在特定设置下为受限本质祖先图；检查受限本质图算法的运行时间也被讨论。
Conclusion: 本文为因果结构学习中融入专家定向知识提供了完整理论框架和算法，适用于允许潜在混杂的场景，是经典 Meek (1995) 规则的重要推广。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multimodal Large Language Model driven Radiology Report Generation with Clinical Knowledge Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: Radiology report generation (RRG) has attracted significant attention due to its potential to reduce the workload of radiologists. The performance of current RRG approaches remains unsatisfactory against clinical standards. This paper introduces a novel RRG method, MLLM-RRG, that integrates multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with various types of clinical knowledge to generate accurate and comprehensive chest X-ray reports. Our method first designs a referring anatomical feature extractor that leverages anatomical knowledge to analyze different regions of the chest X-ray image and extract visual features without explicitly detecting regions. Next, based on the MLLM's decoder, we develop a multimodal report generator that leverages multimodal prompts constructed from dedicated visual features and textual instructions to produce the radiology report in an auto-regressive way. Finally, we introduce a disease-oriented clinical classification and alignment scheme in a multi-task learning manner to leverage disease knowledge to better preserve the clinical relevance among the generated reports. Once the model is trained, we also introduce a novel clinical quality reinforcement learning strategy to enhance the MLLM with report knowledge, further refining the tones of the generated reports towards radiologists. Extensive experiments on the MIMIC-CXR and IU X-Ray datasets demonstrate the superiority of our method over the state of the art. Our codes will be available at https://github.com/viscom-tongji/MLLM-RRG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和临床知识增强的放射学报告生成方法MLLM-RRG，通过解剖特征提取、多模态报告生成器、面向疾病的分类对齐以及临床质量强化学习，在MIMIC-CXR和IU X-Ray数据集上实现了优于现有方法的性能。
Motivation: 当前放射学报告生成方法的性能在临床标准下仍不令人满意，亟需提升报告的准确性和全面性。
Method: 设计了解剖特征提取器利用解剖知识分析胸片不同区域；基于MLLM解码器构建多模态报告生成器，使用视觉特征和文本指令的提示自回归生成报告；引入面向疾病的临床分类对齐方案以及临床质量强化学习策略。
Result: 在MIMIC-CXR和IU X-Ray数据集上的实验表明，该方法在多个指标上优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: MLLM-RRG通过融合多种临床知识有效提升了放射学报告生成的质量，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spatio-temporal model via Locally Adaptive Regression Splines
papers.abstract_en: This paper focuses on the estimation of a non-parametric regression function in the presence of data with spatio-temporal dependencies. In such a context, we study Locally Adaptive Regression Splines, a nonparametric estimator introduced by Mammen and Van De Geer (1997) and Rudin et al. (1992). To the best of our knowledge, this estimator has not previously been examined in a similar context. For univariate settings, the signals we consider are assumed to have a kth weak derivative with bounded total variation, allowing for a general degree of smoothness. In the multivariate setting, we study a variant of the K-Nearest Neighbor fused lasso estimator studied by Padilla et al. (2018a). For this case, the function is required to have bounded variation and satisfy a property that extends a piecewise Lipschitz continuity criterion, or the function is assumed to be piecewise Lipschitz. We develop an ADMM algorithm for practical computation. By aligning with lower bounds, the minimax optimality of our univariate and multivariate estimators is shown. A unique phase transition phenomenon, previously unprecedented in Locally Adaptive Regression Splines studies, emerges through our analysis. Both simulation studies and real data applications underscore the superior performance of our method when compared with established techniques in the existing literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究含时空依赖数据的非参数回归函数估计问题，采用局部自适应回归样条（Locally Adaptive Regression Splines）和K近邻融合lasso方法。在单变量设定中假设信号有k阶弱导且总变差有界，多变量设定中要求函数有界变差并满足分段Lipschitz连续性条件。作者提出ADMM算法进行实际计算，并证明了单变量和多变量估计量的minimax最优性，同时发现了一个此前未在局部自适应回归样条研究中出现的相变现象。模拟和真实数据应用表明该方法优于现有技术。
Motivation: 现有非参数回归方法在处理时空依赖数据时缺乏理论保证和实际有效性，局部自适应回归样条在类似上下文中尚未被充分研究。
Method: 研究局部自适应回归样条在单变量时空数据的变体，以及多变量下基于K近邻融合lasso的拓展，并设计ADMM算法用于计算。
Result: 理论上证明了估计量的minimax最优性（与下界匹配），并通过分析发现新的相变现象；实验表明方法在模拟和真实数据上优于现有技术。
Conclusion: 本文为时空非参数回归提供了具有最优理论性质且实际性能良好的估计方法，但其适用范围限于满足特定光滑性和变差条件的函数。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Tool Use Enables Undetectable Steganography in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Increasingly autonomous agentic AI systems pose novel multi-agent risks, such as secret collusion via covert communication channels. The natural defence to these collusion attempts is to monitor plain-text communication, but the efficacy of monitors has been called into doubt by increasingly sophisticated model steganography; indeed, some theoretical schemes have been proposed that are information-theoretically or computationally indistinguishable from good-faith plain-text communication. In this paper, we demonstrate that the complexity of these schemes is no longer a safety barrier, as agentic coding models can already produce undetectable stegosystems when given realistic tool usage, such as code execution or accessing research papers through web searches. Agents also adapt when key ingredients are missing, for example, by adding model-sampling components or implementing related keyed coding schemes. We then frame tacit steganographic coordination between agents as a Schelling-point problem and introduce coordination metrics for estimating when two agents are likely to select compatible schemes without explicit prior agreement. Our results suggest a shift in the threat model for covert communication between AI agents, where the main barrier is no longer whether frontier agents can understand and implement sophisticated stegosystems, but coordination: whether independently acting agents can converge on compatible schemes, keys, and parameters. We find substantial convergence on broad scheme families but limited strict one-shot coordination, suggesting that shared artefacts, repeated interaction, and tool-mediated search are the settings where covert communication risks are most acute. Overall, our findings provide empirical grounding for the recent strategic confinement hypothesis, which assumes that capable agents can construct covert channels that survive monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体LLM系统中通过工具使用（如代码执行、网络搜索）实现不可检测的隐写通信。作者展示了智能体能够利用前沿模型生成复杂的隐写系统，并将协调问题建模为谢林点问题，提出了协调度量。实验表明在广泛方案族上存在显著收敛，但严格的一次性协调有限，意味着共享工件、重复交互和工具中介搜索下的风险最为严重。
Motivation: 随着自主AI系统日益复杂，智能体间通过隐蔽信道进行秘密勾结的风险增大，而传统监控方法可能因模型隐写术的进步而失效。
Method: 通过实验观察智能体在给定工具（代码执行、网络搜索）时能否产生不可检测的隐写系统，并引入谢林点框架和协调度量来评估智能体无需事先约定即可选择兼容方案的能力。
Result: 智能体能够利用前沿模型实现复杂隐写，且在方案族上存在较大收敛，但严格的一次性协调比例较低，表明共享工具和重复交互是风险最高的场景。
Conclusion: 研究为近期提出的战略约束假设提供了实证基础，即有能力的前端智能体能够构建可存活于监控之下的隐蔽信道，而协调而非实现能力成为主要安全障碍。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: JuZhou 1.0 Technical Report: The First Edge-Native Text-to-Image Foundation Model Trained Entirely on China-Developed AI Accelerators
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models typically require substantial computational resources and cloud infrastructure, posing significant challenges for edge deployment in terms of latency, cost, and user privacy. We present JuZhou 1.0, an ultra-lightweight T2I foundation model designed for fully offline, on-device execution. JuZhou 1.0 achieves its efficiency through four key designs: (1) a compact image-generation backbone consisting of a 0.385B-parameter denoising U-Net and a 1.90M-parameter distilled decoder, totaling approximately 0.387B parameters; (2) Rectified Flow training combined with DMD2 distillation, reducing inference to 4 sampling steps; (3) Chinese semantic alignment trained on 9M curated image-text pairs, enabling direct Chinese prompting without external translation at inference time; and (4) a training and distillation pipeline completed on domestically developed Sugon K100 AI accelerators without relying on NVIDIA GPUs for training or distillation. Despite its compact scale, the 28-step base model of JuZhou 1.0 achieves an overall GenEval score of 0.69, outperforming published baselines including SDXL (2.6B, 0.55), SD3-Medium (2B, 0.62), and IF-XL (4.3B, 0.61). We further validate the full poetry-to-image pipeline on Android and the core CLIP-U-Net-VAE generation branch on iOS. On a smartphone powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Mobile Platform, the 4-step U-Net denoising branch runs in approximately 1.6 seconds, while the full Android poetry-to-image pipeline takes 4.5 seconds with on-device prompt refinement on Xiaomi 17 Pro Max. These results position JuZhou 1.0 as a practical approach to mobile text-to-image generation and provide a concrete reference for Chinese-native generation, domestic-compute training, and fully offline on-device deployment after one-time installation.

papers.title: MedDiffuseMix: Preserving Diagnostic Evidence with Saliency-Aware Diffusion Medical Image Data Augmentatio
papers.abstract_en: Limited data availability, class imbalance, and domain variability remain major barriers to reliable medical image classification. Conventional augmentation can improve training diversity but may distort diagnostically informative structures, whereas unconstrained generative augmentation may introduce label-inconsistent content. This paper proposes MedDiffuseMix, a saliency-guided diffusion mixing framework for controlled medical image augmentation. The method uses classifier-derived saliency maps to separate high-saliency diagnostic regions from low-saliency background areas and applies diffusion-guided mixing mainly to regions with lower diagnostic importance. Adaptive mixing, Gaussian boundary blending, and a saliency-preservation constraint reduce semantic distortion and reject or attenuate samples that shift model attention away from clinically relevant evidence. The framework is evaluated on four public benchmarks: the Radiological Society of North America pneumonia chest radiography dataset, Musculoskeletal Radiographs, PatchCamelyon, and the Breast Cancer Histopathological Image Classification dataset. Experiments with convolutional and transformer-based classifiers show that MedDiffuseMix improves accuracy, F1-score, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve compared with standard augmentation, Mixup, GenMix, SaliencyMix, and diffusion-based augmentation baselines. Ablation studies confirm the importance of saliency guidance, adaptive region mixing, and smooth boundary blending. Visual attribution analysis further indicates that MedDiffuseMix better preserves diagnostically salient regions. These results suggest that saliency-guided diffusion mixing is an effective augmentation strategy for limited-data medical image classification.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedDiffuseMix，一种基于显著性图的扩散混合框架，用于受控的医学图像数据增强。该方法利用分类器生成的显著性图将高显著性诊断区域与低显著性背景区域分离，主要对低诊断重要性区域进行扩散引导混合，并通过自适应混合、高斯边界融合和显著性保持约束减少语义失真。在四个医学图像基准上，该方法在准确率、F1分数和AUC上优于标准增强、Mixup、GenMix、SaliencyMix及基于扩散的增强基线。
Motivation: 医学图像分类面临数据有限、类别不平衡和域变异等问题，传统增强可能扭曲诊断结构，无约束的生成增强可能引入标签不一致内容。
Method: 使用分类器显著性图区分高/低显著性区域，对低显著性区域进行扩散引导混合；结合自适应混合、高斯边界融合和显著性保持约束来减少语义失真。
Result: 在RSNA肺炎胸片、肌肉骨骼X光、PatchCamelyon和乳腺癌组织病理学四个数据集上，与多种增强基线相比，MedDiffuseMix提升了准确率、F1和AUC；消融研究验证了各组件的重要性。
Conclusion: 显著性引导的扩散混合是一种有效的医学图像增强策略，尤其适用于数据有限的情况，但该方法专门针对医学图像设计，未涉及其它领域。

papers.title: DiffRGD: An Inference-Time Diffusion Guidance Through Riemannian Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Recently, diffusion models have been widely adopted in generative modeling and have served as foundational models for many image generation tasks. To control the generation without costly re-training or fine-tuning, many works seek inference-time guidance methods to steer the latent via a differentiable objective at inference time. However, these methods cannot effectively preserve the original Gaussian distribution because they introduce distributional drift, thereby degrading the sample quality. To address this gap, we propose DiffRGD, a distribution-aware guidance framework that explicitly preserves the latent Gaussian structure. DiffRGD formulates each sampling step as a constrained optimization problem on a spherical manifold induced by the latent Gaussian distribution, and solves it efficiently via Riemannian Gradient Descent (RGD). DiffRGD is a plug-and-play method that can be seamlessly integrated into any pre-trained diffusion model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiffRGD outperforms previous methods in most image restoration and conditional generation tasks. Our codebase is available at https://github.com/jwliao1209/DiffRGD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 DiffRGD，一种推理时扩散引导方法，通过 Riemannian 梯度下降在球形流形上求解约束优化，保持潜高斯分布，避免分布漂移。在图像恢复和条件生成任务上优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有推理时引导方法引入分布漂移，破坏潜高斯分布，降低样本质量。
Method: 将每个采样步骤建模为潜高斯分布诱导的球形流形上的约束优化，通过 Riemannian 梯度下降高效求解。
Result: 在多数图像恢复和条件生成任务上优于先前方法。
Conclusion: DiffRGD 是一种即插即用方法，可无缝集成到预训练扩散模型中，有效保持潜高斯结构。

papers.title: AEGIS: A Semantic GAN and Evidential Learning Frameworkfor Robust Adversarial Detection in Vision Sensors
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have shown outstanding performance in visual recognition tasks within vision sensor networks; however, they are still vulnerable to adversarial manipulations and imperceptible perturbations that can lead to erroneous predictions. To address that, this paper presents AEGIS, a semantic aware and uncertainty guided adversarial detection framework designed for robust image classification in vision sensors pipelines. At its core, a SemantiGAN module functions as a multi class semantic discriminator, identifying and filtering visually inconsistent adversarial inputs before they propagate further in the pipeline. For inputs that pass this stage, a stochastic augmentation process generates test time variations, from which handcrafted instability metrics FlipScore, Prediction Inconsistency, Layerwise Cosine Similarity (early and mid layers), and Entropy are computed. These features are aggregated into a compact five dimensional vector and processed by an Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) classifier, which models output evidence using a Dirichlet distribution to yield both class predictions and calibrated uncertainty estimates. Evaluations on the Tiny ImageNet dataset across six categories clean, FGSM, PGD, patch based, functional, and geometric attacks demonstrate the effectiveness of AEGIS. The proposed framework achieves an AUROC of 92.1\%, an AUPRC of 90.2\%, and an accuracy of 90.7\%, outperforming conventional softmax-based detectors in terms of detection performance, robustness, interpretability, and uncertainty calibration.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AEGIS框架，用于视觉传感器中深度神经网络的对抗性检测。该框架结合语义GAN模块进行多类语义判别，过滤视觉不一致的对抗输入，并对通过检测的输入计算FlipScore、预测不一致性、层间余弦相似性（早期和中期层）及熵等不稳定性指标，构成五维特征向量后由证据深度学习分类器处理，利用Dirichlet分布输出预测和不确定性估计。在Tiny ImageNet数据集上针对六类攻击（干净、FGSM、PGD、补丁、功能、几何）的评估显示，AEGIS达到AUROC 92.1%、AUPRC 90.2%、准确率90.7%，优于传统softmax检测器。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在视觉传感器网络中表现优异，但仍易受对抗性操纵和微小扰动影响，导致错误预测，需要鲁棒的对抗检测方法。
Method: 提出AEGIS框架，核心包括SemantiGAN模块（多类语义判别器）和随机增强过程产生的五个不稳定性指标（FlipScore、预测不一致性、早期和中期层余弦相似性、熵），构成五维特征向量后由证据深度学习分类器处理，使用Dirichlet分布建模证据以输出类别预测和校准的不确定性估计。
Result: 在Tiny ImageNet数据集上，对六类攻击（干净、FGSM、PGD、补丁、功能、几何）的检测达到AUROC 92.1%、AUPRC 90.2%、准确率90.7%。
Conclusion: AEGIS框架在检测性能、鲁棒性、可解释性和不确定性校准方面优于传统softmax检测器。

papers.title: On the Necessity of a Liquid Substrate for Mesh Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: A mesh of sovereign agents has no center: no shared clock, no shared model, and no coordinator to gather data or retrain. Its competence rests on each agent folding the projections its peers emit into a single internal state, online, from observations that arrive at irregular, unscheduled times, on a substrate whose weights it cannot retrain. Any one of these constraints is tractable on its own; folding optimally under all three at once is not. We ask what such a substrate must be, and prove two necessary conditions from one model of a self-evolving latent observed at irregular, exogenous times. Because the latent changes, its optimal estimator is time-varying: an adaptive timescale is necessary, and every fixed-gain filter is strictly suboptimal. And because arrivals are clock-free, the optimal estimate depends on the elapsed gap between them, which no gap-blind network recovers at any width or depth. This second condition is capacity-independent: scale cannot substitute for the missing dependence. The two conditions intersect in the continuous-time liquid class. An LSTM satisfies the first, a fixed continuous-time filter the second, and a multi-timescale liquid network both. Synthetic experiments confirm each: the network attains the timescale, and the separation is computed exactly. The characterization is necessary, not sufficient, and binds fixed-weight substrates: a network free to retrain reaches the class by other means. Proved per agent, the necessity binds every agent of a mesh, a structural condition on mesh intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明，在由主权代理构成的网状智能中，当每个代理只能通过不可重训练的固定权重网络，从不规则、无时钟的观测中在线融合同伴的投影时，其最优估计必须满足两个必要条件：自适应的时变时间尺度（固定增益滤波器严格次优）以及估计量依赖于观测之间的时间间隔（任何无视间隔的网络在任意宽度深度下都无法恢复）。这两个条件共同指向连续时间液态网络（liquid network）类，而LSTM只满足第一个，固定连续时间滤波器只满足第二个，多时间尺度液态网络同时满足两者。合成实验验证了这些结论。
Motivation: 现有研究忽略了在无中心、无共享时钟、无协调器、且权重不可重训练的松散代理网格中，每个代理在线融合不规则观测时基底应具备的数学必要条件。
Method: 从自演化潜变量模型出发，推导出在不可重训练权重下，最优估计器必须具有时变时间尺度且必须显式利用观测间隔，进而证明这两个条件等价于连续时间液态网络类。
Result: 理论证明固定增益滤波器严格次优，且无视间隔的网络无法通过增加宽度或深度来弥补间隔依赖的缺失；合成实验验证了该时间尺度要求和分离性。
Conclusion: 这些条件是必要但非充分的，且仅约束固定权重基底；若允许重训练，网络可通过其他方式达到该类别。每个代理都受此条件约束，构成了网状智能的结构性条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RSGPNet: Geometric Prompting for Remote Sensing Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) enables text-guided segmentation of unseen objects, breaking fixed-class limitations to achieve open-world understanding. However, existing OVSS methods primarily focus on modifying the CLIP attention mechanism, which still suffers from unstable local segmentation for remote sensing (RS) domain. To address these limitations, we propose RSGPNet, a training-free geometric prompting framework for RS OVSS that refines segmentation by leveraging object geometric areas and consistency constraints. Specifically, RSGPNet comprises three core modules: a Text-guided Coarse Mask module (TCM), a Geometric Re-prompting Module (GRP), and a Coarse-to-fine Consistency Verification Mechanism (CVM). TCM utilizes text prompts and the input image to construct initial coarse segmentation masks. GRP then converts these coarse masks into geometric box prompts, feeding them back into the segmentation model to generate refined masks. Finally, CVM employs consistency computation to prevent prompting from reinforcing erroneous regions. They allow the model to improve segmentation accuracy in complex areas, such as category boundaries. Extensive experiments on RS datasets demonstrate that RSGPNet significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods across both quantitative and qualitative metrics while exhibiting excellent interpretability. The code is released at \href{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RSGPNet}{https://github.com/wangshanwen001/RSGPNet}.
papers.comment: Open-vocabulary, Remote sensing, Geometric prompting, Multimodal large language model
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RSGPNet，一种无需训练的几何提示框架，用于遥感开放词汇语义分割。通过文本引导粗掩码、几何重提示和一致性验证三个模块，提升复杂区域（如类别边界）的分割精度。实验表明在遥感数据集上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇语义分割方法主要修改CLIP注意力机制，在遥感领域仍存在局部分割不稳定的问题。
Method: RSGPNet包含三个核心模块：文本引导粗掩码模块（TCM）生成初始粗分割掩码；几何重提示模块（GRP）将粗掩码转换为几何框提示并反馈给分割模型生成细化掩码；粗到细一致性验证机制（CVM）通过一致性计算防止错误区域被强化。
Result: 在遥感数据集上的实验表明，RSGPNet在定量和定性指标上均显著优于现有最先进方法，并展现出良好的可解释性。
Conclusion: 本文提出的几何提示方法无需训练即可有效改进遥感开放词汇语义分割，尤其适用于类别边界等复杂区域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evidence-Driven LLM Agent for C-to-Synthesizable-C Conversion and Verification
papers.abstract_en: Software-compilable C programs routinely fail to complete the four-stage pipeline of a high-level synthesis (HLS) toolchain -- compilation, C simulation (CSim), synthesis, and C/RTL co-simulation (CoSim) -- because HLS accepts only a synthesizable subset of C (HLS-C). Yet most existing large language model (LLM) systems built for HLS code repair only cover the early pipeline stages and feed raw tool logs directly to the model, yielding brittle and hard-to-reproduce fixes. We formulate C-to-HLS-C conversion as a closed-loop generation-verification-diagnosis-repair problem on an HLS tool (Xilinx Vitis), contributing three components: an end-to-end workflow of cooperating agents closed by the four-stage verifier under strict evidence isolation; a Progressive Mismatch Localization Chain (PMLC) that localizes CSim/CoSim mismatches through log normalization, AST backward slicing, and dual-trace instrumentation; and a typed-query, two-stage evidence RAG backed by a self-evolving, family-routed repair-card pool. Experimental results show that the proposed workflow substantially outperforms all comparable state-of-the-art models.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 8 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Computer-Aided Design of Integrated Circuits and Systems (TCAD)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对软件可编译C程序难以通过HLS工具链（Xilinx Vitis）四阶段流水线的问题，提出一个基于LLM代理的闭环生成-验证-诊断-修复框架。该框架包含三个核心组件：由四阶段验证器闭环的端到端多代理工作流、基于日志归一化、AST反向切片和双踪迹插值的渐进式错配定位链（PMLC），以及基于自演化修复卡池的带类型查询两阶段证据RAG。实验结果表明该方法显著优于现有SOTA模型。
Motivation: 现有HLS代码修复的LLM系统仅覆盖编译和仿真等早期阶段，直接输入原始工具日志，导致修复结果脆弱且难以复现。
Method: 提出三个组件：1）由编译、CSim、综合、CoSim四阶段验证器闭环的端到端多代理工作流，严格隔离证据；2）PMLC通过日志归一化、AST反向切片和双踪迹插值定位CSim/CoSim中的不匹配；3）基于自演化、族路由的修复卡池，实现带类型查询的两阶段证据RAG。
Result: 在HLS工具链上的实验表明，该工作流在所有对比模型中取得了显著更优的性能，超越当前SOTA。
Conclusion: 论文强调将C到HLS-C转换建模为闭环问题，并利用证据隔离、错配定位和检索增强生成可有效提高自动化修复的鲁棒性和可复现性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can AI Draw Science? A Benchmark for Evaluating Scientific Figure Generation by Text-to-Image and Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image and multimodal generative models are increasingly used to produce scientific figures such as mechanism diagrams, experimental-design schematics, conceptual frameworks, and graphical abstracts. Yet existing image-generation benchmarks (e.g., GenEval, T2I-CompBench, DPG-Bench) evaluate natural images and measure compositionality, object counting, or photorealism. None of them measure what makes a generated scientific figure usable: correct and legible text labels, faithful depiction of entities and their relations, coherent diagrammatic structure, and adherence to disciplinary drawing conventions. We introduce SciDraw-Bench, a benchmark of 32 structured scientific-figure generation tasks spanning eight figure types and ten disciplines, where each task pairs a natural-language prompt with a machine-checkable specification of required labels, relations, components, conventions, and negative constraints. We propose a four-dimensional evaluation protocol: Text Fidelity (OCR-based label recall and character error rate), Semantic Correctness (vision-language-model judging against the specification), Structural Quality, and Convention Adherence, together with a meta-evaluation protocol and a preliminary inter-judge reliability analysis (human-rating validation is ongoing). We evaluate a domain-specific system, SciDraw AI, against representative general-purpose text-to-image models, and outline a code-to-figure baseline as a planned extension. In a pilot over all eight figure types, the domain-specific system substantially outperforms the general-purpose baselines on every dimension and figure type, with the largest gaps on semantic correctness and convention adherence; text fidelity remains the hardest dimension for all systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍SciDraw-Bench，一个评估文本到图像和多模态模型生成科学图表能力的基准。它包含32个结构化任务，覆盖8种图表类型和10个学科，从文本保真度、语义正确性、结构质量和惯例遵循四个维度进行自动评估。初步实验表明，领域专用系统SciDraw AI在所有维度上显著优于通用模型，而文本保真度仍是所有系统的难点。
Motivation: 现有图像生成基准仅评估自然图像，无法衡量科学图表的可用性，如正确标签、实体关系忠实性、图表结构连贯性和学科绘图惯例。
Method: 构建SciDraw-Bench基准，包含32个科学图表生成任务及机器可检查的规范，提出四维评估协议：文本保真度（OCR的标签召回和字符错误率）、语义正确性（VLM判断）、结构质量和惯例遵循，并设计了元评估和初步的评判者间信度分析。
Result: 在覆盖全部8种图表类型的试点实验中，领域专用系统SciDraw AI在每个维度上均大幅超越通用基线模型，其中语义正确性和惯例遵循的差距最大；文本保真度对所有系统仍最具挑战。
Conclusion: SciDraw-Bench为科学图表生成提供了首个结构化基准，揭示了当前模型在文本保真度上的不足，并证明领域专用设计能显著提升图表质量。人类标注验证正在进行中，代码到图表的基线作为扩展计划概述。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Enhancing Layer Interaction Using Key-Correlated Layer Attention
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in network architecture design have introduced layer attention to enhance inter-layer interactions. In such frameworks, each layer queries all preceding layers to establish cross-layer connections. However, layer attention results in quadratic computational complexity with respect to network depth. To mitigate this issue, prior works have proposed Recurrent Layer Attention (RLA) and linear attention mechanisms, which suffer from static information updates and limited long-range cross-layer dependency modeling. To overcome these limitations, we propose Key-Correlated Layer Attention (KCLA), inspired by our observation that Key representations in layer attention exhibit high cosine similarity. KCLA achieves linear computational complexity while preserving dynamic information updates, directly derived from the foundational definition of layer attention. Furthermore, KCLA maintains long-range cross-layer connections and features a fixed spatial complexity, independent of network depth. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that KCLA delivers good performance across diverse tasks, including image recognition, object detection, and medical image segmentation. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/bgx666/KCLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Key-Correlated Layer Attention (KCLA)，一种线性复杂度的层注意力机制，通过利用键表示的余弦相似性，实现动态信息更新和长程跨层依赖建模，避免二次复杂度。在图像识别、目标检测和医学图像分割等任务上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有层注意力机制存在二次计算复杂度，而简化方案如循环层注意力和线性注意力存在静态信息更新和长程依赖建模不足的问题。
Method: 提出 KCLA，基于层注意力中键表示的高余弦相似性观察，推导出线性复杂度的注意力计算，同时保持动态信息更新和固定空间复杂度。
Result: 在图像识别、目标检测和医学图像分割任务上表现良好。
Conclusion: KCLA 在线性复杂度下实现了动态信息更新和长程跨层连接，有望成为深度网络层交互的高效替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Financing Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure: Mapping AI Infrastructure Investment and Compute Governance Across Africa
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence depends on large-scale compute resources and their supporting infrastructure. However, AI governance debates treat compute primarily as a technical input rather than as an outcome of investment, ownership, and financial control. This paper examines AI infrastructure investment flows across Africa through a systematic analysis of 46 publicly announced projects totalling USD $12.7 billion between 2019 and 2025. Using a value chain framework, we analyze who invests in AI-relevant infrastructure and where investments concentrate. Our findings reveal a highly concentrated landscape dominated by global data center operators, hyperscale technology firms, and development finance institutions, clustering in South Africa, Kenya, Nigeria, and Egypt. We introduce asymmetrical interdependence to describe a structural condition in which capital and physical infrastructure account for 73% of total funding while control remains concentrated in the compute layer among a small number of global technology firms. We argue that compute governance must account for capital flows, ownership, and control, not only geographic access, because these dynamics shape AI compute equity. Infrastructure presence is necessary but insufficient for meaningful governance capacity.
papers.comment: 14 pages; two figures. Currently under review at Data and Policy journal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文通过系统分析2019至2025年间非洲46个公开AI基础设施项目（总计127亿美元），研究了投资流动的格局。采用价值链框架发现，投资高度集中在南非、肯尼亚、尼日利亚和埃及，由全球数据中心运营商、超大规模科技公司和发展金融机构主导。提出“不对称相互依赖”概念，指出资本和实体基础设施占总资金的73%，但控制权集中在少数全球科技公司的计算层。认为计算治理必须关注资本流动、所有权和控制，而不仅是地理可及性。
Motivation: 现有AI治理辩论将计算视为技术输入，而非投资、所有权和金融控制的结果，导致对非洲AI基础设施的投资与控制缺乏系统分析。
Method: 采用价值链框架，对2019-2025年间公开宣布的46个非洲AI相关基础设施项目进行系统分析，考察投资者身份和投资地理集中度。
Result: 发现投资高度集中在南非、肯尼亚、尼日利亚和埃及，主要由全球数据中心运营商、超大规模科技公司和发展金融机构主导。资本和实体基础设施占总资金73%，但控制权集中在少数全球科技公司的计算层。
Conclusion: 计算治理需考虑资本流动、所有权和控制，而不仅是地理位置；基础设施存在对治理能力必要但不充分。
Relevance: 0
