papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Software Vulnerability Analysis: A Systematic Review with Emphasis on C/C++ Source Code and Static Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Vulnerability detection in C/C++ software remains a major security challenge due to code complexity, manual memory management, and the limitations of traditional static analysis. Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising approach, particularly for fuzzing, test generation, program exploration, and, more recently, vulnerability detection and localization. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, this work reviews RL techniques for software vulnerability analysis, focusing on C/C++ source code and static analysis. We identified 21 primary studies published between 2015 and 2026 from major scientific databases and complementary searches. We analyze the addressed tasks, algorithms, state-action-reward-environment formulations, code representations, datasets, and evaluation metrics. Results show that 15 studies focus on fuzzing and guided exploration, only 3 on direct vulnerability detection, and just 1 on statement-level localization. Moreover, statically extracted structural representations such as Control Flow Graphs (CFGs) and Abstract Syntax Trees (ASTs) are rarely used as agent states, and benchmarks lack comparability. We propose a task- and formulation-oriented taxonomy and identify a key research gap: the absence of RL agents that use source-code CFGs as states to detect and localize vulnerable nodes.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. Submitted to CIARP 2026
papers.journal_ref: CIARP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文按照PRISMA 2020指南系统综述了强化学习（RL）在C/C++软件漏洞分析中的应用，重点覆盖静态分析和源代码。从2015-2026年间筛选出21篇主要研究，分析了它们解决的任务、算法、状态-动作-奖励-环境制定、代码表示、数据集和评估指标。发现大部分研究聚焦于模糊测试和引导式探索（15篇），仅有3篇涉及直接漏洞检测，1篇涉及语句级定位；静态提取的代码表示（如控制流图、抽象语法树）很少被用作智能体状态，且基准缺乏可比性。论文提出了任务导向和制定导向的分类法，并识别出一个关键研究空白：缺少使用源代码控制流图作为状态来检测和定位漏洞节点的强化学习智能体。
Motivation: C/C++软件漏洞检测由于代码复杂度、手动内存管理以及传统静态分析的局限性仍是重大安全挑战，而强化学习虽有潜力但在漏洞分析中的系统研究尚不充分，缺乏针对该领域的全面综述和分类。
Method: 遵循PRISMA 2020系统综述方法，从主要科学数据库和补充搜索中识别21篇2015-2026年间的主要研究，并分析任务、算法、马尔可夫决策过程制定、代码表示、数据集和评估指标，进而提出一个任务导向和制定导向的分类法。
Result: 发现15篇研究针对模糊测试和引导式探索，仅3篇用于直接漏洞检测，1篇用于语句级定位；静态提取的结构化表示（如控制流图、抽象语法树）很少作为强化学习智能体的状态；不同研究使用的基准缺乏可比性。

papers.title: DCSNet: Multiscale Feature Aggregation for Small Medical Object Segmentation with Detection-guided Hierarchical Cropping
papers.abstract_en: Small object segmentation in medical imaging is primarily hindered by class imbalance and inherent boundary complexity. Consequently, conventional global networks frequently fail to detect sparse targets or suffer from severe edge degradation. To overcome these limitations, we propose the Detection-guided Cropping Segmentation Network (DCSNet), an end-to-end framework that transforms global dense prediction into a localized refinement process. This framework integrates two core components, namely Detection-guided Hierarchical Cropping (DGHC) and Multiscale Feature Aggregation (MSFA). The DGHC module leverages region proposals to dynamically extract object-centric features, effdataectively filtering out massive background interference to mitigate class imbalance. Subsequently, the MSFA module operates strictly within these purified regions, synergizing a Transformer encoder with a pixel-adaptive fusion strategy. This mechanism dynamically aggregates multiscale features to capture both semantic context and fine-grained details for sharp boundary delineation. Extensive experiments across three diverse medical datasets demonstrate that DCSNet significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, yielding substantial improvements in boundary precision and offering a highly robust solution for clinical micro-lesion segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DCSNet，一种用于医学图像中小目标分割的端到端框架。该方法通过检测引导的分层裁剪（DGHC）和多尺度特征聚合（MSFA）模块，将全局密集预测转化为局部细化过程，有效缓解类别不平衡和边界模糊问题。在三个医学数据集上，DCSNet显著优于现有方法，提升了边界精度。
Motivation: 常规全局网络在处理医学图像中小目标分割时易受类别不平衡和边界复杂性的影响，导致稀疏目标漏检或边缘退化。
Method: 提出DCSNet框架，包含两个核心组件：检测引导的分层裁剪（DGHC）利用区域建议动态提取目标中心特征，过滤背景干扰；多尺度特征聚合（MSFA）在净化区域内结合Transformer编码器和像素自适应融合策略，动态聚合多尺度特征以捕捉语义上下文和细粒度细节。
Result: 在三个不同医学数据集上的实验表明，DCSNet显著优于现有最先进方法，在边界精度上取得实质性改进。
Conclusion: DCSNet为临床微病灶分割提供了高鲁棒性的解决方案，通过检测引导裁剪和特征聚合有效解决了小目标分割的难题。

papers.title: Vision-driven Preference Synthesis for Mitigating Hallucinations in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong performance in visual understanding, yet they still suffer from hallucinations, generating content that is not grounded in the image. Preference alignment is a promising approach to improve visual faithfulness, but its success depends heavily on how preference pairs are constructed. Existing methods exhibit two key limitations; (a) intervention-based methods often introduce significant deviation from the policy distribution, and (b) sampling-based methods often underuse visual information during the construction. In this paper, we propose ViPSy (Vision-driven Preference Synthesis), a framework for constructing preference data that are both policy-aligned and visually grounded. Our framework consists of two stages; in the first stage, ViPSy derives a visual cue from recurring object-level content across semantically aligned image variants, so preference construction can rely on visual information rather than language priors. In the second stage, ViPSy conditions the policy's own rollouts on this cue, allowing candidates to be guided by visually grounded content while staying close to the policy's response distribution. The resulting candidates remain close to the policy's response distribution while better leveraging visual information from the image. Experiments show that the resulting VLM, preference-aligned with ViPSy-constructed preference pairs, achieves a new state-of-the-art in hallucination mitigation. Compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, it reduces hallucination rates on AMBER and Object HalBench by 35.7% and 24.5%, respectively. The resulting model further improves on general visual grounding benchmarks, e.g., MMStar, MMVP, and CV-Bench, while also yielding gains in semantic segmentation and ImageNet linear probing, underscoring the effectiveness of our framework in enhancing the model's visual capabilities.
papers.comment: 29 pages; Code is available at https://github.com/yunpal/ViPSy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ViPSy (Vision-driven Preference Synthesis) 框架，通过两阶段过程构建既对齐策略分布又视觉锚定的偏好数据，用于缓解视觉语言模型（VLM）的幻觉。第一阶段从语义对齐的图像变体中提取对象级视觉线索，第二阶段将策略的 rollouts 条件化于此线索。实验表明，使用 ViPSy 构造的偏好对进行对齐后，模型在 AMBER 和 Object HalBench 上幻觉率分别降低 35.7% 和 24.5%，并在多个视觉接地基准上取得改进。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 在视觉理解中仍存在幻觉，偏好对齐方法依赖偏好对构建，但现有干预法偏离策略分布，采样法则未充分利用视觉信息，亟需一种既贴近策略分布又充分利用视觉信息的偏好数据构建方法。
Method: 提出 ViPSy，包含两阶段：第一阶段从语义对齐的图像变体中提取对象级视觉线索；第二阶段将策略的 rollouts 条件化于此线索，使生成的候选响应既保持与策略分布接近，又能更好地利用图像中的视觉信息。
Result: 使用 ViPSy 对齐的 VLM 在 AMBER 和 Object HalBench 上幻觉率分别降低 35.7% 和 24.5%，达到新 SOTA；同时在 MMStar、MMVP、CV-Bench 等视觉接地基准上获得提升，并在语义分割和 ImageNet 线性探测任务上也有增益。
Conclusion: ViPSy 通过视觉驱动的偏好合成有效增强 VLM 的视觉能力，显著缓解幻觉，并在多个视觉任务上验证了其有效性。

papers.title: Meta-learning as a principle for human-like visual representations
papers.abstract_en: The structure of human visual representations underpins our capacity for adaptive behaviour. While pretrained neural networks model human visual representations with unprecedented success, a large discrepancy remains. We propose one reason: these networks optimise a single fixed objective, whereas human representations must support open-ended tasks. We hypothesise this flexibility arises from meta-learning (learning to learn), a pressure shaping representations to acquire new tasks from few observations. To test this, we train a sequence model, without any supervision from human data, across thousands of semantically rich tasks mapping images to high-level concepts. Compared to their pretrained base encoders, meta-learned representations better predict human similarity judgements, semantic rule learning, and high-level visual cortex. Behavioural gains depend on disentangled, high-level task distributions, while brain alignment is driven primarily by the learning-to-learn pressure. Our results suggest the flexibility of human visual representations reflects the functional demand to learn new semantic relationships on the fly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出元学习（meta-learning）可能是人类视觉表征灵活性的来源。通过训练序列模型在数千个语义任务上学习，无需人类数据监督，元学习得到的表征在预测人类相似性判断、语义规则学习和高级视觉皮层方面优于预训练基础编码器。行为增益依赖于解耦的高级任务分布，而大脑对齐主要由学习如何学习（learning-to-learn）的压力驱动。
Motivation: 预训练神经网络虽然成功模拟人类视觉表征，但差距仍大，可能是因为它们优化单一固定目标，而人类表征需支持开放式任务。作者假设这种灵活性源自元学习。
Method: 训练一个序列模型，在数千个将图像映射到高层概念的语义丰富任务上进行元学习，不使用任何人类数据监督。
Result: 元学习表征比预训练基础编码器更好地预测人类相似性判断、语义规则学习和高级视觉皮层活动。行为增益取决于解耦的高层任务分布，而大脑对齐主要由学习到学习的压力驱动。
Conclusion: 人类视觉表征的灵活性可能反映了快速学习新语义关系的功能需求。

papers.title: Semantic-Aware Generative Image Transmission for Resource-Constrained Visual IoT Systems
papers.abstract_en: Resource-constrained visual Internet of Things (IoT) systems, such as edge cameras, unmanned sensing platforms, industrial inspection nodes, and remote monitoring sensors, often need to transmit task-relevant visual evidence over low-rate wireless links to an edge/cloud service. Existing image communication methods usually compress or transmit complete global representations, leaving limited room to exploit receiver-side generative restoration. This paper proposes a semantic-aware generative image transmission framework for edge-assisted visual IoT. The image captured by an IoT visual sensor is encoded into a discrete token grid by a VQ encoder. At the IoT transmitter or nearby gateway, token recoverability, estimated from prediction entropy and local structure complexity, is fused with semantic importance obtained from instance segmentation and category-aware scoring. A spatial dispersal sampler then selects the tokens to be transmitted under a bitrate budget. The transmitter sends only the quantization indices of kept tokens and a binary mask map, while the edge/cloud receiver recovers masked tokens through MaskGIT with Halton sequence scheduling. Experiments on Kodak and VisDrone scenes under AWGN and Rayleigh channels show that the proposed method provides a flexible bitrate-quality tradeoff for narrowband visual IoT links. At 0.074 bpp, it uses 44.6% of the transmitted bits of the 0.167-bpp DeepJSCC/WITT reference while achieving 29.9 dB PSNR. A pseudo-GT downstream detection study on Kodak further shows that semantic-aware masking preserves task-relevant objects better than random masking at both 30% and 50% mask ratios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该文提出语义感知生成式图像传输框架，用于资源受限视觉物联网。采用VQ编码器将图像编码为离散token网格，结合预测熵、局部结构复杂度和语义重要性进行token选择，仅传输保留token的量化索引和二进制掩码，接收端用MaskGIT和Halton序列调度恢复掩码token。在Kodak和VisDrone场景下，0.074 bpp时PSNR达29.9 dB，仅用参考方法44.6%的传输比特。
Motivation: 现有图像通信方法通常压缩或传输完整全局表示，未充分利用接收端生成式恢复能力，尤其对资源受限视觉IoT系统在低速率无线链路上传输任务相关视觉证据的需求。
Method: 提出语义感知生成式图像传输框架：VQ编码器提取离散token；融合token可恢复性（预测熵和局部结构复杂度）与语义重要性（实例分割和类别感知评分）；空间分散采样器在比特率预算下选择token；仅传输保留token索引和二进制掩码；接收端用MaskGIT和Halton序列调度恢复掩码token。
Result: 在AWGN和瑞利信道下，0.074 bpp时PSNR达29.9 dB，使用DeepJSCC/WITT参考方法44.6%的传输比特。语义感知掩码在30%和50%掩码率下比随机掩码更好保留任务相关对象。
Conclusion: 该方法为窄带视觉IoT链路提供灵活比特率-质量权衡，语义感知掩码增强任务对象保留。

papers.title: CLOSER-VLN: Closed-Loop Self-Verified Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language navigation (VLN) has recently advanced with large language and multimodal models, enabling agents to follow natural-language instructions in unseen environments without training a task-specific navigation policy. However, most existing VLN methods relying on large models still adopt an open-loop decision-execution approach, where candidate actions are generated from instructions and observations but are rarely verified or corrected before execution. This causes critical issues in aerial VLN, where minor errors in intermediate actions may quickly accumulate into large trajectory deviations and lead to target loss. To address this issue, we propose Closed-loop Self-verified Retrieval-augmented Reasoning (CLOSER), a training-policy-free method that sequentially performs action reasoning, reliability verification, targeted retrieval, and action correction in a closed-loop manner before executing concrete actions. We instantiate the CLOSER in aerial VLN tasks and develop a CLOSER-VLN framework, which is composed of three components: a hierarchical reasoner for generating candidate actions based on available information, a multidimensional action verifier for assessing the reliability of actions generated by the reasoner, and a verification-triggered multimodal retriever for retrieving targeted exemplars from a memory bank only when verification fails. We conduct experimental evaluations on the CityNav benchmark, where CLOSER-VLN achieves 32.01% SR and 21.28% SPL on the test-unseen split, confirming the effectiveness of closed-loop reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CLOSER-VLN，一种无需训练策略的闭环自我验证检索增强推理方法，用于空中视觉语言导航。该方法在行动执行前依次进行推理、验证、检索和修正，以降低误差累积。在CityNav基准上，CLOSER-VLN在测试未见分割上达到32.01%的SR和21.28%的SPL。
Motivation: 现有大型模型驱动的VLN方法多采用开环决策执行方式，中间动作的错误难以被验证或修正，导致空中导航中误差累积和目标丢失。
Method: 提出CLOSER框架，包含层次推理器生成候选动作、多维动作验证器评估可靠性、验证触发的多模态检索器在验证失败时从记忆库检索示例，实现闭环推理。
Result: 在CityNav基准测试未见分割上，CLOSER-VLN取得32.01%的成功率和21.28%的SPL，验证了闭环推理的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调闭环自我验证与检索增强推理能够有效减少空中VLN中的动作误差累积，且无需任务特定训练策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RadarTwin: Scene-Specific mmWave Radar Simulation and Learning for Mobile Indoor Perception
papers.abstract_en: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar perception is limited by data scarcity: models trained on existing radar datasets fail to generalize to new objects, environments, and sensing trajectories. We present RadarTwin, a framework for generating deployment-specific radar training data before real data collection. Given a 3D reconstruction of a target space (phone LiDAR, robot-mounted sensing, or RGB-to-3D), RadarTwin uses a vision-language model to infer radar-relevant surface materials and a physics-based ray tracer to synthesize raw frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar measurements with multi-bounce propagation. To study what transfers from simulation to reality, we collect a paired real-simulated dataset spanning household objects, material classes, distances, rotations, translations, and mobile sensing trajectories. We show that simulated and real radar share the same object-discriminative shape and material features, and that modeling the environment's multipath is essential to matching real measurements. A representation trained on simulation alone recognizes real objects at 2.5 times chance with no real radar labels, and a few labeled examples raise this to 95.3% on a 12-way recognition task. RadarTwin enables training radar perception for a new space before any real radar data is collected there.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RadarTwin 是一个框架，能在采集真实数据前，为目标空间生成场景特定的毫米波雷达训练数据。它利用 3D 重建、视觉语言模型推断材料属性，并通过物理光线追踪合成 FMCW 雷达测量。实验表明，仅使用仿真数据训练的模型对真实物体的识别率是随机水平的 2.5 倍，加入少量标签后可达 95.3%。
Motivation: 毫米波雷达感知受限于数据稀缺，现有数据集训练的模型难以泛化到新物体、环境和轨迹。
Method: 给定目标空间的 3D 重建（如手机 LiDAR、机器人传感或 RGB 转 3D），RadarTwin 使用视觉语言模型推断雷达相关的表面材料，并用基于物理的光线追踪器合成包含多径传播的 FMCW 雷达测量。
Result: 仿真与真实雷达共享物体判别性形状和材料特征；仅仿真训练识别真实物体的概率是随机水平 2.5 倍，少量标签后 12 类识别准确率达 95.3%。
Conclusion: RadarTwin 能在真实数据采集前为全新空间训练雷达感知模型，减少对大规模真实标注的依赖。

papers.title: JASPR: Joint Spatial Representation learning of histology and spatial genomics for improved virtual genomic screening and clinical prognostication
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies have shown that spatial properties of tumors are critical for understanding disease biology and predicting patient outcomes. These spatial properties are increasingly uncovered through complementary modalities: spatial transcriptomics (ST) captures spatially-resolved molecular states, while hematoxylin and eosin-stained whole slide images (HE) reveal tissue morphology. While approaches are emerging to fuse these modalities, effective methods that learn not only joint representations but also incorporate spatial context across modalities are lacking. Here, we present JASPR (Joint Spatial Representation learning), a self-supervised deep learning framework that integrates HE images and ST data through a cross-modal reconstruction objective that incorporates spatial context within HE images and ST profiles. It employs shared modules to capture universal spatial properties across modalities, while modality-specific experts encode features unique to morphological and genomic data. We train and validate JASPR on breast cancer datasets, demonstrating that its learned joint representation substantially improves HE-based prediction of 9,248 genes and provides prognostic value for breast cancer outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: JASPR是一个自监督深度学习框架，通过跨模态重建目标整合HE组织学图像和空间转录组学（ST）数据，学习联合空间表示。在乳腺癌数据集上，该表示显著改善了基于HE图像的9,248个基因表达预测，并提供了预后价值。
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏有效融合组织学图像与空间转录组学数据的跨模态空间上下文方法，无法同时利用形态学和分子空间信息。
Method: 采用自监督跨模态重建目标，共享模块捕捉跨模态通用空间属性，模态特定专家编码各自独有特征（形态学与基因组学）。
Result: 在乳腺癌数据集上，JASPR的联合表示大幅提升基于HE图像对9,248个基因的表达预测，并展示出乳腺癌预后价值。
Conclusion: 摘要表明JASPR能有效整合组织学与空间基因组学，改善虚拟基因筛选和临床预后，但未提及局限性或泛化性。

papers.title: Personalized Additive Modeling for Multi-level Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary AI faces the challenge of balancing generality with user-specific personalization. In federated learning (FL), this challenge is amplified by highly heterogeneous client data with complex non-IID patterns beyond standard IID assumptions. Many existing FL methods are designed for relatively restricted heterogeneity settings (e.g., a fixed number of clusters or a fixed form of personalization), limiting their robustness under complex structures. In this work, we study FL from a \emph{multi-level non-IID} perspective, where client similarity is captured by multiple granularities of shared knowledge: global, subgroup, and client-specific components. This view captures coarse-to-fine relationships while requiring less prior knowledge of task boundaries. Building on this insight, we propose \emph{Federated Multi-level Additive Modeling} (FeMAM), which learns multiple levels of shareable models and constructs personalized predictors via additive composition across levels. To move beyond a fixed structure, FeMAM allows models to grow and be pruned dynamically during training, adapting to diverse federated scenarios. Despite employing multiple models, FeMAM remains cost-friendly by unlocking only a small subset (one level) of models for training at a time. Extensive experiments show that FeMAM effectively approximates diverse complex non-IID structures and consistently outperforms representative clustered and personalized FL baselines.
papers.comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从多层次非独立同分布（multi-level non-IID）角度研究联邦学习，提出 FeMAM 方法，通过学习全局、子组和客户端特定三个层级的可共享模型，并通过加性组合构建个性化预测器。FeMAM 支持训练中动态增长和剪枝模型，且每次只激活一个层级进行训练以保持计算效率。实验表明，FeMAM 能有效逼近多种复杂非IID结构，并优于现有聚类和个性化联邦学习基线。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习方法多针对相对受限的异质性设置（如固定聚类数或固定个性化形式），难以处理具有复杂层次结构的客户端数据。
Method: 提出 Federated Multi-level Additive Modeling (FeMAM)，学习多个层级的可共享模型（全局、子组、客户端），通过加性组合构建个性化预测器，并允许模型在训练中动态增长和剪枝。
Result: 实验表明 FeMAM 能有效逼近多种复杂非 IID 结构，并在多个基准上持续优于代表性聚类和个性化联邦学习方法。
Conclusion: FeMAM 通过多层次加性建模和动态结构调整，实现了对复杂异构联邦场景的鲁棒适应，同时保持计算成本可控。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GPU-Accelerated Inverse Structural Anastylosis from Block Collapse Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: The physical anastylosis of collapsed architectural monuments -- the meticulous reassembly of fallen stone elements into their original structural configuration -- represents one of the most intellectually demanding challenges in conservation science. Traditional approaches depend heavily on expert archaeologist judgement and manual block-by-block correspondence, a process that is both labour-intensive and inherently subjective. Inspired by the combinatorial complexity of this problem as manifested in the game of Jenga, we present Jenga Inverse Predictor , a GPU-accelerated deep learning framework that addresses structural anastylosis as an inverse prediction task. Given an image of a collapsed block assembly, JIP-2 reconstructs the most probable prior tower configuration by: (1) implementing a complete rigid-body physics engine with OBB/SAT collision detection and a Projected Gauss-Seidel (PGS) contact solver accelerated with Numba JIT and CuPy CUDA; (2) applying the analytical force thresholds of Ziglar (CMU, 2006) -- F_app = 3*mu_s*m*g (Y-axis, torque-free) and F_app = 4*mu_s*m*g (X-axis, torque risk) -- over three friction levels (mu_s in {0.25, 0.40, 0.60}) across 450 simulated episodes; (3) training a dual-stream ResNet-18 that injects a friction one-hot vector and jointly predicts block removal count, per-position removal probabilities, centre-of-mass imbalance, and Ziglar torque risk; and (4) generating a smooth 3-D video of the block-by-block reverse reconstruction. We discuss implications for computer-assisted anastylosis at the UNESCO Maya site of Uxmal, Yucatan, and provide a detailed technical description of the full pipeline, architecture, and loss formulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Jenga Inverse Predictor (JIP-2)，一个 GPU 加速的深度学习框架，将倒塌建筑结构的逆向拼装（逆向结构拼装）建模为逆预测任务。框架集成刚体物理引擎、基于摩擦力的力阈值分析，并使用双流 ResNet-18 预测块移除序列和质心失衡等。方法在 450 个模拟回合上验证，并讨论了对 UNESCO 玛雅遗址 Uxmal 的计算机辅助拼装应用。
Motivation: 传统的建筑结构拼装依赖专家经验和手动对应，劳动密集且主观性强。本文受 Jenga 游戏启发，试图将倒塌结构拼装形式化为逆向预测问题。
Method: 提出 JIP-2，包含四个步骤：(1) 实现 GPU 加速的刚体物理引擎（OBB/SAT 碰撞检测和 PGS 接触求解器）；(2) 应用 Ziglar 的力阈值公式，考虑三个摩擦等级；(3) 训练双流 ResNet-18，输入图像和摩擦 one-hot 向量，联合预测块移除数量、位置概率、质心失衡和扭矩风险；(4) 生成平滑的 3D 逐块逆向重建视频。
Result: 在 450 个模拟回合上训练，方法能预测块移除顺序和结构稳定性指标。摘要未报告具体的定量性能数值，但指出该方法在模拟中有效。
Conclusion: 本文讨论了所提方法在计算机辅助拼装中的应用前景，特别是在 UNESCO 玛雅遗址 Uxmal 的应用。提供了完整的技术细节和损失函数公式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Transition-Aware best-of-N sampling for Longitudinal Chest X-ray Reports
papers.abstract_en: In longitudinal clinical practice, every chest X-ray is read in the context of the patients prior exam, and much of what the radiologist communicates is the change from one visit to the next. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first training-free best-of-N sampling scheme for pre-trained chest X-ray report generators that is explicitly aware of this longitudinal prior to current transition. We call it transition-aware best-of-N sampling, each report is split into sentences and embedded into an unordered set in Rd; each (prior, current) pair is reduced to a fixed-dim directional vector via a set-to-set distance designed to encode the change between the two sets; and candidates are scored by cosine distance from their candidate transition vector to a cached bank of ground-truth training transition vectors, aggregated as min or kNN. We instantiate the framework with four directional set distances (mean-shift, novelty residual, directed-Hausdorff anchor, and cost-weighted optimal transport) and evaluate on a multi-visit AP-PA cohort, running inference under three prompts on three vision-language generators. Transition-aware best-of-N outperforms random selection across the board, with the largest relative gains on the Impression section.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对纵向胸部X光报告的生成任务，提出了一种无需额外训练的 transition-aware best-of-N 采样方法。该方法将报告拆句嵌入为无序集合，通过集合间距离计算方向向量表示从先前到当前的转换，并利用余弦距离匹配候选转换与真实训练转换向量库来评分。在多个视觉语言生成器上的实验表明，该方法全面优于随机选择，尤其在印象（Impression）部分提升最大。
Motivation: 现有胸部X光报告生成通常忽略患者的既往影像，而放射科医生的实际工作高度依赖对比前后变化。
Method: 提出一种训练无关的 best-of-N 采样框架，利用四种方向集合距离（mean-shift, novelty residual, directed-Hausdorff anchor, cost-weighted optimal transport）计算报告间的转换向量，并通过最小距离或kNN聚合与训练集中真实转换向量的余弦相似度来评分候选报告。
Result: 在纵向AP-PA数据集上，使用三种生成器及不同提示，transition-aware best-of-N在所有设置下均优于随机选择。
Conclusion: 本文首次将纵向先验知识引入胸部X光报告生成的采样阶段，无需模型微调即可提升报告质量。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文首次将纵向先验知识引入胸部X光报告生成的采样阶段，无需模型微调即可提升报告质量。

papers.title: RADIANT-PET: Reasoning-Augmented PET/CT Lesion Segmentation with Large Language Models and Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Accurate lesion segmentation in PET/CT is critical for oncology, yet remains challenging because physiologic tracer uptake and artifacts can mimic malignant signal. We present RADIANT-PET, a reasoning-augmented framework that couples a high-sensitivity voxel-level segmentation model with lesion-level large language model (LLM) adjudication. Candidate uptake regions are generated with a deliberately permissive segmentation stage, then converted into structured textual descriptions that summarize uptake intensity, morphology, and regional and global anatomical context. An LLM classifies each candidate as true lesion vs. false positive, optionally leveraging the radiology report as additional clinical context. To strengthen lesion-level reasoning, we further optimize a local LLM via reinforcement learning using Group Relative Policy Optimization, rewarding correct lesion classification and anatomically concordant site assignment. Across AutoPET and an OSU test cohort, RADIANT-PET consistently outperforms strong image-only baselines, with the largest improvements observed when radiology reports are provided. Overall, these results demonstrate that LLM-based lesion-level reasoning adds a novel reasoning layer beyond conventional segmentation, suppressing physiologic false positives and aligning voxel-level predictions with clinical interpretation. The project repository is available at: https://github.com/jwang-580/RADIANT-PET.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RADIANT-PET框架，将高灵敏度体素级分割模型与大语言模型（LLM）的病灶级推理相结合，用于PET/CT病变分割。候选摄取区域被转换为结构化文本描述，LLM判断是否为真实病变，并利用放射学报告提供临床上下文；通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行强化学习优化。在AutoPET和OSU测试集上，该方法优于图像基线，尤其在提供放射报告时改进最大。
Motivation: PET/CT中准确病变分割因生理摄取和伪影模拟恶性信号而具有挑战性。
Method: 使用宽容的分割阶段生成候选区域，转换为结构化文本描述（包括摄取强度、形态、局部和全局解剖上下文），LLM分类候选为真实病变或假阳性，并可结合放射学报告；利用GRPO强化学习优化局部LLM。
Result: 在AutoPET和OSU测试集上，RADIANT-PET持续优于图像基线，提供放射报告时改进最大。
Conclusion: LLM的病灶级推理为分割提供了新的推理层，抑制假阳性，使体素预测与临床解读对齐。

papers.title: Few-class Fidelity: Evaluating Explanations of Real-conditions CNN classifiers with Optimized Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: The wide use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) in numerous domains and real-world classification applications is justified by their high precision and automation speed, helping users concentrate on higher-expertise tasks. To better understand the models and avoid bias during deployment, eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques can be used after training. But as the list of XAI solutions expand, comparisons between them diverge, and consensus over their evaluation cannot be reached. This paper proposes a variation of Fidelity-based XAI metrics, with a focus on real-conditions applications, where the number of classes is often low. The approach generates in-distribution, uncertainty-provoking perturbations, to ensure proper measurement of the XAI methods faithfulness. As demonstration of the evaluation framework usefulness, it is compared with human-centric object localization and segmentation metrics. Once applied to both medical and natural imaging applications, it highlights the intricate correlation between domain, data curation, and XAI solution choices in order to validate training of a new CNN model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出一种针对现实条件中类别数较少的CNN分类器可解释性评估指标变体，通过生成分布内、引发不确定性的扰动来测量XAI方法的忠实度。在医学和自然图像上验证，揭示了领域、数据整理与XAI选择之间的复杂相关性。
Motivation: 现有XAI方法数量增多但比较结果不一致，缺乏共识，尤其在真实应用中类别数少的场景下评估困难。
Method: 提出基于忠实度（Fidelity）的XAI评估指标变体，通过生成分布内且引发不确定性的扰动来测量XAI方法的可靠性。
Result: 在医学和自然图像应用中展示了评估框架的有用性，与人类中心的目标定位和分割指标比较，揭示了领域、数据整理与XAI解决方案选择之间的复杂相关性。
Conclusion: 该框架有助于验证CNN新模型的训练，强调领域、数据整理和XAI方法选择之间的相互作用。

papers.title: Automated Quality Assessment of Geospatial Vector Data: A GeoAI Approach using Spatial Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial vector data quality is a foundational research topic in GIS, yet classic rule-based quality assessment algorithms often struggle with diverse urban morphologies and massive data volumes. Recently, Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI) shows promising potential for automating geospatial analysis, while its application to native vector data remains largely underexplored. To fill this research gap, we proposed Topo4Vec, an automated GeoAI framework, designed for scalable vector data quality assessment via advanced Spatial Representation Learning (SRL). Specifically, Topo4Vec relax the labor-intensive manual annotation process via topological error simulation, such as overlapping polygons and street network connectivity errors e.g., overshoots and undershoots. Then, it leverages state-of-the-art SRL approaches to encode complex, native vector geometries (e.g., polylines and polygons) into a latent space where topological errors are isolated from valid ones. A systematic performance evaluation across three study areas (Los Angeles, Munich, and Singapore) demonstrates the effectiveness and robustness of Topo4Vec, achieving a peak accuracy of 0.99 for detecting overlapping building footprints and 0.60 for overshoots and undershoots in street networks. Moreover, lessons learned from Topo4Vec shed a promising light into a scalable and autonomous GeoAI approach for large-scale vector data consistency and quality monitoring within the fast-growing geospatial data ecosystems. The code and data used in the paper are made openly available in https://figshare.com/s/612148eeb4bccadbd715.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Topo4Vec，一种基于空间表示学习的地理空间矢量数据自动质量评估框架。该方法通过拓扑错误模拟生成训练数据，利用先进的空间表示学习将矢量几何编码到潜在空间，实现拓扑错误与有效数据的分离。在洛杉矶、慕尼黑和新加坡三个研究区域的实验表明，该方法在检测重叠建筑物足迹时准确率达0.99，检测街道网络超限和欠限时准确率达0.60。
Motivation: 传统基于规则的地理空间矢量数据质量评估算法难以应对多样化的城市形态和海量数据，而现有GeoAI方法对矢量数据的直接应用尚不充分。
Method: 提出Topo4Vec框架，通过拓扑错误模拟（如重叠多边形、街道网络连接错误）生成标注数据，再使用空间表示学习对复杂矢量几何（如折线和多边形）进行编码，将拓扑错误映射到潜在空间中的隔离区域。
Result: 在洛杉矶、慕尼黑和新加坡的实验中，重叠建筑物足迹检测准确率达0.99，街道网络超限和欠限检测准确率达0.60。
Conclusion: Topo4Vec展示了一种可扩展的自主GeoAI方法，适用于大规模矢量数据的一致性和质量监测，但街道网络错误检测精度仍有提升空间。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: SoccerNet 2026 Player-Centric Ball Action Spotting: Per-Player Attention with Agreement-Based Ensembling
papers.abstract_en: We present our submission to the SoccerNet 2026 Player-Centric Ball Action Spotting challenge, which uses a two-stage pipeline: a Track-Aware Action Detector (TAAD) produces per-player action logits from broadcast video, and a Denoising Sequence Transduction (DST) transformer converts game-state features and TAAD logits into structured event sequences. We improve the TAAD with a temporal transformer that adds cross-frame context, alongside several training fixes. For the DST stage, we introduce a two-stage per-player attention mechanism operating on game-state features, and show that a spatial-first attention ordering (cross-player attention before temporal attention) improves validation Macro-F1 by 1.87%. To exploit architectural diversity, we train four model variants and combine them with a Weighted Event Fusion ensemble that applies agreement filtering to suppress single-model false positives while preserving recall, plus a dedicated exception for the rare tackle class. Our final system improves the challenge Macro-F1 from a baseline of 48.6 to 58.94.
papers.comment: 2 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. SoccerNet 2026 challenge technical report
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提交至SoccerNet 2026玩家中心足球动作定位挑战赛，提出两阶段流程：Track-Aware Action Detector (TAAD) 从广播视频生成每玩家动作logits，Denoising Sequence Transduction (DST) 转换器将游戏状态特征和TAAD logits转换为结构化事件序列。通过改进TAAD中的时序Transformer、引入每玩家注意力机制及空间优先注意力排序，并采用加权事件融合集成四个模型变体（含协议过滤抑制假阳性），将挑战赛Macro-F1从基线48.6提升至58.94。
Motivation: 足球视频中的玩家中心动作定位需要精确检测每个玩家的动作事件，现有方法在准确性和鲁棒性上存在不足。
Method: 两阶段流程：TAAD使用时序Transformer添加跨帧上下文；DST阶段引入两阶段每玩家注意力机制（空间优先排序），并训练四个模型变体通过加权事件融合集成，应用协议过滤抑制假阳性。
Result: 在SoccerNet 2026挑战赛上，Macro-F1从基线48.6提升至58.94，空间优先注意力排序提升验证集Macro-F1 1.87%。
Conclusion: 提出的两阶段管道和集成策略有效提升了玩家中心足球动作定位性能，但论文仅提交至挑战赛，未讨论泛化性。

papers.title: Schema-First Retrieval: Embedding Catalogs for Natural Language Analytics
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise text-to-SQL systems often fail before SQL is generated: the model receives the wrong schema context. Modern warehouses contain thousands of tables, abbreviated columns, informal metrics, hidden join conventions, and permission boundaries that are not captured by raw table names. We introduce Schema-First Retrieval, a retrieval layer that embeds catalog metadata rather than warehouse rows. The system indexes five typed catalog objects, tables, columns, metrics, relationships, and query history, using object-specific text templates. At query time, it combines parallel vector search, lineage expansion, cross-encoder reranking, workload memory, and deterministic access-control gates before SQL generation. On CRUSH4SQL (1,534 questions), Schema-First Retrieval reaches 96.4% table recall@20 and cross-encoder reranking adds +11.1 points at column recall@10; against an equally-templated BM25 baseline, semantic retrieval is +32.8 points at table recall@5. On SEDE (857 questions), query history raises table recall@5 from 52.1% to 92.3%. On BIRD (96 questions), schema-first context reduces SQL execution errors from 15.6% to 6.2%, a 2.5x reduction. These results show that catalog selection is a first-class retrieval problem for natural language analytics, not a prompt formatting detail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Schema-First Retrieval，一种将目录元数据（而非数据行）嵌入的检索层，用于企业级文本到 SQL 系统。通过索引表、列、指标、关系和查询历史五种对象，结合向量搜索、血缘扩展、交叉编码器重排序、工作负载记忆和访问控制，在多个基准上显著提升了表/列召回率，并减少了 SQL 执行错误。
Motivation: 现有文本到 SQL 系统常因模型接收到的模式上下文错误而失败，数据仓库中的大量表、缩写列、非正式指标、隐式连接约定和权限边界未被原始表名捕获。
Method: 构建一个包含五种目录对象的索引，使用对象特定的文本模板进行嵌入。查询时结合并行向量搜索、血缘扩展、交叉编码器重排序、工作负载记忆和确定性访问控制门，然后生成 SQL。
Result: 在 CRUSH4SQL 上，表召回@20 达到 96.4%，交叉编码器重排序在列召回@10 上提升 +11.1 点；相比 BM25 基线，语义检索在表召回@5 上提升 +32.8 点。在 SEDE 上，查询历史将表召回@5 从 52.1% 提升至 92.3%。在 BIRD 上，模式优先上下文将 SQL 执行错误从 15.6% 降至 6.2%（减少 2.5 倍）。
Conclusion: 目录选择是自然语言分析中的一个首要检索问题，而非简单的提示格式细节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Data Provenance for Image Auto-Regressive Generation
papers.abstract_en: Image autoregressive models (IARs) have recently demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual content generation, achieving photorealistic quality and rapid synthesis through the next-token prediction paradigm adapted from large language models. As these models become widely accessible, robust data provenance is required to reliably trace IAR-generated images to the source model that synthesized them. This is critical to prevent the spread of misinformation, detect fraud, and attribute harmful content. We find that although IAR-generated images often appear visually identical to real images, their generation process introduces characteristic patterns in their outputs, which serves as a reliable provenance signal for the generated images. Leveraging this, we present a post-hoc framework that enables the robust detection of such patterns for provenance tracing. Notably, our framework does not require modifications of the generative process or outputs. Thereby, it is applicable in contexts where prior watermarking methods cannot be used, such as for generated content that is already published without additional marks and for models that do not integrate watermarking. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach across a wide range of IARs, highlighting its high potential for robust data provenance tracing in autoregressive image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对图像自回归模型（IARs）的输出，提出一种无需修改生成过程的后验数据溯源框架，通过检测生成图像中的特征模式来追踪其来源模型。实验在多种IARs上验证了有效性，适用于已发布的无水印内容或未集成水印的模型。
Motivation: 随着IARs广泛使用，需要可靠地溯源生成图像以防范虚假信息、欺诈和有害内容传播。现有水印方法无法用于已发布的无水印内容或未集成水印的模型。
Method: 提出后验框架，利用IARs生成过程中引入的输出特征模式进行检测，不改变生成过程或输出。
Result: 在多种IARs上展示了有效性，表明具有高潜力。
Conclusion: 该框架适用于无法使用水印的场景，为自回归图像生成提供稳健的数据溯源。

papers.title: RoboGaze: Evaluating Robot World Models via Structured Vision-Language Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in robot world models enable synthetic video generation for embodied prediction and planning. However, evaluating these videos is challenging: visually realistic outputs often violate physical laws, temporal consistency, or task logic, while conventional metrics and monolithic Vision-Language Model (VLM) judges fail to generalize or provide precise diagnostic value. We present RoboGaze, a training-free, multi-agent VLM framework that provides structured, interpretable evaluation for generated robot-manipulation videos. Given a task instruction and video, RoboGaze operates via a three-stage pipeline: task-scene grounding, dimension-specific specialist routing, and critic-based verification. It outputs temporally localized glitch reports categorized under a novel 6-dimension, 30-type robotics-specific taxonomy. To benchmark RoboGaze, we introduce a human-validated dataset of 382 clips spanning simulated and real-world multi-view manipulation. Evaluating eight open-source and proprietary VLM backbones, RoboGaze dramatically outperforms zero-shot baselines, improving description-F1 by up to +43 points and temporal alignment (F1 x IoU) by up to +37 points, closing approximately 85% of the gap to the human ceiling. Furthermore, its critic verifier mitigates the "cry-wolf" false-positive flaw of standard VLMs, lifting clean-clip accuracy from under 25% to over 80%. RoboGaze offers a scalable, highly interpretable diagnostic tool for the rigorous evaluation of robot world models.

papers.title: A Query-Driven Communication-Efficient Digital Twins Design for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Digital twins (DTs) have become a potential technology to perform risk-free simulation of physical entities for deterministic and high-reliability services in diverse scenarios such as autonomous driving and low-altitude economy. In the autonomous driving scenario, traditional DT methods that rely solely on vehicle's real-time state synchronization, however, might lead to unacceptable computing and communication consumption for construction of high-fidelity DT with redundant data. To address this issue, we first propose a query-driven DT architecture to enable the DT to actively request the desired environment data from vehicles based on its simulation result. Then, we formulate an optimization problem whose goal is to minimize autonomous driving position error while accounting for DT fidelity and communication constraints. We also design a cross-time-step progressive query mechanism to further improve communication efficiency. The simulation results show that our proposed method achieves a 24% reduction in planning position error compared to traditional methods, while reducing communication overhead by 40%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶场景中传统数字孪生因依赖车辆实时状态同步导致高计算和通信开销的问题，提出一种查询驱动的数字孪生架构。该架构允许数字孪生基于仿真结果主动向车辆请求所需环境数据，并设计跨时间步长渐进查询机制以提升通信效率。仿真结果显示，与基线相比，该方法降低了24%的规划位置误差和40%的通信开销。
Motivation: 自动驾驶中传统数字孪生方法需实时同步车辆状态，构建高保真模型会产生冗余数据，导致不可接受的计算和通信消耗。
Method: 提出查询驱动数字孪生架构，使数字孪生能基于仿真结果主动请求环境数据；构建联合优化问题以最小化位置误差并满足保真度和通信约束；设计跨时间步长渐进查询机制。
Result: 仿真结果表明，所提方法实现规划位置误差降低24%，通信开销减少40%。
Conclusion: 查询驱动架构和渐进查询机制能有效平衡数字孪生保真度与通信效率，适用于自动驾驶等需要高可靠性的场景。

papers.title: Zero-Label Driving Scenario Complexity Detection via Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture
papers.abstract_en: Identifying complex and safety-critical driving scenarios in large unlabelled datasets is an important but expensive problem. Existing approaches rely on human annotators, supervised classifiers, or carefully engineered rule sets, all of which require substantial prior knowledge about what constitutes a difficult scenario. We ask whether a model can discover scenario complexity on its own, with no labels at any stage. We train a minimal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) on structured agent state data from the nuPlan mini dataset and use the temporal prediction error as a zero-shot complexity score. Without access to any ground-truth labels during training or evaluation setup, the model assigns significantly higher scores to scenarios involving unprotected turns, crosswalk interactions, and pedestrian proximity, and significantly lower scores to lane-following and stationary-traffic scenarios. We validate this finding through four ablation experiments that isolate the source of the signal, and through a downstream anomaly detection evaluation that achieves Average Precision of 0.512 against a 0.436 chance baseline. The results show that temporal prediction error in a self-supervised latent world model is a practical proxy for driving scenario complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需标签的驾驶场景复杂度检测方法，基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）在nuPlan mini数据集的结构化智能体状态数据上训练，利用时间预测误差作为零样本复杂度分数。实验显示该方法能区分高复杂度场景（如无保护转弯、人行横道交互）与低复杂度场景（如车道跟随），并在下游异常检测任务中达到平均精度0.512（基线0.436）。
Motivation: 现有驾驶场景复杂度检测依赖人工标注、监督分类或手工规则集，需要大量先验知识。论文旨在让模型自主发现场景复杂度，无需任何标签。
Method: 训练一个最小化的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）处理结构化智能体状态数据，将时间预测误差作为零样本复杂度分数。
Result: 模型在无标签情况下，对无保护转弯等场景分配显著更高的复杂度分数，对车道跟随等场景分配更低分数。下游异常检测平均精度0.512，超过基线0.436。
Conclusion: 时间预测误差在自监督潜在世界模型中可作为驾驶场景复杂度的实用代理，无需标签。

papers.title: Evolutional Math: Cross-Validated Island-Model Genetic Programming for Interpretable Symbolic Regression on Small, Wide Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression via genetic programming routinely fails on small, wide datasets - a regime common in clinical-trial monitoring, biostatistics, and engineering pilot studies - by converging on bloated, overfit expressions that exploit correlation rather than prediction. We present Evolutional Math, an open-source genetic programming system that combines four design choices to yield compact, interpretable formulas in this regime. First, fitness is measured by R-squared on held-out cross-validation folds rather than Pearson correlation on the training set, eliminating single-variable shortcuts that correlate but mis-scale. Second, a multi-island architecture runs independent populations seeded with distinct operator subsets (algebraic, logarithmic, trigonometric, and full) with ring-topology migration every M generations, preventing the search from collapsing into one region of formula space. Third, a structural deduplication scheme treats formulas differing only in constants as equivalent, so the elite archive contains structurally distinct candidates rather than near-duplicate variants. Fourth, top-k individuals undergo numerical constant refinement via scipy L-BFGS-B after each migration phase, decoupling structure search from parameter fitting. We evaluate the system on synthetic benchmarks of the form log(x_i) * x_j / (x_k * c), trigonometric mixtures, and an anonymized clinical site-monitoring dataset with 24 rows and approximately 290 candidate numeric features. The system consistently recovers compact ground-truth structures with R-squared at or above 0.99 within tens of thousands of unique formula evaluations. A reference implementation is released under a noncommercial source-available license.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Reference implementation available at https://gitlab.com/cyntegrity/evomath
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Evolutional Math，一种面向小宽数据集的开放式遗传编程符号回归系统。通过交叉验证R²适应度、多岛屿架构、结构去重和常数优化四个设计，在合成基准和临床数据集上以极少评估次数恢复紧凑、高可解释性的公式，R²不低于0.99。
Motivation: 标准遗传编程在小宽数据集上易收敛到臃肿、过拟合的表达式，这种场景在临床试验监测、生物统计和工程试点中常见。
Method: 采用四个关键设计：1）以适应度度量从训练集Pearson相关改为交叉验证R²；2）多岛屿架构，不同岛屿初始化不同算子子集（代数、对数、三角、全），每M代环形拓扑迁移；3）结构去重，将仅常数差异的公式视为等价，精英库保留结构不同的候选；4）每次迁移阶段后对top-k个体使用scipy L-BFGS-B进行数值常数精化。
Result: 在log(x_i)*x_j/(x_k*c)、三角函数混合等合成基准以及一个24行约290特征匿名临床试验监控数据集上，系统在数万次公式评估内恢复紧凑的真实结构，R²达到0.99或以上。
Conclusion: 系统能一致生成紧凑、可解释的符号表达式，适用于小宽数据集，且开源实现已发布。

papers.title: Distilling a Modular Reservoir Through a Genomic Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: The intricate structures of biological neural networks largely emerge during development, guided by a comparatively compressed blueprint encoded in the genome. The connectivity that emerges from this decoding process is rich in structure, and already equips the organism with functional modules upon birth. This initial structure serves as a scaffold that can be gradually refined and fine-tuned through lifelong experience, via a variety of plasticity mechanisms. Drawing inspiration from this interaction between evolutionary and developmental modes of learning, we use hypernetworks to learn a compressed generative process that generates the connectivity of a modular reservoir. We show that this marriage between curriculum-based meta-learning and modular reservoir computing can generate sparse recurrent networks that solve difficult temporal tasks with minimal training and without concessions to robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受生物神经网络发育过程的启发，提出了一种通过基因组瓶颈蒸馏模块化储备池（modular reservoir）的方法。作者使用超网络（hypernetwork）学习一个压缩的生成过程，从而生成具有模块化结构的储备池连接矩阵。结合课程元学习（curriculum-based meta-learning）与模块化储备池计算（modular reservoir computing），该方法能够生成稀疏循环网络，在最小化训练代价的前提下解决困难的时间任务，且不牺牲鲁棒性。
Motivation: 生物神经网络在发育过程中从压缩的基因组蓝图涌现出丰富的模块化结构，并作为终身学习的支架。现有神经网络通常缺乏这种先天的结构化初始连接，导致训练效率低下或鲁棒性不足。
Method: 提出一个两阶段框架：首先通过超网络学习一个压缩的基因型表示，该表示经过基因组瓶颈后解码为模块化储备池的稀疏连接矩阵；然后利用课程元学习策略，在多个时间任务上逐步优化生成的网络，使其具备良好的泛化能力。
Result: 摘要指出该方法能够生成稀疏循环网络，在困难时间任务上仅需极少的训练即可达到高性能，并且保持鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了将进化发育学习思想与模块化储备池计算结合的有效性，为设计高效、可解释的循环神经网络提供了新途径。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: LEDGER: Scaling Agentic Document Editing with Dependency-aware Graph Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: We introduce LEDGER to tackle the novel context engineering challenge of agentic document editing, where localized edits to long, structured documents must be applied efficiently without breaking cross-references or semantic consistency. LEDGER constructs a lightweight dependency graph that explicitly models document structure, including hierarchical organization, explicit references, implicit dependencies, and semantic relationships. For each edit, graph-guided retrieval selects only the necessary context, avoiding full-document processing while preserving consistency. We evaluate LEDGER on a curated benchmark of 1.9k test cases with various document types and lengths, spanning six state-of-the-art models: LEDGER improves consistency from 56% to 76% across all six models and test scenarios while reducing token usage. Notably, LEDGER with low reasoning effort matches baseline performance at high reasoning effort using fewer tokens, showing that explicit dependency representations can partially substitute for expensive internal reasoning in agentic document editing.

Conclusion: 摘要强调显式依赖表示可有效替代部分内部推理，提升智能体文档编辑的效率与一致性。

papers.title: Memory-Augmented LSTM Autoencoder for Unsupervised Activity Recognition with IMU Sensor Fusion
papers.abstract_en: HAR using Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensors is vital for healthcare monitoring and rehabilitation. Despite deep learning advancements, major challenges remain: reliance on labeled data, multi-sensor fusion complexity, and the limited ability of unsupervised methods to capture spatiotemporal dependencies. These issues are pronounced in real-world scenarios with noisy data, overlapping activities, and missing labels. We propose a fully unsupervised spatiotemporal feature fusion framework using a memory-augmented autoencoder. It enhances activity representations via short temporal windows of multi-sensor IMU data, enabling real-time applications. Our framework extracts hierarchical static features via a Stacked Autoencoder, fusing them within and across sensors. A sequence-to-sequence LSTM Autoencoder then temporally refines these features, incorporating historical motion patterns without labels. We analyze key hyperparameters to identify configurations that maximize feature separability under short-window constraints. Evaluated on DaLiAc and PAMAP2 using realistic inter-class window segmentation, our method achieves 96.6% and 98.4% accuracy, respectively, surpassing supervised baselines and unsupervised approaches. Our method improves feature separability by up to 9% despite shorter temporal windows. While our realistic inter-class segmentation reduces accuracy by ~7%, it was intentionally adopted to better reflect real-world activity transitions and practical relevance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种全无监督的时空特征融合框架，利用记忆增强自编码器处理多传感器IMU数据，用于人体活动识别。通过堆叠自编码器提取静态特征，再由LSTM自编码器进行时序细化，无需标签即可捕获运动模式。在DaLiAc和PAMAP2数据集上分别达到96.6%和98.4%的准确率，超过监督和无监督基线，且特征可分性提升最多9%。
Motivation: 现有HAR深度学习方法依赖标签、多传感器融合复杂，且无监督方法难以捕获时空依赖，在真实场景中面临噪声、重叠活动和标签缺失的挑战。
Method: 提出无监督框架，包括堆叠自编码器用于层内和跨传感器静态特征融合，以及序列到序列LSTM自编码器进行时序特征细化，并引入记忆增强机制以改进特征表示。
Result: 在DaLiAc和PAMAP2上分别取得96.6%和98.4%准确率，超越监督和无监督方法；特征可分性提升最高9%，采用现实跨类窗口分割后准确率下降约7%，但更贴近实际。
Conclusion: 该方法在短时间窗口下仍能有效提取可分特征，适用于实时应用；现实分割牺牲部分准确率但提升了实用相关性。

papers.title: When Does Overlap Help? OSU-Mem and a Cell-Conditional Analysis of Trajectory Memory for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents accumulate interaction trajectories that quickly exceed any practical prompt budget, and existing memory methods either truncate aggressively and lose non-local evidence or retain boilerplate that degrades decision quality. We ask a mechanism question rather than claiming a better general-purpose memory system: when does organizing trajectory memory into overlapping semantic units (OSUs) -- groups of related steps in which one step may belong to several units -- help retrieval over flat or disjoint alternatives? We instantiate this in OSU-Mem, which retrieves from an overlapping OSU pool via budgeted coarse-to-fine expansion, and show its benefit is conditional: overlapping memory helps when the evidence steps a query needs share tool calls or entities, but hurts when those steps are fully heterogeneous and share neither. On a synthetic benchmark where evidence carries such shared structure by construction, OSU-Mem improves over the strongest baseline as the theory predicts; yet on a concatenated, constructed unaugmented $τ$-bench setting its aggregate advantage over flat retrieval vanishes. Splitting queries by whether their evidence shares tools and entities shows this near-tie to be an artifact of mixing query types rather than a property of either method, and ToolBench, a controlled probe built to carry shared structure by design, corroborates the same mechanism via an overlap-vs.-disjoint construction contrast (under a coverage-guided variant), isolating the construction principle rather than validating the full default system. Because the relevant sharing is cheaply estimable from metadata, the analysis yields a metadata-based heuristic for predicting when overlap is likely to improve retrieval. We deliberately isolate the retrieval layer, assessed by retrieval quality and an LLM-mediated evidence-selection stage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长视野LLM智能体轨迹记忆中重叠语义单元（OSU）的检索条件，通过OSU-Mem实例化并分析其帮助与损害的边界。摘要显示当证据步骤共享工具调用或实体时重叠记忆提升检索性能，否则有害；在合成基准上验证了理论预测，但在τ-bench上聚合优势消失，按查询类型拆分发现是混合效应。ToolBench通过受控对比进一步证实了机制。
Motivation: 现有长视野LLM智能体记忆方法要么截断丢失非局部证据，要么保留样板降低决策质量，缺乏对重叠记忆何时真正有帮助的机制理解。
Method: 提出OSU-Mem，将轨迹记忆组织成重叠语义单元，通过预算粗到细扩展检索；并通过合成基准和受控探针（ToolBench）分析重叠与不重叠结构的条件影响。
Result: 合成基准上OSU-Mem在证据共享工具/实体时优于最强基线，但在τ-bench上聚合优势消失；按查询类型拆分后发现近平局是混合假象；ToolBench验证了重叠结构在共享场景下的优势。
Conclusion: 重叠记忆的好处是有条件的，取决于证据步骤是否共享工具调用或实体；分析得出基于元数据的启发式规则，可预测重叠何时改善检索。论文故意隔离检索层，不声称通用系统。

papers.title: Recursive Self-Evolving Agents via Held-Out Selection
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly improved without weight updates by evolving a natural-language artifact, such as reflections, workflows, playbooks, cheatsheets, or optimized prompts, that conditions a frozen policy. Such methods are typically reported as wins on the single benchmark where they help. We study them apples-to-apples and surface a sharper picture. We introduce RSEA, a Recursive Self-Evolving Agent that carries a compact three-layer natural-language state: an imperative strategy, reusable skills, and a procedural playbook. Across generations, RSEA rewrites all three layers from its own trajectories and commits a candidate only if it does not regress on a disjoint held-out split, using a strict keep-better gate. Across four diverse benchmarks, ALFWorld, GAIA, (τ)-bench, and WebShop, and six faithful baselines, ReAct, Reflexion, GEPA, AWM, ACE, and Dynamic Cheatsheet, all evaluated on one shared local backbone, we find three main results. First, no artifact universally wins. RSEA is the strongest single-pass method on ALFWorld, reaching 69.3% compared with 64.6% for ReAct (McNemar (p=0.015)), and reaches 79.4% with retry, the best overall result. However, concrete-workflow induction, represented by AWM, is best on the strong-backbone tool-use tasks. Second, unguarded context evolution is high-variance and unsafe. Dynamic Cheatsheet, which curates context online without a held-out gate, is near-best on ALFWorld at 70.7%, yet collapses on WebShop, with a score of 0.14 compared with 0.43 for ReAct. Third, RSEA's strict held-out selection is what makes recursive self-evolution monotone-safe: it never significantly underperforms the base agent on any benchmark and falls back to vanilla ReAct when evolved context would hurt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出递归自进化智能体RSEA，通过携带三层自然语言状态（策略、技能、剧本）并在迭代中仅当候选版本不降低在独立保留集上的性能时才接受更新，实现安全的自进化。在四个基准和六个基线上的实验表明，无保护的上下文演化会高方差且不安全，而RSEA的严格保留选择保证了单调安全。
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体通过演化自然语言工件（如反思、工作流）来改进，但通常仅在单个基准上有效，缺乏跨基准的公平比较和无保护演化的安全性研究。
Method: 提出RSEA，具有递归自进化机制和三层自然语言状态（策略、技能、剧本），采用严格的保留选择门控：仅当候选版本在独立保留集上不退化时才接受更新。
Result: 在ALFWorld上RSEA单次达到69.3%（优于ReAct的64.6%），重试后达79.4%；但具体工作流归纳方法AWM在强骨干工具使用任务上更优。无保护的Dynamic Cheatsheet在ALFWorld上70.7%但在WebShop上崩溃至0.14（ReAct为0.43）。RSEA从不显著低于基座智能体。
Conclusion: 严格的保留选择使得递归自进化实现单调安全，在多个基准上表现稳健，且无保护演化存在高方差和不安全问题。

papers.title: Model Merging to Evolution: Parameter Space Exploration for Expert Models
papers.abstract_en: Model merging integrates the capabilities of multiple expert models to create strong models for multiple tasks without additional training, thereby reducing computational resource requirements. However, existing methods operate within the convex combination space of expert models, failing to explore high-performance regions outside this space. This paper proposes the MERGEvolve framework, which unifies model merging and evolution within an evolution strategy by treating the merged model as the initialization for evolutionary exploration of the parameter space. During the merging phase, expert models act as deterministic sources to build a strong initial point. The evolution phase then explores the parameter space using random noise. Theoretical analysis shows that MERGEvolve explores regions outside the convex combination space. Extensive experiments on single-task and multi-task benchmarks demonstrate that MERGEvolve consistently achieves performance competitive with advanced model merging baselines. Ablation studies confirm that a high-quality initial point is critical for efficient exploration of the parameter space.
papers.comment: Chao Wang and Yuchen Guo contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MERGEvolve框架，将模型合并与演化策略统一起来：先通过合并多个专家模型构建一个强初始点，再使用随机噪声在该初始点附近进行参数空间演化探索。理论分析表明该方法能够探索专家模型凸组合空间以外的区域。在单任务和多任务基准上的实验显示，MERGEvolve取得了与先进模型合并基线相竞争的性能，消融实验证实了高质量初始点对高效探索的关键作用。
Motivation: 现有模型合并方法局限于专家模型的凸组合空间，无法探索该空间之外可能存在的高性能区域，限制了合并模型的性能上限。
Method: 提出MERGEvolve框架，在演化策略框架下将合并模型作为种群初始化的起点，然后利用随机噪声扰动进行参数空间演化搜索，从而突破凸组合空间的限制。
Result: 在多个单任务和多任务基准上，MERGEvolve的性能与现有的先进模型合并方法相竞争，且消融实验表明初始点的质量对演化探索效率至关重要。
Conclusion: MERGEvolve将模型合并与演化优化统一，实现了对凸组合空间之外参数区域的有效探索，为模型合并研究提供了新思路。

papers.title: GeoISF: Instance Semantic Forest Inspired Large-Scale Cross-View Geo-Localization via Ground LiDAR-to-Satellite Image
papers.abstract_en: The problem of localization on a large-scale satellite image given a frame of query ground view point clouds remains challenging. Existing LiDAR-to-image cross-view localization methods struggle in large-scale scenarios due to limited semantic alignment and the modality gap between point clouds and satellite images. This paper introduces the large-scale LiDAR-to-image geo-localization pipeline called GeoISF. GeoISF introduces an instance semantic forest constructed using WordNet, which enhances temporal semantic representation and discriminative power by integrating semantic trees from multiple frames. By leveraging environmental semantic representation as a shared medium, GeoISF effectively bridges the modality gap and improves semantic matching accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superior performance of GeoISF in large-scale cross-view localization, 13.22 times better than the parallel LiDAR-to-image method in the R@10 metric on the KITTI dataset. The proposed method addresses the existing gap in large-scale LiDAR-to-image cross-view localization, offering a robust solution to the computational and accuracy challenges inherent in such scenarios. We will release the code as an open-source resource available online for the broader research community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GeoISF，一种基于实例语义森林的大规模跨视角地理定位方法，通过WordNet构建语义树增强多帧时序语义表示，弥合地面LiDAR点云与卫星图像之间的模态差异，在KITTI数据集上R@10指标比现有方法提升13.22倍。
Motivation: 现有LiDAR-to-图像跨视角定位方法在大规模场景中面临语义对齐不足和模态差异问题，难以实现精准定位。
Method: 利用WordNet构建实例语义森林，整合多帧语义树以增强时序语义表示和区分能力，并以环境语义表示作为共享媒介桥接模态差异。
Result: 在KITTI数据集上，GeoISF的R@10指标比并行LiDAR-to-图像方法提升13.22倍，验证了大规模跨视角定位的优越性能。

papers.title: Conversational Query Engine for Mixed-Modality Heterogeneous Enterprise Data Sources
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise business intelligence queries span structured warehouses and unstructured document repositories -- modalities with fundamentally different access methods, cost profiles, and correctness semantics. Existing AI-enabled interfaces force users to select the right tool: NL2SQL systems cannot reason over slide decks, and RAG pipelines lack access to live warehouse tables. We present COGNI, a production conversational BI system that treats natural-language analytics as a heterogeneous query processing problem, organized as four architectural layers. First, an indexing layer implements slide-adaptive chunking -- recursive chunking for plain-text slides, hierarchical chunking for structured content such as tables, charts, and key-value blocks - achieving $88.3\%$ on our internal enterprise benchmark. Second, a routing layer built on a LoRA fine-tuned Qwen-2.5-1.5B-Instruct model that produces a dual output - modality decision and complexity assessment at $93.8\%$ accuracy and approximately $7\times$ lower cost than frontier-model. Third, a retrieval layer executes complexity-adaptive pipelines: a self-correcting NL2SQL agent at $93.9\%$ G-Eval, and Recursive Language Models reaching $91.0\%$ on multi-hop synthesis queries. Finally, a caching layer validates query equivalence across multiple dimensions beyond embedding similarity, achieving zero false cache hits and $8.4\times$ latency reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出COGNI，一个面向企业混合模态异构数据源的对话式商业智能（BI）系统。系统将自然语言分析视为异构查询处理问题，包含四个架构层：索引层（幻灯片自适应分块，准确率88.3%）、路由层（基于LoRA微调的Qwen-2.5-1.5B-Instruct模型，模态和复杂度决策准确率93.8%，成本降低约7倍）、检索层（复杂度自适应管线：自纠正NL2SQL代理G-Eval 93.9%，递归语言模型多跳合成查询91.0%）、缓存层（多维度查询等价验证，零假错命中，延迟降低8.4倍）。
Motivation: 现有AI界面（如NL2SQL和RAG）强制用户选择特定工具，无法统一处理结构化仓库和非结构化文档（如幻灯片）等异构数据源，导致查询效率低、成本高。
Method: COGNI采用四层架构：1）索引层：对纯文本幻灯片递归分块，对表格、图表等结构化内容层次分块；2）路由层：使用LoRA微调的Qwen-2.5-1.5B-Instruct模型，同时输出模态决策和复杂度评估；3）检索层：根据复杂度选择自适应管线，包括自纠正NL2SQL代理和递归语言模型；4）缓存层：验证查询等价性（超越嵌入相似度），实现零假错命中。
Result: 在企业内部基准上，索引层达88.3%；路由层准确率93.8%，成本较前沿模型降低约7倍；检索层中NL2SQL代理G-Eval达93.9%，多跳合成查询达91.0%；缓存层实现零假错命中，延迟降低8.4倍。
Conclusion: COGNI通过统一处理结构化与非结构化数据源，显著提升企业BI查询的准确性和效率，并降低了成本。

papers.title: Multimodal and Multiscale Spatial-Temporal Semantic Search and Recommendation with AI Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Semantic search and recommendation of similar documents, such as news and reports about unusual environmental events (e.g., a dead whale washed ashore in Alaska) that contain spatial and temporal information, is a critical task in Geographic Information Retrieval (GIR). This work presents a novel framework that leverages AI foundation models, including Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs), to enable effective similarity search and ranking for such event documents. To support this goal, we introduce two new strategies: (1) CAMERA (Context-Aware Multimodal Event Retrieval Algorithm), which fuses textual and visual information to generate richer embeddings than those derived from text alone; and (2) ASTRA (Adaptive Spatial and Temporal Re-ranking Algorithm), which improves similarity ranking by incorporating scale-dependent spatiotemporal relevance alongside semantic similarity. Experimental results, using a dataset from the Local Environmental Observer Network, demonstrate that our VLM-enhanced methods outperform unimodal, LLM-based approaches in similarity ranking effectiveness. By automatically linking relevant event reports, the proposed framework helps both data curators and the general public gain deeper insights into environmental change and its localized impacts. These findings highlight the potential of AI foundation models to advance GIR through multifaceted, intelligent analysis that integrates key geographic concepts: space, time, scale, and semantics.
papers.comment: 17 pages, accepted for publication in the ACM Transactions on Spatial Algorithms and Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于AI基础模型（LLM和VLM）的框架，用于地理信息检索中的多模态语义搜索和推荐，重点关注包含时空信息的环境事件文档。框架引入两个新策略：CAMERA融合文本和视觉信息生成更丰富的嵌入，ASTRA通过尺度依赖的时空相关性改进相似度排序。实验结果表明，VLM增强方法在相似度排序上优于纯文本LLM方法。
Motivation: 环境事件文档（如搁浅鲸鱼新闻）的语义搜索需要同时处理文本、图像和时空信息，现有方法多基于单模态或未充分利用尺度依赖的时空相关性。
Method: 提出CAMERA算法融合文本和视觉信息生成多模态嵌入，以及ASTRA算法在语义相似度基础上加入尺度敏感的时空重排序。
Result: 在Local Environmental Observer Network数据集上，VLM增强方法在相似度排序上优于单模态LLM方法。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了AI基础模型通过整合空间、时间、尺度和语义等多维地理概念，能够推动地理信息检索的智能化。

papers.title: Beyond the Reranker: Do RAG Retrieval Enhancements Help Once a Strong Reranker Is Present?
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is routinely extended with methods meant to improve retrieval: query expansion, hierarchical and cross-document summarization, graph-based expansion, per-query routing, rank fusion, and corrective re-retrieval. The benefits reported for these methods come almost exclusively from homogeneous corpora, predominantly Wikipedia prose. Whether they hold on the mixed-format collections common in practice, where code, markdown, tables, scientific PDFs, and prose are interleaved within one corpus, has not been measured. To study this directly, we build \textbf{HetDocQA}, a heterogeneous benchmark with \emph{chunker-agnostic} span-overlap relevance labels and collection-disjoint splits, and pair it with MuSiQue and QASPER as homogeneous controls. We evaluate eight methods on a shared backbone, with bootstrap confidence intervals and multiple-comparison correction. A strong cross-encoder reranker accounts for most of the pipeline's quality; beyond it, only two methods yield reliable gains: query expansion and SSCC. SSCC, a per-source calibrated corrector introduced here, sets a separate acceptance threshold for each score source and helps only on heterogeneous data. The remaining reranking and pool-expansion methods in common use, among them hierarchical summarization, graph expansion, routing, and rank fusion, give no reliable gain once that reranker is present.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在强交叉编码重排序器（cross-encoder reranker）存在时，常见的RAG检索增强方法（如查询扩展、分层摘要、图扩展、路由、排名融合等）是否仍能带来提升。通过构建混合格式基准HetDocQA并配合两个同质控制集（MuSiQue、QASPER），实验发现强重排序器已覆盖大部分管道质量；仅查询扩展和新提出的SSCC（按来源校准的正确器）在异构数据上带来可靠增益，其余方法无显著改进。
Motivation: 现有RAG检索增强方法的收益报告几乎全部来自同质语料（如Wikipedia），但在实际应用中常见混合格式集合（代码、Markdown、表格、科学PDF等混杂），其有效性尚未被系统评估。
Method: 构建HetDocQA异构基准，采用与分块器无关（chunker-agnostic）的跨度重叠相关性标签和集合分离划分；基于共享骨干网络评估8种方法，使用bootstrap置信区间和多重比较校正。提出SSCC（per-source calibrated corrector），为每个得分源设置独立接受阈值。
Result: 强交叉编码重排序器承担了管道大部分性能；超过该重排序器后，仅查询扩展和SSCC在异构数据上带来可靠增益，而分层摘要、图扩展、路由、排名融合等常用方法无可靠提升。
Conclusion: 研究提示，在已有强重排序器的情况下，多数RAG检索增强方法不再必要，仅查询扩展和面向异质数据的SSCC有实际价值。

papers.title: CAMI: Cost-Aware Agent-Guided Multi-Indexing for Semantic Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: RAG ingestion pipelines frequently augment search corpus index with semantic enrichment indices (e.g., synthetic queries or summaries generated from corpus chunks) that are subsequently queried alongside the base index to improve retrieval via better alignment between document representations and user intent. While these supplementary representations substantially improve retrieval quality, they introduce a computational bottleneck: the configuration space of enrichment types and generator models is combinatorial, and the cost of exhaustive index-time evaluation scales linearly with corpus size. We introduce CAMI (Cost-Aware Multi-Indexing), a framework that formalizes multi-index construction as a budgeted, multi-objective portfolio selection problem. CAMI targets the upstream decision of which enrichment views to generate and materialize before the retrieval backend is applied. CAMI incorporates three primary mechanisms: (i) an agentic discovery phase that proposes corpus-specific representation templates; (ii) an atomic-unit search procedure that evaluates individual enrichment-model pairs and recombines them via fidelity-local closure to identify synergistic portfolios; and (iii) a confidence-aware promotion schedule that prunes unpromising configurations early, decoupling optimization spend from total corpus size. We evaluate CAMI across diverse retrieval corpora. Our findings reveal that the framework systematically isolates high-recall portfolios under strict budget constraints, outperforming standard content-only baselines in challenging settings by up to 9.4% recall@10. Further, CAMI is able to systematically identify these high-recall portfolios using up to 5x less budget compared to random search baselines, making our approach practical in real production scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAMI框架，将RAG语义检索中多索引构建形式化为预算约束下的多目标组合优化问题。CAMI通过智能体探索、原子单元搜索和置信度剪枝，在严格预算下系统性地筛选出高召回索引组合。实验表明，CAMI在多种检索语料上比标准基线提升最高9.4% recall@10，且仅需随机搜索1/5的预算。
Motivation: 现有RAG流水线引入语义增强索引后，枚举所有可能的增强类型和模型组合的计算成本随语料规模线性增长，实际场景中不可行。
Method: CAMI包含三个机制：(i) 智能体发现阶段生成语料特定的表示模板；(ii) 原子单元搜索评估单个增强-模型对并通过保真度局部闭包重组得到协同组合；(iii) 置信度感知调度提前剪枝无望配置，优化成本与语料规模解耦。
Result: 在多个检索语料上，CAMI在严格预算下达到高召回，相比纯内容基线提升最高9.4% recall@10，且所用预算仅为随机搜索的1/5。
Conclusion: CAMI在资源受限条件下高效选择语义索引组合，使多索引增强检索在真实生产环境中变得可行。

papers.title: ConCise: Training-Free Conclusion-Chain State Compression for Cost-Efficient Multi-Step RAG Services
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has been widely deployed as LLM-powered web services for complex question answering, where iterative retrieval-reasoning rounds deliver strong multi-hop accuracy. However, this paradigm causes historical documents and reasoning traces to accumulate across rounds, inflating cumulative input tokens approximately as $O(N^2)$ with progressively increasing noise density. In API-based service architectures, such growth directly amplifies per-request billing cost, network payload, and response latency. Existing compression approaches rely on pretrained modules or GPU-level KV cache access, introducing model hosting overhead incompatible with API-native, Serverless, and edge-side deployments. To address this issue, this paper proposes ConCise, a training-free state-layer protocol that restructures cross-round context transmission for multi-step RAG services. Specifically, ConCise replaces raw-text accumulation with an append-only chain of structured conclusions, compressing cumulative context growth from $O(N^2)$ to approximately $O(N)$. Furthermore, a fused generation mechanism is introduced to jointly emit reasoning and conclusions in a single API call, eliminating repeated input billing from serial dual-invocation overhead. Extensive experiments across twelve paired configurations spanning three models, two datasets, and two representative frameworks demonstrate that ConCise achieves 64.63\% average token savings while maintaining acceptable accuracy, providing a plug-and-play, deployment-friendly solution for cost-efficient multi-step RAG service optimization.
papers.comment: to be published in IEEE ICWS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ConCise，一种无需训练的结论链状态压缩协议，用于多步RAG服务，将累积上下文增长从O(N²)压缩至约O(N)，并通过融合生成机制避免重复API调用开销。实验表明在保持可接受准确率的前提下平均节省64.63%的token。
Motivation: 多步RAG中历史文档与推理痕迹累积导致输入token约O(N²)增长，增加API计费、网络负载和延迟。现有压缩方法依赖预训练模块或GPU级KV缓存，不适用于API原生、无服务器或边缘部署。
Method: 提出ConCise协议，用仅追加的结构化结论链替代原始文本累积，将上下文增长从O(N²)压缩至O(N)；并设计融合生成机制，在单次API调用中联合输出推理和结论。
Result: 在三个模型、两个数据集、两个框架的12种配置中，平均节省64.63%的token，同时保持可接受的准确率。
Conclusion: ConCise是一种即插即用、部署友好的解决方案，适用于成本高效的多步RAG服务优化，无需额外训练或硬件依赖。

papers.title: Carolina Guide: A Multi-Agent RAG System with Institutional Guardrails for Academic Policy Assistance
papers.abstract_en: University students often struggle to navigate complex academic policies, leading to advising bottlenecks and delayed access to critical information. Although large language models (LLMs) offer promise for automated assistance, their tendency toward hallucination and inability to enforce institutional constraints make them unsuitable for high-stakes policy guidance without careful architectural design. We present Carolina Guide, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system for academic policy assistance at the University of South Carolina (USC). The system employs a modular multi-agent pipeline with institutional guardrails to provide citation-supported, policy-grounded answers to student queries while refusing unsafe requests such as course recommendations or personalized advising. We evaluate the system on a 90 query test set across 6 departments, achieving 98.9% retrieval success at the >= 2 threshold (genuinely relevant results) with the first relevant chunk at rank-1 for 98.9% of queries (MRR at 10 for rel >= 2 = 0.989). Through systematic baseline comparisons and ablation studies, we show that each architectural component-MMR reranking, adequate retrieval context (k=20), and citation enforcement-contributes measurable practical value despite limited statistical power at 90 queries. The evaluation of the guardrail on 30 adversarial queries demonstrates Safety F1 of 0.89, correctly refusing 86% of unsafe queries while maintaining 93% coverage of benign queries. These results show that production-ready LLM systems for institutional policy guidance require rethinking standard RAG patterns to prioritize safety, transparency, and departmental autonomy over conversational sophistication.

Motivation: 大学生难以导航复杂的学术政策，导致咨询瓶颈和信息延迟。LLM 存在幻觉倾向且无法强制机构约束，不适合直接用于高风险政策指导。
Method: 采用模块化多智能体管道，结合 RAG、MMR 重排序、充足检索上下文（k=20）、引用强制机制，并设置护栏以拒绝不安全查询（如课程推荐或个性化建议）。
Result: 在 90 个跨6学院的查询集上，检索成功率（rel>=2）为 98.9%，首个相关块在 rank-1 的比例为 98.9%（MRR@10=0.989）。在 30 个对抗查询上，安全 F1 达 0.89，正确拒绝 86% 的不安全查询，同时保持 93% 的良性查询覆盖率。
Conclusion: 生产级 LLM 系统用于机构政策指导需重新思考标准 RAG 模式，优先考虑安全性、透明度和部门自主性，而非对话复杂度。

papers.title: The Voronoi Bottleneck: Capacity-Aware Dense Retrieval for Product Search
papers.abstract_en: Dense embedding retrieval compresses all relevance information into a single inner product, imposing a fundamental geometric limit -- the Voronoi Bottleneck -- on the number of query-document relevance patterns expressible at fixed embedding dimension (d). We make three contributions. (1) Unified capacity theory. We prove that Voronoi complexity and sign-rank are equivalent for top-1 retrieval, yielding tight dimension bounds and a computable diagnostic, the Capacity Utilization Score (CUS), that predicts per-query retrieval failure with AUC (> 0.8) without relevance labels. (2) Diagnosis. CUS identifies two capacity regimes -- moderate ((δ\gtrsim 1)), where density-aware training yields measurable gains, and vacuous ((δ\ll 1)), where it does not -- giving practitioners an a priori check before investing in retraining. (3) DART training. We introduce AT-DW-InfoNCE, an Adaptive-Temperature Density-Weighted contrastive objective with formally derived optimal weighting (α^* = 2.0). On a 100K-query synthetic product-search corpus with controlled relevance structure, DART improves +1.9 Recall@100 over a same-data InfoNCE baseline ((84.9 \pm 0.0) vs. (83.0 \pm 0.3); 8 seeds, (p < 0.001)), outperforming focal loss and temperature-schedule alternatives. DART requires zero inference-time overhead -- it is a drop-in training objective that improves any dual-encoder system.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Voronoi瓶颈理论，揭示密集嵌入检索在固定维度下表达能力的几何极限。引入容量利用率评分（CUS）无需标签即可预测检索失败，并提出自适应温度密度加权对比学习目标（AT-DW-InfoNCE）。在合成产品搜索语料上，DART训练提升Recall@100达1.9个点（84.9 vs 83.0，p<0.001）。
Motivation: 密集嵌入检索将所有相关性信息压缩到单个内积中，在固定嵌入维度下存在几何极限（Voronoi瓶颈），限制了可表达的查询-文档相关性模式数量，导致检索失败无法提前诊断。
Method: 证明Voronoi复杂度与sign-rank在top-1检索中等价，导出紧维度界和可计算指标CUS。提出AT-DW-InfoNCE损失函数，包含最优密度权重α*=2.0，是一种即插即用的训练目标。
Result: 在100K查询的合成产品搜索语料上，DART相比InfoNCE基线Recall@100提升1.9（84.9±0.0 vs 83.0±0.3，8次随机种子，p<0.001），且无推理开销。CUS在AUC>0.8下预测检索失败。
Conclusion: 论文给出了容量理论、诊断工具和改进训练目标，可直接提升任意双编码器系统的检索质量，无需改变推理流程。

papers.title: How Do LLMs Cite? A Mechanistic Interpretation of Attribution in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) aims to enhance the trustworthiness of Large Language Models (LLMs) by grounding their outputs in external documents, often using inline citations for verifiability. However, the faithfulness of these citations -- whether the model genuinely uses a source to generate an answer -- remains a critical, unverified assumption. This paper offers the first mechanistic account of how a large language model decides whether to attach an inline citation while answering a factoid question. Using the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model in a controlled experimental environment based on the PopQA dataset, we employ an activation patching approach. We map the underlying mechanism responsible for citation, discovering that it is not a single, localized component but a distributed, multi-stage "attributional ensemble" of attention heads and MLP layers. We show that amplifying or attenuating only those critical heads and MLPs repairs over 90% of missed citations and eliminates 69% of spurious ones on PopQA without harming answer accuracy. Although gains on the multi-document HotpotQA benchmark are modest, the same component set still moves citation rates in the intended direction, indicating that the underlying mechanism is not dataset-specific. The results reveal a potential disconnect between the model's apparent reasoning and its internal computational pathway, suggesting that inline citations can create a false sense of security.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次从机制角度解释了大语言模型在检索增强生成（RAG）中如何决定是否添加内联引用。使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型和PopQA数据集，通过激活修补方法发现引用决策并非由单一组件负责，而是由注意力头和MLP层构成的分布式多阶段“归因集成”控制。只需调整这些关键组件即可修复超过90%的遗漏引用并消除69%的虚假引用，且不损害答案准确性；在HotpotQA上效果虽有局限，但同一组件集仍可按预期方向调整引用率。结果表明模型表面推理与内部计算路径可能存在脱节，内联引用可能造成虚假安全感。
Motivation: 尽管RAG旨在通过外挂文档和内联引用增强LLM的可信度，但引用的忠实性（模型是否真正使用来源生成答案）仍是未经检验的假设，缺乏机制层面的理解。
Method: 采用激活修补（activation patching）方法，在PopQA数据集上对Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型进行受控实验，定位并分析决定是否生成内联引用的关键注意力头和MLP层，形成“归因集成”（attributional ensemble）。
Result: 在PopQA上，仅增强或抑制关键组件可修复超过90%的遗漏引用并消除69%的虚假引用，同时答案准确率不受影响；在HotpotQA上效果较温和，但同一组件集仍将引用率向预期方向移动。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了LLM引用机制是分布式且多阶段的，与表观推理过程不一致，提示内联引用可能给用户带来虚假的安全感。机制在不同数据集上具有泛化性，但改进多文档基准的效果有限。

papers.title: ReasonRec: A Reasoning-Augmented Multimodal Agent for Unified Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal recommenders excel at feature fusion but remain opaque and inefficient decision-makers, lacking explicit reasoning and self-awareness of uncertainty. We introduce ReasonRec, a reasoning-augmented multimodal agent structured around a three-stage explicit reasoning pipeline. Specifically, we propose a reasoning-aware visual instruction tuning strategy that systematically transforms diverse recommendation tasks into unified CoT prompts, enabling the VLM to explicitly articulate intermediate decision steps. Additionally, our evidence-horizon curriculum progressively enhances the reasoning complexity to better handle cold-start and long-tail user scenarios, significantly boosting model generalization. Furthermore, the uncertainty-guided delegation mechanism empowers the agent to assess its own confidence, strategically allocating computational resources to optimize both recommendation accuracy and inference efficiency. Comprehensive experiments on four standard recommendation tasks across five real-world datasets demonstrate that ReasonRec achieves over 30% relative improvement in key ranking metrics compared to state-of-the-art multimodal recommenders. Crucially, ReasonRec substantially reduces inference latency by dynamically delegating up to 35% of queries to efficient sub-models without compromising accuracy. Extensive ablation studies further confirm that each proposed reasoning and planning mechanism individually contributes substantially to ReasonRec's overall effectiveness. Collectively, our results illustrate a clear pathway towards interpretable, adaptive, and efficient multimodal recommendation through explicit reasoning and agentic design.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReasonRec 是一个推理增强的多模态推荐智能体，通过三阶段显式推理管线（推理感知视觉指令微调、证据-难度课程、不确定性引导委派）统一处理多种推荐任务。在五个真实数据集的四个标准任务上，关键排名指标相比现有多模态推荐器提升超过30%，同时将推理延迟降低35%。
Motivation: 现有多模态推荐器擅长特征融合但决策不透明且低效，缺乏显式推理和对自身不确定性的感知。
Method: 提出三阶段显式推理管线：1）推理感知视觉指令微调，将推荐任务转化为统一 CoT 提示；2）证据-难度课程，逐步增加推理复杂度以改善冷启动和长尾场景的泛化；3）不确定性引导委派机制，让模型评估自身置信度并动态分配计算资源以平衡准确率和效率。
Result: 在五个真实数据集上，相对于 SOTA 多模态推荐器，关键排名指标（如 Recall、NDCG）相对提升超过30%；同时通过动态委派将高达35%的查询交给高效子模型，显著降低推理延迟而不牺牲准确性。
Conclusion: ReasonRec 通过显式推理和智能体设计，为可解释、自适应且高效的多模态推荐提供了清晰路径。

papers.title: SafeGEO: Understanding Generative Engine Optimization Risks in Recommendation Agents
papers.abstract_en: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) lets content owners rewrite web content to increase their visibility in generative systems. In recommendation agents, this creates a risk that seller-controlled sources make flawed products appear better supported than they are. We study this risk by asking whether recommendation agents preserve utility-aligned decisions when seller-controlled sources are rewritten for GEO. To make this question measurable, we construct SafeGEO, an evaluation suite with 22 GEO attack variants across 600 recommendation cases. We empirically show that GEO attacks can promote flawed target products. On average, they increase the rate at which such flawed products enter the recommendation set by up to 83.2%. We further study whether agent-side design choices can mitigate this risk and show that simple defenses, including defensive prompting and structured evidence checks, reduce harmful target promotion by up to 39.2%. These gains are substantial but do not restore the no-GEO performance, showing that GEO remains a serious risk despite developer-side mitigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成式引擎优化（GEO）在推荐代理中的安全风险：卖家控制的源内容经过GEO改写后可能使劣质产品看起来得到更好支持，从而误导推荐代理。作者构建了包含22种GEO攻击变体和600个推荐案例的评估套件SafeGEO，实验表明GEO攻击使劣质产品进入推荐集的比率平均提升83.2%；简单的防御策略（如防御性提示和结构化证据检查）可将有害目标的推荐降低最多39.2%，但无法完全消除风险。
Motivation: 推荐代理中，卖家可通过GEO改写内容提高其产品在生成系统中的可见度，这可能导致代理推荐劣质产品，损害用户利益。现有研究缺乏对此风险的量化评估和防御方法。
Method: 构建SafeGEO评估套件，包含22种GEO攻击变体（如改写产品描述、添加虚假证据等）和600个推荐案例，通过实验测量攻击效果；并测试简单的代理端防御策略（防御性提示、结构化证据检查）的缓解效果。
Result: GEO攻击使劣质产品进入推荐集的比率平均提升83.2%；防御策略可将有害目标推荐降低最多39.2%，但无法完全恢复无GEO时的性能。
Conclusion: GEO在推荐代理中是严重的安全风险，现有的简单防御虽有效但不足以完全抵消攻击影响，需要更强的鲁棒性措施。

papers.title: DBpedia-Enriched Company Representation for B2B Lead Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Selecting which companies to approach is a central challenge in business-to-business (B2B) sales, where decisions are often based on manual research and fragmented information sources. Modern B2B sales platforms centralize company records and use learned company embeddings to support tasks such as recommending and prioritizing potential clients. In this study, we investigate whether enriching these company embeddings with Semantic knowledge from DBpedia improves downstream interaction-prediction performance, within a pipeline that integrates structured company attributes and text embeddings deployed on a real B2B platform. We evaluate the learned embeddings on a downstream interaction prediction task using real user feedback data from the platform. Results show that DBpedia enrichment improves downstream performance, with gains observed on ranking and discrimination metrics.
papers.comment: 4 pages. Preprint of a paper accepted at the ESWC 2026 Industry Track
