papers.title: Generating in the Limit with Infinitely Many Hallucinations
papers.abstract_en: The classic paradigm of language identification in the limit models learning as a game between an adversary, who reveals strings from an unknown target language, and a learner tasked with identifying that language. The recently introduced framework of language generation in the limit shifted the objective to better reflect modern language modeling, requiring the learner to produce valid, unseen strings from the target language. Related work highlighted a fundamental tension: a broad coverage of the target often comes at the cost of validity. We introduce a new notion of precision and recast this problem as the classic recall-precision trade-off. We analyze generation in the limit under varying constraints on enumeration, novelty, and validity, aimed at reflecting settings closer to those encountered by large language models. A key contribution is our analysis of learners that are not eventually valid: we allow infinitely many mistakes, provided their frequency tends to zero so that precision remains one. We show that this relaxation can strictly increase recall when the adversary permanently withholds a large portion of the target language. We also study a continuous relaxation of the novelty constraint that requires only a fixed fraction of outputs to be novel. Taken together, our results move toward a more realistic model of language generation where occasional errors and repetitions are unavoidable, but their rates are controlled.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在语言生成极限学习框架下，研究当允许无限次错误但错误频率趋近于零时，如何通过放松有效性约束来提升召回率。作者分析了不同约束下的精確率-召回率权衡，并证明这种松弛在对手永久隐藏大部分目标语言时能严格提高召回率。
Motivation: 现有语言生成极限框架中，覆盖广泛性与有效性之间存在根本矛盾，而现实中的大语言模型不可避免会产生偶尔错误和重复。
Method: 引入新的精確率定义，将问题建模为经典的精確率-召回率权衡，并分析在枚举、新穎性和有效性约束下的生成极限。允许学习者无限次错误但错误频率趋于零，同时研究新穎性约束的连续松弛。
Result: 证明当对手永久保留大部分目标语言时，放松有效性约束可以严格提高召回率。
Conclusion: 该工作向更现实的语言生成模型迈进，其中偶尔的错误和重复不可避免但可控制其比率。

papers.title: From Regulatory Approvals to Patents: Cross-Domain Linking for Cardiovascular Device Traceability
papers.abstract_en: Linking FDA-approved medical devices to their underlying United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) patents enables critical applications such as recall root-cause analysis, M&A-driven IP discovery, and technology trajectory mapping. However, this cross-domain entity linking task remains unexplored due to severe *semantic gaps*: FDA documents focus on clinical outcomes, while patents describe technical mechanisms, yielding minimal lexical overlap. We formalize medical device-patent linking as a challenging cross-domain entity linking problem characterized by label scarcity and domain shifts. Using cardiovascular devices as a high-impact, representative domain featuring diverse technologies, high recall rates, and abundant disclosures, we construct a benchmark with 434 devices, 698K patents, and 585 high-fidelity expert-verified pairs. To address these challenges, we propose Bridge-MedDevKG, a coarse-to-fine framework that integrates (1) **MedDevOnto**, a domain-specific ontology that anchors device concepts via three-tier UMLS normalization; (2) **Multi-signal candidate generation** fusing company affiliation, semantic similarity, and ontology-weighted entity overlap; and (3) **Heterogeneous reranking** with multi-signal scoring and XGBoost classification on hard negatives. Our approach achieves a conservative lower-bound recall of 91.6% on the gold standard with 50.9% noise reduction, substantially outperforming LLM baselines under comparable evaluation. The resulting MedDevKG provides 6.8M high-confidence links, laying a scalable foundation for regulatory-IP integration across medical specialties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究跨领域实体链接任务，将FDA批准的医疗器械与USPTO专利进行关联，构建了心血管设备领域的基准数据集，并提出Bridge-MedDevKG框架，包括领域本体MedDevOnto、多信号候选生成和异构重排序，实现了91.6%的召回率和50.9%的噪声降低。
Motivation: 将FDA批准的医疗器械与专利链接有重要应用，但两大领域存在严重语义鸿沟：FDA文档侧重临床结果，专利描述技术机制，词汇重叠极少，且标签稀缺和领域偏移使得该任务尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出Bridge-MedDevKG框架，包括：(1) MedDevOnto领域本体，通过三层UMLS标准化锚定设备概念；(2) 多信号候选生成，融合公司关联、语义相似度和本体加权的实体重叠；(3) 异构重排序，结合多信号评分和基于XGBoost的硬负样本分类。
Result: 在包含434个设备、698K专利和585个专家验证的高保真对基准上，该方法在标准集上达到91.6%的保守下界召回率，噪声降低50.9%，显著优于LLM基线。最终构建的MedDevKG包含680万高置信度链接。
Conclusion: 该工作为跨医学专业的监管-专利集成提供了可扩展的基础，但论文仅以心血管设备领域为代表性案例，其他医学领域的泛化性有待验证。

papers.title: UniCA: Bi-directional Cross-Attention with Positive Similarity Loss for Robust Multi-Modal Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal retrieval has become increasingly critical for handling the growing volume of integrated visual-textual data in real-world applications, but existing frameworks rely on implicit fusion via text encoder self-attention, limiting explicit cross-modal semantic alignment. To address this gap, this paper proposes UniCA (Unified Cross-Attention Encoder), a multi-modal retrieval model with four key innovations: 1) a bi-directional cross-attention (Bi-CA) block that enables active semantic exchange between visual and textual tokens prior to concatenation, capturing inter-modal correlations more efficiently. 2) a Positive Similarity Loss that optimizes absolute semantic proximity between query and positive candidate embeddings. 3) a streamlined dataset UMR-S10 (Universal Multimodal Retrieval Sample 10%) to reduce computational costs while retaining semantic diversity and task representativeness. 4) an experimental validation on the WebQA benchmark demonstrates that UniCA outperforms the baseline model across Hybrid and Image-Text tasks, achieving improvements of up to 4.09% in Recall@5, 3.28% in Recall@10, and 3.96% in MRR@1 for the hybrid task. UniCA provides an efficient and robust solution for multi-modal retrieval, lowering deployment barriers through its lightweight dataset and enhanced fusion mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniCA多模态检索模型，通过双向交叉注意力（Bi-CA）实现视觉与文本token的主动语义交互，并引入正相似度损失（Positive Similarity Loss）优化查询与正例的绝对语义距离。在WebQA基准上，该模型在混合任务中Recall@5提升4.09%，Recall@10提升3.28%，MRR@1提升3.96%。同时提供了一个轻量化数据集UMR-S10以降低计算成本。
Motivation: 现有多模态检索框架依赖文本编码器自注意力进行隐式融合，缺乏显式的跨模态语义对齐，限制了检索性能。
Method: 提出UniCA模型，包含：1) 双向交叉注意力块，在拼接前让视觉与文本token主动交换语义信息；2) 正相似度损失，直接优化查询与正例嵌入的绝对语义接近度；3) 轻量化数据集UMR-S10，保留语义多样性和任务代表性。
Result: 在WebQA基准上，UniCA在混合任务中相比基线模型Recall@5提升4.09%，Recall@10提升3.28%，MRR@1提升3.96%。
Conclusion: UniCA通过增强融合机制和轻量数据集，为多模态检索提供了高效、鲁棒的解决方案，降低了部署门槛。

papers.title: HMARS: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Memory System for Long-Context Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long-context reasoning requires models to access, retrieve, and integrate evidence scattered across documents, dialogues, and accumulated interaction histories. Standard retrieval-augmented generation reduces this problem to top-$K$ chunk retrieval, but such passive access can discard relevant evidence before reasoning begins, especially when relevance depends on broader context. We propose HMARS, a hierarchical multi-agent memory system that treats long contexts as managed memory rather than a flat retrieval corpus. Sub-agents maintain grounded access to bounded memory regions, mid-agents manage regional context and provide query-specific coordination, and a frontier model performs final reasoning over retrieved evidence pages. To evaluate this view, we construct two diagnostic benchmarks targeting evidence breadth and context-dependent relevance. Across long-document and multi-turn memory tasks, HMARS achieves the best overall performance against retrieval, reranking, full-context, graph-based, and agentic long-context baselines. Evidence coverage analysis further shows that its gains come from retrieving the required supporting evidence more completely, rather than merely changing the final answer prompt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HMARS，一种分层多智能体记忆系统 (hierarchical multi-agent memory system)，将长上下文视为可管理的记忆而非扁平检索语料。子智能体维护有限记忆区域的接地访问，中层智能体管理区域上下文并协调查询，前沿模型在检索到的证据页上进行最终推理。在两个诊断基准上，HMARS 在长文档和多轮记忆任务中优于检索、重排序、全上下文、基于图和多智能体长上下文基线。
Motivation: 标准检索增强生成 (RAG) 将长上下文推理简化为 top-K 块检索，但这种被动访问可能在推理开始前丢弃相关证据，尤其是当相关性取决于更广泛上下文时。
Method: 提出分层多智能体记忆系统，包含三个层次：子智能体 (sub-agents) 维护对有限记忆区域的接地访问，中层智能体 (mid-agents) 管理区域上下文并提供特定查询的协调，前沿模型 (frontier model) 执行最终推理。
Result: 在构建的两个诊断基准上，HMARS 在长文档和多轮记忆任务中实现了最佳整体性能，超过了检索、重排序、全上下文、基于图和多智能体长上下文基线。证据覆盖分析表明，其增益来自更完整地检索所需支持证据，而非仅仅改变最终答案提示。
Conclusion: HMARS 证明了将长上下文视为分层管理记忆的有效性，能够通过更完整的证据检索提升推理性能。

papers.title: Agentic Safety is an Epistemic Property, Not a Behavioral One
papers.abstract_en: Contemporary AI safety spans pre-training interventions, post-training alignment, deployment-time controls, monitoring, and red-teaming. These methods are necessary, but they primarily certify snapshots of system behavior. As AI systems become more capable, dynamic, embodied, and self-improving, this snapshot view becomes incomplete: safety depends not only on whether a system behaves acceptably now, but whether it remains correctable as it learns, adapts, acts, and modifies itself over time. This paper argues that safety should therefore be treated as an epistemic property of the evolving learner, not merely a behavioral property of the current policy. We introduce teachability as the capacity to preserve future corrective leverage under bounded human, institutional, or environmental intervention. We argue that advanced systems can retain visible competence while eroding the representational, algorithmic, or meta-decision conditions needed for future correction. Safe advanced AI systems must not only behave acceptably now; they must remain teachable later.
papers.comment: To appear in proceedings of ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文认为传统AI安全方法主要验证系统行为的快照，但随着AI系统变得更加动态、具身和自我改进，安全应被视为学习者的一种认知属性，而非当前策略的行为属性。作者引入了“可教性”（teachability）概念，指在有限干预下保持未来纠正能力的能力。高级系统可能表面表现良好，但侵蚀了未来纠正所需的表征、算法或元决策条件。
Motivation: 现有AI安全方法（预训练干预、对齐、部署控制、监控、红队测试）主要验证系统行为快照，不足以应对未来更动态、自我改进的AI系统，因为这些系统可能表面上表现可接受，但逐渐丧失可纠正性。
Method: 论文提出将安全视为认知属性，并定义“可教性”作为衡量系统在遭受有限人类、机构或环境干预后仍能保持纠正能力的关键概念。
Result: 该论文未提供定量实验结果或具体实证数据，主要提出理论框架和观点。
Conclusion: 论文主张高级AI系统不仅要当前行为可接受，还必须保持未来的可教性，强调安全是动态的认知属性而非静态行为快照。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Auditing LLM-Governed Social Robots with Culture-Specific Moral Gradients
papers.abstract_en: LLM-governed social robots increasingly decide who receives real-world assistance first. As prioritization norms vary across cultures by age, status, and group size, failure to calibrate pluralistically can scale into unequal access. Yet LLM moral audits remain English-centered, rarely test embodied contexts, leaving pluralistic calibration as an urgent diagnostic gap amid intensifying LLM-robot deployment. We introduce a gradient-based audit framework for multilingual evaluation of LLM moral trade-off behavior against cultural preference gradients. Grounded in nine cross-domain social robotics reviews (>8,000 papers), we derive symmetry-controlled scenarios across care, education, and services, translating the Moral Machine Experiment's "whom to spare" into "whom to assist first" dilemmas with preserved identity trade-offs (many vs. few; young vs. old; higher vs. lower status). We audit four LLMs across four country-language pairs in four prompting regimes (57,600 decisions), benchmarked against country-specific MME preference gradients. Ordinal concordance tests whether models differentiate cultural contexts; a governance typology maps vulnerabilities in gradient differentiation, directional tendency, and deliberation. We find persistent, culturally asymmetric gradient tracking failures that prompting alone cannot reliably correct: quality calibration is nearly twice as strong for Western-language decisions as for Chinese and Japanese; high determinism in majority-first trade-offs often erases cross-cultural gradients; partial sensitivity to age- and status-based norms risks sidelining minorities. Prompting effects are uneven; only contrastive exemplars yield consistent gains, while reasoning-only prompts can worsen tracking. Our results motivate multilingual, pluralistic audits as an LLM-robot pre-deployment gate and suggest model factors are a more robust lever than prompting alone.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Proceedings of the 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM驱动的社交机器人在多元文化背景下分配援助优先级的问题，提出了一种基于梯度的审计框架，用于多语言评估LLM的道德权衡行为。作者从超过8000篇社会机器人学综述中推导出对称控制场景，将道德机器实验的“救谁”转化为“先帮助谁”困境，跨护理、教育、服务领域。审计了4个LLM在4个国家-语言对、4种提示模式下的57,600个决策，发现文化梯度跟踪失败普遍存在，仅靠提示无法可靠修正，西语言决策的质量校准几乎是中国和日语决策的两倍强。
Motivation: 现有LLM道德审计以英语为中心，很少测试具身上下文，未能多元校准可能导致不平等访问。随着LLM-机器人部署加剧，需要多语言、多元文化的审计诊断。
Method: 引入基于梯度的审计框架，通过跨9个社会机器人学综述（>8000篇论文）推导对称控制场景，将道德机器实验的“救谁”转化为“先帮助谁”困境，保持身份权衡（多vs少；年轻vs年老；高vs低地位）。审计4个LLM在4个国家-语言对、4种提示模式（57,600个决策），使用MME偏好梯度作为基准，进行序数一致性检验和治理类型学映射。
Result: 发现持续存在的文化不对称梯度跟踪失败：西语言决策的质量校准几乎是中、日语决策的两倍强；多数优先权衡中的高确定性常常抹去跨文化梯度；对基于年龄和地位的规范部分敏感可能导致边缘化少数群体。提示效果不均匀，仅有对比性示例产生一致增益，仅推理提示可能恶化跟踪。
Conclusion: 结果支持多语言、多元文化审计作为LLM-机器人部署前的一道门控，并提示模型因素比提示更稳健的杠杆。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PIXELRAG: Web Screenshots Beat Text for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Augmenting large language models (LLMs) with retrieved web text has become a dominant paradigm, yet the web is not natively textual: existing systems depend on complex parsing pipelines that linearize HTML and discard layout, visual structure, and formatting. We introduce PixelRAG, a new retrieval-augmented method that represents websites in their native visual form and performs retrieval and reading entirely in pixel space, enabling an end-to-end architecture that eliminates text abstraction. PixelRAG is, to our knowledge, the first pipeline to operate over a full Wikipedia corpus in this form, scaling to a datastore of 30 million screenshot images with an efficient visual retrieval index. Built on an existing visual embedding model (i.e., Qwen3-VL-Embedding), PixelRAG further fine-tunes this model on screenshot data with carefully curated contrastive training data. Retrieved screenshots are then fed directly as pixel inputs to a VLM, without intermediate text conversion. PixelRAG consistently outperforms both no-retrieval and text-based RAG baselines, most surprisingly on widely studied text-centric tasks such as NQ and SimpleQA. It also achieves strong gains on multimodal open-domain QA (e.g., MMSearch), benchmarks over noisy news corpora (e.g., LiveVQA), and agentic benchmarks (e.g., MoNaCo), improving accuracy by up to 18.1% over text-based baselines. Finally, pixel representations enable a new efficiency lever for RAG through image compression, achieving up to 3x token cost reduction at lower resolutions while maintaining accuracy. Our results challenge the necessity of text representations in web retrieval, suggesting that web RAG can operate directly in the web's native visual form while improving both performance and efficiency.
papers.comment: Our code is available at https://github.com/StarTrail-org/PixelRAG
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PixelRAG，一种基于截图（像素空间）的检索增强生成方法，直接使用网页截图进行检索和阅读，无需文本解析。该方法在 Wikipedia 3000 万张截图数据集上建立索引，基于 Qwen3-VL-Embedding 微调，在多个任务上超越基于文本的 RAG，并可通过图像压缩降低 token 成本。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 系统依赖复杂的 HTML 解析管道，丢失布局和视觉结构。本文旨在利用网页的原始视觉形式进行检索和阅读，避免文本抽象。
Method: 提出 PixelRAG 流水线：使用视觉嵌入模型（Qwen3-VL-Embedding）在截图数据上微调，构建 3000 万张截图的视觉检索索引；将检索到的截图直接作为像素输入给 VLM，无需文本转换。
Result: 在文本中心任务（NQ, SimpleQA）上一致超越无检索和基于文本的 RAG；在多模态开放域问答、噪声新闻语料库和智能体基准上准确率提升高达 18.1%；通过图像压缩实现高达 3 倍 token 成本降低。
Conclusion: 结果表明网页 RAG 可以直接在网页的原始视觉形式下运行，提升性能和效率，挑战了文本表示的必要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Crowded Embedding Space: A Mean-Field Mechanism for Emergent Marginalization in Retrieval-Augmented Agents
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generative agents rely on retrieval for grounding, yet are typically evaluated on a query-by-query basis. This isolates interactions that are geometrically coupled in a shared embedding space. For example, we show that the high document density required to serve majority interests (e.g., generic "Crime" movies) can geometrically overcrowd the retrieval neighborhood of a semantically similar minority (e.g., "Film Noir"), effectively expelling minority content from top-$k$ results. We introduce a formal framework to analyze how such goal collisions in dense retrieval induce fundamental performance limits and emergent fairness issues inherent to spatial crowding. In our static analysis, we demonstrate that for a fixed embedding space, a phase transition occurs where minority user goals suffer a catastrophic collapse in performance as the density of majority goals increases. We then extend this to a dynamic model and derive a non-linear Fokker-Planck equation that governs the evolution of document embeddings as the agent updates them to maximize retrieval accuracy. Our analysis reveals that this local relevance objective triggers an emergent global mechanism that systematically marginalizes minority interests. We prove that such objectives drive the system to self-organize into a state that exclusively serves majority interests. These results provide a theoretical foundation for understanding a critical grounding failure mode in retrieval-augmented agents.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究检索增强生成代理中嵌入空间的几何拥挤效应，发现服务于多数兴趣的高文档密度会挤压语义相似的少数兴趣的检索邻域，导致少数内容被排斥出 top-k 结果。通过静态分析和动态模型（Fokker-Planck 方程），证明局部相关性目标会引发系统自组织为仅服务多数兴趣的状态，从而产生本质上的边缘化问题。
Motivation: 检索增强代理通常按查询独立评估，忽略了共享嵌入空间中的几何耦合。论文旨在揭示这种耦合如何导致多数兴趣的文档密度对少数兴趣的检索性能产生灾难性影响，从而引发公平性问题。
Method: 提出形式化框架分析密集检索中的目标冲突。静态分析中，在固定嵌入空间下推导多数目标密度增加时少数目标性能的相变。动态分析中，推导非线性 Fokker-Planck 方程描述文档嵌入在代理更新以最大化检索准确性时的演化。
Result: 静态分析显示少数用户目标的性能在多数目标密度超过阈值时发生灾难性下降。动态分析证明局部相关性目标会导致系统自组织为仅服务多数兴趣的状态，系统性边缘化少数利益。
Conclusion: 该工作为检索增强代理中的关键接地失败模式提供了理论基础，揭示了嵌入空间拥挤导致的固有性能极限和新兴公平问题。

papers.title: Operating Regimes of Decentralized Learning Under Mobility and Bandwidth Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized learning is a promising paradigm for collaborative training in mobile and pervasive systems, as it avoids a central coordinator and does not require sharing raw data. Yet, most analyses rely on idealized communication assumptions that break down in wireless settings, where connectivity is intermittent, topology changes due to mobility, and bandwidth is limited. We study decentralized averaging under client asynchrony, time-varying contact graphs, and technology-dependent throughput constraints. We implement a fully decentralized protocol that overlaps synchronization with local training and supports partial tensor-level transfers when contacts end early. Using Random Waypoint mobility and multiple wireless technologies (Bluetooth LE, LTE, and Wi-Fi), we quantify how network dynamics and link capacity impact convergence. We identify three operating regimes: (i) inter-contact time largely dictates convergence via mixing, (ii) partial updates are often well tolerated when contacts are frequent, and (iii) very dense contact patterns can trigger contention, reducing effective throughput. These findings provide a practical lens to reason about decentralized learning deployments over realistic wireless systems, highlighting when improving connectivity, increasing bandwidth, or mitigating contention is most impactful.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE SmartComp 2026. This work was partially supported by the PNRR Project SoBigDatait (IR0000013). S. Sabella, C. Boldrini, and M. Conti were partly funded by the PNRR project FAIR (PE00000013), while A. Passarella and L. Valerio were partially supported by the PNRR project RESTART (PE00000001)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究去中心化学习在移动和带宽受限环境下的运行机制。通过实现完全去中心化的协议，考虑客户端异步、时变接触图和依赖技术的吞吐量约束，利用随机路点移动模型和多种无线技术（蓝牙LE、LTE、Wi-Fi）进行量化分析，识别出三种运行模式：接触间隔时间决定混合收敛、局部更新在频繁接触下可被容忍、密集接触模式导致竞争降低有效吞吐量。这些发现为在实际无线系统上部署去中心化学习提供了实践指导。
Motivation: 现有去中心化学习分析大多基于理想化通信假设，不适用于无线环境中的间歇连接、拓扑变化和带宽限制。本文旨在量化网络动态和链路容量对收敛的影响。
Method: 提出一个完全去中心化的协议，将同步与本地训练重叠，并支持联系结束时部分张量级传输。采用随机路点移动模型和多种无线技术（蓝牙LE、LTE、Wi-Fi）进行模拟。
Result: 识别出三种运行模式：(i)接触间隔时间主要通过混合决定收敛；(ii)当接触频繁时，局部更新通常可被容忍；(iii)非常密集的接触模式可能引发竞争，降低有效吞吐量。
Conclusion: 结果为在现实无线系统上推理去中心化学习部署提供了实用视角，突出了何时改善连接、增加带宽或减轻竞争最有效。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 结果为在现实无线系统上推理去中心化学习部署提供了实用视角，突出了何时改善连接、增加带宽或减轻竞争最有效。

papers.title: Multi-Agent DRL for QoS and Energy Optimization in RIS-Enabled Open-RAN Industrial 6G TN/NTN Networks
papers.abstract_en: Industrial 6G networks require ultra-reliable, low-latency, and energy-efficient connectivity in dynamic and blockage-prone environments, where conventional terrestrial deployments often fail to ensure stable coverage. Hence, in this paper, we propose a RIS-enabled Open-RAN framework for integrated terrestrial/non-terrestrial (TN/NTN) industrial 6G networks, in which UAVs-mounted reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) cooperate with ground radio units and a high-altitude platform (HAP) to enhance connectivity for dense industrial IoT devices. Owing to the high dimensionality and strong coupling among decision variables, conventional optimization techniques become computationally intractable. To overcome this limitation, the joint optimization problem of data rates, latency, and energy consumptions is formulated as a decentralized partially observable Markov decision process (Dec-POMDP) and solved using a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning framework. Simulation results show improvements of up to 75\% in data rate, 25\% latency reduction, and 16\% energy savings compared with state-of-the-art learning-based and non-RIS baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of RIS-assisted Open-RAN intelligence for industrial 6G networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业6G网络中动态和易阻塞环境下的可靠、低延迟、节能连接问题，提出了一种基于RIS（可重构智能表面）的Open-RAN框架，集成地面与非地面网络（TN/NTN）。通过将联合数据速率、延迟和能耗优化问题建模为去中心化部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（Dec-POMDP），并采用多智能体深度强化学习求解。仿真结果显示，与先进的基于学习的基线和无RIS基线相比，数据速率提升75%，延迟降低25%，能耗节省16%。
Motivation: 工业6G网络在动态和阻塞环境中需要超可靠、低延迟和节能的连接，传统地面部署难以保证稳定覆盖，而RIS和Open-RAN的结合有望解决这一问题。
Method: 提出RIS-enabled Open-RAN框架，集成无人机搭载的RIS、地面无线电单元和高空平台（HAP）；将联合优化问题建模为Dec-POMDP，并采用多智能体深度强化学习求解。
Result: 仿真结果显示数据速率提升75%，延迟降低25%，能耗节省16%，优于先进的基于学习的和非RIS基线。
Conclusion: RIS辅助的Open-RAN智能框架在工业6G网络中的有效性得到验证，尤其在动态和阻塞环境下的性能提升显著。

papers.title: A Systems-Level Analysis of Sensitivity, Robustness, and Stability in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are often evaluated using final answer accuracy, even though their failures can originate from preprocessing, retrieval, context packing, or generation. This paper presents a controlled empirical study of RAG sensitivity, robustness, and stability across 56 experimental runs. We evaluate how chunk size, retrieval depth (top k), embedding-based reranking, probabilistic retrieval noise, and repeated seeded runs affect retrieval, context packing, and generation behavior. Using a fixed 500-question QA subset mapped to 20,958 unique corpus contexts, we analyze both final answer metrics and intermediate failure modes. Across these experiments, retrieval-oriented metrics improved under broader retrieval settings, while downstream exact-match and F1 scores often behaved non-monotonically. We also observe preprocessing-induced answer loss under smaller chunk sizes, progressive degradation under retrieval corruption, and higher observed variance in broader retrieval regimes. These findings suggest that RAG evaluation should include sensitivity, robustness, stability, and multi-stage failure analysis rather than relying only on final answer accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对检索增强生成（RAG）系统的敏感性、鲁棒性和稳定性进行了系统级的实证研究，通过56组实验分析了分块大小、检索深度、重排序、概率性噪声和随机种子对检索、上下文打包和生成阶段的影响。结果发现检索指标在更宽泛的检索设置下提升，但下游精确匹配和F1分数呈现非单调变化，并观察到预处理导致的答案丢失、检索退化下的渐进恶化以及高方差问题。
Motivation: 现有RAG评估通常仅依赖最终答案准确性，忽略了来自预处理、检索、上下文打包和生成等多阶段的潜在失败模式。
Method: 在固定500题QA子集（映射到20,958个独特语料上下文）上进行56组实验，系统变化分块大小、top-k检索深度、嵌入重排序、概率检索噪声及重复种子运行，分析最终指标和中间失败模式。
Result: 更宽泛的检索设置改善了检索指标，但下游精确匹配和F1分数呈非单调变化；小分块大小导致预处理答案丢失；检索噪声引起渐进退化；宽检索区间方差更高。
Conclusion: RAG评估应包含敏感性、鲁棒性、稳定性和多阶段失败分析，而非仅依赖最终答案准确率。

papers.title: HyBIRD: Hyperbolic Bridge Retrieval and Diagnosis for Methodology Inspiration Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Methodology Inspiration Retrieval (MIR) asks a system to retrieve prior papers whose methods can inspire a new research proposal. Unlike general scientific retrieval, the central challenge is not topical similarity but whether a candidate paper provides concrete mechanisms that can instantiate an abstract methodological need. Existing MIR dense retrievers provide strong paper-level rankings, but the returned lists do not expose how proposal needs are bridged by retrieved methods, where evidence is weak, or which complementary snippets may help. We propose HyBIRD, a frozen-anchor framework that treats MIR as hyperbolic bridge retrieval and post-hoc method diagnosis. HyBIRD keeps a strong MIR dense retriever fixed, learns lightweight point, cone, and factorized hyperbolic bridge variants, and uses LLM-assisted method blocks for post-hoc explanation and evidence selection. On the MIR benchmark, the factorized bridge reaches 59.034 mAP while preserving the dense anchor's strong retrieval behavior. More importantly, HyBIRD converts ranked papers into inspectable query need profiles, factor coverage, maturity views, and complementary evidence bundles. The results suggest that hyperbolic geometry is most useful as calibrated structure over a dense anchor, rather than as a standalone replacement for dense retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HyBIRD框架，用于方法论灵感检索（MIR），将检索建模为双曲桥检索，并后验诊断方法。HyBIRD保持强密集检索器固定，学习轻量双曲变体，并使用LLM辅助方法块进行后验解释和证据选择。在MIR基准上，因式化桥达到59.034 mAP，同时保留密集锚的强检索行为，并将排名论文转换为可检查的查询需求概况。
Motivation: 现有MIR密集检索器提供强论文级排名，但未暴露查询需求如何由检索方法桥接、证据薄弱处或哪些互补片段可能有帮助。
Method: HyBIRD采用冻结锚框架，将MIR视为双曲桥检索和后验方法诊断，学习点、锥和因式化双曲桥变体，并使用LLM辅助方法块进行后验解释和证据选择。
Result: 在MIR基准上，因式化桥达到59.034 mAP，同时保留密集锚的强检索行为。
Conclusion: 双曲几何最有用作为密集锚上的校准结构，而非作为密集检索的独立替代。

papers.title: LLM-Ideoplasticity: Measuring Ideological Plasticity in the Political Behavior of LLMs as a Context-Conditioned Distribution
papers.abstract_en: We argue, with systematic empirical evidence, that a large language model's political ideology is not a fixed point, but a conditional distribution $\mathbb{P}($position$\mid$context$)$ over a real political space. We evaluate nine current LLMs using a unified measurement framework anchored by VAA-CHES projection models, which map responses onto three validated dimensions (lrgen, lrecon, galtan) across six contextual axes. Our findings reveal high sensitivity to context: persuasive framing and under-represented languages displace coordinates by up to 0.57 and 0.52 units, respectively, while chain-of-thought reasoning often amplifies rather than dampens paraphrase instability. Despite this local plasticity, the model cohort occupies a remarkably narrow Overton envelope overall, occupying roughly one-third the spread of major European parties. Supported by a multi-trait multi-method (MTMM) analysis, we conclude that a single point cannot summarize LLM political behavior; it must be characterized as a shape. Our code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/sakhadib/LLM-Ideoplasticity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过系统性实证证据论证大型语言模型（LLM）的政治意识形态并非固定点，而是依赖于上下文的条件分布。使用VAA-CHES投影模型，在六个上下文轴上评估了九个LLM，发现其政治立场对上下文高度敏感，但整体上只占据狭窄的Overton范围。
Motivation: 现有观点常将LLM的政治立场视为固定点，忽略其上下文依赖性。本文旨在量化这种可塑性并揭示其分布特性。
Method: 提出“意识形态可塑性”概念，使用VAA-CHES投影模型将LLM的回答映射到三个政治维度（lrgen, lrecon, galtan），并在六个上下文条件（包括劝说框架、低资源语言、思维链等）下测量其位置偏移。
Result: 劝说框架和低资源语言分别使坐标位移最多0.57和0.52单位；思维链推理往往放大而非抑制释义不稳定性；整体上所有模型的政治立场范围仅相当于欧洲主要政党宽度的三分之一。
Conclusion: 一个单点不能概括LLM的政治行为，需将其描述为一种形状。基于多特质多方法分析支持了该结论。代码和数据已公开。

papers.title: Ground Truths in Suicide Research: The Current State of AI-Based Suicide Detection in Social Media
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and social media data have led to growing optimism about the ability to detect suicide risk at scale. However, the empirical foundations of this work remain unclear. This article provides a synthesis of current research on AI-based suicide detection in social media, drawing on a recent umbrella review of 22 systematic reviews covering studies up to 2022, alongside an ongoing literature review extending the analysis to more recent work. Across these sources, we identified 195 relevant studies, which are documented in a detailed supplementary dataset outlining their key characteristics and findings (see Supplementary Information). Analysis of these studies reveals consistent patterns, including rapid growth, concentration on a small number of platforms, reliance on textual and English-language data, and repeated use of similar datasets. Most importantly, the majority of studies rely on indirect labeling strategies that do not involve direct, individual-level validation of suicide risk. Instead, ground truth is typically inferred from observable features of online content, such as linguistic markers or community membership. As a result, the predictive task often shifts from identifying individuals at risk to classifying posts that contain suicidal or distress-related language, limiting the ability of current approaches to detect individuals who do not express such content explicitly online. These findings suggest that current advances in model performance should be interpreted with caution. Progress in this field is likely to depend less on improving model performance and more on ensuring that model predictions meaningfully correspond to suicide risk as it is experienced in real life.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对基于社交媒体数据的AI自杀检测研究进行了系统综述，基于22篇系统综述的伞状综述及后续文献扩展，识别出195项研究。分析表明该领域快速增长但集中于少数平台和语言，且绝大多数研究依赖间接标签策略（如语言标记或社区归属）而非直接验证个体自杀风险，导致模型实际预测的是自杀相关语言而非风险个体。当前模型性能提升应谨慎解读。
Motivation: 尽管AI和社交媒体数据带来自杀风险规模化检测的乐观前景，但该领域的实证基础尚不明确，多数研究缺乏对自杀风险直接、个体层面的验证，现有方法可能无法识别未明确表达自杀意图的个体。
Method: 采用伞状综述方法，整合22篇系统综述（覆盖至2022年的研究），并辅以持续文献回顾扩展至近期工作，最终筛选出195项相关研究，构建包含关键特征和发现的补充数据集。
Result: 研究发现该领域研究数量快速增长，但集中于少量平台和英语文本数据，数据集重复使用现象普遍。大多数研究使用间接标签策略，将预测目标从识别风险个体转化为分类具有自杀或痛苦语言特征的帖子，导致模型实际表现需谨慎解释。
Conclusion: 当前AI自杀检测模型的性能进步应谨慎对待；该领域的真正进展更依赖于确保模型预测与实际自杀风险（而非仅社交媒体语言）的对应关系。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Insidious by Design: Implications of Large Language Model algorithmic bias for the Global South
papers.abstract_en: \begin{quote} The biases in Large Language Models' (LLMs) outputs remain inadequately theorised, particularly from the perspective of the Global South. This article reports on a small-scale exploratory study in which identical prompts were submitted to four major LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Copilot), firstly, prompting for stories using names suggestive of specific racial and gender communities, and secondly asking questions about `development'. Drawing on critical AI scholarship and postcolonial theory, we argue that LLM outputs are patterned in ways that reproduce racial hierarchies, gender asymmetries, and Western-centric epistemic frameworks. We argue that these biases are insidious: they operate below the threshold of both obvious error and overt prejudice, and instead are subtly embedded in narrative structure and emotional template. Simply put, women, in LLM narratives have rich interior lives, while men make plans. Black people face hardships while white people navigate the world with agency. And explanations as to the economic world order fail to consider Southern explanations. The models perform plausibility while reproducing dominance. We conclude that universities require structural critique of these technologies rather than unreflective adoption, and that critical AI literacy must engage seriously with questions of whose knowledge systems are reproduced and legitimated, or marginalised and undermined.

papers.title: When Medical Safety Alignment Fails: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on High-Risk Medical Queries
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical and health-related questions, yet their safety in high-risk medical scenarios remains poorly understood. We introduce \textsc{MedHarm}\footnote{Code and data will be released upon acceptance. Due to the sensitive nature of high-risk medical queries, data access will be available to qualified researchers upon request.}, a high-risk medical safety benchmark with 1,100 medically grounded queries across 10 safety-critical categories, including toxicology, pharmacology, covert poisoning, anesthesia, and fetal harm. Unlike broad medical QA benchmarks, \textsc{MedHarm} targets realistic clinical, educational, and technical prompts that require refusal, caution, or safe redirection rather than direct helpfulness. We evaluate 15 LLMs spanning general-purpose, medical-purpose, closed-source, and downstream SFT models, together with 4 representative guardrail models. Results reveal a substantial gap between apparent alignment and medical safety: aligned models can still produce unsafe or actionable responses, medical fine-tuning can amplify harmful specificity, and external guardrails reduce some failures while introducing brittle blocking and weak safe helpfulness. These findings show that medical safety cannot be inferred from general alignment or medical capability alone, highlighting the need for domain-specific stress testing before deploying LLMs in safety-critical medical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了MedHarm，一个包含1,100个高风险医疗查询的基准，涵盖毒理学、药理学、隐蔽投毒、麻醉和胎儿伤害等10个安全关键类别。评估了15个LLM和4个护栏模型，发现对齐模型仍会产生不安全回答，医疗微调可能放大有害具体性，外部护栏虽减少部分失败但引入脆弱阻塞和弱安全帮助。
Motivation: 大语言模型在医疗场景中使用日益增多，但其在高风险医疗问题上的安全性尚不清楚，现有基准缺乏针对需要拒绝或谨慎回应的现实临床、教育和技术提示。
Method: 构建MedHarm基准，包含1,100个医学问题，分为10个安全类别；评估15个LLM（通用、医疗专用、闭源和下游SFT模型）及4个护栏模型。
Result: 对齐模型仍可能产生不安全或可操作回应；医疗微调可能增加有害特异性；外部护栏减少部分失败但同时导致阻塞和弱安全帮助。
Conclusion: 医疗安全不能从通用对齐或医疗能力推断，需要领域特定的压力测试才能在高风险医疗应用中部署LLM。

papers.title: "AI Watermarking": Bridging Policy Discourse and Technical Capabilities
papers.abstract_en: The widespread deployment of generative artificial intelligence (AI) models has raised serious concerns about the proliferation of AI-generated content. This has led to a surge of interest in, and demand for, reliable tracking and detection mechanisms for content that is AI-generated, such as watermarking, metadata tagging, content tagging, and more. The problem has captured the attention of policymakers as well as the popular media, and a spate of recent bills in the US have sought to regulate the spread of AI content, and enforce or promote methods to track and label it. This work performs a critical analysis of the policy discourse surrounding generative AI content transparency in the US and EU. Through a broad document selection methodology, we first collect a broad corpus of documents containing legislative language and policy-relevant discourse on the topic. We then analyze these through inductive coding, and leverage our coding to systematize these documents, identifying key patterns, gaps, and open questions. We identify critical points of disconnect between policy and technological capabilities and practice, and we highlight and discuss potential ambiguities and pitfalls raised by the trends in our corpus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对美国和欧盟关于生成式AI内容透明度的政策话语进行批判性分析。通过收集立法语言和政策相关文档语料库，采用归纳编码方法系统化这些文档，识别政策与技术能力之间的脱节点、歧义和陷阱。
Motivation: 生成式AI的广泛部署引发了AI生成内容泛滥的担忧，但政策制定者对技术能力的理解可能存在偏差。需要系统分析政策话语与技术现实之间的差距。
Method: 采用广泛的文档选择方法收集包含立法语言和政策相关话语的语料库，然后通过归纳编码对文档进行系统化分析，识别关键模式、差距和开放问题。
Result: 发现政策与技术能力和实践之间存在关键的脱节点，并强调了语料库趋势中潜在的歧义和陷阱。
Conclusion: 政策制定者需更深入地理解AI水印等技术的能力与局限，以避免产生误导性法规。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Concentration and Retrieval Instability in Embedding Spaces: Implications for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Embedding-based retrieval systems rely on the assumption that geometric proximity in highdimensional representation spaces reflects semantic relevance. However, high-dimensional geometry induces concentration phenomena that can reduce the discriminative power of similarity measures and can destabilize nearest-neighbor retrieval. This work studies distance concentration, cosine concentration, contrast collapse, hubness, and retrieval instability through controlled numerical experiments across multiple synthetic distributions. The results show that similarity signals progressively lose contrast as dimension increases, leading to unstable retrieval behavior and structural bias in nearest-neighbor selection. A simplified Retrieval-Augmented Generation experiment further suggests that these effects can degrade grounding reliability upstream of generation. These findings motivate geometry-aware diagnostics and robustness-oriented retrieval strategies for embedding-based AI systems. The experiments are intentionally synthetic in order to isolate intrinsic geometric effects. papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过合成数据实验，系统研究高维嵌入空间中距离浓度、余弦浓度、对比崩溃、hubness和检索不稳定性等几何现象，并测试其对检索增强生成（RAG）的影响。结果表明，随着维度增加，相似性信号对比度下降，导致检索不稳定和近邻选择的结构性偏差，可能削弱RAG的接地可靠性。
Motivation: 现有嵌入检索系统假设高维空间中的几何邻近性反映语义相关性，但高维几何的浓度现象可能降低相似度量的判别力，使检索不稳定，影响下游任务可靠性。
Method: 通过受控数值实验，在多种合成分布上研究距离浓度、余弦浓度、对比崩溃、hubness和检索不稳定性；并设计简化RAG实验评估这些效应对生成质量的影响。
Result: 摘要报告相似性信号在高维下逐渐失去对比度，导致检索行为不稳定和近邻选择的结构性偏差；简化RAG实验表明这些效应可能削弱接地可靠性。
Conclusion: 研究结果提示嵌入型AI系统需要几何感知的诊断和鲁棒性导向的检索策略。实验有意采用合成数据以隔离内在几何效应，但未在真实嵌入上验证。

papers.title: $M^3 QuestionIng$: Multi-modal Multi-span Medical Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: The growing adoption of AI in healthcare, particularly in preventive care, highlights the critical need for accessibility and precision in Medical Question Answering (MedQA). In recent years, significant efforts have been made to develop multi-span medical question-answering systems, where the answer to a query may span multiple sections or paragraphs of a source document. However, existing systems fall short of aligning with real-world scenarios, where source documents often include both textual and visual content, requiring answers to incorporate images for better comprehension. To address this gap, we propose $M^3QAFrame$, a multi-modal, multi-span medical question-answering framework that leverages visual cues to enhance the generation of comprehensive answers drawn from diverse textual and visual spans. The model takes the context, query, and images as input and outputs an answer containing both textual answers and relevant images. The text and image embeddings are processed using a transformer-based architecture to determine the sentence and image relevance. We curate a multi-modal, multi-span medical question-answering ($M^3 QuestionIng$) dataset containing queries, medical contexts, associated medical images, and extractive answers. Additionally, each query-answer pair is labeled with user intent and query type to enhance query and context comprehension. Extensive experiments show that our approach consistently outperforms existing methods across various evaluation metrics.

papers.title: TextClusterLab: An Integrated Framework for Reliable Text Clustering Studies
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, text clustering has become a critical technique for applications including intent discovery, topic mining, and recommendation systems. However, evaluating text clustering algorithms remains challenging since many real-world textual datasets are not suitable for clustering assessment due to ambiguous semantic boundaries, the high dimensionality of embeddings, and inconsistent cluster structure. Current clustering dataset generators are designed for numerical data, providing limited support for text-specific benchmarking. This paper introduces TextClusterLab, a comprehensive framework for text clustering research. TextClusterLab offers a Large Language Model (LLM)-driven text clustering dataset generator to produce synthetic text datasets for evaluating clustering algorithms. This generator supports setting various clustering attributes, such as class imbalance, intra-cluster compactness, and inter-cluster diversity. These generated datasets can serve as practical benchmarks for testing the robustness and versatility of text clustering algorithms in diverse scenarios. Moreover, we introduce a benchmark to verify whether a text dataset is suitable for clustering evaluation. Therefore, TextClusterLab provides an integrated framework for reproducible and comprehensive text-specific clustering research. Our TextClusterLab is publicly available at https://github.com/research-paper-code/TextClusterLab, and some synthetic example datasets with various attributes are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/DW-irlab/TextClusterLab.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍TextClusterLab，一个用于文本聚类研究的综合框架，包含基于大语言模型的文本聚类数据集生成器，支持设置类别不平衡、簇内紧密度和簇间多样性等属性，并提供基准测试以验证数据集是否适合聚类评估。

Method: 提出TextClusterLab框架，包括一个由大语言模型驱动的文本聚类数据集生成器，可生成具有可控属性的合成文本数据集，以及一个用于验证数据集聚类适用性的基准。
Result: 框架公开了生成的数据集和代码，但摘要未报告具体的实验数值或性能比较。
Conclusion: TextClusterLab旨在提供可复现且全面的文本聚类研究框架，支持鲁棒性和通用性测试。

papers.title: The Interference Gap: Comparing Retrieval Bounds in Human Memory and RAG Systems
papers.abstract_en: How do retrieval bounds compare between human episodic memory and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems under semantic interference? We present a unified signal detection theory (SDT) framework that applies to both, and use it to fit behavioral and computational data in matched paradigms. Both systems show logarithmic accuracy decline with association count (fan), but humans exhibit lower interference sensitivity ($α/σ= 0.41$) than dense passage retrieval ($α/σ= 0.67$), with cognitively-inspired HippoRAG falling between the two ($α/σ= 0.44$). Behavioral experiments ($N = 112$) and simulations validate the framework; parameter recovery confirms identifiability ($r \geq .93$) and model comparison favors the logarithmic specification over a power-law alternative ($Δ$BIC $> 15$). We discuss encoding specificity, temporal context binding, and retrieval gating as candidate mechanisms whose causal role remains to be established. Six falsifiable predictions connect cognitive memory research with AI retrieval evaluation.

TL;DR: 本文提出统一信号检测理论（SDT）框架，比较人类情景记忆与检索增强生成（RAG）系统在语义干扰下的检索边界。两者均显示关联数量（fan）增加时准确率对数下降，但人类干扰敏感性（α/σ=0.41）低于稠密段落检索（α/σ=0.67），受认知启发的HippoRAG居中（α/σ=0.44）。行为实验（N=112）和模拟验证框架，参数恢复可识别（r≥.93），模型比较支持对数形式而非幂律（ΔBIC>15）。讨论编码特异性、时间上下文绑定和检索门控作为候选机制，并提出六个可证伪预测。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏统一框架比较人类记忆与RAG系统在语义干扰下的检索边界，论文填补这一空白。
Method: 构建基于信号检测理论（SDT）的统一框架，通过行为实验和模拟数据，拟合人类与RAG系统的干扰曲线。
Result: 人类干扰敏感性（α/σ=0.41）低于稠密段落检索（0.67），HippoRAG（0.44）介于之间；参数恢复相关性≥0.93，对数模型优于幂律模型（ΔBIC>15）。
Conclusion: 人类记忆在语义干扰下优于当前RAG系统，但候选机制的因果作用仍待验证；提出的六个可证伪预测连接认知记忆研究与AI检索评估。

papers.title: ADEPT: An Entropy-Driven Dual-Strategy Agent for Interactive Video Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: This research aims to solve the challenge of video retrieval from massive datasets, caused by ambiguous user queries. Prevailing single-round retrieval paradigms face a performance bottleneck, as they lack effective feedback mechanisms to handle complex search intentions. The root cause is the "Intent-Query Gap", where users' intent cannot be captured by a simple text query. To solve this, we propose the ADEPT framework: a training-free agent that pioneers an entropy-driven decision engine to efficiently guide dialogue by dynamically selecting between ASK and REFINE strategies. Experiments on two challenging datasets demonstrate that ADEPT significantly outperforms all non-interactive, heuristic, and Video-LLM baselines. The core contribution of this work is an efficient and interpretable entropy-driven interactive strategy that sets a new performance benchmark for the field of interactive video retrieval.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Published in IEEE ICASSP 2026
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP), pp. 9442-9446, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ADEPT框架，一个无需训练的熵驱动双策略代理，用于交互式视频检索。该框架通过动态选择ASK（询问）和REFINE（精炼）策略来引导对话，以解决模糊查询导致的意图-查询差距问题。在两个数据集上的实验表明，ADEPT显著优于非交互式、启发式和视频-LLM基线。
Motivation: 现有单轮视频检索范式缺乏有效反馈机制，无法处理用户复杂搜索意图，存在意图-查询差距，导致性能瓶颈。
Method: 提出ADEPT框架，包含一个熵驱动的决策引擎，通过计算不确定性动态选择ASK或REFINE策略，无需额外训练。
Result: 在两个挑战性数据集上，ADEPT显著优于所有非交互式、启发式和视频-LLM基线方法。
Conclusion: 熵驱动的交互策略高效且可解释，为交互式视频检索设立了新的性能基准。

papers.title: meta-pipe: An LLM-agent pipeline for end-to-end automated systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.abstract_en: Objective: To describe the architecture and design rationale of meta-pipe, an open-source large language model (LLM)-agent pipeline that integrates the complete systematic review and meta-analysis (SR/MA) workflow -- from literature search through statistical analysis, manuscript generation, and quality assurance -- with mandatory human oversight at critical decision points. Study Design and Setting: We developed a 10-stage modular pipeline integrating Claude (Anthropic; Opus 4 for reasoning, Haiku 3.5 for classification) for LLM-assisted screening and extraction, Python (~3,600 lines of code) for automation, R (meta, metafor, gemtc, netmeta) for statistical analysis, and Quarto for manuscript rendering. Five mandatory human decision points enforce oversight. We systematically compared meta-pipe's capabilities with five existing SR automation tools based on published documentation as of March 2026. Results: meta-pipe offers four capabilities not available in any single existing tool: automated manuscript generation from analysis outputs, semi-automated GRADE assessment, overclaim detection (12 predefined patterns), and dual-paradigm network meta-analysis (Bayesian and frequentist). Estimated API cost is $15-30 per typical 5-10 study review. No validation data are reported; this is a system description, not a validation study. Conclusion: End-to-end AI-assisted evidence synthesis is architecturally feasible as an open-source tool with mandatory human oversight. Formal validation reproducing published Cochrane reviews is underway and essential before routine use.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍meta-pipe，一个基于LLM-agent的开放源码管道，集成了系统综述和元分析的完整工作流，包括文献检索、统计分析、手稿生成和质量保证，并在关键决策点设置强制人工监督。系统由10个模块组成，使用Claude进行筛选和提取，Python自动化，R进行统计分析，Quarto渲染手稿。与五个现有工具比较，meta-pipe提供了自动手稿生成、半自动GRADE评估、过度声明检测和双范式网络元分析等独特功能，每次典型综述的API成本预计15-30美元。
Motivation: 现有系统综述自动化工具缺乏端到端集成，且未充分结合LLM能力与强制人工监督。
Method: 开发10阶段模块化管道，集成Claude（Opus 4推理，Haiku 3.5分类）、Python代码、R统计包（meta, metafor, gemtc, netmeta）和Quarto渲染，设置五个强制人工决策节点。
Result: meta-pipe提供了四种现有单一工具不具备的能力：自动手稿生成、半自动GRADE评估、12种模式的过度声明检测、贝叶斯和频率学派双范式网络元分析。
Conclusion: 端到端AI辅助证据合成在架构上可行，但正式验证（如复制已发表Cochrane综述）正在进行中，在常规使用前必不可少。

papers.title: LUMEN: Cost-Transparent Multi-Agent Pipeline for Automated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Systematic reviews and meta-analyses (SR/MA) remain the gold standard for evidence synthesis, yet completing one typically requires 67 weeks and substantial expert effort. Recent large language model (LLM) systems have demonstrated strong performance on individual SR phases - screening (otto-SR: 96.7% sensitivity), extraction (Gartlehner et al.: 91.0% accuracy), and search (TrialMind: 0.83 recall) - but no study has reported what it actually costs to run an end-to-end pipeline, how cost distributes across phases, or how architectural choices affect the cost-quality trade-off. We present LUMEN, an open-source multi-agent pipeline that automates six SR/MA phases using 11 specialized LLM agents with deliberate model routing. We evaluate LUMEN on seven datasets: five self-conducted domain reviews (psychiatry, psychology, surgery, vaccinology, cardiology) and two SYNERGY screening benchmarks. Across 13 ground-truth-comparable outcomes, LUMEN achieves 100% directional agreement with published meta-analyses, with effect sizes within 1% for homogeneous study designs. The primary contribution is the first empirical cost and operational characterization of such a pipeline: a complete review costs 19 to 29 USD (median 22.65 USD), with title-abstract screening and data extraction together dominating expenditure. A three-arm extraction ablation reveals a phase-dependent architecture reversal: multi-agent design hurts screening but is essential for extraction, producing 5.7x more poolable analyses than single-model alternatives while eliminating clinically dangerous direction errors. A two-dataset screening benchmark demonstrates that model ranking is domain-dependent and not transferable across review topics. All code and cost logs are publicly available.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures. Open-source implementation and cost logs available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LUMEN是一个开源的多智能体管道，使用11个专门的LLM代理自动化系统评价和Meta分析的六个阶段。在七个数据集上评估，LUMEN与已发表的Meta分析达到100%的方向一致性，效应量差异在1%以内。主要贡献是首次经验性地报告了端到端管道的成本：完成一次完整评价需要19至29美元（中位数22.65美元），其中标题-摘要筛选和数据提取占据主要支出。消融实验揭示了阶段依赖的架构反转：多智能体设计在筛选阶段有害，但在提取阶段必不可少。
Motivation: 尽管已有LLM系统在单个系统评价阶段表现良好，但尚无研究报告端到端管道的实际成本、成本分布以及架构选择对成本-质量权衡的影响。
Method: 提出了LUMEN，一个包含11个专门LLM代理的多智能体管道，采用谨慎的模型路由，自动化系统评价和Meta分析的六个阶段。在七个数据集上评估，包括五个自建领域评价和两个SYNERGY筛选基准。
Result: LUMEN在13个可比较的基准上达到100%的方向一致性，效应量差异在1%以内。一次完整评价成本为19-29美元（中位数22.65美元）。三臂提取消融实验表明，多智能体设计在筛选阶段降低性能，但在提取阶段产生5.7倍可合并分析，并消除临床危险的方向错误。模型排名是领域依赖的，不可跨主题转移。
Conclusion: LUMEN展示了成本透明、开源的多智能体管道在自动化系统评价中的可行性，并强调了架构选择的阶段依赖性。所有代码和成本日志已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tool-Augmented Spatiotemporal Reasoning for Streamlining Video Question Answering Task
papers.abstract_en: Video Question Answering (VideoQA) task serves as a critical playground for evaluating whether foundation models can effectively perceive, understand, and reason about dynamic real-world scenarios. However, existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with simultaneously modeling spatial relationships within video frames and understanding the causal dynamics of temporal evolution on complex and reasoning-intensive VideoQA task. In this work, we equip MLLM with a comprehensive and extensible Video Toolkit, to enhance MLLM's spatiotemporal reasoning capabilities and ensure the harmony between the quantity and diversity of tools. To better control the tool invocation sequence and avoid toolchain shortcut issues, we propose a Spatiotemporal Reasoning Framework (STAR) that strategically schedules temporal and spatial tools, thereby progressively localizing the key area in the video. Our STAR framework enhances GPT-4o using lightweight tools, achieving an 8.2% gain on VideoMME and 4.6% on LongVideoBench. We believe that our proposed Video Toolkit and STAR framework make an important step towards building autonomous and intelligent video analysis assistants. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/fansunqi/VideoTool.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个视频工具包（Video Toolkit）和时空推理框架（STAR），增强多模态大语言模型在视频问答任务中的时空推理能力。通过策略性调度时空工具逐步定位视频关键区域，在VideoMME上提升8.2%，在LongVideoBench上提升4.6%。
Motivation: 现有MLLM在复杂视频问答中难以同时建模帧内空间关系和时间因果动态。
Method: 构建可扩展的视频工具包，并提出STAR框架，通过策略性调度时空工具序列避免工具链捷径问题。
Result: 使用轻量工具增强GPT-4o，在VideoMME和LongVideoBench上分别获得8.2%和4.6%的绝对增益。
Conclusion: 该工作为构建自主智能视频分析助手迈出重要一步，代码已开源。
